title: Nash Core in Multiwinner Election
summary:
In the approval-based committee selection problem, a committee is said to be in the core if no subset of voters has an incentive to deviate by selecting a \emph{blocking} committee of proportional size, such that every voter in the deviating group strictly prefers the blocking committee.
  We consider the setting where candidates can be selected fractionally. Under a mild regularity assumption, we show that there always exists a weighting of candidates such that the fractional committee maximizing the candidate-weighted Nash Social Welfare is in the core. We refer to such a solution as being in the \emph{Nash core}. Additionally, we show that a Nash core solution admits a payment assignment between voters and candidates, where each voter pays a candidate they approve in proportion to the weight.
  For the discrete setting, where each candidate is either included or excluded from the committee, we prove that every approval-based committee election with at most eight equally weighted voters has a core committee by rounding the fractional Nash core solution. Although the non-emptiness of the core in this setting remains an open question and checking core membership is coNP-hard, we extend the notion of the Nash core to the discrete case, yielding a formulation that is efficiently verifiable and offers a promising path toward establishing core existence in discrete settings.
  Finally, we test our approach on real voting data using a payment-guided heuristic. We empirically show that the Nash core solution can be efficiently computed through an iterative algorithm in both the fractional and discrete settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究批准式委员会选举中的核心（core）概念，在候选人可分数选择的设定下，证明存在一种候选人权重分配，使得最大化候选人加权纳什社会福利的分数委员会属于核心（称为Nash core），并给出了选民与候选人之间的支付分配。对于离散设定，证明了至多八位等权选民的选举通过舍入分数Nash core解总存在核心委员会；同时将Nash core推广到离散情形，得到可高效验证的公式，并通过真实投票数据上的迭代算法验证了其计算效率。
AI.motivation: 在批准式委员会选举中，核心（core）是一种理想的稳定性概念：没有任何选民子群能通过选择成比例的阻塞委员会而严格获益。然而离散设定下核心的非空性仍是开放问题，且检查核心成员资格是coNP困难的。作者希望寻找一种既能保证核心性质、又能在计算上可行的解概念，并探索从分数解舍入到离散解的有效途径。
AI.method: 作者引入Nash core概念：在温和正则性假设下，证明存在候选人权重分配，使最大化候选人加权纳什社会福利的分数委员会位于核心，并构造选民与候选人之间的比例支付方案。对于离散设定，通过对分数Nash core解进行舍入，证明至多八位等权选民时核心非空；同时将Nash core推广到离散情形，形成可高效验证的公式。最后提出支付引导的启发式迭代算法，在分数与离散两种设定下计算Nash core解。
AI.result: 分数设定下Nash core解总是存在，且具有相应的支付分配；离散设定下证明了至多八位等权选民的选举存在核心委员会（通过舍入分数解获得）；离散Nash core公式可高效验证；在真实投票数据上的实验表明，迭代算法能高效计算分数与离散两种设定下的Nash core解。
AI.conclusion: Nash core为批准式委员会选举提供了一个兼具核心稳定性与计算可行性的解概念，其在分数设定下总能成立，并可通过舍入和迭代算法服务于离散设定；离散核心的非空性仍是开放问题，但本文的离散Nash core为证明其存在性提供了一条有前景的路径。

title: Ordinal Gates, Cardinal Bets: Matching LLM Confidence to the Financial Decision Operator
summary: LLM confidence scores are not independently deployable objects: their decision value depends on the downstream operator and exposure controller that consume them. Monotone recalibration cannot change a coverage-matched rank-based gate, whereas position sizing consumes score magnitude, so changing a confidence map can invalidate a scale fitted to the previous score distribution. We test this on FactSet news for Nasdaq-100 equities, fitting maps and scales on 2021 and evaluating nine open-weight LLMs out-of-sample on 2022--2023. Cross-applying raw and correctness maps with independently fitted scales shows that the two components are not portable alone: scale transfer reduces certainty-equivalent return (CER) in $8/9$ models and produces large risk-target errors. Matching each map with its fitted scale improves ensemble CER by $9.2$ percentage points per year under frozen-scale control ($p<0.001$), and the effect remains significant when the single largest-contributing model is excluded ($+5.5$pp/yr), so it is not driven by one case. Under an identical adaptive-volatility controller, however, the incremental effect falls to $+1.6$pp/yr, with a significant controller interaction. Annual walk-forward effects are smaller, although map--scale interaction remains positive in every fold. Confidence transformations should therefore be evaluated jointly with the downstream controllers that consume them.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了LLM置信度分数并非可独立部署的对象，其决策价值取决于消费它们的下游算子（如门控）和风险敞口控制器（如仓位规模）。通过2021年拟合、2022-2023年样本外评估九款开源LLM在Nasdaq-100新闻上的表现，发现置信度映射（confidence map）与规模参数（scale）必须成对匹配：单独跨模型迁移规模会导致8/9模型CER下降且风险目标误差巨大；映射与匹配规模联合使用可使集成CER提升9.2个百分点/年（p<0.001），且该效应在自适应波动率控制器下显著降低至+1.6pp/年，表明存在显著的控制器交互效应。
AI.motivation: 作者指出LLM置信度分数在实践中的价值取决于下游算子与风险控制器如何消费这些分数。单调重校准无法改变覆盖度匹配的基于排名的门控，而仓位规模化（position sizing）会消费分数幅度——因此改变置信度映射可能导致此前按旧分数分布拟合的规模参数失效。这一"分数变换与下游组件不可分离"的问题尚未被系统检验。
AI.method: 在FactSet新闻数据上针对Nasdaq-100股票进行实证研究：以2021年为拟合期，对九款开源权重LLM在2022-2023年样本外评估。具体做法包括将原始分数映射与正确率映射分别与独立拟合的规模参数交叉应用，以检验两个组件是否可单独移植；同时比较冻结规模控制（frozen-scale control）与自适应波动率控制器（adaptive-volatility controller）下的效果，并开展年度滚动（walk-forward）验证。
AI.result: 规模转移（scale transfer）在8/9个模型中降低确定性等价收益（CER）并产生较大的风险目标误差。将每个映射与匹配的规模联合使用时，集成CER在冻结规模控制下提升9.2个百分点/年（p<0.001）；剔除贡献最大的单一模型后效应仍为+5.5pp/年，说明并非个别案例驱动。但在相同的自适应波动率控制器下，增量效应降至+1.6pp/年，且存在显著的控制器交互。年度滚动效应较小，但映射-规模交互在每个折叠（fold）中均为正。
AI.conclusion: 置信度变换（映射与规模）必须与消费它们的下游控制器联合评估，而不能独立部署或跨模型移植；否则会产生显著的绩效损失与风险目标偏离。这一结论对LLM置信度校准的评估框架设计具有重要启示。

title: Inverse Rendering for Modeling with Line Primitives
summary: Faithfully capturing diverse real-world objects with fuzzy, anisotropic structures, such as hair, fur, fibers, and textiles, for efficient real-time visualization remains challenging. Recent radiance field reconstruction methods capture these structures from multi-view images using translucent volumetric primitives such as 3D Gaussians rather than opaque low-dimensional primitives (e.g., triangles, line segments, and polylines), thereby limiting compatibility with standard depth-tested rasterization, reflection modeling, and physical simulation. We present an inverse rendering method for reconstructing fuzzy geometry using explicit line segments, which are rasterized on a subpixel grid for anti-aliasing to reproduce a semi-transparent appearance. While straightforward to render, optimizing numerous line primitives to match target images poses a significant challenge. We address this by introducing a stochastic differentiable rasterizer for line segments that produces informative gradients with respect to vertex positions, attributes, and discrete connectivity. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that our method outperforms surface-based approaches in capturing fuzzy boundaries and achieves quality comparable to volumetric representations while relying entirely on explicit geometry. The resulting representation integrates seamlessly with standard graphics pipelines, enabling cross-platform rendering, various shading models, and physical simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于显式线段基元的逆渲染方法，用于重建毛发、绒毛、纤维和纺织品等具有模糊各向异性结构的几何。通过亚像素网格光栅化实现抗锯齿，并引入随机可微光栅化器以优化海量线段基元，在保持显式几何的前提下达到与体积表示（如3D高斯）相当的重建质量，且兼容标准图形流水线（深度测试光栅化、反射建模、物理仿真）。
AI.motivation: 现有的辐射场重建方法（如3D高斯）使用半透明体积基元来捕捉毛发的模糊各向异性结构，但这些基元不透明低维基元（三角形、线段、折线）难以兼容标准的深度测试光栅化、反射建模与物理仿真，限制了与常规图形渲染管线的集成。因此需要一种既能够忠实重建模糊结构、又能无缝融入标准图形管线的显式几何表示。
AI.method: 构建显式线段基元表示模糊几何，利用亚像素网格光栅化进行抗锯齿以重现半透明外观；为应对海量线段基元的优化难题，提出一种针对线段的随机可微光栅化器，能够对顶点位置、属性及离散连接关系产生信息丰富的梯度信号。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法在捕捉模糊边界方面优于基于表面的方法，且重建质量可与体积表示相媲美；所得表示完全基于显式几何，可无缝集成到标准图形流水线中，支持跨平台渲染、多种着色模型及物理仿真。
AI.conclusion: 基于显式线段的随机可微光栅化方案为模糊各向异性结构的逆向重建提供了一种兼顾质量与通用性的新路径，弥合了高质量体积重建与标准图形渲染管线之间的鸿沟。

title: An Approach to Asynchronous Unsourced Random Access
summary: In this work we propose an approach to construct a fully asynchronous unsourced random access communications (URA) system. Besides the common URA features such as the absence of the user identification information in the packet and the decoding oriented to receiving the content of the messages, there is no limitation on the user transmission timing. The active users can transmit their packet any time on demand. The proposed system belongs to the class of preamble-payload URA formats. Contrary to the typical role of the preamble to serve as a temporary user identification, the preamble serves for the purpose of timing acquisition. The proposed system also employs a very small pool of preambles to resolve collisions of packets transmitted simultaneously.We provide a performance analysis and simulation results for the proposed system and demonstrate that for a wide range of signal-to-noise ratios (SNR)s the supported numbers of active users are close to the numbers of users supported by a slotted URA system counterpart.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种完全异步的无源随机接入（URA）通信系统，用户可随时按需传输数据包，无定时限制。系统采用前导码-载荷（preamble-payload）格式，前导码用于定时获取而非临时用户标识，并采用极小的前导码池来解决数据包同时传输时的碰撞。通过性能分析和仿真，证明在广泛的信噪比范围内，该系统支持的有源用户数量接近于对应的时隙URA系统。
AI.motivation: 现有URA系统通常依赖时隙化（slotted）机制来协调用户传输，限制了用户传输的灵活性。本文旨在消除用户传输定时限制，构建完全异步的URA系统，同时保持与传统时隙URA系统相当的性能，以满足用户按需随时传输的实际需求。
AI.method: 提出一种完全异步URA系统，属于前导码-载荷（preamble-payload）格式。与传统前导码用作临时用户标识不同，本文中前导码用于定时获取（timing acquisition），并采用极小的前导码池来处理同时传输数据包的碰撞问题。系统保留了URA的核心特征：数据包中不含用户标识信息，解码目标为恢复消息内容。
AI.result: 通过性能分析和仿真，证明了在广泛的信噪比（SNR）范围内，所提出的完全异步URA系统支持的有源用户数量接近于时隙URA系统对应支持的用户数量，表明异步系统的性能损失很小。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功构建了完全异步URA系统，在消除用户传输定时限制的同时，实现了与时隙URA系统相近的用户支持能力，为异步场景下的URA实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: Task-Specific Prompt with Global Context for Multi-Task Graph Pre-Training
summary: Graph prompt learning is an effective paradigm to adapt pre-trained graph models to downstream tasks in low-resource scenarios. However, existing multi-task graph pre-training frameworks generally use randomly initialized prompts, leading to poor alignment between the prompt space, pretext objectives and graph structural characteristics. This greatly weakens the task relevance, structural awareness and transferability of prompt representations. To address this challenge, we propose TPGC, a dual-prior prompt initialization solution that explicitly models the synergy between task prior and structural prior. Specifically, the Task-Prior Injection Module first conducts a short homologous multi-task pre-training on an auxiliary graph, enabling prompt initialization to inherit optimization preferences associated with multiple pretext tasks. Built on the task-aware representations, the Structure-Prior Injection Module further extracts transferable global structural context from the auxiliary graph, converting it into layer-wise prompt vectors by aggregating structurally informative node embeddings. Extensive experiments on 6 mainstream benchmarks covering node and graph classification show that TPGC achieves consistently better performance under few-shot settings than state-of-the-art baselines, with fewer downstream tunable parameters and lower runtime. The code is available at https://github.com/Virgilqiu/TPGC

AI.tldr: TPGC是一种双先验提示初始化方法，通过任务先验注入模块和结构先验注入模块显式建模任务先验与结构先验的协同作用，解决多任务图预训练框架中随机初始化提示导致的对齐不良问题，在少样本节点/图分类基准上以更少参数和更低耗时取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图提示学习范式虽能有效适配预训练图模型到下游低资源任务，但多任务图预训练框架通常使用随机初始化的提示，导致提示空间、预训练目标与图结构特征之间对齐不良，削弱了提示表征的任务相关性、结构感知能力与可迁移性。
AI.method: 提出TPGC双先验提示初始化方案：1) Task-Prior Injection Module在辅助图上进行短周期的同构多任务预训练，使提示初始化继承与多个预训练任务相关的优化偏好；2) 基于任务感知表征，Structure-Prior Injection Module从辅助图中提取可迁移的全局结构上下文，通过聚合富含结构信息的节点嵌入将其转化为逐层提示向量。
AI.result: 在涵盖节点分类和图分类的6个主流基准上的大量实验表明，在少样本设置下TPGC的性能持续优于现有最先进基线，且下游可调参数更少、运行时间更低。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模任务先验与结构先验的协同作用可显著提升图提示初始化的对齐质量、结构感知能力与可迁移性，从而在少样本下游场景下实现更强的性能与更高的效率。

title: Behaviorally Grounded User Profiles from the Wild for Personalized Alignment and Multi-Perspective Reasoning
summary: Persona-driven techniques increasingly adapt large language models (LLMs) to diverse contexts. However, existing methods predominantly rely on rigid, synthetic personas that flatten individual variation, rely on stereotypes, and miss the nuanced signals driving actual human preferences. We introduce profile behavioral grounding, a framework for extracting open-ended, high-fidelity user profiles directly from authentic, anonymized social media posts. We evaluate these profiles across two paradigms: train-time personalization via supervised finetuning (SFT) and non-parametric test-time multi-perspective reasoning. Across complex recommendation and open-ended query benchmarks, behaviorally grounded profiles consistently improve base models and outperform synthetic profile baselines, driving stronger parametric alignment and enabling richer, multifaceted reasoning. Our findings establish open-ended, behavior-derived profiles as a highly diverse and effective foundation for the next generation of personalized language systems. Our code base is available at https://github.com/ServiceNow/behavior-grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"行为画像接地"（profile behavioral grounding）框架，直接从真实匿名社交媒体帖子中提取开放式、高保真的用户画像，替代依赖刻板印象的合成人格，用于大语言模型个性化。作者在训练时（监督微调）与测试时（非参数多视角推理）两种范式下评估，发现行为接地画像在复杂推荐与开放查询基准上持续优于基础模型和合成画像基线，为下一代个性化语言系统提供了有效基础。
AI.motivation: 现有基于人格（persona）驱动的大语言模型个性化技术主要依赖僵化、合成的用户画像，这些画像抹平了个体差异、依赖刻板印象，且无法捕捉驱动真实用户偏好的细微信号，因而个性化效果受限。
AI.method: 提出profile behavioral grounding框架，从真实匿名社交媒体帖子中提取开放式、高保真用户画像；并在两种范式下评估：(1) 训练时个性化——通过监督微调（SFT）实现参数化对齐；(2) 测试时个性化——通过非参数的多视角推理实现。代码已开源。
AI.result: 在复杂推荐与开放查询基准上，行为接地画像一致地提升了基础模型性能，并优于合成画像基线，增强了参数化对齐效果，同时支持更丰富、多面的推理。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，开放式的、源自真实行为的用户画像是高度多样化且有效的个性化基础，为下一代个性化语言系统奠定了新方向。

title: A Cone-Constrained Bilinear Decomposition for Total Scaled-Gradient Variation Models
summary: The total scaled-gradient variation (TSGV) regularizer, derived from sparse modeling of piecewise-linear structures, has been shown to preserve edges and corners in image restoration. However, its highly nonconvex and nonlinear nature poses severe computational challenges, as existing methods often suffer from parameter sensitivity or lack convergence guarantees. To overcome this, we propose a tailored bilinear decomposition that decouples the nonlinear weighted gradient in the TSGV regularizer. This approach yields an equivalent optimization problem governed by cone or sphere constraints, depending on the chosen scaling function. In particular, the cone constraint plays a central role in characterizing edge- and corner-preserving behavior. We solve this reformulation using the alternating minimization method (AMM) equipped with a majorization--minimization strategy, ensuring a monotonic decrease in energy without step-size tuning. Furthermore, we provide a geometric interpretation of the edge-preserving properties of these constraints by analyzing their asymptotic behavior near image singularities. We establish the global convergence of the proposed method to a critical point within the Kurdyka--Łojasiewicz framework. Extensive numerical experiments on Gaussian denoising and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging show that the proposed method achieves PSNR and SSIM competitive with or superior to representative variational methods, especially at high noise levels, and improves the structural reconstruction under dense and sparse scanning.

AI.tldr: 针对TSGV正则子在图像复原中因高度非凸非线性带来的计算难题，提出一种定制的双线性分解方法，将非线性加权梯度解耦为锥约束或球约束的等价优化问题，并采用结合MM策略的交替最小化方法求解，在KL框架下证明全局收敛，在去噪和NLOS成像中取得优于或媲美代表性变分方法的性能。
AI.motivation: TSGV正则子源于分段线性结构的稀疏建模，在图像复原中能保持边缘和角点，但其高度非凸、非线性的特性带来严重的计算挑战：现有方法要么对参数敏感，要么缺乏收敛性保证，因此亟需一种计算高效且具有收敛保障的求解方案。
AI.method: 提出一种定制的双线性分解，将TSGV正则子中的非线性加权梯度解耦，从而得到由锥约束或球约束（取决于所选缩放函数）控制的等价优化问题，其中锥约束在刻画边缘与角点保持行为中起核心作用。采用配备majorization-minimization（MM）策略的交替最小化方法（AMM）求解，无需步长调节即可保证能量单调递减；并通过分析图像奇异点附近的渐近行为给出约束边缘保持性质的几何解释。最终在Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz框架下建立方法全局收敛到临界点。
AI.result: 在高斯去噪和非视域（NLOS）成像的大量数值实验中，所提方法在PSNR和SSIM上达到与代表性变分方法相当或更优的水平，尤其在高噪声水平下优势明显，并在稠密和稀疏扫描下改善结构重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 该双线性分解与MM-AMM求解策略成功克服了TSGV正则子固有的计算困难与参数敏感性问题，在保证单调能量下降和全局收敛的同时，实现了优于或媲美现有方法的复原性能，为边缘和角点保持型图像复原提供了稳健高效的求解框架。

title: HyperWorld: Hypergraph-Structured State Serialization Improves Learned Textual World Models
summary: World models enable language-model agents to predict environment dynamics and plan before acting. In text environments, the model must learn symbolic action effects from serialized state descriptions, but the role of serialization structure remains underexplored. We present HyperWorld, a controlled study of state serialization for learned textual world models. We compare raw observations with three symbolic serializations of the same ground-truth state: independent sentences, pairwise triples, and entity-centered hyperedge units that group multiple related facts around entities and relations. All variants use the same training objective: given a state and an action, predict symbolic effects or judge the action infeasible. Across model scales, data budgets, and in-distribution and out-of-distribution test worlds, hyperedge serialization gives the clearest gains for 0.5B--1.5B models and under distribution shift. Larger models reduce the gap, and pairwise triples can match or slightly exceed hyperedges on in-distribution exact match, but hyperedges achieve the strongest out-of-distribution fact F1 and the best small-to-medium scale trade-off between feasibility detection and effect prediction. In downstream greedy planning, the hyperedge world model also attains the highest success rate among the tested representations. These results show that higher-order state organization is a simple but effective inductive bias for learned symbolic world models, especially when model capacity is limited or test environments differ from training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyperWorld，一项关于文本世界模型中状态序列化方式的受控研究，比较原始观测与三种符号序列化（独立句子、两两三元组、以实体为中心的超边单元），发现超边序列化在中小模型和分布偏移场景下带来最稳定的收益，并在贪心规划下游任务中取得最高成功率，表明高阶状态组织是简单而有效的归纳偏置。
AI.motivation: 世界模型能让语言模型智能体在行动前预测环境动态并规划，但在文本环境中，模型需要从序列化的状态描述中学习符号动作效果，而序列化结构本身的作用尚未被充分探索。作者旨在系统研究状态序列化方式对文本世界模型学习的影响。
AI.method: 构建受控研究框架HyperWorld，在同一真实状态基础上对比原始观测和三种符号序列化表示：独立句子、两两三元组、以及围绕实体和关系聚合多个相关事实的实体中心超边单元。所有变体使用统一训练目标：给定状态和动作，预测符号效果或判定动作不可行。实验覆盖多种模型规模（0.5B-1.5B）、数据预算以及分布内和分布外测试世界，并进一步在贪心规划下游任务中评估世界模型。
AI.result: 超边序列化在0.5B-1.5B规模的模型和分布偏移条件下带来最明显的增益；更大模型会缩小差距，两两三元组在分布内精确匹配上可持平或略超超边，但超边在分布外事实F1上表现最强，并在中小规模上取得可行性检测与效果预测之间的最佳权衡。在下游贪心规划中，超边世界模型取得了最高成功率。
AI.conclusion: 高阶状态组织（超边表示）是一种简单但有效的学习符号世界模型的归纳偏置，尤其在模型容量有限或测试环境与训练分布不同时优势显著，为文本环境中状态序列化设计提供了直接指导。

title: Inverse Rig Optimization from Line Drawings
summary: Stylized 3D character animation is largely hand-authored, with animators authoring rig parameters one keyframe at a time to find the best pose. Because stylized work reads chiefly through contour lines, drawing contours in the camera view is the most direct and precise way to express artistic intent. This mismatch between the rig controls and the artist's goal forces a laborious trial-and-error workflow, with animators repeatedly manipulating rig controls against the rendered view to match the desired contour. To address this, we propose a method that recovers rig parameters from screen-space contour strokes, enabling effective keyframing from sketches. Given strokes that redraw the current contour, our method optimizes the high-level rig parameters defined in the DCC tool. The key is to use a pre-trained MLP rig surrogate that provides a differentiable map from rig parameters to mesh vertices, replacing the original black-box rig within the optimization process. We match user-drawn lines to mesh contour lines and backpropagate the resulting screen-space error through the surrogate to update the rig parameters. Our results demonstrate that the method works for diverse characters and practical scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从屏幕空间轮廓笔触（素描）恢复骨骼绑定参数的自动方法，利用预训练的MLP绑定代模型提供可微映射，使动画师能以绘制轮廓的方式直接表达艺术意图，实现从草图进行高效关键帧制作。
AI.motivation: 风格化3D角色动画主要依赖手工逐帧调整绑定参数，而风格化作品的视觉效果主要通过轮廓线呈现。由于绑定控制器与艺术家的创作目标（绘制轮廓）不匹配，动画师不得不在渲染视图和控制器之间反复试错，流程繁琐低效。
AI.method: 给定对当前轮廓重绘的笔触线条，方法在DCC工具定义的高层绑定参数空间中进行优化。核心是使用预训练的MLP绑定代模型，提供从绑定参数到网格顶点的可微映射以替代黑盒绑定；将用户绘制线条与网格轮廓线匹配，并把屏幕空间误差通过代模型反向传播以更新绑定参数。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法适用于多种不同角色和实际使用场景，能够从轮廓笔触有效恢复绑定参数，实现从素描进行关键帧制作。
AI.conclusion: 该方法弥补了绑定控制与艺术家轮廓绘制意图之间的鸿沟，验证了以可微绑定代模型驱动屏幕空间轮廓优化这一技术路线的可行性，为风格化角色动画的基于草图的关键帧制作提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Capacity Achieving Torn Paper Codes
summary:
In the torn paper channel, a codeword is cut at random locations, and the resulting error-free fragments are delivered to the decoder as an unordered multiset. Although the capacity of this channel can be achieved using random code, decoding such codes generally requires exponential time. The interleaved-pilot construction of Shomorony and Vahid embeds a De Bruijn sequence among the symbols of a shifted erasure code and aligns only fragments that are sufficiently long through global statistical uniqueness. A subsequent local-alignment scheme by Liu and Raviv employs run-length-limited constraints and exclusive all-zero markers to identify pilot positions from local structure, substantially reducing the minimum fragment length that can be aligned.
  We further improve the method of Liu and Raviv by replacing its fixed pilot sequence with a multilevel successive local alignment and pilot-recycling procedure. In Liu and Raviv, the pilot sequence is chosen once and must simultaneously balance the length of the pilot sequence against the ability to align short fragments. Our construction removes this limitation by reusing pilot sequences across successive decoding levels. A pilot sequence with an independent random linear code is first used to align and decode the longest fragments. The information recovered at this stage is then recycled as a larger pilot sequence for the next stage.This process is repeated over multiple levels, so that progressively shorter fragments are recovered while the length of the pilot sequence remains small. Our construction depends on choosing a series of random linear codes, and we show that for any~$\varepsilon>0$, there exists a choice of such codes which attains rate of at least~$\varepsilon$ below the capacity, with high probability as the block length goes to infinity. Therefore, our construction achieves the capacity of the torn-paper channel.

AI.tldr: 本文研究撕碎纸张信道（torn-paper channel）的容量可达编码方案，提出一种多层连续局部对齐与导频重用的构造。与Liu和Raviv固定导频序列的方案不同，本文先在每一层用独立随机线性码作为导频对齐并解码最长的碎片，再将恢复出的信息作为下一层更大的导频序列，逐层回收利用，从而在保持导频序列较短的同时逐步恢复更短的碎片。作者证明：对任意ε>0，存在随机线性码的选择，使块长趋于无穷时以高概率达到至少低于容量ε的速率，即该构造可达撕碎纸张信道的容量。
AI.motivation: 撕碎纸张信道的容量虽可用随机编码达到，但解码通常需要指数时间。已有工作（Shomorony和Vahid的De Bruijn插入导频方案、Liu和Raviv的局部对齐方案）均存在局限：Liu和Raviv的固定导频序列必须同时权衡导频长度与短碎片对齐能力，无法兼顾。本文旨在去除这一权衡，使导频序列保持较短的同时仍能逐步恢复任意短的碎片，并达到信道容量。
AI.method: 提出多层连续局部对齐与导频重用（multilevel successive local alignment and pilot-recycling）方案。具体地，构造依赖一系列独立随机线性码：第一层用某随机线性码作为导频，对齐并解码最长的碎片；随后将该阶段恢复出的信息作为更大的导频序列输入下一层，如此逐级重复，使被恢复的碎片长度逐级变短，而导频序列本身的长度始终保持较小。在此基础上从理论上分析随机线性码序列的存在性，并证明速率可达性。
AI.result: 对任意ε>0，存在一系列随机线性码的选择，使得当块长趋于无穷时，该构造以高概率达到至少低于信道容量ε的速率，从而证明了该方案可达撕碎纸张信道的容量。
AI.conclusion: 通过导频重用与多层局部对齐，本文克服了固定导频方案在导频长度与短碎片对齐能力之间的固有矛盾，以较高的概率、渐进意义上任意接近容量的速率实现撕碎纸张信道的容量可达，为该信道的实用化解码提供了新的理论构造。

title: I-CARE: Analysis of interference-related phenomena in a controllable, diverse and representative unlearning setting for text-to-image models
summary: Machine unlearning studies the removal of knowledge from an AI model, making the system forget a concept it previously learned. Despite rapid progress in generative machine unlearning, the unintended degradation of semantically related concepts that should have been retained (henceforth, interference) remains poorly characterized and inconsistently evaluated. This paper introduces I-CARE, a methodology that formalizes interference as a first-class object of study in generative unlearning. Rather than proposing a new benchmark or unlearning algorithm, I-CARE provides formal definitions for tasks, metrics, and templates for reporting results, enabling the systematic and reproducible study of interference across unlearning settings. While our methodology is designed to remain valid as models and unlearning algorithms evolve, decoupling long-term scientific insight from transient empirical results, we present a feasibility demonstration with state-of-the-art algorithms and frequently used datasets. The results demonstrate that I-CARE enables meaningful analysis of interference patterns across multiple unlearning settings, establishing the practical applicability of the framework. The software implementation of the methodology is provided in an open-source framework, together with a web-based graphical interface that enables exploration of the outcomes of this study without requiring direct interaction with the codebase or specialized data analysis tools.

AI.tldr: I-CARE 是一个将"干扰"（interference）形式化为生成式机器遗忘研究中一类重要对象的通用方法论框架，提供任务、指标和结果报告模板的正式定义，以实现跨遗忘设置的系统性、可复现研究，并附带开源实现与可视化界面。
AI.motivation: 生成式机器遗忘虽进展迅速，但保留的语义相关概念会发生意外退化（即干扰），这一现象目前缺乏清晰的刻画且评估方式不一致，阻碍了该领域的系统研究。
AI.method: I-CARE 并非提出新的基准或遗忘算法，而是提供干扰研究的正式定义，包括任务定义、度量指标以及结果报告模板，使干扰研究在多样化的遗忘设置下可系统、可复现地进行；设计上使方法论随模型与遗忘算法的演进保持有效，将长期科学洞见与短期实证结果解耦。
AI.result: 通过使用当前最优算法和常用数据集进行的可行性演示表明，I-CARE 能够在多种遗忘设置下对干扰模式进行有意义的分析，验证了该框架的实际可用性；其软件以开源框架形式提供，并配有免代码交互的 Web 图形界面。
AI.conclusion: I-CARE 确立了干扰作为生成式遗忘中一个系统性研究对象的实用性，为社区提供了标准化、可复现的工具和交互式界面，从而支持该领域长期、一致的研究进展。

title: Hidden relationships in a document-derived property graph: top-k chunk embeddings and inverse-distance weighting over a dynamically evolving ontology
summary: Large language models extracting knowledge graphs from text capture only explicitly stated facts, often leaving semantically related entities disconnected across documents. We present an additive, engine-neutral second pass that discovers these latent ties without altering extracted facts. Each document is chunked and embedded once; top-k nearest- neighbor queries across existing chunks yield candidate node pairs via entity membership maps. Candidate pairs are scored using Shepard inverse-distance weighting with a rescaled chord distance metric, avoiding the threshold-collapsing flaw of affine cosine scoring behind a k-NN gate. Un-gated per-pair accumulators form a commutative monoid, ensuring the pipeline is strictly order-independent and scales incrementally without recomputing prior documents. Implemented across FalkorDB, Kinetica, ArangoDB, and Neo4j, our method shows that 768- and 240-dimensional embeddings retain 92% and 72% edge fidelity against a 3072-D baseline while achieving a 25x faster top-k formulation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种与图引擎无关的、可加性的第二遍处理流程，通过文档分块嵌入与k-NN最近邻查询，基于Shepard逆距离加权和重缩放弦距评分来发现知识图谱中跨文档的隐式实体关联，且不修改已抽取事实，并在多个图数据库上实现了可扩展的增量计算。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM从文本中抽取知识图谱的方式只捕获显式陈述的事实，导致语义相关的实体在跨文档场景下彼此失联；需要一个不改变已抽取事实的补充机制来发现这些潜在关联。
AI.method: (1) 对每篇文档进行一次分块与嵌入；(2) 在已有分块上执行top-k最近邻查询，通过实体隶属映射获得候选实体对；(3) 使用Shepard逆距离加权与重缩放弦距度量对候选对打分，避免了k-NN门控后仿射余弦评分存在的阈值塌缩缺陷；(4) 采用无门控的逐对累加器构成可交换幺半群，使流程严格顺序无关并可增量扩展，无需重算先前文档；(5) 在FalkorDB、Kinetica、ArangoDB和Neo4j四个图引擎上实现验证。
AI.result: 在FalkorDB、Kinetica、ArangoDB和Neo4j上实现，768维嵌入相对3072维基线保留92%的边保真度，240维嵌入保留72%，同时top-k公式化实现25倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够在不修改已抽取事实的前提下，以引擎中立、顺序无关、可增量扩展的方式发现知识图谱中的潜在跨文档实体关联；通过降维嵌入和高效top-k实现可在保持较高边保真度的同时显著提升计算效率，验证了其通用性与可扩展性。

title: HyperSketch: Controllable Video Sketching in a Style Hyperspace
summary: Vector sketch animation offers tremendous advantages for multimedia and creative design through concise line expressions and flexible editing. Learning-based generation methods of sketch animation have made significant progress in the last decade, but still suffer from limited style diversity and controllability. This paper presents a controllable video sketching method that automatically converts videos into multi-style vector sketch animations. A continuous style hyperspace is constructed by multi-dimensional sketch styles (fidelity, simplicity, text guidance strength) and the timeline. With this hyperspace, stroke control points are parameterized as 4-variable Bernstein polynomials, ensuring smooth and differentiable style transitions. A multi-task, multi-stage optimization framework is designed to learn stroke hyperparameters accurately and efficiently. We further developed a web-based interactive interface that allows real-time style manipulation via editable curves. Experiments show the style controllability, high-quality, and user-friendliness of our method, which outperforms SOTA methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可控视频素描方法，通过连续风格超空间（由保真度、简洁度、文本引导强度和时间线等多维风格构成）将视频自动转换为多风格矢量素描动画，并利用Bernstein多项式参数化笔画控制点实现平滑可微的风格过渡，配合多任务多阶段优化框架和网页交互界面，实现高质量、可控制且易用的实时风格操控。
AI.motivation: 矢量素描动画凭借简洁的线条表达和灵活的编辑能力在多媒体与创意设计中具有巨大优势，但现有基于学习的素描动画生成方法在风格多样性和可控性方面仍存在不足。
AI.method: 1) 构建由多维素描风格（保真度、简洁度、文本引导强度）与时间线组成的连续风格超空间；2) 将笔画控制点参数化为四变量Bernstein多项式，确保风格过渡平滑且可微；3) 设计多任务、多阶段优化框架以准确高效地学习笔画超参数；4) 开发基于Web的交互界面，支持通过可编辑曲线进行实时风格操控。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在风格可控性、生成质量和用户友好性方面表现优异，均优于现有最先进（SOTA）方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的可控视频素描方法成功实现了多风格矢量素描动画的自动生成，兼具平滑可微的风格过渡、准确高效的参数学习及实时交互能力，为素描动画生成领域提供了更优的可控性和多样性方案。

title: Solutions to Three Conjectures and an Open Problem on Binary BCH Codes
summary: BCH codes are among the most important classes of cyclic codes and have played a central role in coding theory and its applications. One of the fundamental problems in the study of BCH codes is to determine their exact minimum distances, which directly govern their error-correcting capability. Although the BCH bound provides a general lower bound, determining the exact minimum distance is often difficult, and many parameter families remain unresolved. In this paper, we investigate three conjectures and an open problem on binary BCH codes proposed by Chen, Xie, and Ding in \cite{Chen59}. We settle these conjectures on the exact minimum distances of three families of binary BCH codes by constructing codewords attaining the BCH bound. Beyond these conjectures, we further study the more difficult family codes and determine its minimum distance for some cases. We further study Open Problem 8.4: affirmative answers are obtained for the first two length families, while for the third family a sufficient condition is established and a counterexample shows that the unrestricted assertion does not hold in general.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二进制BCH码的精确最小距离问题，通过构造达到BCH界码字的方式，解决了Chen、Xie和Ding提出的三个猜想中的一个关键难题；此外还进一步研究了更困难的一族码并确定了部分情形下的最小距离，并对Open Problem 8.4给出了部分肯定回答、充分条件及反例。
AI.motivation: BCH码是循环码中最重要的类之一，其精确最小距离直接决定纠错能力，但确定精确最小距离十分困难，许多参数族仍未解决。此前文献中留下了若干猜想和公开问题，本文旨在解决这些开放问题，推进对BCH码最小距离的完整刻画。
AI.method: 采用构造达到BCH界的具体码字的方法，为三类二进制BCH码族证明其精确最小距离恰等于BCH界；对更困难的一族码结合具体参数分情形讨论来确定最小距离；对Open Problem 8.4中的三个长度族分别处理：前两族给出肯定回答，第三族给出充分条件并构造反例说明无条件断言一般不成立。
AI.result: 成功解决了Chen、Xie和Ding提出的三个关于二进制BCH码精确最小距离的猜想；对更困难的一族码在若干情形下确定了最小距离；对Open Problem 8.4，前两个长度族获得肯定答案，第三个长度族建立了充分条件，同时给出反例表明无限制的一般断言不成立。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过构造达到BCH界的码字，不仅解决了三个公开猜想，还为更难码族及Open Problem 8.4提供了局部完整结论，揭示了该问题中无条件断言与带条件结论之间的边界，为后续研究BCH码精确最小距离提供了新的方法与参考。

title: Convergence issues in Relational Concept Analysis based on AOC-posets
summary: Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) is an approach for conceptual classification building and rule discovery from a binary table describing a set of objects by a set of attributes. Extensions have been proposed to deal with non-binary and more complex data, such as Relational Concept Analysis (RCA) for multi-relational data. RCA aims to highlight groups of objects characterized by their relationships with other groups of objects. The richer and more complex nature of the underlying data allows RCA to produce richer results than FCA, at the expense of higher computational and interpretive complexity. The most commonly used conceptual classification structure in FCA is the concept lattice. However, in many applications, concept lattice substructures, such as AOC-posets, are preferred over the full lattice, either to mitigate combinatorial blow-up or to focus on the most informative parts of the structure. Indeed, in an AOC-poset, only concepts introducing an object or an attribute are represented, which makes AOC-posets smaller and easier to compute and use than concept lattices. Although RCA was originally defined on concept lattices, it can also be instantiated on AOC-posets. RCA is iterative and its convergence is guaranteed in the lattice-based setting, but this guarantee is lost when using AOC-posets. In this paper, we investigate this loss of convergence in detail. We show why convergence is no longer guaranteed in the general case, identify conditions under which it can still be ensured, and discuss how a dataset can be transformed to recover convergence. We also propose a convergent variant of the process, which preserves the AOC-poset structure: relational attributes, once created, are never removed, which guarantees convergence at the price of attributes that may refer to concepts absent from the final structures.

AI.tldr: 本文深入研究了基于AOC-poset的Relational Concept Analysis（RCA）的收敛性问题。RCA最初在概念格上定义且收敛有保证，但将其实例化到AOC-poset（仅表示引入对象或属性的概念，更小更易计算）时，收敛性保证会丢失。作者证明了为何一般情况下不再收敛、识别了保证收敛的条件、讨论了如何通过数据变换恢复收敛，并提出了一种保留AOC-poset结构的收敛变体：关系属性一旦创建就不再删除，以属性可能引用最终结构中不存在的概念为代价来保证收敛。
AI.motivation: FCA常使用概念格结构，但在许多应用中，AOC-poset等子结构因能缓解组合爆炸并聚焦于最有信息量的概念而更受青睐。RCA原本定义在概念格上，也可在AOC-poset上实例化，但RCA的迭代过程在格设置下保证收敛，在AOC-poset设置下该保证失效。因此需要系统研究并解决这一收敛性丧失问题。
AI.method: 作者从理论上分析AOC-poset设置下RCA迭代不收敛的原因，识别在何种条件下仍可保证收敛，并探讨对数据集进行变换以恢复收敛的途径。此外提出一个收敛变体：一旦创建的关系属性永不删除（单调累积），从而保证收敛，代价是这些关系属性可能引用最终结构中不存在的概念。
AI.result: 证明了在一般情况下基于AOC-poset的RCA不再保证收敛，并给出了可保证收敛的条件及恢复收敛的数据变换方法。同时提出了一种保持AOC-poset结构的收敛变体，通过使关系属性只增不减来确保收敛。
AI.conclusion: RCA在AOC-poset上的收敛性保证确实会丢失，但可以通过识别特定条件、数据变换或采用"关系属性永不删除"的收敛变体来恢复收敛；该变体以引入可能指向最终结构中不存在概念的关系属性为代价，换取收敛保证，丰富了RCA在AOC-poset设置下的实用性与理论理解。

title: GUI-CC: Benchmarking Contextual Consistency of GUI World Models as Agent Environments
summary: GUI world models are increasingly evaluated as one-step next-screen predictors, yet their intended use is often as multi-step environments for GUI agents. This mismatch leaves a key requirement under-tested: generated states must remain contextually consistent when they are repeatedly reused for future interaction. We introduce GUI-CC, a benchmark that evaluates contextual consistency of GUI world models as agent environments rather than isolated next-screen predictors. GUI-CC contains two complementary tracks: an offline reference-action track that rolls models along real mobile GUI trajectories, and an online agent-loop track that lets fixed probing agents interact with model-generated UIs. We construct 500 offline trajectory tasks from GUIOdyssey and 200 emulator-verified online tasks across 30 mobile apps. GUI-CC evaluates transition fidelity, transition plausibility, contextual consistency, and task progress. Experiments show that plausible single-step generation does not guarantee reliable environment simulation: current models often produce usable-looking screens while failing to preserve task-relevant context or support executable multi-step rollouts.

AI.tldr: 提出GUI-CC基准，用于评估GUI世界模型作为多步智能体环境时的上下文一致性，而非只作为单步下一屏预测器，以弥补现有评估方式与真实用途之间的错配。
AI.motivation: GUI世界模型越来越多地被当作单步下一屏预测器来评估，但其预期用途往往是作为GUI智能体的多步环境。这种错配使得一个关键需求未被充分测试：当生成的状态被反复复用以支持后续交互时，必须保持上下文一致。
AI.method: GUI-CC包含两条互补轨道：离线参考动作轨道（沿真实移动GUI轨迹滚动模型）和在线智能体循环轨道（让固定探测智能体与模型生成的UI交互）。构建了来自GUIOdyssey的500个离线轨迹任务和覆盖30个移动应用的200个经模拟器验证的在线任务，并评估转移保真度、转移合理性、上下文一致性和任务进度。
AI.result: 实验表明，看似合理的单步生成并不能保证可靠的环境模拟：当前模型往往能生成可用外观的屏幕，却无法保留任务相关上下文或支持可执行的多步回滚。
AI.conclusion: 单步生成质量与多步环境模拟可靠性之间存在显著鸿沟，评估GUI世界模型时应将其作为智能体环境，重点考察上下文一致性与可执行的多步回滚能力。

title: ZimaBlue: Evolving Generalizable World Action Models through Scalable Video Pre-training
summary: Robotic manipulation faces a fundamental scaling challenge: robust generalization demands broad physical experience, yet action-labeled robot trajectories are expensive to collect and inherently limited in diversity. Egocentric videos offer a far more scalable source of embodied experience, capturing object interactions, contact dynamics, tool use, and long-horizon behaviors across diverse environments. The central challenge is how to convert this abundant but action-free experience into effective robot control. We introduce ZimaBlue, a scalable framework for learning generalizable World Action Models (WAMs) from large-scale video. ZimaBlue follows a three-stage training curriculum: it first performs causal embodied video pre-training on large-scale human and robot egocentric videos, then grounds the learned visual dynamics in heterogeneous robot trajectories through video-action mid-training with a unified action representation, and finally specializes the model to a target robot for deployment. To make generative WAMs practical for real-time control, ZimaBluefurther adopts an asynchronous Slow-Fast dual-system architecture, where a high-capacity Slow world model provides generalizable spatiotemporal representations and a lightweight Fast branch enables 30 Hz action prediction on NVIDIA RTX 4090. On real-robot zero-shot evaluations, scaling from target-robot data alone to over 120,000 hours of embodied video improves success from 36.1% to 77.8%. ZimaBlue further delivers strong performance across multiple benchmarks, with particularly pronounced gains on unseen tasks.

AI.tldr: ZimaBlue 是一个从大规模第一视角视频中学习通用世界动作模型（WAM）的可扩展框架，通过因果具身视频预训练、视频-动作中间训练和目标任务微调三阶段课程，并采用异步 Slow-Fast 双系统架构实现 30 Hz 实时控制，将真实机器人零样本成功率从 36.1% 提升至 77.8%。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作面临根本性的扩展瓶颈：鲁棒泛化需要广泛的物理经验，但带动作标注的机器人轨迹既昂贵又多样性有限；丰富的第一视角视频虽提供了可扩展的具身经验来源，却缺乏动作标签，如何将其转化为有效的机器人控制是核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出 ZimaBlue 框架，采用三阶段训练课程：(1) 在大规模人类与机器人第一视角视频上进行因果具身视频预训练；(2) 通过统一动作表征的视频-动作中间训练，将学到的视觉动力学锚定到异构机器人轨迹上；(3) 针对目标机器人微调以部署。另外采用异步 Slow-Fast 双系统架构：高容量 Slow 世界模型提供可泛化的时空表征，轻量 Fast 分支支持在 NVIDIA RTX 4090 上实现 30 Hz 动作预测。
AI.result: 在真实机器人零样本评估中，将训练数据从仅目标机器人数据扩展到超过 12 万小时的具身视频，使成功率从 36.1% 提升至 77.8%；在多个基准上表现强劲，尤其在未见任务上获得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 视频数据的大规模扩展能有效替代昂贵的动作标注数据，ZimaBlue 证明从大规模无动作视频中学习可泛化的世界动作模型是可行且高效的，为机器人操作的可扩展学习指明了方向。

title: Discrete-Time MDP Modeling for Multi-Item Capacitated Lot Sizing with Stochastic Demand Timing
summary: This paper studies a finite-horizon multi-item capacitated lot-sizing problem in which demand quantities are deterministic, while demand-arrival periods are stochastic. Each demand occurs once within a known time window and must be satisfied no later than its deadline. The proposed model makes production and allocation decisions at the demand level, allowing it to represent capacity competition, demand-specific backlog, and allocation-dependent inventory dynamics. The stochastic problem is formulated as a discrete-time Markov decision process (DTMDP), including the state space, feasible actions, transition kernel, and one-period cost function. To isolate the computational effect of stochastic timing, each stochastic instance is first compared with a deterministic counterpart in which each arrival distribution is replaced by its most likely arrival period. This comparison shows that stochastic timing substantially increases the number of states, the number of transitions, solution time, and memory pressure. A genetic algorithm (GA) is then proposed for the stochastic-timing problem. The GA searches over feasible state-feedback policies and evaluates each policy exactly under the DTMDP transition model. Computational experiments on 330 benchmark instances show that the GA remains close to the exact stochastic solution whenever the latter is available, with an average optimality gap of about $3.44\%$. On the difficult benchmark instances, comprising 90 test cases, the GA remains below the $5\%$ optimality-gap threshold and achieves an average optimization speedup of $6.89 \pm 1.41$ at the $95\%$ confidence level. For instances that cannot be solved exactly on the available hardware, an empirical Bellman-time regression is used to estimate the missing exact resolution time and extrapolate the expected GA speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限时域、多物品、有产能约束的批量订购问题，其中需求量确定但需求到达时期随机。作者将该问题建模为离散时间马尔可夫决策过程，并针对随机时机带来的巨大计算负担，提出一种在可行状态反馈策略上搜索并精确评估策略的遗传算法。在330个基准实例上平均最优性差距约3.44%，在90个困难实例上保持在5%阈值内，平均加速6.89倍；对无法精确求解的实例，利用经验Bellman时间回归外推遗传算法的预期加速。
AI.motivation: 需求到达时期的随机性会显著扩大状态空间、转移数量并增加求解时间与内存压力，因此需要在精确随机模型之外寻找可扩展的求解方法，在解的质量与计算效率之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 将随机问题形式化为离散时间马尔可夫决策过程（DTMDP），明确给出状态空间、可行动作、转移核与单期成本函数；先与用最可能到达时期替换各分布的最接近确定性模型对比以隔离随机时机的影响；随后提出遗传算法（GA），在可行状态反馈策略空间上搜索，并在DTMDP转移模型下精确评估每个策略。
AI.result: 在330个基准实例上，GA与精确随机解的平均最优性差距约为3.44%；在90个困难测试实例上，GA保持在5%最优性差距阈值以下，并在95%置信水平下实现6.89±1.41的平均优化加速；对硬件无法精确求解的实例，利用经验Bellman时间回归估计缺失的精确求解时间并外推GA的预期加速。
AI.conclusion: 随机需求到达时机虽然大幅增加问题的求解复杂度，但所提出的遗传算法能够在接近精确最优解的前提下大幅缩短求解时间，是可扩展的有效求解方案。

title: MUFASA: An Information Utility-Aware Preprocessing Framework for Reliable Model Reasoning in Computational Pathology
summary: Reliable computational pathology depends on preprocessing methods that identify informative tissue regions while excluding artifacts and low-utility regions from whole-slide images (WSI). However, existing preprocessing pipelines often retain such regions or discard diagnostically relevant tissue, thereby limiting downstream model performance, reliability, and robustness across heterogeneous cohorts. Here, we systematically evaluate how these regions affect downstream AI model performance across multiple clinically relevant applications and introduce MUFASA, a generalizable, information utility-aware preprocessing framework for H&E-stained WSI that excludes artifacts and low-utility regions while preserving biologically meaningful tissue. MUFASA integrates slide-level artifact masking, stain-aware tile filtering, reconstruction-based utility stratification of tiles, and targeted recovery of tissue tiles that are over-filtered by earlier phases. Across tumor diagnosis, tumor subtyping, biomarker status prediction, and survival prognostication tasks in diverse cancer cohorts, MUFASA consistently improves downstream model performance relative to widely used preprocessing baselines. These gains are accompanied by reduced artifact-associated attribution in model heatmaps, indicating improved alignment between retained tissue and model attention. Our findings establish WSI preprocessing as a critical determinant of downstream model performance and validity, revealing that even accurate predictions can conceal important failure modes stemming from anatomically implausible reasoning driven by retained artifact-containing and low information-utility tiles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MUFASA，一种面向 H&E 染色全切片图像（WSI）的、基于信息效用感知的通用预处理框架，通过集成玻片级伪影掩膜、染色感知的组织块过滤、基于重建的切片效用分层以及对过度过滤组织块的定向恢复，在肿瘤诊断、亚型分类、生物标志物状态预测与生存预后等多类任务中一致提升下游 AI 模型性能，并减少模型热图中的伪影相关归因，确立 WSI 预处理为决定下游模型性能与有效性的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 现有的 WSI 预处理流程常常保留伪影和低效用区域，或者错误丢弃具有诊断价值的组织，从而限制了下游模型在异质性队列中的性能、可靠性与稳健性；此外，即使预测准确，模型也可能基于被保留的伪影组织进行解剖学上不合理的推理，暴露出重要的失败模式。
AI.method: MUFASA 是可泛化的信息效用感知预处理框架，包含四个阶段：1）玻片级伪影掩膜；2）染色感知的组织块过滤；3）基于重建的切片效用分层；4）对早期阶段过度过滤的组织块进行定向恢复，从而在排除伪影和低效用区域的同时保留具有生物学意义的组织。
AI.result: 在多种癌症队列的肿瘤诊断、肿瘤亚型分类、生物标志物状态预测和生存预后任务中，与广泛使用的预处理基线相比，MUFASA 一致提升了下游模型的性能；同时，模型热图中与伪影相关的归因减少，表明保留组织与模型注意力之间的对齐得到改善。
AI.conclusion: WSI 预处理是下游模型性能与有效性的关键决定因素；即使模型预测准确，也可能因保留了含伪影和低信息效用的切片而依赖解剖学上不合理的推理，MUFASA 通过效用感知的预处理可缓解此类失败模式，提升模型的可靠性与稳健性。

title: MeshSplatBench: A Unified Benchmark for Triangle-Based Neural Rendering
summary: Triangle-based neural rendering bridges neural scene representations and conventional graphics pipelines by optimizing explicit geometric primitives compatible with standard rasterization hardware. However, existing approaches are evaluated almost exclusively within custom research renderers, obscuring their practical deployability in production engines. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{MeshSplatBench}, a unified benchmark that systematically investigates triangle-based neural rendering across the complete pipeline from native optimization to game-engine deployment. MeshSplatBench establishes a standardized evaluation protocol while preserving each method's native optimization semantics, reproducing published results within $0.8\%$ PSNR deviation. Furthermore, we introduce a hierarchical Unity deployment protocol spanning three rendering tiers: native CUDA renderers, method-specific dedicated engine shaders, and standard opaque mesh pipelines, isolating the exact fidelity losses caused by engine adaptation \textit{vs.} representation reduction. Finally, we conduct a topological audit of reconstructed surfaces, demonstrating that explicit connectivity and shared indexing alone are insufficient to guarantee production-ready assets due to prevalent non-manifold structures, fragmented components, and boundary artifacts. Overall, MeshSplatBench demonstrates that rasterizability is merely a primitive-level attribute, whereas graphics readiness requires jthe holistic alignment of representation, topology, and engine compatibility. Source code will be released.

AI.tldr: MeshSplatBench 是一个面向三角形神经渲染的统一基准，系统地评估从原生优化到游戏引擎部署的完整流程，并证明“可栅格化”仅是图元级属性，而真正的图形就绪需要表示、拓扑与引擎兼容性的整体对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有基于三角形的神经渲染方法几乎只在自定义研究渲染器中评测，掩盖了其在生产引擎中的实际可部署性，缺乏从原生优化到引擎落地的系统性评估基准。
AI.method: 提出 MeshSplatBench 基准，包含：(1) 标准化评估协议，在保留各方法原生优化语义的前提下复现已发表结果；(2) 分层 Unity 部署协议，涵盖原生 CUDA 渲染器、方法专用引擎着色器、标准不透明网格管线三个渲染层级，以隔离引擎适配与表示约简各自导致的质量损失；(3) 对重建表面进行拓扑审计。
AI.result: 基准可在 0.8% PSNR 偏差内复现已发表结果；拓扑审计表明，显式连接关系与共享索引本身不足以保证生产级资产质量——普遍存在非流形结构、碎片化组件和边界伪影。
AI.conclusion: 可栅格化仅是图元层面的属性，图形就绪性要求表示、拓扑与引擎兼容性的整体对齐。

title: MaskCode: Mask Transformer for Feedback-Assisted Coding With Linear Block Codes
summary: Feedback-based coding schemes have demonstrated substantial performance gains over today's open-loop coding schemes. Unfortunately, these gains are usually achieved in idealized settings with perfect feedback. Over the last few years, machine learning-based schemes have been shown to be promising solutions for implementing feedback-based codes, particularly when combined with short-block-length open-loop error correcting codes (ECCs) in a concatenated coding structure. However, existing ML-based feedback schemes remain agnostic to the outer code's structure, potentially misallocating feedback resources on error patterns already correctable by the outer ECC. To address this, we propose MaskCode, a Transformer-based inner feedback code for concatenated coding systems, which explicitly incorporates structural knowledge of the outer linear block code into the inner feedback encoder design via two synergistic mechanisms: 1) a soft syndrome-based input that informs the encoder about potential parity constraint violations, and 2) a code-aware attention mask derived from the Tanner graph. We further show that end-to-end training with a differentiable belief propagation (BP) decoder offers no additional gain, as MaskCode's structure-aware design already internalizes the structural knowledge of the outer code; in fact, backpropagation through the iterative BP decoder introduces gradient explosion, which degrades rather than improves performance. Extensive evaluations on BCH and LDPC outer codes demonstrate that MaskCode consistently outperforms all baselines, achieving up to 1.5 dB SNR gain.

AI.tldr: 针对级联编码系统中基于机器学习的反馈编码方案忽视外码结构、可能将反馈资源浪费在外码已可纠正的错误图样上的问题，本文提出MaskCode——一种Transformer-based内码反馈编码器，通过软伴随式输入和基于Tanner图的码感知注意力掩码显式融合外码结构知识，在BCH和LDPC外码上一致优于所有基线，最高获得1.5 dB SNR增益。
AI.motivation: 虽然反馈编码方案相比开环编码有显著性能增益，但这些增益通常在理想化的完美反馈场景下才能实现。现有基于机器学习的反馈方案大多对级联结构中外码的结构一无所知，导致反馈资源可能被分配到那些外码（短块长开环纠错码ECC）本身就能纠正的错误图样上，即资源分配不高效。因此需要设计一个能够感知并利用外码结构信息的内反馈编码器。
AI.method: 提出MaskCode，一种用于级联编码系统的Transformer-based内码反馈编码方案。其核心是在内反馈编码器中显式融入外线性分组码的结构知识，通过两种协同机制实现：(1) 软伴随式（soft syndrome）输入，告知编码器外码可能的奇偶校验约束违反情况；(2) 从Tanner图导出的码感知注意力掩码（code-aware attention mask）。此外，作者还探究了与可微信念传播（BP）解码器的端到端联合训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，端到端训练配合可微BP解码器并不会带来额外增益，因为MaskCode的结构感知设计已内化外码结构知识；相反，通过迭代BP解码器反向传播会引入梯度爆炸，导致性能下降而非提升。在BCH和LDPC外码上的大量评估表明，MaskCode一致优于所有基线，最高可获得1.5 dB的SNR增益。
AI.conclusion: 将外码的结构知识显式编码进内反馈编码器的设计中，是提升级联反馈编码系统性能的有效途径；同时，结构感知设计使得复杂的端到端BP反向传播训练不仅多余，反而有害。MaskCode验证了在有限反馈/短块长场景下，融合编码结构先验的ML反馈方案能带来显著且一致的信噪比收益。

title: DISTAL: Distillation and Self-Supervised Pretraining for Structure-Agnostic Materials Property Prediction
summary: Materials property prediction remains difficult in low-data settings, where many target properties are supported by only a limited number of labeled samples. Models with the strongest predictive accuracy often depend on crystal structures, which restricts their use in early-stage screening when structural information is limited or unavailable. To address this challenge, we propose DISTAL, a dual-prior framework for structure-agnostic materials property prediction that combines self-supervised compositional pretraining with structure-aware knowledge distillation. DISTAL first learns transferable compositional representations from a large virtual composition space using 145 composition-derived descriptors. It then distills structural knowledge from a pretrained ALIGNN teacher into a composition-conditioned student. This setting allows structural priors to be used during training without requiring structural inputs at inference. By integrating explicit compositional descriptors, pretrained latent features, and distilled structural features within a unified prediction pipeline, DISTAL captures complementary signals that are difficult to recover from any single representation alone. Across 39 benchmark tasks, the best-performing multimodal configuration combines all three signals, and improves over the reference benchmark on 37 tasks. DISTAL achieves the strongest overall performance among all evaluated feature combinations. These results indicate that compositional pretraining and structural distillation provide complementary priors and offer a practical route to robust composition-only prediction in small-data materials informatics. The source code and the pre-trained models are anonymously available at: https://osf.io/eq96d/overview?view_only=451617f42f7849e08750bd1852b48980 and will be released at the official link after acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DISTAL，一个用于无结构（structure-agnostic）材料性质预测的双先验框架，其结合自监督成分预训练与结构感知知识蒸馏，使模型在训练时利用结构信息、推理时仅需成分输入，并在 39 个基准任务中取得了总体最优性能。
AI.motivation: 材料性质预测在小数据场景下仍然困难，且多数高精度模型依赖晶体结构输入，这限制了其在缺乏结构信息的早期筛选阶段的应用。作者希望在不依赖结构输入的前提下提升成分驱动模型的预测精度。
AI.method: DISTAL 采用双先验框架：首先利用 145 个成分衍生描述符在大规模虚拟成分空间中学习可迁移的成分表示（自监督成分预训练）；然后将预训练 ALIGNN 教师模型的结构知识蒸馏到成分条件的学生模型中。最终将显式成分描述符、预训练隐特征与蒸馏结构特征三种信号统一集成到一个预测流程中，捕获单一表示难以恢复的互补信息。
AI.result: 在 39 个基准任务中，融合三种信号的多模态配置性能最佳，相比参考基准在 37 个任务上取得改进，并在所有评价的特征组合中表现最强。
AI.conclusion: 成分预训练与结构蒸馏提供了互补先验，为小数据材料信息学中鲁棒的成分-only 预测提供了一条实用路径；代码与预训练模型已匿名开源。

title: From Detection to Refusal: Safer LLMs via Circuit-Guided Weight Scaling
comment: Accepted to Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Despite extensive alignment efforts, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to generating unsafe content under adversarial prompting, yet the internal mechanisms by which safety behaviors are implemented remain poorly understood. We study LLM safety from a mechanistic interpretability perspective and characterize a multi-stage *safety circuit* that organizes refusal behavior, consisting of (i) $\textbf{Harmful Detection Heads}$ that respond to harmful inputs, (ii) $\textbf{Safety Neurons}$ that mediate and stabilize safety signals in the residual stream, and (iii) $\textbf{Refusal Heads}$ that translate these signals into safe response generation. Using targeted attention-head and neuron-level interventions, we provide causal evidence consistent with this circuit organization, showing that suppressing upstream Harmful Detection Heads disrupts downstream refusal behavior and that safety neurons mediate this interaction. We validate that this decomposition recurs across multiple LLM architectures and adversarial attack settings, and use simple, architecture-preserving weight scaling as a mechanistic probe to test its functional relevance. Across six LLMs, circuit-guided scaling improves safety rates under attacks by 26.5%, while incurring only a 1.7% accuracy drop across four standard benchmarks. Overall, our results support a circuit-level interpretation of LLM safety and suggest that mechanistic abstractions can reveal stable and transferable patterns underlying aligned behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文从机制可解释性角度研究大语言模型的安全行为，识别出一个由"有害检测头—安全神经元—拒绝头"组成的三阶段安全回路，并通过注意力头与神经元层面的因果干预验证其组织方式，跨6种模型架构与多种对抗攻击下均成立；基于该回路的权重缩放探针可将攻击下安全率提升26.5%，同时仅带来1.7%的标准基准准确率下降。
AI.motivation: 尽管进行了大量对齐训练，大语言模型在对抗性提示下仍容易生成不安全内容，而安全行为背后的内部机制尚不清晰。作者希望从机制可解释性的视角揭示安全行为如何被实现，以理解模型内部稳定且可迁移的对齐模式。
AI.method: 采用机制可解释性方法刻画一个多阶段安全回路：(1) 有害检测头——响应有害输入；(2) 安全神经元——在残差流中中介并稳定安全信号；(3) 拒绝头——将安全信号转化为安全响应。通过针对性的注意力头与神经元层干预提供因果证据，并利用保留架构的简单权重缩放作为机制探针检验其功能相关性。跨6个LLM架构和多种对抗攻击设置验证该分解的普适性。
AI.result: 抑制上游有害检测头会破坏下游拒绝行为，且安全神经元中介了这一交互；电路引导的权重缩放使6个LLM在攻击下的安全率平均提升26.5%，在4个标准基准上仅造成1.7%的准确率下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持对LLM安全性的电路级解释，表明机制性抽象能够揭示对齐行为背后稳定且可迁移的模式，为理解和改进模型安全性提供了可操作的因果框架。

title: A Lagrangian View of Flow Matching
summary: Modern explicit-time generative models, such as Flow Matching [Lipman et al., 2023] and Rectified Flow [Liu et al., 2023], are typically derived top-down via Optimal Transport and the continuity equation. This standard Eulerian approach focuses on the macroscopic transport of probability mass. In this paper, we present an alternative, bottom-up mechanical derivation grounded in a Lagrangian (particle-centric) perspective. By analyzing the local Taylor expansion of a continuous denoiser, we motivate a strict invariance condition required for optimal, singlestep generation: the conservation of target identity. Enforcing this condition yields a governing quasi-linear advection Partial Differential Equation (PDE). We demonstrate that solving this PDE via the Method of Characteristics analytically yields the straight-line trajectories of Flow Matching. This geometric perspective isolates the Jacobian of the denoiser as the primary source of trajectory curvature, providing a direct mathematical explanation for why straight-line flows enable massive step sizes, and why empirical models require distillation to flatten intersecting characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于拉格朗日（粒子中心）视角的自底向上的力学推导方法，替代标准的欧拉视角推导显式时间生成模型。通过分析连续去噪器的局部泰勒展开，作者提出了单步最优生成所需的关键不变性条件——目标身份（target identity）守恒，由此导出拟线性平流偏微分方程（PDE）。利用特征线法求解该PDE可解析地得到Flow Matching的直线轨迹，并揭示了去噪器的雅可比矩阵是轨迹曲率的主要来源，从而在数学上解释了为何直线流能支持大步长、以及为何经验模型需要蒸馏来平整相交的特征线。
AI.motivation: 现有的显式时间生成模型（如Flow Matching和Rectified Flow）通常通过最优传输和连续性方程自上而下地推导，属于标准的欧拉（宏观连续体）视角，仅关注概率质量的宏观输运，缺乏对粒子层面微观机制的深入理解。作者希望从拉格朗日（粒子中心）力学视角建立一种自底向上的替代推导，以更深入地解释生成轨迹为何呈直线、直线流动为何能支持大步长采样，以及经验模型为何需要蒸馏处理，从而为生成模型提供更直接的数学基础。
AI.method: 作者从粒子中心（拉格朗日）视角出发，分析连续去噪器的局部泰勒展开，据此提出了最优单步生成所需的严格不变性条件：目标身份（target identity）守恒。强制该条件后可导出一个控制生成过程的拟线性平流偏微分方程（PDE）。随后利用特征线法（Method of Characteristics）解析求解该PDE，证明该解恰好对应Flow Matching的直线轨迹。
AI.result: 通过该几何视角，作者推导出Flow Matching的直线轨迹，并指出去噪器的雅可比矩阵（Jacobian）是轨迹曲率的主要来源。这直接为两个现象提供了数学解释：其一，直线流使轨迹曲率为零，因此可支持巨大的采样步长；其二，经验模型由于特征线相交而产生曲率，因此需要通过蒸馏来平整相交的特征线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了拉格朗日力学视角与欧拉推导之间的等价关系，证明自上而下的Flow Matching与自下而上的粒子守恒原理在数学上是一致的，并将轨迹曲率统一归因于去噪器的雅可比矩阵，为直线流动的采样效率优势和蒸馏的必要性提供了深刻的几何与数学解释。

title: Incremental Risk Assessment of Progressive Elder Financial Scams via Instruction-Tuned Small Language Models
summary: Financial scams targeting older adults increasingly occur through text and voice channels such as email, SMS, and phone calls, unfolding over multiple conversational turns that begin with impersonation or casual contact, escalate through trust building and urgency, and culminate in requests for sensitive information or financial transfers. Because risk signals emerge incrementally across turns, effective detection requires models that continuously update risk estimates under resource-constrained deployment settings. We propose a cumulative turn-based risk assessment framework that incrementally aggregates conversational turns and re-estimates risk at each step, enabling dynamic scam monitoring across progressively evolving conversations. A multi-turn dialogue dataset is constructed to cover investment, charity, and tech support scam scenarios, with each dialogue containing two to eight turns and annotated at every cumulative stage with a qualitative risk level, a continuous risk score, an explanatory rationale, and a safety recommendation. Four small language models (Phi-4, LLaMA-3.2, DeepSeek-R1, and Qwen3) are fine-tuned and evaluated under a unified training framework. Fine-tuned small models capture fraud-related linguistic cues and cross-turn escalation patterns while maintaining compact architectures suitable for mobile and resource-constrained deployment settings. Among the evaluated models, Phi-4 and LLaMA-3.2 achieve stronger turn-aware risk estimation performance relative to their parameter scale. These results suggest that structured cumulative modeling can support incremental scam risk assessment in deployment-oriented settings while highlighting the potential of compact language models for privacy-aware and on-device fraud protection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于对话轮次累积的风险评估框架，用于检测针对老年人的金融诈骗对话。该框架按轮次增量聚合对话内容并逐步重估风险，配合一个覆盖投资、慈善、技术支持三类诈骗场景的多轮对话数据集（每段2-8轮，每轮标注风险等级、风险分数、解释理由和安全建议），在统一训练框架下微调四个小型语言模型（Phi-4、LLaMA-3.2、DeepSeek-R1、Qwen3）。实验表明Phi-4和LLaMA-3.2在其参数规模下取得了更强的轮次感知风险估计性能，验证了结构化累积建模在资源受限、隐私敏感的设备端诈骗防护场景中的可行性。
AI.motivation: 针对老年人的金融诈骗日益通过邮件、短信和电话等多轮对话渠道发生，诈骗过程从冒充或随意接触开始，经过信任建立和紧迫感升级，最终诱导敏感信息泄露或转账。由于风险信号在多个对话轮次中逐步显现，传统一次性检测难以应对，需要能够在资源受限的部署环境下随对话推进持续更新风险估计的模型。
AI.method: 提出累积式逐轮风险评估框架，增量聚合对话轮次并在每一步重新估计风险。构建涵盖投资、慈善和技术支持三类诈骗场景的多轮对话数据集，每段含2-8轮，并在每个累积阶段标注定性风险等级、连续风险分数、解释性理由和安全建议。在统一训练框架下对Phi-4、LLaMA-3.2、DeepSeek-R1和Qwen3四个小型语言模型进行微调与评估。
AI.result: 微调后的小型模型能够捕捉欺诈相关语言线索和跨轮升级模式，同时保持紧凑的架构以适应移动端和资源受限部署。在评估的模型中，Phi-4和LLaMA-3.2在其参数规模下取得了更强的轮次感知风险估计性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构化累积建模能够支持面向部署场景的增量式诈骗风险评估，并凸显了紧凑语言模型在隐私感知和设备端诈骗防护中的潜力。

title: Aerodynamic Shape Design Space Exploration with Deep Latent Diffusion Model
comment: This is the authors' postprint of the AIAA Journal article https://doi.org/10.2514/1.J066320. Data, code and agentic skill demo: https://github.com/kfxw/DiffGeo
summary: We propose DiffGeo, a latent space diffusion-based generative framework for aerodynamic design space exploration under extreme data scarcity. DiffGeo combines a learned latent space model for automatic shape parameterization, with a diffusion sampler to directly generate novel, geometry-valid and controllable designs. We validate the approach on a series of case studies: (i) a 2D airfoil generation benchmark, where DiffGeo's latent diffusion model is compared against GAN- and VAE-based baselines in terms of sample quality, diversity and constraint adherence under limited data; (ii) integration into a surrogate-based optimization pipeline, where DiffGeo's conditional sampling produces task-informed airfoil data that improve both surrogate modeling and optimization performance; and (iii) extension to 3D turbomachinery blade prototyping, where DiffGeo generates realistic and high-performance blade geometries from a small set of reference designs. Throughout these investigations, DiffGeo achieves high-quality and diverse shape generation with at least an order of magnitude less data than alternatives, decouples geometry representation from design targets for flexible reuse, and seamlessly incorporates complex design constraints via energy-based conditioning. These capabilities demonstrate DiffGeo's potential to enhance early-stage design by automating design space exploration--improving efficiency, expanding design diversity and embedding engineering knowledge through controllable guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出 DiffGeo，一种在极端数据稀缺条件下用于气动设计空间探索的潜空间扩散生成框架，结合自动形状参数化的潜空间模型与扩散采样器，可在比现有方法少一个数量级的数据下生成高质量、多样化、几何有效且可控的设计，并在二维翼型基准、基于代理的优化流程及三维涡轮机械叶片原型中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 气动设计空间探索常面临极端数据稀缺问题，传统生成模型（GAN/VAE）在小样本下难以兼顾样本质量、多样性与约束满足，且形状参数化与设计目标耦合紧密、难以复用，制约了早期设计阶段的高效探索。
AI.method: DiffGeo 采用两阶段架构：先学习一个潜空间模型实现自动形状参数化，再利用扩散采样器在潜空间中直接生成新颖、几何有效且可控的设计；通过基于能量的条件机制无缝融入复杂设计约束，并将几何表示与设计目标解耦以实现灵活复用。
AI.result: 在三个案例中验证：(i) 2D 翼型生成基准上，潜空间扩散模型在样本质量、多样性和约束遵循上优于 GAN/VAE 基线；(ii) 集成到基于代理的优化流程中，条件采样生成的任务信息翼型数据同时提升代理建模与优化性能；(iii) 扩展到 3D 涡轮机械叶片原型生成，仅凭少量参考设计即可产出真实且高性能的叶片几何。整体上，DiffGeo 以至少一个数量级更少的数据实现高质量多样化形状生成。
AI.conclusion: DiffGeo 展示了潜空间扩散生成框架在数据稀缺下自动探索气动设计空间的潜力：提升早期设计效率、扩大设计多样性，并通过可控制的引导方式嵌入工程知识，为自动化、可约束的设计空间探索提供了一条可行路径。

title: FoldingAgent: Inferring Parametric Origami Procedures from Demonstration Videos
comment: Project Page: https://maya-moriya.github.io/origami-page/ Accepted to SIGGRAPH ASIA 2026
summary: We present FoldingAgent, an agentic framework for inferring explicit parametric folding programs directly from origami demonstration videos. Our framework leverages the reasoning power of a pre-trained Vision-Language Model (VLM) equipped with a suite of specialized tools that enable the agent to simulate geometric transitions, verify physical plausibility, retrieve and compare visual content, and evaluate its own predictions. To translate visual content into folding programs, we define a parametric space that consists of the paper's geometry and a set of parametric folding actions. Unlike models that predict static crease patterns, our agent operates sequentially and possesses the ability to re-plan its actions, effectively mitigating the compounding errors inherent in multi-step folding. Our approach takes a step toward closing the gap between human origami knowledge, which is primarily shared through unstructured visual demonstrations, and computational methods, which typically rely on structured, parametric representations such as a crease pattern or an executable parametric plan. We evaluate our approach on PurelandFold, a newly curated benchmark of diverse Pureland origami videos with ground-truth geometry and action labels. Our results demonstrate that by combining VLM reasoning with a set of specialized tools and physical simulation, we can successfully transform unstructured visual demonstrations into executable, physically plausible folding procedures.

AI.tldr: 提出 FoldingAgent，一个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的工具增强型智能体框架，可从折纸演示视频中直接推断出显式参数化折叠程序，并在新构建的 PurelandFold 基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 人类的折纸知识主要通过非结构化的视觉演示传播，而计算方法通常依赖结构化的参数化表示（如折痕图或可执行参数计划），两者之间存在巨大鸿沟；且现有方法多预测静态折痕图，难以处理多步折叠中的累积误差。
AI.method: 利用预训练 VLM 的推理能力，配备一组专用工具（几何过渡模拟、物理可行性验证、视觉内容检索与比较、自评估）；定义包含纸张几何与参数化折叠动作的参数空间；智能体按顺序操作并具备重新规划动作的能力，从而缓解多步折叠中的累积误差。
AI.result: 在自建的多类别 Pureland 折纸视频基准 PurelandFold（含真实几何与动作标签）上评估，证明将 VLM 推理、专用工具与物理仿真相结合，可成功将非结构化视觉演示转化为可执行且物理上合理的折叠程序。
AI.conclusion: 该工作朝着弥合人类非结构化折纸知识与计算化参数化表示之间差距迈出一步，展示了智能体式序列推理与物理仿真结合在机器人/计算折纸任务中的潜力。

title: Coding for Multiple Reverse-Complement and Palindromic Duplications
comment: 32 pages. Submitted to Designs, Codes and Cryptography
summary: Reverse-complement (RC) and palindromic (PAL) duplications copy a length-$k$ block, reverse the copy, and insert it next to the original block; an RC duplication also complements the copied symbols. We study $q$-ary codes correcting $t$ such operations performed sequentially, so a later operation may copy symbols created by an earlier one. For fixed $q,k,t$, every length-$n$ code $C$ for either channel satisfies $n-\log_q|C|\geq t\log_q n-O_{q,k,t}(1)$; for fixed $q,k$ and $t=o(n)$ the lower bound is $t\log_q(n/t)-O_{q,k}(t)$. For a single RC error over an even alphabet with a fixed-point-free complement, the previously known RC-specific lift applies at odd $k$ and does not cover even $k$. For every even $k$, we give a coordinate-wise bijection that turns each RC duplication into a PAL duplication. Applying this bijection to every codeword therefore converts any $t$-error-correcting RC code into a PAL code of the same size, and conversely; encoders and decoders transfer by adding linear-time coordinate passes. We also determine the maximum number of distinct descendants produced by exactly two errors from one source word. Words alternating between any two distinct alphabet symbols attain this maximum for PAL, and the bijection gives the RC maximizers. For both PAL and RC at even $k$, form a graph whose vertices are all $q$-ary words of length $n$, joining two distinct vertices exactly when they have a common exact-two descendant. Bounding the degree and greedily coloring this graph yields existential codes of redundancy $4\log_q n+O_{q,k}(1)$. In the binary two-error problem, the converse gives $2\log_2 n-O_k(1)$, leaving a factor-two gap in the best existence bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 q 元序列上由反向互补（RC）复制与回文（PAL）复制引起的错误校正码。RC/PAL 复制将长度为 k 的块复制并反向插入原块旁，RC 还额外对符号取补。作者给出了纠 t 次此类顺序操作的码下界、偶长度 k 下将 RC 复制化为 PAL 复制的逐坐标双射（从而两个通道的码、编码器与译码器可互相转换）、恰好两次错误后代最大数的最优词形刻画，以及通过图的贪心着色得到的冗余度为 4 log_q n+O(1) 的存在性码；在二进制两次错误情形下证明了冗余度下界 2 log_2 n-O(1)，与存在性上界存在因子 2 的差距。
AI.motivation: 反向互补复制与回文复制出现在 DNA 存储、基因组重排等应用中，这类错误会拷贝并反向（以及取补）插入序列块，且后续操作可作用于先前产生的符号，因此需要研究能纠正多次此类顺序操作的 q 元纠错码。已有结果仅覆盖单个 RC 错误且只在奇数 k 有效，偶数 k 的情形尚缺；同时需要系统性地建立 RC 与 PAL 两类通道之间码的转换关系，并给出一般 t 次错误下的冗余度界与后代数最大值刻画。
AI.method: 作者综合运用信息论/计数下界（对固定 q,k,t 及 t=o(n) 情形推导冗余度下界）、组合构造与代数映射方法。核心贡献是：对每个偶数 k 构造一个逐坐标双射，把每个 RC 复制恰好对应成一个 PAL 复制（由于偶字母表上的无不动点互补在奇偶 k 下的行为差异），从而在码层、编码层和译码层实现 RC 与 PAL 码的等价转换，仅需线性时间的坐标处理。此外通过刻画恰好两次错误的全部后代结构，求出最大后代数及达到最大值的词（PAL 为任意两符号交替词，RC 由双射导出）；并构造以词为顶点、以共享某个恰两次后代为边的图，通过度上界与贪心着色给出存在性码。
AI.result: 主要结果：（1）对固定 q,k,t，任意长度 n 码满足冗余度下界 n-log_q|C| >= t log_q n - O_{q,k,t}(1)；固定 q,k 且 t=o(n) 时为 t log_q(n/t)-O_{q,k}(t)。（2）对每个偶数 k 存在逐坐标双射将每个 RC 复制映射为 PAL 复制，因而任何 t 纠错 RC 码可转化为同大小的 PAL 码且反之亦然，编解码只需附加线性时间坐标扫描。（3）确定了两个错误产生的最大不同后代数，PAL 的最大化者为任意两符号交替词，RC 最大化者由双射给出。（4）对偶数 k 的 PAL 与 RC，构造每点度有界的图并贪心着色，得到冗余度 4 log_q n+O_{q,k}(1) 的存在性码。（5）二进制恰好两次错误问题中，编码下界给出冗余度 2 log_2 n-O_k(1)，与存在性上界之间存在因子 2 的差距。
AI.conclusion: 论文为 q 元 RC 与 PAL 复制通道建立了系统的纠错码理论：给出了多个参数区间的冗余度下界，并在偶数 k 下证明两类通道在码与编解码器层面的完全等价（经由逐坐标双射），同时精确刻画了两次错误的最大后代结构。所得存在性构造的冗余度为 4 log_q n+O(1)，而二进制两次错误情形下下界与上界仍差因子 2，作者将该间隙留作开放问题，指明后续研究方向。

title: ReNFT: Repairing Mode Collapse in Reward Post-Training via Internal Probability-Mass Recalibration
summary: Reward post-training of diffusion generators inevitably concentrates probability mass on a few reward-favored modes, a mode collapse that erases within-prompt diversity. Existing methods for mitigating collapse rely on external signals or interfaces, augmenting the reward with perceptual objectives, adjusting reference regularization, or modifying the text encoder, but none repairs an adapter that has already collapsed while preserving the acquired reward. We observe that online post-training primarily reallocates probability mass over capabilities inherited from pretraining rather than learning new visual content. Collapse is therefore suppression, not deletion, and can be reversed from within the generator. We propose ReNFT, which repairs a high-reward, low-diversity adapter through internal probability-mass recalibration. Unconditional probes first prioritize "anti-hub" prompts where the prompt-independent bias is easiest to expose. Two policy-dominated mixed routes then generate matched counterfactual proposals from the same prompt and initial noise, one probing the frozen base direction for suppressed alternatives and the other exposing the post-trained unconditional tendency. Reward ranking with an adaptive flipping guard assigns pull and push roles, and a joint-and-paired NFT update realizes the repair. On PickScore and GenEval, ReNFT retains 98.9% and 99.0% of NFT's reward while improving DreamSim-Div by 58.8% and 55.0%, respectively, offering a complementary alternative to external interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReNFT，一种通过内部概率质量重校准来修复扩散生成器奖励后训练中发生模式坍缩（高奖励、低多样性）adapter 的方法。其核心发现是：在线后训练主要重新分配预训练继承的能力而非学习新视觉内容，因此坍缩是"抑制"而非"删除"，可从生成器内部逆转。ReNFT 通过无条件探针优先挑选"反中心"提示，构造配对反事实提案并利用自适应翻转守卫的奖励排序来分配拉/推角色，再联合配对 NFT 更新完成修复。在 PickScore 和 GenEval 上，ReNFT 分别保留 NFT 奖励的 98.9% 和 99.0%，同时将 DreamSim-Div 提升 58.8% 和 55.0%，可作为外部干预的互补方案。
AI.motivation: 奖励后训练会使扩散生成器不可避免地将概率质量集中到少数受奖励偏好的模式上，导致模式坍缩并抹除提示内（within-prompt）多样性。现有缓解方法依赖外部信号或接口（如感知目标、参考正则化调整、修改文本编码器），但没有一种能修复已经坍缩的 adapter，同时保留已获得的奖励。本文观察到，在线后训练主要是在预训练继承的能力上重新分配概率质量，而非学习新视觉内容，因此坍缩是"抑制"而非"删除"，从而可以仅从生成器内部实现逆转。
AI.method: 提出 ReNFT（内部概率质量重校准修复）。具体流程：(1) 无条件的探针首先对"反中心"（anti-hub）提示进行优先排序，在这些提示上提示无关的（prompt-independent）偏置最容易暴露；(2) 两条策略主导的混合路线从同一提示和同一初始噪声生成匹配的反事实提案——一条探测冻结的基础方向以寻找被抑制的替代方案，另一条暴露后训练的无条件倾向；(3) 结合自适应翻转守卫（adaptive flipping guard）的奖励排序为提案分配"拉动"（pull）与"推动"（push）角色；(4) 通过联合且配对的 NFT（Noise-Free Training/Fine-Tuning）更新实现修复。
AI.result: 在 PickScore 和 GenEval 基准上，ReNFT 分别保留了 NFT 奖励的 98.9% 和 99.0%，同时将 DreamSim-Div（多样性指标）提升 58.8% 和 55.0%，在不损失已获得奖励的情况下显著恢复多样性。
AI.conclusion: ReNFT 表明奖励后训练导致的模式坍缩本质上是概率质量的重新分配而非能力删除，因此可以仅从生成器内部通过概率质量重校准来修复已坍缩的 adapter——既能保留已获取的高奖励，又能恢复提示内多样性。它为外部干预提供了一种互补的替代方案。

title: Zero-Shot Respiratory Sound Classification through LLM-Augmented Audio-Text Alignment
summary: Self-supervised respiratory encoders lack semantic grounding in clinical domain needed for zero-shot inference, limiting their utility without task-specific labeled data. We propose a framework that aligns these encoders with medical terminology in a shared latent space turning them into a zero-shot-capable foundation model. To address paired data scarcity, we use a medical LLM to synthesize structured reports from metadata, creating dense semantic anchors for contrastive learning. Our training combines a sigmoid-based contrastive loss with encoder's native SSL objective and similarity-aware negative sampling to sharpen pathological boundaries. Across 9 tasks on 6 datasets, our method achieves a 61.3% mean zero-shot AUC, surpassing CLAP (51.4%) and Qwen2-Audio (54.9%) while reaching the highest linear probing AUC (71.6%) with only 43% of data used by full-scale baselines, showing that structured semantic alignment outperforms large-scale, general-purpose models in clinical diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 提出一个将自监督呼吸编码器与医学术语在共享潜在空间中对齐的框架，使其成为支持零样本推理的基础模型，在6个数据集的9项任务上以61.3%的平均零样本AUC超越CLAP和Qwen2-Audio，并以仅43%的数据达到最高线性探测AUC（71.6%）。
AI.motivation: 自监督呼吸编码器缺乏临床领域的语义根基，无法直接进行零样本推理；在缺少任务特定标注数据时其实用性受限。现有的通用大规模模型虽然参数量大，但在临床诊断上效果有限，且成对数据（音频-文本）稀缺，阻碍了语义对齐训练。
AI.method: 提出一个对齐框架：利用医学大语言模型（LLM）从元数据合成结构化报告，为对比学习生成密集的语义锚点，解决成对数据稀缺问题；训练将基于sigmoid的对比损失与编码器原有的自监督（SSL）目标结合，并采用语义感知的负样本采样来锐化病理边界，最终将编码器与医学术语在共享潜在空间中对齐，构建零样本可用的基础模型。
AI.result: 在6个数据集的9项任务中，该方法取得61.3%的平均零样本AUC，超越CLAP（51.4%）和Qwen2-Audio（54.9%）；同时达到最高的线性探测AUC（71.6%），且仅使用全规模基线43%的数据。
AI.conclusion: 结构化语义对齐在临床诊断中优于大规模通用模型，表明利用医学LLM合成的语义锚点进行对齐，可在数据量更少的情况下实现更强的零样本与表征学习性能，为呼吸领域构建临床可用的零样本基础模型提供了有效路径。

title: Distributed Implicit Harm: A Compositional Safety Blind Spot in MLLM-Based Video Moderation
summary: Despite their growing use in video moderation, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit a compositional safety blind spot: videos composed of seemingly benign components can convey harmful meaning when interpreted as a whole. We refer to this phenomenon as Distributed Implicit Harm (DIH), where harm arises from relations among components distributed along a decomposition axis of the video, rather than from any single explicit cue. Among many possible axes, we study two representative cases: temporally distributed harm across visual segments (DIH-T) and cross-modal harm between audio and visual streams (DIH-M). Studying and mitigating DIH at scale requires data that is difficult to collect: such videos lack compositional harm annotations, evade retrieval based on local visual cues, keywords, or single-modality signals, and are consequently absent from existing safety datasets. To bridge this gap, we develop a multi-agent synthesis framework that composes individually benign components into harmful scenarios and generates diverse DIH videos with explicit reasoning annotations, yielding a dataset of over 9,000 videos spanning visual-only and audio-visual settings. Benchmarking over 30 MLLMs spanning frontier proprietary models and leading open-source systems reveals substantial and consistent deficits in detecting both DIH-T and DIH-M. Notably, this failure persists even among the strongest frontier models: they often correctly assess individual components in isolation but fail to recognize the harmful meaning that emerges from their composition. We further evaluate these models on a manually collected set of real-world DIH videos from social media and observe the same failure mode, highlighting DIH as a practical and underexplored challenge for video moderation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“分布式隐式危害”（DIH）概念，指由多个看似无害的视频成分组合后涌现出的有害含义。作者开发了一个多智能体合成框架，生成超过9,000个带推理标注的DIH视频（覆盖时序分布DIH-T与跨模态DIH-M），并评测了30余个MLLM，发现包括前沿闭源模型在内的系统普遍无法识别合成危害，且在真实社交媒体DIH视频上同样失效。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）虽广泛用于视频审核，却存在“组合式安全盲区”：由良性成分组成的视频在整体解读时可能传达有害含义。这种危害无法通过局部视觉线索、关键词或单一模态信号检索到，现有安全数据集也缺少此类组合危害标注，导致规模化研究与缓解缺乏数据支撑。
AI.method: 开发了一个多智能体合成框架，将各自独立的良性成分组合成有害场景，并生成多样化的DIH视频及显式推理标注，最终构建了覆盖纯视觉与音视频设置的超过9,000个视频的数据集。随后对30余个MLLM（包括前沿专有模型与领先开源系统）进行基准评测，并对手动收集的真实社交媒体DIH视频进行评估。
AI.result: 基准评测表明，所有模型在检测DIH-T和DIH-M上均存在显著且一致的缺陷；即使是能力最强的前沿模型也通常在孤立评估各成分时判断正确，却无法识别成分组合后涌现的有害含义。在真实世界的DIH视频上观察到了同样的失效模式。
AI.conclusion: DIH是视频审核中一个实际存在但尚未被充分探索的挑战；现有MLLM缺乏对组合性涌现危害的识别能力，需要专门的建模与数据来弥补这一安全盲区。

title: Long-Horizon State Tracking in LLMs: Executing MD5 through a Deep Sequence of Dependent Tool Calls
summary: Long-horizon tasks remain uncommon in large language model (LLM) evaluation, and for a reason: when each step depends on the last, per-step accuracy that looks excellent in isolation decays catastrophically, as errors cascade and the end-to-end failure probability grows sharply with length. Existing agentic benchmarks report end-to-end success but confound this state-tracking difficulty with instruction interpretation, give no control group that isolates it, and are vulnerable to shortcuts such as a hallucinated final answer, so they cannot say why a long run fails. Whether an LLM can carry exact intermediate state across many tool calls at all is itself not well established. We test this cleanly by having the model compute a cryptographic hash, MD5, step by step: a sequence of $196$ dependent tool calls over $64$ rounds while it carries four $32$-bit words $(a,b,c,d)$ in its own context from one call to the next. Interpretation is trivial and, because we implement MD5 from scratch (RFC~1321), we align every call to the ground-truth trace and check the digest to the bit, so any failure is pure bookkeeping. gpt-oss-120b, a mixture-of-experts model with only $\sim$5.5B active parameters per token, at temperature $0$ with a short fixed prompt, carries the full state across all $196$ calls and returns the correct digest on a majority of completed runs. In the strongest setting we replace every primitive tool with a second LLM, so a driver and a worker compute the whole hash from scratch with no exact-arithmetic oracle in the loop. Two ingredients decide success and neither changes the weights: keeping the model's own reasoning in its context each turn, and voting over a thinking-enabled worker to remove its modular-arithmetic slips. We localize the residual failures by origin, separating state-carrying from arithmetic and from serving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种干净的长程任务评估方法：让LLM逐步计算MD5哈希（196次依赖工具调用、64轮），以此单独测试模型跨工具调用携带精确中间状态的能力，排除了指令理解与取巧因素的混淆。实验表明gpt-oss-120b在多数完整运行中能全程携带状态并输出正确摘要；在将工具替换为第二个LLM的最强设置下，保留模型自身推理与投票机制是关键，且失败可按状态携带、算术、服务来源定位。
AI.motivation: 现有agentic评测仅报告端到端成功率，却把状态跟踪困难与指令理解混为一谈，缺乏隔离该能力的对照组，且易受虚构最终答案等捷径干扰；LLM能否在多次工具调用间精确携带中间状态这一基本问题尚不明确。
AI.method: 让模型按RFC 1321从零逐步计算MD5：在64轮共196次依赖工具调用中，模型须在自身上下文里携带四个32位字(a,b,c,d)在调用间传递。由于与ground-truth逐调对齐并逐位校验摘要，任何失败都纯粹是簿记（bookkeeping）问题。测试了多种设置，最强设置下将每个原始工具替换为第二个LLM，形成driver+worker无精确算术oracle的完全计算。
AI.result: gpt-oss-120b（每token仅约5.5B活跃参数的MoE模型）在温度0、短固定提示下，多数完整运行能跨越全部196次调用携带完整状态并返回正确MD5摘要。两个不改变权重的关键要素决定成败：每轮将模型自身推理保留在上下文中，以及对启用思考的worker进行投票以消除模算术错误。残余失败可按起因分类为状态携带、算术与serving问题。
AI.conclusion: LLM具备在长程工具调用链中精确携带中间状态的能力，且该能力可由纯簿记任务可靠度量；推理保留与投票机制可在不修改权重的前提下显著提升成功率，为长程agent可靠性提供了可诊断、可定位失败的评测范式。

title: VPID: An Integrated Framework for Vulnerability Prioritization and Intrusion Detection in Enterprise Networks
summary: Small enterprises face increasingly serious threats to their internal networks but often lack the financial resources, computing capacity, and specialist staff required to deploy resource intensive security platforms. This paper designs and implements VPID, a lightweight framework for vulnerability prioritization and intrusion detection that consists of two principal modules: controlled vulnerability validation and intelligent intrusion defense. The first module uses OpenVAS for asset mapping and vulnerability identification, applies a decision tree to prioritize vulnerabilities, and employs a rule engine to generate targeted validation payloads. The second module captures network traffic using Scapy, analyzes it through a detection pipeline that combines a decision tree with multinomial Naive Bayes, verifies traffic assessed as high risk using Snort rules, and performs blocking and alerting through iptables. The evaluation uses 550,000 network flow samples containing normal and attack traffic for detector training, together with 15,000 labeled vulnerability records. On the vulnerability ranking test set, the decision tree achieves a precision of 91.8%, a recall of 89.5%, and an F1 score of 90.6%. On an independent test set containing 55,000 traffic samples, the combined detection pipeline achieves a precision of 94.5%, a recall of 88.3%, and an F1 score of 91.3%, while maintaining a false positive rate below 1.5%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了 VPID，一个面向资源有限的小型企业、轻量级的漏洞优先级排序与入侵检测框架，由“受控漏洞验证”和“智能入侵防御”两个模块构成，分别在漏洞排序与流量检测上取得了较高的精确率、召回率和 F1 值。
AI.motivation: 小型企业的内部网络面临日益严重的安全威胁，但往往缺乏部署资源密集型安全平台所需的资金、计算能力和专业人员，因此需要一种轻量级、低成本且有效的安全解决方案。
AI.method: VPID 框架包含两个主要模块：一是受控漏洞验证模块，使用 OpenVAS 进行资产映射和漏洞识别，通过决策树对漏洞进行优先级排序，并利用规则引擎生成针对性的验证载荷；二是智能入侵防御模块，使用 Scapy 捕获网络流量，通过由决策树与多项式朴素贝叶斯结合的检测流水线进行分析，对判定为高风险的流量使用 Snort 规则进一步验证，并借助 iptables 执行阻断和告警。
AI.result: 实验使用 55 万条包含正常与攻击流量的网络流样本训练检测器，以及 1.5 万条带标签的漏洞记录。在漏洞排序测试集上，决策树达到 91.8% 的精确率、89.5% 的召回率和 90.6% 的 F1 值；在包含 5.5 万条流量样本的独立测试集上，组合检测流水线达到 94.5% 的精确率、88.3% 的召回率和 91.3% 的 F1 值，同时误报率保持在 1.5% 以下。
AI.conclusion: VPID 以轻量级架构实现了有效的漏洞优先级排序与入侵检测，能够在有限资源条件下为小型企业提供高精确率、低误报的安全防护能力，验证了融合决策树与朴素贝叶斯等轻量算法的可行性。

title: Figures as Programs: Recursive Generation of Editable Scientific Figures
summary: Scientific methodology figures are essential for communicating complex methods clearly, yet creating them remains labor-intensive and typically requires multiple rounds of refinement. Recent image-generation models can synthesize visually appealing raster figures, but producing a human-satisfactory result in a single generation step remains difficult. Moreover, precise edits to raster figures are challenging for both humans and models. We formulate scientific figure generation as recursive SVG program construction and propose \textsc{FigTree}, a \textit{multi-agent} system that automatically transforms a scientific paper into a structured vector figure. \textsc{FigTree} grounds figure content in the source paper, decomposes a figure into a hierarchy of local regions, generates each region as a short SVG program, and assembles the resulting fragments. A render-critic refinement loop jointly inspects the rendered figure and its underlying program, enabling visual defects to be traced to specific statements and accurately repaired. We conduct extensive evaluations of \textsc{FigTree} on figure quality and editability, showing that \textsc{FigTree} produces high-quality figures, while also enabling more effective editing than existing raster-based methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FigTree，一个将科学论文自动转化为结构化矢量图的多智能体系统。该方法将科学图形生成建模为递归的 SVG 程序构建，通过内容锚定、层次化分解、分区域程序生成与渲染-评论家迭代优化相结合，在保证生成质量的同时显著提升图形的可编辑性。
AI.motivation: 科学方法论图形的创建耗时费力，通常需要多轮人工修改；现有的图像生成模型虽能合成美观的栅格图，但单步生成难以令人满意，且对栅格图进行精确编辑对人和模型都极具挑战。
AI.method: 将科学图形生成形式化为递归的 SVG 程序构建，并设计多智能体系统 FigTree：首先将图形内容锚定于源论文，将图形分解为局部区域的层次结构，为每个区域生成简短的 SVG 程序，再组装各碎片；同时引入"渲染-评论家"（render-critic）优化循环，联合审视渲染出的图形及其底层程序，从而将视觉缺陷追溯到具体语句并精确修复。
AI.result: 在图形质量和可编辑性上对 FigTree 进行了广泛评估，结果表明 FigTree 能生成高质量图形，并且在编辑效率上显著优于现有的基于栅格的方法。
AI.conclusion: 将科学图形生成建模为递归的 SVG 程序构建，能够在保证图像质量的同时赋予图形结构化的可编辑表示，为自动化科学插图生成提供了一个兼顾质量与可编辑性的有效范式。

title: Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design of a Lightweight PCG Equalizer with a Fixed Step Size for Massive MIMO
summary: Coarse quantization in massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems reduces power but causes clipping distortions. The Bayesian Expectation-Maximization (BEM) algorithm can recover clipped signals, but its matrix inversion and dynamic step-size evaluation are hardware bottlenecks. We propose a hardware-friendly one-step correction that uses the initial Jacobi-preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (PCG) direction with a fixed relaxation parameter. The resulting symbol-level update has an ultra-lightweight $\mathcal{O}(U)$ feed-forward datapath and approaches high-resolution reference detectors in the evaluated massive-MIMO setting.
