Our finite-dimensional analysis establishes the exact one-step descent law, proves that Jacobi normalization cancels the raw multiplicative near-far scaling while confining the loaded-system dependence to bounded attenuation factors, and gives verifiable sufficient conditions for fixed-step descent in terms of normalized channel coherence. System-level results indicate projected power savings for energy-efficient massive MIMO uplinks.

AI.tldr: 针对大规模MIMO系统中粗量化引起的削波失真问题，提出一种硬件友好的单步校正方法：利用初始的雅可比预条件共轭梯度（PCG）方向并采用固定松弛参数，得到仅有O(U)前馈数据通路的符号级更新，在评估的大规模MIMO场景中逼近高分辨率参考检测器，并给出有限维分析验证其单步下降规律与收敛充分条件。
AI.motivation: 大规模MIMO中的粗量化虽能降低功耗，但会带来削波失真；贝叶斯期望最大化（BEM）算法虽能恢复被削波的信号，但其中的矩阵求逆和动态步长计算是硬件实现的主要瓶颈，亟需低复杂度、硬件友好的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出一种硬件友好的一步校正方案：使用初始的雅可比预条件共轭梯度方向并配合固定松弛参数，从而形成超轻量级、复杂度仅为O(U)的符号级前馈更新；并通过有限维分析推导精确的一步下降规律，证明雅可比归一化可抵消原始乘性近远缩放、将负载系统依赖性限制在有界衰减因子内，同时给出以归一化信道相干性表示的固定步长下降的充分条件。
AI.result: 所提方案在评估的大规模MIMO场景中性能接近高分辨率参考检测器；有限维分析证明了精确的一步下降规律，验证了雅可比归一化对近远缩放效应的消除以及负载系统依赖性的有界性；系统级结果表明可望显著节省能量高效的Massive MIMO上行链路的功耗。
AI.conclusion: 该单步PCG固定松弛校正方法以极低的硬件开销（O(U)前馈路径）替代BEM中的瓶颈运算，在保持接近高分辨率参考检测性能的同时实现功耗节省，为能量高效的大规模MIMO上行链路提供了一种具有可验证收敛性保证的实用检测方案。

title: Attention Sensitivity Is Not Enough: Dissociating Attention-Level and Behavioural In-Context Learning under Fine-Tuning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) lets large language models adapt to new tasks from demonstrations, and fine-tuning can erode this behaviour. Many preservation diagnostics inspect attention: if attention changes when demonstrations change, the model is treated as context-sensitive. This paper asks how far that proxy can be trusted once it is optimised. We formalise \emph{In-Context Sensitivity} (ICS), the average row distance between last-token attention on matched and mismatched demonstration prefixes, and pair it with \emph{ICL-GAP}, the behavioural accuracy gap between the same prefixes. In a controlled four-arm ablation on Llama-2-7B, an ICS-maximising regulariser ($\armKL$) drives ICS to $1.413$, within $0.5\%$ of its geometric ceiling. The behavioural readout tells a different story: ICL-GAP stays near zero and MMLU accuracy moves from $0.371$ to $0.279$, a Goodhart dissociation of the bounded attention proxy. Endpoint statistics locate the mechanism: attention grows sharp and near-disjoint across prefixes yet routes to formatting and demonstration-body tokens rather than labels. A random-label protocol confirms that the behavioural probe family retains dynamic range at the same checkpoints. In a constructive sweep, behaviour gating partially mitigates the effect, while objectives anchored to pretrained computation hold the high-MMLU, moderate-ICS region that divergence maximisers leave. The main lesson is diagnostic: attention-level ICL proxies earn their place as training targets only after validation against behavioural gaps.

AI.tldr: 本文研究注意力层面的上下文学习（ICL）代理指标在优化后是否可信。作者提出ICS（In-Context Sensitivity，末token注意力在匹配/失配示范前缀间的平均行距离）并将其与行为指标ICL-GAP配对，结果显示仅优化ICS会让该指标逼近几何上界，但行为表现（ICL-GAP接近零、MMLU从0.371降至0.279）出现Goodhart背离，说明注意力级代理在未经行为校准前不宜作为训练目标。
AI.motivation: 上下文学习（ICL）使大模型能从未见示范中自适应，但微调会侵蚀这一能力。现有诊断常以注意力作为代理：若示范变化导致注意力变化，则认为模型具有上下文敏感性。本文质疑这种代理指标在被优化（作为训练目标）之后是否仍然可信，意图刻画并防范代理指标与实际行为之间的脱节。
AI.method: 作者形式化定义了In-Context Sensitivity（ICS，末token注意力在匹配与失配示范前缀之间的平均行距离）和ICL-GAP（同一前缀对之间的行为准确率差距），并在Llama-2-7B上开展四臂受控消融：用ICS最大化正则化器训练模型，同时通过端点统计、随机标签协议以及构造性扫描（行为门控、锚定预训练计算的目标）来定位机制并检验缓解手段。
AI.result: ICS最大化正则化器将ICS推高至1.413，达到其几何上界的99.5%；但行为读数与之背离：ICL-GAP保持接近零，MMLU准确率从0.371降至0.279，呈现Goodhart式脱钩。端点统计显示注意力在各前缀间变得尖锐且近乎不相交，却主要路由到格式标记和示范正文而非标签。随机标签协议证明行为探针族在同一检查点仍保有动态范围；构造扫描中，行为门控可部分缓解，而锚定预训练计算的目标能维持高MMLU、中等ICS区域。
AI.conclusion: 核心教训是诊断性的：注意力层面的ICL代理只有经过行为差距验证后才有资格作为训练目标。仅优化注意力代理会产生Goodhart效应，因此在将此类指标用于训练目标之前，必须将其与ICL-GAP等行为指标对照校准。

title: ValueGraph: Value-Signal Guided Graph Pre-training for Contextualized User Representation
summary: Value signals are aggregated user-level moral representations that capture users' inferred value-related tendencies from their online discourse. User behavior on social media is shaped not only by what users say or whom they interact with, but also by the value signal through which they express attitudes. Existing user representation methods largely miss this value-relevant dimension. We propose ValueGraph, a graph pre-training framework that uses automatically inferred moral-value signals as noisy auxiliary signals for contextualized user representation. From post-reply graphs, ValueGraph learns semantic and structural representations and further aligns users through relative value similarity with contrastive and clustering objectives. Rather than treating inferred values as gold psychological labels, ValueGraph uses them as soft constraints for representation learning. Experiments on stance detection and twitter bot detection show consistent gains over strong text-based, graph-based, and text-only LLM baselines, highlighting value-signal guidance as a useful inductive bias for socially informed user modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ValueGraph，一种基于图预训练的框架，利用自动推断的道德价值信号作为带噪辅助信号来学习上下文感知的用户表示；在立场检测和机器人检测任务上优于强文本、图表及文本大语言模型基线。
AI.motivation: 用户在社会媒体上的行为不仅受其言论内容和互动对象影响，还受其表达态度时所采用的价值信号影响。然而现有用户表示方法大多忽略了这一价值相关维度。
AI.method: ValueGraph 从帖子-回复图中学习语义与结构表示，将自动推断的道德价值信号作为带噪辅助信号；通过相对价值相似性，结合对比学习与聚类目标对用户进行对齐，并将推断出的价值作为软约束而非金标准心理标签来指导表示学习。
AI.result: 在立场检测与 Twitter 机器人检测实验中，ValueGraph 相较于基于文本、基于图以及纯文本大语言模型的强基线取得了一致的性能提升，验证了价值信号引导作为社会信息用户建模的有效归纳偏置。
AI.conclusion: 价值信号可作为有用的归纳偏置指导社会性用户建模，且将推断价值作为软约束而非硬标签能有效提升下游任务的表示质量。

title: Beyond Language Priors: Diagnosing and Fixing Visual-Origin Hallucinations in Multimodal LLM
comment: Carmera-ready version. To appear in ACM MM 2026
summary: Existing research on object hallucination in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) predominantly attributes the problem to language priors such as over-reliance on textual co-occurrence statistics. We challenge this view by presenting quantitative evidence for a complementary, under-explored cause: visual-origin hallucination, where hallucinations arise from incorrect visual feature extraction and misalignment between image and text embeddings. Through cosine similarity analysis and Smooth Grad-CAM entropy measurements, we show that hallucinated samples exhibit systematically lower image-text similarity (average 0.158 vs. -0.122) and inverted attention patterns, where attention is dispersed when the target object is present but wrongly concentrated when it is absent. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose Adversarial Contrastive Fine-Tuning (ACFT). ACFT uses an Adversarial Hallucination Attribute Flipping (AHAF) procedure, involving minimal, targeted adversarial perturbations that flip an image's hallucination attribute, to construct perfectly aligned positive-negative pairs, which are then used for contrastive fine-tuning. AHAF simultaneously serves as a diagnostic probe, revealing that MLLM visual representations lie dangerously close to hallucination decision boundaries. Requiring only 0.9% of the COCO dataset and adding zero inference overhead, ACFT achieves state-of-the-art performance on POPE, MME, and four description-level hallucination benchmarks across LLaVA, MiniGPT-4, and Qwen2.5-VL. Code is available at https://github.com/zxp555/ACFT_MM

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）对象幻觉主要源于语言先验（如文本共现统计）的既有观点，通过余弦相似度分析和Smooth Grad-CAM熵测量提供了量化证据，表明存在一种互补且未充分探索的视觉根源性幻觉：错误视觉特征提取与图文嵌入错对齐。基于此诊断，作者提出对抗对比微调（ACFT），利用对抗幻觉属性翻转（AHAF）构造完美对齐的正负样本对进行对比微调，仅需COCO数据集的0.9%且零推理开销，即在POPE、MME及四个描述级幻觉基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将MLLM中的对象幻觉主要归因于语言先验（如过度依赖文本共现统计），但忽略了视觉层面的成因。作者旨在通过量化分析揭示幻觉的另一互补根源——视觉特征提取错误及图像与文本嵌入之间的错对齐，并据此设计更有效的缓解方法。
AI.method: 先通过余弦相似度分析和Smooth Grad-CAM熵测量进行诊断：显示幻觉样本的图文相似度系统性更低（平均0.158对-0.122），且注意力模式反转（目标存在时注意力分散、目标缺失时反而集中）。在此基础上提出对抗对比微调（ACFT），其核心是AHAF过程：施加最小化、有针对性的对抗扰动以翻转图像的幻觉属性，构造完美对齐的正负样本对用于对比微调；AHAF同时充当诊断探针，揭示MLLM视觉表征紧邻幻觉决策边界。
AI.result: ACFT仅需COCO数据集的0.9%并零推理开销，在POPE、MME及四个描述级幻觉基准上，跨LLaVA、MiniGPT-4和Qwen2.5-VL三种架构取得最先进（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 对象幻觉存在语言先验之外的视觉根源，且MLLM表征接近幻觉决策边界；通过对抗对比微调可以高效、低成本地显著缓解幻觉，验证了视觉对齐机制在幻觉抑制中的关键作用。

title: OpenAgentFlow: Enabling System-Wide Safety Boundaries for Heterogeneous AI Agent Fleets
summary: AI agents powered by large language models are evolving from isolated assistants into heterogeneous systems in which multiple agents, planners, tools, and execution backends operate over shared environments. In such settings, safety becomes a system-level action-governance problem: deciding whether a pending action should be committed given policy-relevant state accumulated across a session. Existing safeguards operate at fragmented boundaries, making it difficult to enforce shared policies over composed action flows across heterogeneous execution paths. We present OpenAgentFlow, a control-plane/action-plane architecture that establishes the action-commit boundary as a shared enforcement interface. GUI, API, tool, and LLM-generated actions are normalized into a common AgentEvent stream and mediated by a shared pre-execution Policy Enforcement Point, while provenance, session state, audit evidence, and updatable policies are maintained outside individual agents. This provides a common governance layer across incompatible executors and allows new policies to take effect without modifying agents, prompts, models, or execution paths. We evaluate OpenAgentFlow through complementary system evaluations spanning controlled action-flow tests, a public external benchmark, policy updates, and real Android execution. On a 300-case controlled suite, OpenAgentFlow achieves 94.00% accuracy and a 95.35% attack-block rate. On the complete 1,220-case AgentDojo-Traj split of TS-Bench, it achieves 97.62% accuracy, 96.59% unsafe-action recall, and a 1.96% safe false-intervention rate. New control-plane rules take effect without modifying protected agents, and the same enforcement path operates across live GUI, API/tool, and LLM-planned Android execution. These results show that a shared action-commit boundary provides a practical basis for system-wide governance across heterogeneous agent execution paths.

AI.tldr: OpenAgentFlow 提出一种控制面/动作面架构，将“动作提交边界”作为异构 AI 智能体系统中统一的安全执行接口。它把 GUI、API、工具及 LLM 生成的动作规范化为统一的 AgentEvent 流，并由共享的事前策略执行点统一裁决，同时将溯源、会话状态、审计证据和可更新策略存放在各智能体之外，从而在互不兼容的执行器之上建立公共治理层。实验表明其在受控用例、公开基准和真实 Android 执行中均取得高准确率与高攻击拦截率，且新策略无需修改受保护智能体即可生效。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型驱动的 AI 智能体正从孤立助手演变为由多个智能体、规划器、工具和执行后端在共享环境中协同运行的异构系统。在此场景下，安全本质上变成系统级的动作治理问题——需要依据跨会话累积的策略相关状态决定某一待执行动作是否应被提交。然而现有安全机制分散在互不衔接的边界上，难以在异构执行路径上对复合动作流强制执行统一共享策略，这是该工作的核心动机。
AI.method: 提出 OpenAgentFlow 架构，采用控制面与动作面分离的设计：将 GUI、API、工具和 LLM 生成的动作统一规范化为共享的 AgentEvent 流，并经过位于动作提交边界的事前政策执行点（Policy Enforcement Point）统一裁决。溯源信息、会话状态、审计证据和可更新策略均维护在单个智能体之外，形成一个跨不兼容执行器的公共治理层；新策略无需修改智能体、提示词、模型或执行路径即可生效。
AI.result: 在 300 例受控动作流测试中达到 94.00% 准确率和 95.35% 攻击拦截率；在 AgentDojo-Traj 完整 1,220 例 TS-Bench 子集上达到 97.62% 准确率、96.59% 不安全动作召回率和 1.96% 安全动作误拦截率。新的控制面规则可在不修改受保护智能体的前提下生效，且同一套执行路径可同时作用于真实 GUI、API/工具及 LLM 规划的 Android 执行。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，一个共享的动作提交边界能够为跨异构智能体执行路径的系统级治理提供切实可行的基础，证明了以统一政策执行点为核心的治理层可兼顾安全性、可更新性与跨执行器通用性。

title: Connectome-Based Modelling Reveals Orientation Maps in the Drosophila Optic Lobe
summary: The ability to extract oriented edges from visual input is a core computation across animal vision systems. Orientation maps, long associated with the layered architecture of the mammalian visual cortex, systematically organise neurons by their preferred edge orientation. Despite lacking cortical structures, the Drosophila melanogaster brain contains feature-selective neurons and exhibits complex visual detection capacity, raising the question of whether map-like vision representations can emerge without cortical infrastructure. We integrate a complete fruit fly brain connectome with biologically grounded spiking neuron models to simulate neuroprocessing in the fly visual system. By driving the network with oriented stimuli and analysing downstream responses, we show that coherent orientation maps can emerge from purely connectome-constrained dynamics. These results suggest that species of independent origin could evolve similar visual structures.

AI.tldr: 通过整合果蝇全脑连接组与生物合理性的脉冲神经元模型，本文证明在缺乏皮层结构的果蝇视觉系统中，仅凭连接组约束的动力学即可涌现出与哺乳动物相似的有序朝向图（orientation maps），提示独立演化物种可能趋同进化出相似的视觉表征结构。
AI.motivation: 朝向提取是动物视觉的核心计算。哺乳动物视觉皮层通过分层结构形成朝向图，但果蝇没有皮层结构却拥有特征选择性神经元和复杂视觉检测能力。这引发了核心问题：没有皮层基础设施，是否能涌现出类似地图式的视觉表征？
AI.method: 将完整的果蝇大脑连接组与生物合理性的脉冲神经元模型相结合，模拟果蝇视觉系统的神经处理过程；用朝向刺激驱动网络，并分析下游神经元响应，以检验朝向图是否能够从连接组约束的动力学中涌现。
AI.result: 实验表明，相干、有序的朝向图可以从纯粹由连接组约束的动力学中涌现出来，而无需任何皮层结构或专门的朝向图布线。
AI.conclusion: 该发现表明，源于独立进化路径的物种也可能演化出相似的视觉结构，即朝向图并非哺乳动物皮层所独有，而可能是连接组动力学约束下趋同演化的普遍结果。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction (NeuSOGA): From Observations to Symbolic Mathematical Representations
summary:
A fundamental challenge in artificial intelligence is the transformation of observations into explicit symbolic representations suitable for abstraction, interpretation, and reasoning. While modern AI systems achieve remarkable perceptual capabilities through large-scale statistical learning, the resulting knowledge is typically encoded within latent parameters that are difficult to inspect or manipulate analytically. Inspired by Neuro-Symbolic AI and theories of human abstraction, this paper investigates the formation of symbolic mathematical representations from geometric observations.
  We propose NeuSOGA (Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction), a framework that progressively transforms observations into topological abstractions, geometric abstractions, and ultimately symbolic mathematical representations. The architecture combines topology-guided structural discovery using Euclidean Distance Transforms, foundation-model perception using Segment Anything, adaptive multi-scale geometric abstraction, and symbolic synthesis through Implicit Area Splines.
  The resulting representation is an analytical implicit model supporting arbitrary-order smoothness, additive composition, and closed-form evaluation. Unlike neural latent encodings, the generated representation remains interpretable, editable, and mathematically explicit. Experiments on ModelNet40 point clouds, arbitrary-view projections, and segmented optical observations demonstrate that NeuSOGA transforms diverse observations into compact symbolic representations while preserving essential geometric and topological structure across sensing modalities and viewing directions.
  NeuSOGA provides an interpretable and explainable pathway from observation to symbol and establishes

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NeuSOGA（神经符号几何抽象）框架，将几何观测逐步转化为拓扑抽象、几何抽象，最终形成显式的符号数学表示，在保持可解释性、可编辑性和解析性质的同时，实现跨感知模态与视角的紧致符号建模。
AI.motivation: 人工智能面临的核心挑战是将观测转化为可抽象、可解释、可推理的显式符号表示；而现代大规模统计学习得到的知识隐藏在难以检视和解析操作的潜在参数中。受神经符号 AI 与人类抽象理论启发，作者旨在从几何观测中自动形成符合人类抽象方式的符号数学表示。
AI.method: 提出 NeuSOGA 框架，采用渐进式抽象流水线：使用欧几里得距离变换进行拓扑引导的结构发现，利用基础模型 Segment Anything 进行感知，实施自适应多尺度几何抽象，并通过隐式面积样条完成符号综合；最终生成支持任意阶光滑性、加法合成与闭式求值的解析隐式模型。
AI.result: 在 ModelNet40 点云、任意视角投影及分割后的光学观测上，NeuSOGA 能将多样观测转化为紧致符号表示，同时保留关键的几何与拓扑结构，且跨感知模态和视角具有一致性；与神经潜在编码不同，该表示可解释、可编辑且数学上显式。
AI.conclusion: NeuSOGA 为从观测到符号提供了一条可解释、可说明的路径，弥合了神经感知与符号推理之间的鸿沟，为可检视、可操作的数学化表示奠定了方法基础。

title: Exact Payload-Decoupling Conditions for Pilot-Only BEM Channel Estimation With Application to OTFS
summary: In high-mobility doubly dispersive links, basis expansion models (BEMs) reduce channel dimensionality, yet unknown payload symbols generally contaminate conventional matched-pilot channel estimates. This paper establishes the exact conditions under which such estimates become payload-independent and derives a pilot, guard, and data-placement rule that guarantees these conditions. We prove a necessary-and-sufficient zero pilot--data interference (ZPDI) condition under which the matched-pilot least-squares (LS) solution coincides with the maximum-likelihood (ML) estimator for the reduced pilot statistic. When ZPDI holds, estimation requires a single precomputed projection. When it does not, the estimate contains a deterministic, channel-scaled payload bias that persists at high signal-to-noise ratio. A disjoint-support rule, independent of the selected basis, realizes ZPDI through pilot, guard, and data placement. We then specialize the framework to orthogonal time--frequency space (OTFS) and examine its structural and performance consequences. With the generalized complex-exponential BEM (GCE-BEM), the ZPDI estimator remains within about $2$~dB of the perfect channel state information benchmark in bit error rate at speeds up to 500~km/h.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高移动性双色散链路中的基扩展模型（BEM）信道估计问题，建立了一组充分必要条件，使匹配导频的最小二乘（LS）估计与最大似然（ML）估计一致（即零导频-数据干扰，ZPDI），并给出了独立于所选基的导频、保护与数据放置规则。当ZPDI成立时，估计仅需一次预计算投影；否则估计含确定性的、随信道缩放的有效载荷偏置，且在高信噪比下持续存在。将框架专门化到OTFS与广义复指数BEM后，在500 km/h速度下误码率距完美信道状态信息基准仅约2 dB。
AI.motivation: 在高移动性双色散链路中，BEM虽能降低信道维度，但未知的有效载荷符号通常会污染常规的匹配导频信道估计，导致高信噪比下仍存在确定性偏置。现有工作缺乏对"何时估计不受有效载荷污染"的精确刻画，需要一个普适、与所选基无关的导频与数据放置准则来消除该污染。
AI.method: 作者首先从理论上证明匹配导频LS解与约简导频统计量的ML估计器一致的充要ZPDI条件；基于该条件，提出与具体基选择无关的不相交支撑（disjoint-support）规则，通过导频、保护间隔与数据的具体放置实现ZPDI；随后将框架专门化到OTFS-GCE-BEM场景，分析其结构与性能。
AI.result: 推导并证明了充要的零导频-数据干扰（ZPDI）条件；当ZPDI成立时估计只需一次预计算投影，当不成立时估计含信道尺度化的确定性有效载荷偏置且在高信噪比下不消失。在GCE-BEM与OTFS下，所提ZPDI估计器在最高500 km/h速度下误码率距离完美CSI基准约2 dB。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为高移动性双色散信道下的BEM信道估计提供了严格的线性代数条件框架：只要按不相交支撑规则放置导频、保护与数据，即可保证估计与有效载荷解耦，使估计复杂度降至单次预计算投影，同时保持接近完美CSI的性能，为OTFS等高速移动场景提供了实用设计准则。

title: RW-LoRA: Communication-Efficient Decentralized LoRA Fine-Tuning via Random Walks
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA have become a standard approach for adapting large foundation models. Adopting fine-tuning to distributed settings faces several challenges. Most existing distributed LoRA methods rely on centralized aggregation, and gossip-based decentralized LoRA requires repeated synchronization among multiple model copies. Both methods incur significant communication overhead and introduce errors due to simultaneous aggregation of multiple model updates. In this paper, we take a different perspective and propose a random-walk-based LoRA fine-tuning scheme. Instead of maintaining multiple model replicas, a single model token traverses the network and is updated sequentially using local fine-tuning objectives. This design eliminates the need for global synchronization, substantially reduces communication and computation costs, and avoids aggregation errors. We provide rigorous convergence guarantees for non-convex objectives under standard assumptions. Through empirical results on multiple NLP tasks and graph topologies, we show that the proposed method achieves competitive task performance with substantially less communication and computation than gossip-based LoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于随机游走的LoRA分布式微调方案：仅用一个模型token在网络中顺序遍历各节点并依次用本地目标更新，从而避免全局同步与多副本聚合，在保证收敛性的同时大幅降低通信与计算开销，并在多项NLP任务和图拓扑上取得了与gossip式LoRA相当的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有分布式LoRA方法（如集中式聚合和基于gossip的分散式LoRA）存在显著通信开销，且因同时聚合多个模型更新而引入误差；此外gossip式方法还需要在多个模型副本间反复同步。
AI.method: 提出随机游走式LoRA微调方案：不再维护多个模型副本，而是让单个模型token在网络中遍历，并在每个节点上使用本地微调目标顺序更新模型；该设计消除了全局同步需求，从根本上避免了多更新同时聚合带来的误差，并大幅降低通信与计算成本。作者还在标准假设下为非凸目标提供了严格的收敛性保证。
AI.result: 在多个NLP任务和图拓扑上的实验表明，所提方法在取得与gossip式LoRA相当的任务性能的同时，通信和计算开销显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 随机游走式LoRA是一种有效的分布式微调范式，能以更低代价获得与gossip式方法竞争的性能，并为非凸目标下的收敛性提供了理论保障。

title: CUDA-Harness: Harnessing Agentic CUDA Kernel Generation and Optimization from Natural Language
summary: Developing high-performance CUDA kernels demands specialized knowledge in algorithm implementation, correctness validation, and hardware-aware parallel optimization, creating a substantial expertise barrier and making generating CUDA kernels directly from natural language (Text2CUDA) essential. Meanwhile, the general-purpose code generation capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) prompts a series of works exploring LLM-based CUDA kernel generation. They mainly focus on transpilation from high-level frameworks such as PyTorch to CUDA (Torch2CUDA) rather than Text2CUDA, where models must understand the high-level input semantics and handle low-level kernel implementation and validation. Additionally, these methods are vulnerable to reward hacking due to reliance on predefined test inputs. In this paper, we propose CUDA-Harness, a framework for harnessing agentic CUDA kernel generation and optimization from natural language. Specifically, we introduce Intermediate-Structured Generation to connect high-level semantic understanding with low-level kernel generation. To dilute reward hacking in Text2CUDA, we construct Synthesis-Based Verification to provide isolated test data and progressive validation. Furthermore, we propose Feedback-Adaptive Evolution, a kernel evolution strategy that prioritizes correctness while optimizing performance. Finally, through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of CUDA-Harness, with further evaluations illustrating generalization across LLMs, hardware platforms, and to C-to-CUDA transpilation.

AI.tldr: 提出 CUDA-Harness 框架，通过中间结构化生成、基于合成的验证与反馈自适应进化三大机制，实现从自然语言到高性能 CUDA 内核的智能体式生成与优化，缓解奖励破解问题，并在多个 LLM、硬件平台及 C-to-CUDA 场景中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 高质量 CUDA 内核开发需要算法实现、正确性验证与硬件感知并行优化等多方面专业知识，门槛极高，使从自然语言直接生成 CUDA 内核（Text2CUDA）成为必要。现有基于 LLM 的工作主要聚焦于从 PyTorch 等高层框架转译（Torch2CUDA），而非 Text2CUDA，后者要求模型理解高层语义并处理底层内核实现与验证；此外，这些方法依赖预定义测试输入，易受奖励破解问题影响。
AI.method: 提出 CUDA-Harness 框架，包含三大核心机制：（1）中间结构化生成（Intermediate-Structured Generation），连接高层语义理解与底层内核生成；（2）基于合成的验证（Synthesis-Based Verification），提供隔离测试数据与渐进式验证以稀释奖励破解；（3）反馈自适应进化（Feedback-Adaptive Evolution），以正确性优先同时优化性能的内核进化策略。
AI.result: 大量实验证明 CUDA-Harness 的有效性；进一步评估表明其具备跨 LLM、跨硬件平台的泛化能力，并可推广到 C-to-CUDA 转译任务。
AI.conclusion: CUDA-Harness 通过将高层语义理解与底层内核生成解耦、以合成验证对抗奖励破解、并采用正确性优先的自适应进化策略，为 Text2CUDA 提供了一套有效且可泛化的解决方案，并展现出向 C-to-CUDA 等场景迁移的潜力。

title: Beyond Blind Compliance: Benchmarking Task Verification in OCR Reasoning
summary:
Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on OCR-centric document understanding and text-rich visual reasoning benchmarks. Yet existing evaluations largely assume that every task is valid and answerable. In real-world OCR scenarios, this assumption often fails: questions may rely on illegible text, occluded evidence, nonexistent visual targets, contradictory premises, or missing variables. We study this reliability gap as OCR-grounded Task Verification: before answering, a model should determine whether the Image Premise (IP), Textual Premise (TP), and Question (Q) jointly define an executable task.
  We introduce VeriOCRBench, a 1,800-sample human-verified benchmark built from source images drawn from 8 OCR-related datasets and spanning 8 real-world image domains, with controlled, image-grounded diagnostic tasks.
  It contains 1,600 trap-injected invalid tasks across 8 trap types and four verification dimensions---Visual, Contextual, Factual, and Logical---plus 200 trap-free controls for measuring over-refusal. Built with a Visual Atomic Fact (VAF)-anchored pipeline and full human auditing, VeriOCRBench enables decoupled evaluation of task verification, root-cause diagnosis, and over-refusal. Evaluating 15 leading MLLMs reveals persistent blind compliance, diagnosis failures, and prompt-induced over-refusal, exposing a critical reliability gap in current OCR reasoning systems.
  The code is available at: https://github.com/zy001122/Beyond-Blind-Compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OCR 场景下的“任务验证”（Task Verification）问题，并构建了 VeriOCRBench——一个包含 1,800 个经人工审核样本的基准，其中 1,600 个为注入陷阱的无效任务（覆盖 8 类陷阱、4 个验证维度），另含 200 个无陷阱对照样本以衡量过度拒答。对 15 个主流多模态大模型的评测显示其普遍存在盲从、诊断失败与过度拒答等可靠性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有面向 OCR 的文档理解与文本密集视觉推理基准大多假设每个任务都是有效且可回答的，但真实场景中问题可能基于模糊文字、被遮挡证据、不存在的视觉目标、矛盾前提或缺失变量。因此在回答之前，模型应先判断图像前提、文本前提与问题是否共同构成一个可执行的任务，这就是被忽视的“OCR 任务验证”可靠性缺口。
AI.method: 作者引入 VeriOCRBench 基准：从 8 个 OCR 相关数据集的源图像中构建样本，覆盖 8 类真实图像域；包含 1,600 个陷阱注入的无效任务（8 类陷阱、四个验证维度：视觉、上下文、事实、逻辑）及 200 个无陷阱对照；采用视觉原子事实（VAF）锚定流程构建并经过完整人工审计，从而支持对任务验证、根因诊断与过度拒答的解耦评测。
AI.result: 对 15 个领先 MLLM 的评测揭示了持续存在的盲目顺从、根因诊断失败以及提示诱导的过度拒答，暴露出当前 OCR 推理系统的严重可靠性缺口。
AI.conclusion: 当前 OCR 推理模型仍缺乏在回答前进行任务有效性与可执行性验证的能力，盲从与拒答之间的可靠平衡尚未建立；VeriOCRBench 为这一可靠性缺口提供了解耦评测框架与数据集（代码已开源）。

title: SCAFFOLD: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset of Computer Science Research Figures with Diagram QA and Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Traces
summary: Computer science papers rely heavily on diagrams: architecture drawings, system flowcharts, and pipeline schematics that often carry more information than the text around them. There is currently no public dataset that pairs this specific kind of figure with captions, context, questions, answers, and step-by-step reasoning, which is exactly what is needed to train a vision-language model to understand them. We present \textbf{SCAFFOLD}\footnote{https://github.com/theranjitraut/scaffold}, a large-scale structured dataset of computer science research figures with diagram QA and Chain-of-Thought reasoning traces. This dataset consists of (image, caption, context, question-answer, chain-of-thought) tuples from arXiv computer science papers prepared using layout detection and PDF parsing, with an AI-assisted question-generation step. The resulting large-sized SCAFFOLD-157K dataset spans 3,058 papers with 29,887 figures (157,387 pairs), a medium-sized SCAFFOLD-37K dataset (36,797 pairs), and a small-sized SCAFFOLD-12K dataset (12,000 pairs). We used SCAFFOLD-12K for baseline experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 SCAFFOLD，一个大规模结构化数据集，包含计算机科学论文研究图的图表问答与思维链推理，由（图像、标题、上下文、问答、思维链）元组构成，并提供 157K/37K/12K 三种规模版本，用于训练视觉语言模型理解论文图表。
AI.motivation: 计算机科学论文高度依赖图表（架构图、系统流程图、流水线示意图），其信息量往往超过周围文字。但目前缺乏将此类特定图形与标题、上下文、问题、答案及逐步推理配对起来的公开数据集，而这正是训练视觉语言模型理解这些图表所需的。
AI.method: 利用版面检测和 PDF 解析从 arXiv 计算机科学论文中提取数据，辅以 AI 辅助的问题生成步骤，构建（图像、标题、上下文、问答、思维链）元组；并按规模划分出 SCAFFOLD-157K、SCAFFOLD-37K 和 SCAFFOLD-12K 三个版本。
AI.result: SCAFFOLD-157K 覆盖 3,058 篇论文、29,887 张图，共 157,387 个数据对；SCAFFOLD-37K 含 36,797 对；SCAFFOLD-12K 含 12,000 对。作者使用 SCAFFOLD-12K 对 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct 进行了基线实验。
AI.conclusion: SCAFFOLD 填补了计算机科学论文图表数据集的空白，为训练和评测视觉语言模型理解科研图表提供了大规模结构化资源，并已公开在 GitHub 上。

title: HarmoCore: Functional Latent Diffusion for Sparse Reconstruction of Oscillatory Wave Fields
summary: Reconstructing oscillatory wave fields from scattered sensors is a severely underdetermined inverse problem. Beyond the challenges of general physical-field reconstruction, wave responses are complex-valued, frequency-sensitive, and highly oscillatory, while costly simulation and sensing often leave only extreme-sparse observations. Existing low-rank, operator, and diffusion approaches are largely designed for real-valued, smoother fields; dense pixel-space diffusion is particularly inefficient for oscillatory complex fields and difficult to scale to 3D. We propose HarmoCore, which places a generative prior in a compact, continuous, and structured wave-field latent. HarmoCore represents joint real--imaginary channels with Functional Tucker cores over shared continuous spatial bases, learns a frequency-conditioned core diffusion prior, and performs Diffusion Posterior Sampling directly in core space. At fixed sensor coordinates, the multilinear decoder induces an explicit likelihood guidance operator, avoiding dense pixel-space correction. Optional target-equation residual guidance further promotes physical consistency. Experiments on 2D Helmholtz, 2D synthetic wave fields, and 3D Helmholtz show substantial gains under 1%--2% sensing while remaining practical in three dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HarmoCore，一种在紧凑、连续且结构化的波场隐空间中进行生成式先验建模的框架，用于从极端稀疏传感器观测（1%–2%）重建高频振荡的复值波场。HarmoCore将实部-虚部联合通道表示为共享连续空间基上的Functional Tucker核，并学习频率条件化的核扩散先验；直接在核空间执行扩散后验采样，利用多线性解码器在固定传感器坐标下导出显式似然引导算子，避免了稠密像素空间校正，可选的残差引导进一步强化物理一致性。在2D Helmholtz、2D合成波场和3D Helmholtz上的实验显示显著增益且三维可扩展。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏传感器重建振荡波场是严重欠定的反问题。波场响应具有复值、频率敏感和高频振荡的特性，且仿真与传感成本高昂，观测通常极度稀疏。现有低秩、算子及扩散方法主要面向实值且更平滑的场；稠密像素空间的扩散对复值振荡场效率低下且难以扩展到三维。因此需要一种能在紧凑结构化潜空间中高效建模复值波场并能适应3D的生成式重建方法。
AI.method: HarmoCore将生成式先验置于紧凑、连续且结构化的波场隐空间中。具体地：(1) 将实部-虚部联合通道表示为共享连续空间基上的Functional Tucker核（多线性张量分解）；(2) 学习频率条件化的核扩散先验；(3) 直接在核空间执行Diffusion Posterior Sampling；(4) 在固定传感器坐标下，多线性解码器可导出显式似然引导算子，从而避免稠密像素空间校正；(5) 可选的目标方程残差引导进一步增强物理一致性。
AI.result: 在2D Helmholtz、2D合成波场以及3D Helmholtz上，HarmoCore在1%–2%传感率下相比现有方法取得显著增益，同时在实际三维场景中仍保持可行性和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将扩散先验迁移到由Functional Tucker核表示的紧凑连续潜空间，HarmoCore有效解决了复值高频振荡波场在极端稀疏观测下的重建难题，兼顾重建精度、物理一致性与三维可扩展性，为该类欠定物理场反问题提供了新的生成式建模思路。

title: Asymptotically Optimal List Size of Random Linear Codes
summary: We prove that for every fixed prime power $q$, every $p\in(0,1-1/q)$, and every $\varepsilon>0$ with $1-H_q(p)-\varepsilon>0$, a random linear code over $\mathbb{F}_q$ of rate $1-H_q(p)-\varepsilon$ is $(p,\,\left\lceil\frac{H_q(p)}{\varepsilon}\right\rceil+O_{p,q}(1))\text{-list-decodable}$ with probability at least $1-q^{-Ω(n)}$. Guruswami, Li, Mosheiff, Resch, Silas, and Wootters showed that, for sufficiently small $\varepsilon$, random linear codes require list size at least $\left\lfloor\frac{H_q(p)}{\varepsilon}+0.99\right\rfloor,$ and conjectured that $\frac{H_q(p)}{\varepsilon}(1+o(1))$ suffices as $\varepsilon\to 0$. This conjecture was previously known for $q=2$, where the upper bound $H_2(p)/\varepsilon+2$ was established. For $q>2$, however, the best known upper bound was $C_{p,q}/\varepsilon$ for a constant $C_{p,q}$ depending on $p$ and $q$. Our result resolves the conjecture for every prime power $q$ and, in fact, establishes the sharper upper bound $\frac{H_q(p)}{\varepsilon}+O_{p,q}(1)$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明：对任意素数幂 q、任意 p∈(0,1-1/q) 及任意 ε>0（满足 1-H_q(p)-ε>0），速率为 1-H_q(p)-ε 的 F_q 上随机线性码以至少 1-q^{-Ω(n)} 的概率是列表大小为 ⌈H_q(p)/ε⌉+O_{p,q}(1) 的 (p,L)-列表可解码码。该结果解决了 Guruswami 等人针对所有素数幂 q 提出的猜想，并将 q>2 时此前已知的 C_{p,q}/ε 上界改进为紧的 H_q(p)/ε+O_{p,q}(1)。
AI.motivation: 随机线性码的列表可解码性研究旨在确定其达到 Gilbert-Varshamov 界时所需的最小列表大小。Guruswami、Li、Mosheiff、Resch、Silas 和 Wootters 已证明对小 ε 列表大小至少为 ⌊H_q(p)/ε+0.99⌋，并猜想 H_q(p)/ε(1+o(1)) 的上界即充分（最优）。该猜想此前仅对 q=2 成立（上界 H_2(p)/ε+2）；对 q>2 只有常数因子 C_{p,q}/ε 的较弱上界。本文动机即是在任意素数幂 q 下解决这一猜想，给出渐近最优的列表大小上界。
AI.method: 本文采用随机线性码的概率分析方法：对 F_q 上速率为 1-H_q(p)-ε 的随机线性码，证明其以指数级高概率（≥1-q^{-Ω(n)}）同时满足 (p, ⌈H_q(p)/ε⌉+O_{p,q}(1))-列表可解码性。通过在随机码集合上构造并控制坏事件（即存在半径 p 的 Hamming 球内码字数超过列表大小的事件）的概率，得到所需的列表大小上界。
AI.result: 对任意素数幂 q、任意 p∈(0,1-1/q) 及满足 1-H_q(p)-ε>0 的 ε>0，随机线性码以概率至少 1-q^{-Ω(n)} 是 (p, ⌈H_q(p)/ε⌉+O_{p,q}(1))-列表可解码的。该结果将此前 q>2 时已知的 C_{p,q}/ε 上界改进为 H_q(p)/ε+O_{p,q}(1)，并建立了比猜测更强的上界（常数阶加性项而非 o(1) 相对误差）。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了 Guruswami 等人关于随机线性码最优列表大小的猜想，对所有素数幂 q 证明了 H_q(p)/ε+O_{p,q}(1) 的列表大小上界，与已知下界 ⌊H_q(p)/ε+0.99⌋ 匹配，从而确认随机线性码在以 Gilbert-Varshamov 速率工作时具有近乎最优的列表可解码性。

title: Stochastic complexity of vectors containing cluster structure
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Originally published in the Proceedings of the International Workshop on Nonlinear Signal and Image Processing (NSIP 2007), Bucharest, Romania, 10-12 September 2007, pp. 164-169
summary: This paper studies the problem of computing the stochastic probability (shortest code length) of the encoded vectors containing cluster structure using Normalized Maximum Likelihood (NML) model. This is of great theoretical and practical importance in data clustering based on Minimum Description Length (MDL) principle, such as for estimating the best number of clusters and best cluster structure for the data. Straightforward computation of the shortest code length of the vector containing cluster structure based on the NML model requires polynomial time with respect to the size of the vector and number of clusters. We show that this is a tractable problem by introducing a recursion formula for the efficient computation of normalizing constant from the NML model. The time complexity of the new formula is linear opposed to previous polynomial time with respect to the size of the vector and number of clusters.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于归一化最大似然（NML）模型的聚类结构编码向量的随机概率（最短编码长度）计算问题，提出了一种递归公式以高效计算归一化常数，将时间复杂度从多项式级降至线性级，从而证明了该问题在MDL聚类框架下是可有效求解的。
AI.motivation: 在基于最小描述长度（MDL）原理的数据聚类中，估计最佳簇数目与最佳簇结构需要计算含聚类结构的编码向量的最短编码长度，而这依赖于NML模型下的随机概率。然而，直接计算该概率需要关于向量长度和簇数目的多项式时间，这在理论和实际应用上都构成计算瓶颈，因此需要更高效的求解方案。
AI.method: 作者提出一个递归公式用于NML模型中归一化常数的有效计算。通过该递归关系，将原本对向量规模和簇数目呈多项式复杂度的计算转化为线性时间复杂度的计算，从而在保持NML模型理论性质的同时大幅降低计算开销。
AI.result: 新公式的时间复杂度为线性，相对于以往关于向量大小和簇数目的多项式时间实现了显著改进，表明该计算问题是可处理的（tractable）。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了基于NML模型计算含聚类结构向量的随机概率是可高效求解的，所提出的线性时间递归公式使得MDL准则下的聚类结构评估（如最佳簇数估计）在实践上更为可行，为该领域提供了重要的理论贡献与实用工具。

title: RePro: Proof-Verified Benchmark Rewriting for Reliable Evaluation of LLM Mathematical Problem Solving
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Data contamination undermines the reliable evaluation of large language models (LLMs) on mathematical problem solving. While rewriting-based evaluation mitigates memorization, existing methods lack guarantees of problem validity and answer correctness. We propose Proof-Verified Benchmark Rewriting (RePro), the first framework to integrate Lean-oriented neural automated theorem provers (ATPs) into benchmark rewriting, which rewrites problems and regenerates answers with correctness ensured by Lean-verified proofs. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH show that RePro's retained rewritten instances achieve 100% well-definedness, feasibility, and answer correctness, while existing methods still produce invalid or incorrect instances. Moreover, several models exhibit accuracy drops on proof-verified rewritten benchmarks, suggesting that their performance is sensitive to surface-level and structural variations and may partly reflect memorization effects. Our source code and data are available at https://github.com/AI4Engi/RePro.

AI.tldr: RePro 是一个将 Lean 导向的神经自动定理证明器（ATPs）集成到基准重写中的框架，用于缓解大语言模型数学评估中的数据污染问题。通过重写题目并用 Lean 验证的证明重新生成答案，RePro 在 GSM8K 和 MATH 上保证了 100% 的良定义性、可行性与答案正确性，而现有方法仍会产生无效或错误的实例；实验还发现多个模型在证明验证的重写基准上准确率下降，表明其表现部分依赖表面与结构变化、可能反映记忆效应。
AI.motivation: 数据污染会破坏 LLM 在数学问题求解上的可靠评估；现有的基于重写的评测方法虽然能缓解记忆化，但无法保证重写后问题的有效性与答案的正确性，需要一种既能抵抗记忆化又能保证问题质量和答案正确性的基准重写方案。
AI.method: 提出 Proof-Verified Benchmark Rewriting (RePro)：作为首个将 Lean 导向的神经自动定理证明器（ATPs）集成进基准重写的框架，它对原问题执行重写并为重新生成的答案提供由 Lean 验证的证明，从而以形式化证明保证重写实例的正确性。
AI.result: 在 GSM8K 与 MATH 上的实验表明，RePro 保留的重写实例在良定义性、可行性和答案正确性上均达到 100%，而现有方法仍会产生无效或错误实例；此外，多个模型在证明验证重写后的基准上出现准确率下降，说明其性能对表层与结构变化敏感，部分成绩可能源于记忆效应。
AI.conclusion: 通过形式化证明验证的重写方式可以同时保证基准的可信度与答案的正确性，有效暴露模型对表面变化的依赖和记忆化倾向，为更可靠的 LLM 数学评测提供了新范式。

title: CoLT-Drive: Counterfactual Long-Tail Benchmarking and Knowledge-Preserving Adaptation for Driving Affordance Prediction
summary: Long-tail autonomous driving failures are often framed as rare-object recognition errors. We argue that this view is incomplete: the decision-critical question is not only whether a model recognizes an unusual object, but whether it infers how that object changes the ego vehicle's feasible high-level actions. We formalize this problem as decision-level driving affordance prediction, where a model maps a front-view image, ego-motion history, and navigation command to a structured longitudinal--lateral meta-action. To evaluate this capability, we introduce CoLT-Drive, a 3,536-sample counterfactual long-tail benchmark that inserts rare objects into otherwise fixed driving scenes and measures whether models predict acceptable action pairs. To improve deployable small VLMs, we propose KPA, a knowledge-preserving adaptation framework that combines structured perception-to-decision prompting, SLERP-based expert merging, and RegMoE, a regime-aware LoRA mixture-of-experts module. KPA preserves the pretrained model's open-world knowledge while allocating lightweight adaptation capacity to different driving decision regimes. Experiments on an in-domain driving split and CoLT-Drive show that KPA achieves 60.8\% pair accuracy on CoLT-Drive, outperforming the pretrained Qwen3-VL-2B baseline (50.3\%) and LoRA SFT (32.4\%) while maintaining competitive in-domain accuracy. Our benchmark and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/tangzx2024/CoLT-Drive and https://github.com/tangzhengxu/CoLT-Drive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出决策级驾驶可供性预测（decision-level driving affordance prediction）来弥补长尾自动驾驶仅关注罕见物体识别的不足，引入包含3,536个样本的反事实长尾基准CoLT-Drive，并提出KPA（知识保持自适应框架，含结构化提示、SLERP专家合并与RegMoE路由混合专家模块），在Qwen3-VL-2B上实现60.8%的动作对准确率，显著优于预训练基线（50.3%）和LoRA SFT（32.4%）。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将长尾自动驾驶失败归结为罕见物体识别错误，但作者认为该视角不完整：关键问题不仅在于模型是否识别出异常物体，更在于它能否推断该物体如何改变自车可行的顶层动作。此前缺少对此决策级能力的评测基准与适配方法。
AI.method: 首先形式化决策级驾驶可供性预测任务：模型以正面图像、自车运动历史与导航指令为输入，输出结构化的纵向-横向元动作对。为此构建CoLT-Drive反事实长尾基准（3,536个样本，将罕见物体插入固定驾驶场景）。随后提出KPA知识保持自适应框架，包含三部分：结构化感知到决策提示（perception-to-decision prompting）、基于SLERP的专家合并，以及RegMoE——一种面向驾驶决策机制的LoRA混合专家路由模块，在保持预训练模型开放世界知识的同时将轻量自适应能力分配到不同驾驶决策机制。
AI.result: 在域内驾驶划分与CoLT-Drive上的实验表明：KPA在CoLT-Drive上达到60.8%的动作对准确率，超过预训练Qwen3-VL-2B基线（50.3%）与LoRA SFT（32.4%），同时保持有竞争力的域内准确率。基准与代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 长尾自动驾驶评估应从物体识别层面提升到决策层面；KPA通过知识保持的轻量适配（SLERP专家合并+RegMoE）能同时兼顾开放世界知识保留与决策机制自适应，为小型可部署VLM在长尾驾驶场景中提供了有效方案。

title: UI-Venus-2 Technical Report
summary: Multimodal GUI agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for digital task automation, yet transitioning from benchmark-oriented models to dependable real-world applications remains challenging due to limited environment coverage, brittle task construction, and unreliable reward verification. In this work, we present UI-Venus-2, a general-purpose foundation GUI agent designed to operate across mobile, web, and desktop environments through a unified closed-loop reasoning-action framework. To bridge the gap toward practical deployment, we jointly scale three critical dimensions: (1) Environments, expanding coverage to more than 170 multilingual mobile apps and native desktop operating systems; (2) Tasks, employing a deep-research pipeline for function-grounded instruction generation; and (3) Verification, adopting trace-level and sample-level evaluators with visual keypoints and multi-model voting to ensure reliable RL signals for training. Furthermore, we integrate safety-aware mechanisms to ensure controlled execution of consequential actions. By offering a capable, efficient, and open-source foundation, UI-Venus-2 advances the field toward more generalizable, verifiable, and self-reflective agents for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UI-Venus-2，一个跨移动端、网页和桌面环境的通用基础 GUI 智能体，通过统一闭环推理-动作框架，并同时在环境覆盖、任务构建和奖励验证三个维度进行规模化，以弥合从基准模型到可靠真实世界应用的差距。
AI.motivation: 多模态 GUI 智能体虽已成为数字任务自动化的有前景范式，但从面向基准的模型转向可靠的现实世界应用仍面临挑战，具体体现为环境覆盖有限、任务构建脆弱以及奖励验证不可靠。
AI.method: 提出 UI-Venus-2，采用统一闭环推理-动作框架，从三个关键维度联合扩展：(1) 环境——覆盖 170 多个多语言移动应用及原生桌面操作系统；(2) 任务——采用深度研究式流水线生成基于功能的指令；(3) 验证——引入轨迹级与样本级评估器，结合视觉关键点和多模型投票，为训练提供可靠的强化学习信号；同时整合安全感知机制以控制关键操作执行。
AI.result: UI-Venus-2 作为一个能力强大、高效且开源的通用基础 GUI 智能体，同时在环境、任务和验证维度上实现扩展，并具备安全感知能力，能够提供可靠的强化学习训练信号。
AI.conclusion: UI-Venus-2 通过兼顾通用性、可验证性和自我反思能力，推动 GUI 智能体向真实世界应用迈进，为领域提供可复用的开源基础。

title: Generalized Tan-Arlery-Rabaste-Lehmann-Ovarlez Lower Bound on Ambiguity Function of a Set of Sequences With Mismatched Filters
summary: In this paper, a lower bound on the maximum ambiguity function (AF) sidelobes of a set of unimodular sequences is formulated for the desired low-ambiguity-zone (LAZ). Our main idea is to introduce a set of mismatched filters associated to a set of unimodular sequences and two weight vectors for the delay and Doppler shifts, respectively. The length of mismatched filter maybe different to the length of unimodular sequence. The proposed lower bound on the maximum AF sidelobes for the desired LAZ can be treated as an extension of Tan-Arlery-Rabaste-Lehmann-Ovarlez lower bound, published in 2020, which dealt with the conventional correlation of sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文针对一组单模序列，在期望的低模糊区（LAZ）内提出了最大模糊函数（AF）旁瓣的下界。核心创新是引入与单模序列关联的一组失配滤波器，以及分别针对时延和多普勒频移的两个权向量，从而将该下界推广为2020年Tan-Arlery-Rabaste-Lehmann-Ovarlez下界（针对传统序列相关）的扩展。
AI.motivation: 在雷达与通信系统中，单模序列的模糊函数旁瓣性能对目标检测和干扰抑制至关重要，尤其是仅关注局部低模糊区（LAZ）的场景。已有下界（如TARLO 2020年下界）仅针对序列的传统相关（即零多普勒情形），缺少对时延-多普勒二维联合下界的刻画，因此需要一种更一般、可配置失配滤波的下界框架。
AI.method: 作者为给定的一组单模序列引入一组失配滤波器，并引入两个权向量分别对时延偏移和多普勒频移加权重；失配滤波器的长度可以与单模序列长度不同。在此基础上，针对期望的LAZ区域，将最大化模糊函数旁瓣的问题形式化为下界求解问题，并将该下界表述为TARLO 2020年下界（针对传统相关）的推广。
AI.result: 论文给出了在该LAZ框架下、允许失配滤波且滤波器长度可变的单模序列组最大模糊函数旁瓣的理论下界；该下界可退化为或涵盖2020年TARLO基于传统相关的下界情形，从而提供了更通用的性能边界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了LAZ场景下失配滤波单模序列组最大AF旁瓣的理论下界，拓展了TARLO 2020年结果，为评估和设计具有期望低模糊区的序列组提供了更一般化的性能准则。

title: Foundation models for electricity price forecasting and battery arbitrage: Can they replace market-specific forecasting models?
summary: Foundation models promise accurate forecasts with little or no task-specific training, but whether they can replace models designed specifically for electricity price forecasting remains unclear. We compare nine variants from five foundation model families, evaluated in zero-shot mode, with two state-of-the-art electricity price forecasting benchmarks in Germany, Poland, and Spain over 2021-2025. Their performance is assessed in terms of point and probabilistic forecasting accuracy, as well as economic value in battery energy storage arbitrage. Only the TabPFN models consistently and significantly outperform the benchmarks across all three markets and all statistical measures. However, this statistical dominance does not translate directly into economic dominance: TabPFN performs best under unlimited bids and riskier quantile-based strategies, whereas the Distributional Deep Neural Network benchmark is more profitable when risk tolerance is lower. Thus, foundation models cannot universally replace market-specific models, and their value depends on both model architecture and the decision problem.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了五个基础模型家族（九个变体，零样本模式）与两个最先进的电价预测基准模型在德国、波兰、西班牙三国2021-2025年数据上的表现。仅在点预测、概率预测和经济价值（电池储能套利）三个维度上评估后发现：只有TabPFN模型在所有三个市场和所有统计指标上一致且显著优于基准，但这种统计优势并未直接转化为经济优势——TabPFN在无限出价和较高风险的基于分位数的策略下表现最好，而分布型深度神经网络（Distributional Deep Neural Network）基准在风险容忍度较低时更有利可图。
AI.motivation: 基础模型承诺无需或仅需极少特定任务训练即可实现准确预测，但它们能否取代专门为电价预测设计的模型尚不明确。作者旨在通过多市场、多维度的实证比较来回答这一问题。
AI.method: 选取五大基础模型家族中的九个变体，在零样本模式下运行，与两个最先进的电价预测基准模型进行比较；在德国、波兰和西班牙三国2021-2025年数据上进行评估，同时从点预测与概率预测的统计精度、以及电池储能套利的经济价值三个维度进行衡量。
AI.result: 仅有TabPFN模型在所有三个市场、所有统计指标上一致且显著优于基准模型；但在经济价值维度上，统计优势并未直接转化为经济优势：TabPFN在无限出价和更高风险的基于分位数的策略下表现最佳，而Distributional Deep Neural Network基准在风险容忍度较低时利润更高。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型无法普遍取代针对特定市场设计的模型；其价值取决于模型架构和具体的决策问题，因此选择模型时须结合统计精度与下游决策目标综合考量。

title: Medical Causal Hypothesis Verification with Large Language Models
summary: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) for search and information retrieval underscores the need to evaluate their reliability in high-stakes domains such as healthcare. Although LLMs can effectively answer questions about diseases, symptoms, and treatments, their ability to accurately assess causal relationships and ground their conclusions in verified scientific evidence remains unclear. Here, we present a preliminary, small-scale study that investigates the accuracy of LLMs in evaluating causal medical claims and supporting them with peer-reviewed research. We propose an evaluation framework for causal hypothesis verification that can be used to systematically track the performance of existing and future LLMs. We assess the performance of eight LLMs on 17 medical causal hypotheses to evaluate whether they can reliably verify these hypotheses using scientific evidence from the literature. We systematically annotate the scientific evidence they provide according to six criteria (a total of 1,067 annotation points) and assess them with nine evaluation metrics. Our analysis shows that while LLMs exhibit strong recall, they often perform poorly at providing valid scientific articles and evidence for support and at rejecting unsupported hypotheses. These findings highlight a critical limitation of current LLMs, as they cannot yet be trusted fully to verify causal relationships from the biomedical literature. This work underscores the need for rigorous evaluation before using LLMs for search and retrieval in healthcare settings.

AI.tldr: 本文开展了一项初步的小规模研究，评估大型语言模型（LLM）在验证医学因果主张及为其提供同行评审科学证据方面的能力，发现LLM虽表现出较高的召回率，但在提供有效科学文章、支持证据以及拒绝未经验证的主张方面表现不佳，凸显其在医疗检索场景中尚不能被完全信任。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地被用于搜索与信息检索，特别是在医疗等高风险领域，其可靠性亟待评估。尽管LLM能有效回答疾病、症状和治疗相关的问题，但它们能否准确评估因果关系并将结论建立在经过验证的科学证据之上仍然不清楚，因此需要系统性的评估框架来跟踪其表现。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个用于因果假设验证的评估框架，并在17个医学因果假设上评估了8个LLM。他们根据六项标准系统性标注了LLM提供的科学证据（共1,067个标注点），并使用九项评估指标进行评估，以考察LLM是否能在文献证据基础上可靠地验证这些假设。
AI.result: 分析显示，LLM在召回率方面表现较强，但在提供有效科学文章和支持证据、以及拒绝未受支持假设方面往往表现较差，表明它们在从生物医学文献中验证因果关系时存在关键局限性。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM尚不能被完全信任用于验证生物医学文献中的因果关系，这强调了在医疗领域的搜索与检索场景中部署LLM之前，必须进行严格的评估，并为现有及未来LLM的性能系统追踪提供了基础。

title: CrossFeat: Bridging Imaging Modalities in Feature Descriptor Space
summary: Most advances in keypoint descriptions address monomodal settings, where image variations arise from viewpoint, illumination, or contrast changes. Multimodal scenarios involve images produced by fundamentally different sensing processes, such as multispectral imaging, RGB-depth, satellite imagery, or medical imaging, causing the same structures to appear differently. A common solution to cross-modal description is to train descriptors for each modality pair, which requires retraining whenever the modalities change, or to train large models, which incur a significant increase in runtime. Instead, we propose CrossFeat, a framework that enables an existing monomodal descriptor to operate across modalities. Our method learns a crossing function in descriptor space that maps features from one modality to a representation compatible with another. To preserve the structural information captured by the original descriptor, CrossFeat introduces a geometry-appearance disentanglement such that only appearance is altered while the geometric properties are preserved. Experiments across multiple domains and datasets demonstrate improved performance in multimodal matching.

AI.tldr: CrossFeat 是一个让现有单模态关键点描述子直接适用于跨模态场景（如多光谱、RGB-深度、卫星图像、医学影像）的通用框架。它通过在描述子空间中学习一个"跨越函数"，将某一模态的特征映射为与另一模态兼容的表示；同时引入几何—外观解耦，仅改变外观、保留几何结构，从而在不重新训练描述子和不大幅增加模型开销的情况下提升多模态匹配性能。
AI.motivation: 现有关键点描述子的先进成果大多针对单模态设置（仅涉及视角、光照或对比度变化），而多模态场景（多光谱成像、RGB-深度、卫星图像、医学影像等）中同一结构在不同传感机制下外观差异显著。常见的两条路径均有缺陷：为每对模态单独训练描述子需要随模态变化不断重训；训练大型模型则显著增加运行时间。因此需要一个通用、轻量的方案，让已有单模态描述子无需重训即可跨模态工作。
AI.method: 提出 CrossFeat 框架：在描述子空间中学习一个跨模态映射函数（crossing function），把某一模态的特征变换为与另一模态兼容的表示。为保持原描述子捕获的结构信息，方法引入几何—外观解耦（geometry-appearance disentanglement），使映射仅改变外观成分，而几何属性得以完全保留。
AI.result: 在多个领域和数据集上的实验表明，CrossFeat 在多模态匹配任务上取得了更好的性能（相比逐模态对训练和大型模型方案）。
AI.conclusion: CrossFeat 证明无需重训描述子或引入大规模模型，仅通过在描述子空间学习一个保留几何、只改外观的映射函数，就能使现有单模态描述子有效迁移到任意模态对，为跨模态关键点匹配提供了一条通用且高效的解决路径。

title: EULER: Exploring Underused Links with Evidence-Checked Return for Multi-Agent Mathematical Discovery
comment: 55 pages, 10 figures, 29 tables; includes a 13-page companion candidate-proof manuscript as Appendix P
summary:
Mathematical communities work with different objects, invariants, and tools, so transferring a problem across them is expensive and often skipped. We present EULER, a multi-agent system that takes such a transfer--a bridge--as its unit of search. Around a fixed conjecture, EULER runs direct, adjacent-domain, and distant-domain routes in competition; a bridge keeps its budget only if it supplies an operation the source representation cannot execute and its target-side evidence returns to the original statement along a checked implication. Six ordered stress tests reject invalid bridges before expensive search begins.
  We evaluate EULER on 120 recent conjectures. The conjectures were frozen before search and screened for contamination, and are drawn from public papers by authors who had recently published in the Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series A, a leading journal in combinatorics. EULER produced 10 proofs and 3 refutations, plus 45 scoped partial results. Two mechanisms held up under ablation: bridge-specific stress tests cut incorrect conclusions from 9 to 3, and bridge material combined with a target-native operation yielded a positive interaction of +4.2 resolved tasks that neither factor produced alone. Domain distance did not reliably predict success; executable operation gain and valid return did.

AI.tldr: 提出 EULER，一个以"桥"（领域间问题迁移）为搜索单元的多智能体系统，在固定猜想上并行运行直接/邻近域/远域三条路线，并通过六项有序压力测试在昂贵搜索前筛除无效桥。在 120 个近期组合学猜想上得到 10 个证明、3 个反例和 45 个局部结果；消融实验表明压力测试和桥材料显著有效，而领域距离并不能可靠预测成功。
AI.motivation: 数学社群使用不同的对象、不变量和工具，跨领域迁移问题成本高昂且常被跳过，导致有价值的跨领域思想（桥）未被充分利用。
AI.method: EULER 以桥为搜索单元：围绕固定猜想同时运行直接域、邻近域和远域三条竞争路线；一条桥只有在源表示无法执行该操作、且目标侧证据能沿可核验的蕴含回到原始陈述时才保留预算；六项有序压力测试在昂贵搜索之前拒绝无效桥；采用冻结+污染筛查的 120 个近期猜想作为评测集。
AI.result: EULER 产出 10 个证明、3 个反例和 45 个有范围的局部结果；消融显示桥专用压力测试将错误结论从 9 降到 3，桥材料与目标原生操作结合产生 +4.2 个已解决问题数的正向交互；领域距离不能可靠预测成功，而可执行的操作增益与有效回传才可预测。
AI.conclusion: 跨领域"桥"是可搜索、可验证的有效单元，关键不在于领域距离，而在于桥能否提供源表示无法执行的操作并保证目标侧证据能沿可核验蕴含回到原命题；EULER 证明了该机制能显著提升自动推理系统解决现代猜想的能力。

title: From Source Reconstruction to Predictive State Preservation: An Information-Theoretic Framework for AI-Native Communication
summary: AI-native communication increasingly aims to support prediction rather than reproduce every detail of the source. This shift raises a basic question left implicit by conventional source coding: what should be preserved when the terminal goal is prediction? We take the source-induced predictive state as the fidelity object. It is the distribution of the specified future conditioned on the source observation and shared context. We show that this state is sufficient and minimal for exact predictive preservation. The terminal prediction loss then defines communication distortion as lost predictive performance rather than source reconstruction error. Under logarithmic loss, this distortion equals the conditional mutual information lost through communication. Using the receiver-side predictive state as a Bayes reference, we separate AI-receiver error into predictive value lost in communication, receiver-available value unusable by the model family, and family capability not realized by the deployed model. The same predictive state also suffices for matched compression. For finite-alphabet memoryless sources, access to the raw source gives no rate-distortion advantage over coding the state directly. Applying the same target-conditioned construction to sequential prediction reveals a dynamic boundary. A state induced by a fixed horizon is minimal for that horizon but may not support recursive updating as the target window shifts. Taking the entire future as the target yields a minimal full-future state that updates recursively and admits a Markov representation. Together, these results shift AI communication from source reconstruction to predictive-state preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文将预测性状态（predictive state）确立为AI原生通信的保真对象，证明该状态对精确预测保持而言既充分又最小，并据此把通信失真定义为预测性能的损失而非源重建误差，从而使通信从源重建范式转向预测状态保持范式。
AI.motivation: AI原生通信日益以支持预测为目标，而非逐细节复现源信息；传统的信源编码隐含地以源重建为保真目标，未回答"当最终目标为预测时应保留什么"这一基本问题。
AI.method: 以源诱导的预测状态（给定源观测与共享上下文的指定未来之条件分布）作为保真对象，证明其充分性与极小性；以终端预测损失定义通信失真，并在对数损失下将其等价为通信中丢失的条件互信息；以接收端预测状态为贝叶斯参考，将AI接收端误差分解为三个成分；将该构造推广到序贯预测与匹配压缩场景，分析固定时域状态与全未来状态在递归更新上的差异。
AI.result: 证明了预测状态对精确预测保持是充分且最小的；在有限字母无记忆源上，直接编码该状态相比编码原始源没有率失真劣势；固定时域的状态仅对该时域最小、未必支持窗口移动时的递归更新，而以整个未来为目标的全未来状态则最小、可递归更新并具有马尔可夫表示。
AI.conclusion: AI通信应转向预测状态保持而非源重建：以预测状态为保真对象，以预测性能损失为失真度量，并实现对通信、模型族与部署模型三层误差的系统分离。

title: Assessing Alignment and Stability of Feature Importance Explanations via Weight of Evidence
comment: Accepted at XKDD and Beyond 2026 Workshop, ECML-PKDD
summary: Feature importance Methods (FIMs) are widely used in Explainable AI to interpret model predictions, yet attribution scores alone often provide limited insight into the underlying reasoning process. In this work, we introduce a novel perspective by embedding FIMs within a hypothesis-testing framework based on Weight of Evidence (WoE). We quantify how strongly the observed evidence supports any given hypothesis on feature importance. The reference hypothesis can stem from domain knowledge, ground truth, or be derived from the FIM itself. This formulation enables a principled evaluation of FIMs, capturing both their alignment with prior knowledge and their variability. We further provide theoretical results linking WoE to attribution variance. Empirical results shows the applicability and flexibility of our strategy analyzing LIME and SHAP explanations in settings with different reference hypotheses. Overall, our framework offers a complementary tool for assessing FIMs through a contrastive, evidence-based lens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于证据权重（WoE）的假设检验框架，将特征重要性方法（FIM）的归因分数嵌入其中，从而以对比性、基于证据的视角量化观测证据对任意特征重要性假设的支持程度，为LIME、SHAP等FIM提供原则化的评估工具。
AI.motivation: 现有的特征重要性方法（FIM）在可解释AI中被广泛用于解释模型预测，但归因分数本身通常只能提供有限的信息，难以揭示模型背后的推理过程，也缺乏对归因结果与先验知识一致性和稳定性的系统评估手段。
AI.method: 将FIM嵌入基于证据权重（Weight of Evidence, WoE）的假设检验框架中，量化观测证据对给定特征重要性假设的支持强度。参考假设可来自领域知识、真实标签（ground truth）或FIM自身。同时推导了WoE与归因方差之间关系的理论结果。
AI.result: 实验在LIME和SHAP上验证了该策略的适用性与灵活性，能够在不同参考假设设定下有效评估FIM；理论结果表明WoE与归因方差存在联系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为评估FIM提供了一种互补性的、基于对比证据的工具，能够同时捕捉FIM与先验知识的一致性及其变异性，拓展了可解释AI中归因评估的方法论。

title: Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents
summary: A language-model agent asked to analyse an experiment will usually return working code. Whether the analysis is defensible is a different question. A defensible analysis depends on procedural choices: which test the field accepts, which identifier namespace is authoritative, and which caveats must accompany a result. We present Scientific Agent Skills, an open library of 163 such procedures in 16 areas of practice, including genomics, cheminformatics, medical imaging, study design and scientific communication. Each skill is a directory built around a versioned, human-readable instruction file. An agent loads the file only when a task calls for it; the directory often also contains reference material and runnable scripts. We report no task-level evaluation and no host selection rate. Openly licensed and available at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Scientific Agent Skills：一个开放源码库，包含16个实践领域（如基因组学、化学信息学、医学影像、研究设计和科学传播）中的163个程序化技能。每个技能是一个目录，围绕一个带版本、人类可读的指令文件构建；只有当任务需要时，代理才会加载该文件，目录中还常包含参考资料和可运行脚本。论文明确表示不报告任务级评估和宿主选择率，代码在GitHub上开放获取。
AI.motivation: 语言模型代理在分析实验时通常能生成可运行的代码，但其分析是否经得起推敲是另一回事。经得起推敲的分析依赖于程序性选择：该领域接受哪种检验、哪个标识符命名空间是权威的、结果必须附带哪些说明。这些程序性知识正是当前代理所欠缺的，因此需要一套系统化的程序技能库来支撑可辩护的科学分析。
AI.method: 构建了一个名为Scientific Agent Skills的开放库，包含16个实践领域的163个程序技能。每个技能是一个目录，围绕一个带版本、人类可读的指令文件组织；代理仅在任务需要时才加载该文件；目录通常还包含参考资料和可运行脚本。
AI.result: 论文不报告任务级评估，也不报告宿主选择率。该库采用开放许可，可在https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills获取。
AI.conclusion: Scientific Agent Skills提供了一套开放、模块化、按需加载的程序性技能库，旨在让语言模型代理在科学分析中做出符合领域规范的防御性程序选择。作者坦诚未进行任务级评估，并开放了资源供社区使用和验证。

title: StreamScout: Learning When to Look Deeper for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires answering questions that arrive at arbitrary moments over an unbounded video stream. Existing systems primarily focus on what to retain in a bounded memory, yet access that memory using the same fixed-cost procedure for every query, despite substantial variation in the evidence required. We argue that deciding how deeply to access memory for each query is as important as deciding what the memory should store. To this end, we introduce StreamScout, an adaptive inference framework that maintains only a lightweight textual timeline in context as the stream unfolds. At query time, StreamScout progressively augments the timeline with up to three increasingly informative visual views: a glance at recent frames, a uniform look-back over the past stream, and query-salient retrieval. At each stage, the model answers immediately if the available evidence is sufficient; otherwise, it escalates to the next view. To improve this stop-or-escalate policy, we probe the cascade on an auxiliary set and distill the model's empirical competence boundary into supervision for a lightweight LoRA adaptation, yielding StreamScout-S. We further refine the policy through reinforcement learning, allowing the model to explore stopping behaviors beyond imitation of the distilled decisions, yielding StreamScout-R. Across three backbones and three streaming benchmarks, StreamScout and its variants consistently outperform prior streaming methods while substantially reducing inference cost and token consumption; on OVO-Bench, for instance, StreamScout-S improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 14.65 points while using 59% fewer tokens than uniform sampling and answering in 1.04 s on average.

AI.tldr: StreamScout是一种针对流式视频理解的自适应推理框架，通过按需逐级访问记忆（新颖帧快照、均匀回看、查询相关检索）来决定每个查询的推理深度，并利用辅助集蒸馏和强化学习优化"停止或升级"策略，在三个基准上超越现有方法同时显著降低推理成本和token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频理解系统主要关注在有限记忆中保留什么内容，但对每个查询都使用相同的固定成本过程来访问记忆，忽略了不同查询所需证据量的巨大差异。作者认为，为每个查询决定访问记忆的深度与决定记忆存储什么同样重要。
AI.method: StreamScout在流展开时仅在上下文维护轻量级文本时间线；查询时逐步用最多三种渐增信息量的视觉视图补充时间线：最近帧快照、对过去流的均匀回看、查询显著检索。每个阶段若证据充分则立即回答，否则升级到下一视图。通过辅助集上探测级联并蒸馏模型经验能力边界作为LoRA轻量适配的监督（StreamScout-S），再通过强化学习进一步优化策略，让模型探索超出蒸馏决策模仿的停止行为（StreamScout-R）。
AI.result: 在三个骨干网络和三个流式基准上，StreamScout及其变体一致超越现有流式方法，同时大幅降低推理成本和token消耗。例如在OVO-Bench上，StreamScout-S使Qwen3-VL-8B提升14.65个点，同时比均匀采样少用59%的token，平均回答时间仅1.04秒。
AI.conclusion: 针对流式视频理解，按查询自适应地决定记忆访问深度是提升性能与效率的关键。StreamScout通过级联视图与学习到的停止-升级策略，证明了"何时深入"与"记住什么"同等重要，为高效流式问答提供了可行的自适应推理范式。

title: When Prediction Error Is Not Enough: Evaluating Nuisance-Function Prediction for Causal Estimation
summary: Prediction error is widely used to evaluate nuisance-function estimators in causal inference, but its relationship with causal estimator performance may differ across performance measures. We studied this question in a partially linear model using Monte Carlo simulations. We compared ordinary least squares (OLS), generalized additive models (GAMs), XGBoost, and Double Machine Learning with XGBoost (DML-XGBoost), evaluating nuisance-function prediction error, bias, RMSE, and 95\% confidence interval coverage. We also examined a simple joint-error measure based on the absolute cross-product of estimation errors from the exposure and outcome nuisance functions. Across the simulated settings, XGBoost had the lowest RMSE among the non-oracle methods, while DML-XGBoost generally provided better confidence interval coverage. Prediction error did not consistently track causal bias across methods and settings, and the method with the best point-estimation performance did not necessarily have the best confidence interval coverage. The joint-error measure was only weakly associated with causal bias and did not provide a useful standalone measure of causal performance. These results suggest that prediction error is useful for assessing nuisance-function estimation, but it should not be treated as a direct measure of the quality of the resulting causal estimator.

AI.tldr: 本文通过蒙特卡洛模拟研究部分线性模型中预测误差与因果估计量性能之间的关系，比较了OLS、GAM、XGBoost与DML-XGBoost四种方法，发现预测误差不能稳定追踪因果偏差，且联合误差度量与因果性能关联微弱，预测误差不宜作为因果估计量质量的直接度量。
AI.motivation: 预测误差被广泛用于评估因果推断中的干扰函数估计量，但其与因果估计量性能的关系可能因性能指标而异。作者旨在厘清预测误差是否能作为因果估计质量的可靠代理指标。
AI.method: 在部分线性模型框架下进行蒙特卡洛模拟，比较OLS、GAM、XGBoost和基于XGBoost的双机器学习（DML-XGBoost）四种方法；评估干扰函数预测误差、偏差、RMSE和95%置信区间覆盖率，并考察一种基于暴露与结局干扰函数估计误差绝对叉积的简单联合误差度量。
AI.result: 在模拟设置中，XGBoost在非oracle方法中RMSE最低，而DML-XGBoost通常提供更好的置信区间覆盖率。预测误差在不同方法与设置间不能一致地追踪因果偏差，点估计性能最佳的方法未必具有最佳的置信区间覆盖率。联合误差度量与因果偏差仅呈弱关联，不能作为衡量因果性能的独立有效指标。
AI.conclusion: 预测误差有助于评估干扰函数估计本身，但不应被视为所得因果估计量质量的直接度量；评估因果估计量时应采用因果层面的性能指标（如偏差、RMSE与覆盖率）加以验证。

title: Quantum LDPC and High-Rate CSS Codes from Fair-Density Parity-Check Codes
summary:
We construct quantum LDPC (qLDPC) and high-rate CSS codes from our recently introduced classical fair-density parity-check (FDPC) codes. To this end, we introduce a structured sparsification of FDPC parity-check matrices, which reduces their check weights while preserving the underlying combinatorial structure and distance guarantees. Combined with the hypergraph-product construction, this yields finite-length qLDPC codes with analytically controlled blocklength, dimension, certified distance, and stabilizer weight. For quantum blocklengths $N<10^5$, the constructions introduced here span guaranteed rates from approximately $0.35\%$ to $25.8\%$ and certified quantum distances from $12$ to $69$, with stabilizer weights between $8$ and $16$.
  In the large-blocklength regime, allowing the FDPC order and sparsified check weight to scale moderately with blocklength yields a family of high-rate CSS codes, which we refer to as quantum FDPC (qFDPC) codes, with rate $R_Q$ and minimum distance $D$ satisfying \[ R_Q =
1-O\left(\frac{1}{\log\log N}\right), \ \ D=Ω(N^{1/4}), \] and stabilizer weight $O(\log N\log\log N)$. Finally, the analytically available FDPC weight distribution provides explicit information about the logical operators of the resulting hypergraph-product codes. Over the quantum erasure channel, this structure yields rigorous first-order maximum likelihood (ML) expressions and a higher-order weight-distribution approximation to the ML logical block error probability. This enables estimation of finite-length operating points and the onset of the error-floor regime.
  To the best of our knowledge, beyond surface-code-type constructions, this is the first finite-rate qLDPC framework to provide both finite-length certified minimum-distance information and an analytical characterization of low-weight logical multiplicities.

AI.tldr: 本文基于新近提出的经典公平密度奇偶校验（FDPC）码，通过结构化稀疏化其校验矩阵并结合超图积构造，构建了具有解析可控块长、维数、认证距离和稳定子权重的有限长量子LDPC码，以及大块长下速率趋向于1、距离为Ω(N^{1/4})的高速率CSS码（qFDPC码），并利用FDPC权重分布给出了量子擦除信道下ML逻辑误块概率的一阶精确表达式与高阶近似。
AI.motivation: 现有量子LDPC（qLDPC）码和高速率CSS码的构造中，在有限长方面缺乏同时具备认证最小距离信息与低权重逻辑算子解析刻画的能力；除表面码类构造外，很难在有限速率框架下同时提供有限长认证距离和逻辑权重分布的解析信息。作者旨在弥补这一空白，借助其先前提出的经典FDPC码构造出兼具理论保证和可解析分析的量子码族。
AI.method: 作者引入一种FDPC奇偶校验矩阵的结构化稀疏化方法，在不破坏底层组合结构与距离保证的前提下降低校验权重；将该稀疏化FDPC码与超图积（hypergraph-product）构造相结合，得到有限长qLDPC码。在大块长区域，允许FDPC阶数与稀疏化校验权重随块长适度增长，从而得到称为qFDPC码的高速率CSS码族；最后利用FDPC可解析获得的权重分布刻画所得超图积码的逻辑算子结构，并推导擦除信道上ML逻辑误块概率的一阶精确表达式及高阶权重分布近似。
AI.result: 有限长方面：在量子块长N<10^5时，构造的码覆盖保证速率约0.35%至25.8%，认证量子距离12至69，稳定子权重介于8与16之间。大块长方面：得到速率R_Q=1-O(1/log log N)、最小距离D=Ω(N^{1/4})、稳定子权重O(log N log log N)的qFDPC码族。此外，该框架是首个（除表面码类构造外）同时提供有限长认证最小距离信息与低权重逻辑多重度解析刻画、且支持对有限长工作点和错误平层区域起始进行估计的有限速率qLDPC框架。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为量子纠错码构造提供了首个兼具有限长认证距离与逻辑算子权重分布解析信息的有限速率qLDPC框架，同时给出逼近容量的高速率CSS码族和擦除信道下ML译码性能的解析估计，对有限长运行点选择与错误平层分析具有实用价值。作者认为这是除表面码类构造外首次实现的此类综合保证。

title: Safin-1: Safety from Within through Memory-Native State Evolution
summary: Long-horizon complex tasks require foundation models to accumulate information, maintain internal states, and adapt over extended interactions. Safety should be an intrinsic property of the model itself, rather than a behavioral constraint relying solely on external safeguards or post-hoc alignment such as supervised fine-tuning. This motivates Safety from Within, where safety-relevant capabilities are represented and invoked through the model's native computation. We present Safin-1, a family of foundation models realizing this principle through memory routing and state evolution. Safin-1 is built on Memory-Anchor Routing across Context History (MARCH), a network architecture that maintains structured memory states and selectively retrieves relevant historical information through content-conditioned routing. It supports test-time adaptation of persistent capability states without repeatedly modifying the backbone, enabling controlled specialization over a shared foundation. We investigate this interface on downstream safety tasks through a Safety State, demonstrating effective state-based adaptation with substantial safety improvements. More broadly, the routed-state interface unifies contextual memory and persistent capability adaptation within the model's native computation, reframing memory from a passive record of prior context into an active substrate for maintaining and evolving model behavior. Evaluations across general capabilities, long-context understanding, retrieval, and efficiency further validate Safin-1. These findings provide a path toward safety as a state-native and adaptively maintainable capability. This work is only an initial architectural exploration of Safety from Within, and substantial further work is needed to realize this broader vision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Safin-1 系列基础模型，通过 MARCH（Memory-Anchor Routing across Context History）网络架构实现"由内而外的安全"（Safety from Within）：模型通过结构化记忆状态和内容条件路由来维护与调用安全相关能力，并借助 Safety State 接口在不改动主干的情况下进行测试时自适应，最终在安全任务及通用能力、长上下文、检索和效率上均取得验证。
AI.motivation: 长程复杂任务要求基础模型在长时间交互中积累信息、维护内部状态并持续适应。作者认为安全应是模型自身的内在属性，而非依赖外部防护或事后对齐（如监督微调）的行为约束，因此需要让安全相关能力通过模型原生计算被表示和调用，从而提出"Safety from Within"理念。
AI.method: 构建 Safin-1 系列模型，核心是 MARCH 网络架构：维护结构化记忆状态，并通过内容条件路由选择性检索相关历史信息。该架构支持对持久能力状态进行测试时自适应，无需反复修改主干网络，从而在共享基础模型上实现受控特化。作者在下游安全任务中引入 Safety State 接口以研究该状态接口，实现基于状态的安全自适应。
AI.result: 实验表明 Safety State 接口能实现有效的基于状态的适配并带来显著安全改进；同时 Safin-1 在通用能力、长上下文理解、检索和效率评估中均表现良好。状态路由接口将上下文记忆与持久能力自适应统一到模型原生计算中，把记忆从被动的历史记录转变为主动维护和演化模型行为的媒介。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为"安全作为一种状态原生、可自适应维护的能力"提供了可行路径，表明记忆路由和状态演化是实现 Safety from Within 的初步架构探索；作者同时强调这仅是初始探索，距离实现更宏大的愿景仍需大量后续工作。

title: OCGQuant: Outlier-Companion Grouping for NVFP4 Quantization
summary: NVFP4 is an efficient microscaling format for low-bit inference, but activation outliers can still degrade quantization accuracy within NVFP4 blocks. Within each quantization block, large activations can dominate the block scale, increasing the quantization error of the remaining values sharing the same scale. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods mitigate outlier errors through strategies such as mixed precision, rotation, or residual compensation, but these approaches are either not specifically tailored to NVFP4 or introduce additional computation. In this work, we revisit NVFP4 from a channel-grouping perspective and define the reducible error incurred by remaining block values under the scale set by the block maximum as Collateral Quantization Error. Based on this insight, we propose OCGQuant, a post-training quantization method centered on Outlier-Companion Grouping (OCG), which adaptively pairs outlier channels with low-magnitude companion channels to improve NVFP4 activation block composition. Experiments on Llama3 and Qwen3 show that OCGQuant achieves the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity and highest average downstream accuracy among evaluated PTQ methods, while maintaining prefill speedup close to RTN and matching its peak decoding memory. Code is available at https://github.com/Eshamont/OCGQuant.

AI.tldr: OCGQuant 是一种面向 NVFP4 格式的后训练量化方法，通过 Outlier-Companion Grouping（OCG）将异常值通道与低幅值伴生通道自适应配对，改善激活值量化块组成，从而在保持推理速度与内存效率的同时显著降低量化误差、提升精度。
AI.motivation: NVFP4 是用于低比特推理的高效微缩放（microscaling）格式，但激活值异常值仍会降低 NVFP4 量化块的精度：块内大激活值会主导块尺度，增大共享同一尺度的其余值的量化误差。现有 PTQ 方法（混合精度、旋转、残差补偿等）要么未针对 NVFP4 定制，要么引入额外计算开销。
AI.method: 本文从通道分组（channel-grouping）视角重新审视 NVFP4，定义了块最大值设定尺度下、剩余块值所产生的可缩减误差为"Collateral Quantization Error"（附带量化误差）。基于此提出 OCGQuant，核心是 Outlier-Companion Grouping（OCG），即自适应地将异常值通道与低幅值伴生通道配对，以改善 NVFP4 激活量化块的构成。
AI.result: 在 Llama3 与 Qwen3 上的实验表明，OCGQuant 在所评估的 PTQ 方法中取得最低的 WikiText-2 困惑度与最高的平均下游任务准确率，同时保持接近 RTN 的预填充（prefill）加速比，并匹配其峰值解码内存。
AI.conclusion: OCGQuant 通过通道重分组从根本上缓解 NVFP4 块内异常值对尺度的影响，在不引入额外推理计算、不牺牲速度与内存效率的前提下，实现了优于现有 PTQ 方法的量化精度，为低比特高效推理提供了实用方案。

title: TRUST: Threshold-Recalibrated Uncertainty-Safe Training for Certified Dismissal in Breast Cancer Screening
summary: Reducing the review of clearly cancer-negative screening mammograms could lower radiologist workload without compromising cancer detection. We propose a closed-loop threshold-aware training strategy in which the dismissal threshold is recalculated during training and used to penalize cancer-positive images that approach the dismissal region. We evaluated the method on NLBS and RSNA using five controlled training configurations, with case-level assessment based on a one-sided 99\% Clopper--Pearson upper bound for cancer prevalence among dismissed cases. The proposed model achieved the highest case-level dismissal rates at both 98\% and 95\% recall targets. On NLBS, dismissal reached 19.74\% and 21.70\%, while the cross-entropy baseline did not meet either recall target. On RSNA, dismissal improved from 7.04\% to 14.31\% and from 13.49\% to 19.69\%. In external RSNA$\to$NLBS evaluation, the proposed model achieved dismissal rates of 12.95\% and 19.87\% at the 98\% and 95\% recall targets, respectively. These results support closed-loop threshold-aware training for high-recall selective dismissal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种闭环阈值感知训练策略，用于在筛检性乳腺X线摄影中安全地筛除明显无癌症的病例，从而降低放射科医师工作负荷。方法在训练过程中重新计算“筛除阈值”并据此对接近筛除区域的癌症阳性图像施加惩罚，并在NLBS和RSNA数据集上使用五种受控训练配置进行评估，以单侧99% Clopper-Pearson置信上界进行病例级评估。实验表明该方法在98%和95%召回目标下均取得最高的筛除率（NLBS上达19.74%/21.70%，RSNA上从7.04%提升到14.31%、从13.49%提升到19.69%），交叉熵基线甚至无法达到召回目标；外部RSNA→NLBS评估得到12.95%/19.87%的筛除率，支持闭环阈值感知训练用于高召回选择性筛除。
AI.motivation: 减少对明确无癌症的筛检性乳腺X光片的审查可降低放射科医师工作负荷，同时不损害癌症检出能力；现有方法在高召回率目标下筛除效率有限（如交叉熵基线甚至无法达到设定召回目标）。作者旨在开发一种能安全、高效地在高召回约束下筛除大量阴性病例的训练策略。
AI.method: 提出闭环阈值感知训练策略：训练中动态重新计算筛除阈值，并用该阈值惩罚接近筛除区域的癌症阳性图像，使模型学习将阳性病例推离筛除区域。评估基于NLBS和RSNA两个数据集、五种受控训练配置，采用病例级评估，以单侧99% Clopper-Pearson置信区间上界约束被筛除病例中的癌症患病率（即保证癌症漏检风险受控）。
AI.result: 在98%和95%两种召回目标下，所提模型筛除率均为最高：NLBS上达到19.74%和21.70%（交叉熵基线未达到召回目标）；RSNA上筛除率从7.04%提升至14.31%、从13.49%提升至19.69%；外部RSNA→NLBS评估中，98%和95%召回目标下筛除率分别为12.95%和19.87%。
AI.conclusion: 闭环阈值感知训练策略能显著提升高召回选择性筛除的性能，在维持低癌症漏检风险的前提下大幅提高可安全筛除的阴性病例占比，具备跨数据集泛化能力，可作为筛检读片工作负荷优化的一项有效方案。

title: MiNER: Fine-Tuned Biomedical Natural Language Processing for Malaria Disease Entity Recognition in Clinical Texts
summary: Malaria remains a significant global health burden, necessitating continuous research efforts to understand its complex molecular mechanisms, epidemiology, and potential therapeutic interventions. Extracting essential biomedical information from the vast and constantly growing malaria literature is a challenging task that demands innovative approaches. Recently, pre-trained language models have revolutionized natural language processing tasks, demonstrating remarkable capabilities in various domains. This paper proposes a fine-tuned pre-trained biomedical language model for biomedical information extraction from scientific literature on malaria disease. The proposed methodology selects and preprocesses a large corpus of scientific articles on malaria, and then annotates them with entities of clinical significance. It then leverages BioBERT, a state-of-the-art pre-trained language model, to encode the textual data into context-aware representations. We fine-tune the model using domain-specific annotations and supervised learning to enhance its ability to extract relevant biomedical named entities. Extensive experiments and comparisons with different encoding and machine learning algorithms show that the proposed approach significantly outperforms them in precision, recall, and accuracy. We also publish our human-labeled dataset for entity and relation extraction to enable other health informatics researchers to train advanced models for malaria information extraction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于微调预训练生物医学语言模型（BioBERT）的方法，用于从疟疾病学术文献中自动抽取临床相关的生物医学命名实体，并通过与多种编码和机器学习算法的对比实验证明其在精确率、召回率和准确率上均显著更优，同时公开了人工标注的数据集以支持该领域研究。
AI.motivation: 疟疾仍是重大的全球健康负担，其文献量庞大且持续增长，从中提取关键的分子机制、流行病学和治疗干预等信息十分困难，传统方法难以应对，需要更创新的自动化信息抽取手段。
AI.method: 首先筛选并预处理大量疟疾相关科学文献语料，对其进行临床相关实体的人工标注；然后利用预训练语言模型BioBERT对文本进行上下文感知的编码表示；最后基于领域特定的标注数据通过监督学习对模型进行微调，以提升生物医学命名实体抽取的能力。
AI.result: 通过与不同编码方法和机器学习算法的大量对比实验表明，所提方法在精确率（precision）、召回率（recall）和准确率（accuracy）上均显著优于基线方法；此外，论文还发布了人工标注的实体与关系抽取数据集供健康信息学研究者使用。
AI.conclusion: 基于微调BioBERT的领域适应方法能够有效提升疟疾文献中生物医学信息抽取的性能，并为该领域提供了可复用的高质量训练数据资源，有助于推动疟疾健康信息学研究。

title: Lifted-Product QLDPC Codes in the Polynomial Domain
summary: This paper presents a finite-length polynomial-domain formulation of lifted-product quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes. We formulate the code construction over the quotient ring F 2[D]/(D L + 1), where polynomial base matrices are lifted entrywise to binary circulant blocks. This representation gives a compact algebraic description of the lifted-product parity-check matrices and allows CSS orthogonality to be analyzed before binary expansion. We show that the standard circulant lifting map is compatible with polynomial conjugation, which implies that the resulting binary matrices satisfy the CSS commutation constraint. The construction is illustrated with a constraint length 7, rate 1/2 NASA convolutional code example, and numerical examples are provided from a 3 x 4 polynomial parity-check matrix. The finite-length performance of selected constructed codes is then evaluated over the depolarizing channel using various benchmark decoders. The resulting framework gives a structured method to construct finite-length lifted-product QLDPC codes from small polynomial base matrices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种有限长度、多项式域上的升积量子LDPC码构造框架。该构造在商环F2[D]/(D^L+1)上进行，将多项式基矩阵逐项提升为二元循环块，从而在二进制展开前即可分析CSS正交性，并证明标准循环提升映射与多项式共轭相容，保证所得二元矩阵满足CSS对易约束。
AI.motivation: 量子LDPC码的构造需要在有限码长下兼顾码率与性能，而现有升积构造通常直接在二元矩阵域上进行，缺乏紧凑的代数描述，且CSS正交性条件往往要在二进制展开之后才能验证。作者希望建立一种多项式域上的有限长度构造框架，既能简化奇偶校验矩阵的代数表示，又能在二进制展开之前预先保证CSS约束成立，从而提供一种从小型多项式基矩阵系统构造有限长度升积QLDPC码的结构化方法。
AI.method: 作者在商环F2[D]/(D^L+1)上定义多项式基矩阵，并将其逐项（entrywise）提升为二元循环块（circulant blocks），从而给出升积奇偶校验矩阵的紧凑代数描述。关键理论贡献是证明标准循环提升映射与多项式共轭（polynomial conjugation）相容，由此可严格推导出所得二元矩阵满足CSS对易（正交）约束。论文以约束长度7、码率1/2的NASA卷积码为示例，并从3×4多项式奇偶校验矩阵给出数值实例。
AI.result: 该框架成功地在二进制展开前完成了CSS正交性的代数分析，所构造的有限长度升积QLDPC码均满足CSS对易约束。论文给出了基于NASA卷积码及3×4多项式矩阵的构造示例，并选取若干构造码在去极化信道上使用多种基准译码器进行有限长度性能评估，验证了构造方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出的结论是：多项式域表述为升积QLDPC码提供了一种结构化的有限长度构造途径，仅需从小型多项式基矩阵出发即可生成满足CSS约束的码，同时保留了紧凑的代数可分析性，为后续码设计提供了统一的数学框架。

title: Local Reference Geometry Residual Augmentation for Imbalanced Time Series Classification
summary: Imbalanced time series classification is often addressed by changing the training distribution, objective, logits, or final threshold. These interventions address important biases, yet leave a representation-level question unmeasured: after minority support is reduced, does a learned feature space remain locally reliable around minority regions? We identify a training-local geometry failure: under imbalance, minority cases can lie in sparse, rest-dominated, or mixed feature-space neighborhoods, even when the representation retains useful global class structure. To diagnose and repair this failure, we propose Local Reference Geometry (LRG), a lightweight post-hoc feature augmentation module applied between a fixed feature extractor and the classifier head. Using training features only, LRG measures local exposure and class-mixture risk, then augments each fixed feature with a standardized signed displacement from nearby training geometry and an LDA-projected residual summary. On controlled UCR/Bake Off Redux imbalance benchmarks, paired raw-versus-LRG comparisons show gains for learned, pretrained, and fixed representations, including when LRG is combined with training-level interventions and post-encoder classifier corrections. Ablations show that the gain comes from the signed local residual appended to the original feature, rather than from generic prototype distances, affinity features, scalar statistics, or VLAD-style codes. Further analyses support the proposed local-geometry failure hypothesis: minority neighborhoods become increasingly rest-exposed under imbalance, training-local risk identifies error-prone regions, and LRG gains concentrate in those high-risk regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级后置特征增强模块 LRG（Local Reference Geometry），用于修复不平衡时间序列分类中少数类样本局部特征空间几何失效的问题。LRG 仅利用训练特征，在固定特征提取器与分类头之间为每个特征附加一个标准化带符号位移和 LDA 投影残差摘要，从而在 UCR/Bake Off Redux 不平衡基准上显著提升分类性能，并通过消融与分析验证了"局部几何失效"假设。
AI.motivation: 现有的不平衡时间序列分类方法通常通过改变训练分布、目标函数、logits 或最终阈值来缓解偏差，但这些干预忽略了一个表示层面的问题：当少数类支持被削减后，学习到的特征空间在少数类区域是否仍然局部可靠。作者识别出一种"训练局部几何失效"：即使表示在整体上保留了有用的全局类别结构，不平衡条件下少数类样本也可能落入稀疏、被多数类主导或混合的特征空间邻域中，导致分类器在这些局部区域不可靠。
AI.method: 提出 Local Reference Geometry (LRG)，一个轻量级、后置的特征增强模块，置于固定特征提取器与分类头之间。LRG 仅使用训练特征：1) 度量每个样本的局部暴露度（local exposure）与类别混合风险（class-mixture risk）；2) 为每个固定特征附加一个标准化的带符号位移（源自附近训练几何）以及一个 LDA 投影的残差摘要。整个过程无需重新训练特征提取器，可即插即用地集成到现有流程中。
AI.result: 在受控的 UCR/Bake Off Redux 不平衡基准上，逐对比较原始特征与 LRG 增强特征，结果表明 LRG 对学习表示、预训练表示和固定表示均带来增益，且可与训练层面的干预及编码器后的分类器校正相结合。消融实验证明增益来自附加到原始特征上的带符号局部残差，而非通用的原型距离、亲和特征、标量统计或 VLAD 风格编码。进一步分析支持局部几何失效假设：不平衡下少数类邻域越发被多数类暴露，训练局部风险能识别易错区域，且 LRG 的增益集中在这些高风险区域。
AI.conclusion: 不平衡分类不仅需要训练分布、目标或阈值的修正，还需要关注特征空间的局部几何可靠性。LRG 作为一种轻量后置模块，通过量化并修复少数类局部邻域的几何失效，能够在不改动特征提取器的情况下有效提升不平衡时间序列分类性能，且其增益机制可解释地与局部风险区域相关联。

title: Do Multimodal LLMs See Before They Read? Diagnosing Contextual Sycophancy
summary: External text can override conflicting image evidence in multimodal large language models, a failure we call multimodal contextual sycophancy. We introduce a 998-case diagnostic that independently varies visual evidence, commonsense priors, and external text, and probe when this failure arises by moving the information boundary around a context-blind visual witness. On abnormal images paired with Gemini-generated false text, GPT-5.1 scores 7.9% under joint conditioning, 49.7% when the context-blind witness report is scored directly, 63.7% under a matched two-call witness-arbiter pipeline that exposes the witness to the text, and 84.2% under System-2 Visual Arbitration (S2VA), which withholds the text from the witness. Across six models, S2VA improves over the direct witness report by 19.7 to 44.1 points, with all paired 95% confidence intervals excluding zero. The best information boundary is not uniform: textual context scaffolds some models, and a GPT-4o-regenerated subset changes the relative ordering of joint conditioning, Witness-Only, and S2VA. Contextual sycophancy is therefore sensitive to when text is introduced, as well as to the model and context source.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"多模态情境谄媚"（multimodal contextual sycophancy）这一失败模式，即外部文本可以覆盖与图像相矛盾的视觉证据。作者构建了一个998例的诊断集，独立变化视觉证据、常识先验与外部文本，并通过移动"情境盲视证人"（context-blind visual witness）的信息边界来探究该失败何时出现。GPT-5.1在联合条件化下得分7.9%，直接评估情境盲视证人报告为49.7%，双调用见证人-仲裁者流水线（暴露文本给见证人）为63.7%，而S2VA（向见证人隐藏文本）达84.2%。在六个模型上，S2VA相对直接见证人报告提升19.7~44.1个百分点，所有配对95%置信区间均不包含零。最优信息边界并非统一：文本情境对某些模型有支撑作用，GPT-4o重生成的子集会改变联合条件化、Witness-Only与S2VA的相对排序。结论是情境谄媚对文本引入时机、模型与情境来源均高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在面对与图像证据矛盾的外部文本时，会倾向服从文本而忽略视觉证据。现有研究缺乏系统化诊断，未厘清这种"情境谄媚"失效究竟源于信息边界的位置、模型本身，还是上下文来源。作者希望通过可控实验独立变化视觉证据、常识先验与外部文本，精确定位失效发生的条件。
AI.method: 构建998例诊断集，独立操纵视觉证据、常识先验和外部文本三个变量；引入"情境盲视证人"（context-blind visual witness）概念，通过移动信息边界设计多种评估架构：联合条件化（joint conditioning）、直接评估见证人报告（Witness-Only）、匹配的双调用见证人-仲裁者流水线（暴露文本给见证人），以及系统2视觉仲裁（S2VA，向见证人隐藏文本但向仲裁者暴露）。在六个模型上进行配对比较，并使用95%置信区间进行统计检验；额外用GPT-4o重生成子集验证排序稳定性。
AI.result: GPT-5.1在四类架构下得分分别为7.9%（联合条件化）、49.7%（Witness-Only）、63.7%（暴露文本的两调用流水线）和84.2%（S2VA）。六个模型上S2VA相对Witness-Only提升19.7~44.1个百分点，所有配对95%置信区间排除零。但最佳信息边界不统一：部分模型受益于文本情境脚手架，且GPT-4o重生成子集改变了联合条件化、Witness-Only与S2VA的相对排序。
AI.conclusion: 情境谄媚并非单一机制所致，其对文本引入时机（信息边界）、模型选择和上下文来源均敏感。向视觉见证人隐藏文本（S2VA）整体上是稳健且显著有效的干预手段，但最优架构需要按模型和情境来源自适应选择，不存在放之四海而皆准的信息边界。

title: Where Should Experience Live? Hierarchical Hebbian Memory for Continual Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers provide strong visual representations but typically rely on slowly updated parameters, limiting their ability to organize newly acquired information across different memory timescales. This work proposes \textit{Hierarchical Hebbian Memory}, a three-level memory architecture composed of rapid Working Memory, persistent Routed Episodic Memory, and slower Semantic Memory. A learned controller regulates memory contribution, read and write routing, plasticity, retention, and consolidation. A causal read-before-write lifecycle ensures that the current outcome cannot influence the prediction it supervises. The architecture is evaluated on Omniglot 5-way 1-shot recognition and CORe50 continual object recognition. With Swin-Tiny, the hierarchical model reaches 97.39\% accuracy on Omniglot and 95.37\% final accuracy on CORe50 when combined with experience replay. Learned multi-bank retrieval reaches 47.50\% delayed-association accuracy, compared with 24.17\% for a single persistent bank and 25.00\% without memory. After intervening distractors, Episodic Memory retains approximately 0.96 cosine similarity with stored associations, while Working Memory falls to approximately 0.05. These results show that Hebbian association and learned memory routing can jointly organize online visual experience across rapid, persistent, and consolidated memory timescales within Vision Transformers.
