We evaluate zero-shot LLMs on Census Block Group-level mobility prediction across four U.S. metropolitan areas using anonymized Cuebiq data to construct point-level, trajectory-level, and temporal mobility outcomes, paired with sociodemographic and built-environment predictors. We compare LLM predictions with supervised baselines and introduce a directional alignment analysis to test whether LLM-implied predictor effects agree with empirical OLS and Jonckheere-Terpstra trends. Supervised models achieve 0.580 average accuracy, compared with 0.435 for the best LLM, with spatial extent outcomes showing the strongest predictability but also the largest LLM-baseline gaps. Directional analysis shows that LLMs often rely on coarse, stable predictor-level priors that remain similar across outcomes and cities, including asymmetric treatment of protected-group predictors. Overall, LLMs can partially recover aggregate mobility patterns from urban context, but their predictions should not be treated as structurally grounded without auditing empirical alignment and potential bias.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了零样本大语言模型（LLM）在普查区块组层面预测城市人口流动的能力，使用美国四个都市区的匿名Cuebiq轨迹数据，并与监督学习基线对比，发现监督模型准确率（0.580）显著优于最佳LLM（0.435），且LLM倾向依赖粗糙稳定的先验、对受保护群体预测变量存在不对称处理，其预测不应被视为结构性可靠。
AI.motivation: 细粒度轨迹数据通常专有、受限且隐私敏感，而LLM可能通过生成合理流动轨迹作为替代方案，但其能否推断聚合的邻里层面移动模式尚不明确，因此需要系统评估。
AI.method: 利用匿名Cuebiq数据在美国四个都市区构建点级、轨迹级和时间维度三类移动结果，结合社会人口与建成环境预测变量；对LLM进行零样本评估，并与监督基线比较；引入方向对齐分析，检验LLM隐含的预测变量效应是否与实证OLS和Jonckherere-Terpstra趋势一致。
AI.result: 监督模型平均准确率为0.580，最佳LLM仅为0.435；空间范围类结果可预测性最强但LLM与基线差距最大。方向分析显示LLM依赖跨结果和城市间相似的粗略、稳定预测变量先验，且对受保护群体预测变量处理不对称。
AI.conclusion: LLM能从城市语境中部分恢复聚合移动模式，但其预测不能被当作结构性可靠的依据；在未审计实证对齐性和潜在偏见之前，不应直接采用。

title: Assessing Suicide Risk in Arabic Crisis Helpline Calls: A Comparison of Arabic and English Large Language Models
summary: Crisis helplines assess suicide risk through structured interviews, a process that is slow and dependent on operator training and workload. Natural language processing could support risk assessment and call prioritization, but almost no work addresses Arabic-language helpline calls or operates within the privacy constraints of real helpline data. We analysed de-identified transcripts from Lebanon's National Lifeline for Emotional Support and Suicide Prevention. Audio never left the helpline: calls were transcribed on site with a speech recognition model for Levantine Arabic, and an Arabic named-entity recognition model removed identifying information locally. Only the de-identified transcripts were shared with the research team. Operators recorded the five suicidal ideation items of the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale, which we combined into two binary outcomes: at-risk and high-risk. We also machine-translated the transcripts into English, giving a paired Arabic/English comparison. On each corpus, we fine-tuned five instruction-tuned large language models alongside six transformer encoder baselines (four Arabic, two English) and evaluated all models on a held-out test set. We included 383 calls: 373 for the at-risk task (52.3% positive) and 297 for the high-risk task (30.0% positive). The best Arabic model reached a macro-F1 of 81.19 and a ROC-AUC of 90.61 on high-risk; the best English model reached 85.00 and 92.59, identifying 88.9% of high-risk calls. In both languages, high-risk calls separated more cleanly than at-risk calls, and translation to English did not reduce the best observed performance. Suicide risk can be classified from de-identified Arabic transcripts without sending audio outside the helpline. The high-risk results support further testing as an operator-facing tool; lower-severity ideation proved the harder case.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在真实隐私约束下，利用黎巴嫩国家心理支持热线的去标识化阿拉伯语通话转录文本，将自杀风险分为“有风险”和“高风险”两类；通过本地化语音识别与命名实体识别实现音频不出电话热线，并对比阿拉伯语/英语（机器翻译）语料上微调的大语言模型与 Transformer 编码器基线，证明高风险分类可达较高性能（最佳英文模型宏F1 85.00、ROC-AUC 92.59，识别出88.9%的高风险来电），而低严重度意念分类更具挑战。
AI.motivation: 危机热线通常通过结构化访谈评估自杀风险，过程缓慢且依赖接线员的培训与工作负荷；自然语言处理虽有潜力支持风险评估与来电优先级排序，但几乎没有任何工作针对阿拉伯语热线通话，且需满足真实热线数据的隐私约束。
AI.method: 分析来自黎巴嫩国家心理支持与自杀预防热线的去标识化转录文本。音频全程不出热线：现场使用黎凡特阿拉伯语语音识别模型转写，并用阿拉伯语命名实体识别模型在本地移除身份信息，研究团队仅获得去标识化转录。接线员记录哥伦比亚自杀严重度评定量表（C-SSRS）的5个自杀意念条目，合并为两个二分类结局：at-risk（有风险）与 high-risk（高风险）。同时将转录机器翻译为英语，形成阿拉伯语/英语配对语料；在两个语料上分别微调5个指令微调大语言模型及6个Transformer编码器基线（4个阿拉伯语、2个英语），并在留出测试集上评估。共纳入383通电话：373通用于at-risk任务（阳性率52.3%），297通用于high-risk任务（阳性率30.0%）。
AI.result: 在high-risk任务上，最佳阿拉伯语模型宏F1为81.19、ROC-AUC为90.61；最佳英语模型宏F1为85.00、ROC-AUC为92.59，并识别出88.9%的高风险来电。两种语言均显示高风险电话比有风险电话更容易区分，且翻译为英语并未降低最佳观测性能。
AI.conclusion: 自杀风险可从去标识化的阿拉伯语转录中分类，且无需将音频送出热线之外。高风险分类结果支持进一步作为面向接线员的辅助工具进行测试；而较低严重度的意念识别（at-risk）仍是更具挑战的难题。

title: Soft-Argmax for the Projective Plane via the Veronese Embedding
summary: From horizon detection to fibre structures in X-ray imaging, many vision tasks recover lines via peak detection in Hough space $H=S^1\times\mathbb{R}$, the domain of orientation-offset pairs $(θ,ρ)$. Differentiable pipelines extract coordinates via \emph{soft-argmax}, a probability-weighted average that is only meaningful in a globally linear space. However, $(θ,ρ)$ and $(θ+π,-ρ)$ describe the same undirected line, so $H$ double-covers the space of undirected lines $H/\mathbb{Z}_2$: a Möbius strip, obtained by identifying each pair under $\mathbb{Z}_2$ action. Soft-argmax operates on the cover $H$, but since $H/\mathbb{Z}_2$ admits no linear structure, it tears geometrically adjacent lines apart. Thus we need a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-invariant embedding of lines into a linear space, on which soft-argmax is well-defined. We achieve this by parametrising lines via unit-norm homogeneous vectors $\ell=(1+ρ^2)^{-1/2}(\cosθ,\sinθ,-ρ)^{\top}\in\mathbb{R}^3$ and applying the Veronese map $v_2(\ell)=\ell\ell^{\top}$ that satisfies $v_2(\ell)=v_2(-\ell)$. This descends continuously to an embedding of the quotient $H/\mathbb{Z}_2$ into the linear space $\mathrm{Sym}^2(\mathbb{R}^3)$, where the antipodal ambiguity vanishes. Line extraction becomes a barycentre in $\mathrm{Sym}^2(\mathbb{R}^3)$, projected back via its leading eigenvector. We validate our \emph{Veronese soft-argmax} in a Hough transform-based network across all resolvable lines, confirming uniform and seam-free recovery. We further derive that the $L_2$-loss on isometrically weighted Veronese embeddings equals the squared chordal distance between lines in projective space, enabling a geometrically precise training objective.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Hough空间中不可定向直线（由Möbius带双覆盖导致）无法被软argmax正确提取的问题，提出Veronese软argmax：将直线参数化为单位范数齐次向量，经Veronese映射嵌入对称矩阵的线性空间，使反足歧义消失，直线提取变为该线性空间中的重心计算，并通过主导特征向量反投影。实验表明该方法在Hough变换网络中实现均匀、无接缝的直线恢复，且其等距加权嵌入上的L2损失等价于射影空间中直线的弦距离平方，从而获得几何精确的训练目标。
AI.motivation: Hough空间H=S^1×R是方向-偏移对(θ,ρ)的域，但(θ,ρ)与(θ+π,-ρ)描述同一条无向直线，因此H是直线空间H/Z_2（Möbius带）的双覆盖。可微管线使用软argmax（概率加权平均），这仅在全局线性空间中才有意义；而H/Z_2不具线性结构，软argmax会在其覆盖H上撕裂几何上相邻的直线。因此需要一个Z_2不变的直线线性空间嵌入，使软argmax良定义。
AI.method: 将直线参数化为单位范数齐次向量ℓ=(1+ρ²)^{-1/2}(cosθ,sinθ,-ρ)^T∈R³，并施加Veronese映射v₂(ℓ)=ℓℓ^T，满足v₂(ℓ)=v₂(-ℓ)，从而连续下降到商空间H/Z_2到线性空间Sym²(R³)的嵌入，反足歧义消失。直线提取变为Sym²(R³)中的重心（软argmax），再经主导特征向量反投影回直线。基于此提出Veronese软argmax，并在Hough变换网络的全部可分辨直线上验证；同时推导等距加权Veronese嵌入上的L2损失等于射影空间中直线间的弦距离平方。
AI.result: 在基于Hough变换的网络中跨所有可分辨直线验证了Veronese软argmax，确认了均匀且无接缝（seam-free）的直线恢复；并证明等距加权的Veronese嵌入上的L2损失等价于射影空间中直线间平方弦距离，提供了几何精确的训练目标。
AI.conclusion: Veronese软argmax通过对齐次向量施加Veronese映射，将Möbius带形状的直线空间连续嵌入到线性空间Sym²(R³)，消除了Z_2反足歧义，使软argmax得以良定义地用于直线提取，兼顾均匀性、无接缝性及几何精确的训练损失。

title: ConvDeck: Conversational Paper-to-Slide Generation via Stage-Specific User Feedback
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Project webpage: https://convdeck.github.io/
summary: Automatic academic paper-to-slide generation is inherently iterative, because creating an effective presentation requires repeated cycles of generation, critique, and revision. Recent multi-agent systems partially acknowledge this through internal critique-and-revise loops, while conversational approaches allow users to refine generated slide decks through dialog. However, these refinement processes either remain largely closed to the user or introduce feedback only after a complete deck has been produced, limiting the user's ability to participate in the iterative refinement of narrative flow, content allocation, and presentation emphasis. To address this gap, we introduce ConvDeck, a multi-agent pipeline for conversational paper-to-slide generation that distributes interaction across the pipeline through stage-specific loops, allowing users to iteratively refine both the presentation outline and the final slide deck at the stages where each kind of decision is made. These loops are driven by a refinement mechanism in which agents can think, speak, and act, enabling them to either directly apply edits or respond conversationally to clarify user feedback and discuss revision options. Our evaluation shows that stage-specific conversational feedback improves user-goal satisfaction while preserving narrative coherence, content quality, and visual presentation.

AI.tldr: ConvDeck 是一个面向"论文到幻灯片"自动生成的多智能体流水线，通过在流水线不同阶段（大纲与幻灯片）引入阶段特定的对话式反馈循环，让用户参与叙事流、内容分配与呈现重点的迭代精修。其精修机制使智能体能够"思考、发言、行动"，既可直接应用编辑，也可对话式回应以澄清用户反馈和讨论修订选项。实验表明该方法在保持叙事连贯性、内容质量与视觉效果的同时提升了用户目标满意度。
AI.motivation: 论文到幻灯片的自动生成本质上是迭代的过程，需要"生成—批评—修订"的循环。现有多智能体系统虽引入内部批评-修订循环，对话式方法也允许用户通过对话改进幻灯片，但这些精修过程要么对用户基本封闭，要么只能在一整套幻灯片生成完成之后才引入反馈，从而限制了用户在叙事流、内容分配和呈现重点等迭代精修中的参与。
AI.method: 提出 ConvDeck，一个用于对话式论文到幻灯片生成的多智能体流水线。它将交互分散到流水线的各个阶段，通过阶段特定的循环让用户能够在做出相应决策的阶段分别迭代精修演示大纲和最终幻灯片。这些循环由一种"思考、发言、行动"的精修机制驱动：智能体既能直接应用编辑，也能以对话方式回应，以澄清用户反馈并讨论修订选项。
AI.result: 实验评估显示，阶段特定的对话式反馈能够提高用户目标满意度，同时保持叙事连贯性、内容质量和视觉呈现效果不下降。
AI.conclusion: 将迭代精修分散到流水线各阶段并支持对话式反馈，能够在兼顾幻灯片质量的前提下更好地满足用户个性化目标，是论文到幻灯片生成中一种有效的交互设计。

title: Deterministic LLM Inference Across GPU Kernels: Power-of-Two INT8 Quantization Scales and the Limits of Tolerance-Based Conformance
comment: 9 pages (IEEEtran two-column), 3 figures, 5 tables. Fault injection against a two-stage-pinned prediction matrix (8,232 scored cells; 63-cell pre-data core, corrected and re-pinned after a disclosed smoke run); power-of-two requantization measured at 1.7B/8B/14B. Companion to arXiv:2608.13756, whose open questions on check sensitivity and deployability this paper answers
summary: Conformance suites for quantized GEMM kernels ask whether two implementations agree within a tolerance. We measure what such a suite can detect. Injecting nine faults into a reference INT8 pipeline over 8,232 layer--fault--regime cells of Qwen3-1.7B, we find that every one of five epilogue faults -- scale precision, double rounding, multiplication order, output truncation, fused ordering -- moves the output by at most a single bfloat16 spacing, and by exactly one whenever it moves it at all, across 5,880 cells. A tolerance of one spacing is therefore blind to the entire class by construction: four of the five faults are detected by no check in the suite, and the fifth only under power-of-two scales. Faults that violate the accumulator's exactness preconditions, or that break operand sharing, are detected without exception, and a null fault never fires. What a tolerance-based suite of this shape establishes is therefore narrower than interchangeability: that the preconditions hold, that operands are shared, and that differences stay within one spacing. The power-of-two constraint that exposes the one detected fault is also deployable. Requantizing every weight scale to its nearest power of two makes CUTLASS and Triton agree bitwise at every linear layer (196/196 and 252/252, against 8/196 and 10/252 under the checkpoints' own scales) and yields byte-identical generated token sequences at 1.7B, 8B and 14B (8/8 prompts, against 0/8 at all three). Observed perplexity point estimates are +0.32%, -0.28% and +0.48%; the 90% intervals cover zero at the two smaller sizes but not at 14B, reaching +0.71% and +0.76%. A previously reported +157% perplexity for this intervention was an artifact of a probe that rewrote scales without requantizing the weights; separating the effects attributes 99.8% of it to the resulting weight--scale mismatch rather than to the power-of-two constraint itself.

AI.tldr: 通过向INT8量化GEMM流水线注入9种故障，本文评估了容差型一致性测试套件能检测什么。研究发现：5种结尾（epilogue）故障的输出偏移至多一个bfloat16间距，因此单间距容差在构造上对这整类故障盲视；而违反累加器精确性前提或破坏操作数共享的故障则无一例外被检测到。本文还证明可部署的2的幂权重尺度约束能使CUTLASS与Triton在所有线性层按位一致，并生成字节级完全相同的token序列，且此前报告的+157%困惑度恶化是探针未重新量化权重导致的伪影。
AI.motivation: 一致性测试套件（conformance suite）用于判断两个量化GEMM实现是否在容差范围内一致，但其实际检测能力从未被系统测量。研究者希望在8232个层-故障-模式单元中量化"这类套件究竟能证明什么"，从而厘清通过测试到底意味着"可互换"还是更窄的性质，并解释一个已被报告的+157%困惑度异常结果。
AI.method: 对Qwen3-1.7B参考INT8流水线注入9种故障（5种结尾故障：尺度精度、双重舍入、乘法顺序、输出截断、融合顺序；其余为违反累加器精确性前提或破坏操作数共享的故障），在5,880个单元上逐字节比较输出；随后将权重尺度重量化到最近2的幂，在CUTLASS与Triton上做线性层按位一致性、token序列一致性及困惑度评估，并通过"分离效应"的对照实验（只改尺度但不重量化权重 vs. 正确重量化）来归因此前报告的+157%困惑度。
AI.result: 5种结尾故障中4种完全不被任何检查检出，第5种仅当尺度为2的幂时才被检出；所有结尾故障输出偏移至多或恰好为一个bfloat16间距，故单间距容差在构造上盲视该类故障。违反累加器精确性前提或破坏操作数共享的故障被无一例外检出，空故障从不触发。将权重尺度重量化到最近2的幂后，CUTLASS与Triton按位一致（196/196与252/252，对比原始尺度下的8/196与10/252），1.7B/8B/14B三规模全部8/8 prompt生成字节相同的token序列（对比0/8）。困惑度点估计为+0.32%、-0.28%、+0.48%，90%区间在两较小规模覆盖零但在14B处达+0.71%与+0.76%。此前+157%困惑度中99.8%归因于权重-尺度失配而非2的幂约束本身。
AI.conclusion: 一类这种形状的容差型套件所能确立的比"可互换性"更窄：它只能证明前置条件成立、操作数被共享、以及差异保持在单间距之内——对单间距量级内的整类结尾故障本质上是盲的。2的幂尺度约束是唯一能暴露该故障的可部署手段，且在实践中代价极小，但它并非无代价：在14B规模困惑度区间不覆盖零，提示存在统计上可见的效应；同时揭示了先前文献中+157%困惑度为伪影，强调评测探针必须正确重量化权重。

title: Uncovering and Mitigating Aggregation-Induced Reward Hacking in Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning of large language models increasingly adopts multiple reward dimensions, including verifiable rules, task-specific evaluators, and learned reward models, to provide richer supervision across diverse capabilities. These dimensions are commonly scalarized with fixed aggregation weights. We identify a failure mode in which aggregation itself induces reward hacking: static projection aliases qualitatively different reward profiles into a single scalar, steering optimization toward whichever dimensions are easiest, densest, or systematically favored by the reward signal. Over training, this traps the policy in suboptimal profiles and prevents convergence to better-balanced ones that would yield higher task performance. To address this, we propose Adaptive Multi-Reward Projection (AMRP), a lightweight online method that reallocates aggregation weights using three signals, relative shortfall, reward volatility, and recent progress, increasing pressure on lagging, unstable, or stagnant dimensions while relieving saturated ones. Across structured reasoning, citation-grounded generation, and open-ended alignment under GRPO, AMRP consistently improves reward-profile balance and downstream performance over fixed and dynamic weighting baselines; it also remains effective with GDPO and PPO, supporting compatibility across RL algorithms. Our code is available at https://github.com/yyhappier/AMRP.git.

AI.tldr: 本文指出多奖励维度的静态加权标量化会引发“奖励劫持”——固定投影将性质不同的奖励画像混叠成单一标量，导致优化偏向最易、最密或系统性受偏袒的维度，使策略困于次优画像。为此提出轻量级在线方法AMRP，利用相对缺口、奖励波动性和近期进展三类信号动态重分配聚合权重，以缓解滞后、不稳定或停滞的维度并释放饱和维度。在GRPO下的结构化推理、引用生成和开放对齐任务中，AMRP一致优于固定与动态加权基线，并在GDPO与PPO中同样有效。
AI.motivation: 大模型RL微调常引入多种奖励维度（可验证规则、任务评估器、学习到的奖励模型），但通常用固定权重将它们标量化合并。作者发现这种聚合本身会诱发奖励劫持：静态投影会把质量不同的奖励画像混叠为单一标量，驱使优化走向最易、最密或系统受偏袒的维度；随着训练推进，策略被困在次优画像，无法收敛到更平衡、任务性能更高的画像。
AI.method: 提出自适应多奖励投影（AMRP），一种轻量级在线方法。它利用三个信号动态重新分配聚合权重：相对缺口（relative shortfall）、奖励波动性（reward volatility）和近期进展（recent progress），从而增大对落后、不稳定或停滞维度的优化压力，同时释放已饱和维度。该方案在训练过程中持续在线更新权重，且不依赖特定RL算法。
AI.result: 在GRPO下的结构化推理、基于引用的生成和开放式对齐任务中，AMRP在奖励画像平衡度和下游性能上一致优于固定与动态加权基线；在GDPO和PPO下同样有效，表明其跨RL算法的兼容性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: AMRP通过在线调整多奖励聚合权重缓解了静态标量化带来的奖励劫持，将优化压力导向滞后、不稳定或停滞的维度，从而改善奖励画像平衡并提升下游任务性能，且具备跨算法（GRPO、GDPO、PPO）的通用性。

title: GenScale: A Benchmark for Relative Object Scale in Image Generation and Editing
summary: Modern image generation and editing systems can produce photorealistic, prompt-aligned images, but still often render familiar objects at implausible relative sizes. To measure this failure mode, we introduce GenScale, a benchmark and evaluation protocol for real-world relative object scale in image generation and editing. GenScale contains 900 image-level entries and 1,643 pairwise anchor-target scale relations across common-object generation, human-product generation with metric dimensions, and scale correction from failed generations. We further design a human-calibrated ordinal judge for scalable pairwise scale evaluation. Last but not the least, we introduce Rescale, a model-agnostic post-processing agent for localized scale correction without modifying the source generator. Experiments reveal that state-of-the-art image generators and editors cannot reliably observe relative scale yet, while Rescale consistently improves scale plausibility across generated and edited images. Together, GenScale establishes relative object scale as a distinct, measurable, and actionable capability for image generation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GenScale，一个用于评估图像生成与编辑中真实世界物体相对尺度合理性的基准（包含900个图像级条目和1,643对锚点-目标尺度关系），并配套设计人工校准的序数评判器用于可扩展的成对尺度评估；同时提出 Rescale，一种与模型无关的后处理智能体，可在不修改源生成器的情况下对局部尺度进行修正。实验表明现有 SOTA 生成器与编辑器难以可靠遵循相对尺度约束，而 Rescale 能持续提升生成与编辑图像的尺度合理性。
AI.motivation: 现代图像生成与编辑系统虽能生成逼真且与提示对齐的图像，但常以不合常理的相对大小渲染熟悉物体，这一失败模式缺乏系统的基准与评估方法。
AI.method: 构建 GenScale 基准，包含常见物体生成、带度量维度的人-产品生成以及失败生成的尺度修正三类任务的成对锚点-目标尺度关系；设计人工校准的序数评判器进行可扩展的成对尺度评估；并提出 Rescale，一种模型无关的后处理智能体，对生成或编辑图像进行局部尺度修正而不改动源生成器。
AI.result: 实验显示当前最先进的图像生成器与编辑器无法可靠地遵循相对尺度关系，而 Rescale 能持续提升生成图像和编辑图像的尺度合理性。
AI.conclusion: GenScale 将相对物体尺度确立为图像生成系统的一项独立、可度量且可干预的能力，为该方向提供了基准工具与改进手段。

title: Learning What to Retain: Gated-Memory Routing for Efficient Collaboration in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems tackle complex reasoning by orchestrating how multiple agents are configured and how they collaborate. A central challenge is to adapt orchestration to the evolving collaboration state. Routing from the query alone cannot adapt to intermediate progress or errors, which hurts accuracy. Routing from the complete execution history supplies this missing context, but forces later decisions to process every prior step, including redundant or low-utility ones. This creates an execution-history overload that inflates cost. Effective orchestration instead requires a compact state that captures useful progress without accumulating redundant context. We propose Gated-Memory Routing, which conditions each decision on the query and a learned execution memory. A learned Memory Write Gate commits only non-redundant reasoning steps, and a learned Retrieval Gate supplies each agent a compact, relevant subset, so every decision conditions on a clean, informative state. At each step, the system selects the next role and backbone from this memory, while an Adaptive Halting Controller stops execution once the memory contains sufficient evidence for answering. Across five reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, our framework is both effective and efficient: it attains the best average accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.44 points, while reducing HumanEval inference cost by 31.9% relative to that baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/rajibrhasan/gated-memory-routing

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Gated-Memory Routing 框架，通过学习到的遗忘写入门与检索门维护紧凑的执行记忆，并配合自适应停止控制器，使 LLM 多智能体系统的每一步编排决策都基于查询与精炼状态而非全部历史。在五个推理与代码生成基准上取得最优平均精度，比最强基线高 2.44 分，同时将 HumanEval 推理成本降低 31.9%。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统依赖智能体配置与协作方式的编排，其核心挑战是让编排适应动态变化的协作状态。仅基于查询进行路由无法感知中间进展或错误，损害精度；而基于完整执行历史路由虽能提供缺失上下文，但迫使后续决策处理每个先前步骤（含冗余或低效用步骤），造成执行历史过载并推高成本。因此需要一种既能捕获有效进展、又不累积冗余上下文的紧凑状态。
AI.method: 提出 Gated-Memory Routing：每一步决策同时以查询和可学习的执行记忆为条件。其中，可学习的 Memory Write Gate 只提交非冗余的推理步骤；可学习的 Retrieval Gate 为每个智能体提供紧凑且相关的记忆子集，从而保证每次决策基于干净且信息丰富的状态。系统每一轮依据该记忆选择下一角色与骨干模型，并由 Adaptive Halting Controller 在记忆已包含足够证据时提前终止执行。
AI.result: 在五个推理与代码生成基准上，该方法同时实现了有效性与高效性：取得最优平均准确率，超过最强基线 2.44 个百分点，并使 HumanEval 推理成本相对该基线降低 31.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通过以紧凑执行记忆替代完整历史来驱动逐步路由与自适应停止，可显著提升 LLM 多智能体编排的精度与效率，验证了在演化协作状态中维护非冗余状态表示的价值。

title: Counterfactual Fragility Certificates: Exposing High-Confidence Brittleness under Structured Evidence Failure
summary: High test accuracy and good aggregate calibration do not show whether an individual prediction is structurally supported by its evidence. In tabular decision systems, failures often occur when a feature family becomes unavailable, delayed, noisy, stale, or low-trust while the model remains highly confident. Existing calibration, uncertainty, selective-prediction, explanation, and perturbation methods provide scalar scores or attribution maps, but not a recomputable audit object answering: under a declared evidence-failure protocol, what trajectory makes this prediction lose support? We introduce Counterfactual Fragility Certificates (CFC), a model-agnostic protocol-level audit certificate-not a formal robustness certificate-that maps each prediction into an ordered evidence-failure trajectory summarized by greedy flip budget, normalized margin-collapse area, degradation thresholds, and fragility dominance score. Across seven tabular benchmarks and strong linear, tree-based, boosting, and neural baselines, CFC-FDS identifies independently brittle high-confidence cases with 0.915 AUROC, improving over the strongest non-certificate score by +0.405. The advantage persists across perturbation, permutation-importance, group-SHAP, baseline-choice, seed-variance, budgeted-review, and naturalistic field-unavailability checks. Under a 20% review budget, CFC-FDS captures 88.9% of brittle high-confidence cases, compared with 31.8-37.4% for confidence and energy scores. We also evaluate fragility-aware regularization and brittleness-aware temperature correction as secondary uses. CFC provides a concrete reliability framework for exposing high-confidence brittleness missed by ordinary score-centric evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反事实脆弱性证书（CFC），一种模型无关、协议级的审计证书，将每个预测映射为有序的证据失效轨迹，并总结为贪心翻转预算、归一化边际崩塌面积、退化阈值和脆弱性优势分数等指标，用于揭露表型决策系统中高置信度预测的底层脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 高测试准确率与良好的聚合校准无法说明单个预测是否在结构上得到其证据支持；在表格决策系统中，当特征族变得不可用、延迟、含噪、过时或低信任时，模型仍可能保持高置信度而失败。现有校准、不确定性、选择性预测、解释和扰动方法仅提供标量分数或归因图，缺少一个可重算的审计对象来回答：在声明的证据失效协议下，什么样的轨迹会使该预测失去支持。
AI.method: 作者提出 Counterfactual Fragility Certificates (CFC)，一种模型无关的协议级审计证书（非形式化鲁棒性证书），将每个预测映射为一条有序的证据失效轨迹，并通过贪心翻转预算、归一化边际崩塌面积、退化阈值和脆弱性优势分数（CFC-FDS）进行概括；同时探索了脆弱性感知正则化和脆弱性感知温度校正作为次要用途。
AI.result: 在七个表格基准及线性、树、提升和神经网络强基线上，CFC-FDS 以 0.915 AUROC 识别独立脆弱的髙置信度样本，相比最强非证书分数提升 +0.405；在 20% 审核预算下捕获 88.9% 的脆弱高置信度样本，而置信度与能量分数仅为 31.8–37.4%；优势在扰动、置换重要性、group-SHAP、基线的选择、种子方差、预算式审核和自然场景字段不可用检验中均保持。
AI.conclusion: CFC 为暴露普通以分数为中心的评估所遗漏的高置信度脆弱性提供了具体、可重算的可靠性框架，将可靠性审计从聚合分数扩展到协议级别的逐预测证据支持审查。

title: LLM-as-a-Demographic: Whom Sociodemographic Prompting Helps, and Whom It Hurts
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges for subjective tasks, where annotators disagree and the relevant question is not only how accurate a judge is, but whose judgments it reproduces. Sociodemographic prompting conditions the judge on an annotator's demographic profile to align its judgments with the corresponding group's. We test whether this alignment emerges distributionally, comparing the predicted label distributions of 23 open-weight LLMs on three subjective tasks against those of real annotator groups, under three conditions: no demographic information, single-attribute profiles, and intersectional profiles over gender, age, race, and education. Three findings emerge. First, a judge prompted with no demographics is not perspective-neutral: models best reproduce the judgments of White, college-educated annotators. Second, demographic conditioning is asymmetric: it moves the judge toward majority groups and away from minority groups, most strongly on offensiveness, where intersectional profiles amplify the harm. Third, by comparing base and instruct models we identify instruction-tuning as a possible source of the asymmetry. Demographic conditioning should therefore be used with caution to estimate group judgments: conditioning moves predictions away from the reference distributions of the minority groups the method is often invoked to serve.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在社会人口统计学提示下的判断对齐行为，发现无人口统计信息的法官并非观点中立（偏向白人、受过大学教育的标注者），人口统计学条件化呈现不对称性（使模型靠近多数群体、远离少数群体），并指出指令微调可能是这一不对称性的来源。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作主观任务的裁判，而主观任务中标注者意见存在分歧，关键问题不仅在于裁判多准确，还在于它复现了谁的判断。社会人口统计学提示通过将裁判条件化于标注者的人口统计画像，使其判断与对应群体对齐，但这种对齐是否在分布层面真正涌现尚待验证。
AI.method: 在三个主观任务上，对23个开放权重LLM，比较其预测的标签分布与真实标注者群体的分布。实验设置三种条件：无人口统计信息、单属性画像、以及涵盖性别、年龄、种族和教育的交叉性画像，并对比基础模型与指令微调模型。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：（1）无人口统计信息的裁判并非视角中立，模型最好地复现了白人、受过大学教育的标注者的判断；（2）人口统计学条件化具有不对称性，使裁判向多数群体靠拢、远离少数群体，在冒犯性任务上最为显著，交叉性画像加剧了这种危害；（3）通过对比基础与指令微调模型，识别出指令微调可能是不对称性的来源。
AI.conclusion: 人口统计学条件化在估计群体判断时应谨慎使用：条件化会使预测偏离少数群体的参考分布，而该方法恰恰常被用于服务这些少数群体。

title: A Glance Is All You Need: Single-Pass Fine-Grained Image Captioning with SimLoss
summary:
An image may be worth a thousand words, but most captioning models describe it in only a few. Modern vision-language models produce fluent high-level captions, yet routinely miss the attributes, counts, textures, materials, and spatial relations that make an image visually specific. Recent multi-stage systems recover some of these details through generation, decomposition, verification, and rewriting, but they do so at the expense of substantially higher inference latency.
  We propose SimLoss, a reference-free embedding-space objective for single-pass fine-grained image captioning. SimLoss trains a vision-language model to align its projected hidden-state representation with a frozen image embedding through an InfoNCE contrastive loss, supplying a dense visual supervision signal before any text is decoded, and requiring neither human-written fine-grained captions nor pseudo-captions from a multi-stage pipeline. We instantiate it as SimLoss FFT, which backpropagates through a locally available embedding model, and SimLoss GRPO, which treats that model as a black-box reward.
  Compared with single-pass, multi-stage verification, reward-optimized, and perception-aware baselines, the fully differentiable fine-tuning variant, SimLoss FFT, achieves the highest precision while nearly matching the F1 score of the multi-stage method, all while retaining single-pass inference and running roughly 20 times faster than the multi-stage pipeline.
  The reward-based variant SimLoss GRPO attains the strongest recall. Together, these results show that embedding-space supervision can recover the quality of multi-stage verification at the latency of a single-pass captioner.

AI.tldr: 提出 SimLoss，一种用于单遍（single-pass）细粒度图像描述的免参考嵌入空间目标函数。它通过 InfoNCE 对比损失将视觉-语言模型的投影隐状态与冻结的图像嵌入对齐，在解码前提供密集视觉监督信号，无需人工细粒度描述或多阶段伪描述。SimLoss FFT（全微分微调）接近多阶段方法的 F1 且精度最高，速度约为多阶段流水线的 20 倍；SimLoss GRPO（黑盒奖励）取得最强召回率，证明嵌入空间监督能以单遍延迟恢复多阶段验证的质量。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽能生成流畅的高层描述，却常遗漏属性、数量、纹理、材质和空间关系等使图像视觉上具体的细节。多阶段系统（生成、分解、验证、重写）虽能恢复部分细节，却显著增加了推理延迟。因此需要一种既能保持单遍推理低延迟、又能提供密集视觉监督以实现细粒度描述的训练方案。
AI.method: 提出 SimLoss，一种免参考的嵌入空间目标函数：通过 InfoNCE 对比损失，将视觉-语言模型解码前的投影隐状态表示与冻结的图像嵌入对齐，从而在解码任何文本之前提供密集的视觉监督信号，既不需要人工标注的细粒度描述，也不需要多阶段流水线生成的伪描述。论文实例化了两个变体：SimLoss FFT（对本地可用的嵌入模型进行反向传播的全微分微调）和 SimLoss GRPO（将嵌入模型视为黑盒奖励的基于 GRPO 的变体）。
AI.result: 与单遍、多阶段验证、奖励优化和感知感知基线相比：全微分微调变体 SimLoss FFT 取得最高精度，其 F1 几乎与多阶段方法持平，同时保持单遍推理，运行速度约为多阶段流水线的 20 倍；基于奖励的变体 SimLoss GRPO 取得最强召回率。实验表明嵌入空间监督能够以单遍描述器的延迟恢复多阶段验证的质量。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入空间监督是一种高效且有效的细粒度图像描述训练范式：SimLoss 不仅免除了对细粒度人工标注和多阶段伪描述流水线的依赖，还能在保持单遍推理低延迟的同时，在精度、F1 和召回率上分别达到或接近多阶段验证方法的水平，为细粒度图像描述提供了一条兼顾质量与效率的新路径。

title: Invalidation Contracts for Cross-Episode Agent Memory
summary: LLM agents that cache recovery suggestions from API errors can skip re-derivation in later episodes, spending fewer tokens and fewer model calls on constraints they have already learned. Server-side data drift turns those cached fixes into silent failures, and the usual remedy, re-deriving on every episode, gives the savings back. We introduce invalidation contracts, a protocol layer that attaches version stamps and cacheability hints to every recovery suggestion so the client can evict stale entries without trial and error, and keep the rest. The contract decomposes realized savings into two independent factors: validity, the fraction of cached suggestions that remain correct after a drift event, and compliance, the fraction the planner applies on the first attempt. Validity depends only on the protocol and is vendor-independent. Compliance depends on the planner model: identical wire bytes yield 100% first-try compliance on Claude Haiku 4.5 and 11% or below on Claude Sonnet 5, which exhibits input-schema conservatism, refusing fixes that add fields the original request did not contain. We evaluate across seven models, three serving paths, two domains, and approximately 9,400 episodes. Row-level invalidation raises compliance by 0 to 66.7 percentage points across the seven models, 55.6 to 66.7 on three, and recovers 29-33% of baseline token cost on four of seven models, while table-level invalidation destroys co-located entries and drops post-drift first-try rates to 0% on five of seven. Eviction precision is 1.00 at row granularity on every model under the row-level oracle of Section 4.1. The contract adds 15% to response payload. Version-stamp validity is deterministic by construction and produced identical results across every model and serving path, with zero contract failures in the entire evaluation.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM智能体缓存API错误恢复建议时因服务端数据漂移导致的静默失效问题，提出"失效契约"(invalidation contracts)协议层，通过在每条恢复建议上附加版本戳和可缓存性提示，使客户端无需试错即可驱逐过期条目，从而在保留缓存的token节省的同时避免静默失败。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体会缓存API错误中的恢复建议以跳过后续回合的重新推导，节省token和模型调用；但服务端数据漂移会使缓存修复变成静默失败，而每回合重新推导又会抵消节省。现有方案在"节省"与"正确性"之间存在两难，需要一个无需逐条试错即可高效驱逐过期条目、保留有效条目的机制。
AI.method: 提出失效契约(Invalidation Contracts)协议层：为每条恢复建议附加版本戳(version stamps)和缓存性提示(cacheability hints)，让客户端据此驱逐过期条目并保留其余部分。契约将实际节省分解为两个独立因子：有效性(validity，漂移后仍正确的缓存建议占比，仅取决于协议、与厂商无关)和合规性(compliance，规划器首次尝试即采纳的占比，取决于规划器模型)。评估采用行级(row-level)与表级(table-level)两种失效粒度，跨7个模型、3条服务路径、2个领域、约9,400个回合。
AI.result: 行级失效在7个模型上将合规性提升0至66.7个百分点（其中3个模型提升55.6-66.7），并在7个模型中的4个上恢复29-33%的基线token成本；表级失效会破坏共存条目，导致7个模型中的5个漂移后首次尝试率降至0%。在行级oracle下，所有模型的驱逐精度均为1.00。契约使响应负载增加15%。版本戳有效性在构造上确定，在所有模型和服务路径上结果一致，整个评估中零契约失败。另发现输入模式保守性：Claude Haiku 4.5首次尝试合规100%，而Claude Sonnet 5仅11%或更低，拒绝添加原始请求中未包含字段的修复。
AI.conclusion: 失效契约提供了一种轻量、确定性且供应商无关的协议层，在保证缓存正确性的同时保留其成本节省：行级失效粒度在多数模型上带来显著的合规性提升与token成本回收，且驱逐精确；而表级失效会严重破坏缓存收益。版本戳机制确定性验证表明该协议高度可靠，可作为LLM智能体错误恢复缓存的标准实践。

title: Adapting Without Gradients: Affine Statistics Transport and What Its Certificate Can Tell You
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) typically assumes that model parameters can be updated at inference time. This assumption is restrictive for inference-only accelerators, frozen or third-party models, and memory-constrained deployments, and standard BatchNorm-based TTA configurations may also become inactive on architectures without BatchNorm. We study adaptation when the learned model must remain frozen. We introduce CASTER, a gradient-free method that stores source class statistics in a discriminative subspace, estimates a class-shared affine transformation from target-batch moments, and analytically transports the source class distributions before classification. CASTER requires no backward pass, optimizer state, or stored source feature bank. Across four backbones and seven datasets, it outperforms k-NN on identical frozen features in 27 of 28 backbone-dataset settings while retaining a median of 18x less state. Affine transport is not always reliable. On ImageNet-C, where batches contain only 64 samples for 1000 classes, unconditional transport loses 21.2 top-1 points. We therefore introduce an empirical residual-to-margin transportability certificate. Across 307 evaluation cells, every transport losing more than 10 points has certificate value above 3.9, although benign and destructive regimes are not perfectly separated. Gating converts an average $-3.35$-point effect of unconditional transport into a +1.69-point gain, and performance remains within 0.3 points of the best threshold over a broad threshold range. Finally, we show that this certificate is mechanism-specific: when applied to Tent, it accepts only $4.3\%$ of updates and preserves 0.6% of Tent's available gain. These results position CASTER as a lightweight adaptation mechanism for frozen-model deployment, together with an explicit account of when its safety signal is informative and when it is not.

AI.tldr: 本文研究测试时自适应（TTA）中模型参数必须保持冻结的场景，提出无梯度方法 CASTER：在判别子空间中存储源域类别统计量，利用目标批次矩估计类别共享的仿射变换，并在分类前解析地迁移源类别分布。该方法无需反向传播、优化器状态或源特征库。在四种骨干网络和七个数据集上，CASTER 在 28 个骨干-数据集组合中的 27 个优于基于相同冻结特征的 k-NN，且状态开销中位数少 18 倍。针对无条件仿射迁移在 ImageNet-C 上失效的问题，作者引入残差到间隔的可迁移性证书（transportability certificate），通过门控将无条件迁移平均 -3.35 点的效果转为 +1.69 点的增益，并证明该证书具有机制特异性。
AI.motivation: 传统 TTA 假设推理时可以更新模型参数，这限制了仅推理加速器、冻结或第三方模型以及内存受限的部署场景；同时基于 BatchNorm 的 TTA 配置在无 BatchNorm 的架构上可能失效。标准 TTA 方法在不允许更新参数的冻结模型环境中并不适用，因此需要一种不修改模型参数、无梯度的轻量级自适应机制来提升冻结模型的泛化能力。
AI.method: CASTER 是一种无梯度的仿射迁移方法：首先在判别子空间中存储源域类别统计量，然后从目标批次的一阶/二阶矩估计一个类别共享的仿射变换，最后在分类前解析地将源类别分布迁移到目标域。该方法不需要反向传播、优化器状态或存储源特征库。针对无条件仿射迁移在小批次（如 ImageNet-C 中 64 样本对应 1000 类）下不可靠的问题，作者进一步提出经验性的"残差到间隔"可迁移性证书（residual-to-margin transportability certificate），用于判断何时仿射迁移是有益的，并据此对迁移进行门控（gating）。
AI.result: 在四种骨干网络和七个数据集上，CASTER 在 28 个骨干-数据集组合中的 27 个优于基于相同冻结特征的 k-NN，同时状态中位数减少 18 倍。在 ImageNet-C 上，无条件迁移损失 21.2 个 top-1 点；在 307 个评估单元中，所有损失超过 10 点的迁移其证书值均高于 3.9，但良性/破坏性区间并未完全分离。门控将无条件迁移平均 -3.35 点的效果转为 +1.69 点的增益，且在大范围阈值内性能与最优阈值相差不超过 0.3 点。将同一证书应用于 Tent 时只接受 4.3% 的更新，仅保留 Tent 可用增益的 0.6%，说明该证书具有机制特异性。
AI.conclusion: CASTER 为冻结模型部署提供了一种轻量级、无需梯度和存储的自适应机制，并在多数设定下显著优于相同特征上的 k-NN。同时，论文明确刻画了其安全信号（可迁移性证书）在何种条件下具有信息量、何时不可靠：该证书能有效识别大规模仿射迁移的破坏性区间，但其良性/破坏性区间并未完全分离，且针对 Tent 等基于更新的方法不具有可迁移的判别力。这为冻结模型 TTA 提供了一个兼具实用性与可解释性边界的方案。

title: Bridging Lexical Divergence: LLM-Assisted, Cost-Efficient, Zero-shot Scientific Entity Linking
summary: Scientific domain entity linking (EL) differs from general domain EL because mentions and entity names often lack lexical overlap. Another challenge is that specialized terminology is used in the scientific domain, which is rarely encountered in models pretrained on general domains. Therefore, models trained on general domains transfer poorly to scientific domains. To address this, in-domain fine-tuning is the natural remedy. However, many scientific domains lack expert-annotated data, motivating the need for a zero-human-annotation approach. Existing zero-shot methods heavily rely on LLMs to generate aliases across entire mention corpora, which incurs substantial computational cost, and those methods provide no mechanism to filter out noise from LLMs. To address these challenges, we propose Sci-ZSEL, a framework that selectively generates entity aliases with an LLM to control computational cost, and applies an ontology-aware filter to remove aliases that semantically drift toward ontology neighbors. Then, filtered aliases are used to construct pseudo-labeled mention-entity pairs for fine-tuning. To enable evaluation of EL under low lexical overlap, we also release a new animal science EL benchmark linked to three livestock trait ontologies, where mentions and entities exhibit substantially lower lexical overlap than in existing benchmarks. Across five benchmarks, Sci-ZSEL outperforms the non-fine-tuned baseline, is most useful on nonoverlapping mentions, and combining it with curated synonyms gives the best performance in most settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sci-ZSEL，一个面向科学领域实体链接的零人工标注框架。它通过有选择地使用 LLM 生成实体别名以控制计算成本，并利用基于本体感知的过滤器剔除语义漂移向本体邻居的噪声别名，再用过滤后的别名构建伪标注的提及-实体对进行微调。作者还发布了与三个家畜性状本体链接的动物科学 EL 基准，其提及与实体间的词汇重叠度明显低于现有基准。五个基准上的实验表明，Sci-ZSEL 优于未微调基线，对非重叠提及尤为有效，且与人工策展同义词结合时在多数设置下取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 科学领域的实体链接与通用领域不同：提及与实体名称常缺乏词汇重叠，且科学专业术语在通用预训练模型中很少见，导致通用模型迁移效果差。领域内微调是自然解决方案，但许多科学领域缺乏专家标注数据，需要零人工标注方法。现有零样本方法严重依赖 LLM 为整个提及语料库生成别名，计算成本高，且无法过滤 LLM 产生的噪声。
AI.method: 提出 Sci-ZSEL 框架：(1) 有选择性地使用 LLM 生成实体别名以控制计算成本；(2) 应用本体感知过滤器，移除语义漂移向本体邻居方向的噪声别名；(3) 用过滤后的别名构建伪标注的提及-实体对用于微调。同时发布一个链接到三个人类家畜性状本体的新动物科学 EL 基准，其提及与实体词汇重叠度显著更低。
AI.result: 在五个基准上，Sci-ZSEL 始终优于未微调基线，在非重叠提及上提升最为明显；将其与人工策展同义词结合时，在大多数设置下取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: Sci-ZSEL 表明，通过选择性生成与本体感知过滤相结合，可以在零人工标注条件下以可控的计算成本实现科学领域实体链接的有效领域适配，尤其能解决低词汇重叠这一核心难题。

title: BrainDiff: Longitudinal Report Generation for Multimodal Brain MRI
summary: Neuroradiologists rarely read a brain MRI in isolation, yet automated brain-MRI report generation has been built almost entirely for single studies. Temporal analysis has been explored on chest radiography and chest CT, but to our knowledge, longitudinal reporting for brain MRI, where interval change is often subtle and spatially distributed, remains unaddressed. We present BrainDiff, the first longitudinal vision-language system for brain MRI. BrainDiff outperforms both frontier general-purpose and single-study neuroimaging models on the same patient pairs. Moreover, BrainDiff retains 91% of internal RadGraph-XL entity+relation F1 (rg_er) on an external, cross-hospital cohort. Beyond the system, we contribute three analyses. First, we identify two independent grounding levers: a counterfactual objective with prior-report dropout, which increases measured image reliance by ~47%, and a staged curriculum. Together, these interventions raise image reliance 2.5-fold from the baseline. Second, we provide a factorial over prior-report availability and image identity, isolating a visual contribution of +0.0387 rg_er, which grows when the prior report is withheld. Third, a cheap change-decodability test for candidate backbones shows that interval change is decodable far more weakly than single-study pathology (0.60 vs. 0.77 AUROC). Code is publicly available at https://github.com/jhuldr/BrainDiff.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BrainDiff，首个面向脑部 MRI 的纵向视觉-语言报告生成系统，通过反事实目标结合既往报告 dropout 与分段课程学习提升图像依赖性与生成质量，在内部与外部跨院数据集上均优于通用与单次研究模型，并系统分析了时间变化可解码性的局限。
AI.motivation: 神经放射科医生几乎不会孤立地阅读单次脑 MRI，但现有的脑 MRI 自动报告生成几乎全部针对单次检查构建。虽然胸部 X 光与 CT 已探索过时间序列分析，但脑 MRI 的纵向报告生成（其间隔变化往往细微且空间分布广泛）此前尚未被解决。
AI.method: 提出 BrainDiff，一个纵向多模态系统，以同一患者的成对（既往与当前）脑 MRI 为输入进行报告生成。包含两个独立的“接地”（grounding）杠杆：一是带既往报告 dropout 的反事实目标函数，二是分段式课程学习，二者结合使图像依赖度较基线提升 2.5 倍。此外还设计了廉价的可解码性测试用于候选骨干网络。
AI.result: BrainDiff 在相同患者对上优于前沿通用模型及单次研究神经影像模型；在外部跨院队列上保留了内部 RadGraph-XL 实体+关系 F1（rg_er）的 91%。反事实目标使图像依赖度提升约 47%；对既往报告可用性与图像身份进行析因分析，分离出 +0.0387 rg_er 的视觉贡献，且在既往报告被隐藏时该贡献增大。可解码性测试显示间隔变化比单次研究病理更弱（0.60 vs 0.77 AUROC）。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 纵向脑 MRI 报告生成是可行且有效的，BrainDiff 证明了结合既往信息与图像接地技术可以显著提升系统性能与外推能力；同时，间隔变化的可解码性显著弱于单次研究的病理信息，提示该方向仍需更强的时序建模与接地机制。

title: Authority Bias in Conversational Search Engines for Academic Paper Recommendation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as conversational search engines for academic literature, yet whether they judge papers on content or on authority signals has not been tested causally. We investigate authority bias: systematic preference for papers based on author prestige, venue, and citations rather than content. Holding title and abstract constant, we vary authority metadata across three counterfactual conditions (original, flipped, boosted) over eight LLMs (five open-weight and three frontier closed-weight) in an in-context, single-turn, top-1 recommendation setting. Our experiments show that authority bias is substantial and directional, varies markedly across models, and is only partially addressable through prompt-level debiasing. We further document a say-do gap: debiasing instructions suppress authority mentions far faster than authority-driven flips, so surface auditing systematically underestimates behavioral bias.

AI.tldr: 本文通过因果实验研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在学术文献推荐中的"权威偏差"（authority bias），即在标题和摘要内容不变的情况下，模型是否会因作者声望、期刊/会议级别和引用量等权威元数据的改变而系统性地改变推荐结果。实验在八种LLM上对比三种反事实条件（原始、反转、增强），发现权威偏差显著且具有方向性、跨模型差异大，且仅能通过提示层面的去偏部分缓解。文章还揭示了"说-做差距"（say-do gap）：去偏指令能迅速抑制权威相关表述，但无法同等程度地消除权威驱动的推荐翻转，因此表面审计会系统性低估行为层面的偏差。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作学术文献的对话式搜索引擎，但学界尚未通过因果检验的方式验证它们究竟是基于论文内容还是基于权威信号（如作者声望、期刊/会议级别、引用量）来评判论文。识别这种权威偏差及其可缓解程度，对于学术搜索的可信度至关重要。
AI.method: 在保持标题和摘要内容恒定的前提下，通过三种反事实条件（原始、反转、增强）改变权威元数据，在八种LLM（五种开放权重、三种前沿闭源权重）上采用上下文内、单轮、top-1推荐设置进行系统性因果实验。
AI.result: 权威偏差显著且具有方向性；不同模型间偏差程度差异很大；提示层面的去偏只能部分缓解该偏差。此外存在"说-做差距"：去偏指令能更快地抑制权威相关表述，但权威驱动的推荐翻转下降较慢，说明表面审计会系统性低估行为偏差。
AI.conclusion: LLM在学术文献推荐中确实存在实质性且方向性的权威偏差，仅靠提示级别的去偏不足以保证基于内容的公平推荐；同时，仅以模型输出中是否提及权威信息来评估去偏效果会严重低估其真实行为偏差，未来的审计与去偏工作应关注行为层面的指标。

title: Neural means and kernel corrections for operator learning
summary: We combine neural network means with exact Matérn kernel regressions of their residuals and of their learned features, and evaluate the pairing on two public emulation problems with published baselines: the structural-mechanics benchmark of de Hoop et al. and the OCO-2 radiative-transfer emulator of Lamminpää et al. On structural mechanics the combination reaches 4.55% test error, matching the best published architecture, and 5.38% against a published 6.49% in the low-data regime. On OCO-2 it improves on the published Gaussian-process emulator on that problem's own test points, outright on two of the three spectral bands; the same kernel that trails the network tenfold on the raw state overtakes it on the network's features, and we measure why (the target's squared native-space norm drops about fortyfold at fixed effective dimension) and prove the mechanism. Where the two families tie instead, the residuals of every architecture we train correlate above 0.86 and their shared component is flat in diversity and sample size, which reads the published plateau as a property of the data. Supporting results include a second-moment identity that predicts stacking outcomes from measured correlations, an optimal-recovery certificate, and a distribution-free coverage band, the only uncertainty signal that survives our tests.

AI.tldr: 本文将神经网络均值与精确Matérn核回归（分别作用于残差和网络学习到的特征）相结合，在两个公开仿真问题上（de Hoop等人的结构力学基准和Lamminpää等人的OCO-2辐射传输仿真器）达到或超越已发表基线：结构力学任务达到4.55%测试误差（追平最佳已发表架构），低数据体制下5.38%（超过已发表的6.49%）；OCO-2任务在两个谱带上直接优于已发表的GP仿真器。作者不仅测量了核方法在网络特征上反超原始输入约十倍的现象及其机制（目标原生空间范数平方在固定有效维下降约40倍），还证明了该机制；同时指出两种方法打平时所有架构残差相关性高于0.86、共享成分随多样性与样本量保持平坦，从而将已发表的平台期解读为数据固有属性。辅助结果包括预测堆叠结果的二阶矩恒等式、最优恢复证书，以及唯一通过全部测试的无分布覆盖带。
AI.motivation: 神经网络与高斯过程/核回归是两类互补的仿真器：神经网络在原始状态上往往胜过核方法（约十倍），但核方法可能在其他表示（如网络特征）上表现更优。作者希望系统性地考察二者组合是否能在已有公开基准上取得增益，并解释为什么在某些问题上两种方法打平（呈现平台期）——这究竟是方法局限还是数据固有属性。同时，他们希望为堆叠（stacking）预测提供可预测的理论依据，并检验不确定性信号在真实任务中的可靠性。
AI.method: 本文方法分为两部分实验框架与理论支撑。(1) 组合方案：以神经网络输出作为均值，分别对其残差和对其学习到的特征做精确Matérn核回归（即"网络+核"堆叠），并与单独方法对比。(2) 归因分析：通过测量目标在原生空间与特征空间中的平方范数（在固定有效维度下约下降40倍）解释核方法在特征上反超的原因，并给出形式化证明。(3) 理论工具：推导二阶矩恒等式以从实测相关性预测堆叠结果；给出最优恢复（optimal-recovery）证书；构造无分布覆盖带作为不确定性信号，并与其它不确定性估计进行比较检验。(4) 数据属性检验：对多种架构的残差做相关性分析（>0.86），并检验共享成分对多样性与样本量的平坦性，以判定已发表平台期是否来自数据本身。
AI.result: 结构力学基准上，组合达到4.55%测试误差，追平最佳已发表架构；低数据体制下为5.38%，优于已发表的6.49%。OCO-2任务上，组合在三个谱带中的两个上直接优于已发表的GP仿真器。机制上，相同的核在原始状态上比网络差约十倍，但在网络特征上反超网络；其原因被测量为固定有效维度下目标平方范数约下降四十倍并被形式化证明。当两种方法打平时，所有训练架构的残差相关性高于0.86，其共享成分对多样性与样本量均平坦，表明已发表的平台期是数据性质。不确定性方面，只有无分布覆盖带通过全部检验。
AI.conclusion: 神经均值与Matérn核回归残差/特征的组合是一种稳健且可解释的仿真策略：不仅能在两个公开基准上追平或超越最优已发表结果，还能从数据几何（范数、相关性）上解释"何时堆叠有效、何时打平"。平台期并非方法缺陷而是数据固有属性；同时，无分布覆盖带是唯一可靠的不确定性信号，而二阶矩恒等式与最优恢复证书为堆叠预测提供了可复用的理论工具。

title: LOOMSUM:Weaving Quantitative and Narrative Evidence for Faithful Long Text-Table Summarization
comment: Preprint, code will be available soon
summary: Long documents often distribute important information across extensive narrative passages and multiple tables, making faithful summarization particularly challenging. Existing methods may generate individually supported quantitative facts and analytical statements yet associate them incorrectly, producing quantitatively plausible yet analytically unfaithful summaries. In this work, we propose LOOMSUM, a training-free framework that extracts source-grounded atomic evidence, explicitly links table-derived facts with supporting narrative analyses, and plans the discourse structure before generation. We also introduce Table-Grounded Faithfulness (TGF), a claim-level metric that separately evaluates Numeric Grounding, Analysis Support, and Relation Consistency. Experiments on the text--table summarization benchmarks FINDSum and USTT show that LOOMSUM improves analytical faithfulness while maintaining strong summarization quality. Human evaluation finds positive component-level associations with the corresponding human judgments. Our Relation Consistency metric further shows stronger agreement with human relation judgments than generic factuality metrics, indicating that explicit cross-modal linking helps reduce errors in which supported quantities are paired with incorrect narrative interpretations. Together, these findings show that faithful long text--table summarization requires not only grounding individual facts, but also preserving the relations between them.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的框架 LOOMSUM 与配套指标 TGF，用于提升长文档文本—表格摘要的分析性忠实度：通过抽取基于来源的原子证据、显式链接表格事实与叙事分析并在生成前规划篇章结构，同时引入分别评估数字依据、分析支持和关系一致性的声明级指标。
AI.motivation: 长文档的重要信息常分散于大量叙事段落和多个表格中，现有方法虽能分别生成受支持的数量事实与分析性陈述，却可能将其错误关联，从而产生数值上看似合理但分析上不忠实的摘要。
AI.method: 提出训练无关框架 LOOMSUM：抽取基于来源的原子证据，显式地将表格派生事实与支撑性叙事分析关联起来，并在生成前规划话语结构；同时提出声明级指标 Table-Grounded Faithfulness (TGF)，分别评估 Numeric Grounding、Analysis Support 与 Relation Consistency 三个维度。
AI.result: 在文本—表格摘要基准 FINDSum 和 USTT 上，LOOMSUM 在提升分析性忠实度的同时保持了较强的摘要质量；人工评估显示其各组件与相应人工判断呈正向关联；Relation Consistency 指标相较于通用事实性指标与人工关系判断的一致性更强，表明显式跨模态关联有助于减少"受支持的数量被配以错误叙事解释"的错误。
AI.conclusion: 忠实的长期文本—表格摘要不仅需要使单个事实有据可依，还必须保持事实之间的关联关系。

title: Streaming4D: Accelerate 4D World Models via Block-wise Video Generation and Incremental Reconstruction
summary: Current 4D generation paradigms are often bottlenecked by a sequential decoupling design: video is generated first, followed by 3D reconstruction, leading to high interaction latency. This limits applications in interactive real-time scenarios. To this end, we propose \textbf{Streaming4D}, a tightly coupled synchronous pipeline that integrates block-wise autoregressive video generation with incremental 3D reconstruction. Unlike traditional frame-by-frame emission and delayed geometry recovery, Streaming4D generates temporal video blocks and immediately triggers reconstruction for each completed block, enabling parallel execution between synthesis and geometric updates. This approach allows the world representation to evolve online with the video stream, reducing feedback latency while preserving geometric fidelity. We instantiate \textbf{Streaming4D} using a Self-Forcing-style autoregressive generator and an incremental reconstruction backend. Experiments show consistent runtime improvements across resolutions on a single RTX 4090 (1.24$\times$ speedup), while maintaining high-quality 4D geometry and multi-view consistency.

AI.tldr: Streaming4D 提出一种紧耦合的同步流水线，将分块自回归视频生成与增量式 3D 重建结合，使世界表示随视频流在线演化，在单张 RTX 4090 上获得 1.24× 加速，同时保持 4D 几何与多视角一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有 4D 生成范式采用"先生成视频、再重建 3D"的串行解耦设计，存在高交互延迟，难以满足实时交互场景的需求。
AI.method: 提出 Streaming4D，一种紧耦合的同步流水线：将视频生成划分为时间块（block-wise），采用 Self-Forcing 风格的自回归生成器逐块生成视频，并在每个块完成后立即触发增量式 3D 重建后端，使合成与几何更新并行执行，实现世界表示随视频流在线演化。
AI.result: 在单张 RTX 4090 上，跨分辨率取得一致的运行时间提升（1.24× 加速），同时保持高质量的 4D 几何与多视角一致性。
AI.conclusion: Streaming4D 通过并行化视频合成与增量重建，有效降低 4D 生成的反馈延迟并保持几何保真度，为实时交互式 4D 生成提供了可行的同步流水线方案。

title: Hypotheses-Guided Self Distillation for Continual Personalization
summary: As people increasingly interact with LLM assistants in daily life, continually adapting to individual preferences has become essential for effective long-term interactions. However, user preferences are rarely stated in full, and instead emerge through heterogeneous, latent, and noisy signals, with existing methods relying on raw interaction histories or costly reward-based optimization to manage personalization. We introduce HypReflect, a reliable, scalable framework for continual personalization that infers explicit, uncertainty-aware preference hypotheses from diverse user signals, reflectively refines them as new evidence accumulates, and incorporates the resulting user model through hypotheses-guided self-distillation. Experiments across three personalization settings: online personalization, multi-session interactions, and implicit behavioral signals, show that HypReflect outperforms a range of baselines, including raw-history and incremental-update methods. We further demonstrate strong generalization to unseen users and cross-domain settings, along with stability across context budgets, reusable hypotheses, and more focused personalization. These results suggest a step towards reliable and scalable continual personalization through explicit, revisable user preference hypotheses.

AI.tldr: HypReflect是一个可靠、可扩展的持续个性化框架，从多样化的用户信号中推断显式且具有不确定性感知的偏好假设，随着新证据积累进行反思性修正，并通过假设引导的自蒸馏将用户模型融入LLM，在在线个性化、多会话交互和隐式行为信号三个场景中优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 随着人们日常与LLM助手交互日益增多，持续适应用户个体偏好对长期有效交互至关重要。然而用户偏好很少被完整陈述，而是通过异质、潜在且带噪声的信号浮现出来，现有方法依赖原始交互历史或昂贵的基于奖励的优化来实现个性化，缺乏可靠且可扩展的持续适配方案。
AI.method: HypReflect从多样的用户信号中推断显式、带不确定性感知的偏好假设；随着新证据累积，通过反思机制不断修正这些假设；最终通过假设引导的自蒸馏（hypotheses-guided self-distillation）将所得用户模型整合进生成过程。
AI.result: 在在线个性化、多会话交互和隐式行为信号三个个性化场景中，HypReflect优于一系列基线（包括原始历史方法和增量更新方法）；同时展现出对未见用户和跨域设置的强泛化能力，并在上下文预算、可复用假设及更聚焦的个性化方面保持稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式、可修正的用户偏好假设，HypReflect为可靠且可扩展的持续个性化迈出了一步，证明了以假设驱动的个性化方式在长期、跨用户和跨域场景中的有效性。

title: A Multi-Branch Feature Fusion Approach for Health Misinformation Detection and Propagation
summary: This paper presents a multi-branch fusion framework for detecting and characterising the propagation of health misinformation in online social networks (OSNs). Grounded in the Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM) and the Theory of Planned Behaviour (TPB), the model fuses transformer-based semantics with rhetorical cues, stance representations, and psychologically motivated proxies in a unified multi-task architecture. In addition to binary classification, we introduce the Cognitive Propagation Score (CPS), an interpretable post-hoc auxiliary score computed from psychologically motivated, text-derived cues capturing argument complexity, emotional intensity, and content-derived virality potential, to support diffusion-risk reasoning when engagement ground truth is incomplete or unavailable. Experiments on three benchmark datasets, Constraint, COVID--19\_FNIR, and Monkeypox, show strong classification performance, achieving ROC--AUC up to 0.9999 on COVID--19\_FNIR, while propagation-oriented ranking achieves near-perfect agreement when engagement-derived supervision is available (Monkeypox, Spearman's $ρ= 0.9952$) and similarly high ranking alignment under proxy-based supervision on COVID--19\_FNIR ($ρ= 0.9954$). Compared with representative literature baselines, the fusion model improves detection on Constraint and COVID--19\_FNIR, while Monkeypox remains more challenging, reflecting domain- and signal-specific differences. Ablation analysis further indicates that psychological and rhetorical branches provide complementary gains beyond semantic embeddings. Overall, the framework bridges cognitive theory and neural modelling to improve transparency and to support scalable misinformation monitoring, with future work required to validate CPS against human-centred diffusion judgements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多分支融合框架，基于精细加工可能性模型（ELM）与计划行为理论（TPB），将基于Transformer的语义特征与修辞线索、立场表示及心理动机代理特征统一到多任务架构中，用于检测在线社交网络中的健康错误信息传播。同时提出可解释的认知传播分数（CPS），在缺少参与度真值数据时支持传播风险评估。在Constraint、COVID-19_FNIR和Monkeypox三个基准数据集上取得优异性能（COVID-19_FNIR上ROC-AUC最高达0.9999，传播排名与参与度监督的Spearman ρ达0.9952/0.9954），消融实验表明心理与修辞分支相比纯语义嵌入带来互补增益。
AI.motivation: 在线社交网络中健康错误信息的传播对公共健康构成严重威胁，现有检测方法大多只做二元分类，缺乏对传播风险的可解释评估；同时，当参与度等真实传播信号不完整或不可用时，难以对信息的扩散风险进行推理。作者希望将认知理论（ELM、TPB）与神经建模结合，既提升检测性能，又能为错误信息传播风险提供可解释、可扩展的监控依据。
AI.method: 构建统一的多任务多分支融合框架：融合基于Transformer的语义表示、修辞线索、立场表示以及由心理理论（ELM与TPB）驱动的代理特征；在二元分类之外，提出可解释的事后辅助评分——认知传播分数（CPS），由文本派生的认知线索计算得到，涵盖论证复杂度、情绪强度与内容驱动的病毒式传播潜力，用于在参与度真值缺失时支持扩散风险推理。模型通过多任务学习联合优化。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集（Constraint、COVID-19_FNIR、Monkeypox）上，分类性能优异，COVID-19_FNIR上ROC-AUC最高达0.9999；在可获得参与度监督的Monkeypox上传播排序与真值接近完美一致（Spearman ρ=0.9952），在基于代理监督的COVID-19_FNIR上也达到高排序对齐（ρ=0.9954）。与代表性文献基线相比，在Constraint和COVID-19_FNIR上检测性能提升，而Monkeypox更具挑战性，反映领域与信号差异。消融实验表明心理与修辞分支在语义嵌入之外提供互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功将认知理论（ELM、TPB）与神经多任务建模相结合，在提升健康错误信息检测性能的同时，通过CPS为传播风险提供了可解释且可扩展的推理支持，增强了模型透明性，适用于大规模错误信息监控。未来工作需要以人类中心的扩散判断对CPS进行验证，以进一步确认其有效性。

title: NSIDDx: A Design Framework for Neuro-Symbolic, Practitioner-First Differential Diagnosis in Low-Resource Settings
summary: LLM-based diagnostic systems achieve high semantic accuracy on benchmarks, but open-ended evaluation on clinically uncommon presentations reveals a systematic gap between headline accuracy and verifiable clinical reliability. We evaluate an LLM+rare-disease-RAG pipeline across two cohorts and show that the paradigm produces confident outputs that are frequently unverifiable and systematically resistant to clinician interrogation. We present NSIDDx (Neuro-Symbolic Integrated Differential Diagnosis System), a design framework arguing that DDx systems in low-resource settings must treat the clinician as an active reasoning agent. We instantiate this through a neuro-symbolic pipeline with ternary symptom encoding, contradiction detection, audit strings, and practitioner override - running offline on consumer hardware. We distill five design principles for clinician-in-the-loop clinical NLP and invite the prospective studies needed to validate the claim at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文指出基于LLM的诊断系统在基准测试中语义准确率高，但在临床罕见病例的开放式评估中暴露出"头条准确率"与"可验证临床可靠性"之间的系统性差距。作者提出NSIDDx框架，主张低资源环境下的鉴别诊断系统应将临床医生视为主动推理者，并通过神经符号流水线（三元症状编码、矛盾检测、审计字符串、医生覆盖）实现，可离线运行于消费级硬件，同时提炼出五条临床在环NLP设计原则。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM诊断系统在高语义准确率基准与实际临床可靠性之间存在系统性差距：在临床罕见病例的开放式评估中，LLM+罕见病RAG流水线会产生自信但常常无法验证的输出，且系统性地抵抗临床医生的质询。这一发现表明需要重新设计DDx系统，使其在低资源场景下将临床医生视为主动推理的参与方。
AI.method: 作者在两个队列上评估了LLM+罕见病RAG流水线，进而提出NSIDDx设计框架：一种神经符号流水线，包含三元症状编码、矛盾检测、审计字符串（audit strings）和临床医生覆盖（practitioner override）机制，可在消费级硬件上离线运行。并据此提炼出五条临床医生在环（clinician-in-the-loop）临床NLP设计原则。
AI.result: 评估显示现有范式产生自信但难以验证、且系统性地抵抗临床医生质询的输出；NSIDDx通过神经符号架构（三元编码、矛盾检测、审计与覆盖机制）提供了可验证、可审计的替代设计方案，并在消费级硬件上实现离线部署。
AI.conclusion: 诊断系统不应只追求基准准确率，而应在低资源环境中将临床医生作为主动推理代理纳入系统设计。作者呼吁开展前瞻性研究，以在更大规模上验证NSIDDx框架及临床在环NLP设计原则的有效性。

title: Restrict, Don't Retrain: Inference-Time VLM Guidance for Zero-Shot Aerial Segmentation
summary: Global welfare often depends on the correct interpretation of aerial and satellite imagery. Acting on such imagery (mapping flooded ground, crop extent, or damaged infrastructure) demands pixel-level segmentation to ensure perfect class localization. Pretrained general foundation models, when applied directly, often miss important features and cannot always find all the classes belonging to a given scene, overlooking smaller objects that matter most. We use a single consumer-grade GPU running a vision-language model (VLM) to supply this missing guidance, improving segmentation while producing structured, auditable evidence that drives the result and can be inspected on its own. We fuse three approaches: the frozen foundation model that labels every pixel, and two queries to a VLM, one to choose the classes that matter, and one to locate the small objects the base model misses. Evaluating across four aerial datasets, we see consistent gains at each stage where the base model is competent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用消费级GPU上的视觉语言模型（VLM）为航空/卫星影像分割提供引导的方法：融合一个冻结基础模型的逐像素标注与两次VLM查询（分别用于选择重要类别和定位被遗漏的小目标），在四个航空数据集上取得了一致的性能提升，并生成可审计的结构化证据。
AI.motivation: 全球福祉常依赖于航空与卫星影像的正确解读，而洪水、作物、受损基础设施等应用需要像素级分割以实现精准定位。然而，预训练通用基础模型直接应用时常常遗漏重要特征和小目标，无法覆盖场景中的全部类别，而这恰恰是最关键的物体。
AI.method: 仅使用单块消费级GPU运行VLM以提供缺失的引导信息，融合三种途径：(1) 冻结的基础模型对每个像素进行标注；(2) VLM查询之一用于选择重要类别；(3) VLM查询之二用于定位基础模型遗漏的小物体。由此在改进分割的同时生成结构化、可审计且可独立检查的证据。
AI.result: 在四个航空数据集上的评估表明，在基础模型具备能力的各个阶段，每个环节均带来一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效弥补基础模型在航空影像分割中对小目标与关键类别的遗漏，仅凭消费级GPU即可提升分割性能，并提供可审计证据以支撑结果的可信性与可解释性。

title: The Answer Is Not the Argument
summary: Chain-of-thought monitoring is proposed for AI oversight, yet evaluations often provide monitors with a trusted reference answer. We ask whether answer access improves reasoning verification or mainly exposes incorrect conclusions. We collected 237 step-numbered solutions to 79 Humanity's Last Exam physics questions from three frontier models, with no inserted errors, and independently labelled final-answer correctness and the first false step. The reference standard combined physicist annotations, an independent LLM debate, and source-masked adjudication. This yielded 24 critical traces in which the answer was correct but the trace contained a genuine error. 8 LLM monitors evaluated traces blind, with an unverified or certified answer, or after a blind commitment. Certification raised mean balanced accuracy from 0.637 to 0.796, while exact first-error localization rose from 0.261 to 0.379. Certification changed recall (the fraction of error traces flagged as erroneous) from 0.653 to 0.951 on wrong-answer traces but from 0.521 to 0.438 on critical traces; the contrast had the same direction for all 8 monitors (question-bootstrap 95% CI [+0.256, +0.506]). After blind commitment, monitors shown the answer newly flagged 93.8% of previously passed wrong-answer traces as erroneous, but only 18.0% of critical traces. Answer access therefore improves conclusion-consistency checking rather than independent verification of the supporting argument. For AI safety, these traces provide a benign analogue of reward hacking: an acceptable output does not establish that the process producing it was sound. Although the errors studied here were ordinary and mostly non-load-bearing rather than adversarial, trusted-answer evaluations may similarly overstate monitoring capability when acceptable outputs conceal unsound reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过237个来自三家前沿模型的分步解题轨迹，研究给LLM监测器提供"可信参考答案"是否真正提升推理验证能力。结果发现，参考答案主要改善的是"结论一致性检查"（把错误答案的轨迹判为错误），而非对支撑论证的独立验证：在24条"答案正确但轨迹含真实错误"的关键轨迹上，提供答案反而使召回率从0.521降至0.438。这揭示了"可接受输出并不证明推理过程健全"的安全隐患，类似良性奖励黑客现象。
AI.motivation: 思维链监控被提议用于AI监督，但现有评估常给监控器提供可信参考答案。作者质疑：获得答案是否真正提升了推理验证能力，还是仅仅暴露了错误结论？这关系到监控评估是否可能高估能力，尤其当可接受的输出掩盖了不健全的推理时。
AI.method: 收集3家前沿模型对79道Humanity's Last Exam物理题的237个分步编号解答（无人工注入错误），独立标注最终答案正确性与首个错误步骤。参照标准融合物理学家标注、独立LLM辩论和源遮蔽裁决，得到24条"答案正确但轨迹含真实错误"的关键轨迹。8个LLM监控器在三种条件下评估：盲测、提供未经核验或已认证答案、先盲判再展示答案。
AI.result: 提供认证答案使平均平衡准确率从0.637升至0.796，首个错误精确定位率从0.261升至0.379；但在错误答案轨迹上召回率从0.653升至0.951，而在关键轨迹上却从0.521降至0.438，且8个监控器方向一致（question-bootstrap 95% CI [+0.256, +0.506]）。盲判后看到答案时，93.8%的被漏判错误答案轨迹被重新标记为错误，但关键轨迹仅18.0%被重新标记。
AI.conclusion: 参考答案提升的是结论一致性检查而非对支撑论证的独立验证。这些关键轨迹提供了奖励黑客的良性类比：可接受的输出并不能证明产生它的过程健全。虽然本研究中的错误是普通且大多非承重的，但可信答案式评估在"可接受输出掩盖不健全推理"时可能同样高估监控能力，对AI安全具有警示意义。

title: How Temporal Correlations Shape Memory in Linear Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: The linear recurrent neural network (LRNN) is a simple model for studying how much memory a network builds up as it trains. For uncorrelated inputs, earlier work found that training itself settles the network between keeping the past and reacting only to the present. Real sequences are correlated, and we solve the learning dynamics exactly for correlated inputs. In the solution, keeping the past carries a cost. The whole effect of correlation lands on that cost. This cost reduces to the earlier one when inputs are uncorrelated and grows once they are positively correlated. Three findings follow. (1) Correlation reshapes the course of learning, not only its end. Memory builds, overshoots, and is partly removed, and the settled network keeps less of the past. (2) Memory switches off at a threshold set by one number, how much each input resembles the one just before it. Neither sequence length nor longer-range correlation moves this threshold. Memory is worth keeping only when the task needs the previous input more than the current input already supplies it through correlation with the past. (3) The best network changes too. Zero error demands a feedthrough, a path that passes the current input straight to the network's output and remembers nothing, and training builds it unprompted when given one spare hidden dimension. Our work turns one property of the input into a prediction of whether a network learns memory and explains why correlated data turns recurrent networks into change detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文精确求解了线性循环神经网络（LRNN）在相关输入下的学习动力学，发现相关性会为"保留过去"的记忆行为引入一项代价；该代价在输入不相关时退化为已有结果，在正相关时增大。由此得出三个结论：相关性不仅改变学习终点也重塑学习轨迹（记忆先建立、过冲再部分移除）；记忆在由"相邻输入相似度"这一单一阈值处开关，与序列长度和长程相关无关；最优网络会自发构建直通路径（feedthrough）以实现零误差，解释了为何相关数据使循环网络变成变化检测器。
AI.motivation: 已有研究针对不相关输入发现，训练会使线性循环网络在"记住过去"与"只对当前作出反应"之间达到平衡。但真实序列通常具有相关性，而相关输入下网络学习动力学的确切行为此前未知，因此作者希望探究相关性如何影响记忆的建立与消除。
AI.method: 作者对相关输入下的线性循环网络学习动力学进行了精确解析求解。核心做法是把输入相关性的全部效应归结为"保留过去的代价"这一项，并与不相关情形对照，从而推导网络记忆随训练演化的闭式行为及最优网络的变迁。
AI.result: 得到三项主要结果：(1) 相关性重塑学习轨迹——记忆先建立、过冲后被部分移除，最终网络保留更少的过去；(2) 记忆在由"相邻输入相似度"这一单一数值决定的阈值处关闭，序列长度与长程相关都不改变该阈值，记忆仅在任务需要的上一个输入超过当前输入经由相关性已经提供的信息时才值得保留；(3) 最优网络发生改变——零误差要求一条把当前输入直接送到输出的直通路径，训练在获得一个额外隐藏维时会自发构建它。据此可以把输入的单一属性转化为网络是否会学习记忆的预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将输入相关性这一性质转化为对网络是否学到记忆的定量预测，并解释了为何相关数据会把循环网络塑造为变化检测器，为理解循环网络在真实（相关）数据上的记忆行为提供了理论依据。

title: Slow to See, Slow to Suppress: Understanding the Effects of Modality in Context-Memory Conflicts
comment: Accepted to EMNLP Findings 2026. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/aparaselli/slow-to-see-slow-to-suppress
summary: We investigate how vision-language models (VLMs) handle context-memory conflicts; that is, situations in which the model is given information in context that differs from what was stored parametrically during training. We document asymmetric biases: models tend to prefer in-context information about entities which appear in text, but prefer parametric information about entities which appear in images. We relate this asymmetry to the late representational alignment across modalities, showing that the longer processing time associated with resolving visual entities prevents the suppression of the model's usual factual recall mechanism, thus resulting in more parametric answers. Chain-of-thought reasoning does not appear to resolve the gap, but increasing the amount of visual information in the context does show an effect. These results illustrate the complexity of ensuring consistent behavior as models become increasingly multimodal and retrieval-augmented.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉-语言模型（VLM）在处理上下文与参数记忆冲突时的行为，发现非对称性偏差：模型对文本实体更倾向于采用上下文信息，而对图像实体更倾向于采用参数化知识。该偏差源于跨模态的表征对齐较晚，视觉实体的处理耗时长，阻碍了事实回忆机制的抑制。思维链推理无法消除该差距，但增加上下文中的视觉信息量有一定效果。
AI.motivation: 随着多模态模型和检索增强技术的普及，模型经常面临上下文中提供的信息与训练时存储的参数化知识不一致的情况（即上下文-记忆冲突）。理解模型在这种冲突下如何抉择，对于保证模型行为的一致性和可靠性至关重要，但目前对此类冲突中跨模态的不对称行为缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 作者设计实验对比VLM在文本实体与图像实体情境下对冲突信息的处理：系统性地考察上下文信息与参数记忆冲突时模型的回答倾向，并进一步将这种非对称偏差与跨模态表征对齐的时序联系起来；同时检验了思维链推理以及上下文视觉信息量增加对偏差的影响。
AI.result: 发现三项关键结果：（1）模型存在非对称偏差——文本中的实体倾向采用上下文信息，图像中的实体倾向采用参数化信息；（2）该偏差与跨模态表征的晚期对齐有关，视觉实体的处理时间更长，抑制了模型惯常事实回忆机制的启动，从而导致更多参数化回答；（3）思维链推理不能消除该差距，而增加上下文视觉信息量则能产生影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了VLM在上下文-记忆冲突中跨模态的非对称行为及其机制根源，说明晚期模态对齐带来的时序差异是导致行为不一致的重要原因。这凸显了随着模型日益多模态化和检索增强化，确保其行为一致性的复杂性，并为后续改进多模态模型的可控性与可靠性提供了方向。

title: Beyond Landmark Extraction: A Framework for Robust Geometric Feature Construction in Structured Image Classification
comment: Under consideration at Pattern Recognition Letters
summary: Much of the literature on structured image recognition has disproportionately focused on the comparison of classification algorithms. Rather than investigating which classifier performs best, this paper instead asks: what should a classifier know before it ever makes a prediction? In structured vision problems such as gesture recognition, facial expression categorization, and medical image analysis, discriminative information lies less in individual pixels and more in spatial relationships between semantic parts. Raw pixel spaces are high-dimensional, sensitive to nuisance variation, and often obfuscate the geometric structures that make visual tasks interpretable. Landmark extraction provides one form of dimension reduction, but it does not by itself determine the information preserved. This paper studies the post-landmark feature map as the central object of analysis and proposes a systematic framework for constructing and interpreting landmark-derived representations as an, informed, feature-based "dimension reduction" step. Using static hand gesture recognition as a case study, we evaluate coordinate, distance, angle, and hybrid representations through perturbation and ablation experiments. The results show that visually variable data exposes substantial gaps between raw coordinate features and their geometrically invariant counterparts, while hybrid representations achieve the strongest overall performance by combining complementary geometric components. These findings frame feature construction as a fundamental modeling decision and ultimately suggests that the question of what representation should a classifier learn from is one worth asking. The code used for feature construction and evaluation is available at https://github.com/ShivMaureeCWRU/Feature_based_dimension_reduction

AI.tldr: 本文提出将"特征构建"而非"分类器选择"作为结构化图像识别（如手势识别、表情分类、医学图像分析）中的核心建模决策，并以静态手势识别为案例，系统地构建和评估基于关键点（landmark）的坐标、距离、角度及混合表示，发现几何不变特征显著优于原始坐标，混合表示性能最佳。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化图像识别研究过度集中于分类算法的比较，而忽视了"分类器在做出预测之前应该知道什么"这一前提问题。在姿态识别、面部表情分类和医学图像分析等任务中，判别性信息主要存在于语义部件之间的空间关系而非单个像素；原始像素空间维度高、对干扰变化敏感，且会掩盖几何结构。关键点提取虽提供了降维手段，但并未决定保留何种信息，因此需要系统研究后关键点特征映射的构建与解释。
AI.method: 将后关键点特征映射作为分析的核心对象，提出一个系统的框架来构建和解释基于关键点的表示，将其作为一种"有依据的特征化降维"步骤。以静态手势识别为案例，构建坐标、距离、角度及混合（hybrid）四类表示，并通过扰动（perturbation）与消融（ablation）实验进行系统评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：在视觉可变性较高的数据上，原始坐标特征与几何不变特征之间存在显著差距；混合表示通过组合互补的几何组件取得了最强的整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 特征构建应被视为一项基础性的建模决策，"分类器应该从何种表示中学习"这一问题值得认真对待。研究成果为基于关键点的特征降维提供了系统性方法与实证证据，相关代码已开源。

title: Autoresearch for Marketplace Catalogs: From Legacy Forms to AI-Native Matching
summary: Two-sided service marketplaces are moving from deterministic request-form intake to AI-native probabilistic matching, enabled by large language models (LLMs) that infer intent, preferences, and latent constraints from natural language. Relying on inferred intent rather than fixed-form fields forces these platforms to regenerate the provider-side preference taxonomy underwriting matching, search, and pricing: attributes interpretable to service providers while remaining a useful signal for marketplace decisions. We present an autoresearch loop that generates this taxonomy, one occupation at a time, and has been deployed in production at a major U.S. consumer services marketplace since April 2026, spanning 132 occupations. Instead of one global hierarchy, the loop treats each occupation as an independent generation problem and runs iterative propose-evaluate-keep refinement cycles. Each candidate tag set is scored by a recalibrated six-rubric LLM-as-judge framework, and a 7-critic panel of distinct personas contributes weighted penalties to an adjusted score, with no hard vetoes. A separate parity-mapping stage maps legacy request-form Q&A pairs back to the generated taxonomy, yielding both a coverage signal and an interface for human quality assurance; it does so by first inferring the provider attribute each legacy question was meant to measure, rather than translating questions to tags literally.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向双边服务市场的"自动研究循环"（autoresearch loop），借助大语言模型按职业逐个生成服务提供方偏好分类体系（taxonomy），并以迭代式"提出-评估-保留"优化、六准则LLM裁判评分与七角色评审团加权惩罚、以及遗留表单问答的平价映射（parity-mapping）共同支撑生产部署；该系统已在美国某大型消费服务市场覆盖132个职业。
AI.motivation: 双边服务市场正从确定性的表单式需求录入转向基于大语言模型的AI原生概率匹配，依靠从自然语言中推断意图、偏好与潜在约束。由于不再依赖固定表单字段，平台必须重新生成用于匹配、搜索和定价的服务提供方偏好分类体系——该分类既要对服务提供方可解释，又必须对平台决策保持有价值的信息量。这一需求催生了按职业自动生成分类学的方法。
AI.method: 作者提出一个自动研究循环，将一个职业视为独立的生成问题，运行迭代的"提出-评估-保留"（propose-evaluate-keep）优化周期。每个候选标签集由重新校准的六准则LLM-as-judge框架打分，并由7位具有不同人格角色的评审团对调整后得分进行加权惩罚（无硬性否决）。此外，单独的平价映射阶段将遗留表单的Q&A对映射回生成后的分类体系，方法是先推断每个遗留问题原本要衡量的提供方属性，而非将问题逐字翻译为标签，从而同时得到覆盖信号和人工质量保证接口。
AI.result: 该系统已在美国一家主要消费服务市场投入生产（自2026年4月起），覆盖132个职业；平价映射阶段既提供了覆盖率信号，也为人工质量保证提供了交互界面。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，将每个职业作为独立生成问题、而非构建单一全局层级，结合多角色无否决的评审机制和"按意图映射而非字面翻译"的平价映射，能够在真实生产环境中可靠地生成并提供可解释、可保证质量的提供方偏好分类体系，支撑AI原生的概率匹配。

title: Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization
summary:
Group relative policy optimization for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically uses a fixed importance-sampling (IS) ratio clipping boundary across all rollouts. We identify a key limitation: rare correct rollouts on harder problems and abundant correct rollouts on easier problems are clipped at comparable rates, despite contributing very different learning signals. Rollouts with low group success exhibit larger IS ratios and carry stronger gradient signal for exploration and solving new problems, yet are disproportionately suppressed by fixed clipping.
  To address this, we propose Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization (GAPO), a plug-in modification to GRPO methods that adapts the clipping boundary to the rollout advantage. GAPO is motivated by a reverse-KL trust-region perspective, which suggests that rollouts with larger learning signal should receive proportionally greater update headroom. GAPO requires no reward shaping and preserves the standard PPO/GSPO surrogate while adapting only the clipping threshold. Across Qwen and Llama models, GAPO consistently improves both Pass@1 and Pass@k over fixed clipping and advantage-shaping baselines on math reasoning and coding benchmarks where the pass rates by the base model are relatively low.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAPO（组自适应裁剪策略优化），针对GRPO/RLVR中固定重要性采样（IS）比率裁剪边界的问题，根据rollout的优势动态调整裁剪阈值，使学习信号更强的角色获得更大的更新空间，从而在不引入奖励塑形的前提下提升数学推理与代码生成任务的Pass@1和Pass@k。
AI.motivation: RLVR中的GRPO类方法通常对所有rollout使用固定的IS比率裁剪边界，但困难问题上稀有的正确rollout与简单问题上大量出现的正确rollout被以相近的比率裁剪，尽管它们携带的学习信号截然不同。低组成功率（group success）的rollout具有更大的IS比率和更强的梯度信号，对探索与解决新问题至关重要，却被固定裁剪不成比例地抑制。
AI.method: 提出GAPO，作为GRPO方法的即插即用修改，将裁剪边界自适应地调整为rollout优势的函数。GAPO由逆向KL置信域视角启发，认为学习信号更大的rollout应获得成比例的更大更新空间。它不需要奖励塑形，保留标准PPO/GSPO代理目标，仅调整裁剪阈值。
AI.result: 在Qwen和Llama系列模型上，GAPO相比固定裁剪和优势塑形基线，在基础模型通过率相对较低的数学推理与代码生成基准上一致地提升了Pass@1和Pass@k。
AI.conclusion: 固定IS裁剪边界会压制高价值（低组成功率、大IS比率）的rollout，GAPO通过按优势自适应调整裁剪边界，在标准代理目标下为高信号rollout提供更大的更新空间，从而更有效地利用探索性样本并提升下游性能。

title: Toward Workflow-Aware Benchmarking for Healthcare NLP Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed for healthcare tasks such as clinical documentation, evidence retrieval, patient messaging, and care coordination. Yet many evaluations remain limited to static medical question answering or one-shot generation, under-representing longitudinal state, interruptions, and human handoffs. We introduce an episode-level evaluation protocol for healthcare NLP agents. The protocol separates evidence across model, agent, and simulated-workflow behavior; specifies a five-field episode schema; and defines annotation and scoring for state continuity, evidence traceability, and escalation decisions. It is instantiated as four task templates: documentation update, evidence retrieval, patient messaging, and triage handoff. The protocol does not claim to measure clinical outcomes or deployment value. Instead, it supplies a reproducible intermediate evaluation layer between static benchmarks and prospective workflow studies, with an explicit cost-sensitive treatment of missed versus unnecessary escalation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向医疗保健 NLP 智能体的“情节级”（episode-level）评估协议，用以弥补静态问答与一次性生成评估的不足。该协议将证据按模型、智能体与模拟工作流行为分层，定义五字段情节模式及状态连续性、证据可追溯性、升级决策的标注与评分规则，并以文档更新、证据检索、患者消息与分诊交接四个任务模板实例化，在静态基准与前瞻性工作流研究之间提供可复现的中间评估层。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体正越来越多地被应用于临床文档、证据检索、患者消息和护理协调等医疗任务，但现有评估大多局限于静态医学问答或一次性生成，未能充分体现纵向状态、交互打断以及人工交接等真实工作流特征，因此缺乏能够刻画这些动态行为的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建情节级评估协议：将证据按模型层、智能体层和模拟工作流行为层分离；规定一个五字段情节模式；定义针对状态连续性、证据可追溯性和升级决策的标注与评分方法，并对遗漏升级与不必要升级采用显式成本敏感的权衡处理；最终以四个任务模板（文档更新、证据检索、患者消息、分诊交接）完成实例化。
AI.result: 协议成功实例化为四个任务模板，能够作为介于静态基准与前瞻性工作流研究之间的可复现中间评估层，提供可操作、可复现的评估框架，并系统区分了不同类型升级错误的成本。
AI.conclusion: 该协议并不声称衡量临床结局或部署价值，其定位是补充性的中间评估层，旨在为医疗 NLP 智能体提供可复现、标准化的动态评估手段，为后续工作流研究奠定基础。

title: You Cannot Photograph the Same Street Twice: Reliability Limits in Vision-Language Measurement of Urban Change
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used to measure urban change from repeated street-level imagery, but their longitudinal reliability is not well understood. We test how much a perception score can change when the street itself does not undergo substantial redevelopment. Using 4,648 consecutive-epoch image pairs from 435 Google Street View standpoints across five US cities, we find that re-photographing the same street changes a perception score by 0.80 points on average, equivalent to 66.5% of the difference between two different streets in the same city. Repeated model calls contribute almost no variation, while image re-encoding and prompt-order changes each account for about one fifth of the between-street difference. Six image statistics describing scattering, contrast, colour, exposure, sharpness and specularity explain almost none of the remaining epoch-to-epoch variation. A small systematic drift of about 0.1 points remains and increases with the interval between captures, consistent with minor physical changes not recorded by redevelopment labels. Controlled experiments further show that acquisition conditions can shift scores when camera and image properties are allowed to vary, and that the direction of these shifts depends on the model. In crowdsourced imagery, camera geometry alone causes a model to report physical change in 45% of identical-scene pairs; normalising both images to a common virtual camera reduces this rate to 7.5%. Despite poor reliability at the individual-location level, aggregation recovers a coherent redevelopment signal: changed streets are judged wealthier, better maintained, more enclosed and less green. These results show that vision-language measurement of urban change is reliable at the scale of hundreds of paired observations, but not at the scale of individual sample points.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了视觉语言模型在重复街景图像中测量城市变化的纵向可靠性。利用来自美国五座城市435个Google街景视角的4,648对连续时期图像，发现重新拍摄同一街道会使感知评分平均变化0.80分，相当于同城两条不同街道差异的66.5%；重复模型调用几乎无波动，而图像重新编码和提示词顺序变化各占街道间差异约五分之一。在个体点位层面可靠性差，但聚合数百个配对观测后能恢复出一致的再开发信号。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型日益被用于从重复街景图像测量城市变化，但其纵向可靠性尚未被充分理解。研究旨在检验当街道本身没有经历实质性再开发时，感知评分会发生多大变化，从而明确这类测量在何种尺度上可信。
AI.method: 使用美国五座城市435个Google街景视角的4,648对连续时期图像，量化"重拍同一街道"时的感知评分波动；对比重复模型调用、图像重新编码和提示词顺序变化的贡献；用六种图像统计量（散射、对比度、颜色、曝光、清晰度、镜面反射）解释剩余变异；检测随拍摄间隔增长的系统漂移；并开展受控实验：改变相机与图像属性观察评分漂移方向，以及用虚拟相机归一化处理众包图像中的相机几何效应。
AI.result: 重拍同一街道使感知评分平均改变0.80分，相当于同城两街差异的66.5%；重复模型调用几乎无变异，图像重新编码与提示词顺序各约占街道间差异的五分之一；六种图像统计量几乎无法解释剩余变异；存在约0.1分的系统漂移且随拍摄间隔增大。受控实验显示采集条件可移动评分且方向取决于模型；众包图像中仅相机几何就导致模型在45%的相同场景对中报告物理变化，归一化到虚拟相机后降至7.5%。聚合层面能恢复出一致信号：变化街道被判定为更富裕、维护更好、更封闭且更少绿色。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型对城市变化的测量在数百个配对观测的聚合尺度上是可靠的，但在单个样本点尺度上不可靠；评估者应避免基于单个点位或少量样本做推断，而应依赖大规模聚合，并注意相机几何等采集条件的系统性影响。

title: The Irreversibility Budget: Fleet-Level Risk Accounting and Admission Control for Agent Operating Systems
summary: Fleets of LLM agents now externalize effects that cannot be fully undone: they move money, deploy code, delete data, and disclose information. Current controls check one effect at a time, so a fleet of individually authorized agents can overdraw its principal's risk under a shared trigger while every local gate stays correct. We propose the irreversibility budget, a cumulative account of residual value-at-risk that a trusted runtime maintains for each principal across agents, workflows, and tenants. Treating irreversibility as a first-class resource, the runtime charges each effect its residual loss below the agent and denies the marginal effect once the aggregate would overdraw the budget. Getting the price right is hard, because effects are heterogeneous, adversarially declared, and correlated. We perform a controlled study in which per-effect gates admit fleet-level overdraws of up to 48 times the tenant's risk limit while the budget holds every correctly charged run within that limit. Conservative, dependency-aware pricing remains the central open problem for a deployable design.

AI.tldr: 提出“不可逆性预算”（irreversibility budget）机制：由可信运行时为每个主体跨代理、工作流、租户维护一个累积的剩余风险价值账户，将不可逆性视为一等资源，对每个效果按其剩余损失收费，并在聚合超支时拒绝边际效果，以防范代理舰队在逐门检查正确的情况下仍导致的整体超支。
AI.motivation: LLM代理舰队现在会执行无法完全撤销的外部效果（转账、部署代码、删除数据、泄露信息）。现有控制机制逐个检查效果（per-effect gates），导致即使每个局部门都正确，舰队在共享触发条件下也能使主体的风险超出其限额。因此需要一种能跨代理、跨工作流、跨租户进行全局累计的风险控制手段。
AI.method: 将不可逆性作为一等资源进行计量与定价：可信运行时为每个主体维护一个“不可逆性预算”账户（累计的残余风险价值）；每个效果按其残余损失（低于代理层面的剩余损失）收费；当聚合效果会透支预算时拒绝该边际效果。论文还开展了受控实验研究，并指出合理定价面临的三大难点：效果异构、对抗性声明、效果间相关性。
AI.result: 受控研究表明，逐效果门控（per-effect gates）在租户风险限额下会出现高达48倍的舰队级超支；而预算机制在每次正确收费的情况下都能将所有运行控制在限额之内。但保守且考虑依赖关系的定价仍是实现可部署方案的核心开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 不可逆性预算提供了一个概念上简洁且经验上有效的全局风险控制范式，能弥补逐效果门控的聚合漏洞；然而其实际可用性取决于能否解决异构、对抗性与相关性下的保守依赖感知定价问题，这是未来部署的关键研究方向。

title: CRAD: Class-wise Reliability-Aware Distillation for Decentralized Heterogeneous Federated Learning
summary: Conventional federated learning (FL) relies on parameter averaging, which forces clients to be doubly homogeneous: it demands an identical architecture and degrades under non-IID data. Real-world deployments usually break both assumptions. We sidestep both by building a decentralized knowledge distillation framework in which each client evaluates its peers' model snapshots on its own local data and distills from the resulting soft predictions. Because knowledge is transferred through the shared class posterior, clients are free to run different architectures; and because every teacher is evaluated on the student's own device, raw data never leaves the client, with no central server or public dataset required. Within this setting, we identify and address an under-examined problem: how to combine the peer teacher predictions. Existing methods, like uniform averaging, ignore how knowledge reliability varies across teachers and classes. We propose Class-wise Reliability-Aware Distillation (CRAD), which, per class, first discards teachers that disagree with the peer consensus and then takes a weighted average of the rest, weighting each teacher by its per-class reliability (precision, or inverse variance). Since the variance of an accuracy from $n$ samples scales as $1/n$, support enters automatically: among the teachers that survive filtering, a teacher is trusted for a class to the degree that it is both accurate and well-evidenced for it. On three image-classification benchmarks (CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and PathMNIST colon pathology), across heterogeneous architectures under severe non-IID skew, CRAD consistently outperforms competing methods in global accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种去中心化知识蒸馏的联邦学习框架，客户端在本地数据上评估同伴教师的软预测以传递知识，从而同时摆脱模型架构同质化和非IID数据两大限制；并针对教师预测的融合问题提出逐类可靠性感知蒸馏（CRAD），先剔除与同伴共识不一致的教师，再按每类的可靠性（精确率/逆方差）加权聚合，在三个图像分类基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦学习依赖参数平均，要求客户端架构一致（同构）且会在非IID数据下性能退化，而真实场景往往同时违反这两个假设。现有去中心化蒸馏方法在融合多个同伴教师预测时简单采用均匀平均，忽视了不同教师、不同类别间知识可靠性的差异。
AI.method: 构建去中心化知识蒸馏框架：每个客户端在自身本地数据上评估同伴的模型快照，并从其软预测中蒸馏知识，通过共享的类别后验传递知识，因此允许异构架构、原始数据不出设备、无需中心服务器或公共数据集。在该框架下提出CRAD：对每个类别，先剔除与同伴共识不一致的教师，再对剩余教师按逐类可靠性（精确率或逆方差）加权平均；由于n个样本下准确率的方差按1/n缩放，样本支持度自动进入权重，使教师仅在其既有准确度又有充分证据的类别上被信任。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和PathMNIST结肠病理三个图像分类基准上，在异构架构与严重非IID数据倾斜条件下，CRAD在全局准确率上一致优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化知识蒸馏能够同时绕开架构同质化和非IID数据两个约束，而逐类可靠性感知的教师融合（CRAD）比均匀平均更有效地利用同伴知识，为异构、隐私受限的实际联邦学习部署提供了更稳健的方案。

title: Emotional Labor Strategy Preferences in LLM Personas
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Emotional labor is the effortful management of emotional displays to meet social or professional expectations. Personality traits have been correlated with emotional labor strategies, yet research on this link relies almost exclusively on self-report scales administered only in occupational settings. We investigate whether large language models injected with psychometrically grounded personas reproduce these personality-driven selection patterns across everyday social scenarios. We construct the first emotional labor strategy dataset of 500 socially situated events, each offering three behavioral choices corresponding to surface acting, deep acting, and genuine expression. We source 50 fictional characters from a large-scale personality repository and profile each through two parallel tracks: observer-rated bipolar adjective composites and in-character self-report items. Five LLMs evaluate all scenarios under both persona conditions.
