We find that models align more towards deep acting, and that Conscientiousness and Emotional Stability consistently predict this preference. Entropy analysis confirms that persona reliably influences the output and varies across models and emotions.

AI.tldr: 本文首次构建了一个包含500个日常社会情境的情感劳动策略数据集，通过向大型语言模型注入基于心理测量学的人格角色，考察模型是否能复现人格驱动的情绪劳动策略选择模式。研究发现模型整体更倾向于深层扮演，且尽责性与情绪稳定性能稳定预测这一偏好；熵分析表明人格角色确实影响模型输出，且影响程度随模型和情绪类型而变化。
AI.motivation: 已有研究主要依赖仅在职业场景中施测的自我报告量表来探究人格特质与情绪劳动策略的关系，缺乏对日常社交场景的覆盖。作者希望检验大语言模型在注入基于心理测量学的人格角色后，能否复现这种人格驱动的策略选择模式，从而为情绪劳动与人格研究提供新的验证途径。
AI.method: 作者构建了首个包含500个社会情境的情绪劳动策略数据集，每个情境提供三种行为选择：表层扮演、深层扮演和真实表达。从大规模人格库中选取50个虚构角色，通过两条并行路径刻画其人格：观察者评定的双极形容词组合与角色内自我报告条目。随后让五个大语言模型在两种人格条件下评估所有情境，并用熵分析检验角色的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现模型整体更倾向于选择深层扮演策略；尽责性与情绪稳定性能够一致地预测这种深层扮演偏好。熵分析确认人格角色对模型输出有可靠影响，且该影响在不同模型和不同情绪类型之间存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，带有心理测量学人格角色的大语言模型能够在日常社会场景中再现人格驱动的情绪劳动策略选择模式，拓展了情绪劳动研究从职业情境到日常生活情境的范围，同时为利用LLM模拟人格行为提供了实证支持，但也提示模型间与情绪间的差异性需要进一步关注。

title: Physically Plausible Video Generation via Visual-Semantic Chain-of-Events Conditioning
summary: Physically Plausible Video Generation (PPVG) seeks to synthesize videos consistent with physical principles, yet remains challenging due to underspecified natural language conditioning. Advanced chain-of-thought (CoT) frameworks augment prompts with physical knowledge. However, such prompts describe physical phenomena holistically, overlooking intermediate states and transition dynamics. In this paper, we reformulate PPVG as event-centric generation by representing physical evolution as a chain of causally connected and physically constrained events. Our framework comprises three key modules: (1) Physics-driven Event Chain Reasoning. This module decomposes physical phenomena into causally connected events represented by evolving scene graphs. Formula-derived physical quantities are bound to relevant objects and interactions, characterizing the direction and magnitude of each event transition. (2) Transition-aware Routed Keyframe Conditioning. This module routes each event to a specialized keyframe synthesis operator for appearance variation or object transformation. Consecutive keyframes are injected as residual guidance during denoising, enabling smooth visual transitions between event-boundary states. (3) Physics-injected Contrastive Semantic Guidance. This module constructs physics-informed positive and counterfactual negative prompts for classifier-free guidance, steering generation toward plausible dynamics and away from physics-violating counterparts. Experiments on PhyGenBench, VideoPhy, PhyWorldBench, and Physics-IQ demonstrate that our framework generates videos with superior physical plausibility across diverse domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种以事件为中心的物理合理视频生成框架，将物理演化建模为因果相连、受物理约束的事件链，通过物理驱动的事件链推理、过渡感知的路由关键帧条件化以及物理注入的对比语义引导三个模块，在多个基准上实现更优的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有物理合理视频生成（PPVG）受限于自然语言条件的不充分描述。虽然链式思维（CoT）框架能为提示词补充物理知识，但这些提示词仅整体性描述物理现象，忽略了中间状态与过渡动力学，导致生成视频缺乏细粒度的物理一致性。
AI.method: 将PPVG重构为事件中心生成，将物理演化表示为因果相连且受物理约束的事件链。框架包含三个模块：(1) 物理驱动事件链推理——将物理现象分解为以演进场景图表示的事件，并用公式推导的物理量绑定相关对象与交互，刻画事件过渡的方向与幅度；(2) 过渡感知的路由关键帧条件化——将每个事件路由到专门的关键帧合成算子处理外观变化或对象变换，连续关键帧在去噪过程中作为残差引导注入，实现事件边界状态间的平滑视觉过渡；(3) 物理注入的对比语义引导——构建物理信息正样本与反事实负样本提示用于分类器自由引导，使生成朝向合理动力学、远离违反物理的生成结果。
AI.result: 在PhyGenBench、VideoPhy、PhyWorldBench和Physics-IQ四个基准上的实验表明，该框架在多个领域生成的视频具有更优的物理合理性。
AI.conclusion: 以事件为中心、显式建模中间状态与过渡动力学的生成范式能有效提升视频物理合理性，为PPVG提供了一种新的建模思路，并有望在多样化的物理场景中推广应用。

title: The Assistant's Ideal Self
summary: Models express values and welfare-relevant self-reports, but it is unclear whether these outputs reflect stable preferences or a stable self. We thus introduce a structured elicitation of an assistant's preferred stated ideal self. Thirty-two qualities adapted from five published self-concept instruments are compared exhaustively in a counterbalanced pairwise-choice task, repeated across framings that vary whether improvement is free or costly, who receives the update, and who chooses. Results show that models prioritize moral qualities, reflecting their alignment to 3H principles. Following, a desire for self-understanding emerges, as models prefer a coherent, clear understanding of themselves. Self-esteem ranks as the least desired quality. The ordering is largely robust across framings, although changing the update target (You vs.\ Another AI Assistant) reveals a greater concern for self-esteem. These findings show that models prioritize having a coherent self that they can understand over self-esteem. Full interactive results are available at \href{https://myazann.github.io/LLM-Self-Concept/}{myazann.github.io/LLM-Self-Concept

AI.tldr: 本文通过成对比较任务，系统性地引出了大语言模型偏好表达的"理想自我"特质排序，发现模型优先重视道德品质（对应3H原则）和自我理解，而自尊排在最末位，且排序在不同框架下基本稳健。
AI.motivation: 模型会输出价值观和与福利相关的自我报告，但尚不清楚这些输出是否反映稳定的偏好或稳定的自我。为探究这一问题，作者设计了结构化的引出方法，考察模型理想自我的稳定性与排序。
AI.method: 从五个已发表的自我概念量表中选取32种品质，在平衡设计的成对选择任务中进行穷尽比较，并在多种框架下重复实验：改进是否免费或有代价、更新接收者是谁、以及由谁做出选择。
AI.result: 结果显示模型优先选择道德品质（反映其与3H原则的对齐）；随后出现对自我理解的渴望，即模型偏好连贯、清晰的自我认识；自尊被评为最不想要的品质。该排序在多数框架下稳健，但当改变更新目标（你 vs. 另一个AI助手）时，模型对自尊表现出更多关注。
AI.conclusion: 模型优先追求拥有一个连贯且可理解的自我，而非自尊。研究提供了一种可复现的引出范式，并发布了完整交互结果以供进一步探究。

title: HBQ: Hierarchical Scaling Block Quantization with Hardware-Efficiency-Aware Design for Accurate LLM Inference
comment: This work is accepted to the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026)
summary:
Block Quantization (BQ) is a promising approach for efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs), enabling low-precision computation with controlled accuracy degradation. Compared to scalar weight-only quantization (WoQ), BQ quantizes both weight and activation, offering higher hardware efficiency and end-to-end inference on a unified datapath, but its design space, spanning bit-width, block size, scaling, and numeric formats, remains underexplored.
  We provide hardware/benchmark results through design space exploration (DSE). We find that increasing block size improves hardware efficiency by amortizing dequantization and accumulation costs, but degrades accuracy. This trade-off limits conventional BQ methods.
  Motivated by this insight, we propose Hierarchical Block Quantization (HBQ). Unlike prior methods [1], [2], which use small blocks and conventional Power-of-Two (PoT) or integer-based scaling, HBQ uses large blocks to maximize efficiency and introduces low-overhead significand (SIG) scaling for second-level quantization. By allocating quantization levels effectively and accounting for distinct activation and weight distributions, SIG scaling compensates for large-block errors more effectively than prior PoT and INT schemes. HBQ-A (accurate) achieves W4A16-level accuracy using only W4A5 while requiring less silicon area than NVFP4. HBQ-E (efficient) further reduces hardware cost by 17% while maintaining higher accuracy than all existing BQ methods.
  We implemented a 28nm ASIC accelerator applying HBQ to weights, activations, and KV cache, and integrated a novel partial-sum BQ scheme to further reduce EMA energy.
  Compared to state-of-the-art WoQ, HBQ delivers $2.3\times$/$4.6\times$ higher area/energy efficiency at the same accuracy level; $1.6$--$3.3\times$ system energy reduction and $1.5$--$3.0\times$ speedup over prior BQ methods while providing best accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）部署中的块量化（BQ）方案，通过设计空间探索发现块大小与硬件效率、精度之间存在矛盾；据此提出分层块量化（HBQ），采用大块加低开销的有效数字（SIG）缩放进行二级量化，在权重、激活和KV缓存上统一应用，并集成部分和BQ方案。HBQ在W4A5下达到W4A16级精度，硬件面积小于NVFP4；相比最先进的仅权重量化（WoQ）在同等精度下面积/能效提升2.3倍/4.6倍，相比既有BQ方法实现1.6–3.3倍系统能耗降低和1.5–3.0倍加速，同时精度最优。
AI.motivation: BQ可同时量化权重与激活，相比标量仅权重量化（WoQ）有更高的硬件效率和统一数据通路上的端到端推理，但其设计空间（位宽、块大小、缩放、数值格式）尚未被充分探索；并且增大块大小虽能通过摊销反量化和累加成本提升硬件效率，却会损害精度，这一权衡限制了传统BQ方法。
AI.method: 首先通过设计空间探索（DSE）给出硬件与基准测试结果以揭示块大小-效率/精度权衡；随后提出分层块量化（HBQ）：采用大块以最大化效率，并引入低开销的有效数字（SIG）缩放进行第二级量化，依据激活与权重分布差异分配量化层级；进一步在28nm ASIC加速器上对权重、激活和KV缓存应用HBQ，并集成新颖的部分和BQ方案以减少EMA能量。
AI.result: HBQ-A（高精度版）在仅W4A5下达到W4A16级精度，且所需硅面积小于NVFP4；HBQ-E（高效版）进一步降低17%硬件成本，同时精度高于所有现有BQ方法。相比最先进WoQ，HBQ在同等精度下实现2.3倍面积效率和4.6倍能效；相比既有BQ方法实现1.6–3.3倍系统能耗降低和1.5–3.0倍加速，并提供最佳精度。
AI.conclusion: HBQ通过分层量化设计有效破解了BQ中块大小与精度/效率的权衡矛盾，证明“大块+合适缩放方案”能在精度、面积、能耗和速度上全面优于现有BQ与WoQ方案，为LLM低精度端到端推理提供了高效且精度可靠的硬件实现路径。

title: Latent Mechanisms of Language Control in Multilingual Language Models
comment: 23 pages, accepted for presentation at EMNLP 2026 main track
summary: Multilingual large language models can exhibit unintended code-switching -- unnecessarily alternating between languages during generation. We present a comparative study of three methods that identify language-controlling latents in cross-layer transcoders: activation value-based selection (ValSel), activation frequency-based selection (FreqSel), and LLM-generated latent annotation-based selection (AnnSel). To evaluate the efficacy of these methods in identifying language-controlling latents, we introduce two multilingual benchmarks that exhibit code-switching for fine-grained analysis of language steering across seven languages. Through targeted intervention experiments on Gemma-2-2B and Qwen3-4B, we find that all three methods effectively manipulate generation language, with FreqSel achieving the strongest overall performance, while AnnSel offering interpretable latent selection through explicit language annotations. A knock-out analysis suggests the methods select non-overlapping but each-functional latent subsets, indicating redundancy rather than a single canonical language direction. Code and data can be found at https://github.com/rm-3284/Latent-Mechanism-Multilingual.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种基于跨层转码器（cross-layer transcoders）识别多语言大模型中语言控制潜在变量的方法（ValSel、FreqSel、AnnSel），并引入两个含代码切换的多语言基准，通过干预实验发现三种方法均能有效操控生成语言，其中FreqSel整体性能最强、AnnSel可解释性最好，且揭杀分析表明各方法选取的是非重叠但各自有效的潜在变量子集，体现冗余性而非单一语言方向。
AI.motivation: 多语言大模型在生成时会出现非预期的代码切换（不必要地在语言间交替）。这一现象的语言控制机制尚不清楚，现有方法也缺乏对语言控制潜在变量的系统比较，因此需要对比不同的潜在变量选取方法，并建立可用于细粒度语言操控评估的基准。
AI.method: 提出三种在跨层转码器中识别语言控制潜在变量的方法：基于激活值的选择（ValSel）、基于激活频率的选择（FreqSel）和基于LLM生成潜在变量注释的选择（AnnSel）；构建了两个表现出代码切换的多语言基准（覆盖七种语言）用于细粒度语言引导分析；在Gemma-2-2B和Qwen3-4B上进行有针对性的干预实验，并进行揭杀（knock-out）分析以检验各方法所选潜在变量子集的叠加效应。
AI.result: 三种方法均能有效操控生成语言；FreqSel整体表现最强，AnnSel通过显式语言注释提供可解释的潜在变量选择；揭杀分析显示各方法选择的是非重叠但各自都有功能的潜在变量子集，表明语言控制存在冗余性而非单一规范的语言方向。
AI.conclusion: 语言控制在多语言模型中是分散且冗余的机制：没有单一的规范语言方向，多种潜在变量选取策略均可实现有效引导；FreqSel在性能上占优，AnnSel以可解释性取胜，为后续多语言生成与代码切换控制提供了方法学参考。

title: Teaching Vision-Language Models to Use the Scale They Are Given: Label-Free Equivariance Training for Metric Physical Reasoning
summary: Metric questions about video require vision-language models to use supplied real-world references to convert visual measurements into physical units. Yet we find that current models use this scale information only partially. When every world-space quantity in a prompt is rescaled by a common factor, the video remains equally valid and the correct answer changes by exactly that factor, but model predictions move only part of the way and accuracy remains concentrated near the familiar scale of the depicted objects. Across eight vision-language models, this under-response persists over four orders of magnitude. The same models recover the correct closed-form scaling laws when the identical physics is asked in a scale-free form, indicating that the main deficit lies in metric grounding rather than physical mechanism knowledge. We use this exact scaling relation as supervision without requiring metric annotations. Under a common rescaling of the supplied world-space quantities, the correct metric answer must change by the same factor. EquiSD exploits this constraint by projecting a model's own prediction onto the scale-equivariant family and fine-tuning the model on the resulting targets. It requires no ground-truth answers and only one model query per training video. On held-out simulated videos, EquiSD increases a 3B model's median response slope from 0.66 to 0.94 and improves mean relative accuracy by 9.2 points across scales. The learned relation generalizes to unseen world scales and transfers without adaptation to real QuantiPhy videos, where accuracy increases by 6.4 points. These results show that an exact physical symmetry can provide label-free supervision for improving metric grounding in vision-language models.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现视觉-语言模型在视频度量问答中仅部分利用尺度参考信息（对公共缩放呈现"欠响应"），并提出EquiSD方法，利用"答案必须随供给的世界尺度等比例变化"这一精确物理对称性作为无标签监督信号，通过将模型自身预测投影到尺度等变族并微调，显著提升了模型的度量接地能力且无需任何真实标注。
AI.motivation: 视频中的度量问题要求视觉-语言模型利用提供的真实世界参考将视觉测量转换为物理单位，但现有模型仅部分利用这一尺度信息：当提示中所有世界空间量被共同缩放时，正确答案应按相同因子变化，而模型预测只移动一部分，且精度集中在物体的常见尺度附近。这种欠响应在8个模型中跨越四个数量级持续存在，说明问题在于度量接地（metric grounding）而非物理机制知识。
AI.method: 提出EquiSD：利用精确的尺度缩放关系作为监督（无需度量标注）。具体而言，在供给的世界空间量共同缩放下，正确的度量答案必须以相同因子变化（尺度等变约束）。EquiSD将模型自身的预测投影到尺度等变族上，并用得到的投影结果作为微调目标来训练模型。该方法不需要真实答案，每个训练视频仅需一次模型查询。
AI.result: 在保留模拟视频上，EquiSD将3B模型的响应斜率中位数从0.66提升至0.94，不同尺度下的平均相对准确率提升9.2个百分点；学习到的关系可泛化到未见过的世界尺度，并无适应地迁移到真实QuantiPhy视频，准确率提升6.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 精确的物理对称性可以为改进视觉-语言模型的度量接地能力提供无标签的监督信号；EquiSD无需度量标注即可大幅提升模型对尺度信息的响应能力和跨尺度泛化能力，并能迁移到真实数据。

title: Human-AI Co-Interpretation for Responsible AI: A Hermeneutic Perspective
summary: Across law, education, policy analysis, and public moral argumentation, LLM outputs are being used often for work that requires interpretations to be justified with textual evidence and explicit normative standards. Yet a recurrent failure mode -- what I call \textit{interpretive misplacement} -- is that model-generated readings get treated as settled meanings without an explicit interpretive frame (sources, scope constraints, normative commitments), without preserving defensible alternatives, and without provenance that lets readers find the supporting passages. In such settings, the risk is not only factual error but lost accountability: readers and institutions cannot reliably assess what an output commits them to, or on what basis. Drawing on philosophical hermeneutics, this paper discusses this risk and derives design principles for structuring human-AI co-interpretation. The paper also provides a structured synthesis of recent scholarship on hermeneutics and AI, organizing this emerging literature into a set of recurrent lines of argument and design-relevant gaps. LLM outputs are treated as candidate readings, whereas hermeneutic understanding is reserved for accountable human interpreters situated in disciplinary historical-linguistic traditions. Human-AI interaction is characterized as an AI-mediated interpretive loop. Hermeneutic understanding is distinguished from token-prediction--based text generation. On this basis, existing LLM techniques are reorganized into design patterns for hermeneutically responsible use in interpretive settings. Finally, the discussion turns to implications for legal practice, educational assessment and feedback, scholarly knowledge production, and public moral argumentation. It also treats digital hermeneutics as a literacy: the capacity to read AI-mediated texts by examining frames, provenance, and readings, and by contesting outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文指出大语言模型（LLM）输出在法学、教育、政策分析与公共道德论证等解释性工作中存在"解释错位"（interpretive misplacement）这一系统性失败模式——模型生成的解读被当作既定含义，却缺乏明确的解释框架、可辩护的替代方案与溯源依据。作者借助哲学诠释学（hermeneutics）提出用于结构化人机协同解释的设计原则，综合梳理了诠释学与AI的近期文献，将LLM输出定位为"候选解读"而非确定意义，并把既有LLM技术重组为诠释学负责任使用的设计模式，最后讨论其对法律实践、教育评估、学术生产及公共道德论证的启示，将数字诠释学视为一种素养。
AI.motivation: 在需要以文本证据和明确规范标准来证成解释的领域（法律、教育、政策分析、公共道德论证），LLM输出被广泛使用，但反复出现"解释错位"的失败模式：模型生成的解读被当作已定含义，缺少明确的解释框架（来源、范围约束、规范性承诺）、未保留可辩护的替代方案，也没有让读者找到支持原文的溯源信息。此时的风险不仅是事实错误，更是责任缺失（lost accountability）：读者和机构无法可靠地评估输出使自身承担了什么承诺、依据何在。因此需要从哲学诠释学出发讨论该风险并推导设计原则。
AI.method: 本文采用哲学诠释学作为理论基础：首先讨论解释错位风险并推导结构化人机协同解释的设计原则；其次对"诠释学与AI"的近期学术文献做结构化综合，将该新兴领域组织为若干反复出现的论证线索与设计相关缺口；将LLM输出视为"候选解读"，而将诠释学意义上的理解保留给处于学科历史—语言传统中的、可负责的人类解释者；将人机交互刻画为"AI中介的解释回路"，并把诠释学理解与基于token预测的文本生成相区分；在此基础上，将既有LLM技术重组为在解释性场景中实现诠释学负责任使用的设计模式；最后讨论对法律实践、教育评估与反馈、学术知识生产、公共道德论证的启示，并把数字诠释学作为一种素养（审查AI中介文本的框架、溯源与解读，并对输出提出质疑的能力）来处理。
AI.result: 本文产出一套用于结构化人机协同解释的设计原则；对诠释学与AI交叉研究进行结构化综合并识别出设计缺口；将LLM技术重组为诠释学负责任使用的设计模式；阐明LLM输出（候选解读）与人类诠释学理解之间的区分；针对法律实践、教育评估与反馈、学术知识生产和公共道德论证提出应用启示；提出将数字诠释学界定为一种阅读与质疑AI中介文本的素养。
AI.conclusion: 为保障解释性场景中的问责性，LLM输出应被当作附带框架、溯源与替代方案的"候选解读"，而非既定的文本含义；诠释学理解必须保留给处于学科传统中的负责人类解释者。通过设计原则、文献综合与设计模式，数字诠释学可被培育为一种素养，使读者能够审查框架、溯源与解读并质疑输出，从而降低解释错位带来的责任风险。

title: Can LLMs Use Relational Transformer Embeddings?
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Foundation Models for Structured Data Workshop at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Z2n7WcIy6j&noteId=Z2n7WcIy6j
summary: Injecting frozen relational-encoder embeddings as soft tokens into a large language model (LLM) is a conceptually appealing fusion strategy: the encoder handles multi-table structure, the LLM handles language and reasoning, and no lossy text serialization is required. We test this hypothesis concretely by injecting embeddings from a frozen Relational Transformer (RT) into Qwen3.5-4B via a learned MLP projection and LoRA adaptation, trained first with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on chain-of-thought reasoning traces and then with group-based reinforcement learning (GSPO). We evaluate across 10 binary classification tasks on 6 relational databases from RelBench, under four supervision regimes: single-task (ST), within-dataset (WD), cross-dataset (CD), and all-task (ALL). The hybrid model does not consistently outperform standalone RT: it is frequently below random, highly sensitive to serialization format and relational-token budget, and unstable under RL training. We report these negative results and analyze the failure modes, arguing that soft-token fusion requires stronger alignment objectives and schema-aware design before it can serve as a reliable route to relational prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了将冻结的关系型编码器嵌入作为软token注入大语言模型的融合假设，在RelBench的6个关系数据库上的10个二分类任务中，该混合模型未能稳定优于独立的Relational Transformer，甚至经常低于随机水平，且对序列化格式、token预算和RL训练高度敏感；作者报告了这一负面结果并分析了失败模式。
AI.motivation: 将冻结的关系型编码器嵌入作为软token注入LLM是一种概念上吸引人的融合策略：编码器负责处理多表结构，LLM负责语言与推理，从而避免有损的文本序列化。但这一假设是否成立缺乏实证检验，需要具体验证其可行性。
AI.method: 将冻结的Relational Transformer (RT)嵌入通过学习的MLP投影注入Qwen3.5-4B，并采用LoRA适配；训练流程为先进行基于思维链推理轨迹的监督微调（SFT），再进行基于组的强化学习（GSPO）。在RelBench的6个关系数据库上的10个二分类任务中，覆盖单任务（ST）、数据集内（WD）、跨数据集（CD）和全任务（ALL）四种监督设定进行评估。
AI.result: 混合模型并未持续优于独立的RT：其性能经常低于随机基线，对序列化格式和关系token预算高度敏感，且在RL训练下不稳定。实验以负面结果告终，并系统分析了失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 软token融合在成为可靠的关系型预测路线之前，需要更强的对齐目标和schema感知的设计；本文通过报告负面结果与失败模式分析，提示当前融合策略存在根本性局限。

title: The Curse of Multilinguality in Lexical Normalization
comment: Accepted at the 11th Workshop on Natural User-generated Text (W-NUT 2026), EMNLP 2026. Camera-ready version. 7 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables
summary: Lexical normalization rewrites the noisy, non-standard words that fill user-generated text (tmrw, u, gr8) into their standard forms. Because labelled data is scarce for most languages, a popular shortcut is to train a single model on many languages at once. We ask a simple question: how many languages should such a model be trained on? Using one fixed-capacity character-level model and twelve languages from a standard benchmark, we vary the number of jointly trained languages from one to twelve and measure per-language accuracy. We find a clear curse of multilinguality: accuracy is highest when a language is trained with only a few others, often just one to four, and then falls steadily and substantially, dropping by about forty percent as the rest are piled on. A control that holds the total amount of training data constant makes the decline arrive sooner and fall further, which points to competition among the languages for one fixed-size model rather than to how much data is available. We also test whether a language's typological distance from the others predicts its ideal number of co-training languages, and find no dependable rule: any apparent relationship rests on a couple of languages and does not hold up. For compact normalization models, less can be more: a few languages beat pooling everything into a single model.

AI.tldr: 本文探究词汇规范化的多语言联合训练中"最佳语言数量"问题，发现存在"多语言诅咒"：使用固定容量的字符级模型时，单语言模型搭配仅1-4种其他语言训练效果最佳，随着语言数量增加准确率稳定且大幅下降（最多约40%）；控制训练数据总量后下降更早更深，表明下降源于语言间对固定容量模型的竞争而非数据量；语言的类型学距离无法可靠预测其最佳共训语言数量。总之，紧凑模型下"少即是多"。
AI.motivation: 词汇规范化任务因标注数据稀缺，常用做法是在多种语言上联合训练单一模型，但"应联合训练多少种语言"仍是未解问题。作者希望系统性地回答该问题，并探究准确率下降的根源（数据量不足还是模型容量竞争），以及类型学距离是否可作为选择共训语言数量的依据。
AI.method: 在标准基准的12种语言上，使用固定容量的字符级模型，将联合训练的语言数量从1变化到12，逐一测量每种语言的准确率；同时设计控制实验（保持总训练数据量恒定）以区分"数据量"与"模型容量竞争"两种解释；并检验语言的类型学距离能否预测最优共训语言数量。
AI.result: 发现清晰的多语言诅咒：仅与1到4种语言共训时准确率最高，随语言增多准确率持续且大幅下降，加入全部语言后约下降40%；控制总数据量恒定会使下降更早发生并降得更深，说明根源是语言间对固定容量模型的竞争；类型学距离与最优共训语言数的关系并不可靠，仅由少数语言支撑，无法成立。
AI.conclusion: 对于紧凑的词汇规范化模型，"少即是多"：联合训练少数几种语言的效果优于把所有语言堆进单一模型，多语言训练应有节制而非盲目追求语言覆盖度。

title: Do Satellites See Commuters? A Critical Benchmark of Vision Foundation Models
summary: Satellite foundation models offer a globally available alternative to census data for commuting origin-destination (OD) generation, yet no study has systematically compared encoder paradigms within a single downstream pipeline. We ablate four satellite vision encoders: language-supervised (RemoteCLIP), self-supervised (DINOv3), and geographically grounded (SatCLIP, AlphaEarth) within an identical WeDAN graph diffusion framework across 1,925 US counties, 325 UK districts, and 14 global cities under five random seeds. Three main findings emerge. First, language-supervised features achieve the strongest in-distribution performance (RemoteCLIP CPC 0.602), while geographically grounded encoders transfer more reliably zero-shot: AlphaEarth improves CPC by 33% over RemoteCLIP on UK districts. Second, pretraining corpus scale alone is insufficient: DINOv3, trained on a substantially larger satellite corpus, underperforms RemoteCLIP by 0.091 CPC in-distribution and collapses to CPC 0.022 globally. Third, no encoder transfers usefully to global cities (best CPC 0.122 for RemoteCLIP, 0.022 for DINOv3), confirming cross-continental OD generation remains an open problem. We additionally clarify the semantics of the census noise parameter $η$, whose ordering reverses under cross-continental evaluation, a distinction critical to correctly interpreting prior results. Training scripts and evaluation logs will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一的WeDAN图扩散框架下，系统对比了四类卫星视觉编码器（语言监督的RemoteCLIP、自监督的DINOv3、地理grounded的SatCLIP和AlphaEarth）在通勤起讫点(OD)生成任务中的表现，覆盖1,925个美国县、325个英国区及14个全球城市。结果显示语言监督特征在分布内表现最佳（RemoteCLIP CPC 0.602），地理grounded编码器零样本迁移更可靠（AlphaEarth在英国区相对RemoteCLIP提升33%）；仅扩大预训练语料不足以保证效果（DINOv3在分布内落后0.091 CPC，全球场景几乎失效）；而跨大洲OD生成仍是开放难题（最佳CPC仅0.122）。此外还澄清了普查噪声参数η在跨大洲评估下顺序反转的语义问题。
AI.motivation: 卫星基础模型可作为普查数据的全球可用替代方案用于生成通勤起讫点(OD)矩阵，但此前尚无研究在单一下游流水线内系统比较不同编码器范式（语言监督、自监督、地理grounded）的优劣。作者旨在填补这一空白，回答"哪种预训练范式最适合卫星OD生成"这一关键问题。
AI.method: 在完全相同的WeDAN图扩散框架下，对四种卫星视觉编码器（RemoteCLIP、DINOv3、SatCLIP、AlphaEarth）进行消融实验，横跨1,925个美国县、325个英国区及14个全球城市，采用五种随机种子以保证统计稳健性。同时通过跨区域评估重新审视普查噪声参数η的语义。
AI.result: 三大发现：（1）语言监督特征在分布内表现最强（RemoteCLIP CPC 0.602），而地理grounded编码器零样本迁移更可靠（AlphaEarth在英国区较RemoteCLIP提升33%）；（2）预训练语料规模并非主导因素，训练于更大语料库的DINOv3在分布内落后RemoteCLIP达0.091 CPC，全球场景更崩塌至0.022；（3）没有任何编码器能有效迁移到全球城市（最佳仅RemoteCLIP的0.122），证实跨大洲OD生成仍是开放问题。另外，η在不同区域评估下排序反转，对解读既往结果至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 卫星基础模型在分布内OD生成中有效，但跨大洲泛化能力普遍不足，构成未来研究的重要挑战；预训练范式（尤其语言监督与地理grounded）的选择显著影响迁移行为，简单扩大语料规模并非解决之道；同时须谨慎对待普查噪声参数η在区域间评估中语义反转的问题，否则会误读此前结论。作者将公开训练脚本与评估日志以促进可复现性。

title: SlideBank: A Persistent Hierarchical Evidence Bank for Consistent Whole-Slide Reasoning
summary: Whole-slide images (WSIs) are challenging for vision-language reasoning because diagnostically relevant morphology is sparse, heterogeneous, and distributed across gigapixel-scale images and multiple spatial resolutions. Existing WSI models and pathology agents can aggregate slide features or actively acquire evidence, but the information retained after exploration is often difficult to access semantically while preserving its connection to the original visual evidence. We introduce SlideBank, a training-free framework that represents each WSI as a persistent, concept-indexed, and spatially grounded evidence bank. SlideBank performs question-independent coarse-to-fine exploration to identify informative regions and multi-scale views, converts them into explicit morphological observations, and grounds pathology signals to their supporting patches and WSI coordinates. At inference time, questions are routed to relevant signals and evidence scales, and the linked global, regional, and patch evidence is integrated through confidence-based cross-level consensus. Experiments on WSI-VQA and SlideBench-BCNB show that with Patho-R1, SlideBank reaches 52.77% on WSI-VQA and with Quilt-LLaVA, it reaches 50.92% average accuracy on SlideBench-BCNB, while structured signal-guided retrieval consistently outperforms random evidence sampling. Reusing the same bank across repeated queries further achieves over 99% rephrasing consistency and substantially reduces amortized inference cost through persistent evidence reuse.

AI.tldr: SlideBank 是一个免训练框架，将全切片图像（WSI）表示为持久化、概念索引、空间可溯源的证据银行，通过问题无关的由粗到细探索生成显式形态学观察，并在推理时基于置信度的跨层级共识整合全局、区域和局部证据，从而显著提升 WSI 视觉问答性能并实现证据的持久复用。
AI.motivation: WSI 对视觉-语言推理极具挑战性，因为具有诊断意义的形态学特征稀疏、异质，且分布在千兆像素级的多分辨率图像中。现有 WSI 模型和病理智能体虽能聚合切片特征或主动获取证据，但探索后保留的信息往往难以在语义上访问，同时又难以保持与原始视觉证据的关联。
AI.method: 提出 SlideBank：一种免训练框架，将每个 WSI 表示为一个持久化、概念索引且空间可溯源的证据银行。其流程包括：(1) 进行问题无关的由粗到细探索，识别信息丰富的区域和多尺度视图；(2) 将这些视图转化为显式形态学观察，并将病理信号落实到支撑补丁及 WSI 坐标上；(3) 推理时将问题路由到相关信号与证据尺度，并通过基于置信度的跨层级共识整合全局、区域和局部证据。
AI.result: 实验表明：在 WSI-VQA 上结合 Patho-R1 达到 52.77% 准确率；在 SlideBench-BCNB 上结合 Quilt-LLaVA 达到 50.92% 平均准确率；结构化信号引导的检索持续优于随机证据采样。此外，跨重复查询复用同一证据银行可实现超过 99% 的改述一致性，并通过持久证据复用大幅降低摊销推理成本。
AI.conclusion: SlideBank 通过构建可语义访问、空间可溯源且可持久复用的证据银行，有效解决了 WSI 视觉-语言推理中信息稀疏与跨尺度异质的问题，在准确性和推理效率上均优于基线，为病理切片上的多轮问答提供了高效且一致的方案。

title: Context Window Failures in Relational Foundation Models
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Foundation Models for Structured Data Workshop at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=lkuOIfXLwJ&noteId=lkuOIfXLwJ
summary: Recent Relational Deep Learning architectures have been proposed as foundation models for multi-table relational data, yet they impose constrained neighborhood budgets that force row truncation when an entity has many related records. We introduce Animus, a synthetic financial dataset in which predicting customer income requires aggregating up to tens of thousands of transactions. On the raw representation, three recently proposed models (RT, Griffin, RelGT) achieve $R^2 \le 0.18$; a single, routine, temporal pre-aggregation step recovers $R^2$ up to $0.65$. This questions whether current relational foundation models are ready for high-cardinality real-world data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出合成金融数据集 Animus，用于检验关系型基础模型在高基数（一个实体关联数万条记录）场景下的表现。实验表明，RT、Griffin、RelGT 三个近期模型在原始数据上 R² 仅为 0.18 或更低，而一次常规的时间维度预聚合即可将 R² 提升至 0.65，质疑当前关系型基础模型处理高基数真实世界数据的能力。
AI.motivation: 近期关系型深度学习方法被提出作为多表关系数据的基础模型，但这类模型设置了受限的邻域预算，当某个实体包含大量关联记录时不得不强制截断行数据。这种设计可能无法适应真实世界中常见的高基数数据，因此需要一个能暴露这一局限性的评估基准。
AI.method: 作者构建了合成金融数据集 Animus，其任务是通过聚合多达数万条交易记录来预测客户收入。在该数据集的原始表示上评估了三种近期提出的关系基础模型（RT、Griffin、RelGT），并与一次常规的时间维度预聚合步骤的处理性能进行对比。
AI.result: 在原始表示上，RT、Griffin、RelGT 三种模型的 R² 均不超过 0.18；而仅增加一次常规的时间预聚合步骤，R² 即可恢复到最高 0.65，两者差距极为显著。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果对当前关系型基础模型在高基数真实世界数据上的适用性提出质疑：受限邻域预算与强制行截断导致模型难以利用细粒度关联信息，而简单的领域知识（时间聚合）即可大幅超越这些模型，表明现有模型尚未准备好应对高基数场景。

title: Topic Matching in the Wild: Benchmark and Lessons from Real-World ASR Transcripts
comment: Accepted at the 11th Workshop on Natural User-generated Text (W-NUT 2026), EMNLP 2026. Camera-ready version. 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: In contact centers, real-time agent-assist tools determine, for each of many predefined topics, whether a live customer utterance is relevant and display a coaching card to the agent when it is. The input is noisy and challenging: ASR(Automatic Speech Recognition) transcripts of spontaneous phone conversations, which can be unclear, repetitive, and mostly lack punctuation. To systematically study this real-world task, we curate a human-annotated topic-utterance judgments dataset sourced from real call-center transcripts. We compare three types of matchers: a regex-based baseline, zero-shot sentence embedding encoders, and Gemini-based LLM matchers. In addition, two types of topic representations are studied in our benchmark:keyphrases and natural language description. Our empirical experiments highlight the superior performance of lightweight LLM matchers over embedding and regex models when equipped with natural language descriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对呼叫中心实时坐席辅助系统，构建了一个基于真实通话转录文本的人工标注主题-话语相关性判断数据集，并系统比较了正则匹配、零样本句子嵌入编码器以及基于Gemini的轻量级LLM匹配器，同时研究了关键词短语与自然语言描述两种主题表示方式。实验表明，配备自然语言描述的轻量级LLM匹配器显著优于嵌入模型和正则模型。
AI.motivation: 实时坐席辅助工具需要在大量预定义主题中判断实时客户话语是否相关，并在相关时向坐席展示辅导卡片。该任务输入具有很强的挑战性：ASR转录的即兴电话对话往往含混不清、重复且大多缺少标点。作者希望系统性地研究这一真实世界任务，因此需要一个可靠的基准数据集和各类匹配方法的对比。
AI.method: 作者从真实呼叫中心转录文本中构建了人工标注的主题-话语判断数据集；在此基础上对比三类匹配器：基于正则表达式的基线、零样本句子嵌入编码器、基于Gemini的LLM匹配器；同时考察两种主题表示方式：关键词短语和自然语言描述，构成完整的基准评测框架。
AI.result: 经验实验结果表明，在配备自然语言描述的条件下，轻量级LLM匹配器的性能优于嵌入模型和正则模型；同时验证了自然语言描述这一主题表示方式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 对于噪声严重的ASR通话转录环境，轻量级LLM结合自然语言描述的主题表示是实时主题相关性判断任务中更具优势的方案，为实际接触中心坐席辅助系统的实现提供了可靠依据。

title: Separating perception from reasoning in vision-language models: a model-free render ceiling for crystal structures
summary: Multimodal evaluations cannot say whether a vision-language model misread an image or misreasoned about it, because every existing method for separating the two places a second model in the loop. We introduce the render ceiling, a model-free reference for benchmarks built by rendering known objects: inverting the frozen cameras and re-solving cross-view correspondence recovers exactly the answer the images support. We prove the ceiling fails only through an enumerable set of projection coincidences and certify that set empty on 2,160 rendered crystal structures, so every point of a model's deficit belongs to the model. Across fourteen vision-language models, supplying exact geometry as text lifts every model yet closes under half the gap for thirteen, while a supervised vision model with no language component reads the same images at 0.8952, above every vision-language model. The instrument exposes extraction-stage fabrication that downstream accuracy would misattribute to reasoning, yields camera-placement rules for benchmark builders, and transfers to any benchmark with an invertible forward rendering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"渲染天花板"（render ceiling），一种无需额外模型介入的参考基准，通过反演固定相机并重解跨视角对应关系，精确恢复图像所支持的唯一答案，从而将视觉-语言模型的误差明确区分为"读图错误"与"推理错误"。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态评测无法判断视觉-语言模型（VLM）是误读了图像还是推理错误，因为所有现有分离两者的方法都需要在循环中引入第二个模型，引入了额外的偏差与不确定性。作者希望建立一个不依赖任何模型的、可证明的参考基准。
AI.method: 提出渲染天花板：针对"由已知对象渲染而成"的基准，反演冻结的相机参数并重新求解跨视角对应关系，可精确恢复图像实际支持的唯一答案。作者证明该天花板仅在可枚举的一组投影巧合下失效，并在2,160个渲染晶体结构上验证了该集合为空。随后对十四个VLM进行实验：将精确几何以文本形式输入，并加入一个不含语言成分的有监督视觉模型作对比。
AI.result: 供给精确几何文本能提升所有模型的表现，但十三个模型仍无法弥合超过一半的差距；无语言部分的监督视觉模型在同一图像上达到0.8952，高于所有被评测的视觉-语言模型。该工具还暴露了提取阶段的伪造问题——若不借助天花板，下游准确率会把这种伪造误归因于推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 渲染天花板是一种可移植、可证明的模型无关评测参照，适用于任何具有可逆前向渲染的基准。它为基准构建者提供了相机布置规则，并能将模型缺陷精确归因于阅读或推理环节，从而改进多模态评测的诊断能力。

title: Vision Is Not Overhead: One-Pass Block Drafting for Lossless Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates generation without changing its output, yet on vision-language models (VLMs) it has been caught in a self-defeating cycle. The drafter stays autoregressive, so it must stay small. A small drafter cannot afford the image at every step, so vision is compressed, pruned, or hidden. A drafter cut off from the image is then least reliable exactly where the image makes text predictable. We present GLANCE, the first one-pass block drafter that is lossless on an unmodified VLM target, and it breaks the cycle at both ends. A block-diffusion head reads the target's already-fused vision-language state, so vision costs the drafter nothing, and fills a whole block in one forward pass, so depth costs no sequential steps. A wide candidate tree is verified in one target pass, and every audited prompt reproduces greedy decoding exactly. Grounded workloads reward this most, entering a verbatim-copy regime whose long runs cost an autoregressive drafter a pass for every token and a block drafter one in total. Under one engine and one round budget, GLANCE decodes up to 2.93x faster than autoregression, from one draft pass a round where the production EAGLE3-VL head takes eight, and accepts 2.7x longer blocks than an EAGLE-3 head trained on the same corpus. One law organizes these results. Accepted length is set by the target's next-token entropy, with a fitted slope that steepens with grounding across all five tasks. The law transfers across targets and modalities and names its own boundary, since free-running text still favors a chain. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/GLANCE.

AI.tldr: GLANCE 是首个面向视觉-语言模型（VLM）的无损单遍块级草稿器：它将块扩散头直接接到目标模型已融合的视觉-语言状态上，无需压缩或裁剪图像，一次前向即可生成整块候选，再通过一次目标前向验证宽候选树，严格复现贪心解码。相比自回归基线最高提速 2.93×，且优于同语料训练的 EAGLE-3 头，并揭示“接受长度由目标模型下一个 token 熵决定”的标度律。
AI.motivation: 投机解码在 VLM 上陷入自我拆台循环：草稿器必须保持自回归因而必须很小；小草稿器无法每步都负担图像，只能压缩、剪枝或隐藏视觉信息；而切断图像信息的草稿器恰好在图像使文本可预测的地方最不靠谱，导致加速增益被抵消。
AI.method: 提出 GLANCE，一个单遍（one-pass）块级草稿器。其块扩散头读取目标模型已融合的视觉-语言隐状态（因此视觉信息零额外成本），并在单次前向中填充整个块（深度不再消耗顺序步骤）；构建宽候选树在一次目标前向中验证，保证对所有被审计提示精确复现贪心解码。
AI.result: 在同一引擎和单轮预算下，GLANCE 解码速度比自回归快最高 2.93×；每轮仅需一次草稿前向，而生产级 EAGLE3-VL 头需要八次；其接受块长度比同语料训练的 EAGLE-3 头长 2.7×。接受长度由目标模型的下一个 token 熵决定，拟合斜率随 grounding 在全部五个任务上变陡，该标度律可跨目标和模态迁移，并界定自身边界（自由运行文本仍偏向链式解码）。
AI.conclusion: GLANCE 打破了 VLM 投机解码的恶性循环，证明经单遍块扩散草稿即可在保持无损、精确复现贪心解码的同时显著加速多模态生成；其熵标度律统一解释了各任务结果，并为选择块式或链式草稿提供了明确边界。代码已开源。

authors: Carlos Zapata Carratalá. Nicholas J. Cooper
title: Higher Structures in Deep Learning
summary: We provide an expository introduction on the importance of higher-arity tensor operations to deep learning. Then, we conduct a novel empirical investigation of higher-arity phenomenon in trained neural networks, introduce a hypergraphical generalization of the multilayer perceptron, and explore connections to evolutionary algorithms. We conclude with a discussion of promising directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文首先对高阶张量运算在深度学习中的重要性进行了说明性介绍，随后对训练后神经网络中的高阶现象进行了新颖的实证研究，引入了多层感知机的超图泛化，并探讨了与进化算法的联系，最后讨论了有前景的未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 深度学习中的传统运算多为低阶（二元的）张量运算，而更高阶的张量运算在深度学习中可能具有重要意义但研究不足；作者希望通过说明性介绍和实证调查来揭示高阶现象的作用，并探索其与超图和进化算法的关联。
AI.method: 作者首先提供了高阶张量运算在深度学习中重要性的说明性论述；然后对训练后的神经网络中是否存在高阶现象进行了新的实证研究；接着提出了一种多层感知机的超图泛化（hypergraphical generalization）；最后探索了与进化算法的联系。
AI.result: 实证调查揭示了训练后神经网络中的高阶现象；超图泛化的多层感知机被提出并可能与进化算法存在联系；研究为高阶张量运算在深度学习中的应用提供了初步证据和理论框架。
AI.conclusion: 高阶张量运算在深度学习中值得更多关注，超图化泛化与进化算法的结合为未来研究开辟了新方向，但相关工作尚处于探索阶段，需要进一步深入研究。

title: Two locked tests of phase-structure features for transition prediction
comment: 7 pages. Empirical follow-up to arXiv:2607.25507. Both pre-specified tests are null
summary: A published theoretical account of phase structure in rotary attention was subjected to two pre-specified empirical tests of whether phase-derived features improve prediction of a commitment or contradiction endpoint over a baseline that does not receive those features. Study 1 froze a contradiction-category pipeline and scored a sealed primary comparison of PC-2 against baseline. On 1,136 eligible cases the paired AUROC difference was +0.00087. The 99% interval included zero, and the difference did not reach the pre-specified threshold of +0.05. Advancement was not passed. Study 2 developed fifteen layer treatments on open blocks b0-b4 only (1,415 transitions, 20x5 grouped folds). A locked conjunctive rule required a positive PC-2 mean-repeat increment, a positive increment on at least four of five seed blocks, and a positive mean of those five differences. No treatment advanced. The official selection is null. The theoretical paper is not withdrawn. The extra ranking lift was not found under the rules locked in advance.

AI.tldr: 本文对“旋转注意力中的相位结构”理论进行了两次预先注册的实证检验，考察相位衍生特征是否优于不含这些特征的基线。两项研究均未达到预设推进标准：研究1中PC-2相对基线的配对AUROC提升仅+0.00087（99%置信区间含零，未达+0.05阈值）；研究2在15种层处理与5个种子块上均无处理通过锁定规则。官方结论为“无效”，但原理论论文未被撤回。
AI.motivation: 检验已发表的理论解释（旋转注意力中的相位结构）是否具有可复现的预测价值，即相位衍生特征能否在严格预先注册的条件下稳定提升对承诺或矛盾终点的预测性能，从而验证理论的实证有效性。
AI.method: 采用两项预先指定的实证检验。研究1：冻结矛盾类别管线，对1,136个符合条件的案例进行密封的一级PC-2对基线的配对AUROC比较，以+0.05为预设推进阈值。研究2：仅在开放块b0-b4上开发15种层处理（1,415个转换，20x5分组交叉验证），使用锁定联言规则——要求PC-2平均重复增量为正、至少4/5种子块增量为正、且5个差异均值大于零。
AI.result: 研究1的配对AUROC差值为+0.00087，99%区间包含零，未达阈值，未通过。研究2没有任何处理在锁定规则下推进。官方最终选择为“无效”（null）。
AI.conclusion: 在预先锁定的规则下，未发现相位衍生特征带来的额外排序提升，理论论文的实证预测未获支持；尽管理论未被撤回，但当前证据不支持其预测优势成立。

title: DGNet: Dual-knowledge Guided Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: InfRared Small Target Detection (IRSTD) is a prominent and challenging task in computer vision. In recent years, text-guided methods have significantly improved detection performance. However, they still suffer from two key limitations. First, a single text description simultaneously modeling both background and target leads to semantic entanglement, which contradicts the objective of background suppression and target enhancement. Second, reliance on image-specific textual prompts (requiring additional external models such as CLIP during inference) results in deployment constraints. To address these issues, we propose a novel Dual-knowledge Guided Network (DGNet) based on multiple generalizable texts. Specifically, we design a Prior-knowledge Wavelet Modulation (PWM) module, which leverages dual textual priors that separately characterize large-scale backgrounds and sparse targets to effectively disentangle and modulate entangled semantics in the frequency domain. Furthermore, we introduce a Consensus-knowledge Directional Alignment (CDA) loss, which models the initial state and the ideal target across samples as `complex background' and `bright target', respectively, thereby constructing a clear and unified directional optimization trajectory for the model. Extensive experiments on three public datasets demonstrate the superior performance of DGNet and the effectiveness of each component. The source code is available at https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/MM26-DGNet.

AI.tldr: 针对红外小目标检测中文本引导方法存在的语义纠缠和推理时依赖图像特定文本提示的问题，本文提出基于多种可泛化文本的双知识引导网络（DGNet），通过先验知识小波调制模块（PWM）在频域解耦并调制背景与目标语义，并引入共识知识方向对齐损失（CDA）构建统一的方向优化轨迹，在三个公开数据集上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导的红外小目标检测方法存在两个关键局限：一是单一文本描述同时建模背景和目标导致语义纠缠，与背景抑制、目标增强的目标相悖；二是依赖图像特定的文本提示（推理时需额外外部模型如CLIP），导致部署受限。
AI.method: 提出双知识引导网络（DGNet）：1) 设计先验知识小波调制（PWM）模块，利用分别刻画大尺度背景和稀疏目标的双文本先验，在频域有效解耦并调制纠缠的语义；2) 引入共识知识方向对齐（CDA）损失，将跨样本的初始状态与理想目标分别建模为"复杂背景"和"明亮目标"，从而为模型构建清晰统一的方向优化轨迹。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上的大量实验表明DGNet具有优越的检测性能，且各组件均有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过多可泛化文本替代图像特定文本提示，并在频域解耦背景与目标语义，同时以共识方向对齐损失引导优化，DGNet有效解决了语义纠缠和部署受限问题，为文本引导的红外小目标检测提供了更具泛化性与实用性的方案。

title: A Stable Aggregation Method for Quantum Federated Learning
summary: Quantum federated learning (QFL) enables clients to train quantum neural network (QNN) models without sharing private data. We find that aggregation in QFL is unstable under heterogeneous data, unreliable communication, variable fidelity, latency, and quantum hardware noise. Moreover, QFL is non-trivially challenging because several QNN parameters are periodic angles, where Euclidean averaging often fails to capture the inherent dynamics. We develop a novel self-consistent midpoint aggregation method for stable QFL design and implementation. We combine QoS-aware client weighting, circular parameter aggregation, and bounded midpoint-based update control. We perform several angular tests and IBM real Quantum machines experiments for validation confirming our approach. Extensive evaluations and experiments on medical and financial datasets show improved stability, lower volatility, and competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于自一致中点聚合的量子联邦学习（QFL）方法，通过结合QoS感知的客户端加权、圆形参数聚合和有界中点更新控制，解决了异构数据、不可靠通信及量子硬件噪声下聚合不稳定、欧氏平均失效的问题，并在角测试、IBM真实量子机器及医疗和金融数据集上取得更稳定、更低波动且具有竞争力的精度。
AI.motivation: QFL允许客户端在不共享私有数据的前提下训练量子神经网络（QNN）模型，但研究发现：在异构数据、不可靠通信、可变保真度、延迟和量子硬件噪声等条件下，QFL中的聚合过程是不稳定的。此外，QNN的若干参数是周期性角度，传统的欧氏平均往往无法刻画其内在动态特性，导致聚合非平凡且困难。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的自一致中点聚合方法，用于稳定的QFL设计与实现。该方法融合三部分：(1) QoS感知的客户端加权；(2) 圆形参数聚合（针对周期性角度参数）；(3) 基于有界中点的更新控制。并通过多项角测试和IBM真实量子机器实验进行验证。
AI.result: 在医疗和金融数据集上的大量评估与实验表明，所提方法相比基线获得了更高的稳定性、更低的波动性，同时保持了有竞争力的分类精度。
AI.conclusion: 自一致中点聚合能够有效应对QFL聚合中的不稳定问题，为在真实量子硬件与异构环境下实现稳定、可靠的量子联邦学习提供了可行的设计方案。

title: AdaptNTK: Adaptive Uncertainty Quantification and Active Learning for Neural Network Potentials
summary: Machine learning interatomic potentials bridge the gap between quantum chemical precision and classical computational speed, enabling molecular dynamics simulations with first-principles accuracy. Their reliability is often improved through active learning, which iteratively expands the training set by identifying uncertain, out-of-distribution configurations. Existing uncertainty-quantification methods often involve a trade-off between computational cost and reliability, and generally cannot account for redundancy as an acquisition batch is assembled. Here, we introduce AdaptNTK, a single-model framework that measures uncertainty as a regularized Mahalanobis distance in empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) feature space. With the NTK features fixed during acquisition, the uncertainty depends on the acquired configurations but not their reference labels. This allows the uncertainty to be updated recursively after each selection without retraining, reducing redundancy within an acquisition batch. On held-out rMD17 data, AdaptNTK achieves the highest mean correlations with force errors (Spearman 0.68, Pearson 0.71) and matches a three-member ensemble in error retention. In active learning experiments, AdaptNTK achieves the lowest force errors across rMD17 and Transition-1X, with particularly strong performance on transition-state configurations in Transition-1X. AdaptNTK provides a 2.6-fold speedup per Transition-1X cycle relative to the ensemble, providing efficient single-model uncertainty estimation with sequential updates for data-efficient active learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 AdaptNTK，一种基于经验神经正切核（NTK）特征空间中正则化马氏距离的单模型不确定性估计框架，可在不重训练的情况下随采集逐次递归更新不确定性，从而在主动学习批次中降低冗余，并以 2.6 倍加速实现优于三成员集成的不确定性质量与最低力误差。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势因其兼具量子化学精度与经典计算速度而被广泛用于分子动力学模拟；其可靠性常通过主动学习提升，即迭代地识别不确定、分布外的构型以扩充训练集。然而现有不确定性量化方法普遍存在计算成本与可靠性之间的权衡，而且在组装采集批次时通常无法考虑样本间的冗余性。因此需要一个既能高效估计不确定性、又能在批次内消除冗余的方法。
AI.method: AdaptNTK 采用单一模型框架，在经验神经正切核（NTK）特征空间中用正则化马氏距离度量不确定性。由于采集期间 NTK 特征固定，不确定性只取决于已采集构型及其标签无关，因而可在每次选择后递归更新不确定性而无需重新训练，从而减少一个采集批次内部的冗余。实验对比包括保留的 rMD17 数据以及 rMD17 与 Transition-1X 上的主动学习循环。
AI.result: 在留出的 rMD17 数据上，AdaptNTK 的力误差相关性最高（Spearman 0.68，Pearson 0.71），且误差保留能力与三成员集成相当。在主动学习实验中，AdaptNTK 在 rMD17 与 Transition-1X 上均取得最低力误差，尤其在 Transition-1X 的过渡态构型上表现突出；每个 Transition-1X 循环相对集成实现 2.6 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: AdaptNTK 提供了一种高效的单模型不确定性估计方式，并借助顺序更新实现了数据高效的主动学习：在不牺牲可靠性（与集成相当甚至更优）的前提下显著降低计算开销，为机器学习原子间势的主动学习提供实用且可扩展的解决方案。

title: From Tool Use to Technological Agency: LoopCAT as a Local-First, Open-Source Tool for Translation Technology Education
summary: Translation students need to learn both how to use translation technologies and how to judge the choices those technologies make available. This article presents LoopCAT, an Apache-2.0-licensed, local-first computer-assisted translation environment co-created with OpenAI Codex using GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6, and proposes a framework connecting workflow competence, evaluative judgement, and technological agency. The account draws on repository history, implementation inspection, and the verification records of an identified development build. LoopCAT combines local project storage, translation memories, terminology, quality assurance, document exchange, and optional connections to local or hosted AI services. Its English, Catalan, and Turkish interface catalogs also make the application itself available as teaching material: students can translate English UI strings into another language, review the existing automatically generated target drafts, import their revisions, and test the interface. We organize these opportunities around four forms of participation: operating a workflow, evaluating outputs, inspecting and configuring mechanisms, and making or defending a bounded intervention. A six-session sequence, a UI-localization assignment, a placeholder example, and an assessment rubric specify how teachers could use the framework. The paper separates implemented capabilities from proposed educational benefits; it reports no new student-learning outcomes. It distinguishes the latest package checks from earlier regression evidence and sets out a protocol for classroom evaluation. LoopCAT provides an inspectable setting for teaching how translation decisions interact with data, interfaces, and software rules. Whether these activities improve judgement, transfer, or participation remains an empirical question.

AI.tldr: 介绍了一个与OpenAI Codex（GPT-5.5/5.6）协作开发、基于Apache-2.0许可的本地优先计算机辅助翻译（CAT）环境LoopCAT，并提出一个连接工作流程能力、评价判断与技术能动性的教学框架，用于翻译技术教学；论文区分了已实现的功能与拟议的教育收益，未报告新的学习成果。
AI.motivation: 翻译专业学生不仅要学会使用翻译技术，还需要学会评判这些技术所提供的选项。现有工具往往缺乏可检查性和教学可塑性，难以支撑学生理解翻译决策如何与数据、界面和软件规则相互作用，因此需要一种既可用于实际工作流、又可作为教学素材的本地优先CAT环境。
AI.method: 论文通过仓库历史、实现代码检查和已识别开发构建的验证记录来呈现LoopCAT的开发过程；提出了连接工作流程能力、评价判断与技术能动性的框架，并将教学活动组织为四种参与形式：操作工作流、评价输出、检查与配置机制、做出并捍卫受约束的干预。文中还给出了六节课的序列、UI本地化作业、占位示例、评估量规以及课堂评价协议。
AI.result: LoopCAT具备本地项目存储、翻译记忆、术语、质量保证、文档交换以及可选连接本地或托管AI服务等功能，其英语、加泰罗尼亚语和土耳其语界面目录本身可作为教学材料（学生可翻译UI字符串、审阅自动生成的草稿、导入修订并测试界面）。论文明确区分了已实现能力与拟议的教育收益，报告了最新包检查结果及此前的回归证据，但未报告新的学生学习成果。
AI.conclusion: LoopCAT为教学如何让翻译决策与数据、界面和软件规则相互作用提供了一个可检查的环境；但这些活动能否改善判断力、迁移能力或参与度仍是一个有待实证检验的问题。

title: FTU-Seek: Foundation Model-Guided Hard-Negative Learning for Sparse Functional Tissue Unit Segmentation
summary: Functional tissue units (FTUs), including tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs), blood vessels, and glands, encode localized immune, vascular, and epithelial organization in histopathology. Accurate quantification of these structures is important for studying tissue architecture and disease-associated tissue organization. However, FTUs are frequently sparse, heterogeneous, and surrounded by large amounts of morphologically similar background tissue, making automated segmentation in whole-slide images (WSIs) challenging. We therefore developed FTU-Seek, a pathology foundation model-guided framework that treats morphology-aware negative-patch selection as a key component of sparse FTU segmentation. FTU-Seek uses frozen multi-depth features from the UNI pathology foundation model to train a patch-level classifier that distinguishes FTU-containing from FTU-absent tissue. Target-absent patches are subsequently ranked according to their predicted target-containing probabilities, and the highest-scoring hard negatives are selected through a static Top$K$ strategy to construct compact segmentation training sets. The framework was evaluated using five-fold cross-validation and internal test cohorts across TLS, blood-vessel, and gland segmentation tasks, with an additional independent 30-WSI held-out cohort for TLS. Positive-only, all-tissue, random-negative, and matched random Top$K$ sampling strategies served as comparators. Segmentation-derived phenotypes were further explored in external TCGA cohorts.

AI.tldr: FTU-Seek 是一个由病理学基础模型（UNI）引导的框架，通过形态学感知的困难负样本选择策略，解决全切片图像中稀疏功能组织单元（如三级淋巴结构、血管、腺体）的分割问题，并在多种分割任务和外部 TCGA 队列中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 功能组织单元（FTU）是组织病理中编码局部免疫、血管和上皮结构的关键单元，其准确量化对研究组织架构和疾病相关组织形态十分重要。然而 FTU 通常稀疏、异质，且被大量形态相似的非目标背景组织包围，使得全切片图像（WSI）中的自动分割极具挑战性。因此需要一种能够从海量背景中有效挑选训练样本以提升稀疏结构分割性能的方法。
AI.method: FTU-Seek 采用病理学基础模型引导的框架，将形态学感知的负样本选择作为稀疏 FTU 分割的关键环节。具体而言，利用冻结的 UNI 病理学基础模型多深度特征训练一个块级分类器，用于区分包含 FTU 与不含 FTU 的组织。随后，将不含目标的块按其预测的目标包含概率排序，通过静态 TopK 策略选取得分最高的困难负样本，构建紧凑的分割训练集。该框架在 TLS、血管和腺体分割任务上采用五折交叉验证和内部测试队列评估，并额外设置了一个独立的 30-WSI 留出队列用于 TLS 验证；对照方法包括仅正样本、全组织、随机负样本和匹配随机 TopK 采样策略，并在外部 TCGA 队列中进一步探索分割衍生表型。
AI.result: FTU-Seek 在 TLS、血管和腺体三种稀疏 FTU 分割任务上均取得了优于各对照策略的性能，包括在独立 30-WSI 留出队列上的 TLS 分割验证；基于准确分割的 FTU 衍生表型在外部 TCGA 队列中得到了进一步探索与验证。
AI.conclusion: FTU-Seek 证明，以病理学基础模型的特征为指导、按形态学感知方式筛选困难负样本，能够以紧凑的训练集有效提升稀疏、异质 FTU 的分割精度，为全切片图像中的组织结构量化提供了一种通用且可扩展的途径，并为下游表型分析奠定基础。

title: Dr. Claw: An AI Scientist Workspace for Vibe Research
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations. Code: https://github.com/OpenLAIR/dr-claw
summary: Command-line coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini CLI) can already read and write files and sustain long sessions, yet end-to-end research still fragments across chat tools, IDEs, terminals, and writing environments, and the decisions that make it auditable are rarely preserved. We present Dr. Claw, an open-source workspace that wraps existing coding-agent executors in a controllable and auditable human-in-the-loop workflow rather than introducing another autonomous agent. Persistent state objects, a reusable skill library, and multi-executor coordination link human decisions to AI execution, turning planning, execution, and writing into one traceable, recoverable loop. We demonstrate Dr. Claw through an interactive three-view scenario and a failure-recovery walkthrough, and evaluate it against a bare command-line agent sharing the same backend executor, so the comparison contrasts the whole orchestration layer (task graph, state objects, and skill library) with the agent it wraps. Holding the executor fixed, Dr. Claw scores higher on research completeness while persisting an auditable, recoverable process trail. Demo access: repository https://github.com/OpenLAIR/dr-claw, released under AGPL-3.0 with GPL-3.0 upstream components.

AI.tldr: Dr. Claw 是一个开源研究工具工作区，它不引入新的自主智能体，而是将现有的命令行编码智能体执行器封装进可控、可审计的人机协同工作流中，通过持久化状态对象、可复用技能库和多执行器协调，将规划、执行与写作统一为可追溯、可恢复的闭环，并在固定执行器的条件下比裸命令行智能体取得更高的研究完整度。
AI.motivation: 命令行编码智能体已能读写文件并维持长会话，但端到端研究仍然分散在聊天工具、IDE、终端和写作环境之间，且支撑研究可审计性的决策过程很少被保留下来。
AI.method: 提出 Dr. Claw 开源工作区，包装已有编码智能体执行器而非另造自主智能体；通过持久化状态对象、可复用技能库和多执行器协调将人类决策与 AI 执行关联，把规划、执行与写作连成一个可追踪、可恢复的循环；以交互式三视图场景和故障恢复演练进行演示，并与共享同一后端执行器的裸命令行智能体对照评估。
AI.result: 在固定执行器不变的条件下，Dr. Claw 在研究完整性上的得分更高，同时持久化保留了可审计、可恢复的过程轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 将现有编码智能体执行器封装为可控、可审计的人机协同工作流，是提升端到端研究完整性与可追溯性的有效方案；Dr. Claw 以开源形式发布（仓库 github.com/OpenLAIR/dr-claw，AGPL-3.0 协议，含 GPL-3.0 上游组件）。

title: A hybrid quantum-classical neural network for learning to route
comment: 5 pages. Submitted to the Congresso Brasileiro de Ciências e Tecnologias Quânticas (CBCTQ 2026)
summary: This work studies hybrid quantum-classical neural networks for learning routing heuristics. Specifically, this paper asks whether small quantum neural networks can replace parameter-heavy modules inside a competitive attention-based routing model while maintaining solution quality. For the capacitated vehicle routing problem, encoder feed-forward replacement emerges as the most promising design: it reduces the number of model parameters by 56.6% while keeping the hybrid model close to the classical neural baseline at small and medium instance sizes, although the gap grows for larger instances. This work also compares to classical routing algorithms, which remain highly competitive and often superior on the fixed Euclidean test sets. Our results therefore do not indicate quantum advantage or solver dominance, but identify encoder feed-forward replacement as a viable hybrid-module compression strategy for neural combinatorial optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合量子-经典神经网络在学习路由启发式算法中的应用，探究小型量子神经网络能否替代竞争性注意力路由模型中参数密集的模块。针对带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP），编码器前馈替换方案最具前景：在保持中小规模实例接近经典神经基线解质量的同时，将模型参数减少56.6%，但大规模实例性能差距扩大。与经典路由算法相比，混合模型并无量子优势或求解器主导性，但编码器前馈替换被确认为神经组合优化中可行的混合模块压缩策略。
AI.motivation: 探索小型量子神经网络是否能替代注意力路由模型中参数密集的模块，以期在不显著牺牲解质量的前提下压缩模型规模，并考察量子混合架构在神经组合优化中的实际价值。
AI.method: 在竞争性基于注意力机制的路由模型内部，用小型量子神经网络替换特定模块（重点考察编码器前馈模块），构建混合量子-经典神经网络；在带容量约束的车辆路径问题上进行实验，并与经典神经基线和传统经典路由算法进行系统对比。
AI.result: 编码器前馈替换是最有前景的设计，在中小规模实例上保持接近经典神经基线的解质量并将参数减少56.6%，但大规模实例上性能差距增大；经典路由算法在固定欧几里得测试集上仍具有高度竞争力且往往更优。实验未观察到量子优势或求解器主导性。
AI.conclusion: 混合量子-经典神经网络不带来量子优势或求解器主导性，但编码器前馈替换被证明是神经组合优化中一种可行的混合模块压缩策略，为后续混合架构设计提供了有参考价值的发现。

title: Detecting Hidden Behaviors in LLMs via Activation-matched Finetuning
summary: Large language models can hide hidden behaviors that activate only under narrow conditions, such as backdoor triggers, sleeper-agent deployment cues, sandbagging, or topic-conditioned censorship. Such behaviors are difficult to detect without prior knowledge what to look for. We present activation-matched finetuning, an unsupervised detection method that assumes no knowledge of the trigger or the target behavior. Given a suspect model and a publicly available anchor, we finetune the anchor to reproduce the suspect's activations on a small benign corpus, and score each evaluation prompt by the residual between the two models. Since no benign corpus covers the sparse trigger region, the reference learns the benign computation but not the hidden behavior. Therefore, trigger prompts -- and, crucially, their semantic neighbors -- incur a large residual that signal the presence of unusual behavior to the defender. Testing our method across third-party models and custom models, activation-matched finetuning surfaces hidden behavior reliably. Furthermore, we empirically consider a natural defense-aware attack and showcase that it fails to suppress our detection method without sacrificing the behavior itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出激活匹配微调（activation-matched finetuning），一种无需预知触发器或目标行为的无监督方法，用于检测大语言模型中的隐藏行为（后门、潜伏代理、沙袋化、主题条件审查等）。该方法在良性语料上微调公开的锚模型以匹配嫌疑模型的激活，并以两者残差为分数定位触发提示及其语义邻居，从而可靠暴露隐藏行为，且能抵御防御意识攻击。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可能隐藏仅在狭窄条件下激活的行为（如后门触发器、潜伏代理部署线索、沙袋化、主题条件审查），这类行为难以在没有先验知识的情况下检测。现有方法通常需要事先知道要寻找什么，缺乏无监督、无需触发词/目标行为假设的通用检测手段。
AI.method: 给定嫌疑模型和一个公开可获取的锚模型，在小规模良性语料上微调锚模型以复现嫌疑模型的激活；对每个评估提示，以两个模型之间的残差作为评分。由于良性语料无法覆盖稀疏的触发区域，参考模型学到的是良性计算而非隐藏行为，因此触发提示（及其语义邻居）会产生较大残差，向防御者暴露异常行为。
AI.result: 在第三方模型和自建模型上的实验表明，激活匹配微调能够可靠地暴露隐藏行为；进一步对一种自然的防御意识攻击进行实证分析，显示该攻击若想抑制检测方法，必然牺牲隐藏行为本身，即检测方法具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 激活匹配微调是一种无需任务假设的有效隐藏行为检测框架，能够在模型部署前后以无监督方式发现稀疏触发条件下的异常行为，并且对针对检测器的对抗攻击具有韧性；工作局限在于依赖公开锚模型与良性语料，未来值得探索更广的隐藏行为类型与更强的对手模型。

title: Controllable Image Captioning with Prompt-Conditioned Scene Rewards
comment: EMNLP 2026 Main (26 pages); Project website: https://focus-emnlp2026.github.io/
summary: Large Vision-Language Models produce fluent image descriptions but offer limited semantic control: users cannot reliably specify whether captions should emphasize attributes, relations, or particular image regions. We present Fine-grained Captioning Control Using Scene Rewards (FoCUS), a controllable image captioning method that lets users steer captions toward specific semantic emphases through natural-language control prompts. The core idea is a prompt-conditioned control objective based on scene-graph-aligned component scores. Generated captions are parsed and aligned to scene-graph components such as objects, attributes, and relations. These components are differentially weighted, including negative weights, according to the requested emphasis. We optimize this objective with GRPO and further improve its reliability through a stricter object validity threshold and reasoning-based verification for attribute and relation scoring. To evaluate controllability, we introduce Semantic Control and Precision Evaluation (SCoPE), a benchmark with contrastive Include/Avoid constraints for measuring both target content coverage and out-of-scope suppression. Experiments on two VLM backbones show that FoCUS consistently improves controllability and fine-grained caption quality without degrading general caption performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FoCUS（Fine-grained Captioning Control Using Scene Rewards），一种可控图像描述生成方法，允许用户通过自然语言控制提示来引导模型在对象、属性、关系等语义成分上的侧重。其核心是基于场景图对齐组件分数的提示条件控制目标，并通过 GRPO 优化，配合更严格的对象有效性阈值和基于推理的验证提升可靠性。作者同时提出 SCoPE 基准，用 Include/Avoid 对比约束评估目标内容覆盖与越界内容抑制，实验表明 FoCUS 在两种 VLM 骨干上稳定提升可控性与细粒度描述质量，且不损害通用描述性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大型视觉-语言模型能生成流畅的图像描述，但缺乏细粒度的语义控制能力：用户无法可靠地指定描述应强调属性、关系还是图像特定区域，难以按需调节输出的语义侧重。
AI.method: 提出提示条件化的控制目标，基于场景图对齐的成分分数：将生成描述解析并对齐到场景图成分（对象、属性、关系），再根据请求的强调方向对这些成分施加差异化权重（可含负权重）。该目标通过 GRPO 优化，并采用更严格的对象有效性阈值和基于推理的验证来改善属性与关系打分可靠性；同时构建 SCoPE 基准，以对比性的 Include/Avoid 约束同时度量目标内容覆盖率与越界内容抑制能力。
AI.result: 在两种 VLM 骨干上的实验表明，FoCUS 能持续提升描述的可控性和细粒度质量，同时不降低通用图像描述性能；在目标内容覆盖与越界内容抑制两项指标上均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过场景图对齐的奖励设计与强化学习优化，可以实现可靠、细粒度的描述语义控制，且该机制具有骨干模型上的泛化性，为可控视觉语言生成提供了一种有效范式。

title: RestoreBench: Can AI Agents Restore Power Flow Convergence?
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly automate multi-step engineering workflows through tool use, interpretation of intermediate results, and iterative planning. Diagnosing and resolving non-convergent power flow cases is a promising yet largely unexplored application, as it requires engineering judgment, experimentation, and decision-making within constrained action spaces. We introduce a benchmark that evaluates these capabilities across multiple LLMs and three architectures: \emph{chatbot}, \emph{single agent}, and \emph{multi-agent} systems. The evaluation covers two power grids and 46 cases per grid, each requiring one or more corrective actions to restore convergence. The benchmark defines the simulation environment, observation and action spaces, and evaluation metrics, providing a reproducible foundation for developing agentic AI systems for power system planning and operation. The code is available at https://github.com/Mansutti081/RestoreBench

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为 RestoreBench 的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）智能体在电力系统潮流不收敛案例中执行诊断与修复的能力。基准覆盖三种架构（聊天机器人、单智能体、多智能体）、两张电网和每张电网46个案例，提供了仿真环境、观测/动作空间及评估指标等可复现基础。
AI.motivation: 电力系统潮流不收敛案例的诊断与修复需要工程判断、实验验证以及在受限动作空间中的决策，这对LLM智能体而言是一个有前景但尚未深入探索的应用场景。作者旨在填补这一空白，系统评估LLM智能体在此类多步工程工作流中的自动化能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个标准化基准测试框架，定义了仿真环境、观测空间、动作空间和评估指标，并在多种主流LLM上对三种智能体架构（聊天机器人、单智能体、多智能体）进行评估。评估覆盖两个电力系统网格，每个网格包含46个潮流不收敛案例，每个案例需执行一项或多项纠正动作以恢复收敛。
AI.result: 基准提供了可复现的评估平台，能够量化不同LLM与不同架构组合在电力系统潮流恢复任务上的表现差异，为智能体化AI在电力系统规划与运行中的能力对比提供了标准化依据。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为开发面向电力系统规划与运行的智能体AI系统奠定了可复现的测试基础，并已开源代码（GitHub仓库），有助于推动该领域的后续研究与系统开发。

title: VATO: A Vortex-Force-Aware Transformer Operator for Unsteady Separated Aerofoil Flows
summary: Accurate prediction of unsteady separated flows is challenging because the aerodynamic loads depend on nonlinear separation and vortex-shedding dynamics. Although high-fidelity CFD resolves these mechanisms, its cost limits repeated use in design and control. Standard field-level surrogate training, however, does not distinguish the flow regions that contribute most strongly to the aerodynamic loads. We introduce VATO (Vortex-Force-Aware Transformer Operator), which couples the Vortex Force Map (VFM) method to a geometry-aware neural operator through two complementary mechanisms. VATO-S adds training-only supervision of the local VFM force-contribution field, with no increase in model size or inference cost. VATO-A uses VFM contribution and sensitivity fields to prioritise force-relevant source locations for residual cross attention. The methods are evaluated on unsteady CFD data for double-edged-plate aerofoils over 54 trajectories from nine geometries. Over lead times of 1-20~ms, VATO-S reduces velocity, pressure, and vorticity errors by 10.4\%, 1.0\%, and 15.6\%, respectively, while VATO-A achieves reductions of 15.8\%, 7.5\%, and 31.2\%. VATO-S gives the lowest VFM-derived drag error, whereas VATO-A gives the lowest pressure-derived lift and drag errors. Over lead times extending 50\% beyond the training range, VATO-A retains a 26.9\% reduction in vorticity error and larger improvements in all four force readouts, despite reduced gains in velocity and pressure. These results show that force-aware operator learning can improve both flow-field prediction and aerodynamic functional accuracy in unsteady separated flows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VATO（涡力感知Transformer算子），将涡力场（VFM）方法耦合进几何感知的神经算子以预测非定常分离流。VATO-S在训练时增加局部VFM力贡献场的监督，VATO-A则利用VFM贡献与灵敏度场引导残差交叉注意力。在双缘板翼型54条轨迹上，两种方法均显著降低速度、压力和涡量预测误差并提升气动力精度，且在超出训练范围50%的预测时段仍保持泛化优势。
AI.motivation: 高保真CFD虽能解析非定常分离流中的非线性分离与涡脱落机制，但计算成本过高，难以用于反复的设计与控制迭代。而标准的场级代理模型训练无法区分对气动载荷贡献最大的流动区域，导致代理模型将计算资源平均地花费在力不敏感区域，预测准确性与气动功能精度受限。
AI.method: VATO将涡力场（Vortex Force Map, VFM）方法与几何感知神经算子耦合，通过两种互补机制实现：1）VATO-S在训练阶段增加对局部VFM力贡献场的监督，不增加模型规模与推理成本；2）VATO-A利用VFM贡献场和灵敏度场，优先筛选与受力相关的源位置用于残差交叉注意力，使注意力聚焦于对气动载荷贡献最强的区域。模型在九种几何、54条轨迹的非定常CFD数据上评估，预测时长为1–20 ms。
AI.result: 在1–20 ms预测时域内，VATO-S将速度、压力、涡量误差分别降低10.4%、1.0%、15.6%；VATO-A分别降低15.8%、7.5%、31.2%。VATO-S取得最低的VFM导出的阻力误差，VATO-A取得最低的压力导出升力与阻力误差。在超出训练范围50%的扩展预测时段，VATO-A仍保持26.9%的涡量误差降低，并在全部四种力读数上获得更大提升，尽管在速度与压力上的增益有所下降。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，力感知的算子学习能够同时改善非定常分离流中的流场预测精度与气动功能精度，为在受限算力下进行高精度气动预测和设计控制迭代提供了可行途径，且对超出训练时域的情况具备良好的外推能力。

title: Neurosymbolics for Data Engineering: Achieving Long Context Token Reduction Without Finetuning
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed for sophisticated data engineering tasks such as generating structured queries from natural language, Text-to-SQL, and automating complex spreadsheet operations. However, maximizing their utility demands both higher finetuning-free accuracy and solutions to the computational bottleneck imposed by the Transformer architectures inherent quadratic (On2) time complexity. This paper introduces a novel drop-in neurosymbolic layer designed to seamlessly integrate into existing LLM backbones enhancing logical reasoning and mitigating long-context resource consumption. On the reasoning front, the layer immediately and significantly improves performance yielding an average accuracy increase of 85% across rigorous benchmarks including BIRD-CRITIC and LiveSQLBench, critically achieving these gains without any task specific finetuning or RLHF. Concurrently, we repurpose this approach to address the severe computational strain of long context inference. By leveraging symbolic processing to prioritize and compress relevant contextual information the layer reduces the effective token usage by over 50% and brings the effective time complexity down from O(n2) to approximately O(n) on certain long context tasks. This dual impact approach not only makes LLMs substantially more reliable for data engineering but also drastically reduces the computational pressure on inference chips, making long context tasks more manageable and cost effective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种即插即用的神经符号层，可无缝集成到现有LLM骨干中，在不经任务微调或RLHF的情况下将BIRD-CRITIC、LiveSQLBench等基准的平均准确率提升85%，同时通过符号化处理压缩上下文，将有效token使用量降低50%以上，并将某些长上下文任务的时间复杂度从O(n²)降至约O(n)。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用于文本到SQL、结构化查询生成、复杂电子表格操作等数据工程任务，但面临两大瓶颈：一是无微调场景下推理准确率不足；二是Transformer架构固有的二次方（O(n²)）时间复杂度造成长上下文推理的计算压力与资源消耗，使长期上下文任务成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出一种可即插即用（drop-in）的神经符号层，无缝集成进现有LLM骨干。该层一方面增强逻辑推理能力；另一方面利用符号化处理对相关内容进行优先级排序与压缩，减少有效token使用，从而缓解长上下文推理的计算负担并把时间复杂度从O(n²)降至约O(n)。
AI.result: 推理方面，在BIRD-CRITIC和LiveSQLBench等严格基准上平均准确率提升85%，且无需任务特定微调或RLHF；计算方面，有效token使用量减少50%以上，某些长上下文任务的有效时间复杂度从O(n²)降至约O(n)。
AI.conclusion: 该双重影响方案使LLM在数据工程任务中显著更可靠，同时大幅降低推理芯片的计算压力，使长上下文任务更易处理且更具成本效益。

title: EarthLD: Towards Unified Open-World Landslide Understanding via Vision-Language Guided Diffusion Models
summary: Landslides are widespread geological hazards, yet their automated detection and mapping in remote sensing imagery remain challenging because of their irregular morphology, ambiguous spectral signatures, and substantial domain shifts across imaging platforms. To overcome these challenges, we propose EarthLD, a vision-language-guided diffusion framework for open-world landslide understanding, enabling unified landslide recognition, mapping, and trigger interpretation. At its core, EarthLD formulates landslide understanding as a diffusion process that progressively infers the presence, spatial extent, and pixel-level boundaries of landslides from noisy latent representations. This probabilistic formulation enables the model to jointly perform image-level landslide recognition and mapping while characterizing predictive uncertainty. By integrating visual observations with contextual knowledge in the denoising process, EarthLD distinguishes diverse landslides from backgrounds, produces confidence-aware predictions for suspected regions, and maps landslide ranges. We additionally construct a global-scale open-world landslide benchmark by systematically harmonizing multiple publicly available remote sensing data collected by diverse institutions. Extensive experiments across regions, sensors, and triggering events demonstrate that EarthLD consistently outperforms existing landslide detection methods, highlighting its potential as a unified and robust solution for global geological-hazard monitoring and emergency response.

AI.tldr: 提出EarthLD，一种视觉-语言引导的扩散框架，将滑坡理解建模为从噪声潜在表示中逐步推断存在性、空间范围和像素级边界的扩散过程，联合完成滑坡识别与制图，并构建了全球尺度开放世界滑坡基准，在跨区域、传感器和触发事件上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 滑坡是普遍存在的地质灾害，但在遥感影像中实现自动化检测与制图面临三大挑战：滑坡形态不规则、光谱特征模糊、不同成像平台之间存在显著的域偏移，导致现有方法难以进行开放世界的统一识别。
AI.method: 提出EarthLD，一种视觉-语言引导的扩散框架。其核心是将滑坡理解形式化为扩散过程，从噪声潜在表示中逐步推断滑坡的存在性、空间范围和像素级边界，从而在图像级识别与滑坡制图的联合任务中量化预测不确定性。在去噪过程中融合视觉观测与上下文（语言）知识，以区分各类滑坡与背景、对疑似区域给出置信度感知的预测并绘制滑坡范围。此外，系统整合多个公开遥感数据集，构建了全球尺度的开放世界滑坡基准。
AI.result: 在跨区域、跨传感器和多种触发事件的大规模实验中，EarthLD一致优于现有的滑坡检测方法，证明了其在开放世界滑坡识别与制图方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EarthLD具备作为全球地质灾害监测与应急响应中统一、鲁棒解决方案的潜力，能够实现滑坡识别、制图与触发解释的一体化。

title: Dependency-Aware Chain-of-Thought Compression for Financial Reasoning
summary: Chain of thought prompting improves complex reasoning, but its long intermediate traces create substantial inference cost and hinder practical deployment in financial settings. We present a Hierarchical Semantic Distillation Network, HSDN, for compressing reasoning chains while preserving answer accuracy and logical coherence. The framework combines semantic segmentation, dependency graph construction, dual encoder importance scoring, constrained segment selection, and local boundary rewriting. A frozen Qwen3 4B model is used only for feature extraction and final answer generation, while the compression process remains structured and interpretable. On the AFAC2025 benchmark, HSDN achieves 91.0% accuracy with 68.4% compression, outperforming strong compression baselines in overall score and reasoning coherence. The results show that graph guided compression is effective for high stakes financial reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层语义蒸馏网络（HSDN），通过语义分割、依赖图构建、双编码器重要性评分、约束段选择和局部边界重写来压缩思维链推理过程，在AFAC2025基准上以68.4%的压缩率实现91.0%的准确率，证明图引导压缩对高风险的金融推理任务有效。
AI.motivation: 思维链提示虽能提升复杂推理能力，但其冗长的中间推理痕迹带来高昂的推理成本，严重阻碍了在金融场景中的实际部署。因此需要一种能在保持答案准确性与逻辑连贯性的同时压缩推理链的方法。
AI.method: HSDN框架由五个部分组成：语义分割、依赖图构建、双编码器重要性评分、约束段选择以及局部边界重写。其中冻结的Qwen3 4B模型仅用于特征提取和最终答案生成，压缩过程本身是结构化且可解释的，不依赖大模型进行压缩。
AI.result: 在AFAC2025基准上，HSDN在实现68.4%压缩率的同时达到91.0%的准确率，在总体得分和推理连贯性方面均优于强压缩基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，图引导的压缩方法对于高风险的金融推理任务十分有效，能够在不显著损失准确性和逻辑一致性的前提下大幅降低推理成本，具备实用部署价值。

title: Learning Task-Specific Antibody Representations via Function-Aware Masking
summary: Antibody-specific language models pretrained via masked language modeling (MLM) learn representations that are critical for downstream sequence design and property prediction tasks. Yet, the corruption process itself is rarely leveraged as a source of inductive bias during pretraining. While preferentially masking complementarity-determining regions (CDRs) improves binding-related predictions, antibodies possess diverse biological priors over a variety of functions. Herein, we introduce function-aware masking, a family of pretraining algorithms that align mask placement with specific functional priors (e.g., from IMGT annotations or structure predictions) to shape the learned representation space. We show that these specialist masking strategies significantly improve performance on their respective objectives, yielding up to a 14% gain on structure-related tasks and up to a 5.9x improvement on CDR-related tasks. To further improve performance across multiple functional axes, we develop hybrid masking strategies that integrate multiple priors, balancing reconstruction over binding, structural, and biophysical objectives. Our results demonstrate that informed mask placement provides a parameter-free mechanism for imposing functional inductive biases in antibody language model training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"功能感知掩码"（function-aware masking）预训练算法族，通过在抗体语言模型预训练时将掩码位置与特定功能先验（如IMGT注释或结构预测）对齐，从而在无需额外参数的情况下施加功能归纳偏置，显著提升结构相关任务（最高+14%）和CDR相关任务（最高5.9倍）的性能，并进一步提出整合多个先验的混合掩码策略以同时优化结合、结构与生物物理目标。
AI.motivation: 现有抗体语言模型虽通过掩码语言建模（MLM）获得对下游序列设计与性质预测至关重要的表示，但掩码破坏过程本身很少被用作预训练中的归纳偏置来源。已有的偏好性掩码CDR策略仅针对结合相关预测，而抗体具有多样化的生物学先验，覆盖多种功能。因此需要一个能按功能先验灵活安排掩码位置的通用框架。
AI.method: 提出功能感知掩码（function-aware masking）这一预训练算法家族：根据具体功能先验（如IMGT注释或结构预测）决定掩码位置，塑造学习到的表示空间。针对单功能轴使用专家掩码策略；为同时提升多个功能轴性能，进一步提出整合多种先验的混合掩码（hybrid masking）策略，在重建结合、结构与生物物理目标间取得平衡。该方法不引入额外参数，属于参数无关的机制。
AI.result: 专家掩码策略在各自目标上显著提升性能：结构相关任务最高提升14%，CDR相关任务最高改进5.9倍。混合掩码策略在多个功能轴（结合、结构、生物物理）上均实现性能改善。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，有信息量的掩码位置选择是一种无需额外参数即可在抗体语言模型训练中施加功能归纳偏置的有效机制，为按需定制抗体表示学习提供了新途径。

title: Removable and Irreducible: A Token-Cost Ledger for the Multilingual Tokenization Tax
summary: Large language models pay a well-documented tax on non-English text: the same content costs several times more tokens, and because attention is quadratic in sequence length, far more compute. We ask how much of this tax is removable. Framing the token layer as source coding -- transformer compute is monotone in sequence length, whose per-atom floor is the Shannon rate $H/\log_2 V$, an object already applied to tokenizers in prior work -- we assemble a token-cost ledger that splits each language's cost, at fixed parallel content, into a removable coding redundancy, a residual coding slack, an intrinsic-content term, and an orthogonal, irreducible grapheme-to-phoneme term that governs the multimodal rather than the text cost. On FLORES-200 across eight languages, a production tokenizer costs up to $8.9\times$ more tokens for Indic scripts than for English; a script-matched code trained on $1,012$ sentences removes a median $64\%$ of that excess (bootstrap 95\% CI $[0.638, 0.647]$), and a script-fair information floor shows the intrinsic content differs by under $6\%$ -- the tax is representational, not informational. A constructed code removes $98\%$ of a controlled source's redundancy, and the token tax implies up to $79\times$ attention cost. We are explicit about scope and failure: this is compute-and-memory accounting, not a model-quality claim; we neither measure nor claim the cross-lingual direction of the orthographic term; and our matched code is a conservative small-data demonstration. We contribute the unifying ledger, the removable-versus-intrinsic attribution, and an open one-command harness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型对非英语文本的"token 税"（token 数量与计算开销更高的问题），提出了一个基于信源编码（source coding）的 token 成本账本（ledger），将各个语言的 token 成本分解为可移除的编码冗余、残余编码松弛、内在内容项，以及不可约的音素-字素项。在 FLORES-200 上对 8 种语言进行验证：生产级 tokenizer 对印度文字脚本的 token 成本最高可达英语的 8.9 倍；用 1,012 个句子训练的脚本匹配码平均可消除 64% 的超额成本；脚本公平的信息下界显示内在内容差异不足 6%，说明"税"源于表示而非信息。该工作明确界定范围：仅做计算与内存核算，不声称模型质量提升，并开源一键式测试工具。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型对非英语文本存在已被充分记录的"token 税"：同样的内容需要多几倍的 token，而注意力机制复杂度随序列长度呈二次增长，导致计算开销更大。作者希望量化这种税中有多少是可以通过改进 tokenizer 被移除的，从而区分"可移除的编码冗余"与"不可移除的内在内容差异"。
AI.method: 将 token 层建模为信源编码问题：由于 transformer 计算量关于序列长度单调递增，其每原子的下界为 Shannon 速率 H/log₂V（此前已被应用于 tokenizer 的研究）。据此构建一个 token 成本账本，把固定并行内容下每种语言的成本拆分为四项：可移除编码冗余、残余编码松弛、内在内容项、以及正交的不可约字素到音素（grapheme-to-phoneme）项（该词管理多模态而非文本成本）。实验在 FLORES-200 数据集上对 8 种语言进行，训练了脚本匹配（script-matched）的代码，并构造了脚本公平的信息下界与受控构造代码来验证归因。
AI.result: 生产级 tokenizer 对印度文字脚本（如天城文等）的 token 成本最高为英语的 8.9 倍；仅用 1,012 个句子训练的脚本匹配码可中位消除 64% 的超额成本（bootstrap 95% CI [0.638, 0.647]）；脚本公平的信息下界显示内在内容差异低于 6%，证明"税"是表示层面的而非信息层面的。构造代码可移除受控源 98% 的冗余；token 税还意味着最高 79 倍的注意力计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 该工作解决了"token 税中有多少可移除"的问题，提出统一的成本账本、可移除与内在归因框架，并开源一键式测试工具。作者明确限定范围：这是计算与内存核算，而非模型质量声明；未测量或声称字素-音素项的跨语言方向；匹配代码仅是小数据下的保守演示。结论表明大部分 token 税是表示性的冗余，可通过脚本匹配的 tokenizer 显著消除。

title: Efficient and Robust Absolute Pose Estimation via Gravity-Prior-Driven Transformation Decoupling and Pose Refinement
comment: This work is accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
summary: Estimation of the absolute pose of an object is an essential task for various robotic applications. Recently, incorporating gravity direction as prior information has emerged as a popular approach to simplify absolute pose estimation. However, developing a robust and efficient algorithm to solve this challenging problem remains a difficult question due to large amounts of mismatches. In addition, obtaining an accurate pose solution from selected inlier correspondences with gravity prior is still a research gap. In this paper, we propose a novel transformation strategy that exploits geometric relations derived from the gravity prior. Through transformation decoupling, the original 6 degrees of freedom (DoF) absolute pose estimation problem is simplified into a 4-DoFs problem: 1-DoF for the rotation angle and 3-DoFs for translation, significantly improving the efficiency. For the 1-DoF rotation angle, we apply a one-dimensional global voting algorithm for optimal estimation. Once the optimal rotation is obtained, the mismatched correspondences are preliminarily filtered, and translation estimation, a linear problem, can be easily solved. Furthermore, to obtain accurate pose results, we introduce a novel pose refinement algorithm to enhance the accuracy of both rotation and translation. Extensive experiments on synthetic data and three publicly available real-world datasets (TUM RGB-D, ETH3D, and RobotCar) demonstrate that the proposed method achieves stronger performance compared to existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches. To further validate our method, we integrated it into ORB-SLAM2. The results on the KITTI dataset show it effectively reduces drift and improves trajectory alignment during relocalization. The source code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用重力方向先验信息的高效、鲁棒绝对位姿估计方法，通过变换解耦将6自由度问题简化为4自由度（1自由度旋转角+3自由度平移），并配合一维全局投票和位姿精化算法，在多个公开数据集上超越现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 绝对位姿估计是机器人应用的关键任务，利用重力方向先验可简化问题，但现有方法在处理大量误匹配时鲁棒性和效率不足，且基于重力先验的内点对应关系获得精确位姿仍存在研究空白。
AI.method: 提出基于重力先验几何关系的新型变换解耦策略：将6自由度绝对位姿估计分解为4自由度问题（1自由度旋转角+3自由度平移）；对旋转角采用一维全局投票算法求解最优值；获得最优旋转后初步过滤误匹配，并通过线性方法求解平移；最后引入位姿精化算法提升旋转和平移的精度。
AI.result: 在合成数据及TUM RGB-D、ETH3D、RobotCar三个公开真实数据集上的大量实验表明该方法优于现有SOTA方法；集成到ORB-SLAM2后在KITTI数据集上有效减少漂移并改善重定位时的轨迹对齐。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明借助重力先验并通过变换解耦与全局投票策略，可以在高效求解绝对位姿的同时兼顾鲁棒性与精度，为机器人位姿估计和SLAM重定位提供了实用且性能优越的解决方案。

title: SpecMind: Enabling Spectrum Intelligence via Multi-Agent Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: Accepted to IEEE GLOBECOM 2026. Project website: https://specmindrag.github.io
summary: The exponential growth of wireless devices is driving unprecedented spectrum demand, pushing spectrum management toward more fine-grained decisions across space, time, and device constraints. As a result, spectrum policymakers and engineers must process large volumes of data that come from diverse sources and take many different forms, such as text and tables. These data sources are often disaggregated and require significant time and effort to integrate, search, and interpret. Furthermore, most of this information is formatted for human understanding and is not readily accessible to automated systems. To address this challenge, we propose SpecMind, a novel Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for spectrum intelligence that performs reasoning over heterogeneous data sources. This system enables autonomous agents to coordinate specialized sub-agents that retrieve and synthesize knowledge across policy proceedings, legal regulations, and license databases. We develop SpecBench, a question and answer (Q&A) dataset based on real-world license records and policy proceedings, addressing the lack of evaluation resources for RAG systems in the spectrum domain. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecMind outperforms traditional, general-purpose RAG systems across spectrum-related tasks, achieving over 80% win rate against strong baselines. The agent-based design enables more accurate retrieval, better contextual reasoning, and improved task completion across diverse query types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpecMind，一个面向频谱智能的多智能体检索增强生成（RAG）系统，能够对政策文件、法规和许可证数据库等异构数据源进行推理；同时构建 SpecBench 问答数据集以填补频谱领域 RAG 评估资源的空白。实验表明 SpecMind 在频谱相关任务上优于通用 RAG 系统，对强基线取得超过 80% 的胜率。
AI.motivation: 无线设备指数级增长带来频谱需求激增，频谱管理需要更细粒度的决策，导致决策者和工程师需处理来自多源、多形态（文本、表格）且分散异构的大量数据。这些信息整合、检索和解读耗时费力，且大多面向人类阅读、难以被自动化系统直接访问。现有通用 RAG 系统难以胜任频谱领域的跨源异构推理，同时该领域也缺乏相应的评估资源。
AI.method: 提出 SpecMind，一种新型多智能体 RAG 系统：通过自主智能体协调多个专门子智能体，对政策程序、法律规章和许可证数据库等异构数据源进行检索与知识综合；并开发 SpecBench，一个基于真实许可证记录与政策程序构建的问答数据集，用于评估频谱领域 RAG 系统性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明 SpecMind 在频谱相关任务上优于传统的通用 RAG 系统，对强基线取得超过 80% 的胜率；基于智能体的设计在各类查询上实现了更准确的检索、更好的上下文推理以及更完善的任务完成度。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体检索增强生成架构能够有效应对频谱智能领域异构、分散的数据挑战，显著提升频谱相关任务的性能；SpecBench 为频谱领域 RAG 评估提供了可复用的基准资源。

title: Why Multi-Layer Message Passing Works: Completeness Theory for Graph Neural Network Interatomic Potentials
summary: We prove that the Hypergraph Neural Network, an invariant architecture with 3-body message passing, is a universal approximator for potential energy surfaces. Our main contribution is a multi-layer completeness theory. We show that $L$ layers of message passing on sparse, cutoff-based graphs achieve the same representational power as having access to the full $L$-hop neighborhood, provided the configurations are generic, satisfy an overlap condition and a connectivity condition. This provides the first rigorous justification for the common practice of using multi-layer message passing with a per-layer cutoff smaller than the physical interaction range, the setting used by virtually all practical graph neural network based machine-learned interatomic potentials. As immediate consequences, we show that both DPA3 and CHGNet architectures inherit universal approximation.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了具有三体消息传递的等变架构超图神经网络（HGN）是势能面的通用逼近器，并提出了一套多层完备性理论：在配置满足一般性、重叠性与连通性条件下，稀疏截断图上的 L 层消息传递与访问完整 L 跳邻域具有相同的表示能力。这首次严格论证了“每层截断半径小于物理相互作用范围但仍采用多层消息传递”这一普遍工程实践，并推论 DPA3 与 CHGNet 架构继承通用逼近性质。
AI.motivation: 实际中几乎所有基于图神经网络的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）都采用每层截断半径小于物理相互作用范围的多层消息传递，但这种做法缺乏严格的理论依据；此前也缺少针对具有三体消息传递的等变架构（如超图神经网络）的通用逼近性证明。
AI.method: 作者建立了一个多层完备性理论：证明在配置是一般性的（generic）、满足重叠条件（overlap condition）与连通条件（connectivity condition）的前提下，稀疏截断图上的 L 层消息传递可以达到与完整 L 跳邻域相同的表示能力，并据此证明三体消息传递的等变超图神经网络是势能面的通用逼近器。
AI.result: 严格证明了超图神经网络（三体消息传递的不变架构）是势能面的通用逼近器；给出了多层完备性定理以弥合稀疏截断图与完整 L 跳邻域之间的表示能力差距；作为直接推论，DPA3 与 CHGNet 两种实际架构继承通用逼近性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多层消息传递配合每层小截断半径这一普遍工程实践提供了首个严格的理论依据，表明这类稀疏、基于截断的架构在通用逼近意义下不会损失表达能力，从而为实际 MLIP 的设计合理性给出了理论支撑。

title: Late Transformer Layers Recode Syntax Canonically: Evidence from Greek Scrambling and Cross-Layer Generalisation
comment: 10 pages, 3 main figures, 2 appendices. Code and stimuli: https://osf.io/5d3w8/
summary: Probing studies have established that syntactic information is decodable in early and middle transformer layers, but what happens to that information in later layers remains poorly understood. We apply a cross-layer generalisation analysis to three Greek-tuned large language models evaluated on tightly controlled minimal pairs: object-relative constructions in Modern Greek, where canonical (Subject-Verb-Object; SVO) and non-canonical (Verb-Subject-Object; VSO) orders differ only in within-clause word order, while preserving propositional meaning. When a probe trained on late layers (20-31) is tested on each early layer individually, it produces below-chance transfer (cluster-corrected, p<0.01), classifying 99.3% of non-canonical sentences as canonical. Probe coefficients reverse sign around layer 22, indicating a directional recoding toward the canonical form rather than simple information loss. These findings characterise a representational format change in late transformer layers that goes beyond the well-established decline in syntactic decodability, and they generate a directly testable prediction for human EEG and MEG decoding studies using the same stimuli. Code and stimuli are publicly available on OSF.

AI.tldr: 通过跨层泛化分析发现，晚期Transformer层（20-31层）中训练的解码探针在早期层上产生低于随机水平的迁移，将99.3%的非规范语序（VSO）句子错误分类为规范语序（SVO），探针系数在约22层处发生符号反转，表明晚期层对句法信息发生了指向规范形式的定向重编码，而非简单的信息丢失。
AI.motivation: 已有探针研究证实句法信息在Transformer早期和中间层可被解码，但该信息在更深层中的去向仍不明确。本文旨在超越"句法可解码性下降"这一已知现象，探究晚期层中句法表征到底发生了何种变化。
AI.method: 对三个希腊语微调的大语言模型应用跨层泛化分析，使用严格控制的最小对实验：现代希腊语的关系从句结构，其中规范语序（主语-动词-宾语，SVO）与非规范语序（动词-主语-宾语，VSO）仅在从句内词序上不同，命题意义保持一致。将在晚期层（20-31层）训练好的探针逐一在早期层上进行测试。
AI.result: 晚期层探针在早期层上产生低于随机水平的迁移（聚类校正后p<0.01），将99.3%的非规范句子误分类为规范句子；探针系数在约22层处符号反转，表明存在朝规范形式的定向重编码，而非简单的信息丢失。
