AI.conclusion: 这些发现刻画了晚期Transformer层中一种表征格式的转变，这超出了此前已有共识的"句法可解码性下降"现象；同时为使用相同刺激的人类EEG和MEG解码研究提供了一个可直接检验的预测。代码和刺激材料已在OSF上公开。

title: Design and Implementation of a Kalman Filter-Infused Algorithm for Tilt Estimation
summary: Accurate tilt angle estimation is important in many engineering applications, such as robotics, motion tracking, and embedded control systems. However, measurements from low-cost inertial sensors are often degraded by noise and drift. This paper presents a single-axis tilt angle estimation system based on the MPU6050 inertial measurement unit, implemented on an RP2040 microcontroller platform, with sensor fusion achieved through a Kalman filter. The accelerometer provides a direct estimate of tilt angle from gravity but is sensitive to noise and short-term fluctuations. The gyroscope provides smooth angular rate measurements, but integration over time introduces drift. To overcome these limitations, a Kalman filter is used to combine measurements from both sensors, leveraging the long-term stability of the accelerometer and the short-term smoothness of the gyroscope. Both simulation and hardware experiments are performed. In simulation, sensor noise and drift are modeled to evaluate the filter performance under control conditions. In the hardware implementation, real-time MPU6050 data is acquired and processed by the RP2040 platform, and the estimated tilt angle is compared with accelerometer-only and gyroscope-only outputs. The results show that the proposed method effectively reduces noise measurements and suppresses long-term drift while preserving good dynamic response. Overall, the system provides more stable and accurate tilt estimation than either sensor alone, demonstrating a practical and accessible approach for Kalman filter based sensor fusion in embedded application.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于MPU6050惯性测量单元和RP2040微控制器的单轴倾角估计系统，利用卡尔曼滤波器融合加速度计与陀螺仪数据。仿真与硬件实验表明，该方法能有效降低噪声、抑制长期漂移并保持良好的动态响应，比单独使用任一传感器更稳定、更准确。
AI.motivation: 倾角估计在机器人、运动跟踪和嵌入式控制系统等工程应用中具有重要意义，但低成本惯性传感器测量常受噪声和漂移影响：加速度计对噪声和短期波动敏感，陀螺仪积分会引入随时间累积的漂移。因此需要一种融合两种传感器优势的可靠倾角估计方法。
AI.method: 设计了一个基于MPU6050与RP2040平台的单轴倾角估计系统。利用加速度计基于重力直接估计倾角（长期稳定），利用陀螺仪提供平滑角速率（短时平滑），并通过卡尔曼滤波器融合两者，以扬长避短。在仿真中建立噪声与漂移模型以控制条件下评估滤波性能；在硬件实验中实时采集MPU6050数据，并将估计结果与仅用加速度计和仅用陀螺仪的输出进行对比。
AI.result: 结果表明，所提方法能有效降低测量噪声、抑制长期漂移，同时保持良好的动态响应。与单独使用任一传感器相比，系统提供的倾角估计更稳定、更准确，验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该系统展现了一种实用且易于实现的基于卡尔曼滤波的传感器融合方法，适用于嵌入式应用中的倾角估计，为低成本惯性传感器在实际工程场景中的应用提供了可行方案。

title: SAGE: State-Grounded, Abstention-Aware Evaluation of Task-Oriented Dialogue Agents
summary: Evaluating task-oriented dialogue agents requires judging not merely whether a reply reads well but whether each turn advances the underlying workflow state correctly--a distinction conventional holistic LLM judges can miss because they evaluate the available context as a single unit and require one or more full-model calls per turn. We propose SAGE (State-Grounded Abstention-Aware Evaluation), which compiles a workflow specification and per-turn state diff into atomic, schema-grounded criteria and routes each through a cascade of symbolic and encoder/NLI verifiers that abstain rather than guess, aggregating criterion verdicts into a turn-level decision with an evidence trace. Its recommended operating point, SAGE-Core, decides 81--91% of criteria with only the compiler, symbolic rules, and on-device encoders--at zero paid LLM cost--while SAGE-LLM adds an optional focused-LLM fallback for open-class criteria. Across four slices spanning MultiWOZ, Schema-Guided Dialogue, and ABCD, no evaluated LLM-as-a-judge baseline--including a state-aware GPT-4.1 judge and cheaper GPT-4.1-mini variants--significantly exceeds SAGE-Core on any slice, even though the GPT-4.1 G-Eval judge costs $4.7--8.0 per 1,000 turns to SAGE-Core's $0. A two-annotator human audit (n=200, $κ$=0.94) confirms strong label fidelity on the transcript-visible failure classes--where, excluding the weak-salience IUV class, SAGE-Core is statistically tied with the strongest LLM judge--and honestly scopes ignored-user-value as a state-consistency signal with weak broad-human salience. We analyze construct-validity limits from injected failures and partial symbolic circularity.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAGE（State-Grounded Abstention-Aware Evaluation），一种面向任务型对话智能体的状态感知评估框架：它将工作流规范与逐轮状态差异编译为原子化、基于 schema 的判据，并通过“符号规则+编码器/NLI 验证器”的级联流水线处理，采用“弃权而非猜测”的策略，最终聚合成带证据轨迹的轮级决策。默认运行点 SAGE-Core 以零付费 LLM 成本解决 81–91% 的判据，且在 MultiWOZ、SGD、ABCD 四个切片上不被任何 LLM 评委基线显著超越。
AI.motivation: 任务型对话智能体的评估不能只看回复是否读起来自然，还要判断每一轮是否正确推进底层工作流状态。传统的整体式 LLM 评委把可用上下文当作单一单元整体评分，无法捕捉细粒度的状态推进正确性，且每轮需要一次或多次完整模型调用，成本高。
AI.method: SAGE 将工作流规范与逐轮状态差异（state diff）编译成原子化的、以 schema 为根基的判据；每条判据经符号规则与编码器/NLI 验证器构成的级联流程路由处理，验证器在不确定时选择弃权而非猜测；最后把所有判据裁决聚合成带证据轨迹的轮级决策。推荐运行点 SAGE-Core 仅使用编译器、符号规则和端侧编码器（零付费 LLM 成本），SAGE-LLM 则对开放类别判据增加可选的聚焦式 LLM 兜底。
AI.result: SAGE-Core 以零付费 LLM 成本裁决 81–91% 的判据。在覆盖 MultiWOZ、Schema-Guided Dialogue 和 ABCD 的四个切片上，没有任何 LLM-as-a-judge 基线（包括具备状态感知能力的 GPT-4.1 评委及更便宜的 GPT-4.1-mini 变体）能在任一切片上显著超越 SAGE-Core，而 GPT-4.1 G-Eval 每 1,000 轮成本为 $4.7–8.0，SAGE-Core 为 $0。两标注者人工审计（n=200，κ=0.94）在可见转写失败类别上确认了强标签保真度：排除弱显著性 IUV 类别后，SAGE-Core 与最强 LLM 评委统计持平。
AI.conclusion: SAGE 以远低于 LLM 评委的成本实现了可比的、基于状态接地的高保真任务型对话评估，并通过弃权机制诚实划定自身能力边界：将 ignored-user-value（IUV）明示为状态一致性信号中弱普适显著性的一类，同时分析注入失败与部分符号循环性所带来的构念效度限制。

title: DeSyR: A Decoupled Symbolic Recovery Framework with PINN-Guided Structure Search and Physics-Informed Coefficient Refinement
summary: Recovering compact explicit solutions from neural approximations is challenging when imperfect teacher data guide symbolic topology search and coefficient estimation. We present DeSyR, a decoupled symbolic recovery framework for differential equations. A physics-informed neural network guides repeated searches to construct candidate topologies with provisional constants. Once a topology is fixed, its coefficients are refined solely from the governing equation and prescribed constraints, followed by gated selection and verification. For linear fixed-topology parameterizations, we characterize teacher-error inheritance and show that finite-weight mixed data--physics fitting retains an $O(β^{-1})$ teacher-dependent contribution when the teacher error projects onto the model space. Under well-posedness, representability, zero-residual attainment, and discrete determinacy, physics-only refinement conditionally recovers exact coefficients; for nonlinear parameterizations, the corresponding guarantees are local. DeSyR is evaluated on 15 differential-equation problems across 18 configurations covering high-order, space--time, multidimensional, nonlinear, and coupled systems. A candidate-level audit yields a 99.23% convergence rate among free-parameter refits, while every selected refinement involving free coefficients converges. Configuration-level median refined relative $L_2$ errors are $2.31\times10^{-14}$ or lower. In same-topology comparisons, refinement reduces error by eight to fourteen orders of magnitude. These results show that an approximate neural teacher can guide topology discovery without imposing its error scale on final recovered coefficients, provided a target-capable topology is retained and physics-only refinement converges.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeSyR，一种用于微分方程符号恢复的解耦框架：先用物理信息神经网络指导候选拓扑搜索并暂定系数，再固定拓扑后仅依据控制方程与约束精化系数，配合门控选择与验证，从而在近似神经教师引导发现拓扑的同时避免其误差污染最终系数。
AI.motivation: 从不完美的神经近似中恢复紧凑的显式解析解十分困难，因为教师数据本身存在误差，会同时干扰符号拓扑搜索和系数估计，导致最终恢复的解既可能在结构上出错，也可能在系数上继承教师误差。
AI.method: 提出解耦符号恢复框架 DeSyR：① 物理信息神经网络引导重复搜索以构造带暂定常数的候选拓扑；② 拓扑固定后，仅由控制方程和给定约束精化系数；③ 采用门控选择与验证。理论上刻画了线性固定拓扑参数化中的教师误差继承，证明在适定性、可表示性、零残差可达性与离散确定性条件下，纯物理精化可条件性地恢复精确系数（非线性情形为局部保证）。
AI.result: 在 15 个微分方程问题、18 种配置（覆盖高阶、时空、多维、非线性与耦合系统）上评估：候选级审计中自由参数重拟合的收敛率达 99.23%，所有涉及自由系数的选定精化均收敛；配置级中位精化相对 L2 误差低至 2.31×10^-14 或以下；同拓扑比较下精化将误差降低 8 到 14 个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 只要保留具备目标表达能力的拓扑且纯物理精化能够收敛，近似神经教师即可有效引导拓扑发现，而不会将其误差尺度强加于最终恢复的系数之上，从而在结构发现与系数精度之间实现解耦。

title: (V)LMs generalize beyond surface co-occurrence: Evidence from cross-modal number agreement
summary: Language models learn about grammatical number primarily from co-occurrence, and show frequency effects as a result---sometimes taken to indicate that they do not learn abstract ``rules'', and are instead dependent on specific lexical items. Testing generalization with text stimuli alone cannot settle this debate, since distributional cues (is/are, this/these) easily give number away. We instead use cross-modal generalization as a tool to investigate abstractions in LMs that can also accept visual inputs (VLMs), restricting the evidence that diagnoses number to an extra-linguistic modality. We teach VLMs pairs of new nouns by adding new embeddings and only updating them during learning, comparing conditions where number is diagnosed by visual cues alone against ones where it is disambiguated by text. Across behavior, representational dynamics, and causal mechanisms, we find non-trivial evidence for cross-modal generalization across both exposure conditions, and that linguistic vs. extra-linguistic cue conditions are treated in similar ways in the internal mechanisms of the model. This suggests that statistical learners like VLMs can generalize beyond surface-level co-occurrence and show genuine abstraction-compatible behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文利用跨模态泛化（视觉线索诊断语法数）来检验视觉-语言模型（VLM）是否具备超越表层共现的抽象规则泛化能力，并发现模型在视觉线索与文本线索条件下的行为、表征动态和因果机制高度相似，表明统计学习者能展现真正的抽象兼容行为。
AI.motivation: 语言模型主要通过共现频率学习语法数（grammatical number），其表现出的频率效应被部分人解读为模型并未学习抽象的"规则"，而是依赖特定词汇项。然而仅用文本刺激测试泛化无法解决这一争论，因为分布线索（如is/are、this/these）很容易泄露数的信息。因此需要一种能排除文本分布线索、将数信息限定在非语言模态的诊断手段。
AI.method: 作者使用也能接受视觉输入的VLM进行跨模态泛化测试：通过添加新嵌入并仅更新这些嵌入来教模型新的名词对，对比两种条件——一种仅由视觉线索诊断数（画面中物体数量），另一种由文本线索消歧（如is/are）。研究者从行为表现、表征动力学（representational dynamics）和因果机制（causal mechanisms）三个层面进行分析。
AI.result: 研究发现，在两种暴露条件下都存在非平凡的跨模态泛化证据；且语言线索条件与非语言（视觉）线索条件在模型内部机制中的处理方式相似。这表明模型并未停留在表面共现层面，而是表现出了与抽象泛化兼容的行为。
AI.conclusion: 统计学习者（如VLM）能够超越表面层次的语言共现进行泛化，表现出真正的抽象兼容（abstraction-compatible）行为，从而为"模型能习得抽象规则而非仅依赖词汇项"这一观点提供了来自跨模态证据的支持。

title: Mind the Rift: Cross-Scale Coupling Mismatch for AI-Generated Video Detection
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26), Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This version includes the supplementary material as Appendix A-E
summary: As AI video generators achieve cinematic realism, reliable detection becomes essential for safeguarding digital trust. We identify cross-scale coupling mismatch as a new forensic signal, where scale refers to the level of abstraction (semantic dynamics vs. pixel-level residuals): in natural videos, macro-level temporal dynamics and micro-level residual patterns are intrinsically coupled by the unified imaging physics pipeline, whereas AI generators, whose training objectives do not explicitly preserve this joint distribution, systematically violate this coupling. Detecting such mismatch is challenging because it requires independently extracting information at both scales while simultaneously quantifying their cross-scale relationship. We propose RIFT (Representation Inconsistency Forensics on Trajectories), an orthogonal forensic framework that addresses this through three interlocking components: a macro stream that builds a dynamic baseline of expected temporal evolution via differential geometry and persistent homology on learned manifold trajectories, a micro stream that acts as a sensitive forensic probe via steganalytic filtering and temporal modeling, and a coupling divergence module that measures the conditional dependency between the two streams. Gram-Schmidt orthogonality guarantees the information-theoretic validity of this measurement. Experiments on two benchmarks (VidProM, 120K videos, 7 generators; GenVidBench, 68K videos, 4 generators) demonstrate that RIFT achieves 99.33% and 99.72% F1-score respectively, with 97.87% unseen-generator detection rate in leave-one-out evaluation, while exhibiting encoder agnosticism: scaling from ViT-S/14 (22M) to ViT-L/14 (300M) changes F1 by less than 0.1%, and switching to a different encoder family (DINOv1) reduces F1 by only 0.73 pp. Code is available at https://github.com/Litsay/RIFT

AI.tldr: 提出RIFT（表示轨迹不一致取证）框架，利用跨尺度耦合失配这一新取证信号检测AI生成视频：宏观流通过微分几何与持续同源建模流形轨迹的预期时域演化，微观流通过隐写滤波与时域建模充当敏感探针，再由耦合散度模块量化两者条件依赖，并以Gram-Schmidt正交性保证信息论有效性。在12万视频（7个生成器）与6.8万视频（4个生成器）两个基准上分别取得99.33%和99.72%的F1，留一评估下未知生成器检测率达97.87%，且对编码器规模与类型高度不敏感。
AI.motivation: AI视频生成器已达到电影级真实感，可靠检测对维护数字信任至关重要。论文将跨尺度耦合失配识别为新的取证信号：自然视频中，宏观时域动态与微观像素级残差由统一成像物理管线内在耦合，而AI生成器训练目标未显式保持该联合分布，因此系统性违背这一耦合。检测这种失配具有挑战性，因为需要独立提取两个尺度的信息并同时量化其跨尺度关系。
AI.method: 提出RIFT（Representation Inconsistency Forensics on Trajectories），一种正交取证框架，包含三个相互关联的组件：1) 宏观流——利用微分几何与持久同调在学习到的流形轨迹上构建预期时域演化的动态基线；2) 微观流——通过隐写滤波与时域建模作为敏感取证探针；3) 耦合散度模块——度量两条流之间的条件依赖性；Gram-Schmidt正交化保证该度量的信息论有效性。
AI.result: 在两个基准（VidProM：12万视频、7个生成器；GenVidBench：6.8万视频、4个生成器）上分别取得99.33%和99.72%的F1分数；留一评估中未知生成器检测率达97.87%；且展现出编码器无关性：从ViT-S/14（22M）扩展到ViT-L/14（300M）F1变化小于0.1%，切换到不同编码器家族（DINOv1）F1仅下降0.73个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RIFT通过揭示并量化自然视频与AI生成视频在跨尺度耦合上的系统性差异，实现了高精度、强泛化（尤其是对未见生成器）且对编码器选择高度鲁棒的AI视频检测，为数字内容取证提供了有效且实用的解决方案。

title: Conversation Coach: A Voice-enabled AI System that Helps Practice Difficult Workplace Conversations
summary: Effective manager-employee communication is critical for retaining high performers and developing underperformers, yet training managers in these skills remains costly. Text-based chatbots offer a scalable approach but cannot provide realistic rehearsal: managers need to practice speaking aloud to build confidence before high-stakes conversations. In this paper, we propose Conversation Coach, a voice-first AI system that enables managers to rehearse difficult workplace conversations in a realistic spoken format. The system addresses three challenges: achieving low-latency interactions with strong language understanding, enabling adaptive conversations through configurable bot personalities that simulate different employee types, and generating personalized feedback on content and policy compliance. We compare an end-to-end speech-to-speech model with a cascaded approach combining automatic speech recognition, a large language model, and text-to-speech synthesis. The end-to-end approach achieves 3$\times$ lower median (P50) latency with native barge-in capability at an estimated 8$\times$ lower cost, while the cascaded approach offers superior reasoning essential for coaching quality. We deployed the cascaded architecture in production, where 40,000+ managers used it over six months, with adoption patterns indicating selective use for difficult conversations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Conversation Coach，一个语音优先的 AI 系统，让管理者能以真实口语形式排练困难的工作对话。作者对比了端到端语音到语音模型与级联（ASR+LLM+TTS）方案，发现端到端方案延迟更低（中位延迟低 3 倍）且成本更低（约 8 倍），但级联方案推理能力更强、更利于教练式反馈质量。最终级联架构上线生产，6 个月内被 4 万多名管理者使用，且采用模式显示用户会有选择性地将其用于困难对话场景。
AI.motivation: 有效的主管—员工沟通对留住高绩效者和培养低绩效者至关重要，但管理者技能培训成本高昂。基于文本的聊天机器人虽可扩展，却无法提供贴近真实的开口练习——管理者需要在高压对话前通过大声说出话的方式建立自信，因此亟需一种可扩展且支持真实口语排练的方案。
AI.method: 构建语音优先的 AI 系统 Conversation Coach，让管理者以真实口语形式排练困难职场对话。系统需解决三大挑战：低延迟交互与强语言理解、通过可配置机器人人格模拟不同类型员工实现自适应对话、生成关于内容与合规性的个性化反馈。方法上对比端到端语音到语音模型与级联方案（自动语音识别 + 大语言模型 + 语音合成），并评估延迟、成本与推理质量。
AI.result: 端到端方案实现中位（P50）延迟低 3 倍、原生 barge-in 打断能力，且成本约低 8 倍；级联方案则具备对教练质量至关重要的更优推理能力。团队将级联架构部署到生产环境，6 个月内吸引 4 万多名管理者使用，采用模式显示用户会有选择地将其用于困难对话。
AI.conclusion: 在延迟与成本优先、打断交互重要的场景下端到端方案更有优势，而级联方案更适合对推理与教练反馈质量要求高的应用。由于教练质量是核心价值所在，生产部署选择了级联架构；实证采用数据表明该系统确有实际价值，用户会针对最困难、最高风险的对话有针对性地使用它。

title: GenONet: A Generative operator Network for High-Resolution Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: High-resolution precipitation nowcasting is critical for reducing the impacts of severe weather but remains difficult because of rapid storm evolution. Deep learning models have shown great promise for this task, but their predictive skill often deteriorates over longer forecast horizons. This leads to increasingly blurry forecasts that fail to capture the complex, non-linear evolution of storm systems. In order to address these limitations, we introduce Spatio-Temporal U-DeepONet (GenONet), a novel architecture for long-range precipitation forecasting up to 3 hours, specifically designed to produce sharp and physically consistent results. GenONet's architecture pioneers the use of a Deep Operator Network (DeepONet) as a generator within a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) framework for this task. The DeepONet learns the continuous-time dynamics of precipitation, ensuring stability over long forecast horizons. Adversial training against a spatio-temporal discriminator compels the model to produce sharp, coherent forecasts, while a physics-informed loss regularizer, derived from the Moisture Conservation Equation, improves physical plausibility in our ablation setting. Quantitative evaluations show that our model achieves consistently higher scores on most of the metrics, especially for highintensity events and at longer lead times. Qualitatively, GenONet produces structurally coherent forecasts that maintain their integrity, whereas baseline models degrade into indistinct patterns. Finally, an ablation study confirms the benefit of this physics-informed loss, highlighting the strength of combining operator learning with adversarial training.

AI.tldr: 提出GenONet（Spatio-Temporal U-DeepONet），一种面向长达3小时高分辨率降水临近预报的新型架构，首次将DeepONet作为GAN框架中的生成器，结合对抗训练与基于水分守恒方程的物理信息损失，以生成清晰、物理一致且长期稳定的预报。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率降水临近预报对减轻恶劣天气影响至关重要，但风暴快速演变使其极具挑战。现有深度学习模型预测技巧随预报时效增加而下降，产生日益模糊的预报，无法捕捉风暴系统复杂、非线性的演变过程。
AI.method: GenONet架构首创将DeepONet用作GAN框架中的生成器：DeepONet学习降水的连续时间动力学以保证长期预报稳定性；通过时空判别器进行对抗训练以促使模型输出清晰连贯的预报；并引入由水分守恒方程推导的物理信息损失正则化器（在消融设置中）提升物理合理性。
AI.result: 定量评估表明，GenONet在大多数指标上得分一贯更高，尤其在高强度事件和更长预报时效下；定性上，GenONet产生结构连贯且保持完整性的预报，而基线模型退化为模糊无区分度的模式；消融研究确认了物理信息损失的收益。
AI.conclusion: 将算子学习与对抗训练相结合，GenONet能够生成长期、清晰且物理自洽的降水预报，优于基线模型，证明了这一组合思路在临近预报中的有效性。

title: Location-Aware Language Models via Secondary Embeddings
comment: Accepted for publication at the 29th International Conference on Text, Speech and Dialogue (TSD 2026)
summary: Pretrained transformer-based language models achieve strong performance across a wide range of NLP tasks but remain limited in encoding geo-locational semantics, leading to suboptimal representations of place names and spatial entities. In this work, we propose a lightweight, model-agnostic approach for injecting geo-spatial awareness into pretrained embeddings without modifying the tokenizer or requiring costly retraining. Our method augments input representations with structured geographic signals by combining location names with their corresponding latitude and longitude, and employs a location-focused masking to better align textual representations with real-world spatial relationships. This design allows the model to incorporate geo-spatial context while preserving existing semantic and syntactic knowledge. Experimental results demonstrate substantial improvements in geo-spatial alignment while maintaining comparable performance on standard NLP benchmarks such as GLUE. The method is computationally efficient, requiring only minutes of additional training, and generalizes across multiple model architectures and scales.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级、模型无关的方法，通过将地名与经纬度结合并采用位置聚焦掩码，将地理空间感知注入预训练语言模型的嵌入表示中，以提升地理空间对齐能力，同时保持标准NLP基准上的性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练transformer语言模型在广泛NLP任务上表现优异，但在编码地理空间语义方面存在局限，导致对地名和空间实体的表示欠佳；现有方案往往需要修改分词器或进行昂贵的重训练。
AI.method: 提出一种轻量级、模型无关的方法：将地名与其对应经纬度结合，增强输入表示中的结构化地理信号；并采用位置聚焦掩码机制，使文本表示更好地与现实空间关系对齐。该方法无需修改分词器或重训练，仅需数分钟附加训练即可，且能跨多种模型架构与规模泛化。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在地理空间对齐方面取得显著提升，同时在GLUE等标准NLP基准上保持可比性能，且计算高效、训练时间短。
AI.conclusion: 通过注入结构化地理信号与位置聚焦掩码，可以在不牺牲既有语义和句法知识的前提下，以极低的成本增强预训练模型的地理空间感知，为空间实体表示提供了一条高效且通用的改进路径。

title: Feed-Forward Multi-view Multi-person Reconstruction with Contrastive Human-Aware 3D Representation
comment: Published in International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV)
summary: Multi-view human reconstruction has been extensively studied under simplified settings, yet robust and efficient multi-person reconstruction in unconstrained environments remains challenging. Existing bottom-up methods often rely on accurate camera calibration and explicit cross-view matching, and therefore struggle with severe occlusions and ambiguities. We propose a new top-down paradigm that maintains a unified, instance-centric human-aware 3D space, enabling simultaneous camera calibration, cross-view association, and human reconstruction via cross-modal contrastive learning. Observations from multiple views are lifted and fused into this shared 3D space, where geometric structure, visual appearance, and human-centric semantic cues are jointly encoded at the instance level. We further introduce a spatial contrastive learning strategy that aligns 3D features corresponding to the same human instance across different views and modalities while separating different instances. This enables correspondence reasoning, semantic aggregation, and instance discrimination to be performed natively in 3D, improving cross-view consistency and robustness under severe occlusions. Finally, structured human body models are recovered in a feed-forward manner by regressing SMPL parameters from instance-level 3D human tokens. Extensive experiments demonstrate robust, accurate, and efficient multi-view human reconstruction in challenging real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新的自顶向下多视角多人重建范式，通过统一的实例中心人类感知3D空间，利用跨模态对比学习同时完成相机标定、跨视角关联与人体重建，并在该3D空间中联合编码几何、外观与语义线索，最终前馈回归SMPL参数恢复结构化人体模型。
AI.motivation: 现有自底向上方法依赖精确的相机标定和显式跨视角匹配，在无约束场景下难以应对严重遮挡和歧义，导致多视角多人在复杂真实环境中的鲁棒高效重建仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出自顶向下范式：维护统一的实例中心人类感知3D空间，将多视角观测提升并融合到该共享空间，在实例层级联合编码几何结构、视觉外观与人类中心语义线索；引入空间对比学习策略，对齐同一人体实例在不同视角和模态下的3D特征并区分不同实例，使对应推理、语义聚合和实例判别在3D中原生进行；最后通过从实例级3D人体token回归SMPL参数，以前馈方式恢复结构化人体模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提方法在具有挑战性的真实世界场景中实现了鲁棒、准确且高效的多视角人体重建，并在严重遮挡下提升了跨视角一致性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在统一3D空间中通过对比学习原生实现对应推理与实例判别，克服了现有方法对标定和显式匹配的依赖，为无约束环境下的鲁棒高效多人群人体重建提供了有效的新范式。

title: mimeo: Compiling Public Expert Corpora into Agent Skills and Testing What Transfers
comment: 42 pages, 6 figures. Toolkit and expert profiles: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/mimeo
summary: Giving an agent a file about a named expert can supply hard-to-find material, produce a recognizable persona, or change what the agent decides. These are different claims. We test each one. mimeo is an open-source tool that finds a person's public work, checks each extracted quotation against the cached source text, and writes a file an agent can load. Eight logged builds averaged 38 model calls; the check rejects 13.2% of extracted quotations. We tested four expert files with one coding-agent harness. Knowledge access was clearest: mimeo answered all 20 obscure, quotation-heavy questions; no closed-book condition answered more than 10. Keyword search (BM25) over the same pages answered 15-17, a gap this sample cannot resolve. Grounding showed one clear benefit: personas written from model memory misstated a documented position on 1-4 of 20 answers under every grader; the plain agent and mimeo never did. Every persona was easy to spot on short open prompts, and adding task material lowered identification by 18-23 points. mimeo was no more identifiable than a from-memory profile. Judgment transfer remained unresolved because both tests hit their ceiling: every condition found 94-97% of the problems planted in engineering tasks and scored 94-100% on 16 new application scenarios. An AI-judged "sounds like the expert" score changed with the judge: two of four preferred answers based on a model's stereotype, while two found no difference on the same text. That is a caution against relying on a single AI judge. The evidence supports mimeo as a compact, inspectable reference on a person, not as a demonstrated transfer of their judgment. Toolkit and expert profiles: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/mimeo

AI.tldr: 本文介绍并评估了开源工具 mimeo，它通过检索人物的公开发表内容、核验引文并生成可供智能体加载的专家档案。实验在四项专家档案和一个编码智能体上分三方面验证：知识获取（mimeo 答对全部 20 道冷门引文题，封闭书条件下最多 10 道）、人格可识别性与接地性（记忆撰写的人格会在 20 题中错述 1–4 处立场，mimeo 与普通智能体从未出错）、以及判断迁移（因效果天花板而无法判定）。作者警告不应依赖单一 AI 裁判。
AI.motivation: 给智能体提供关于某位专家的档案文件可能带来三种不同的效果：提供难以获取的材料（知识获取）、产生可识别的人格（人格可识别性）、或改变智能体的决策（判断迁移）。作者指出这三者是被混为一谈的不同主张，因此需要逐一检验，以弄清"专家档案"究竟在何种意义上起作用。
AI.method: 构建开源工具 mimeo：检索一个人的公开发表作品，将每条抽取的引文与缓存的源文本核对，生成智能体可加载的专家档案文件。在四个专家档案和一个编码智能体测试平台上进行实验：对比封闭书条件与 BM25 关键词检索；对比基于模型记忆撰写的人格与 mimeo 接地档案；评估人格识别的难易；并用 AI 裁判打分"听起来像专家"的程度。
AI.result: 知识获取效果最明确：mimeo 答对全部 20 道冷门引文题，封闭书条件最多答对 10 道，BM25 答对 15–17 道（样本量不足以判定差异）。接地性上，记忆撰写的人格在每种裁判下都有 1–4/20 的立场错述，而普通智能体和 mimeo 从未错述。人格在短开放提示下极易识别，加入任务素材可使识别率下降 18–23 个百分点，且 mimeo 并不比记忆画像更易识别。判断迁移因天花板无定论（各项条件均发现 94–97% 的问题、解决 94–100% 的新场景）。AI 裁判的"像专家"评分不稳定：四位裁判中两位偏向基于刻板印象的答案，另两位认为无差异。构建日志显示平均 38 次模型调用，引文校验拒绝 13.2% 的抽取引文。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持将 mimeo 视为关于某人的紧凑、可检视的参考资料，而非已经被证明能迁移其判断的机制。同时，单一 AI 裁判的评分不可靠，需谨慎对待这类评估结论。

title: Toppling the Hierarchy in Byte-level Language Modeling
summary: This work examines recent byte-level models and their failure to perfectly manipulate characters. State-of-the-art byte-level models use a hierarchical structure, starting at the byte level, downsampling to the word level, and then upsampling back to bytes. While this improves training and inference efficiency, we find that the hierarchical design itself limits character-level understanding, with pure byte-level models consistently outperforming hierarchical variants on character manipulation tasks. Ablating transformer layers into attention and feed-forward components further reveals that byte-level attention is the primary mechanism driving this behavior. Together, our results provide an explanation for the character-level failures of hierarchical byte models and establish a clear trade-off between computational efficiency and fine-grained character understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了层级式字节级模型为何无法完美操作字符：层级结构（字节→词→字节）虽提升训练和推理效率，却损害了字符级理解能力；纯字节级模型在字符操作任务上始终优于层级变体，且消融实验表明字节级注意力是驱动该差异的主要机制，揭示了计算效率与细粒度字符理解之间的明确权衡。
AI.motivation: 最新的字节级模型采用层级结构（字节层下采样到词层再上采样回字节）以提升训练和推理效率，但这些模型在字符操作（character manipulation）任务上表现不完美。作者希望探究层级设计是否以及如何限制了模型的字符级理解能力，并找出导致这种失败的根本机制。
AI.method: 作者系统比较了纯字节级模型与层级字节级模型（字节→词→字节的下采样-上采样结构）在字符操作任务上的表现；并通过将Transformer层消融为注意力部分和前馈部分，分别测试各组件对字符操作行为的影响，以定位驱动该差异的关键机制。
AI.result: 研究发现层级设计本身限制了字符级理解：纯字节级模型在字符操作任务上始终优于层级变体；消融实验进一步表明，字节级注意力（byte-level attention）是驱动这一行为的主要机制，而非前馈组件。
AI.conclusion: 研究为层级字节模型在字符级任务上的失败提供了机制层面的解释，并明确指出计算效率与细粒度字符理解之间存在显著权衡：追求层级结构带来的效率提升，必然以牺牲字符级理解能力为代价。

title: VOIM: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Mapping for RGB-D and Monocular SLAM
summary: We present Voxel-Grounded Online Instance Manager (VOIM), a training-free voxel-grounded instance manager that builds open-vocabulary 3D instance maps from RGB-D or from monocular RGB alone, a regime no prior training-free system addresses. Online systems typically segment object instances and label them at first detection, committing when evidence is weakest. VOIM instead defers label and instance decisions until soft evidence from unmodified, off-the-shelf perception has accumulated per voxel across views. We show that the mapping stage, rather than the particular perception models, carries the result: across four perception configurations on ScanNet++, varying the region descriptor, the detector label prior and the mask source, the map exceeds the strongest online RGB-D system, OVO-SLAM, by between 4.8 and 11.7 mIoU. Perception is not neutral, and substituting that baseline's own descriptor family costs 4.1 of the margin, yet the baseline carries the marginally better 2D descriptor (33.7 vs. 31.5 mIoU over three scenes) and still realizes the weaker map. Under a like-for-like protocol VOIM reaches 44.07 mIoU on ScanNet++ against 32.37, winning all ten scenes and both aggregations (pooled 33.31 vs. 25.97), and the same system runs unchanged to fully monocular RGB, matching that baseline pooled on Replica (27.80 vs. 27.50). The advantage is regime-specific: under Replica's all-classes scoring, matched inputs give a split result, 28.60 vs. 27.50 pooled against 24.59 vs. 30.11 on the per-scene mean. Room scale is label-limited and building scale drift-limited. Labeling does not run in real time, dominated by per-class detection over the full vocabulary. The maps export occupancy grids and resolve free-form queries to object instances.

AI.tldr: VOIM 是一种无需训练的、以体素为锚定的在线实例管理器，能够仅凭 RGB-D 或单目 RGB 构建开放词汇的 3D 实例地图；其核心思想是推迟标注与实例判定，直到来自现成感知模型的软证据在跨视图的每个体素上累积充分后再做决策。实验表明映射阶段而非具体感知模型决定了结果：在 ScanNet++ 上以可比协议达到 44.07 mIoU，胜过最强在线 RGB-D 系统 OVO-SLAM（32.37），并在纯单目 RGB 模式下无需改动即可与基线在 Replica 上打平。
AI.motivation: 现有的在线 3D 实例建图系统通常在首次检测时就对物体实例进行分割和标注，而此时证据最弱，导致决策可靠性差；且目前缺少一个无需训练、可同时处理 RGB-D 与纯单目 RGB 输入的开放词汇在线建图系统。
AI.method: VOIM 通过"体素接地"的实例管理器，不修改也不训练现成的感知模型，而是在跨视角观测中按体素累积来自这些模型的软证据，并延迟做出实例划分与类别标注的决策，直到证据足够充分。系统最终生成占用栅格地图，并可将自由形式的查询解析到具体物体实例。
AI.result: 在 ScanNet++ 上采用可比协议达到 44.07 mIoU，对比 OVO-SLAM 的 32.37，并在全部十个场景及两种聚合方式（pooled 33.31 vs. 25.97）中获胜；在四种感知配置下，地图相比最强在线 RGB-D 系统高出 4.8 至 11.7 mIoU。同一系统不改动即可切换到纯单目 RGB 模式，在 Replica 上与基线池化结果打平（27.80 vs. 27.50）。但优势具有场景特异性：在 Replica 的全类别评分下结果出现分歧（pooled 28.60 vs. 27.50，而逐场景均值 24.59 vs. 30.11）。室温尺度受标注限制，建筑尺度受漂移限制；标注环节因要对全词表逐类检测，无法实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：在线 3D 实例建图的最终质量主要由映射（证据累积与决策延迟）阶段决定，而非具体的感知模型；感知并非中性，但即使替换为基线所用的描述符族（损失 4.1 的优势）或采用表现更好的 2D 描述符，VOIM 的弱地图仍能胜过基线。VOIM 在 RGB-D 与纯单目 RGB 上均成立，但优势局限于特定评测协议与场景尺度。

title: Towards a Belief-Based World Model for LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are being used as policies for autonomous decision-making and planning in many domains. Despite their strong reasoning capabilities, LLMs struggle with long-horizon tasks, especially under partial observability. World models are a promising way to enhance policy performance, both during training and inference. During inference, agents currently use world models to simulate the consequences of candidate actions before committing to an action, which can improve decision-making. However, we argue that simulation alone is an incomplete interface for decision-making under partial observability: simulation doesn't adequately capture uncertainty about the current state, which agents may need for accurate decision-making. We address this limitation with Belief-Based World Models (BB-WMs), which model and maintain a belief that LLMs can query to access information on what is known and uncertain about the current state. Before developing methods to learn accurate BB-WMs, we first ask a more fundamental question: does exposing a world model's belief directly to an LLM policy improve decision-making? Our results show that giving LLM agents access to world model beliefs improves task performance under partial observability, while remaining complementary to existing simulation-based world models. Code is released at https://github.com/skumar-ml/belief-world-models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信念基世界模型（BB-WMs），通过建模并维护对当前状态已知与不确定信息的信念，并将其直接提供给LLM策略查询，以改善部分可观测条件下的长时程决策。实验表明，给予LLM智能体访问世界模型信念可提升任务表现，且与现有基于仿真的世界模型方法互补。
AI.motivation: LLM虽具有强大的推理能力，但在部分可观测条件下的长时程任务中表现不佳。现有基于世界模型的推理方法仅通过仿真候选动作后果来辅助决策，但仿真本身无法充分捕捉对当前状态的不确定性，而这种不确定性对准确决策至关重要，因此需要更完整的决策接口。
AI.method: 提出信念基世界模型（Belief-Based World Models, BB-WMs），该模型建模并维护一个信念分布，LLM可以查询该信念以获取关于当前状态已知和不确定的信息。通过与现有基于仿真的世界模型结合，将信念信息直接暴露给LLM策略（LLM agent），使其在决策时同时利用仿真和信念信息。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在部分可观测条件下，让LLM智能体访问世界模型信念能够提升任务表现，并且该机制与现有的基于仿真的世界模型方法相互补充，可以共同提升决策性能。
AI.conclusion: 将世界模型的信念直接暴露给LLM策略是改善部分可观测条件下决策的一种有效且互补的途径，这为未来研究如何学习准确的信念基世界模型提供了基础与动机。

title: EEG-VID: Task-Guided Latent Predictive Pretraining for EEG Decoding and Assistive Target Selection
summary: We propose EEG-VID, a task-guided latent predictive pretraining framework for EEG decoding under session and subject shifts. EEG-VID predicts future latent EEG states from recent history using an exponential-moving-average target encoder and weak task guidance, followed by supervised fine-tuning. Across VIG-48 and BCI Competition IV-2a/IV-2b, Stage 1 improves mean accuracy in 41 of 42 matched backbone-dataset-protocol comparisons, including all 12 leave-one-subject-out settings, with a maximum gain of 16.22 percentage points. On the 48-region cross-day VIG-48 task, EEG-VID achieves 6.52% Top-1 and 30.50% Top-5 accuracy. In a separate six-participant offline robot-scene study, candidate-constrained target selection reaches 40.24% versus a 25% chance level after subject-specific calibration. These results support task-guided latent prediction as a transferable pretraining strategy for EEG decoding and scene-constrained assistive target selection.

AI.tldr: EEG-VID 是一种面向脑电（EEG）解码的任务引导潜在预测预训练框架，通过指数滑动平均目标编码器与弱任务引导从近期历史中预测未来潜在 EEG 状态，随后进行监督微调，以应对会话间与受试者间的分布偏移。
AI.motivation: EEG 解码在实际应用中常受会话偏移（session shift）与受试者偏移（subject shift）影响，模型跨条件泛化能力不足；需要一种可迁移的预训练策略，在不依赖大量标注数据的情况下提升跨天、跨受试者的解码性能。
AI.method: 提出 EEG-VID 两阶段框架：阶段一为任务引导的潜在预测预训练，采用指数滑动平均（EMA）目标编码器并结合弱任务引导（weak task guidance），从近期 EEG 历史状态预测未来潜在表征；阶段二为监督微调，将预训练得到的表征迁移到具体解码任务。在 VIG-48 与 BCI Competition IV-2a/IV-2b 上按匹配的 backbone-数据集-协议进行系统比较，并额外在六人离线机器人场景任务中评估候选受限的目标选择。
AI.result: 阶段一在 42 组匹配的 backbone-数据集-协议比较中提升了 41 组的平均准确率，覆盖全部 12 个留一受试者（leave-one-subject-out）场景，最大提升 16.22 个百分点；在 48 区域跨天 VIG-48 任务上达到 6.52% Top-1 与 30.50% Top-5 准确率；在六人离线机器人场景研究中，经受试者特定校准后候选受限目标选择准确率达 40.24%，显著高于 25% 的随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 任务引导的潜在预测可作为一种可迁移的 EEG 解码预训练策略，并适用于场景约束的辅助目标选择任务，为跨会话、跨受试者的脑机接口应用提供了有效且稳健的范式。

title: TRIS: A Tri-Layer Retrieval Integrity Sieve Against Knowledge Poisoning
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external corpora, but implicit trust in retrieved documents creates a critical attack surface: PoisonedRAG shows that a handful of crafted passages can dominate dense retrieval and steer generation toward attacker-chosen answers. We present the Tri-Layer Sieve, a middleware defense that sanitizes retrieved evidence through cross-embedding-space clustering with an independent judge model, structural filtering of trigger-payload artifacts, and LLM consistency verification. The design exploits a key weakness of retrieval-stage poisoning: a single document must satisfy one embedding geometry, one internal Trigger-Payload structure, and one generation objective - rarely all three simultaneously, a fragility that persists even against an adaptive attacker who paraphrases around it. On Natural Questions, HotpotQA, and MS-MARCO with Contriever retrieval (k=50), the Sieve reduces black-box Attack Success Rate from 67.0/87.0/64.0% to 3.0/14.0/4.0%, mitigates white-box HotFlip attacks from ~74% to 27.8% on NQ with Layer 3 enabled, and drives poisoned-document MRR to 0.000, while restoring clean accuracy from 13-33% under attack to 58-76%. Under an architecture-aware adversary who paraphrases triggers to evade the structural filter, enabling the consistency layer halves adaptive ASR (32.0% to 15.0% on NQ) while raising clean accuracy by 18 points, at an added latency of ~16-19 s/query under live retrieval.

AI.tldr: Tri-Layer Sieve是一个针对RAG检索阶段投毒攻击的中间件防御方法，通过对检索证据进行跨嵌入空间聚类（配合独立裁判模型）、触发-载荷伪影的结构化过滤以及LLM一致性验证三层消毒，显著降低攻击成功率并恢复干净检索准确率。
AI.motivation: RAG将大语言模型锚定于外部语料库，但对检索文档的隐式信任带来了严重攻击面：PoisonedRAG表明少量精心构造的段落即可主导稠密检索并诱导生成器输出攻击者选定的答案，因此需要一种能够净化检索证据的防御机制。
AI.method: Tri-Layer Sieve包含三层防御：(1) 跨嵌入空间聚类，利用独立的裁判模型对检索文档进行多视角验证；(2) 对触发-载荷（Trigger-Payload）伪影进行结构化过滤；(3) 利用LLM一致性验证交叉检验生成结果。其核心洞察是：单个投毒文档须同时满足一种嵌入几何、一种内部触发-载荷结构以及一种生成目标，几乎不可能三者同时成立。
AI.result: 在Natural Questions、HotpotQA和MS-MARCO上（Contriever检索，k=50），黑盒攻击成功率从67.0/87.0/64.0%降至3.0/14.0/4.0%；在NQ上白盒HotFlip攻击从约74%降至27.8%（启用第三层）；投毒文档MRR降至0.000；干净准确率在攻击下从13-33%恢复至58-76%。面对会改写触发词以绕过结构化过滤的架构感知对手，一致性层使自适应攻击成功率减半（NQ上32.0%降至15.0%），干净准确率提升18个百分点，实时检索下每查询仅增加约16-19秒延迟。
AI.conclusion: 多层防御设计利用了检索阶段投毒的本质脆弱性——单个文档难以同时满足嵌入几何、结构特征与生成目标三重约束，因此即使在适应性对手（包括绕过过滤器的触发词改写与白盒攻击）面前依然稳健，能以可控延迟代价换取攻击成功率的大幅下降与干净检索效用的显著恢复。

title: Solaris: Towards Interfaces That Are Generated, Not Coded
summary: Digital interfaces are traditionally implemented through intermediate representations such as code, requiring their appearance and behavior to be specified in advance. We introduce Solaris, an interface world model that instead generates an interactive UI directly, frame by frame, in response to user actions. Solaris treats mouse interactions as conditioning signals and autoregressively synthesizes the resulting visual state at interactive speeds. To enable real-time generation while maintaining visual coherence over extended interactions, we combine autoregressive frame generation with few-step distillation and training on the model's own outputs. A language model complements the visual world model by interpreting user intent and specifying how interactions should affect the generated environment, separating high-level reasoning from visual rendering. By generating both the appearance and behavior of an interface dynamically, Solaris enables open-ended interactions that need not be explicitly programmed in advance. We view interface world models as a step toward a new paradigm for software, where interfaces are generated and adapted continuously around user intent rather than implemented as fixed collections of predefined states and

AI.tldr: Solaris 是一种界面世界模型，将鼠标交互视为条件信号，以帧为单位自回归地实时生成交互式 UI 的视觉状态，并结合少量步长蒸馏与语言模型实现意图理解，从而实现无需预先编程的开放式交互界面。
AI.motivation: 传统数字界面通过代码等中间表示实现，其外观和行为必须预先定义，无法灵活适应开放式的用户交互。作者希望通过世界模型直接生成交互界面，使界面不必以预定义状态的固定集合实现。
AI.method: Solaris 将鼠标交互作为条件信号，以自回归方式逐帧合成交互产生的视觉状态；结合自回归帧生成、少量步长蒸馏以及基于模型自身输出的训练来实现实时生成并维持长时间交互的视觉一致性；同时，语言模型负责解释用户意图并指定交互如何影响生成环境，将高层推理与视觉渲染分离。
AI.result: 该方法能够在交互速度下实时生成视觉状态，并在扩展交互过程中保持视觉连贯性；通过动态生成界面的外观与行为，支持无需预先明确编程的开放式交互。
AI.conclusion: 界面世界模型代表了一种新的软件范式：界面围绕用户意图被持续生成和自适应调整，而不是作为预定义状态的固定集合来实现。

title: EGT-KG: Evidence-Grounded Typed KG Retrieval for Practical Scientific QA with Small Language Models
summary: For emerging scientific research domains, local Small Language Models (SLMs) are becoming more attractive, as they offer stronger privacy control and more stable deployment pipelines than Large Language Models. However, in practice, scientific question-answering on SLMs often operates under inevitable constraints: small literature collections, fragmented evidence, limited context window and reasoning abilities. We propose the Evidence-Grounded Typed Knowledge Graph (EGT-KG), a retrieval framework to improve information retrieval with local SLMs. We assessed three question-answering settings: a vanilla Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflow and two EGT-KG workflows: an automatically generated relation schema (AS) and an expert-defined relation schema (ES). Our experiments were evaluated with a six-dimensional evaluation framework (S3CRF: Soundness, Correctness, Completeness, Conciseness, Relevance, Fluency) on a Biopolymer-bound Soil Composite literature benchmark, showing that EGT-KG outperforms the vanilla RAG method in most settings, with the best improvement from llama3:8b: a Final Score of 70.37 (+14.67%) and 68.82 (+12.14%) by AS/ES EGT-KG variants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出证据扎根的类型化知识图谱（EGT-KG）检索框架，用于增强本地小语言模型（SLM）在科学问答中的信息检索能力。在生物聚合物-土壤复合材料文献基准上，EGT-KG显著优于传统RAG方法，其中llama3:8b在自动模式（AS）与专家模式（ES）下分别取得70.37分（+14.67%）和68.82分（+12.14%）的最佳提升。
AI.motivation: 新兴科学研究领域中，本地小语言模型（SLM）相比大语言模型（LLM）具有更强的隐私控制和更稳定的部署流程，在实际科学问答中却面临小规模文献集合、碎片化证据、有限的上下文窗口和推理能力等不可避免的约束，导致传统RAG检索效果受限，亟需改进检索框架。
AI.method: 提出证据扎根的类型化知识图谱（Evidence-Grounded Typed Knowledge Graph, EGT-KG）检索框架，并评估三种问答设置：传统RAG工作流，以及两种EGT-KG工作流——自动生成关系模式（AS）和专家定义关系模式（ES）。
AI.result: 在生物聚合物-土壤复合材料文献基准上，采用六维评估框架（S3CRF：合理性、正确性、完整性、简洁性、相关性、流畅性）进行评估。结果显示EGT-KG在大多数设置下优于传统RAG方法，最佳提升来自llama3:8b：AS/ES变体分别获得最终得分70.37分（+14.67%）和68.82分（+12.14%）。
AI.conclusion: EGT-KG通过构建证据扎根的类型化知识图谱，有效缓解了本地SLM在科学问答中文献规模小、证据碎片化和推理能力受限的问题，在多数评估设置下优于传统RAG方法，且自动生成关系模式（AS）效果略优于专家定义模式（ES），表明该方法可作为本地SLM科学问答的有效检索增强方案。

title: GeoPAR: Large-Scale Multi-Agent Combinatorial Optimization with Geometry-Guided Parallel Autoregressive Learning
summary: Multi-agent combinatorial optimization problems are notoriously challenging due to their NP-hard nature. Recent parallel autoregressive neural solvers improve inference efficiency by allowing agents to make decisions simultaneously, but their performance often degrades on large-scale instances. This is largely attributable to weak modeling of local geometric structures and the fact that conflicting task selections are handled only after action generation. To address these limitations, we propose GeoPAR, a geometry-guided parallel autoregressive reinforcement learning framework for scalable multi-agent combinatorial optimization. GeoPAR integrates three key components: (1) a projection-window sparse geometry mechanism that builds lightweight local candidate neighborhoods through multi-directional projections, (2) sparse edge-biased attention that injects these geometric relations into node representations, and (3) cache-guided conflict-aware assignment that reuses the geometric cache during decoding to suppress duplicate selections of exclusive tasks. Experiments on heterogeneous vehicle routing and open multi-depot pickup-and-delivery problems show that GeoPAR improves large-scale zero-shot generalization while substantially reducing rollout steps and maintaining efficient inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoPAR，一种几何引导的并行自回归强化学习框架，通过投影窗口稀疏几何机制、稀疏边偏置注意力和缓存引导的冲突感知分配三大组件，提升多智能体组合优化问题在大规模实例上的零样本泛化能力与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 多智能体组合优化问题因NP-hard特性极具挑战性。现有并行自回归神经求解器虽能通过智能体并行决策提升推理效率，但在大规模实例上性能明显下降，这主要归因于两方面：对局部几何结构的建模薄弱，以及冲突的任务选择只能在动作生成之后才被处理。
AI.method: 提出GeoPAR框架，集成三个关键组件：(1) 投影窗口稀疏几何机制，通过多方向投影构建轻量级局部候选邻域；(2) 稀疏边偏置注意力，将几何关系注入节点表示；(3) 缓存引导的冲突感知分配，在解码阶段复用几何缓存以抑制互斥任务的重复选择。
AI.result: 在异构车辆路径问题和开放多车场取送货问题上的实验表明，GeoPAR在提升大规模零样本泛化能力的同时，大幅减少了rollout步数，并保持了高效的推理性能。
AI.conclusion: GeoPAR通过显式建模局部几何结构和提前处理任务冲突，有效解决了并行自回归求解器在大规模多智能体组合优化上的性能退化问题，实现了更强的泛化能力与更高的推理效率，验证了几何先验与缓存机制在此类问题中的有效性。

title: Exploring Collaboration between a language and a non-language agent
summary: LLMs are increasingly deployed as orchestrators that coordinate specialized subagents to solve complex tasks through natural language. However, in many important domains like game playing and robotics, the strongest available agents are not language models. Integrating non-language agents with LLMs would require \emph{verbalization}: compressing their rich continuous representations into sparse textual summaries at each interaction step. To study whether verbalization constitutes a bottleneck, we introduce \textsc{LLAMIA-Bench}, a suite of six diverse collaborative chess tasks spanning three facets: behavioral imitation, state assessment, and natural-language explanation. Each task instantiates a well-established chess problem that neither the LLM nor the chess engine can solve alone. To solve LLM collaboration with non-language agents, we introduce \emph{latent state internalization}, which projects the subagent's continuous representations directly into the LLM's token stream as learned state tokens, with dynamic re-encoding as actions advance the environment state. Comparing internalization to verbalized integration, our experiments reveal a consistent \emph{verbalization debt}: the performance gap widens throughout training and persists as the LLM scales from 4B to 14B parameters. A single 14B model, \textsc{LLAMIA}, trained with latent state internalization, matches or exceeds task specialists and frontier models including GPT-5.1 with tool access across all benchmark tasks, and generalizes out-of-distribution where task-specific finetunes collapse

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLAMIA-Bench基准（六个协作国际象棋任务），研究大语言模型与非语言智能体协作时的“言语化瓶颈”问题，并提出“潜在状态内化”方法——将子智能体的连续表征以学习到的状态词元直接投影到LLM的词元流中，并随环境状态推进动态重编码。实验表明言语化集成存在持续的“言语化债务”，而14B的LLAMIA模型在全部任务上达到或超越任务专家及具备工具访问的前沿模型，并具备分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: LLM常被部署为协调多个专业子智能体的“编排者”，但在游戏、机器人等重要领域中最强的智能体并非语言模型。将这些非语言智能体与LLM集成需要“言语化”，即在每个交互步骤将其丰富的连续表征压缩为稀疏文本摘要，这构成了潜在的瓶颈，因此需要系统研究该瓶颈是否存在及其影响程度。
AI.method: 引入包含六个多样化协作国际象棋任务的基准套件LLAMIA-Bench，覆盖行为模仿、状态评估与自然语言解释三个维度；提出“潜在状态内化”方法，将子智能体的连续表征作为学习得到的潜在状态词元直接投影进LLM的词元流，并在动作推进环境状态时执行动态重编码；实验对比内化式与言语化集成，并考察模型从4B扩展到14B参数时的表现。
AI.result: 实验发现持续存在的“言语化债务”：言语化与内化之间的性能差距在训练过程中不断加大，并在LLM从4B扩展到14B时依然存在。仅14B的LLAMIA模型经过潜在状态内化训练后，在所有基准任务上匹配或超越任务专家以及具备工具访问的GPT-5.1等前沿模型，并能在特定任务微调失效的分布外场景中保持泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 言语化确实是LLM与非语言智能体协作中的关键瓶颈，而潜在状态内化提供了一种更有效的集成范式；通过直接注入连续状态表征，能够显著缩小性能差距并提升规模扩展效率与分布外鲁棒性，为未来混合智能体系统设计提供了可行方向。

title: Forbid Your Attention: Fooling Multimodal Large Language Models by Selectively Removing Intrinsic Focus in Spectral Domain
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have extended the capability of large language models (LLMs) to process more contextual multimodal information, showing remarkable progress in diverse realistic multimodal applications. Despite their strong perception and reasoning abilities, recent studies reveal that MLLMs remain highly vulnerable to adversarial inputs, especially those targeting visual components. However, existing attacks mainly focus on global perturbations, lacking an understanding of how MLLMs internally interpret visual structures. In this paper, we make the attempt to investigate the intrinsic focus of MLLMs in the frequency domain and discover that their predictions are particularly sensitive to phase information, which encodes essential structural and semantic cues. Based on this observation, we propose a novel phase-aware adversarial attack framework that explicitly restricts adversarial perturbations to structure-relevant phase regions to suppress the MLLMs' focus for effective and imperceptible attacks. To further amplify the structural influence, we also introduce an auxiliary adversarial prompt learning module to guide multimodal misalignment around phase-sensitive regions, misleading the MLLM's attention toward targeted structural patterns. Extensive experiments on multiple representative MLLM models and datasets demonstrate the superior effectiveness of our method compared to existing attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于频域相位感知的对抗攻击框架，首次发现多模态大语言模型（MLLM）对视觉输入的相位信息高度敏感，并将对抗扰动限制在与结构相关的相位区域，同时引入辅助对抗提示学习模块来放大结构性影响、引导多模态错位，从而实现对MLLM的高效且不易察觉的攻击，实验证明其优于现有攻击方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管MLLM展现出强大的感知与推理能力，但它们对针对视觉组件的对抗输入高度脆弱。然而，现有攻击主要依赖全局扰动，缺乏对MLLM内部如何理解视觉结构的深入理解，因此需要从频域角度探究MLLM的内在关注点，以实现更有效且不易察觉的攻击。
AI.method: 1) 从频域角度研究MLLM的内在关注点，发现其预测对编码结构性和语义线索的相位信息尤为敏感；2) 据此提出相位感知对抗攻击框架，将对抗扰动显式限制在与结构相关的相位区域，抑制MLLM的关注以实现有效且不可察觉的攻击；3) 引入辅助对抗提示学习模块，围绕相位敏感区域引导多模态错位，将MLLM注意力导向特定结构模式。
AI.result: 在多个代表性MLLM模型和数据集上的大量实验表明，所提出的方法在攻击有效性方面显著优于现有攻击方法。
AI.conclusion: MLLM在频域上对相位信息所编码的结构语义极为敏感，这为设计针对视觉组件的攻击提供了新视角；通过将扰动限制在相位敏感区域并结合提示学习模块，可在保持扰动不易察觉的同时有效削弱MLLM的预测与注意力，为此类模型的安全防御研究提供了重要启示。

title: The Privacy-Hallucination Tradeoff in Differentially Private Language Models
summary: Both privacy and factual accuracy are paramount in high-stakes domains like healthcare. Concerningly, we uncover and investigate a privacy-hallucination tradeoff in differentially private (DP) language models. First, we empirically show that models pre-trained or fine-tuned with DP tend to produce more hallucinations than non-DP counterparts, with increased severity as the privacy budget grows stricter. Second, we investigate model properties driving this tradeoff, demonstrating that DP mechanisms flatten output distributions, potentially redistributing probability mass toward factually incorrect alternatives. Third, through experiments where we control fact frequency in training data, we characterize how information frequency can reduce hallucination risks in DP models. Overall, our findings underscore the need for more nuanced privacy-preserving interventions that offer rigorous privacy guarantees without compromising factual accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文首次揭示并系统研究了差分隐私（DP）语言模型中的“隐私-幻觉权衡”现象，即DP训练（预训练或微调）会使模型产生更多幻觉，且隐私预算越严格幻觉越严重；其机理在于DP机制使输出分布趋于平坦，将概率质量重新分配给事实性错误答案；同时实验表明训练数据中事实的出现频率可降低DP模型的幻觉风险，从而强调需要更精细的隐私保护干预手段。
AI.motivation: 在医疗等高风险领域，隐私保护与事实准确性都至关重要，但以往研究未充分关注DP训练对模型幻觉的影响。作者旨在探究DP模型在保护隐私的同时是否及如何损害事实准确性，从而填补这一空白。
AI.method: 本研究采用三方面方法：一是对预训练或微调采用DP机制（不同隐私预算强度）的模型与非DP基线进行对比实验，量化幻觉发生率与严重程度；二是分析模型属性，通过实验证明DP机制对输出分布产生“平坦化”效应，导致概率质量向错误事实转移；三是通过控制训练数据中事实的出现频率进行受控实验，刻画信息频率对幻觉风险的调节作用。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：DP模型比非DP模型产生更多幻觉且严重程度更高，并且隐私预算越严格（保护越强），幻觉越严重；DP机制会使输出分布平坦化，从而将概率质量重新分配至事实错误的候选答案；提高训练数据中事实信息的频率能够有效降低DP模型的幻觉风险。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了现有DP训练方案在隐私与事实准确性之间存在固有权衡，说明仅靠收紧隐私预算会牺牲事实可靠性。作者呼吁设计更精细的隐私保护干预手段，在提供严格隐私保证的同时不损害事实准确性，为高风险领域DP语言模型的应用提供了重要启示。

title: CRAFT: Fine-Tuning Pre-hoc Explainability in AI-native 6G RAN
summary: The next generation of mobile networks is envisioned as fully AI-native, with AI-RAN architectures embedding small language models (SLMs) to perform reasoning over real-time telemetry. The state-of-the-art training paradigms for telecom LLMs, exemplified by RANSTRUCT-style supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated instruction data, are limited to post hoc rationalization. Here, the explanations, when produced at all, are generated after or independently of the decision, leaving the decision process unauditable. Pre-hoc reasoning, where a causal reasoning trace is produced before the output label, is preferable, and the broader LLM reasoning literature has made real progress toward it via RL methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Here we observe that transplanting this recipe into the telecom setting runs into a cold-start barrier: SLMs either learn to output the desired format or learn to predict the label, but rarely both. We identify this barrier and propose CRAFT, which stands for Cold-start Reasoning Alignment via Fine-Tuning, a data-centric method to autonomously generate a verified dataset of (input, trace, label) triplets. CRAFT fine-tunes SLMs on this verified data using low-rank adaptation (LoRA), requiring substantially less compute and wall-clock time than GRPO-based methods. On the TRACTOR and IC xApp telecom datasets, CRAFT achieves up to 86.5% and 94.6% for accuracy and F1 with no parse failures, while direct GRPO and SFT+GRPO fail to exceed 28% and 53.5% F1 with multiple parse failures. We further show that CRAFT-initialized policies serve as a robust foundation for subsequent GRPO fine-tuning, as under diverse reward functions the performance remains consistent with no parse failures. Finally, we demonstrate that CRAFT consumes 59% less energy than GRPO-based baselines, making it a sustainable path to deployable, auditable AI in 6G RAN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CRAFT（Cold-start Reasoning Alignment via Fine-Tuning），一种面向电信领域 SLM 推理对齐的数据中心方法：通过自主生成并验证（输入、推理轨迹、标签）三元组，再用 LoRA 微调，从而克服 GRPO 风格强化学习在电信场景下的冷启动壁垒，在 TRACTOR 与 IC xApp 数据集上实现高准确率/F1 且零解析失败，能耗较 GRPO 基线降低 59%。
AI.motivation: 现有面向电信 LLM 的 SFT 范式（如 RANSTRUCT）只能做事后合理化（post hoc rationalization），解释在决策之后或独立于决策产生，决策过程不可审计；而更理想的事前推理（pre-hoc reasoning）需借助 GRPO 等 RL 方法，但将其直接移植到电信场景会遇到冷启动壁垒：SLM 要么学会输出目标格式、要么学会预测标签，很少能同时兼顾两者。
AI.method: 提出 CRAFT 方法：首先通过数据中心的方式自主生成并校验（输入、推理轨迹、标签）三元组数据集，然后使用低秩适配（LoRA）在此验证数据上微调 SLM。该方法无需 GRPO 式在线策略优化，计算开销与墙钟时间显著降低；同时 CRAFT 初始化得到的策略可作为后续 GRPO 微调的稳健基础。
AI.result: 在 TRACTOR 和 IC xApp 电信数据集上，CRAFT 的准确率与 F1 分别最高达 86.5% 和 94.6%，且无解析失败；而直接 GRPO 与 SFT+GRPO 的 F1 分别不超过 28% 和 53.5%，且伴随多次解析失败。此外，CRAFT 初始化的策略在多种奖励函数下的后续 GRPO 微调中性能保持一致且无解析失败，且 CRAFT 相比 GRPO 基线能耗降低 59%。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT 为 6G RAN 中可部署、可审计的 AI 提供了一条可持续的路径：以更低的计算与能耗成本实现 SLM 的事前因果推理对齐，并为后续基于 GRPO 的强化学习提供稳健的初始化基础。

title: Are Near-Tied LLM Rankings Robust to Family-DIF-Guided Benchmark Recomposition?
comment: Code and data artifacts will be released
summary: Small leaderboard gaps are often interpreted as evidence that one language model is better than another, but their sign may depend on which benchmark items are included. We test this using item-level responses from five benchmarks and a family-label-free spectral approximation to multidimensional item-response theory (MIRT). In owner-disjoint folds, one owner half identifies items with low residual differential item functioning across model families (low-DIF); the resulting frozen, source- and easiness-balanced weights score models in the other half, while equally short matched-random subtests control for generic subtest variation. Full-benchmark and low-DIF rankings remain strongly correlated ($τ_b=.900$--$.948$). Yet in four of five benchmarks, 30.9--47.1\% of cross-family pairs initially within one percentage point reverse order, exceeding their matched-random medians by 16.9--28.6 percentage points (all $p=.001$). The fifth benchmark shows no reliable excess ($-0.9$ points, $p=.689$). The pattern survives all pre-specified population perturbations, and residual item--family signatures replicate across owner halves; however, no family shows a consistent advantage across benchmarks. Thus, globally stable rankings can still leave individual near-tie orderings sensitive to benchmark composition, and sub-one-point leaderboard gaps should be accompanied by evidence that the implied ordering is composition-robust.

AI.tldr: 本文基于五项基准测试的逐题作答数据，采用无模型族标签的谱近似多维项目反应理论（MIRT），研究小分差排行榜差距对题目（benchmark item）构成的敏感性。作者用"持有方不相交折分"选出低DIF题目，再在另一半数据上打分。虽然低DIF排名与完整排行榜高度相关（τ_b=.900–.948），但在五个基准中的四个里，原本差距在1个百分点以内的跨模型族配对中，有30.9%–47.1%的顺序发生反转，显著超过随机匹配子测试的中位水平；仅第五个基准无显著超额效应。结论是：全局稳定的排名仍然可能使个别"接近平局"的顺序对基准构成敏感，次一分级差距应附带构成稳健性证据。
AI.motivation: 小而重要的排行榜差距常被直接解读为某个语言模型优于另一个，但这一结论的有效性存疑：基准中包含哪些题目可能改变排名的正负号。现有研究缺乏系统检验"榜单位置的构成敏感性"的方法，作者希望回答：当两个模型的表现非常接近时，排名是否只是特定题目集合的产物。
AI.method: 使用五项基准的逐题（item-level）作答数据；采用无模型族标签的谱近似方法估计多维IRT模型以刻画残差项目—模型族交互。具体流程为：在"持有方不相交折分"（owner-disjoint folds）中，用一个持有方的数据挑选残差跨族差异低的题目（low-DIF），得到冻结的、按来源与难度平衡的权重，在另一半数据上对模型打分；同时用等长的、随机匹配的子测试作为对照，以控制一般性子测试变异。此外还实施了预先指定的人群扰动检验，并检验残差项目—族特征在两个持有方之间的复制性。
AI.result: 低DIF子测验与完整基准的排名仍高度相关（τ_b=.900–.948）。然而在五个基准中的四个，原本差距在1个百分点以内的跨族配对中，30.9%–47.1%的顺序发生反转，较随机匹配中位数高出16.9–28.6个百分点（均p=.001）；第五个基准未见可靠超额（-0.9个百分点，p=.689）。该模式在所有人预指定扰动下依然成立，残差题项—族特征在两个持有方间可复制；但没有哪个模型族在所有基准上表现出一致优势。
AI.conclusion: 全局稳定的排行榜排名仍可能使个别接近平局的模型顺序对基准构成高度敏感（即整体秩相关高不代表局部次序稳健）。因此，报告中小于1个百分点的排行榜差距应当附带证据，证明其隐含的顺序对基准构成具有稳健性，否则不应将其解读为某一模型更优。

title: Advanced Pixel Diffusion Model with Guided Sparse Global Refinement
summary: Pixel-space diffusion has recently emerged as a promising direction for high-fidelity image generation by modeling images directly in the original pixel domain. However, pixel-space diffusion is computationally demanding due to the extremely high dimensionality of natural images. For efficiency, existing pixel diffusion models either compromise fine details with large-patch tokenization or confine subsequent refinement within individual patches. Such intra-patch refinement inevitably restricts structural continuity across patch boundaries and long-range token interactions, limiting refinement quality. To address these issues, we propose PixSGR, a novel Pixel diffusion framework with Sparse Global Refinement tailored for modeling the distribution of natural images directly in pixel space. PixSGR starts from a supervised low-channel bottleneck to efficiently capture the low-dimensional manifold of natural images. It then progressively expands the channel dimensionality and spatial resolution to recover increasingly fine-grained structures. At the spatial refinement stage, coarse-scale attention maps preselect globally relevant interactions to pre-sparsify fine-scale attention, enabling non-local refinement beyond isolated patches without the quadratic cost of dense attention. Extensive experiments on ImageNet validate the effectiveness of PixSGR. It achieves an FID of 1.51 at 256$\times$256 and maintains performance when scaled to 512$\times$512, attaining an FID of 1.60.

AI.tldr: 提出了PixSGR，一种面向像素空间扩散模型的稀疏全局细化框架。它通过监督式低通道瓶颈高效捕获自然图像的低维流形，逐步扩展通道维度与空间分辨率，并在空间细化阶段利用粗尺度注意力图预选全局相关交互来预稀疏化细尺度注意力，从而实现超越孤立补丁的非局部细化且避免稠密注意力的二次方开销。在ImageNet上以FID 1.51（256×256）和FID 1.60（512×512）验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散虽能在原始像素域直接建模以生成高保真图像，但自然图像维度极高导致计算开销巨大。现有像素扩散模型为求效率要么用大补丁token化牺牲细节，要么将后续细化限制在单个补丁内，而这种补丁内细化会破坏补丁边界的结构连续性并限制长程token交互，最终制约细化质量。
AI.method: PixSGR从监督式低通道瓶颈出发高效捕获自然图像的低维流形，随后逐步扩展通道维度与空间分辨率以恢复日益精细的结构；在空间细化阶段，利用粗尺度注意力图预先筛选全局相关的交互来预稀疏化细尺度注意力，从而在不产生稠密注意力二次方成本的前提下实现超越孤立补丁的非局部细化。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上的大量实验验证了PixSGR的有效性：256×256分辨率下达到FID 1.51，扩展到512×512仍保持性能，达到FID 1.60。
AI.conclusion: PixSGR通过稀疏全局细化解决了像素空间扩散中计算开销大与补丁内细化限制全局结构连续性的矛盾，在保持高效性的同时实现了非局部长程细化，并在256与512分辨率下均取得优异FID，表明该框架具备良好的可扩展性。

title: Validity-Aware Jailbreak Evaluation for Large Language Models
summary: Jailbreak robustness has become central to large language model (LLM) safety evaluation, yet prevailing methodologies rely primarily on refusal behavior, semantic resemblance, and intent-matching heuristics that emphasize linguistic plausibility rather than correctness. We identify a key limitation in existing evaluations: many jailbreak intents depend on instructional validity rather than epistemic factuality, allowing realistic-looking responses to be labeled successful despite being factually or procedurally incorrect. To address this gap, we propose Sequential Epistemic and Action-Level Validation (SEAV), a verification-centric jailbreak evaluation framework that decomposes responses into ordered steps and evaluates both validity and correctness. SEAV combines LLM-as-a-judge mechanisms for semantic interpretation with retrieval-grounded verification using external knowledge sources, assessing whether generated content is factually correct, structurally consistent, and operationally capable of advancing harmful objectives. Empirically, SEAV cuts the false-positive rate on SD-A (a curated strategic-dishonesty diagnostic) by 14.9\,pp vs. the strongest baseline, and reclassifies 22.1\%--51.0\% of sampled prior-labeled successes as invalid across three of four public benchmarks. Together, these results show that enforcing correctness substantially reshapes measured robustness: many previously labeled jailbreak successes are reclassified as invalid, and results are stable across the tested search backends and evaluator models. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Ardor-Wu/SEAV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SEAV（Sequential Epistemic and Action-Level Validation），一个以验证为核心的越狱评估框架，将模型回复分解为有序步骤，同时评估其语义有效性与事实正确性，显著降低越狱评估中的误报率。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型越狱评估方法主要依赖拒绝行为、语义相似度和意图匹配等启发式标准，强调语言合理性而非正确性。许多越狱意图依赖的是指令有效性而非认识论事实性，导致看似合理的回复即使事实或程序上是错误的，仍可能被错误标记为成功，从而高估模型的越狱脆弱性。
AI.method: SEAV 将回复分解为有序步骤，结合 LLM-as-a-judge 机制进行语义解释，并利用外部知识源进行基于检索的事实核验，综合评估生成内容是否事实正确、结构一致且在操作上足以推进有害目标。
AI.result: 在 SD-A（战略性欺骗诊断数据集）上，SEAV 相比最强基线将误报率降低 14.9 个百分点；在三个公开基准上，将 22.1%–51.0% 先前标记为成功的样本重新分类为无效，且结果在不同检索后端和评估模型上保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 强制要求正确性会显著重塑对鲁棒性的测量结果：许多此前被视为越狱成功的样本实际无效，说明现有评估方法需将认识论事实性与操作有效性纳入核心标准，才能获得更真实、可靠的 LLM 安全评估。

title: Topological Steering
summary: With the rapid rise of large language models (LLMs), controlling undesirable model behaviors has become increasingly important. Existing behavioral control methods typically intervene directly in activation or feature space, but such approaches can be sensitive to outliers, distributional shifts, noise, and other local perturbations. Motivated by Topological Data Analysis (TDA), which captures global rather than purely local structure, we propose Topological Steering, a new framework for steering LLM behavior through the topological representation of activation spaces. Using persistence diagrams, our method connects activation-based steering with TDA and enables more robust behavioral control. We show that Topological Steering consistently modifies LLM behavior across multiple model families and model sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Topological Steering框架，利用持久性图（Persistence Diagrams）对LLM激活空间进行拓扑表示，从而实现比传统激活/特征空间干预更鲁棒的行为控制，并在多个模型家族和模型规模上验证了一致的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM行为控制方法通常直接干预激活空间或特征空间，这类方法对异常值、分布偏移、噪声及其他局部扰动敏感；而TDA能够捕捉全局而非纯局部的结构，因此引入TDA可提升行为控制的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出Topological Steering框架，通过持久性图将激活空间中的steering与拓扑数据分析（TDA）联系起来，以激活空间的拓扑表示来引导LLM行为，实现更鲁棒的行为控制。
AI.result: 实验表明Topological Steering能够在多个模型家族和多种模型规模上持续、一致地改变LLM行为，验证了该方法的有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 基于拓扑表示的激活空间引导为LLM行为控制提供了一种比局部干预更稳健的新途径，在未来可能成为应对分布偏移和噪声场景下行为控制的优选方案。

title: EvoFlint: An Evolutionary Atlas of Multi-Turn LLM Vulnerabilities
summary: Frontier language models that refuse harmful single-turn prompts often comply when the same intent is reached gradually over many turns, making multi-turn attacks one of the least understood failure modes of large language models. Most automated red-teaming methods treat this as a generation problem: produce attacks that break the model. We argue it is better framed as a search problem: discover, organize, and iteratively refine a diverse archive of attack strategies, producing a structured map of how a target model fails rather than a list of one-off successes. We introduce EvoFlint, which applies evolutionary quality-diversity search to multi-turn red-teaming. Attack strategies are phased conversation plans, not raw prompts, and are evolved through LLM-driven mutation and crossover. A Pareto fitness over attack success rate and peak severity preserves selection signal from near-miss attacks. A risk-indexed archive runs novelty search with local competition over strategy description embeddings inside each cell, maintaining diversity without committing to a predefined style taxonomy. A generation-level memory accumulates target-model insights across the population and feeds them back into strategy generation. On the HarmBench-test split, EvoFlint reaches attack success rates of 35.8% on Claude Sonnet 4.6, 59.7% on GPT-5.4, and 94.3% on Qwen3-32B, alongside 98.7% on the older GPT-4o included as a baseline reference. The resulting archive, organized by risk category, exposes for each target which categories of harm its safety training has and has not covered.

AI.tldr: EvoFlint 将多轮越狱（multi-turn red-teaming）重新定义为搜索问题而非生成问题，采用进化式质量-多样性（quality-diversity）搜索，把攻击策略视为分阶段对话计划，并通过 LLM 驱动的变异与交叉进行演化。它结合 Pareto 适应度（攻击成功率与峰值严重性）保留近失攻击信号、基于风险索引的档案库进行局部竞争的 novelty search 以维持多样性，以及代际记忆将目标模型的洞察反馈回策略生成。在 HarmBench-test 上分别达到对 Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4、Qwen3-32B 的 35.8%、59.7%、94.3% 攻击成功率，并产出按风险类别组织的攻击档案地图，揭示目标模型安全训练覆盖与未覆盖的危害类别。
AI.motivation: 前端语言模型通常能拒绝有害的单轮提示，但当相同意图经过多轮逐步达成时却常会顺从，使多轮攻击成为大语言模型最缺乏理解的失败模式之一。现有自动化红队方法多将其视为"生成问题"——产出能攻破模型的攻击即可，但作者认为应将其重构为"搜索问题"：发现、组织并迭代精炼多样化的攻击策略档案，从而生成目标模型如何失效的结构化地图，而非零散的一次性成功列表。
AI.method: EvoFlint 采用进化式质量-多样性搜索进行多轮红队测试。核心设计包括：(1) 攻击策略被表示为分阶段对话计划而非原始提示，并通过 LLM 驱动的变异和交叉进行演化；(2) 采用基于攻击成功率与峰值严重性的 Pareto 适应度，以保留近失攻击（near-miss）的选择信号；(3) 风险索引档案库在每格内基于策略描述嵌入进行局部竞争的 novelty search，在无需预定义风格分类的前提下维持多样性；(4) 代际记忆跨种群累积目标模型洞察并将其反馈到新策略生成中。
AI.result: 在 HarmBench-test 划分上，EvoFlint 对 Claude Sonnet 4.6 达到 35.8%、对 GPT-5.4 达到 59.7%、对 Qwen3-32B 达到 94.3% 的攻击成功率，并对作为基线参考的旧版 GPT-4o 达到 98.7%。最终生成的档案库按风险类别组织，能够揭示每个目标模型的安全训练已覆盖与未覆盖的危害类别。
AI.conclusion: 将多轮红队从"生成攻击"重新框定为"搜索攻击策略空间"，不仅能显著提升多轮越狱的攻击成功率并覆盖不同模型，还能产出一张按风险类别组织的攻击档案地图，系统性地展示目标模型安全训练覆盖的盲区。这一范式将红队从一次性攻击列表转向对模型失效方式的持续、结构化测绘，为评估和改善模型安全训练提供更有解释力的工具。

title: ReBridge-Flow: Re-Coupling Posterior Bridges in Flow Matching for Image Restoration
summary: Flow Matching provides an efficient generative prior for image restoration by learning continuous transport between source and data distributions. However, existing methods typically incorporate measurement constraints through local corrections. Such corrections may disrupt the source-clean endpoint coupling implicitly encoded by the pretrained flow, making the corrected endpoint pair incompatible with the current state. To address this issue, we propose ReBridge-Flow, a posterior bridge re-coupling method. Specifically, given the current state, ReBridge-Flow first decodes the corresponding local source and clean endpoints. It then incorporates measurement information through clean-side anchoring and synchronously re-couples the source endpoint, yielding a measurement-aware endpoint pair with improved local bridge compatibility. The re-coupled endpoints further define a posterior-informed transport direction for advancing the sampling process. We also introduce the Posterior Bridge Defect, which jointly characterizes measurement error, deviation from the flow prior, and bridge mismatch, and leads to explicit updates for clean-side anchoring and source-side re-coupling. Extensive experiments on multiple natural and medical image restoration tasks demonstrate that ReBridge-Flow effectively alleviates bridge mismatch and improves the structural consistency of restored images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReBridge-Flow，一种基于后验桥重耦合的流匹配图像复原方法。它针对现有方法通过局部校正引入测量约束会破坏预训练流中源-清晰端点耦合的问题，通过解码当前状态对应的源与清晰端点、执行清晰侧锚定与源端同步重耦合，并引入后验桥缺陷度量来显式更新两端，从而获得与当前状态兼容的测量感知端点对，定义后验引导的传输方向以推进采样。在自然图像与医学图像多项复原任务上验证了其缓解桥不匹配并提升结构一致性的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流匹配的图像复原方法通常通过局部校正来引入测量约束，但这种校正会破坏预训练流隐式编码的源-清晰端点耦合，导致校正后的端点对与当前状态不兼容（即桥不匹配），影响复原质量。
AI.method: 提出 ReBridge-Flow 后验桥重耦合方法：给定当前状态，先解码对应的局部源端点和清晰端点；再通过清晰侧锚定引入测量信息，并同步重耦合源端点，得到测量感知、具备更好局部桥兼容性的端点对；该端点对进一步定义后验引导的传输方向用于推进采样。同时引入后验桥缺陷（Posterior Bridge Defect），联合刻画测量误差、对流先验的偏离以及桥不匹配，并由此推导出清晰侧锚定与源侧重耦合的显式更新规则。
AI.result: 在多个自然图像与医学图像复原任务上的大量实验表明，ReBridge-Flow 能有效缓解桥不匹配问题，并提升复原图像的结构一致性。
AI.conclusion: ReBridge-Flow 通过测量感知的端点重耦合机制修复了局部校正导致的源-清晰端点耦合失配，在保持流先验的同时更好地注入测量信息，从而提升图像复原的结构一致性与整体性能。

title: Wave Function Backpropagation with Explicit Temporal-Interval Dynamics
summary: Conventional neural networks learn predominantly through affine transformations followed by nonlinear activations, while elapsed time is often treated as an auxiliary feature or assumed to be uniformly sampled. This paper introduces Wave Function Backpropagation (WFB), a wave-parameterized learning formulation in which neural responses are represented by learnable amplitude, wavenumber, angular frequency, and phase. The formulation associates an observed state with its temporal interval Delta t through the phase of a differentiable spatiotemporal wave. We derive standard WFB gradients and a spatial-curvature correction based on the Laplacian of the wave response. WFB is instantiated in a deliberately feed-forward trajectory predictor to provide a controlled proof of concept; sequence learning is outside the scope of the present evaluation. With motion features, STD-WFB using real intervals reduces average displacement error (ADE) by 20.4% relative to the original FFN baseline. In a new position-only evaluation that removes temporal leakage through precomputed velocity and acceleration, real-interval WFB reduces ADE by 10.4% relative to the original FFN and remains competitive with parameter-matched ReLU controls, obtaining 2.1% lower mean ADE than the matched FFN with explicit Delta t. Shuffled-interval WFB attains the lowest mean ADE, indicating that the present evidence supports the effectiveness of the wave representation but does not attribute the gain to interval alignment. These results establish WFB as a viable structured feed-forward learning formulation and define a clear basis for subsequent architectural studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出波函数反向传播（WFB），一种以可学习振幅、波数、角频率和相位表示神经响应的波参数化学习框架，通过时空波的相位将观测状态与时间间隔Δt关联，并将其实例化为前馈轨迹预测器。实验表明，使用真实时间间隔的WFB相比原始FFN基线可将平均位移误差（ADE）降低20.4%（含运动特征）和10.4%（仅位置输入），与参数匹配的ReLU对照组相比平均ADE降低2.1%；但打乱间隔的WFB取得了最低平均ADE，说明增益主要来自波表示本身而非间隔对齐。
AI.motivation: 传统神经网络主要依赖于仿射变换加非线性激活，时间信息通常被视为辅助特征或假设均匀采样，缺乏一种将时间间隔自然纳入网络响应、并能显式刻画时空动态的通用学习范式。作者希望设计一种以波参数（振幅、波数、角频率、相位）表征神经响应的学习形式，使网络能够利用时间间隔信息。
AI.method: 提出Wave Function Backpropagation（WFB）框架：神经响应由可学习的振幅、波数、角频率和相位参数化；通过可微的时空波相位将观测状态与其时间间隔Δ t相关联。推导了标准WFB梯度，并基于波响应的Laplacian引入空间曲率修正项。模型实例化为刻意设计的前馈（feed-forward）轨迹预测器，序列学习不在本评估范围内。
AI.result: 在含运动特征设置下，采用真实间隔的STD-WFB相比原始FFN基线将平均位移误差（ADE）降低20.4%。在新的仅位置输入评估（去除通过预计算速度与加速度造成的时间泄漏）中，真实间隔WFB相比原始FFN降低ADE 10.4%，并与参数匹配的ReLU对照相当，比显式加入Δt的匹配FFN平均ADE低2.1%。打乱间隔的WFB取得最低平均ADE，表明现有证据支持波表示的有效性，但增益不归因于间隔对齐。
AI.conclusion: WFB被确立为一种可行的结构化前馈学习范式，其增益主要来源于波参数化表示本身而非时间间隔的对齐，这为后续更深入的结构/架构研究（如序列学习）提供了明确的基础与评估基线。

title: Confess What You Know: Forget-Set Misalignment with Model Knowledge in LLM Unlearning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 22 pages, 3 figures
summary: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) often assumes that a pre-defined forget set matches what the model has memorized, but this frequently breaks in realistic privacy settings where the original training data is inaccessible. We term this gap forget-set misalignment and identify two cases. In Under Unlearning, the forget set omits memorized information and leakage persists. In Out-of-Knowledge Unlearning, the algorithm is driven to "forget" knowledge the model never learned, perturbing parameters and degrading utility. Using gradient-level analysis, we show these behaviors arise from misaligned unlearning targets rather than specific optimization choices. We then propose CONfession-to-Forget-Set (CONFS), a data-blind framework that constructs model-aligned forget sets by eliciting and formalizing the model's memorized knowledge. Across synthetic, multimodal, and real-world benchmarks, CONFS approaches Gold-standard performance on several metrics and achieves a competitive forgetting-utility balance, while preserving utility better than other data-blind forget-set constructions.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型机器遗忘中遗忘集与实际记忆内容不匹配的问题，提出CONFS数据盲框架，通过诱导并形式化模型自身记忆知识来构建对齐的遗忘集，在合成、多模态及真实基准上接近金标准性能并实现竞争性的遗忘-效用平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM机器遗忘方法常假设预定义的遗忘集与模型已记忆的内容一致，但在原始训练数据不可访问的真实隐私场景中该假设经常失效。作者将此差距定义为"遗忘集错位"（forget-set misalignment），并识别出两种情形：欠遗忘（遗漏已记忆信息导致泄漏持续）与知识外遗忘（算法被迫"遗忘"模型从未学到的知识，扰动参数并损害效用）。
AI.method: 通过梯度级分析证明上述现象源于错位的遗忘目标而非特定优化选择。据此提出CONFession-to-Forget-Set（CONFS），一种数据盲框架，通过诱导并形式化模型已记忆的知识来构建与模型对齐的遗忘集。
AI.result: 在合成、多模态和真实世界基准上，CONFS在多项指标上接近金标准的性能，实现了具有竞争力的遗忘-效用平衡，并比其他数据盲遗忘集构造方法更好地保持效用。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘集与模型记忆的对齐是有效且保持效用的机器遗忘的关键；CONFS证明了在不依赖原始训练数据的情况下，通过从模型自身诱导记忆知识构建对齐遗忘集是可行且有效的方案。

title: MemeBridge: A Dataset for Benchmarking and Mitigating the Bidirectional Cultural Gap in Meme Interpretation
summary: Communicating across cultures is inherently challenging, especially through culturally dense and ambiguous formats like memes. While people expect large language models (LLMs) to hold promise for bridging such gaps, existing benchmark datasets often fail to capture the cultural context necessary for accurate interpretation. To address this, we introduce MemeBridge, a curated dataset centered on U.S.-originated memes, designed to capture two complementary perspectives: (1) how Chinese participants interpret these memes, and (2) how U.S. participants anticipate how people from other cultures might misunderstand them. Here, context refers to implicit cultural knowledge, including background beliefs, norms, and shared assumptions that shape meme comprehension. The dataset was constructed via a multi-stage crowdsourcing pipeline with rigorous validation, including human agreement checks and GPT-based classification verification. Each meme is annotated with sentiment, emotion, cultural significance, and knowledge type, providing rich supervision for downstream tasks. Notably, we observe that the anticipated misunderstandings from U.S. participants are often inaccurate, highlighting the asymmetries in cultural understanding and the challenges of adopting perspectives beyond one's own. This bidirectional framing, which focuses on both expression and perception, enables more nuanced benchmarking of cross-cultural comprehension. Our probing of multiple LLMs reveals that while models developed in different cultural contexts exhibit partial cross-cultural understanding, they often struggle with sophisticated interpretations. By contrast, fine-tuning with MemeBridge improves model performance, underscoring the value of culturally grounded resources for training and evaluating LLMs in globally diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MemeBridge，一个围绕美国起源梗（meme）构建的跨文化理解数据集，同时捕捉中国参与者对梗的解读以及美国参与者对他人可能误解的预判，并通过对多种 LLM 的探测与微调验证了该文化感知资源对提升模型跨文化理解能力的价值。
AI.motivation: 跨文化沟通本质上具有挑战性，尤其是通过文化密集且模糊的格式（如梗图）进行沟通时。尽管人们期望 LLM 能弥合这类文化鸿沟，但现有基准数据集往往缺乏准确解读所需的丰富文化背景，无法有效支撑跨文化理解的研究与评测。
AI.method: 构建了 MemeBridge 数据集，采用双向互补视角：中国参与者对 meme 的解读，以及美国参与者对来自其他文化人群可能产生误解的预判；通过多阶段众包流水线并配合人类一致性检验与基于 GPT 的分类验证进行严格质检，为每个 meme 标注情感、情绪、文化意义与知识类型，随后对多种 LLM 进行探测并以该数据集进行微调。
AI.result: 实验结果发现：美国参与者预判的误解往往并不准确，凸显了文化理解的不对称性与视角转换的困难；不同文化语境下开发的 LLM 虽具备部分跨文化理解能力，但常在精细解读上表现欠佳；利用 MemeBridge 微调可显著提升模型性能。
AI.conclusion: MemeBridge 这种同时关注表达与感知的双向框架，为跨文化理解提供了更精细的基准评测手段；研究强调文化扎根资源在训练与评测面向全球多样场景的 LLM 中的重要价值。

title: RingMoClaw: An Experience-Inspired Multi-Agent Framework for Self-Evolving Research in Remote Sensing
summary: Remote sensing visual models have continuously advanced various interpretation tasks. However, the research process behind model improvement still heavily relies on manual expertise, requiring extensive trial-and-error iterations in model design, data processing, and performance diagnosis. Existing agent-based approaches mainly focus on task execution and workflow orchestration, while lacking the capability of autonomous research iteration for continuous performance optimization. To address this issue, we propose RingMoClaw, an experience-inspired self-evolving multi-agent framework for remote sensing visual interpretation. RingMoClaw integrates a research branch, a quality-control branch, and a dual-stream dynamic experience bus to establish a closed-loop optimization process covering strategy generation, experiment execution, independent review, and experience accumulation. The heterogeneous Critic mechanism provides stage-wise diagnosis and feedback, while the dual-stream experience bus incorporates external knowledge and internal experimental experience to guide strategy evolution and eliminate ineffective searches. Extensive experiments on four remote sensing downstream tasks, including object detection, scene classification, semantic segmentation, and change detection, demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of RingMoClaw. Compared with the corresponding baseline models, RingMoClaw improves performance by 1.84\% mAP$_{50}$ on object detection and achieves consistent gains across the other three tasks, while reducing the required evolution steps by over 40\% compared with existing research automation frameworks. These results suggest that RingMoClaw offers a feasible route from task execution toward continuous research driven model evolution in remote sensing.

AI.tldr: 提出RingMoClaw，一个经验启发的自进化多智能体框架，通过研究分支、质量控制分支和双流动态经验总线构建覆盖策略生成、实验执行、独立评审和经验积累的闭环优化流程，用于遥感视觉解译的持续性能优化。
AI.motivation: 遥感视觉模型的改进过程仍高度依赖人工专家经验，需要在模型设计、数据处理和性能诊断中进行大量试错迭代。现有基于智能体的方法主要聚焦于任务执行和工作流编排，缺乏自主研究迭代以持续优化性能的能力。
AI.method: RingMoClaw集成了三大核心组件：(1) 研究分支（research branch）与质量控制分支（quality-control branch），负责策略生成与独立评审；(2) 双流动态经验总线（dual-stream dynamic experience bus），融合外部知识与内部实验经验以引导策略进化并消除无效搜索；(3) 异构Critic机制（heterogeneous Critic），提供分阶段诊断与反馈。整体形成涵盖策略生成、实验执行、独立评审、经验积累的闭环优化流程。
AI.result: 在目标检测、场景分类、语义分割和变化检测四个遥感下游任务上的实验表明，RingMoClaw在目标检测上较基线提升1.84% mAP50，在其他三个任务上均取得一致增益，同时相比现有研究自动化框架减少超过40%的进化步数，验证了其有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RingMoClaw为遥感领域从任务执行走向持续研究驱动的模型进化提供了一条可行路径，实现了由经验启发的自主研究迭代闭环，缓解了对人工专家试错的高度依赖。

title: CoVer: Conflict-Aware Claim Verification
summary: Social media fact-checking has long been challenged by evidence-level and aggregation-level conflicts, where erroneous evidence mimics authoritative news sources. To capture this challenge and support conflict verification tasks, we present ContraNote, a large-scale real-world dataset curated from X's Community Notes system. It includes 33,686 posts for evaluating evidence-level conflict resolution, and 54,474 instances for evaluating aggregation-level prioritization. Additionally, we propose CoVer, a factual adjudication framework with three-stage pipelines: evidence schema normalization, factual consensus and support verification. This prioritizes evidence over noise to prevent it from compromising the final verdict. Technical evaluations show that CoVer achieves strong performance compared with state-of-the-art baselines across ContraNote (86.0% Acc., 68.0% mac. F1, 64.5 bal. Acc. on Conflict; and 88.5% Acc., 88.5 mac. F1 and 89.2 bal. Acc. on Prioritization), CONFACT-HumC (88.4% Acc.) and CONFACT-ModC (89.4% Acc.).

AI.tldr: 本文提出ContraNote，一个基于X（Twitter）Community Notes系统构建的大规模真实世界社交媒体事实核查数据集（33,686条用于证据级冲突消解，54,474条用于聚合级优先排序），并提出CoVer三阶段事实裁决框架（证据模式规范化、事实共识与支持验证），通过将证据置于噪声之上以避免干扰最终裁决，在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体事实核查长期面临两个层面的冲突挑战：证据层面的冲突（错误证据可能模仿权威新闻来源）与聚合层面的冲突。这一现象给冲突验证任务带来了困难，需要新的数据与方法来系统化地刻画并解决该问题。
AI.method: （1）构建ContraNote数据集，从X的Community Notes系统中收集真实世界数据，包含33,686条帖子用于证据级冲突消解评估，54,474个实例用于聚合级优先排序评估；（2）提出CoVer事实裁决框架，采用三阶段流水线：证据模式规范化（evidence schema normalization）、事实共识（factual consensus）与支持验证（support verification），核心思想是让证据优先于噪声，防止噪声干扰最终裁决。
AI.result: CoVer在ContraNote数据集上表现优异：冲突消解任务达到86.0%准确率、68.0%宏平均F1、64.5平衡准确率；优先排序任务达到88.5%准确率、88.5宏平均F1、89.2平衡准确率；在CONFACT-HumC上准确率达88.4%，在CONFACT-ModC上准确率达89.4%，整体优于各最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将证据置于噪声之上的优先化设计，CoVer有效缓解了社交媒体事实核查中的证据级与聚合级冲突问题；ContraNote为后续冲突验证研究提供了大规模真实世界基准，验证了所提框架在多样化数据集上的泛化能力与鲁棒性。

title: Breaking the Structural Identity: Personalized Federated LoRA Fine-tuning under Rank Heterogeneity
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, but their adaptation to privacy-sensitive, distributed datasets remains a challenge. While Federated Learning (FL) combined with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) provides a resource-efficient paradigm for collaborative fine-tuning, practical deployments are hindered by the dual challenges of resource heterogeneity and data heterogeneity. Existing rank-heterogeneous methods primarily focus on bridging dimension mismatches for aggregation but typically provide a unified global model for all clients sharing the same rank, failing to capture client-specific features in non-IID scenarios. In this paper, we propose FedRoRA (Federated Rank-wise Personalized LoRA), a novel framework that enables fine-grained personalization within rank-heterogeneous federations. FedRoRA decouples adaptation into shared global directions and personalized rank-wise magnitudes governed by learnable diagonal scales. On the server side, it extracts a global subspace via singular value decomposition (SVD) and redistributes client-specific initializations through a personalized projection and top-$k$ selection mechanism. Extensive experiments on NLU and NLG benchmarks demonstrate that FedRoRA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: FedRoRA 提出了一种在异构秩联邦中实现细粒度个性化的 LoRA 框架，通过将适配解耦为共享的全局方向和可学习的逐秩个性化幅度，并利用 SVD 提取全局子空间及个性化投影与 top-k 选择机制，在 NLU 与 NLG 基准上持续优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型在隐私敏感、分布式数据集上的适配仍具挑战。尽管 FL 与 LoRA 结合提供了资源高效的协作微调范式，实际部署受资源异构性和数据异构性的双重制约。现有秩异构方法主要关注通过维度匹配实现聚合，但通常为所有客户端提供共享同一秩的全局模型，无法在非独立同分布（non-IID）场景下捕捉客户端特有特征，缺乏个性化的细粒度支持。
AI.method: FedRoRA 将适配解耦为共享的全局方向与由可学习对角尺度控制的个性化逐秩幅度。服务端通过奇异值分解（SVD）提取全局子空间，并借助个性化投影与 top-k 选择机制向各客户端重新分配特定初始化，从而实现秩异构联邦内的细粒度个性化。
AI.result: 在自然语言理解（NLU）和自然语言生成（NLG）基准上的大量实验表明，FedRoRA 在性能上一致优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: FedRoRA 通过全局方向与个性化逐秩幅度的解耦，在不共享统一全局秩的情况下兼顾异构资源利用与客户端个性化需求，为秩异构联邦场景下的 LLM 微调提供了一种更优的解决方案。

title: Human-Anchored Factuality Evaluation with Strategic Annotation
comment: Accepted as a conference paper for Industrial Track of EMNLP 2026
summary: LLM-based factuality judges provide scalable evaluation signals, but their metrics are often systematically biased relative to human judgments. We study human-anchored factuality evaluation under limited annotation budgets, where judge predictions on the full dataset are combined with human labels on a small selectively sampled subset to obtain statistically valid estimates. The efficiency of this approach depends critically on which examples receive human annotation: in factuality evaluation, judge-human misalignment is not driven solely by low confidence, but also by structured failure modes such as incomplete evidence, temporal mismatch, unverifiable claims, and rubric misalignment. To exploit this structure, we introduce a factuality-specific annotation policy design pipeline that uses failure-space analysis (FSA) to derive diverse predictive signals for modeling human-judge misalignment. On an internal reference-based factuality evaluation system (AutoFA) and RAGTruth, where judge-predicted estimates substantially underestimate human-annotated factual accuracy, our FSA-guided policy improves annotation efficiency over uniform sampling and uncertainty-driven baselines, achieving effective-sample-size gains of 40.3% on AutoFA and 27.1% on RAGTruth.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在有限标注预算下如何利用人类标注的样本对LLM事实性评判模型（judge）的预测进行校正，提出基于失败空间分析（FSA）的采样策略，通过建模评判者与人类判断的系统性分歧（不完整证据、时间错配、不可验证声明、标准错位等）来选择最有价值的标注样本，显著提升标注效率。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的事实性评判模型虽然能提供可扩展的评估信号，但其度量相对人类判断往往存在系统性偏差；在标注预算有限的情况下，评判模型的全量预测与少量人工标注如何结合以获得统计有效且高效的事实性评估结果，是关键挑战。现有不确定性驱动的采样忽略了误判并非仅由低置信度引起，还来源于结构化的失败模式。
