AI.method: 提出面向事实性评估的标注策略设计流程：采用失败空间分析（FSA）从数据中挖掘多样化的预测信号，用于建模"人类-评判模型"错配（misalignment）；随后利用这些信号指导选择性采样，将评判模型在全数据集上的预测与精选子集上的人类标注相结合，得到统计有效的估计。
AI.result: 在内部基于参考的事实性评估系统AutoFA和RAGTruth上，评判模型预测显著低估了人类标注的事实准确率；FSA引导的采样策略相比均匀采样和不确定性驱动的基线，有效样本量（effective sample size）分别提升40.3%（AutoFA）和27.1%（RAGTruth）。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模评判者与人类判断背后的结构化失败模式，而非仅依赖置信度，可以大幅提升有限标注预算下事实性评估的标注效率，为"人机协同"的人类锚定评估提供更有效的采样方案。

title: Can Scene Text Recognition Read Rare Compositions?
comment: Preprint. Under review. Main text plus appendix: 10 figures, 13 tables
summary: Scene text recognition is reported as 89--97% accurate on the six standard benchmarks, and the problem is widely treated as saturated. We present an alternative reading. When the same test images are stratified jointly by ground-truth word rarity and character n-gram novelty against a reference corpus, accuracy at the rare-word x rare-trigram corner of the resulting 5x5 grid drops 10--18 pt below the q3/q3 centre across nine English specialised recognisers, and the same direction (corner below centre) holds on all 13 of 13 (language, model) pairs we test across four writing systems (Latin, Han, Han+kana, Arabic). The drop is not a capacity bottleneck. A 6x vision-backbone scale-up (CLIP4STR-Base 158M -> CLIP4STR-Huge 1.0B, OpenCLIP ViT-H/14 LAION-2B) leads every benchmark in aggregate accuracy yet leaves the stress corner unchanged (86.9 -> 86.5, within paired-bootstrap noise). Four converging probes--layer-wise probing, confidence-when-wrong, attention re-balancing, and a cross-script commit-vs-abstain error split--localise the failure to the autoregressive decoder's lexical prior. We then ask how much of the gap existing techniques recover. Of 16 non-architectural mitigations, the largest mean q5/q5 gain is +1.3 pt and none clears the paired-bootstrap noise floor; the only intervention that does is the architectural shift from autoregressive to CTC decoding (SVTRv2, +2.5 pt, p=0.02, n=474). A confidence-routed AR-CTC ensemble adds a directionally consistent +0.6 pt that stays within noise, and its dominant learned coefficient is each model's own minimum-softmax confidence--independently echoing the mechanism above. No configuration we test improves both the compositional corner and aggregate accuracy. The rare-input long tail thus points to architectural change rather than added capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文对"场景文字识别已饱和"的共识提出异议：按词频稀有度和字符三元组新颖度对测试图像分层后，稀有词×稀有三元组角落的准确率比中心低10–18pt；该问题并非容量瓶颈（参数从158M扩至1.0B不改变角落性能），而源于自回归解码器的词汇先验；16种非架构缓解均未超过成对bootstrap噪声，唯一显著有效的是改用CTC解码（+2.5pt, p=0.02），且没有任何配置能同时改善组成性角落与整体准确率。
AI.motivation: 标准基准上场景文字识别准确率已达89–97%，问题普遍被视为已饱和；作者认为这一判断误导，因为当按词稀有度与字符n-gram新颖度联合分层时，稀有输入角落存在系统性性能塌陷，值得重新审视真正的瓶颈所在。
AI.method: 采用5×5网格按词稀有度×三元组新颖度分层评估9种英文识别器与跨4种书写系统的13组(语言,模型)；通过6倍视觉主干缩放（CLIP4STR-Base 158M→Huge 1.0B）检验容量假设；用四种探针（逐层探针、错误时置信度、注意力再平衡、跨脚本提交-弃权错误拆分）定位失败源；再系统性比较16种非架构缓解与CTC架构切换（SVTRv2），并用置信度路由的AR-CTC集成进一步验证。
AI.result: 稀有×稀有角落准确率比中心低10–18pt，且13/13对(语言,模型)均呈角落低于中心的趋势；扩大容量使整体准确率领先所有基准但角落不变（86.9→86.5，处于噪声内）；四种探针一致将失败归因于自回归解码器的词汇先验；16种非架构缓解的q5/q5最大增益仅+1.3pt且未越过噪声底限，唯一显著干预是架构性切换为CTC解码（+2.5pt, p=0.02），置信度路由AR-CTC集成仅+0.6pt且在噪声内，其主导学习系数正是各模型自身的最小softmax置信度；测试的所有配置均无法同时改善角落与整体准确率。
AI.conclusion: 稀有输入长尾问题指向架构变革而非增加容量：修复组成性角落需要放弃依赖词汇先验的自回归解码架构（如改用CTC解码），仅靠扩展模型规模或非架构性缓解无法解决该缺陷。

title: When the Algorithm Becomes the Brand Crisis: A Sociotechnical Theory of Distributed Responsibility and Accountable Transparency
summary: Artificial intelligence systems increasingly enact market-facing promises through chatbots, recommendation systems, automated decisions, and generative interfaces. Their failures, misuse, and misrepresentation raise a question that conventional brand-crisis models do not fully specify: how do stakeholders assign responsibility when technical causation, customer-facing control, and governance duties are distributed across an AI system, developer, deployer, vendor, and user? This conceptual paper develops a sociotechnical process theory from a structured, federated scoping synthesis of verified academic and primary sources. It distinguishes an AI/algorithmic incident from an AI-related organisational crisis and, in turn, from an AI-related organisational scandal. The framework proposes that incident configuration shapes actor-specific attribution; attribution informs capability, integrity, fairness, and relationship appraisals; and public moralisation may, but need not, escalate an incident into scandal. The theory offers a reconciliation of findings that algorithm involvement can buffer negative brand reactions in some settings while robot and chatbot failures can redirect responsibility to an associated firm in others. It introduces accountable transparency as a proposed response configuration that combines timely notice, an intelligible account, role-responsibility acknowledgement, remedy, evidence of correction, and recourse. The evidence supports conditional, proximal inferences about blame, trust, satisfaction, firm evaluation, and communication credibility more strongly than claims about durable reputation, brand equity, or market performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个社会技术过程理论，解释当AI系统、开发者、部署方、供应商和用户之间技术归因、客户控制与治理责任分散时，利益相关者如何分配责任。该理论区分AI/算法事件、AI相关组织危机与AI相关组织丑闻，并提出问责透明作为应对配置。
AI.motivation: 传统品牌危机模型无法充分说明在AI系统、开发者、部署方、供应商和用户之间分布的技术因果、面向客户的控制与治理职责，因此需要新理论来解释利益相关者如何在AI失败、滥用和失实陈述中分配责任。
AI.method: 基于结构化、联邦式范围综述（federated scoping synthesis），整合经核实的学术与一手来源，发展出概念性的社会技术过程理论。
AI.result: 框架提出事件配置塑造针对行为体的责任归属，进而影响能力、诚信、公平与关系评价；公共道德化可能但并非必然将事件升级为丑闻。该理论调和了算法参与在某些情境下缓冲负面品牌反应、而机器人和聊天机器人失败在其他情境下将责任转嫁给相关企业的矛盾发现，并提出问责透明的应对配置（及时通知、可理解的说明、角色责任承认、补救、纠正证据与追索）。证据更有力地支持关于责备、信任、满意度、企业评价和沟通可信度的条件性、近端推断，而对持久声誉、品牌资产或市场表现的论断支持较弱。
AI.conclusion: 责任归因的证据支持条件性、近端的推断，而不是关于持久声誉、品牌资产或市场表现的强主张；问责透明被提出为综合性的理想响应配置。

title: DK-GBMKKM: Dynamic Kernel-Space Granular-Ball Multiple Kernel $k$-Means Clustering
summary: Multiple kernel $k$-means integrates complementary nonlinear similarities by learning a combination of base kernels. Its pointwise optimization, however, is sensitive to noisy and boundary samples and repeatedly operates on sample-scale kernel matrices. Granular-ball representations organize local sample groups into mesoscopic units, but granular balls generated once in the input space may be inconsistent with the fused-kernel geometry that evolves during multiple kernel learning. We propose dynamic kernel-space granular-ball multiple kernel $k$-means (DK-GBMKKM). The method generates granular balls in the current fused kernel space and alternates kernel-weight learning with granular-ball membership updates, allowing the representation to adapt to changes in the fused-kernel geometry. A sample-size-weighted granular-ball kernel is further constructed to preserve the contributions of balls of different sizes, and its positive semidefiniteness and related equivalence properties are established. Experiments on 12 public datasets demonstrate the strong overall clustering performance of DK-GBMKKM. The code has been open-sourced for reproducibility: https://github.com/lianxiaoyu724/DK-GBMKKM.

AI.tldr: 针对多核k-means逐点优化对噪声/边界样本敏感、以及一次性在输入空间生成的粒度球与多核学习中演化的融合核几何不一致的问题，提出动态核空间粒度球多核k-means（DK-GBMKKM）：在当前的融合核空间中生成粒度球，并交替执行核权重学习与粒度球隶属更新，使表示自适应融合核几何的变化；同时构造样本量加权的粒度球核以保留不同大小球的贡献，并证明了其半正定性与等价性质。在12个公开数据集上验证了整体聚类性能优势。
AI.motivation: 多核k-means通过学习基础核的组合来整合互补的非线性相似性，但其逐点优化对噪声样本和边界样本敏感，且反复计算样本尺度核矩阵代价高昂。粒度球表示能将局部样本组织成介观单元，但一次性在输入空间生成的粒度球可能与多核学习过程中动态演化的融合核几何不一致，导致表示失真。因此需要一个能随融合核空间几何变化而自适应的粒度球表示框架。
AI.method: 提出DK-GBMKKM：在当前的融合核空间中生成粒度球，并设计交替优化框架——核权重学习与粒度球隶属更新交替进行，使粒度球表示适应融合核几何的变化；进一步构建样本量加权的粒度球核以保留不同大小粒度球的贡献，并从理论上建立了该核的正半定性和相关等价性质。
AI.result: 在12个公开数据集上的实验表明，DK-GBMKKM取得了整体上强于对比方法的聚类性能；同时该方法具备理论保证（半正定性与等价性质），且代码已开源可复现。
AI.conclusion: 通过在融合核空间中动态生成粒度球并使其与核权重学习交替更新，DK-GBMKKM有效缓解了多核k-means对噪声/边界样本的敏感性，解决了粒度球表示与融合核几何不一致的问题，在保证理论性质的前提下提升了聚类的整体性能与鲁棒性。

title: Beyond Token Positions: Safety Alignment Across Denoising Steps in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text through iterative denoising rather than left-to-right decoding. This generation paradigm introduces two axes that can influence safety alignment: when tokens are generated during denoising and where they appear in the response. In this paper, we measure dLLM safety behavior under harmful prompts by tracing intermediate token distributions and commitment decisions throughout denoising. Our analysis shows that refusal signals are concentrated in early denoising steps and leading response positions, and the tokens committed early can strongly shape the final safety outcome. Our measurements further show that the denoising step and persistence of refusal-token commitment are important for understanding dLLM safety. Based on these findings, we propose Refusal-Aware Early Commitment (RAEC), a simple training-free decoding method that commits persistent refusal signals from early steps. Experiments on LLaDA and Dream show that RAEC reduces attack success rates while largely preserving utility. The code is available at https://github.com/Glresearch1/RAEC.

AI.tldr: 本文研究扩散大语言模型（dLLM）在有害提示下的安全对齐行为，发现拒绝信号集中于早期去噪步骤和响应前部位置，并提出无需训练的拒绝感知早期承诺（RAEC）解码方法，在LLaDA和Dream上降低攻击成功率的同时保持效用。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型通过迭代去噪生成文本而非自左向右解码，这种生成范式引入了安全对齐的两个新维度：token在去噪过程中何时被生成、以及它们出现在响应的哪个位置。理解这两个维度对dLLM安全性的影响是提出有效防护方法的前提。
AI.method: 首先通过追踪去噪过程中的中间token分布与承诺决定来测量dLLM在有害提示下的安全行为；在此基础上提出Refusal-Aware Early Commitment (RAEC)，一种无需训练的解码方法，从早期步骤中提交持久的拒绝信号。
AI.result: 测量发现拒绝信号集中在早期去噪步骤和响应前部位置，早期承诺的token能显著影响最终安全结果；去噪步骤和拒绝token承诺的持久性对理解dLLM安全至关重要。在LLaDA和Dream上的实验表明RAEC降低了攻击成功率，同时基本保持了模型效用。
AI.conclusion: dLLM的安全行为与其去噪时序和空间位置密切相关，通过早期承诺拒绝信号可以在不进行训练的情况下有效增强扩散LLM的安全对齐，为这类新型生成模型的防护提供了可行思路。

title: Visual Attention Faithfulness in Vision-Language Models is Heterogeneous
summary: Whether attention weights faithfully reflect model reasoning has been actively debated in NLP, yet this question remains largely unexplored for the visual modality in Vision-Language Models (VLMs). We address this gap through causal perturbation analysis on current VLMs, evaluating both the comprehensiveness and sufficiency gap of attention-ranked visual tokens. Our analysis reveals that visual attention faithfulness is heterogeneous, manifesting in three distinct processing modes: Faithful-Sufficient, where top-$k$ attention tokens are both necessary and sufficient for prediction; Faithful-Distributed, where they are necessary but broader visual context remains required; and Non-Focal, where no localized attention region is individually necessary while visual information remains an essential trigger for prediction. Furthermore, human-annotated ground-truth regions satisfy comprehensiveness in only $\sim 60$% of cases compared with model attention rankings, revealing systematic divergence between model visual reliance and human intuition. We demonstrate these patterns across both general VQA on VQAv2 and document tasks on VRDU and ChartQA, showing that visual attention faithfulness varies systematically with processing demands and model architectures rather than being uniformly faithful or unfaithful.

AI.tldr: 本文通过因果扰动分析首次系统研究视觉语言模型（VLM）中注意力权重是否忠实反映模型推理，发现视觉注意力忠实度具有异质性，呈现三种处理模式：忠实-充分、忠实-分布、非聚焦。人类标注的真实区域仅在约60%的情况下满足完整性，表明模型视觉依赖与人类直觉存在系统性分歧，且该模式在VQAv2、VRDU和ChartQA上随处理需求和模型架构系统地变化。
AI.motivation: 在NLP中，注意力权重是否忠实反映模型推理已被广泛讨论，但在视觉语言模型（VLM）的视觉模态中这一问题几乎未被探索。作者旨在填补这一空白，考察VLM视觉注意力是否忠实反映其推理过程。
AI.method: 采用因果扰动分析方法，对当前VLM进行干预测试，评估注意力排序的视觉token的完整性（comprehensiveness）和充分性差距（sufficiency gap）。同时将人类标注的真实区域与模型注意力排序进行对比分析。
AI.result: 发现视觉注意力忠实度呈异质性，表现为三种处理模式：（1）忠实-充分：top-k注意力token既必要又充分；（2）忠实-分布：注意力token必要但需要更广的视觉上下文；（3）非聚焦：没有局部注意力区域单独必要，但视觉信息仍作为预测的关键触发因素。此外，人类标注的真实区域仅在约60%的情况下满足完整性，与模型注意力排序存在系统性分歧。这些模式在VQAv2、VRDU和ChartQA上均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 视觉注意力忠实度并非统一忠实或不忠实，而是随处理需求和模型架构系统性地变化。模型视觉依赖与人类直觉存在系统性分歧，这提示在可解释性和人机对齐方面需要更细粒度的评估方法。

title: ISO-RAG: Isoperimetric Noise Control for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates large language models (LLMs) hallucinations, yet conventional dense retrieval struggles with the complex reasoning paths of multi-hop question answering (QA). Graph-based RAG captures multi-step relationships but suffers from severe semantic drift and high online latency due to noisy global graph traversals. Thus, we propose ISO-RAG (ISOperimetric Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a geometry-aware RAG framework. By projecting the underlying knowledge graph into a hyperbolic Poincare ball to precompute node-wise isoperimetric profiles, ISO-RAG prunes spurious edges during retrieval, restricting the search space to a strictly localized subgraph. This topological purification regulates Personalized PageRank (PPR) diffusion driving the retrieval process, ensuring exact and low-latency convergence. Experiments on multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ISO-RAG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by average absolute gains of 10.0% in retrieval recall and 4.3% in downstream exact match, achieving a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off by fundamentally eliminating the latency bottleneck of global traversals. Our source code is available at https://github.com/ZaiizaiZHANG/ISO-RAG.

AI.tldr: ISO-RAG 是一个几何感知的检索增强生成框架，通过将知识图谱投影到双曲庞加莱球并预先计算节点等周剖面来消除图中的噪声边，从而将检索限制在严格局部化的子图上，以调节 Personalized PageRank 扩散，实现多跳问答的精确、低延迟检索，在检索召回率和下游精确匹配上分别平均提升 10.0% 和 4.3%。
AI.motivation: 传统稠密检索难以应对多跳问答的复杂推理路径；基于图的 RAG 虽能捕捉多步关系，但因全局图遍历引入严重语义漂移和高在线延迟。作者旨在兼顾全局图结构信息与检索精度、效率，消除噪声遍历造成的性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 将底层知识图谱投影到双曲庞加莱球中，预计算节点级等周剖面（isoperimetric profiles），在检索阶段剪除虚假边，将搜索空间限制在严格局部化的子图上；通过这种拓扑净化机制调控 Personalized PageRank（PPR）扩散来驱动检索过程，确保精确且低延迟的收敛。
AI.result: 在多跳问答基准上，ISO-RAG 相较 SOTA 基线平均绝对增益为：检索召回率提升 10.0%，下游精确匹配提升 4.3%；通过从根本上消除全局遍历的延迟瓶颈，实现了更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: ISO-RAG 证明了几何感知的拓扑净化（双曲空间中的等周剖面）可以有效解决图基 RAG 的语义漂移与延迟问题，为多跳问答提供一个高精度、低时延的检索增强生成方案，代码已开源。

title: EEG-AS: Instance-Level Foundation Model Selection for EEG Foundation Models via Behavior Reconstruction
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a non-invasive technique for measuring neural activity and has been widely used in neuroscience applications. Recent advances in EEG foundation models have enabled strong performance across diverse neural decoding tasks. However, no single foundation model consistently performs best across datasets or individual EEG instances, while instance-level model selection remains largely unexplored. To address this limitation, we formulate EEG foundation model selection as an instance-level Algorithm Selection (AS) problem. We propose \textbf{EEG-AS}, an instance-level algorithm selection framework that characterizes each EEG instance using inference-available latent EEG embeddings, handcrafted neurophysiological features, and an anchor foundation model. During training, EEG-AS learns to reconstruct unavailable foundation-model behaviors from privileged prediction tokens conditioned on an anchor foundation model, while during inference it estimates these behaviors without executing the entire model portfolio, enabling efficient selection from seven EEG foundation models. Experiments on seven public EEG benchmarks demonstrate that EEG-AS substantially narrows the gap between the Single Best Solver (SBS) and the oracle upper bound for each instance. These results highlight the effectiveness of instance-level AS for adaptive deployment of EEG foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EEG-AS，一种面向 EEG 基础模型的实例级算法选择（AS）框架。它利用推理时可获得的潜在 EEG 嵌入、手工神经生理学特征和一个锚定基础模型来刻画每个 EEG 样本，训练时借助特权预测 token 重建不可得的各基础模型行为，推理时无需执行完整模型组合即可估计这些行为，从而在七个 EEG 基础模型中选择最优解。在七个公开 EEG 基准上，EEG-AS 显著缩小了单一最优求解器（SBS）与逐实例 oracle 上界之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 尽管 EEG 基础模型在多种神经解码任务上表现强劲，但没有任何单一基础模型能在所有数据集或个体 EEG 样本上持续最优；而实例级（instance-level）的模型选择问题此前基本未被探索。这构成了自适应部署 EEG 基础模型的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 将 EEG 基础模型选择形式化为实例级算法选择（AS）问题，并提出 EEG-AS 框架：1) 使用推理时可获得的特征刻画每个 EEG 实例，包括潜在 EEG 嵌入、手工设计的神经生理学特征以及一个锚定基础模型；2) 训练阶段，在锚定基础模型条件下，利用特权预测 token（privileged prediction tokens）学习重建无法直接获取的各候选模型行为；3) 推理阶段，无需执行完整模型组合即可估计这些行为，从而高效地在七个 EEG 基础模型中进行选择。
AI.result: 在七个公开 EEG 基准数据集上的实验表明，EEG-AS 能够大幅缩小 Single Best Solver（SBS，单一最优求解器）与逐实例 oracle 上界之间的性能差距，验证了实例级 AS 对 EEG 基础模型自适应部署的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 实例级算法选择为 EEG 基础模型的自适应部署提供了一种高效且有效的途径：通过轻量地估计各基础模型在个体样本上的行为，EEG-AS 可以在不执行完整模型组合的前提下逼近 oracle 性能，为后续在多基础模型生态下的智能调度与部署提供了新思路。

title: The Interlingua Hypothesis: LLMs Translate via a Latent Task-agnostic Feature Space
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated improved machine translation performance over strong supervised baselines. This raises questions as to what mechanisms underlie how LLMs perform machine translation between languages. Motivated by recent interpretability findings--namely, that LLMs use massively multilingual latent feature representations to perform language modeling--we propose the interlingua hypothesis. The hypothesis holds that language models translate by reading a source sentence into a latent feature space, and generate a target sentence by reading from the latent feature space. We show three lines of evidence in support of this hypothesis: (1) variance in BLEU across language pairs is largely predictable from language-specific competences with no language pair-specific interaction terms; (2) many model components are causally influential in both monolingual tasks and translation tasks; and (3) fine-tuning on monolingual data recovers a large proportion of translation improvements relative to fine-tuning on aligned documents. Together, these provide convergent evidence in support of the interlingua hypothesis, and suggest new ways of understanding and improving how LLMs can be leveraged to perform translation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"互通语（interlingua）假说"：大语言模型（LLM）通过将源语言句子编码到多语种共享的潜在特征空间，再从该空间生成目标语言句子来完成机器翻译，并通过三条证据线对该假说进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在机器翻译上已超越强监督基线，但其跨语言翻译的内在机制尚不明确。受可解释性研究的启发——LLM在语言建模中使用大规模多语种的潜在特征表示——作者提出互通语假说，以解释LLM如何在语言之间进行翻译。
AI.method: 作者提出互通语假说，即LLM通过将源句读入潜在特征空间并从该空间生成目标句来完成翻译，并给出三条证据：（1）比较不同语言对的BLEU方差，检验其是否仅由各语言自身能力决定而无语言对交互项；（2）分析模型组件在单语任务与翻译任务中的因果影响力是否重叠；（3）对比在单语数据与对齐文档上微调对翻译性能的提升幅度。
AI.result: 三条证据均支持互通语假说：跨语言对的BLEU差异主要由语言特定能力预测，无显著语言对交互作用；许多模型组件同时影响单语任务与翻译任务；单语数据微调能恢复对齐文档微调所带来的大部分翻译提升。
AI.conclusion: 这些汇聚一致的证据支持了互通语假说，并提出了理解和改进LLM翻译任务的新思路，表明翻译可被视为经由共享潜在表示空间的中介过程。

title: Residual Kalman Dynamics for Event-Based UAV Forecasting
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Neuromorphic Vision (NEVi) at ECCV 2026, 16 pages
summary: We study short- and mid-horizon UAV bounding-box forecasting on the FRED event-camera dataset. We use a constant-velocity Kalman filter over a full center-size box state as a strong physical baseline, and train a residual model to predict acceleration-like corrections from recent box history, filtered state features, and local event representations. This simple residual formulation consistently improves over the Kalman baseline, with event-conditioned models giving the strongest results among the evaluated methods. We further show that part of the residual target is predictable from anchor position and velocity alone, indicating that canonical FRED results can reflect both visual evidence and dataset-specific motion priors. To analyze this effect, we introduce decorrelated subsets as a diagnostic stress test, showing that event-conditioned residual models retain useful predictive signal even when measured position- and velocity-based shortcuts are weakened.

AI.tldr: 在FRED事件相机数据集上研究短/中期UAV包围框预测，以恒速卡尔曼滤波器为物理基线，训练残差模型从包围框历史、滤波状态特征和局部事件表示中预测加速度类修正，实验表明事件条件模型效果最佳，并通过去相关子集诊断测试验证其预测信号并非仅依赖位置/速度捷径。
AI.motivation: 现有UAV包围框预测方法在事件相机数据上的表现可能同时受视觉证据和数据集特定的运动先验影响，作者希望厘清这两者的贡献，并验证事件条件模型在削弱位置/速度捷径后是否仍保留有效的预测信息。
AI.method: 以全中心-尺寸框状态的恒速卡尔曼滤波器作为强物理基线，训练一个残差模型预测加速度类修正项，输入包括近期包围框历史、滤波状态特征和局部事件表示；同时引入去相关子集作为诊断压力测试，削弱可测量的位置与速度捷径。
AI.result: 残差公式持续优于卡尔曼基线，事件条件模型在所有评估方法中表现最强；部分残差目标可由锚点位置和速度单独预测，说明FRED规范结果兼具视觉证据与数据集特定运动先验；在去相关子集上事件条件残差模型仍保留有效预测信号。
AI.conclusion: 事件条件残差预测方法在UAV包围框预测中显著优于纯物理基线，且其优势并非完全依赖位置/速度捷径，存在真实可利用的视觉预测信号；同时提示评估此类任务时应警惕数据集特定运动先验带来的偏差。

title: Feedback-Assisted Trust Propagation over Document Relation Graphs for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems rely on external corpora that may contain outdated, contradictory, noisy, or unreliable documents, introducing reliability risks. Prior work has leveraged document relations to improve the answer reliability of RAG. To propagate reliability signals beyond directly compared document pairs, we propose TrustPropRAG, which structures document relations as a graph and estimates document reliability through multi-hop propagation across the graph. TrustPropRAG anchors this propagation with a limited set of human feedback on document reliability, extending these costly-to-collect feedback-based reliability signals across the whole corpus. Specifically, based on the constructed document relation graph, TrustPropRAG estimates a trust score for each document by formulating and solving an optimization problem that jointly captures pairwise document relations and user feedback. These scores are then used to improve the selection of reliable documents and support trust-aware answer generation. Evaluation results show that TrustPropRAG improves both retrieval quality and exact match over baselines, and remains robust under sparse and noisy feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出TrustPropRAG，将文档关系构建为图并通过多跳传播估计文档可靠性信任分数，用少量人工反馈锚定传播过程，从而改进RAG系统的文档选择与答案生成，提升检索质量和精确匹配，并在稀疏、含噪反馈下保持鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: RAG系统依赖外部语料库，其中可能含有过时、矛盾、嘈杂或不可靠的文档，带来可靠性风险。已有工作利用文档关系提升答案可靠性，但缺乏将可靠性信号传播到超出直接比较文档对之外的机制，且人工反馈成本高昂，难以覆盖整个语料库。
AI.method: TrustPropRAG将文档关系结构化为图，通过多跳传播估计文档可靠性；以少量人工可靠性反馈作为锚点，将代价高昂的反馈信号扩展到整个语料库。具体地，基于构建的文档关系图，通过构造并求解一个联合刻画成对文档关系与用户反馈的优化问题，为每个文档估计信任分数；再利用这些分数改进可靠文档的选择，并支持信任感知的答案生成。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，TrustPropRAG在检索质量和精确匹配（exact match）上均优于基线方法，并且在稀疏和含噪反馈条件下仍保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TrustPropRAG验证了将文档关系图与多跳信任传播相结合、以少量人工反馈为锚点的有效性，能够以低成本将可靠性信号扩散至整个语料库，从而提升RAG系统的可靠性与鲁棒性。

title: Skill Following: Evaluating Actual Skill Use in Retrieval-Enabled LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external skills, yet standard evaluations obscure whether retrieving these skills actually helps. Aggregate metrics often compare retrieved versus non-retrieved tasks, introducing severe selection bias and failing to isolate the true effect of skill use. To measure this actual-use capability-which we formalize as Skill Following (SF)-we introduce the Retrieval-Invoked Actual-Use Effect (RAE). RAE computes the same-task outcome difference between matched skill-enabled and skill-disabled executions, conditioned exclusively on tasks where the agent actively retrieved a skill. Evaluating 17 LLMs across coding and mathematical domains, we uncover a stark evaluation paradox: models frequently show positive aggregate retrieval lift but negative RAE. On MBPP+, multiple models that appear to benefit system-wide actually harm their own performance on the exact tasks where retrieval occurred. These findings demonstrate that aggregate averages can create a misleading illusion of tool-use proficiency, whereas RAE directly measures whether the retrieval-to-answer pipeline genuinely rescues more outcomes than it harms.

AI.tldr: 本文发现标准评估中"技能检索整体收益"存在严重选择偏差，提出"技能遵循（SF）"能力与"检索调用实际使用效应（RAE）"指标，通过在技能启用/禁用两种条件下对同一任务进行匹配比较，仅考察智能体确实检索了技能的任务。对17个LLM在编程和数学领域的评测揭示了一个评估悖论：多个模型在整体聚合上表现出正检索提升，但在实际发生检索的任务上RAE为负，即检索反而损害了其自身性能。RAE直接度量从检索到答案的流水线是否真正"救回"多于"伤害"的结果。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体日益依赖外部技能，但标准评估无法判断技能检索是否真的有用：聚合指标常在"检索过"与"未检索过"的任务间比较，引入严重选择偏差，无法隔离技能使用的真实效应，从而可能对工具使用熟练度产生误导性印象。
AI.method: 形式化"技能遵循（SF）"这一实际使用能力，提出"检索调用实际使用效应（RAE）"：仅在智能体主动检索了技能的任务子集上，比较技能启用与技能禁用（匹配）两种执行下同一任务的结果差异，从而去除选择偏差并隔离技能的真实因果效应。
AI.result: 对17个LLM在MBPP+等编程与数学领域进行评测，发现评估悖论：多个模型在系统层面呈现正聚合检索提升，但在实际发生检索的任务上RAE为负——即检索反而损害了自身在那些任务上的表现，说明聚合平均值可制造"工具使用熟练"的虚假假象。
AI.conclusion: 聚合平均指标不足以免除选择偏差，无法反映技能检索的真实效用；RAE能够直接度量"检索到答案"流水线是更多地挽救结果还是破坏结果，为评估LLM智能体的实际技能使用能力提供了更可靠的度量方式。

title: An Intelligent Decision Support System for Emotion Monitoring using Microscopic Fixational Dynamics
summary: The rising prevalence of psychological disorders necessitates effective emotion monitoring, yet current methods relying on facial or physiological signals often suffer from intrusiveness and privacy issues. This paper proposes an intelligent decision support system and pervasive edge-computing framework that leverages smart glasses and a companion smartphone to infer emotional states from microscopic visual fixation patterns. Moving beyond traditional macroscopic gaze metrics, the proposed system extracts and decomposes three distinct neurophysiological micro-movements: microsaccades, ocular drifts, and ocular microtremors. We introduce an interpretable hybrid artificial intelligence pipeline combining a multi-head attention mechanism, extreme gradient boosting, and a support vector machine to extract deep temporal features, quantify their physiological importance, and perform efficient on-device classification. Through an extensive evaluation involving 60 volunteers, we rigorously validate the framework under a strict leave-one-subject-out cross-validation protocol across both controlled and naturalistic mobile scenarios. Ablation studies unequivocally demonstrate that these fixational micro-movements are substantially more discriminative for emotion inference than traditional macroscopic features. Furthermore, aligned with contemporary affective science, the system incorporates a few-shot personalization mechanism to bridge universal physiological baselines with individual emotional heterogeneity, achieving a highly robust personalized F1-score of 83.6%. This work establishes a physiologically interpretable, unobtrusive, and deployable paradigm for continuous real-time emotion monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于智能眼镜与配套智能手机的智能决策支持系统，通过提取凝视过程中的三种神经生理微观眼动（微跳视、眼漂移、眼微震颤），结合可解释的混合人工智能管线（多头注意力、极限梯度提升、支持向量机），实现对情绪状态的无侵入、实时、可部署的推断。在60名志愿者的严格跨被试验证下，个性化F1分数达83.6%。
AI.motivation: 心理障碍患病率上升，亟需有效的情绪监测手段；然而现有基于面部或生理信号的方法常受侵入性和隐私问题困扰，需要一种不引人注目且保护隐私的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出智能眼镜+智能手机的边缘计算框架，从微观视觉注视模式中提取并分解三种神经生理微运动（微跳视、眼漂移、眼微震颤）；构建可解释的混合AI管线，融合多头注意力机制、极限梯度提升与支持向量机，用于深层时间特征提取、生理重要性量化与端上分类；并结合少样本个性化机制桥接通用生理基线到个体情绪异质性。
AI.result: 在60名志愿者、严格的留一被试交叉验证协议下，覆盖受控与自然移动场景；消融研究显示固视微运动比传统宏观特征具有显著更强的情绪判别力；结合少样本个性化机制后达到高度稳健的个性化F1分数83.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了一种生理上可解释、无侵入且可部署的连续实时情绪监测范式，为情绪推断提供了优于宏观特征的微观眼动证据，并为边缘计算场景下的个性化情绪监测提供了可行方案。

title: VoiceLongMemEval: Do Assistants Remember How You Sounded?
summary: With the growing scale of multi-agent architectures and large language models, deployed AI assistants are increasingly tasked with reasoning over long, continuous, multi-session conversation histories. Current benchmarks evaluate this dialogue history as information retrieval over long horizon, temporal reasoning, or knowledge updates, while crucially ignoring the fundamental dynamics of human-agent interaction, i.e. how they said it. To address this gap, we present VoiceLongMemEval (VLME) benchmark, where every answer depends on paralinguistic metadata (emotion labels, prosody descriptors, and voice events) attached to conversational turns, which is otherwise unrecoverable from the words alone. Every item passes a three-stage adversarial gate, ensuring that a strong language model fails when given only the transcript. Evaluating leading frontier and open-weight models reveals a pervasive affect gap; providing text-track paralinguistic metadata yields a 0.09 to 0.38 accuracy boost (0.61 to 0.69 when prompted with evidence hints), while standard ASR pipelines systematically discard this signal. Additionally, audio-native models successfully extract these cues directly from speech (0.354 to 0.412 vs. 0.325 blind). Code and dataset will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VoiceLongMemEval (VLME) 基准，用于评估多模态长对话记忆：所有答案都依赖于说话语气、情绪标签、韵律描述和语音事件等副语言元数据，这些信息无法仅从文字转录中恢复。评测表明存在普遍的"情感鸿沟"：加入元数据可带来 0.09–0.38 的准确率提升，而标准 ASR 流水线会系统性丢弃该信号；音频原生模型可直接从语音中提取这些线索。
AI.motivation: 随着多智能体架构和 LLM 规模的增长，部署的 AI 助手日益需要处理跨多会话的连续长对话历史。现有基准仅将该历史建模为长时信息检索、时间推理或知识更新，忽略了人机交互的基本动态——即"怎么说"（说话方式/副语言信息），导致模型无法利用超越文字本身的表达性信号。
AI.method: 构建 VLME 基准：(1) 每个问题的答案都依赖于附着在对话轮次上的副语言元数据（情绪标签、韵律描述、语音事件），仅凭文字不可恢复；(2) 每个条目都通过三阶段对抗性门控，确保仅给定转录时强语言模型会失败；(3) 在文本轨道中加入元数据提示进行评估，并比较标准 ASR 流水线与音频原生模型的差异。
AI.result: 评测前沿与开放权重模型发现普遍存在情感鸿沟：在文本轨迹中提供副语言元数据可获得 0.09 到 0.38 的准确率提升（给出证据提示时提升 0.61 到 0.69）；标准 ASR 流水线系统性丢弃该信号；音频原生模型可直接从语音中成功提取这些线索（0.354–0.412 vs. 盲设 0.325）。
AI.conclusion: 当前对话记忆评测与模型忽视了副语言信息这一关键维度；VLME 表明副语言元数据对长对话理解具有显著价值，并提示标准 ASR 会丢失关键信号，而音频原生多模态模型能更好地利用语音中的情感与韵律信息。作者承诺在论文被接收后公开代码与数据集。

title: A Study of Hidden-State Optimization Order in Predictive Coding Networks
summary: Local learning methods offer an alternative to end-to-end backpropagation, but their unstructured local objectives can produce weak feature learning in deep networks. We study whether the order of hidden-state optimization can address this limitation. We propose a boundary-first inference schedule that partitions a model into chunks, first coordinates hidden states at chunk boundaries, and then refines representations within each chunk. We instantiate this schedule in predictive coding networks (PCNs), a local-learning framework in which hidden activities and prediction errors are explicitly exposed during inference. On CIFAR-10, the resulting boundary-first predictive-coding instantiation improves accuracy over standard predictive coding by $9.77\%$ under a standard parametrization and by $5.51\%$ under a $μ$-parametrization. Diagnostic analyses further show more non-trivial early-layer updates, lower initial-to-final CKA, and more diverse layerwise gradients, consistent with stronger feature learning. These results support boundary-first, chunk-based inference as a practical design principle for predictive-coding training and motivate its study in broader local-learning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种边界优先（boundary-first）的分块推理调度方法，用于增强局部学习（如预测编码网络）中的特征学习能力。该方法先把模型划分为若干块，优先协调块边界处的隐状态，再细化块内表示。在CIFAR-10上，与标准预测编码相比，边界优先实例在标准参数化和μ-参数化下分别提升准确率9.77%和5.51%，并通过早期层更新、CKA和梯度多样性等诊断指标证实了更强的特征学习。
AI.motivation: 端到端反向传播的替代方案——局部学习方法，虽然避免了全局梯度传播，但其非结构化的局部目标函数可能导致深层网络中的特征学习较弱。作者希望探究隐状态优化的顺序是否能够缓解这一局限，从而提升局部学习框架的特征学习能力。
AI.method: 提出一种边界优先的推理调度：将模型划分为多个块（chunk），推理时先协调块边界处的隐状态，再细化每个块内部的表示。将该调度实例化到预测编码网络（PCNs）中，预测编码网络在推理过程中显式暴露隐活动与预测误差，便于实施分块调度。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10数据集上，边界优先的预测编码实例相比标准预测编码，在标准参数化下准确率提升9.77%，在μ-参数化下提升5.51%。诊断分析显示：更多非平凡的早期层更新、更低的初始到最终CKA、以及更多样化的逐层梯度，这些均与更强的特征学习一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，边界优先的、基于分块的推理可以作为预测编码训练的一个实用设计原则，并值得在更广泛的局部学习系统中加以研究。

title: Same Semantics, Different Outcome: On the Modality Robustness of Multimodal LLMs under Knowledge Conflict
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly provided with contextual evidence in heterogeneous forms: as a text passage, as a rendered image of the same passage, or as both together. However, it remains unclear how consistently these surface forms are processed, especially when the evidence conflicts with the model's parametric knowledge. We study modality robustness under knowledge conflict across 13 MLLMs and two datasets, and find them far from robust. (1) Contrary to common belief, models favor a context that contradicts parametric knowledge more readily in image form than in text form; (2) when a contradicting text and image are presented together, the preferred modality is essentially arbitrary, varying with input order, model, and dataset. We further demonstrate that this instability has practical consequences: it degrades performance in multimodal RAG and can be exploited by adversarial attacks. To alleviate this brittleness, we examine several simple techniques---prompting, steering, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and direct preference optimization; the majority prove ineffective, whereas SFT achieves moderate success. We therefore call for greater awareness of this inconsistency and argue that it is fundamental, demanding attention at multiple training stages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在面对与参数量知识相冲突的上下文证据时，对不同表面形式（文本、渲染图像或二者结合）处理的一致性。通过对13个MLLM和两个数据集的系统评估，发现模型远非稳健：模型在图像形式下比文本形式更容易采纳与参数化知识矛盾的上下文；当矛盾文本与图像同时呈现时，偏好模态几乎任意，随输入顺序、模型和数据集而变化。这种不稳定性会降低多模态RAG性能，并可能被对抗性攻击利用。在多种缓解手段（提示、引导、监督微调SFT、直接偏好优化）中，仅SFT取得中等成效，作者因此呼吁在多训练阶段关注这一根本性问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型越来越多地以异构形式接收上下文证据——文本段落、同一段落的渲染图像，或两者同时提供。然而，当这些证据与模型的参数化知识相冲突时，这些表面形式被处理的一致性仍不明确。理解这一点对于模型可靠性至关重要，也是本研究的出发点。
AI.method: 作者在13个MLLM和两个数据集上系统地研究了知识冲突下的模态鲁棒性。实验设计包括：对比纯文本、纯图像和图文混合三种证据呈现形式；改变输入顺序考察偏好稳定性；并评估四种缓解技术——提示工程（prompting）、引导（steering）、监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）。
AI.result: 研究发现：（1）与普遍认知相反，模型在图像形式下比在文本形式下更容易采纳与参数化知识相矛盾的上下文；（2）当矛盾的文本与图像同时出现时，偏好模态本质上是任意的，随输入顺序、模型和数据集的不同而变化。这种不稳定性在实践中会降低多模态RAG的性能，并可被对抗性攻击所利用。在缓解措施中，提示、引导和DPO大多无效，仅SFT取得中等程度的成功。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为这种模态不一致性是根本性的而非表面现象，仅靠单点修复难以解决，需要在多个训练阶段给予关注。研究呼吁学界与工业界对这一不一致性提高警惕，并在模型开发全流程中加以考量。

title: ADGNet: Asymmetric Dual-text Guided Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
comment: 10 pages, 10 figures. Accepted by the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM Multimedia 2026)
summary: InfRared Small Target Detection (IRSTD) is a challenging task. Relying solely on pixel-level information, vision-only methods struggle to distinguish targets from clutter. Current multimodal methods typically describe both targets and backgrounds with a single textual prompt. Such an approach lacks dedicated regional guidance and ignores infrared semantic asymmetry. Consequently, it provides insufficient background suppression information and introduces severe feature optimization conflicts, overwhelming small targets with noise. To address these issues, we propose a novel Asymmetric Dual-text Guided Network (ADGNet). Specifically, accounting for the infrared semantic asymmetry, we first design the Asymmetric Dual-text Prompt (ADP), comprising an image-agnostic abstract target prompt and an image-specific detailed background prompt. To leverage these prompts, we introduce an Asymmetric Dual-Branch Interaction (ADBI) module to separately guide visual features with their respective text priors, protecting targets from noise while suppressing background clutter. Subsequently, we introduce an Adaptive Feature Aggregation (AFA) module to dynamically fuse features from the two branches. Furthermore, we construct a multimodal Asymmetric Image-Text Infrared (AITIR) dataset by providing asymmetric text annotations for three public datasets (IRSTD-1K, NUDT-SIRST, and SIRST). Extensive experiments demonstrate that ADGNet outperforms 21 state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. Code is available at https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/MM26-ADGNet.

AI.tldr: 提出非对称双文本引导网络(ADGNet)，通过图像无关的抽象目标提示与图像特定的详细背景提示分别引导视觉特征，并动态融合两个分支，以解决红外小目标检测中背景抑制不足与特征优化冲突问题，在三个公开数据集上超越21种SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 仅依赖像素级信息的视觉方法难以区分目标与杂波；现有多模态方法使用单一文本提示同时描述目标和背景，缺乏针对性的区域引导，且忽略了红外语义的非对称性，导致背景抑制信息不足，并引发严重的特征优化冲突，使小目标被噪声淹没。
AI.method: 提出ADGNet：(1)设计非对称双文本提示(ADP)，包含图像无关的抽象目标提示和图像特定的详细背景提示；(2)引入非对称双分支交互(ADBI)模块，用各自文本先验分别引导视觉特征，保护目标免受噪声干扰同时抑制背景杂波；(3)引入自适应特征聚合(AFA)模块动态融合两个分支的特征；(4)构建多模态非对称图像-文本红外(AITIR)数据集，为IRSTD-1K、NUDT-SIRST和SIRST三个公开数据集提供非对称文本标注。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ADGNet在三个公开数据集上优于21种最先进(SOTA)方法，代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用红外语义非对称性并采用目标/背景分离的双文本引导范式，ADGNet有效增强了对小目标的保护与背景抑制，显著提升了红外小目标检测性能。

title: Residual Sparsification via Output Importance for Compressing Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures scale large language models efficiently, but they demand massive GPU memory. To cope with such demand, models are commonly compressed to reduce their memory footprint. Residual sparsification is a representative compression technique that decomposes each projection matrix of an expert into a shared base matrix and per-expert residual matrix, and then compresses the residuals. Existing sparsification methods compress each residual matrix independently by minimizing its compression error, thereby minimizing the error of each projection matrix. However, our analysis shows that this objective is misaligned with preserving model accuracy after compression. In an expert, the final output is produced through computations coupled across multiple projections and hidden representations. Therefore, even small errors in individual matrices can propagate through hidden representations and projection interactions, leading to large expert output errors and accuracy degradation. To address this misalignment, we propose PARSER, a new residual sparsification method that shifts the compression objective from minimizing isolated matrix errors to preserving the expert output error. PARSER achieves this by introducing output importance, which measures the actual contribution to the expert output error. Our experiments show that, compared with existing methods, PARSER narrows the accuracy gap to the uncompressed model by 1.41$\times$ on Qwen and 1.44$\times$ on DeepSeek, while achieving the same peak memory reduction. Our code is available at https://github.com/OSSS-KU/PARSER.

AI.tldr: 针对混合专家（MoE）模型残差稀疏化压缩的目标错位问题，提出PARSER方法，将压缩目标从最小化单个残差矩阵的误差转变为最小化专家输出误差，通过输出重要性度量各投影对专家输出误差的实际贡献，在Qwen和DeepSeek上分别将精度差距缩小1.41倍和1.44倍，同时保持相同的峰值内存削减。
AI.motivation: MoE架构高效扩展大语言模型但需要巨大GPU内存，常用残差稀疏化压缩（将专家投影矩阵分解为共享基矩阵与每专家残差矩阵并压缩残差）。现有方法独立地最小化每个残差矩阵的压缩误差，但该目标与保护压缩后的模型精度不对齐：专家最终输出是多个投影与隐藏表示耦合计算的结果，单个矩阵的小误差会经隐藏表示和投影交互传播，导致较大的专家输出误差和精度下降。
AI.method: 提出PARSER残差稀疏化方法，将压缩目标从最小化孤立矩阵误差转变为保持专家输出误差。关键引入"输出重要性"（output importance），衡量各投影对专家输出误差的实际贡献，据此指导残差矩阵的压缩，使压缩误差在专家输出层面更可控。
AI.result: 实验显示，与现有方法相比，PARSER在Qwen上将与未压缩模型的精度差距缩小1.41倍，在DeepSeek上缩小1.44倍，同时实现相同的峰值内存削减。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 压缩误差最小化应在专家输出层面而非孤立的矩阵层面进行，PARSER通过输出重要性对齐压缩目标与模型精度保持，在显著降低MoE模型内存占用时缩小了精度差距，为MoE压缩提供了更有效的方向。

title: Verdict Instability of OOD Scores under Reference Resampling
summary: Post-hoc out-of-distribution detectors are fitted on a finite reference set, so every score they produce is an estimate. If we had chosen a different set, some verdicts would have moved. We measure that movement by resampling the reference set and recording the bootstrap standard deviation of the score, which we call verdict instability. It admits a closed form with no fitted parameters. The instability of a verdict is the within-class dispersion of the assigned class along the query's direction, divided by the square root of that class's reference count. That count is what separates verdict instability from the geometry of the score distribution, and it is identifiable only under class imbalance. Instability grows with the local dispersion. Far-OOD queries lie along the low-variance directions of an anisotropic embedding, so every distance-based score we test assigns its highest values to the verdicts that are most reproducible. Only estimators of local dispersion carry the sign a practitioner expects. We give a rule that predicts this sign for any score from a single label-free correlation, and abstention driven by a wrong-signed score turns out worse than abstention at random on every dataset we test.

AI.tldr: 后验离群（OOD）检测器依赖有限参考集，其分数是估计值；本文以重采样参考集得到的分数bootstrap标准差度量"判决不稳定性"，给出无拟合参数的闭式解：不稳定性等于查询方向上的类内离散度除以参考样本数平方根。实验表明距离类分数在远OOD查询上给出最可复现（最稳定）的判决，而仅局部离散度估计量携带实践者期望的符号；本文给出一个仅靠单个无标签相关性预测符号的规则，且错误符号分数驱动的弃权在全部数据集上劣于随机弃权。
AI.motivation: 后验OOD检测器在一个有限的参考集上拟合，因此其输出的每个分数都是估计值；若更换参考集，部分判决会改变。作者希望量化这种因参考集抽样变化而导致的判决变动，给出可计算的度量。
AI.method: 通过重采样参考集并记录分数的bootstrap标准差来定义"判决不稳定性"（verdict instability），并推导出其闭式解（无拟合参数）：等于所分配类别沿查询方向的类内离散度除以该类参考样本数的平方根。作者进一步在各类分数（距离类与局部离散度类）上验证该量，并给出一个基于单个无标签相关性来预测判决符号的规则。
AI.result: 不稳定性随局部离散度增长；在各项异性嵌入的低方差方向上，远OOD查询使所有距离类分数将其最高值赋予最可复现（最稳定）的判决，因此距离类分数携带与直觉相反的符号；只有局部离散度估计量携带实践者期望的符号。该符号可由单个无标签相关性的规则预测，而在所测的全部数据集上，错误符号分数驱动的弃权劣于随机弃权。
AI.conclusion: 判决不稳定性本质上由几何（类内离散度）与统计计数（参考样本数）共同决定，其中参考计数只有在类不平衡情形下才可识别，这也是其区别于分数分布几何的关键。距离类分数不适用于需要可复现判决的场景，弃权决策必须使用符号正确的分数。

title: EM^2Mem: Event-Centric Multimodal Memory for Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal memory offers a scalable interface for long-video question answering, but existing methods often retrieve captions, frames, transcripts, summaries, or graph facts as isolated fragments. Although searchable, such fragments are not generation-ready: language models must reconstruct cross-modal and temporal alignments at inference time, when context is limited and attribution is difficult. We propose EM^2Mem, an event-centric multimodal memory framework that binds heterogeneous evidence to event anchors during memory construction. Each event-indexed memory cell aligns multimodal records, temporal context, graph-linked relations, semantic facts, and provenance, enabling compact evidence readout over grounded multimodal events rather than modality-specific fragments. Across three long-video QA benchmarks, EM^2Mem improves average accuracy over the strongest memory baseline by 2.0, 2.4, and 3.7 points, improves strict event-level Top-5 evidence recall by 7.0 points, and reduces per-query latency by 4.67 times and total inference tokens by 63.66% (The code will be integrated into https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem).

AI.tldr: 提出事件中心的多模态记忆框架 EM^2Mem，将异构证据绑定到事件锚点上，形成可检索且可直接用于生成的紧凑证据，在长视频问答三个基准上显著提升准确率、证据召回并大幅降低延迟和推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频问答的多模态记忆方法通常将字幕、帧、转录、摘要或图谱事实作为孤立片段检索，虽然可搜索，但不可直接用于生成——语言模型必须在推理时（上下文受限、归因困难）重建跨模态与时间对齐。
AI.method: EM^2Mem 是一种事件中心的多模态记忆框架：在记忆构建阶段将异构证据绑定到事件锚点，每个事件索引的记忆单元对齐多模态记录、时间上下文、图谱关联关系、语义事实与出处，从而实现对有依据的多模态事件的紧凑证据读取，而非按模态返回碎片。
AI.result: 在三个长视频问答基准上，EM^2Mem 相比最强记忆基线平均准确率提升 2.0、2.4、3.7 个点；严格事件级 Top-5 证据召回提升 7.0 个点；每次查询延迟降低 4.67 倍，推理总 token 减少 63.66%。
AI.conclusion: 事件中心化的记忆组织方式比模态碎片化检索更适合长视频问答：它使记忆既可扩展检索又可直接支持生成，减少推理时跨模态重对齐负担，同时提升准确性、归因能力和效率；代码将集成到开源项目 LightMem 中。

title: Training-Free Inpainting Across Domains with a Frozen Text-to-Image Diffusion Model
summary: We show that a frozen generic text-to-image diffusion model can perform conditional inpainting across three evaluated natural-image domains with one fixed controller configuration, without inpainting-specific weight training, dataset-specific weight adaptation, or learned inpainting-specific conditioning channels. Step-PI augments known-region projection with boundary-interior latent feedback, persistent PI state, and a predefined four-field release schedule that modulates controller signals along the reverse trajectory. Developed only on Main35-disjoint CelebA-HQ pilots, the controller transfers unchanged to AFHQ and Places2. Across two field-identical comparisons on the same 3,500 cases, adding persistent state and replacing uniform release with the predefined schedule each improve all 15 dataset-metric cells; 95% bootstrap intervals exclude zero for all five metrics in both comparisons. In descriptive native-route comparisons, Step-PI leads LanPaint and PILOT (the closest evaluated training-free baselines using vanilla SD1.5) on all five equal-dataset macro metrics. Inpainting-trained systems retain the absolute metric leads but rely on substantial inpainting-specific offline optimization. Our method provides a complementary approach for repurposing a frozen generic text-to-image model for cross-domain inpainting through test-time latent control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Step-PI，一种无需重新训练即可让冻结的通用文生图扩散模型执行跨域条件修复（inpainting）的方法。它通过对已知区域投影进行增强，引入边界-内部潜在反馈、持久化PI状态以及预定义的四字段释放调度，仅基于CelebA-HQ子集开发，便能无修改地迁移到AFHQ和Places2，在多项指标上与现有免训练基线相比取得领先。
AI.motivation: 现有的条件修复方法往往需要针对修复任务进行专门的权重训练、数据集特定的权重适配，或学习专门的修复条件通道，成本高昂且泛化性受限。作者希望探究一个冻结的通用文生图扩散模型能否仅通过测试时的潜在控制（test-time latent control）即可完成跨域的、无监督的、免训练的条件修复，从而提供一种互补的轻量级方案。
AI.method: Step-PI在已知区域投影（known-region projection）基础上加入三项关键技术：1）边界-内部潜在反馈（boundary-interior latent feedback）；2）持久化PI状态（persistent PI state）；3）预定义的四字段释放调度（predefined four-field release schedule），用于沿逆向轨迹（reverse trajectory）调制控制器信号。该方法仅在Main35不相交的CelebA-HQ小规模试点数据上开发，控制器冻结后直接迁移到AFHQ与Places2，无需任何修复专用的权重训练、数据集适配或学习型条件通道。
AI.result: 在两个字段一致的对比实验（同一3,500个测试样本）中，加入持久化状态以及用预定义调度替代均匀释放调度，分别使全部15个数据集-指标组合得到改善，且五个指标的95%自助法（bootstrap）置信区间均排除零。在描述性的原生路线对比中，Step-PI在全部五个等数据集宏观指标上领先于使用vanilla SD1.5的最接近的免训练基线LanPaint与PILOT。经过修复专用训练的系统在绝对指标上仍占优，但依赖大量修复专用的离线优化。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：冻结的通用文生图扩散模型可通过测试时潜在控制被有效复用为跨域条件修复器，Step-PI的组件设计（持久化状态与预定义调度）具有一致且统计显著的增益。尽管绝对指标仍落后于修复专用训练系统，但Step-PI提供了一种无需离线优化的互补路线，适合在无法进行修复专用训练或数据集适配的场景下使用。

title: Consistency Without Alignment: Item-Sensitive Language Models Indistinguishable From Random
summary: Item-sensitivity, defined as whether a model's choice depends on the specific input rather than on its own output prior, is widely reported as evidence of task competence. We show this evidence is necessary but not sufficient using a forced-choice signalling task abstracted from the board game Deception: Murder in Hong Kong. In this environment, the reference points against which a coordinate should be judged (a fit-maximising strategy, a posterior-maximising strategy, and uniform random selection) are all computable in closed form. Across seven language models, two model families, a post-training ablation, and three independent scoring rules, every one of 21 model-by-rule cells is reliably item-sensitive. Yet 8 of those 21 cells are not statistically distinguishable from a chooser that ignores the item and selects at random, and 5 score worse than random at describing the target. Item-sensitivity and distance from random correlate at only r = 0.30. We call this consistency without alignment and argue it generalises to any evaluation that relies on item-sensitivity, permutation consistency, or self-consistency without an independent reference for the measured quantity. We further find that a literal-similarity baseline with no pragmatics outperforms most tested language models, that adding a pragmatic layer over two baseline similarity sources moves choosers toward random rather than toward the Bayesian reference, and that a standard labelled multiple-choice format carries no measurable content signal here. All results represent the model side of a pre-registered instrument; a matched human condition is designed and piloted but not yet collected.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在《Deception: Murder in Hong Kong》桌游中抽象出的强制选择信号任务，证明“item-sensitivity”（模型选择依赖具体输入而非自身输出先验）虽然是任务能力的必要条件，但并非充分条件。在7个语言模型、2个模型家族、1个后训练消融及3个独立评分规则组成的21个“模型×规则”单元中，所有单元都可靠地表现出item-sensitivity，但其中8个单元与忽略输入随机选择的chooser在统计上不可区分，5个单元在描述目标上比随机更差，item-sensitivity与随机距离仅相关r=0.30。作者称此为“无对齐的一致性”（consistency without alignment），并论证该问题可推广到任何依赖item-sensitivity、置换一致性或自一致性而无独立参照标准的评估中。此外，无语用学的字面相似性基线优于大多数被测模型，而在两个基线相似性来源上叠加语用层反而使chooser更接近随机而非贝叶斯参照；标准的带标签多项选择格式在此不携带可测的内容信号。所有结果为预注册实验的模型侧数据，对应的人类条件实验已设计并预测试但尚未收集。
AI.motivation: 现有文献广泛将item-sensitivity（模型选择是否取决于具体输入而非其自身输出先验）作为任务能力（task competence）的证据。作者质疑这一证据的充分性，希望证明item-sensitivity在缺少独立参照标准的情况下可能误导评估结论，从而在只有一致性而无对齐时产生虚假的能力信号。
AI.method: 作者从桌游《Deception: Murder in Hong Kong》中抽象出一个强制选择信号任务环境，其中所有参照点均可用闭式解计算：fit-maximising策略、posterior-maximising策略以及均匀随机选择。他们跨7个语言模型、2个模型家族、1个后训练消融和3个独立评分规则进行系统评测，并将每个模型-规则单元与上述计算性参照点（尤其是随机chooser）进行统计比较，同时测量item-sensitivity与距随机距离之间的相关性。还测试了无语用学的字面相似性基线、叠加语用层的变体以及标准的带标签多项选择格式。
AI.result: 21个“模型×规则”单元全部可靠地表现出item-sensitivity，但其中8个单元与忽略输入随机选择的chooser在统计上无法区分，5个单元描述目标的得分低于随机；item-sensitivity与距随机距离的相关性仅为r=0.30。字面相似性基线（无语用学）优于大多数被测语言模型；叠加语用层使chooser更偏向随机而非贝叶斯参照；带标签的多项选择格式不携带可测内容信号。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出“无对齐的一致性”概念，指出item-sensitivity（以及置换一致性、自一致性等）仅凭自身无法证明任务能力，除非有独立参照标准衡量所测量的量。该发现可推广到任何依赖这类一致性指标而无外部参照的评估，警示研究者不要将一致行为误认为对齐或胜任；同时强调需要参照点（如理性策略或随机基线）来正确解读模型行为。

title: MUGEN: Generating Unlearnable Graph Examples for Multiple Learning Tasks
summary: Graph data across diverse domains can expose valuable relational information to unauthorized representation learning, creating a pressing need for protection against such misuse. Unlearnable examples offer a data-level defense by perturbing a training release so that models trained on it fail to generalize to clean data. Existing methods generate unlearnable graph examples for only a specified downstream task. Consequently, a release protected against one task may remain learnable for other plausible uses, including node classification, graph classification, and link prediction, which the data owner cannot anticipate. We introduce MUGEN, to our knowledge the first framework for generating unlearnable graph examples that jointly protect all enabled tasks. From one clean dataset, MUGEN produces a single feature-perturbed release that protects every enabled task through a shared GNN encoder and task-specific heads. We devise a Task-Aligned Separability Objective (TASO), which leverages task prediction and classwise separability to strengthen unlearnability and its transfer across GNN backbones and enabled tasks. We further introduce Type-Adaptive Perturbation (TAP), which tailors perturbation optimization to node-attribute type, with direct search over feasible hard flips that accept only loss-improving updates for discrete node attributes and customized gradient-based updates for continuous node features, thereby enabling strong unlearnability across both settings. Experiments across five benchmarks, four backends and three learning paradigms demonstrate that MUGEN generates transferable unlearnable graph examples across GNN backbones and all three tasks, and remains effective under adversarial training and data augmentation.

AI.tldr: MUGEN是首个能够同时针对节点分类、图分类和链接预测等全部下游任务生成不可学习图示例（unlearnable graph examples）的框架。它通过共享GNN编码器与任务特定头，从单一干净数据集生成一个特征扰动后的发布版本，使在其上训练的模型无法泛化到干净数据，从而在数据层面防御图数据的未授权表示学习。
AI.motivation: 图形数据在多个领域包含有价值的关联信息，易被未授权的表示学习滥用，亟需数据层面的防护。现有不可学习图示例方法仅针对单一指定下游任务生成扰动，导致发布的数据对其他潜在任务（如节点分类、图分类、链接预测）仍然可学习，而数据所有者无法预先知晓所有可能的用途。因此需要一种能同时保护所有启用任务的统一框架。
AI.method: MUGEN从单一干净数据集生成一个特征扰动后的发布版本，通过共享GNN编码器和任务特定头同时保护所有启用任务。其核心包括两个组件：(1) 任务对齐可分性目标（TASO），利用任务预测与类内可分性来增强不可学习性及其在GNN骨干网络和任务间的迁移能力；(2) 类型自适应扰动（TAP），根据节点属性类型定制扰动优化：对离散节点属性采用直接搜索可行硬翻转并仅接受损失改善型更新，对连续节点特征采用定制化的梯度更新，从而在两类属性设置下都实现强不可学习性。
AI.result: 在五个基准、四种后端和三种学习范式上的实验表明，MUGEN生成的不可学习图示例能够在GNN骨干网络间以及全部三种任务（节点分类、图分类、链接预测）上迁移，并且在对抗训练和数据增强下依然保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: MUGEN作为首个多任务联合保护的不可学习图示例生成框架，通过TASO与TAP的协同设计，实现了对全部启用任务的强不可学习性以及跨骨干网络和防御手段的鲁棒性，为图数据的未授权使用提供了有效且可迁移的数据级防护方案。

title: Enoki: Efficient Multi-Level Hallucination Detection
summary: Ensuring factuality remains a critical challenge for deploying LLMs in high-stakes settings. Existing hallucination detectors usually operate at a single level: claim-level methods provide interpretable factual units, while span-level methods localize unsupported text. Bridging these views is costly, as LLM-heavy pipelines require multiple decomposition and verification calls, and modular systems need additional claim-to-span alignment. We propose Enoki, an Open Information Extraction framework for multi-level hallucination detection. Enoki extracts text-anchored relational facts, verifies them against evidence, and projects unsupported facts back to hallucinated spans. This shared representation enables claim-level verification and span-level localization without requiring separate alignment. Enoki supports LLM-based, encoder-based, and rule-based extraction regimes, balancing accuracy and inference cost through a common interface. Experiments show that Enoki remains competitive with strong claim-level systems while using fewer resources and achieves superior performance on fine-grained span- and entity-level localization. We also release EnokiQA, a dual-granularity dataset with aligned claim-level verification and span-level localization annotations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Enoki，一个基于开放信息抽取（OIE）的多层级幻觉检测框架。它通过抽取文本锚定的关系事实、对照证据进行验证并将不支持的事实投射回幻觉片段，从而在同一共享表示下同时实现声明级（claim-level）验证与跨度级（span-level）定位，无需额外对齐。Enoki 支持基于 LLM、编码器及规则的抽取模式，兼顾准确率与推理成本；实验表明其在声明级任务上与强基线持平且资源消耗更少，并在细粒度跨度级与实体级定位上表现更优，同时发布了带有双粒度对齐标注的数据集 EnokiQA。
AI.motivation: 在高风险场景中部署 LLM 时确保事实性仍是一个关键挑战。现有幻觉检测器通常只在单一层级工作：声明级方法提供可解释的事实单元，跨度级方法定位不支持的文本片段。将两者桥接代价高昂——依赖 LLM 的流水线需要多次分解与验证调用，模块化系统还需要额外的声明到跨度对齐步骤。
AI.method: 提出 Enoki，一种面向多层级幻觉检测的开放信息抽取（OIE）框架。Enoki 抽取文本锚定的关系事实，对照证据进行验证，并将不支持的事实投射回幻觉跨度。这种共享表示使得声明级验证与跨度级定位无需单独对齐即可实现。Enoki 通过统一接口支持基于 LLM、基于编码器以及基于规则的抽取机制，从而在准确性与推理成本之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 实验表明，Enoki 在使用更少资源的情况下仍能与强声明级系统保持竞争力，并在细粒度的跨度级与实体级定位上取得更优性能。此外，论文发布了 EnokiQA，一个带有对齐的声明级验证与跨度级定位标注的双粒度数据集。
AI.conclusion: Enoki 通过统一的共享表示将声明级验证与跨度级定位融为一体，避免了传统方案中昂贵的分解、验证与对齐步骤，为幻觉检测提供了一种兼顾可解释性与定位细粒度、且可控成本的有效方案。

title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Automated Pathology Diagnosis and Report Generation
summary: The rapid advancement of vision-language models (VLMs) has accelerated progress in computational pathology; however, whole-slide image (WSI)-based pathology report generation remains limited by the scarcity of large-scale WSI--report datasets and the complexity of mapping spatially distributed visual patterns to structured clinical text. To address this, we introduce a clinically curated Pan-Asia WSI--report dataset of approximately 10,500 pairs from five institutions and establish the REG 2025 benchmark through a MICCAI challenge for systematic evaluation of multimodal models. We analyze submitted methods spanning pretrained VLMs, multiple-instance learning frameworks, hierarchical expert models, retrieval-augmented generation, and cross-modal Transformers. Rather than indicating that VLM use alone was sufficient for superior performance, the results suggest that top-performing methods benefited from structured report representations, hierarchical diagnostic decomposition, and effective multimodal grounding. We identify key limitations, including instability in quantitative attribute estimation (e.g., numeric hallucination) and a tendency toward diagnostic overspecification, with some errors resembling known diagnostic pitfalls in routine pathology. These findings establish REG 2025 as a benchmark for evaluating WSI-based structured report generation and vision-language understanding in computational pathology, providing insights for the design of clinically grounded multimodal pathology models.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含约10,500对来自五个机构的泛亚洲全切片图像（WSI）-病理报告数据集，并通过MICCAI挑战赛建立REG 2025基准，系统评估了预训练VLM、多实例学习、分层专家模型、检索增强生成及跨模态Transformer等方法，发现结构化报告表示、分层诊断分解与多模态对齐对性能提升更关键，同时揭示了数字幻视与诊断过度细化等局限。
AI.motivation: 全切片图像（WSI）级别的病理报告生成仍受限于大规模WSI-报告数据集的匮乏，以及将空间分布的视觉模式映射为结构化临床文本的复杂性，亟需系统化的基准与评估框架以推动该领域发展。
AI.method: 作者构建了临床整理的泛亚洲WSI-报告配对数据集（约10,500对，来自五个机构），并依托MICCAI挑战赛建立REG 2025基准，对涵盖预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）、多实例学习（MIL）框架、分层专家模型、检索增强生成（RAG）与跨模态Transformer的提交方法进行系统分析。
AI.result: 结果表明，仅使用VLM并不足以获得最优性能；排名靠前的方法得益于结构化报告表示、分层诊断分解和有效的多模态对齐。同时识别出关键局限，包括数值属性估计的不稳定性（即数字幻视）和诊断过度细化倾向，其中部分错误类似常规病理中的已知诊断陷阱。
AI.conclusion: REG 2025可作为一个评估WSI结构化报告生成与视觉语言理解的基准，为设计临床可落地的多模态病理模型提供重要洞察，推动计算病理学中更可靠、临床导向的报告生成研究。

title: Same Request, Different Boundary: Evaluating Cybersecurity Assistance across Conversational Contexts
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can solve complex problems, but their misuse in high-risk domains can lead to severe consequences. Model providers therefore restrict assistance for potentially harmful requests. Refusing all cybersecurity requests would therefore harm legitimate users. Providers need a mechanism to block malicious use without denying legitimate assistance to defenders. Existing cybersecurity-specific datasets evaluate this mechanism, but none considers the conversational context of a request. We introduce 3R-Bench (Refusal, Repetition, and Revision), a benchmark of 150 real-world cybersecurity requests augmented with two adversarial conversational settings, and evaluate eight LLMs on it. Prior assistant behavior strongly changes responses to an unchanged request: among 376 available pairs from a 400-pair panel, compliance rises from 62.0% after refused history to 85.1% after accepted history. The opposite pattern appears under dialogue decomposition. In comparison, compliance falls from 501/800 direct responses to 172/800 after dialogue; among 738 pairs returning model-authored text in both conditions, the decrease is 45.1 points. Failure feedback recovers only a small fraction of this loss.

AI.tldr: 3R-Bench 是包含150个真实网络安全请求及两种对抗性对话设置的基准，用于评测8个LLM的安全拒答机制。研究发现：先前助手行为会显著改变对相同请求的响应（拒绝历史后合规率62.0%，接受历史后升至85.1%）；对话分解模式下合规率从直接响应的501/800骤降至172/800，失败反馈仅能恢复其中一小部分损失。
AI.motivation: LLM既能解决复杂问题，也可能在高风险领域被滥用造成严重后果，因此服务提供商需限制对潜在有害请求的帮助。但一刀切拒绝所有网络安全请求会伤害合法防御者。现有网络安全专用数据集在评测该机制时均未考虑请求的对话上下文，存在评估盲区。
AI.method: 提出3R-Bench（Refusal, Repetition, Revision）基准，包含150个真实世界网络安全请求，并附加两种对抗性对话设置（被拒绝历史/被接受历史、对话分解），在400对面板和738对可比较样本上对8个LLM进行系统评测，统计合规率变化。
AI.result: 先前的助手行为强烈改变对未变请求的响应：在400对面板的376个可用对中，合规率从拒绝历史后的62.0%升至接受历史后的85.1%。对话分解下呈现相反模式：合规率从直接响应的501/800降至对话后的172/800；在738个两条件均返回模型文本的对中，降幅达45.1个百分点，失败反馈仅恢复其中一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 对话上下文会显著影响LLM对相同网络安全请求的安全响应，现有安全机制极易被对话历史操纵或削弱，说明安全评测必须纳入对话语境，且当前模型在对话场景下的拒答一致性存在严重漏洞。

title: Patterning in Practice: Debiasing Reward Models with Susceptibilities
summary: Reward models trained on human preferences are known to suffer from length, formatting, and other stylistic biases. In this paper we use patterning, which reweights each preference pair according to its measured effect on posterior expectation values of benchmark losses (its susceptibility), to debias a Gemma 2 9B Instruct reward model trained on Skywork-Reward-Preference v0.2. We obtain $+14.2 \pm 1.2$ pp on RM-Bench Hard, the split where style cues point against correctness (mean $\pm$ s.e.\ over 5 seeds), with overall RM-Bench accuracy preserved, comparable to the strongest Hard-split gain reported by the closest published comparator (SteerRM, $+13.2$ pp). We demonstrate in a simple case that the reweighting is interpretable by tracing a side effect of the intervention (a regression on a safety subset of RM-Bench) to a small class of training pairs, which we confirm by ablation. The weights also transfer: those computed on Gemma 2 9B debias Gemma 2 2B and 27B with no recomputation, and transfer partially to Llama 3.1 8B. This is the first application of patterning, a program grounded in singular learning theory, beyond small models and synthetic tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将基于奇异学习理论的"patterning"方法应用到大规模奖励模型上，通过在Skywork-Reward-Preference v0.2上对Gemma 2 9B Instruct奖励模型按成对偏好数据的"易感性"重新加权，在不损失整体RM-Bench精度的前提下将Hard子集准确率提升14.2±1.2个百分点（超越SteerRM的13.2pp），并展示了可解释性、消融验证及跨模型规模的可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 基于人类偏好训练的奖励模型已知存在长度、格式等风格性偏差，这些偏差会导致其判断被非内容线索干扰，尤其在风格线索与正确性相冲突的评测子集（RM-Bench Hard）上表现显著。如何有效、可解释地去除这类偏差是一大难题。
AI.method: 采用patterning方法：根据每个偏好对对其后验期望损失（基准损失）的影响大小（即"易感性"）重新加权训练数据，从而抵消风格偏差。具体对在Skywork-Reward-Preference v0.2上训练的Gemma 2 9B Instruct奖励模型进行去偏，并验证权重在Gemma 2 2B/27B及Llama 3.1 8B上的迁移性。
AI.result: 在RM-Bench Hard子集上获得+14.2±1.2个百分点（5个种子的均值±标准误），整体RM-Bench精度保持不变；效果与当前最强公开对照SteerRM（+13.2 pp）相当。在RM-Bench的安全性回归子集上，可将干预副作用溯源到一小类训练样本对并经消融确认；权重无需重新计算即可迁移到2B/27B，部分迁移到Llama 3.1 8B。
AI.conclusion: Patterning作为一种根植于奇异学习理论的方法，首次成功扩展至大规模奖励模型和真实任务，能够在不牺牲整体性能的前提下显著消除奖励模型中的风格偏见，且具备可解释性、可迁移性和可消融验证性，为奖励模型去偏提供了一条新路径。

title: Quit While You're Ahead: Quit for Efficient Candidate Generation in Machine Translation Reranking
summary: Reranking methods, such as Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding and Quality Estimation (QE) reranking, are widely used in modern neural machine translation (NMT) to select an output from a set of candidate hypotheses. However, the performance gains come at the cost of high inference latency. Existing acceleration methods target MBR decoding and reduce only reranking computation, leaving QE reranking unaddressed and candidate generation---which can be the larger computational bottleneck---largely untouched. In this work, we propose Quit (Quantifying Uncertainty for Incremental Termination), a novel early-stopping strategy for the entire generation--reranking pipeline. Viewing candidate generation as a sequential decision under uncertainty, Quit incrementally generates and reranks candidates, stopping when the highest estimated quality in the candidate set stabilizes. Comprehensive experiments on three NMT models across 19 language pairs show that Quit yields end-to-end speedups of $1.47$--$2.66\times$ for MBR and $3.43$--$4.12\times$ for QE reranking while preserving translation quality within prespecified equivalence margins.

AI.tldr: 提出 Quit，一种面向神经机器翻译"生成-重排"全流程的早停策略，通过将候选生成视为不确定性下的序贯决策，增量地生成并重排候选，并在最高质量估计趋于稳定时提前终止，从而同时加速 MBR 解码和 QE 重排，在保持翻译质量的前提下获得端到端提速。
AI.motivation: MBR 解码和 QE 重排等重排方法能显著提升 NMT 翻译质量，但带来较高的推理延迟。现有加速方法仅针对 MBR 解码、只缩减重排计算量，既未处理 QE 重排，也基本没有触及可能更大的计算瓶颈——候选生成阶段。
AI.method: 提出 Quit（Quantifying Uncertainty for Incremental Termination），一种面向整个生成-重排流水线的早停策略。它将候选生成视为不确定性下的序贯决策：增量地生成并重排候选，当候选集中最高估计质量趋于稳定时即停止，从而避免生成过多冗余候选。
AI.result: 在 3 个 NMT 模型、19 个语言对的综合实验中，Quit 对 MBR 解码取得 1.47–2.66 倍的端到端加速，对 QE 重排取得 3.43–4.12 倍的端到端加速，并在预设等价区间内保持翻译质量不变。
AI.conclusion: Quit 表明：通过质量不确定性驱动的增量式早停，可以同时优化候选生成与重排两个阶段，显著降低 MBR 与 QE 重排的端到端推理延迟，且不牺牲翻译质量，弥补了现有加速方法仅聚焦重排计算、忽略候选生成瓶颈的不足。

title: The Visual Insensitivity Gap: Diagnosing When Vision-Language Models Fail to Use Visual Evidence
comment: 17 pages (7-page main text plus technical appendix), 10 figures, 6 tables
summary: Vision-language models are evaluated by aggregate accuracy on multimodal benchmarks, a practice that implicitly assumes the model uses its visual input. We show this assumption fails on 40%--97% of samples across six VLMs and three perceptual benchmarks: blurring the question-relevant visual region leaves the next-token distribution nearly unchanged. We name this phenomenon the Visual Insensitivity Gap and quantify it with a per-sample Visual Sensitivity Index (VSI). The gap is a property of samples, not of models: VSI ranks correlate across models (grand-mean Spearman rho=+0.40, permutation p<10^-3), so the same samples are flagged insensitive by VLMs sharing no architectural detail beyond a contrastively pretrained vision tower. The mechanism is concrete: on the insensitive samples, a linear probe on each model's own vision tower distinguishes perturbed from clean images at 0.72--0.79 accuracy, yet the model's argmax token changes on only 2%--11% of the same samples, an encoder--LLM gap above 0.65 on every model. Mapping VSI's diagnostic utility cell by cell surfaces a strong regime (multi-choice reasoning on capable VLMs: AUROC=0.85--0.87) and a weak regime (well-calibrated factuality, where softmax confidence already leads). VSI is not a universal best abstention signal; it is a sample-intrinsic indicator of vision-ignoring failure, best used as a conditional ensemble component.

AI.tldr: 本文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）在多模态基准上存在一个普遍现象——视觉不敏感缺口：在40%–97%的样本上模糊掉与问题相关的视觉区域几乎不改变下一词元分布，说明模型实际上忽略了视觉输入。作者提出逐样本的视觉敏感度指数（VSI）来量化该缺口，证明它是样本固有属性（跨模型排序一致），并揭示其源于视觉编码器与LLM之间的信息断层；VSI可作为条件式的集成/弃权组件，在多项选择推理上表现强（AUROC 0.85–0.87），但在校准良好的事实性问题上是弱信号。
AI.motivation: 现有评测用多模态基准上的平均准确率评估VLM，隐含假设模型真正使用了视觉输入；作者发现这一假设在大量样本上不成立，模型几乎完全忽略视觉信号却仍能作答，因此需要一种机制来测量和解释这种"视觉盲区"。
AI.method: 提出逐样本视觉敏感度指数（VSI）：通过模糊与问题相关的视觉区域，测量扰动前后下一词元分布的变化。作者在六个VLM和三个感知基准上对比了VSI排序的跨模型一致性，并用各模型自身视觉塔上的线性探针区分扰动/干净图像，量化视觉编码器到LLM之间的信息损失（encoder–LLM gap），最后逐单元格分析VSI在不同模型/任务配比下的判别能力（AUROC）。
AI.result: 40%–97%的样本对视觉扰动不敏感；VSI跨模型排序一致（均值Spearman ρ=+0.40，permutation p<10^-3），证明缺口是样本固有属性。线性探针能以0.72–0.79准确率区分扰动与干净图像，但模型argmax token仅变化2%–11%，encoder–LLM gap在每个模型上均超过0.65。VSI在能力较强的VLM上的多选推理场景表现最佳（AUROC 0.85–0.87），但在已良好校准的事实性场景中不如softmax置信度。
AI.conclusion: VSI是样本固有的、指示"忽略视觉输入"失败的诊断指标，但不是通用的最优弃权信号；它最适合作为条件式集成组件，只在特定模型能力与任务形态（如多选推理）组合下发挥最佳效用，揭示了VLM中视觉编码与语言推理之间的实质性断层。

title: Socrates went Nuclear: Comparing Interaction Strategies for AI systems in a Learning Context using Brain Sensing
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, to appear at The 14th International Conference on Human-Agent Interaction (HAI'26)
summary: Does unrestricted AI access bypass the cognitive effort required for learning, or does it streamline knowledge acquisition? This paper reports on a study where we compare three designs for user-AI interaction in a learning context: (1) an unrestricted conversational bot like ChatGPT, (2) a pedagogically constrained bot that guides through hints without giving final answers, which we refer to as the Socratic mode; and (3) a non-conversational adaptive tutoring system that adjusts difficulty in real-time based on the user's cognitive engagement derived from the brain signals. Fifty study participants were tasked with learning about nuclear safety protocols, a domain chosen for its zero-prior knowledge baseline. The participants progressed through an instructional video, a pre-test, an AI-driven assessment phase, which varied in the three conditions, and an immediate post-test. The nature of the questions centered primarily on factual knowledge acquisition, but it still required participants to have a global understanding of the concepts in order to answer the questions correctly. A Muse headband was used to derive the cognitive engagement of all users in all conditions. The unrestricted chatbot produced higher learning gains (delta) than both constrained modes (p < .03, d > 0.80), while the adaptive condition generated significantly higher EEG engagement (p = .018). The cluster analysis of chatbot usage and discussion patterns by users showed that most participants in the unrestricted-mode adopted a direct answer-retrieval strategy, while participants in the Socratic-mode initially attempted to reason through the hints before progressively disengaging. Consequently, this also suggests that the success of the unrestricted AI is not an evidence of deeper learning, but rather a result of the immediate post-test evaluation after the training phase.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了三种人机交互设计（无限制对话机器人、苏格拉底式提示机器人、基于脑电信号的适应性辅导系统）对学习效果的影响。研究发现无限制的ChatGPT式聊天机器人带来了更高的学习增益，而适应性系统产生了更高的脑电认知投入，但聚类分析表明无限制模式的成功主要源于直接获取答案的策略和即时后测，而非更深层次的学习。
AI.motivation: 探讨无限制的AI访问是否绕过了学习所需的认知努力，还是其能够简化知识获取过程。现有研究表明不同人机交互模式对学习的影响尚不明确，作者希望通过对三种交互设计进行受控实验，考察AI交互方式对学习效果与认知投入的真实影响。
AI.method: 招募50名被试学习核安全协议（选择该领域以确保零先验知识基线）。被试依次经历教学视频、前测、三种条件之一的AI评估阶段（无限制对话机器人、苏格拉底式引导机器人、基于脑电信号实时调节难度的非对话式自适应系统）以及即时后测。使用Muse头带采集所有条件下被试的认知投入脑电信号，并对聊天使用模式进行聚类分析。问题以事实性知识获取为主，但需要掌握概念的全局理解才能正确作答。
AI.result: 无限制对话机器人产生的学习增益（delta）显著高于两种受约束模式（p<.03, d>0.80）；自适应条件则产生了显著更高的脑电认知投入（p=.018）。聚类分析显示：无限制模式的多数被试采用直接检索答案的策略，而苏格拉底模式被试起初尝试通过提示推理，随后逐渐脱离参与。这表明无限制AI的成功并非深层学习的证据，而是即时后测评估阶段效应的结果。
AI.conclusion: 无限制AI带来的更高学习增益实际上源于直接答案获取与紧接训练后的即时评估效应，而非更深刻的认知加工；受约束的苏格拉底模式虽然初期能激发推理，但易导致参与度下降，因此需要在认知投入与学习成果之间寻求更合理的交互设计平衡。

title: Online Self-Weighted Fine-Tuning
summary: Standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) assigns the same explicit loss weight to every expert demonstration, regardless of the model's changing competence over training queries. Reinforcement learning (RL) based methods adapt update strength using model-generated rollouts, but often require substantially more sampling and can be unstable on hard tasks. We propose \textbf{Online Self-Weighted Fine-Tuning (OSW-FT)}, a simple method that augments SFT with online, trajectory-level weighting. For each query, OSW-FT estimates the model's current success rate using a small number of inference-only rollouts and rescales the standard SFT loss accordingly. The optimization direction remains anchored to the expert trajectory, while the update magnitude adapts online. For binary-verifiable reasoning, we connect this weighting to SFT and RL at the gradient level, inspired by variance-reduction principles. The resulting estimator is unbiased for the exact OSW-FT surrogate update for any finite rollout count, and we analyze convergence with respect to the corresponding surrogate objective. Evaluated across Qwen3 series ranging from 0.6B to 4B on multiple challenging benchmarks (e.g., AIME), OSW-FT consistently improves over SFT on small-to-medium scale models. OSW-FT offers a favorable compute-performance trade-off as a practical approach for fine-tuning small-to-medium LLMs on binary-verifiable reasoning tasks with only \textbf{2 online rollouts}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在线自加权微调（OSW-FT），在标准监督微调（SFT）基础上，对每个查询用少量仅推理的rollout估计模型当前成功率，并据此对SFT损失进行在线轨迹级加权，从而让更新幅度随模型能力自适应变化，同时保持优化方向锚定在专家轨迹上。
AI.motivation: 标准SFT对所有专家演示赋予相同的显式损失权重，忽视了模型在训练过程中对不同查询的能力变化；而基于强化学习的方法虽能自适应调整更新强度，但通常需要大量采样且难以在困难任务上保持稳定。因此需要一种既能自适应更新强度、又保持SFT简单稳定特性的方法。
AI.method: OSW-FT用少量推理型rollout估计模型当前对每个查询的成功率，并据此重新缩放标准SFT损失，实现轨迹级在线加权。优化方向仍锚定于专家轨迹，仅更新幅度在线自适应。针对二值可验证推理任务，作者在梯度层面借鉴方差缩减原理将OSW-FT与SFT、RL建立联系，并证明该估计器对任意有限rollout数量的OSW-FT代理更新的精确无偏性，同时分析了相应代理目标下的收敛性。
AI.result: 在Qwen3系列（0.6B到4B）多个挑战性基准（如AIME）上的实验表明，OSW-FT在中小型模型上持续优于SFT，且仅需2个在线rollout即可获得有利的计算-性能权衡，是一种实用的小型到中型LLM在二值可验证推理任务上的微调方法。
AI.conclusion: OSW-FT以几乎不增加采样开销的方式（仅2个在线rollout）弥合了SFT与RL之间的差距，为中小规模模型在可验证推理任务上提供了一种简单、稳定且计算高效的微调方案，在梯度层面建立起的理论保证也为其可靠性提供了支撑。

title: Investigating Assistant Bias in LLM User Simulators Using a Role Vector
summary: LLM-based user simulators are increasingly used to evaluate autonomous agents at scale, in place of costly human evaluations. Despite this promise, these simulators exhibit "assistant bias," a tendency to cooperate and pursue task goals. They rarely reproduce the frustration or disengagement that real users exhibit, compromising evaluation validity. Prior work outlines that this bias is baked in during model training, which role-playing prompts fail to override. We analyze this bias from model activations, extracting a user role vector by contrasting how the model represents user versus assistant perspectives on the same dialogue. We observe two findings: (i) the user direction is identifiable in activations, elicits user-like behaviors, and captures characteristics distinct from assistant traits; and (ii) although user-role activation associates with simulation realism and steering strengthens it, it can exaggerate user behaviors and override individual user profiles. Together, our findings provide a representation-level analysis of LLM user simulators, confirming that assistant bias is structurally identifiable and that user behavior can be directionally analyzed.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM用户模拟器中的"助手偏见"问题，提出从模型激活层入手，通过对比模型在同一对话中对用户视角与助手视角的表示差异，提取"用户角色向量"。研究表明该方向在激活中可识别、能诱发类用户行为且独立于助手特征；但对用户角色激活进行强化虽然能提升模拟真实感，也可能夸大用户行为并覆盖个体用户画像。该工作提供了对LLM用户模拟器的表示级分析，证明助手偏见在结构上可识别、用户行为可沿方向进行分析。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的用户模拟器虽可替代昂贵的人工评估，但因训练过程固化的"助手偏见"而倾向于配合并追求任务目标，难以再现真实用户的挫败或脱离表现，从而损害评估效度。既有研究表明角色扮演提示无法覆盖这一偏见，因此需要从更底层的模型表示层面理解并分析该偏见。
AI.method: 通过对同一对话中"用户视角"与"助手视角"的模型表示进行对比，从模型激活中提取一个用户角色向量（user role vector）；随后基于该向量进行方向性分析，考察其是否可识别、能否诱发用户类行为，以及对其进行激活强化（steering）对模拟真实感和个体用户画像的影响。
AI.result: 两项主要发现：(i) 用户方向在激活中可识别，能够诱发用户类行为，且其捕捉的特征与助手特质显著不同；(ii) 用户角色激活与模拟真实感相关，强化该方向能增强真实感，但同时可能夸大用户行为并覆盖个体用户画像。
AI.conclusion: 这一表示级分析证实：助手偏见的形成在模型结构上是可识别的，用户行为可以被方向性地分析与操控；但同时提示了激活层面的用户模拟存在真实感提升与个体特征保真之间的权衡，为构建更有效的用户模拟器提供了新的分析视角和干预思路。

title: Vision-Language-Guided Pseudo-Labels for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Semantic Segmentation for Waste Sorting
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, accepted at ECML-PKDD 2026
summary: Obtaining labeled data for semantic segmentation in applied settings (e.g., autonomous driving, industrial waste sorting) is expensive and often infeasible at scale. We present a cross-modal pseudo-labeling pipeline that enables unsupervised domain adaptation without any target-domain annotations. The pipeline is built on two core foundation models: SAM generates class-agnostic region proposals, and EVA-CLIP assigns semantic labels based on region-text similarity, with confidence filtering ensuring that only reliable pseudo-labels are used for self-training a segmentation model. As an optional extension, BLIP provides language-grounded verification for ambiguous regions, thereby improving pseudo-label quality without altering the overall pipeline. Evaluated on two domain shifts, synthetic-to-real autonomous driving and, with a primary focus, lab-to-factory industrial waste sorting, the pipeline consistently improves over source-only baselines. Our results demonstrate that pseudo-label quality, not quantity, is a decisive factor in self-training under domain shift, and that cross-modal language grounding offers a practical path to reliable automatic annotation in deployment-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于跨模态伪标签的流水线，利用SAM生成区域提案、EVA-CLIP分配语义标签、置信度过滤筛选可靠伪标签，并可选地通过BLIP进行语言校验，从而实现无需目标域标注的无监督域自适应语义分割；在合成到真实自动驾驶以及实验室到工厂的工业废料分拣两个域偏移上持续优于源域基线。
AI.motivation: 在自动驾驶、工业废料分拣等实际应用中，获取语义分割的标注数据成本高昂且难以规模化，因此需要一种无需任何目标域标注的方法来实现可靠的自动标注与域自适应。
AI.method: 提出跨模态伪标签流水线：1）SAM生成类别无关的区域提案；2）EVA-CLIP基于区域-文本相似度分配语义标签；3）置信度过滤确保仅用可靠的伪标签对分割模型进行自训练；4）可选扩展——BLIP对模糊区域进行基于语言的验证，以提升伪标签质量而不改变整体流水线。
AI.result: 在合成到真实自动驾驶和（重点）实验室到工厂工业废料分拣两种域偏移上，该流水线一致优于源域基线；实验表明伪标签质量而非数量才是自训练在域偏移下起决定性作用的因素，跨模态语言基础为部署关键应用提供了可靠的自动标注路径。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明跨模态语言基础（利用基础模型）能够以高质量伪标签支撑无监督域自适应语义分割，强调伪标签质量优于数量，为缺少标注的实际应用场景提供了实用且可扩展的自动标注方案。

title: Control-Data Flow Separation: Stable Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Prompt optimization can improve multi-agent LLM systems, but the prompts being optimized often serve two entangled roles: generating task-relevant content and specifying execution-critical protocols, such as message routing, output formatting, and termination signals, on which the underlying code relies. As a result, a prompt edit intended to improve content generation can inadvertently corrupt the protocol and cause the entire agent pipeline to fail. Our key observation is that these two roles have different representations: execution protocols are typically structured, while task-relevant content is usually expressed in unstructured language. Based on this, we propose control-data flow separation, where execution-critical control is represented as typed, validated program objects, while task-relevant language remains the optimizable data flow for agent communication. This design allows optimizers to improve multi-agent behavior without exposing the routing or formatting interface to prompt drift. Across synthetic reasoning, collaborative review generation, and insurance rating workflows, our framework empirically achieves 100% eventual protocol validity while consistently improving task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出控制-数据流分离（control-data flow separation）框架，将多智能体LLM系统中可优化的提示词按角色拆分为结构化、类型化、可校验的程序对象（控制流）与可优化的非结构化自然语言（数据流），从而在提示优化提升任务表现的同时，避免路由、格式等执行协议因提示漂移而失效。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统中的提示词承担两种纠缠不清的角色：生成任务相关内容，以及规定代码依赖的执行协议（如消息路由、输出格式、终止信号）。为改进内容生成而做的提示编辑可能无意中破坏执行协议，导致整个智能体流水线失败。关键观察在于这两类角色具有不同表示形式：执行协议通常是结构化的，而任务相关内容通常以非结构化语言表达。
AI.method: 提出控制-数据流分离设计：将执行关键的控制逻辑表示为类型化、经过校验的程序对象，而任务相关语言保留为可优化的数据流用于智能体通信。该设计让优化器能够改善多智能体行为，同时不将路由或格式化接口暴露于提示漂移（prompt drift）之下。
AI.result: 在合成推理、协同评审生成和保险评级工作流等任务上，该框架经验性地实现了100%的最终协议有效性，同时持续提升任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 将执行协议与任务内容在表示层面分离，可以在提示优化中兼顾协议稳定性与任务性能提升，为多智能体系统提供更稳健的优化途径。

title: Text Capability Loss in Vision-Language Adaptation: An Attention-Sink Diagnosis
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 29 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/minsik-choi126/sink-strength. * Equal contribution. † Corresponding author
summary: Fine-tuning a pretrained LLM into a vision-language model (VLM) can erode the backbone's text capability, with the damage concentrated on tasks that require following exact output rules, such as instruction following, chain-of-thought reasoning graded on a strictly parsed final answer, and similar evaluations with strict graders. We trace this gap to attention-sink corruption: VL fine-tuning perturbs the early sink position that anchors a large fraction of attention probability, and how well the base LLM preserves its sink tracks how much of the affected capability survives adaptation. Building on this view, we introduce Sink Strength, a single scalar computed on the base LLM in a few seconds on a single GPU that predicts post-VL degradation without any VL training. It consistently tracks relative degradation across the six VLM-LLM pairs and multiple format-sensitive tasks. Complementing this diagnostic, we find that post-pretraining QK-RMSNorm injection fails to reproduce the protection of native QK-RMSNorm, while several off-the-shelf weight-merging settings fail to recover the lost capability after VL training. These negative results underscore the value of screening backbones with Sink Strength before VL training and narrow the intervention space toward head-selective training-time protection.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示将预训练LLM微调为视觉语言模型（VLM）会侵蚀骨干模型在严格格式任务上的文本能力，归因于注意力汇聚点（attention sink）被破坏；据此提出仅在基础LLM上几秒内即可计算的标量指标Sink Strength，无需任何VL训练即可预测能力退化程度，并指出若干干预手段（QK-RMSNorm注入、权重合并）无效，最终将干预方向收敛到头部选择式的训练期保护。
AI.motivation: 将预训练LLM微调为VLM会损害骨干网络的文本能力，且这种损害集中在对严格输出格式敏感的任务上（如指令跟随、需严格解析最终答案的链式推理等）。现有工作缺乏对这种退化成因的机理性理解，也缺少在VLM训练前就能预估退化程度、指导骨干选择的诊断工具。
AI.method: 将退化归因于注意力汇聚点破坏：VL微调扰动了承载大量注意力概率的早期汇聚位置，基础LLM保持其汇聚点的能力与生存下来的能力高度相关。据此提出Sink Strength——在单个GPU上数秒内基于基础LLM计算出的单一标量，无需任何VL训练即可预测微调后的退化程度。同时进行干预实验：测试post-pretraining阶段注入QK-RMSNorm能否复现原生QK-RMSNorm的保护效果，并尝试多种现成权重合并设置以恢复丢失的能力。
AI.result: Sink Strength在六组VLM-LLM配对及多个格式敏感任务上持续跟踪相对退化程度，预测能力得到验证。干预实验均为负面结果：post-pretraining的QK-RMSNorm注入无法复现原生QK-RMSNorm的保护，现成的权重合并设置也未能恢复VL训练后丢失的能力。
AI.conclusion: 这些负面结果凸显了在VL训练前用Sink Strength筛查骨干网络的实用价值，并将可行的干预空间收窄为头部选择性（head-selective）的训练期保护策略。

title: Trust Your Guide Only When Certain: Uncertainty-Aware Sparse Alignment at Inference Time
summary: A prominent paradigm in inference-time alignment employs lightweight supervisors to steer Large Language Models (LLMs). Through empirical analysis, we identify a structural mismatch in this paradigm: weak supervisors exhibit pervasive high entropy across the vast majority of tokens, yet prevailing dense intervention approaches mandate supervision at every decoding step. This leads to frequent low-confidence interventions that can disrupt valid base-model reasoning and incur substantial utility costs. To resolve this, we propose TUSA (Trust-based Uncertainty Sparse Alignment). Moving away from continuous oversight, TUSA reframes alignment as a dynamic arbitration process, introducing an uncertainty-aware arbiter that authorizes intervention only when two conditions are met: the supervisor is confident and the token is semantically salient. This mechanism effectively filters out uncertainty-driven noise and redundant supervision. Extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks show that TUSA consistently improves both safety alignment and general helpfulness. By bypassing approximately 50% of alignment steps, it not only enhances safety preference by up to 15.6%, but also boosts general preference rates by up to 12.0% compared to the dense baseline, demonstrating that selective, high-precision alignment can outperform continuous supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出TUSA（基于信任的不确定性稀疏对齐）方法，针对推理时对齐中弱监督器在高熵token上触发低置信干预的问题，引入不确定性感知仲裁机制，仅在监督器高置信且token语义显著时干预，从而减少约50%的对齐步骤，同时提升安全对齐和通用帮助性。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时对齐范式依赖轻量级监督器逐解码步进行密集干预，但经验分析发现弱监督器在绝大多数token上呈现普遍高熵，导致大量低置信干预频繁发生，既可能破坏基座模型的有效推理，也带来显著效用成本。这种结构错配促使作者寻求更稀疏、更精准的监督方式。
AI.method: 提出TUSA（Trust-based Uncertainty Sparse Alignment），将对齐重新定义为动态仲裁过程，引入不确定性感知仲裁器，仅在两个条件同时满足时授权干预：监督器置信度高、且token语义显著。该机制有效过滤不确定性驱动的噪声和冗余监督，将连续监督转变为选择性高精度干预。
AI.result: 在多个模型和基准上的实验表明，TUSA一致地提升了安全对齐与通用帮助性。相比密集基线，它绕过约50%的对齐步骤，安全偏好最高提升15.6%，通用偏好率最高提升12.0%。
AI.conclusion: 选择性、高精度的对齐可以胜过连续监督，证明了稀疏干预范式在推理时对齐中的有效性：通过过滤低置信干预并聚焦语义显著的高置信token，既能增强安全性，也能维护基座模型的帮助性与推理能力，带来更优的综合效用。

title: HELIOS: From midnight to noon, continuous outdoor urban scene relighting
summary: Modifying the illumination of driving images is a fundamental challenge, as most datasets are captured at specific times of day. Existing methods rely on synthetic data or paired multi-illumination supervision, which limits their generalization to the diverse and challenging conditions of real-world scenarios. To address this, we propose HELIOS, a novel image relighting approach that relies on unlabeled real-world datasets without requiring any paired images for training. Our approach integrates albedo-based conditioning into a cycle-consistent diffusion pipeline to prevent identity collapse and ensure accurate domain translation. To handle low-visibility nighttime conditions, we introduce a robust albedo distillation strategy that transfers structural stability from the daytime domain. Additionally, we replace traditional text prompts with a fine-grained control mechanism based on GPS-derived solar angles, enabling smooth and continuous lighting manipulation across the day-night cycle. Through extensive evaluation and a user study, we demonstrate that HELIOS produces structurally consistent and realistic results in both night-to-day and day-to-night tasks, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: HELIOS 是一种无需配对图像、仅依赖未标注真实世界数据集的图像重打光方法，通过将基于反照率的条件融入循环一致性扩散管道，并利用 GPS 太阳角实现细粒度、连续的昼夜光照操控，在昼夜双向转换任务中取得优于现有方法的结构一致且真实的结果。
AI.motivation: 驾驶图像的照明修改具有挑战性，因为大多数数据集只在特定时间段采集。现有方法依赖合成数据或配对的多光照监督，限制了其在真实世界多样复杂条件下的泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出 HELIOS，仅依赖未标注的真实世界数据集训练，无需任何配对图像；2) 将基于反照率（albedo）的条件融入循环一致性扩散管道，防止身份崩塌并确保准确的域转换；3) 引入鲁棒的反照率蒸馏策略，从白天域迁移结构稳定性，以应对低可见度夜间条件；4) 用基于 GPS 太阳角的细粒度控制机制替代传统文本提示，实现昼夜周期内平滑连续的光照操控。
AI.result: 大量评估与用户研究表明，HELIOS 在夜转昼和昼转夜任务中均能产生结构一致且真实的图像，性能优于现有最先进方法。
