Second, at a single global threshold TRACE mostly recovers a direct, adjacent-influence graph: lag-1 true edges are recalled at 0.97-0.99, while true edges at lag 2 or more read orders of magnitude lower---the reading-scale price of randomizing mediating positions, which an exact test of direct causal effect requires when the truth is unknown. A per-lag threshold family recovers a third to a half of lag-2 truth; on lag-uniform data one validated threshold recalls every lag at 0.40-0.87, 8-26 pp below an atomic-intervention control at lags 3-6. Third, the default lag decay of the paper's synthetic benchmark concentrates about 85% of interventional truth at lag 1 and pushes the rest below the estimator's noise floor, so headline F1 there certifies lag-1 recovery only and conflates the benchmark's skew with the algorithm's own limit; a flatter decay separates the two. Fourth, F1 saturates from N = 2 particles at the selected threshold---a property of the threshold's margin over the noise floor, not of the estimator, which converges as N^(-1/2). We distill five practitioner rules.

AI.tldr: 本文对TRACE（通过固定阈值对预训练自回归模型的逐位置条件互信息估计进行截断，从而从事件类型中读出因果图）进行了独立复现。复现结果：在词表规模1000时，基于验证集选择阈值的逐序列F1达0.90–0.91（原文0.91）。但研究发现：最优阈值并不固定，而是钉在真值边界（delta=0.05）附近；单一全局阈值主要恢复滞后1的直接相邻影响边，滞后2及以上大幅衰减；基准的滞后衰减设计把约85%干预真值集中于滞后1，使头条F1只认证滞后1恢复；F1在N=2粒子处饱和而估计器本身按N^{-1/2}收敛。最终提炼出五条实践规则。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在独立验证TRACE方法宣称的头条合成结果，并系统考察其阈值选择性质、各滞后真值恢复能力、基准设计偏差以及样本粒子数对性能的影响，从而厘清方法本身的局限与基准偏斜造成的混淆。
AI.method: 在合成数据上以精确干预真值为对照：用验证集选择全局阈值复测F1；分析最优阈值与真值margin（delta=0.05）及估计器校准的关系（含5000词表外样本确认）；比较单一全局阈值与逐滞后阈值族对滞后1至更高滞后真边的召回；设计滞后均匀数据以分离基准偏斜与算法极限；考察粒子数N=2起的F1饱和现象及估计器收敛阶。
AI.result: 词表1000时验证集选择阈值下平均逐序列F1为0.90–0.91（复现原文0.91）；100至2000词表下为0.86–0.91。最优阈值随样本逼近delta/2×校准而非恒定值，误差恰好分布在0.05真值边界两侧。单一全局阈值下滞后1真边召回0.97–0.99，滞后2及以上低数个数量级；逐滞后阈值族仅恢复三分之—至一半的滞后2真边，滞后均匀数据下单一验证阈值在各滞后召回0.40–0.87，比原子干预对照低8–26个百分点（滞后3–6）。基准默认滞后衰减将约85%真值集中在滞后1，其余落入噪声底。F1在N=2即饱和，但估计器本身以N^{-1/2}收敛，饱和源于阈值对噪声底的margin。
AI.conclusion: TRACE在单一全局阈值下主要读出的是直接、相邻影响图，滞后恢复能力受真实因果未知时需随机化中介位置这一读取尺度代价的严重限制；头条F1仅认证滞后1恢复，且混淆了基准偏斜与算法极限。作者据此给出五条实践规则：阈值须按验证集选择而非固定常数；识别最优阈值须锚定真值边界；跨滞后比较需区分全局阈值与逐滞后阈值；基准设计需平缓滞后衰减以分离偏斜与算法极限；对F1饱和现象应关注估计器收敛而非阈值饱和。

title: Context-Grounding Gains Are Mediated by Pre-existing Machinery: Auditing GRPO, SFT, and DPO
summary: Language models can ignore prompt evidence when it conflicts with memorized knowledge. Post-training can make models follow such evidence more reliably, but it is unclear whether these gains require new machinery or strengthen machinery already present. We compare nine post-training arms spanning GRPO, SFT, and DPO from one starting checkpoint, with key comparisons extended across scales and families. We estimate a grounding direction from that checkpoint before training. Across five tested GRPO variants, grounding gains are small. For the two variants replicated across seeds, equivalence tests bound their effects below the conflict-SFT gain even as the rewarded metric improves. Conflict-SFT improves grounding moderately, while DPO drives grounding near ceiling on its matched distribution. Conflict-SFT and DPO largely use the same causal attention-head set as the starting model. Subtracting the starting-model direction suppresses both gains, while adding it to the starting model recovers 35% of DPO's gain at a dose passing all stated side-effect checks. After a supervised warm start makes the context answer appear in more rollouts, the same GRPO recipe adds essentially no further grounding gain. In our setting, grounding gains largely depend on machinery already present in the starting model.

AI.tldr: 本文从同一初始检查点出发，比较GRPO、SFT、DPO等九种后训练方案对语言模型“遵循提示证据（接地）能力”的影响，发现GRPO带来的接地增益很小，冲突SFT增益中等，DPO在匹配分布上接近上限；且增益大多依赖于初始模型中已存在的机制（注意力头），而非新引入的机器。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在提示证据与记忆知识冲突时可能忽略证据，后训练虽能提升模型遵循证据的可靠性，但尚不清楚这种提升是源于全新的机制，还是强化了模型中已有的机制。厘清这一点有助于理解后训练方法的本质与可迁移性。
AI.method: 从一个起始检查点出发，比较涵盖GRPO、SFT和DPO的九个后训练分支，并在多个规模和模型家族上扩展关键对比。训练前估计该检查点的“接地方向”；对五个GRPO变体测试接地增益，对两个变体跨种子重复并做等价性检验；通过因果注意力头分析、方向消减/叠加实验及监督热启动等手段验证增益来源。
AI.result: 五个GRPO变体的接地增益均较小；跨种子重复的等价性检验显示其效应低于冲突SFT的增益，尽管奖励指标在提升。冲突SFT适度提升接地，DPO在匹配分布上几乎达到上限。两者与起始模型使用相同的因果注意力头集合；减去起始模型方向会抑制两种增益，而将其叠加回起始模型可在通过所有副作用检查的剂量下恢复DPO增益的35%。在监督热启动使上下文答案更频繁出现后，相同GRPO配方几乎不再增加接地增益。
AI.conclusion: 在该研究设定下，接地增益在很大程度上依赖于起始模型中已经存在的机制，而非后训练引入的全新机制；这提示DPO等高增益方法更多是强化并放大已有能力。

title: ViTAMINS: An Empirical Study of Training Self-Supervised Vision Transformers with Synthetic Hard Negatives
summary: We introduce ViTAMINS, a method that integrates synthetic hard negatives into unsupervised vision transformer pretraining to improve representation quality. Our approach is thoroughly benchmarked on ImageNet and transfer learning, image retrieval, copy detection, and image, video segmentation tasks. Notably, our proposed negatives give rise to emergent properties, where learned representations contain explicit information about the semantic content of an image and serve as excellent classifiers (up to +11.3% over baselines). ViTAMINS achieves these benefits through simple modifications to existing contrastive frameworks and outperforms competing methods while being more resource efficient, e.g., our ViT-B surpasses V-JEPA with ViT-L. Our findings motivate reconsidering contrastive learning as a simpler yet powerful alternative to dominant generative and self-distillation approaches.

AI.tldr: ViTAMINS 通过将合成的困难负样本（synthetic hard negatives）引入无监督视觉 Transformer 预训练，以极小的改动提升对比学习表征质量，并展现出语义信息编码的涌现特性，在多项下游任务上以更低资源消耗超越生成式与自蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的无监督视觉预训练主要被生成式方法（如 V-JEPA）和自蒸馏方法主导，而对比学习被视为较为朴素或能力受限的范式。作者希望验证：仅通过对现有对比学习框架进行简单修改、引入合成困难负样本，即可大幅提升表征质量，使其成为更简单且更具资源效率的替代方案。
AI.method: ViTAMINS 在无监督 ViT 预训练中整合合成困难负样本，作为对现有对比学习框架的简单扩展；负样本被设计为与正样本语义相近但存在差异的样本，从而迫使模型学习更精细的判别性特征。作者在 ImageNet 及多项下游任务上进行了系统性基准测试。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet、迁移学习、图像检索、复制检测及图像/视频分割任务上全面超越基线（最高提升 +11.3%）；学习到的表征涌现出显式的图像语义内容信息，并可作为优秀的分类器；资源效率更高，例如 ViT-B 规模的 ViTAMINS 超越使用 ViT-L 的 V-JEPA。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，对比学习经过简单改造（引入合成困难负样本）即可成为生成式与自蒸馏方法之外更简单且资源高效的有力替代，为无监督视觉预训练范式的选择提供了新视角，并值得重新审视对比学习的潜力。

title: Towards a Reliable and Practical Eval Pipeline
summary: LLM-based software systems increasingly require effective "evals" as quality gates in the development lifecycle. However, existing work typically addresses individual aspects of eval reliability rather than the full set of practical requirements. We present an end-to-end eval pipeline that combines eval checklist creation, with learned aggregation for checklist responses, to improve agreement across LLM judges and accuracy against human judgments. The framework additionally pro- vides self-consistency, explanations, and prediction uncertainty, and we empirically demonstrate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出一个端到端的大语言模型评测（eval）流水线，结合评测清单创建与基于学习的聚合方法，提升多个LLM评判者之间的一致性以及与人类判断的准确率，并额外提供自一致性、解释和预测不确定性。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的软件系统在开发周期中越来越需要有效的评测作为质量门禁，但现有工作通常只解决评测可靠性的单个方面，而缺乏满足全部实际需求的完整方案。
AI.method: 构建端到端评测流水线：首先创建评测清单（eval checklist），然后对清单响应采用学习得到的聚合方法（learned aggregation），以提升LLM评判者间的共识并对齐人类判断；框架还内置自一致性、解释生成与预测不确定性估计。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架能有效提升多个LLM评判者之间的一致性，并提高与人类判断的准确率，同时成功提供自一致性、解释和预测不确定性等附加能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了现有评测可靠性研究仅关注单一环节的空白，提供了一个兼顾评判者一致性、人类对齐以及可解释/不确定性等实用需求的完整评测流水线方案。

title: When Does Online Adaptation Pay on the Edge? A Leakage-Free Evaluation of Warmup, Learning-Rate Selection, and Resource Trade-offs for Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Online adaptation can help edge time-series forecasting under distribution drift, but its measured benefit is sensitive to evaluation choices. We study six public multivariate streams, including building-sensor and smart-meter data, under a leakage-free streaming protocol. We identify two additional sources of comparison bias. First, the warmup budget of the static baseline has a two-sided effect: insufficient warmup undertrains the baseline, whereas excessive warmup can degrade its pre-drift generalization. Across six dataset-backbone settings, the estimated adaptation benefit changes by 3.0 to 18.8 percentage points (pp) over the 1,000-20,000-step warmup range. Second, comparing SGD with momentum (SGD+m) and Adam at a shared default learning rate conflates optimizer quality with rate sensitivity. We select both the warmup budget and each optimizer's online rate using a held-out pre-drift validation slice without accessing test data. Under this validation-only procedure, Adam outperforms SGD+m in 310 of 360 evaluated cells, while 4 Adam cells remain below the static baseline. We further characterize accuracy against adaptation-state memory and A100-measured per-update latency for full, head-only, and calibration-based adaptation. In the evaluated PatchTST frontier settings, several parameter-efficient variants are nondominated on the adaptation-state-memory axis. Smart-meter analyses also show that reported gains depend on meter-selection rules. These findings support a validation-only commissioning procedure, while target-device latency and energy remain to be measured. Code, data, and all reported numbers: https://github.com/keiotakmin/tsf-edge-adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究边缘时序预测中在线自适应收益的评估偏差问题，识别出两个新的比较偏差来源（静态基线热身预算的双向效应、共享学习率下优化器质量与速率敏感性的混淆），并提出一种基于留出验证切片（validation-only）的评估流程。在六个公共多元流数据和 PatchTST 前沿设置下，Adam 在 310/360 个单元中优于 SGD+m，多种参数高效变体在自适应状态内存维度上不被支配。
AI.motivation: 在线自适应有助于边缘时序预测应对分布漂移，但其测量收益对评估选择高度敏感。现有工作未能充分揭示评估协议中的偏差来源，导致对自适应方法真实收益的估计可能有偏，需要系统性辨识并消除这些比较偏差。
AI.method: 在无泄漏流式协议下评估六个公共多元流（建筑传感器、智能电表等）。识别两类比较偏差：(1) 静态基线热身预算的双向效应（不足则欠训练、过度则损害漂移前泛化）；(2) 共享默认学习率下 SGD+m 与 Adam 的比较混淆了优化器质量与速率敏感性。采用留出的漂移前验证切片（不使用测试数据）同时选择热身预算与各优化器在线学习率，并沿自适应状态内存与 A100 实测每更新延迟刻画全量、头only、基于校准的自适应变体。
AI.result: 在六个数据集-骨干组合中，估计的自适应收益在 1,000-20,000 步热身范围内变化 3.0 至 18.8 个百分点。验证-only 流程下 Adam 在 360 个评估单元中的 310 个优于 SGD+m，但仍有 4 个 Adam 单元低于静态基线。在 PatchTST 前沿设置下多个参数高效变体在自适应状态内存轴上不被支配；智能电表分析显示报告收益取决于电表选择规则。
AI.conclusion: 支持采用 validation-only 的调试（commissioning）流程来公平评估边缘自适应收益，并指出目标设备上的延迟与能耗仍待实测；代码、数据与全部报告数字已公开。

title: DualStake: Dual-Path Confidence Calibration in Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep Research agents tackle knowledge-intensive tasks through multi-round retrieval and decision-oriented generation. However, these agents suffer from severe overconfidence, making their expressed confidence unreliable for user trust and downstream abstention. To address this, we augment the Deep Research pipeline with step confidence elicitation after each retrieval, building on the commonly used post-answer verbalized confidence. Interestingly, we find that Evidence Confidence (E-Conf), elicited after the final retrieval step, provides a stronger uncertainty signal than Answer Confidence (A-Conf), elicited after answer generation, and that A-Conf is largely shaped by E-Conf. Based on these findings, we propose DualStake, a dual-path calibration method that applies margin-clipped, confidence-dependent stake rewards to jointly align E-Conf and A-Conf with answer correctness while limiting extreme confidence optimization. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Qwen3-4B across 8 QA benchmarks demonstrate that DualStake consistently improves calibration without sacrificing answer accuracy. The code is available at https://github.com/FloXXXt/DualStake.

AI.tldr: 针对Deep Research智能体在知识密集型任务中过度自信、置信度不可靠的问题，提出DualStake双路径校准方法：在检索后引出证据置信度(E-Conf)与答案置信度(A-Conf)，通过margin-clipped的置信度相关stake奖励联合校准两者与答案正确性，在8个QA基准上稳定提升校准效果且不损失答案准确性。
AI.motivation: Deep Research智能体通过多轮检索和决策生成处理知识密集型任务，但存在严重的过度自信问题，其表达的置信度对用户信任和下游弃权(abstention)决策不可靠，因此需要有效的置信度校准方法。
AI.method: 在Deep Research流程中，每次检索后引入步骤级置信度引出，并建立在常用的答案后口头置信度基础上。提出双路径校准方法DualStake：(1)在最终检索步骤后引出证据置信度(E-Conf)，在答案生成后引出答案置信度(A-Conf)；(2)应用margin-clipped、与置信度相关的stake奖励，联合对齐E-Conf和A-Conf与答案正确性，同时限制极端置信度的优化。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B上覆盖8个QA基准的实验表明，DualStake一致地改善了校准效果，且不牺牲答案准确性。关键发现是E-Conf(最终检索步骤后引出)比A-Conf(答案生成后引出)提供更强的不确定性信号，且A-Conf在很大程度上由E-Conf塑造。
AI.conclusion: 证据置信度(E-Conf)是比答案置信度(A-Conf)更强的不确定性信号，通过DualStake双路径校准方法可以可靠地联合对齐两者与答案正确性，在保持答案质量的同时实现稳健的置信度校准，为Deep Research智能体的用户信任和下行决策提供可靠基础。

title: Dyn-3D: Unveiling and Resolving Ego-Motion Ambiguity in Vision-Language Models
summary: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) tackle dynamic 3D spatial reasoning, ego-motion perception becomes essential to resolve monocular scale ambiguity. However, current models often overfit to smooth trajectory priors rather than genuinely understanding physical motion. Consequently, their spatial reasoning degrades severely under large displacements, a phenomenon we term Kinematic Collapse. This failure stems from spurious visual-motion correlations in natural videos and a lack of explicit physical supervision. To evaluate this, we introduce Dyn-3D, a benchmark using counterfactual 3D rendering to rigorously decouple visual changes from true kinematic properties. Furthermore, we propose the TempoVista framework, featuring the Kinematic-GSPO algorithm. By embedding metric physical ground truth into policy optimization, TempoVista explicitly grounds visual representations in 3D space. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves both motion estimation and robust spatial reasoning by utilizing camera dynamics as an effective geometric calibration signal.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在动态3D空间推理中过度拟合平滑轨迹先验、而非真正理解物理运动的问题，提出“运动学崩溃”（Kinematic Collapse）现象，并构建基于反事实3D渲染的Dyn-3D基准来评估该问题，同时提出TempoVista框架及其核心算法Kinematic-GSPO，通过将度量级物理真值嵌入策略优化，显式地将视觉表征锚定于3D空间，实验表明该方法显著提升运动估计与空间推理的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: VLM在动态3D空间推理中需要感知自运动（ego-motion）以解决单目尺度歧义，但现有模型常过拟合平滑轨迹先验而非真正理解物理运动，导致在大位移场景下空间推理严重退化（即运动学崩溃）。作者指出该失败源于自然视频中虚假的视觉-运动相关性以及缺乏显式的物理监督，因此需要更严格的基准与显式的物理约束来迫使模型学习真实的运动学。
AI.method: 1) 提出Dyn-3D基准：利用反事实3D渲染严格解耦视觉变化与真实运动学属性，从而诊断模型是否真正理解运动而非依赖捷径特征；2) 提出TempoVista框架，其核心是Kinematic-GSPO算法：将度量级物理真值（metric physical ground truth）嵌入策略优化过程，显式地将视觉表征锚定在3D空间中，利用相机动力学作为校准信号。
AI.result: 实验表明，TempoVista显著改善了运动估计精度与空间推理鲁棒性，相较于基线模型在大位移场景下性能明显提升，验证了将相机动力学作为有效几何校准信号的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了VLM空间推理中的运动学崩溃问题及其成因，表明仅靠数据层面的视觉-运动相关性不足以支撑稳健的3D推理；通过将度量物理真值注入策略优化，可让模型更真实地感知物理运动，为动态3D空间推理提供了新的评估基准与训练范式。

title: One Policy, Any Budget: Internalizing Budget-Aware Search via Reinforcement Learning
summary: While reinforcement learning has enabled LLM-based search agents to invoke external tools, existing methods train under fixed budgets and cannot adapt when constraints vary at deployment. We propose AnySearch, a framework that enables a single policy to perform budget-aware search under any budget constraint through a training scaffold and curriculum reinforcement learning. In the first phase, we train the agent with explicit budget state injection and structured reasoning prompts that guide efficient allocation under linearly decaying budgets. In the second phase, the scaffold is removed and the agent learns to operate autonomously under adaptively sampled budget constraints, matching inference conditions. Both phases are optimized with a composite reward that couples answer accuracy with budget efficiency through absolute and relative signals, where an adaptive weight amplifies the efficiency signal for high-accuracy queries and attenuates it for low-accuracy ones. Extensive experiments on seven general and multi-hop QA benchmarks show that our method outperforms baselines across all budget scales, generalizes to unseen constraints beyond the training range, and achieves superior tool productivity without excessive token overhead. Our code is available at https://github.com/xwsun01/AnySearch.

AI.tldr: AnySearch 提出一种框架，使基于 LLM 的搜索代理能够在任意预算约束下运行，通过两阶段训练（预算状态注入与课程强化学习）实现预算感知的搜索，在七个 QA 基准上优于所有基线，并能泛化到训练范围之外的未见约束。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的 LLM 搜索代理在固定预算下训练，部署时无法适应变化的外部工具调用约束。实际应用中预算约束往往动态变化，因此需要一种能适应任意预算约束的单一策略。
AI.method: 两阶段训练框架：第一阶段通过显式预算状态注入和结构化推理提示，在线性递减预算下训练代理进行高效资源分配；第二阶段移除训练脚手架，让代理在自适应采样的预算约束下自主运行，与推理条件匹配。两个阶段均使用复合奖励，将答案准确性与预算效率耦合（包含绝对与相对信号），并通过自适应权重根据查询准确性动态放大或衰减效率信号。
AI.result: 在七个通用及多跳问答基准上的大量实验表明，AnySearch 在所有预算尺度下均优于基线，能泛化到训练范围之外的未见约束，并在不过度增加 token 开销的情况下实现了更高的工具生产力。
AI.conclusion: 通过课程式强化学习与预算状态建模，可以训练单一策略适应任意预算约束，在保证答案准确性的同时提升工具利用效率，为预算敏感场景下的 LLM 搜索代理提供了可行方案。

title: Scaled Idempotence in Transformer Attention: Paired OV Geometry and Shared-Value Algebras
summary: We identify a recurrent algebraic regularity in Transformer attention: a sparse subset of effective OV operators $T=OV^\top$ nearly closes under composition, $T^2\approxαT$. Across six pretrained endpoints spanning 2.8B--235B parameters, 3.98--8.00% of heads reach squared closure alignment $\mathcal{P}\geq0.9$, while no matched within-layer O/V mismatch does. An exact principal-coordinate factorization, $T=Q_OKQ_V^\top$ and $T^2=Q_O(KDK)Q_V^\top$, separates within-support transport from read--write return geometry. Across all 7,304 heads in nine MHA/GQA models, scrambling only the orientation of $K$ while preserving singular values, norms, factor spans, and principal angles reduces median closure from 0.336 to $1.04\times10^{-4}$; trained orientation wins for 98.64% of heads and in every layer. Constructive searches show that high closure is feasible in every surveyed layer, but usually not attained. Retrospective trajectories in three independently trained lineages further separate broadly available capacity from the orientations attained by final strong heads. Under exact value sharing, headwise closure extends to a right-action algebra, $T_iT_j=α_jT_i$. Seven-model experiments verify the approximate law and reveal distinct oblique projections with a shared value-defined kernel. These results characterize scaled idempotence as a sparse trained orientation within broadly available geometric capacity and show how value sharing extends a headwise relation into a local operator algebra.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Transformer注意力中存在一种普遍的代数规律：有效的OV算子T=OV^⊤在稀疏的头子集上近似满足闭包性T²≈αT（尺度化幂等性）。跨多个预训练模型（2.8B–235B参数），少量头达到高闭合对齐，而匹配的层内O/V错配则没有。通过主坐标分解、仅打乱K方向等对照实验、构造性搜索和回溯轨迹，作者证明这种闭合是广泛可用的几何容量中的稀疏训练取向，而非必然结果；在精确价值共享下，该头级关系可推广为右作用代数T_iT_j=α_jT_i。
AI.motivation: Transformer注意力机制中OV（输出-价值）算子的代数结构尚未被系统刻画。理解有效算子T=OV^⊤在组合下的行为，有助于揭示注意力读-写返回几何、价值共享机制以及训练过程如何利用可用的几何容量，进而深化对预训练大模型内部可解释性与算子代数的认识。
AI.method: 主要方法包括：（1）在六个预训练端点（2.8B–235B参数，含MHA/GQA共9个模型、7,304个注意力头）上度量头级闭合对齐P=T²与αT的接近程度；（2）提出精确的主坐标分解T=Q_O K Q_V^⊤与T²=Q_O(KDK)Q_V^⊤，将支撑内传输与读写返回几何分离；（3）对照实验：仅打乱K的方向（保持奇异值、范数、因子张成与主角度不变）将中位闭合从0.336降至1.04×10⁻⁴；（4）构造性搜索检验各层高闭合的可行性；（5）三个独立训练谱系的回溯轨迹分析分离容量与最终取向；（6）在精确价值共享下推导右作用代数T_iT_j=α_jT_i并进行七模型验证。
AI.result: 在规模2.8B–235B的六个预训练端点中，3.98%–8.00%的头达到闭合对齐P≥0.9，而匹配的层内O/V错配无一达到；训练得到的K取向在98.64%的头和每一层中都优于随机取向（中位闭合0.336 vs 1.04×10⁻⁴）。构造性搜索显示高闭合在每一层都可行但通常未被实现；跨三个谱系的回溯轨迹进一步将广泛可用的容量与最终强头达到的取向分离。七模型实验验证了T_iT_j≈α_jT_i的近似规律，并揭示了具有共享值定义核的不同斜投影。
AI.conclusion: 尺度化幂等性（scaled idempotence）是预训练Transformer中一种稀疏出现的训练取向，它存在于广泛可用的几何容量之中，而非训练必然实现的默认属性；该头级闭合关系在价值共享条件下可自然扩展为局部算子代数，为理解注意力头的组合行为与价值共享几何提供了统一的代数框架。

title: A Dataset for Modeling Iterative Problem-Solving
summary: Solving problems through repeated attempts is a sequential modeling task: at each step, the solver receives feedback and decides how to revise their solutions. Predicting whether performance improves, plateaus, or regresses across attempts is central to understanding any iterative problem-solving process in both human learners and autonomous agents. Beyond outcomes, modeling what errors persist and how strategies shift across attempts provides deeper insight into the mechanics of sequential learning. Studying these dynamics requires observing many solvers as they attempt, receive feedback, and revise. Programming courses with automated grading provide this setting, as students iteratively submit code to test suites and receive feedback on every attempt. We therefore curate CodeInsight, a large-scale dataset of over 3 million submissions from 3,286 undergraduates across 2 introductory C++ courses in 2 academic years, with test-case-level outcomes, timestamps, and source code. On this dataset, we build a benchmark that evaluates models spanning parametric, sequential, and generative traditions under a shared calibration-and-scoring protocol, including a Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) adapted to track solver characteristics through discrete latent variables and an LLM-based predictor that generates explicit solutions. The adapted RSSM achieves the strongest predictive accuracy on three of the four courses. The LLM predictor is less accurate but produces full submissions at each attempt, enabling direct analysis of failure modes. We find that the model's coding proficiency is inversely related to predictive performance in this setting, with the LLM better understood as a generative solver conditioned on context rather than a faithful predictor of solver behavior. We publicly release our code and the dataset on request to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CodeInsight，一个包含两个学年、两门C++入门课程、3286名本科生超过300万次提交的大规模数据集（含测试用例级结果、时间戳和源代码），并在此基础上构建基准，采用统一的校准与评分协议评估参数化模型、序列模型和生成式模型，包括用离散隐变量跟踪求解者特征的循环状态空间模型（RSSM）和能生成完整提交的LLM预测器。
AI.motivation: 反复尝试求解问题是典型的序列建模任务：每一步求解者接收反馈并决定如何修改方案。预测性能在多次尝试中是提升、停滞还是退步，对于理解人类学习者和自主智能体中任何迭代式问题求解过程都至关重要。此外，建模错误如何持续存在、策略如何在尝试间转变，可提供对序列学习机制的更深洞察。编程课程中的自动评分系统天然提供了这种反复尝试、接收反馈并修改的动态场景。
AI.method: 作者从两门C++入门课程中收集超过300万次提交构建CodeInsight数据集，包含测试用例级结果、时间戳和源代码。在此数据集上建立基准，在统一的校准与评分协议下评估参数化、序列和生成三类传统模型，包括一个通过离散潜变量跟踪求解者特征的循环状态空间模型（RSSM），以及一个生成显式解法的LLM预测器。
AI.result: 改进后的RSSM在四个课程中的三个上取得了最强的预测准确率。LLM预测器准确率较低，但能在每次尝试时生成完整提交，从而支持对失败模式的直接分析。研究发现，模型的编码能力与预测性能在该设定下呈负相关：LLM更适合被理解为在上下文条件下工作的生成式求解器，而非求解者行为的忠实预测器。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了大规模、细粒度的编程迭代求解数据集与统一评估协议，表明序列潜变量模型在预测求解者行为上优于生成式LLM，并揭示生成能力与预测能力之间的张力。代码和数据集将公开提供，以促进后续研究。

title: IT-TextFusion: Iterative Text-Image Interaction with Text-Guided Residual Refinement for Degradation-Aware Image Fusion
summary: Text-guided image fusion has recently emerged as an effective paradigm for integrating multi-modal information while enabling flexible and task-oriented fusion control. However, existing text-guided fusion methods often rely on shallow semantic-visual interaction and limited attention mechanisms, which restrict their ability to robustly handle complex degradations and fully exploit textual guidance. In this paper, we propose an iterative text-guided image fusion framework that incorporates text-conditioned feature interaction across multiple fusion and refinement stages. The proposed method integrates deepest-level Cross-Attention, multi-scale Cross-Gate Fusion, and stage-specific text-conditioned modulation, allowing the global text embedding to condition hierarchical feature fusion and residual refinement. By repeatedly injecting the pooled text embedding across hierarchical decoder and refinement stages, the proposed framework provides degradation-aware global semantic conditioning while preserving complementary information from the visible and infrared modalities. Experiments on several benchmark datasets show that the proposed method improves several information-preservation and perceptual-quality metrics, while exhibiting metric-dependent trade-offs on some datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种迭代式文本引导图像融合框架，通过最深层交叉注意力、多尺度交叉门控融合和阶段特定文本条件调制，让全局文本嵌入与从粗到精的解码器及残差细化阶段反复交互，从而在可见光与红外图像融合中兼顾全局语义引导与互补信息保留，在多个基准数据集上提升了信息保留和感知质量指标。
AI.motivation: 文本引导图像融合已成为集成多模态信息并实现灵活、面向任务的融合控制的有效范式，但现有方法依赖浅层的语义-视觉交互和有限的注意力机制，难以稳健处理复杂退化并充分挖掘文本引导的潜力。因此需要更深入的语义-视觉交互机制来提升融合质量。
AI.method: 提出迭代式文本引导图像融合框架，将文本条件特征交互贯穿多个融合与细化阶段。核心设计包括：最深层交叉注意力（deepest-level Cross-Attention）、多尺度交叉门控融合（multi-scale Cross-Gate Fusion）以及阶段特定的文本条件调制（stage-specific text-conditioned modulation）。通过在多层级解码器与细化阶段反复注入池化的文本嵌入，使全局文本嵌入能够对层级化特征融合与残差细化进行条件约束，实现退化感知的全局语义条件化，同时保留可见光与红外模态的互补信息。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在多项信息保留指标与感知质量指标上均有提升，但在部分数据集上表现出随指标而变的权衡（即某些指标改善、另一些指标存在折中）。
AI.conclusion: 反复注入池化文本嵌入的多阶段框架能够提供退化感知的全局语义条件化，在提升信息保留与感知质量的同时保持可见光与红外模态的互补信息，为文本引导图像融合提供了更稳健的解决方案；不过其性能在不同指标与数据集上存在一定权衡，值得进一步研究。

title: AnalysisBank: An Expert Analysis Pattern Library for Financial Report Generation
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (main conference, long paper)
summary: We argue that financial report generation should operate at the analytical rather than structural level, composing content from data-derived insights rather than high-level topics or sections. To this end, we propose AnalysisBank, which distills expert reports into a reusable library of Analyses, each pairing a data signal, an analytical move, and the expert span it was derived from. At inference time, AnalysisBank matches input signals to library entries and applies the retrieved moves to compose the report. A study of Analyses distilled from 550 expert reports reveals a heavy-tailed distribution of 47-52 signal types spanning 13 move types. On two financial benchmarks across four LLM backbones, AnalysisBank increases the proportion of novel, data-grounded insights by 1.7-3.7x over structural-level baselines. Transfer to scientific writing suggests that the distinction generalizes beyond finance. Code and the distilled Analysis library are available at https://github.com/yajingyang/AnalysisBank.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnalysisBank，主张财务报告生成应在分析层面而非结构层面运作，通过从专家报告中提炼可复用的"分析单元"（数据信号+分析动作+专家原文片段）库，在推理时匹配输入信号并应用检索到的动作来生成报告，相比结构级基线将新颖且基于数据的洞察比例提升1.7-3.7倍。
AI.motivation: 现有财务报告生成方法工作在结构层面（基于高层主题或章节组织内容），作者认为这不够充分，报告生成应基于数据派生出的洞察在分析层面进行内容组织，以获得更具数据支撑和原创性的分析。
AI.method: 提出AnalysisBank框架：从专家报告中提炼可复用的"分析"库（每个分析单元将数据信号、分析动作和来源专家文本片段配对）；推理时匹配输入信号到库条目，并应用检索到的分析动作来撰写报告；在四个LLM骨干上于两个财务基准进行评测，并迁移至科学写作验证泛化性。
AI.result: 从550份专家报告提炼的研究显示，信号类型呈重尾分布（47-52种信号类型、13种动作类型）；在四个LLM骨干上，AnalysisBank相比结构级基线将新颖且数据依据充分的内容比例提升1.7-3.7倍；迁移到科学写作表明该区分具有超越金融领域的普适性。
AI.conclusion: 分析层面优先于结构层面的生成范式能显著提升内容的新颖性与数据依据性，且该方法可泛化到其他写作领域，验证了"分析级生成"这一区分的通用价值。

title: Superposed Latent Autoencoder
summary: Autoencoders typically meet tight latent-memory budgets by making each latent representation smaller, sacrificing representational capacity. We ask a different question: can multiple wider latents be stored together instead? We introduce the Superposed Latent Autoencoder (SLAE), which preserves high-capacity latent representations while sharing storage through learned superposition. SLAE transforms latents into storage-friendly codes, binds them with randomized keys, superposes multiple codes into a single memory tensor, and learns to recover each latent before decoding. Under the same storage budget, SLAE replaces irreversible dimensional bottlenecks with structured interference that can be suppressed. Across CIFAR-10/100, SVHN, STL-10, Tiny ImageNet, and a wide range of memory budgets, SLAE substantially improves the reconstruction--memory tradeoff, reducing reconstruction error by up to 56% over conventional autoencoders at matched storage. Further analysis shows that SLAE's advantage comes from making wider representations usable under the same storage budget. These gains also extend beyond reconstruction: the information preserved by SLAE improves downstream classification by up to 16.79 percentage points under the same memory budget. Our results suggest a new principle for representation compression: instead of making every latent smaller, keep representations wide and let them share memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出超位置潜变量自编码器（SLAE），颠覆传统自编码器通过压缩每个潜变量来适应存储预算的做法，改为保持潜变量高容量、通过学习到的叠加机制让多个宽潜变量共享存储，在同等存储预算下显著改善重构-存储权衡并提升下游分类性能。
AI.motivation: 传统自编码器在紧凑的潜记忆预算约束下，通常通过缩小每个潜变量表示来节省存储，但这样会牺牲表示容量。作者提出一个不同的问题：能否将多个更宽的潜变量一起存储？即用结构化干扰替代不可逆的维度瓶颈，从而在相同存储预算下保留更多信息。
AI.method: SLAE包含四条核心路径：将潜变量转换为存储友好的编码；用随机化键（随机 keys）绑定这些编码；将多个编码叠加成一个单一的记忆张量；学习从叠加张量中恢复出每个潜变量，然后再进行解码。整个过程通过端到端学习实现，使叠加产生的干扰可被抑制而非像维度压缩那样造成不可逆信息损失。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100、SVHN、STL-10、Tiny ImageNet以及多种存储预算下，SLAE在相同存储条件下能将重构误差最多降低56%；进一步分析表明其优势源于使更宽的表示在相同存储预算下变得可用；此外在下游分类任务中，同等存储预算下准确率最多提升16.79个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出表示压缩的新原则：不要把所有潜变量都缩小，而应保持表示宽度并让其共享记忆。SLAE用学习到的叠加机制将不可逆的维度瓶颈替换为可抑制的结构化干扰，验证了“宽表示+共享存储”在重构与下游任务上的双重有效性。

title: Calibration is the Bottleneck: An Action-Class Diagnostic of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/fbj2333/tool-calling-calibration
summary: Multi-turn tool calling is a core evaluation scenario for large language model (LLM) agents. On public tool-calling benchmarks, open-weight models now approach or even surpass closed-source frontier models in aggregate accuracy. However, this metric averages over many different multi-turn situations and obscures whether progress is balanced across them. We propose an action-class-oriented diagnostic framework that decomposes multi-turn failures into two orthogonal modes: action-class miscalibration and action-execution failure. The framework operates over a four-class action space (TOOL_CALL/ASK/REFUSE/CONFIRM) and introduces a self-revealing upper bound Acc <= GAR (Gold Action Recall); the two modes show up as bound violation (Acc > GAR, exposing state-grader masking of miscalibration) and large bound slack (GAR >> Acc, localizing execution failure within TOOL_CALL). We validate it on a panel of tool-calling models across multiple multi-turn benchmarks. Across our panel, the diagnostic reveals action-class miscalibration as a substantial failure mode the state grader cannot see. This gap inflates standing for heavily tool-trained families, which our diagnostic separates from families with context-appropriate action choice. Calibration is reshapable through context-only perturbations, but the reshape is heterogeneous: a single perturbation moves accuracy in opposite directions across families (up to +11.5 vs -21.0 pp on the same scenario), and its effect further depends on the perturbation mechanism. We argue that multi-turn tool-calling evaluations should supplement aggregate accuracy with action-class diagnostics that expose what the model actually does in each scenario.

AI.tldr: 针对多轮工具调用评测中聚合准确率掩盖模型实际行为的问题，本文提出基于动作类（TOOL_CALL/ASK/REFUSE/CONFIRM）的诊断框架，将失败分解为动作类校准失误与动作执行失败两种正交模式，并借助自揭示上界 Acc ≤ GAR（Gold Action Recall）区分两者，从而揭示出状态评分器无法察觉的动作类校准偏差及其对模型排名的影响。
AI.motivation: 在公开工具调用基准上，开源模型的聚合准确率已接近甚至超越闭源前沿模型，但该指标是对多种多轮场景的平均，掩盖了不同场景下进步是否均衡。聚合准确率无法暴露模型在每类场景中的真实行为，尤其会掩盖动作类选择层面的系统性失误。
AI.method: 提出动作类导向的诊断框架，将多轮失败分解为两个正交模式：动作类校准失误（action-class miscalibration）与动作执行失败（action-execution failure）。框架在四类动作空间（TOOL_CALL/ASK/REFUSE/CONFIRM）上运行，引入自揭示上界 Acc ≤ GAR（Gold Action Recall），以上界违反（Acc>GAR，暴露状态评分器对校准失误的掩盖）和大上界松弛（GAR>>Acc，定位 TOOL_CALL 内的执行失败）来区分两种模式；并在多基准模型面板上进行了验证。
AI.result: 诊断显示动作类校准失误是状态评分器无法察觉的重要失败模式，该差距抬高了重度工具训练模型家族的表观成绩，而诊断可将其与动作选择契合上下文的模型家族区分开。校准可通过仅上下文的扰动重塑，但重塑是异质的：同一扰动在同一场景下对不同家族产生相反方向的准确率变化（最高 +11.5 与 -21.0 个百分点），且效果还依赖扰动机制。
AI.conclusion: 多轮工具调用评测应在聚合准确率之外补充动作类诊断，以揭示模型在每个场景中的实际行为；聚合指标不足以反映模型在各类多轮情境下的真实能力与校准状况。

title: P-PatchDiff: Progressive Patch Diffusion Models for Low-light Image Enhancement
summary: Recent advancements in low-light image enhancement have leveraged diffusion models for their strong ability to generate perceptually realistic, detailed images. Patch diffusion models further offer a promising solution to size-agnostic image restoration while improving efficiency. However, existing methods typically rely on small, fixed patches (e.g., 64$\times$64) that cannot capture image-level brightness context, whereas enlarging the receptive field improves brightness and colour estimation but substantially increases computational cost. Moreover, low-light images often exhibit uneven brightness across regions, making it necessary to ensure that locally enhanced patches remain visually coherent when combined into the full image. To address these limitations, we propose P-PatchDiff, a scalable progressive patch diffusion framework for low-light image enhancement that dynamically adjusts patch size throughout the denoising process, enabling a gradual shift from local to global views. A Multi-Patch Alignment strategy is also introduced to normalise features across varying patch scales using an estimated global brightness proxy. Rather than pursuing pixel-level reconstruction accuracy, P-PatchDiff focuses on scalability and coherent brightness across the whole image, allowing the model to perceive multi-scale information and better enhance regions with varying brightness. We empirically demonstrate that P-PatchDiff effectively enhances images ranging from 400 $\times$ 600 to 4K and is 80$\times$ faster than existing patch diffusion models while using less than 9GB of memory. The code is available at https://github.com/RuoyuGuo/P-PatchDiff.

AI.tldr: 本文提出P-PatchDiff，一个可扩展的渐进式补丁扩散框架，用于低光照图像增强。它通过在去噪过程中动态调整补丁大小，实现从局部到全局的渐进视图转换，并引入多补丁对齐策略以保持亮度一致性。该框架支持从400×600到4K分辨率的图像，比现有补丁扩散模型快80倍，且内存占用低于9GB。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的低光照图像增强方法存在以下局限：固定的小补丁（如64×64）无法捕获图像级亮度上下文，而扩大感受野虽能改善亮度与颜色估计但计算成本大幅增加；同时低光图像不同区域亮度不均，局部增强的补丁在拼接为完整图像时需要保持视觉连贯性。
AI.method: 提出P-PatchDiff可扩展渐进式补丁扩散框架，核心机制为在去噪过程中动态调整补丁尺寸，实现从局部视图到全局视图的渐进过渡；并引入多补丁对齐（Multi-Patch Alignment）策略，利用估计的全局亮度代理来归一化不同补丁尺度下的特征。
AI.result: 实验表明P-PatchDiff能有效增强从400×600到4K分辨率的图像，比现有补丁扩散模型快80倍，内存占用低于9GB，能感知多尺度信息并更好地增强亮度不均匀的区域。
AI.conclusion: P-PatchDiff不追求像素级重建精度，而是聚焦于可扩展性和整幅图像的亮度一致性，为低光照图像增强提供了一种兼顾效率、内存开销与跨尺度感知能力的有效解决方案。

title: Polished but Unresolved: Identifying Late-Stage Pressure States in Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
comment: Accepted in the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Long-horizon tool-use agents need not only to search and plan, but also to decide when to finalize. We study late-stage pressure states, in which an agent is biased toward submitting a final answer that appears complete and polished while key constraints remain unresolved. We first train a linear probe to show that this pressure state is identifiable from the agent's hidden states. Then, we use activation interventions along this pressure direction and find that shifting the hidden states changes both the pressure score and whether the agent continues tool use or submits early. Through controlled context manipulations, we further see that the pressure is mitigated by constraint clarity and action mapping. Based on these findings, we propose Probe-Sensed Pressure Relief (PSPR), a plugin that applies lightweight pressure relief direction under moderate pressure and moves to structured organization under high pressure risk. Experiments on multiple long-horizon benchmarks show that our method consistently strengthens existing agent methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长时程工具使用智能体在"晚期压力状态"下的过早提交问题，通过线性探针从隐藏状态中识别该状态，利用激活干预验证其因果作用，并基于受控环境操作发现约束清晰度与动作映射可缓解压力，进而提出即插即用的PSPR插件（中度压力下施加轻量压力缓解方向，高风险时转为结构化组织），在多个长时程基准上稳定增强现有智能体方法。
AI.motivation: 长时程工具使用智能体不仅要进行搜索和规划，还需决定何时终止并提交最终答案。在晚期阶段，智能体容易受到"压力状态"影响，倾向于提交看似完整实则关键约束未解决的答案，导致过早提交和失败。作者希望识别、理解并缓解这一压力状态。
AI.method: 首先训练线性探针证明压力状态可从智能体隐藏状态中识别；然后沿该压力方向进行激活干预，验证其能同时改变压力分数及智能体继续工具使用或提前提交的行为；再通过受控上下文操纵发现约束清晰度与动作映射可缓解压力；基于以上发现提出Probe-Sensed Pressure Relief (PSPR)插件，在中等压力下施加轻量压力缓解方向，在高风险下转为结构化组织。
AI.result: 在多个长时程基准上进行实验，PSPR方法能一致地增强现有智能体方法的性能，表明其具有通用性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 压力状态是长时程工具使用智能体过早提交的重要可识别因素，且可被激活干预调节；PSPR作为轻量即插即用插件，通过压力感知的干预策略有效缓解该问题，为增强长时程智能体可靠性提供了新途径。

title: CopyShield: A Cross-Level Benchmark of Copyright Defenses in LLMs
summary: Large language models can reproduce memorized text verbatim, yet copyright defenses are usually evaluated under incompatible protocols. We introduce CopyShield, a controlled benchmark comparing three representative defenses at distinct intervention levels: contrastive decoding (output), Direct Preference Optimization (behavioral), and activation intervention (representation). We evaluate CopyShield on two model families, LLaMA-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B-v0.3, using controlled memorization over five public-domain books and a shared protocol measuring literal leakage, calibrated non-literal leakage, utility, and degeneracy. Across these methods, intervention level is associated with distinct compliance-utility trade-offs. On LLaMA-3.1-8B, contrastive decoding remains near-degeneracy-free (0-2%) but reaches a literal-suppression floor at NV-Recall 0.192-0.203. DPO nearly eliminates literal leakage (0.263 to 0.002) but induces paraphrase-loop degeneracy in 58% of QA outputs, with no utility gain over the SFT baseline. Activation intervention attains the lowest non-literal flagging rate (1/200) by blocking 84% of non-literal queries before generation. Human evaluation confirms that DPO has low coherence, whereas activation lowers perceived copyright risk through broad refusal. On Mistral-7B-v0.3, the output- and representation-level patterns persist, while DPO degeneracy falls to 10-14%, showing that its severity is model-dependent. Together, CopyShield provides cross-level reference baselines and identifies targeted non-literal suppression as an open challenge. The code is available at https://github.com/spotai-mbzuai/CopyShield.git.

AI.tldr: CopyShield 是一个用于评估大语言模型版权防御方法的受控基准，它在三种干预层面（输出端对比解码、行为端 DPO、表示端激活干预）上，以统一协议比较了 LLaMA-3.1-8B 和 Mistral-7B-v0.3 上的字面泄漏、校准后的非字面泄漏、实用性与退化度，揭示不同干预层面存在不同的合规-实用性权衡。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可能逐字再现训练中记忆的受版权保护文本，但现有版权防御的评估通常采用互不兼容的协议，缺乏可在统一标准下跨干预层面进行公平比较的基准。
AI.method: 提出 CopyShield，一个受控基准，选用三种代表性防御方法（对比解码-输出层、直接偏好优化-行为层、激活干预-表示层），在 5 本公有领域书籍上构建受控记忆场景，并采用共享协议测量字面泄漏（NV-Recall）、校准后的非字面泄漏、实用性和退化度，辅以人工评估；在两个模型家族（LLaMA-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.3）上验证。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 上：对比解码几乎无退化（0-2%）但存在字面抑制下限（NV-Recall 0.192-0.203）；DPO 几乎消除字面泄漏（0.263→0.002）但在 58% 的 QA 输出中引发释义循环退化且无实用性增益；激活干预通过阻断 84% 的非字面查询达到最低非字面标记率（1/200）。人工评估确认 DPO 连贯性低、激活干预通过广泛拒答降低版权风险。在 Mistral-7B-v0.3 上，输出层与表示层模式保持，DPO 退化降至 10-14%，表明其严重性依赖模型。
AI.conclusion: CopyShield 提供了跨干预层面的参考基线，指出输出层防御存在字面抑制上限、行为层防御以退化换取合规、表示层防御以广泛拒答换取安全；同时将针对性的非字面抑制识别为待解决的开放挑战。

title: PersianAnonymizer: Evaluating LLM-Labeled Training for Efficient NER-based Anonymization in Persian
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Published at LREC 2026
summary: We target practical anonymization of Persian customer chats by training a compact NER model from LLM-labeled supervision and selecting the best labeler for deployment. We compare three instruction-tuned LLMs: DeepSeek-V3-0324, GPT-OSS-120B, and Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507, to produce span annotations under a shared JSON protocol, yielding four corpora (OSS_ZeroShot, Qwen_ZeroShot, Qwen_FewShot, DeepSeek_FewShot). A MatinaRoberta-based token-classifier is trained per corpus and evaluated with token-level Precision/Recall/F1 (overall and per-class). We also report Label Coverage Recall (LCR), the proportion of gold non-O tokens predicted as non-O, and quantify cross-labeler behavior via a token-level Venn on test annotations. Finally, we contrast test-set annotation latency of the LLMs on H200 nodes with the trained NER's test-time labeling on a single RTX 3090. Results show that supervision from OSS_ZeroShot yields the strongest macro-F1 and LCR, while the resulting NER labels an entire 40K-message test set in approximately 2 minutes on one consumer GPU. This establishes a practical path to high-quality, low-cost anonymization for Persian industrial data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一条面向波斯语客服聊天记录的实际匿名化路径：以指令微调大语言模型（DeepSeek-V3-0324、GPT-OSS-120B、Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507）在统一 JSON 协议下生成跨度标注，构建四个训练语料，并分别训练基于 MatinaRoberta 的紧凑型 NER 模型。结果显示，由 OSS_ZeroShot 语料提供的监督信号取得了最强的宏平均 F1 与标签覆盖率召回率（LCR），且训练所得 NER 在单张消费级 RTX 3090 上仅用约 2 分钟即可完成 4 万条消息的测试集标注，为波斯语工业数据的高质量、低成本匿名化提供了可行方案。
AI.motivation: 波斯语客户聊天数据包含大量个人敏感信息，需要匿名化处理；而纯 LLM 推理标注在工业级大规模部署中成本高、延迟大。因此作者希望获得一种既保持高质量标注效果、又具备低延迟与低成本（消费级 GPU 即可运行）的实际匿名化方案，探索以 LLM 标注结果作为弱监督来源训练紧凑 NER 模型的可替代路径。
AI.method: （1）在统一 JSON 协议下，让三个指令微调 LLM（DeepSeek-V3-0324、GPT-OSS-120B、Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507）以零样本/少样本方式生成跨度标注，得到四个语料：OSS_ZeroShot、Qwen_ZeroShot、Qwen_FewShot、DeepSeek_FewShot；（2）针对每个语料分别训练基于 MatinaRoberta 的 token 级分类器；（3）以 token 级 Precision/Recall/F1（总体与按类别）评估，并引入标签覆盖率召回率（LCR，衡量金标准非 O token 被预测为非 O 的比例）以及基于 token 级 Venn 图量化不同标注器之间的行为差异；（4）对比 LLM 在 H200 节点上的测试集标注延迟与训练后 NER 在单张 RTX 3090 上的测试阶段标注效率。
AI.result: 实验表明，来自 OSS_ZeroShot 语料的监督信号训练出的 NER 取得最强宏平均 F1 与最高的 LCR；该 NER 在单张消费级 GPU（RTX 3090）上约 2 分钟即可完成 4 万条消息的测试集合标注，性能上与 H200 上的 LLM 标注相比具备明显效率优势，确立了高质量、低成本的波斯语工业数据匿名化路径。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了借助 LLM 生成的伪标签训练紧凑 NER 模型用于波斯语聊天匿名化的实用性：它能在保持较高标注质量（宏 F1、LCR 最优来自 OSS_ZeroShot）的同时，将延迟与硬件成本大幅降低到消费级 GPU 水平，为工业场景下的隐私保护数据脱敏提供了可落地的方案。后续可进一步扩展更多标注协议、模型与类别体系以提升泛化性。

title: Different Changes Require Different Reasoning: Change-Type-Specialized Experts for Robust Change Captioning
summary: Change captioning is the task of generating natural language descriptions that explain the changes between a pair of images. Although different change types (e.g., color shifts, object additions) exhibit distinct visual cues and require specialized reasoning processes, existing methods often overlook these distinctions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Expert Diagnosis for Image Change (MEDIC), a novel framework that introduces change-type awareness by explicitly modeling change categories. MEDIC employs type-specialized memory experts that dynamically retrieve type-relevant visual patterns conditioned on the input. This design enables each expert to capture diverse variations within its change type while focusing on the most informative visual cues. By softly routing inputs across type-specialized experts and learning dedicated representations for each change category, MEDIC generates more precise and type-aware change descriptions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed MEDIC consistently outperforms existing methods across diverse and challenging datasets. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/MEDIC}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: MEDIC提出了一种新颖的图像变化描述（change captioning）框架，通过显式建模变化类别并引入类型专用记忆专家来动态检索与输入相关的视觉模式，从而生成更精确、类型感知的变化描述，并在多个数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图像变化描述方法通常忽略不同类型变化（如颜色变化、物体新增）之间的差异，而这些类型具有不同的视觉线索并需要专门的推理过程。作者希望解决这一局限，引入变化类别感知能力。
AI.method: 提出Multi-Expert Diagnosis for Image Change (MEDIC)框架：显式建模变化类别；采用类型专用记忆专家（type-specialized memory experts），根据输入动态检索类型相关的视觉模式；通过软路由机制（softly routing）将输入分配到不同类型的专家，并为每个变化类别学习专门的特征表示。
AI.result: 每个专家能够捕获其变化类型内的多样变化，同时聚焦最具信息量的视觉线索；广泛的实验表明MEDIC在多样且具有挑战性的数据集上持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: MEDIC通过引入变化类别建模与类型专用专家路由机制，有效提升了变化描述生成的精确性和类型感知能力，验证了显式区分变化类型的价值，并已开源代码。

title: FLaG: Frequency-Domain Latent-attention Gated Pooling for Token Aggregation
summary: Token aggregation converts token-level representations into fixed-dimensional sample representations, but most pooling methods operate only in the original token space. We introduce Frequency-Domain Latent-attention Gated Pooling (FLaG), a plug-in aggregation module that re-expresses encoder outputs in the Fourier domain before final pooling. FLaG represents the nonredundant rFFT spectrum through concatenated real and imaginary components, summarizes spectral tokens with learnable latent queries, derives a sample-conditioned channel gate, and reconstructs modulated token representations for downstream aggregation. We evaluate the same architecture across ESM2-based antimicrobial peptide (AMP) activity prediction, ResNet18 image classification on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, and three RoBERTa-based language tasks. FLaG achieves the best macro-averaged Spearman correlation coefficient, RMSE, and Recall@50 across four AMP backbone-species settings and the highest top-1 accuracy on CIFAR 10. It also achieves the best mean results on five of seven language metrics, although mean pooling remains strongest on STSBenchmark. AMP-side mechanistic analyses reveal low-frequency prediction sensitivity across most encoder layers, with increased relative high-frequency sensitivity in the final layer, and pronounced peptide-specific positional responses. The residual gate broadly amplifies spectral channels while preserving the low-frequency-dominated energy profile, whereas latent cross-attention exhibits sample- and species-specific spectral allocation. Overall, FLaG provides a transferable frequency-domain aggregation bias across protein, visual, and textual representations, with benefits that depend on the backbone and downstream task. Supplementary materials, source code, and data are available at https://www.healthinformaticslab.org/supp/ and https://github.com/Kewei2023/AMPCliff/tree/FLaG.

AI.tldr: 提出一种即插即用的频域池化模块 FLaG：将编码器输出变换到傅里叶域，用学习型潜在查询汇总频谱 token 并生成样本条件通道门控，再重建 token 表示用于下游聚合；在蛋白质（AMP 活性）、图像（CIFAR-10/100）和文本（RoBERTa）三类任务上验证了其迁移性与有效性。
AI.motivation: Token 聚合（池化）方法多数只在原始 token 空间操作，未能利用编码器输出中可能存在的频域结构信息；作者希望引入一种可迁移的频域聚合偏置，以提升下游任务中的固定维度样本表示质量。
AI.method: FLaG 在最终池化前将编码器输出变换到傅里叶域：用非冗余 rFFT 频谱的实部与虚部拼接表示频谱 token；以可学习的潜在查询对频谱 token 做汇总；推导样本条件通道门控；再将调制后的 token 表示重建用于下游聚合，作为可插入已有编码器的插件模块。
AI.result: 在 ESM2 的 AMP 活性预测（四个骨干-物种设置）中取得最佳宏平均 Spearman 相关系数、RMSE 和 Recall@50；在 CIFAR-10 上取得最高 top-1 准确率；在七个语言指标中的五个取得最佳均值（STSBenchmark 上均值池化仍最强）。机制分析显示：多数编码器层对低频敏感、末层高频相对敏感度上升、存在肽特异性的位置响应；残差门控整体放大频谱通道并保持低频主导的能量分布，而潜在交叉注意力呈现样本与物种特异性的频谱分配。
AI.conclusion: FLaG 提供了一种跨蛋白质、视觉与文本表示的频域聚合偏置，其收益依赖于所选骨干网络与下游任务；整体上是一种通用、可迁移且可解释的池化改进方案，并已公开补充材料、源码与数据。

title: Pre-carved Niches: The Formation Dynamics of Modular Task Partitions in Early LLM Training
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Step-by-step training-dynamics study of modular task partitions in a from-scratch Pythia-410M model
summary: Large language models exhibit a modular internal organization that mirrors well-studied functional networks of the human brain, but how this organization forms during training is unknown: prior work has characterized finished models, not the formation process. We track formation step by step: we train a Pythia-410M model from scratch (two trajectories, bf16 and fp32) and run attribution patching at every step, alongside probes for gradient norms, effective updates, weight norms, and first-order loss decomposition across 14 tasks in four cognitive domains. Three findings. First, the modular map is pre-carved: before any learning, the dominant task pair already overlaps at ~3.6x the attribution substrate (a task-independent baseline), and its layer-0 concentration is an architecture-level constant on this model family. Second, the partition locks in through two sharp jumps whose amplitudes do not track the learning-rate schedule (the second reaching 20.4 sigma quiet-window / 6.2 sigma global), accompanied by gradient-level relative deprivation--winners receive 2.25->2.73x the loser's gradient supply, 9.5-11.5 standard deviations below a random control--that does not propagate to updates or weights. Third, deviation from the substrate appears only in the domain being learned, consistent with the hypothesis that modularity tracks learning. We close by separating the feature-level account we can defend from the mechanistic questions we cannot, and we pre-register the scale-threshold hypothesis behind our ongoing 2.8B experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文首次逐训练步骤追踪了大语言模型模块化内部组织的形成过程：从头训练Pythia-410M（bf16与fp32两条轨迹），在每一步执行归因修补，并结合梯度范数、有效更新、权重范数及一阶损失分解，在四个认知领域的14个任务上考察。主要发现三点：(1) 模块化图谱在训练前已"预刻"——初始时主导任务对的重叠度即达基线约3.6倍，其第0层集中度是该模型族上的架构级常数；(2) 任务划分通过两次陡峭跳变锁定，幅度不随学习率调度变化（第二次达20.4σ安静窗口/6.2σ全局），伴随梯度层面的"相对剥夺"（胜者梯度供给为败者2.25→2.73倍，偏离随机对照9.5-11.5σ），但不传导至更新与权重；(3) 与基底的偏离仅出现在正在学习的领域，支持"模块化随学习追踪"的假说。作者最后区分了可辩护的特征级解释与无法回答的机制性问题，并为正在进行的2.8B实验预先注册了尺度阈值假说。
AI.motivation: 虽然已知大语言模型内部具有镜像人脑功能网络的模块化组织，但该组织如何在训练过程中形成仍是空白——此前工作只刻画了训练完成的模型，未研究形成过程。作者旨在逐步骤打开这一"黑箱"，从特征层面说明模块化组织何时、如何出现，并区分可辩护结论与尚无法回答的机制问题。
AI.method: 从零训练Pythia-410M（bf16和fp32两条轨迹），在每个训练步骤运行归因修补（attribution patching），并配套测量梯度范数、有效更新、权重范数和一阶损失分解；在四个认知领域的14项任务上进行系统分析，以任务无关基线衡量归因底物（attribution substrate）重叠度，并统计跳变显著性及梯度供给差异。
AI.result: (1) 模块化图谱在训练前已预刻：初始时主导任务对的重叠度即达基线3.6倍，第0层集中度为架构级常数；(2) 任务划分经两次陡峭跳变锁定，第二次达20.4σ（安静窗口）/6.2σ（全局）显著性，且与学习率调度无关；同时存在梯度级相对剥夺（胜者梯度为败者2.25→2.73倍，低于随机对照9.5-11.5σ），但不影响更新与权重；(3) 与基底的偏离仅在正在学习的领域出现，支持模块化追踪学习的假说。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型的模块化组织并非在训练中"新生成"，而是在架构层面预先存在"图谱"，训练通过少数几次骤变将其锁定，且与学习过程动态耦合（仅学习领域偏离基底）。作者明确区分了可辩护的特征级结论与机制上的未解疑问，并为2.8B规模实验预注册了尺度阈值假说，指向"模块化源于架构预置、由学习激活"的研究方向。

title: Disclosure-Gated User Simulation for Companion-Agent Evaluation
summary: Using a large language model to play the user is now standard in scalable evaluation. It has a repeatedly diagnosed failure: the simulated user is excessively cooperative, so a system under test can score by the sheer number of questions it asks rather than by making the user willing to speak. We answer with a disclosure gate conditioning information release on the companion agent's behaviour: its state is a ladder of five ordered gates, merged onto three observable depth layers. We specify, ablate, and audit it, and train a user simulator against that specification. Gating behaviour is learned from the training corpus's synthetic branch, while the real branch supplies how people speak and react; after training, the simulator need not be told at runtime which gate each item sits behind. The gate is a load-bearing component of the environment: on the English corpus of a published companion-agent benchmark (CompanionBench), once training no longer states per example which gate each item sits behind, the largest rank displacement across 12 systems under test exceeds the noise band set by re-running that environment under a new seed, while per-system scores show no detectable change. We state two acceptance criteria: a ranking must be order-preserving, and absolute scores must be scale-stable. Of the candidates we examine, only one passes both -- the simulator we release -- and its leaderboard correlates at 0.993 with the benchmark's original simulator. By contrast, prompting a frontier model as the simulator barely moves the ranking while shifting every score upward -- a shift invisible to anyone checking the ranking alone. The environment we specify is the one that benchmark already used. That publication describes the mechanism in about four hundred words, and we supply what it lacked: specification, ablations, human studies, negative controls, and downstream sensitivity analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM用户模拟器过度配合、使被测系统靠提问数量而非用户真实参与意愿得分的已知缺陷，提出了“信息披露门控”（disclosure gate）机制，将信息释放条件化为对同伴智能体行为的五级有序门、合并为三个可观测深度层，并据此规范、消融、审计并训练了一个用户模拟器。在CompanionBench英文语料上，门控是环境中承担关键作用的组件；提出的两条验收标准（排名保序、绝对分数尺度稳定）中，仅作者发布的模拟器同时通过，其排行榜与原模拟器相关度达0.993，而提示前沿模型充当模拟器虽几乎不改排名却整体抬高分数。该文补充了原基准仅用约四百字描述机制所缺失的规范、消融、人工研究、阴性对照与下游敏感性分析。
AI.motivation: 可扩展评估中常用大语言模型扮演用户，但其反复被诊断出的失败是：模拟用户过度配合，导致被测系统仅凭提问数量即可得分，而非通过让用户愿意继续交谈来得分。作者希望明确指定信息释放的条件化规则，使评估能真实反映系统引发用户持续交流的能力，并给出可复现、可审计的规范。
AI.method: 提出披露门控机制：同伴智能体状态为五个有序门构成的阶梯，合并映射为三个可观测深度层；作者对门控进行规范、消融与审计，并依据该规范训练用户模拟器。门控行为由训练语料的合成分支学习而来，真实分支则提供人们如何说话与反应的样式；训练后模拟器在运行时无需被告知每条信息位于哪个门。评估采用两条验收标准：排名必须保序，绝对分数必须尺度稳定。
AI.result: 在CompanionBench英文语料上，一旦训练不再按示例指定每条信息所在的门，12个被测系统中最大排名位移超过了更换随机种子重跑该环境所得的噪声带，而各系统绝对分数无可检测变化，说明门控是环境的关键组件。在被考察的候选中仅有一个同时通过两条验收标准——即作者发布的模拟器，其排行榜与原基准模拟器相关度为0.993；相反，提示前沿模型充当模拟器时排名几乎不动但每个分数整体上移，仅检查排名的评估者无法发现此偏移。
AI.conclusion: 作者所规范的环境正是原基准已在使用的那一个，原文献仅以约四百字描述其机制；本文补足了其缺失的规范、消融、人工研究、阴性对照与下游敏感性分析，证明将披露门控明确化与规范化可使排行榜评估既保序又尺度稳定，从而修复过度配合带来的虚假高分问题。

title: Revisiting Face Recognition for Monozygotic Twins: The Celeb Twins Test Set
summary: Past literature on face recognition for monozygotic (("identical") twins points to facial marks and mirror asymmetry as possible directions for improved accuracy of twins recognition. The Celeb Twins Test Set (CTTS) contains web-scraped image pairs for 80 sets of celebrity twins. It is the only twins test set with meta-data for twins with distinguishing skin marks and possible mirror asymmetry. CTTS is organized in the manner of face verification test sets such as LFW, CALFW, CPLFW, CFP-FP, and AgeDB-30. Current deep CNN matchers can achieve over 76% accuracy in classifying CTTS same-person / different-person image pairs. We show that current matchers do not make use of skin marks, or asymmetry, and discuss reasons for this. Finally, we discuss the feasibility of using generative AI tools such as Grok, ChatGPT and Gemini to create images of imagined monozygotic twins as a means to increase representation of twins in face recognition training sets.

AI.tldr: 本文围绕同卵双胞胎人脸识别难题，介绍了名为CTTS（Celeb Twins Test Set）的评测数据集，涵盖80对名人双胞胎及其皮肤标记、镜像不对称等元数据。实验表明当前深度CNN匹配器在CTTS上的准确率可超过76%，但并未真正利用皮肤标记或镜像不对称特征。文章最后探讨了利用Grok、ChatGPT、Gemini等生成式AI工具合成虚构双胞胎图像以扩充训练集的可行性。
AI.motivation: 同卵双胞胎共享完全相同或高度相似的基因与外貌，使人脸识别系统难以区分；已有研究指出皮肤标记（facial marks）和镜像不对称可能是提升双胞胎识别精度的潜在线索。但现有公开测试集中缺乏带此类元数据的数据，也缺少针对双胞胎验证场景的专门评测基准，因此亟需构建相关测试集并探究当前模型是否真正利用了这些线索。
AI.method: 1) 构建CTTS测试集：从网络抓取80对名人双胞胎的图像对，并整理为与LFW、CALFW、CPLFW、CFP-FP、AgeDB-30一致的人脸验证（same-person/different-person）评测格式；该数据集的独特性在于标注了可用于区分双胞胎的皮肤标记及可能的镜像不对称元数据。2) 使用当前深度CNN匹配器在CTTS上进行同人/异人图像对分类评测。3) 分析模型是否实际使用皮肤标记或镜像不对称特征并探讨原因。4) 讨论利用生成式AI工具（Grok、ChatGPT、Gemini）生成虚构同卵双胞胎图像来扩充训练数据的可行性。
AI.result: 当前深度CNN匹配器在CTTS同人/异人图像对分类任务上可取得超过76%的准确率；但分析表明现有匹配器并未利用皮肤标记或镜像不对称信息，作者对其中原因进行了讨论；生成式AI合成双胞胎图像的方案被提出并讨论了其可行性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管CTTS提供了带皮肤标记与镜像不对称元数据的双胞胎测试集且CNN匹配器能达到76%以上的准确率，但模型并未利用这些判别线索，暴露出当前方法在双胞胎识别上的局限。生成式AI有望用于扩充双胞胎训练数据以提升表示与泛化能力，但可行性仍需进一步验证。

title: Towards Generalizable Visually Grounded Exploration of Household Devices
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in static visual recognition and high-level semantic reasoning. However, current embodied exploration paradigms still heavily rely on imitation learning from human-annotated trajectories, which severely limits agents' generalization ability. The key bottleneck of realizing general autonomous embodied agents lies in Generalizable Visually Grounded Exploration: the ability to operate novel devices without manuals or specific training by actively grounding abstract world knowledge into fine-grained visual affordances. Yet, existing benchmarks fail to evaluate this capability: they generally rely on explicit documents and annotated trajectories, neglecting the dynamic Hypothesis-Interaction-Refinement process essential for functional device operation. To bridge this gap, we introduce VGEBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the generalizable visually grounded exploration capabilities of VLMs. Unlike static datasets, we construct a Logic-Driven State Machine framework. This framework simulates multi-turn interaction loops, compelling agents to achieve goals by active visual perception and feedback-driven correction. Experimental results demonstrate that existing VLMs face significant challenges in translating semantic knowledge into physical execution and maintaining long-horizon state tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VGEBench，一个用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在泛化性视觉接地探索（Generalizable Visually Grounded Exploration）能力的综合基准。该基准采用逻辑驱动状态机框架模拟多轮交互循环，迫使智能体通过主动视觉感知和反馈驱动的纠错来达成目标，而非依赖人工标注轨迹或静态文档。
AI.motivation: 现有具身探索范式过度依赖人类标注轨迹的模仿学习，严重限制智能体的泛化能力；而现有基准依赖显式文档和标注轨迹，忽略了功能性设备操作中关键的"假设-交互-修正"动态过程，无法评估智能体在无手册、无专门训练条件下主动将抽象世界知识落地为细粒度视觉可供性的能力。
AI.method: 构建逻辑驱动状态机（Logic-Driven State Machine）框架，模拟多轮交互循环，要求智能体通过主动视觉感知与反馈驱动的纠错实现目标；该框架作为动态评测环境，区别于静态数据集，能够系统测试 VLM 在长期状态跟踪和知识-执行转换上的表现。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，现有 VLM 在将语义知识转化为物理执行步骤以及维持长时程状态跟踪方面面临显著挑战，暴露出其在泛化性视觉接地探索能力上的明显不足。
AI.conclusion: VGEBench 填补了现有基准在评估动态假设-交互-修正过程方面的空白，揭示了 VLM 从静态识别走向通用自主具身智能体的关键瓶颈，为未来研究提供了新的评测工具与方向。

title: Births are difficult to predict even with rich survey and full-population register data
summary: Major life events have proven difficult to predict. Does this reflect limits of theory, data, and algorithms, or the large role of chance? We examine one outcome - having a child within three years - through a near-ideal setting for prediction: a data challenge where 147 researchers predicted births for Dutch residents aged 18-45, using survey data and full-population registers. Methods ranged from logistic regression to a large language model and transformers. Predictions were moderately accurate (best F1: register 0.59, survey 0.76); advanced models did not outperform classical ones; and the larger registers did not beat the survey. Simulating the stochastic biology of conception and pregnancy, we estimated a predictive ceiling (survey F1 ~ 0.86-0.94, register 0.88-0.96). Observed performance falls short of this ceiling, implicating imperfect data, methods, and unmodelled chance, while the ceiling itself shows that chance in reproduction alone sets a non-trivial limit on predicting individual lives.

AI.tldr: 通过一项包含147名研究者的数据挑战，对荷兰18-45岁居民三年内生育子女这一结果进行预测，发现预测精度中等（最优F1：注册数据0.59，调查数据0.76），先进模型并未优于经典模型，更大规模的注册数据也未优于调查数据；通过模拟受孕与妊娠的随机生物学过程估算出预测上限（调查F1约0.86-0.94，注册数据约0.88-0.96），实际表现低于该上限，表明数据与方法的不完善以及未建模的随机性共同限制了预测，且生育中的随机性本身对个体人生预测构成了不可忽视的边界。
AI.motivation: 重大生活事件长期以来难以预测，作者希望弄清这种困难究竟是源于理论、数据和算法的局限，还是由于随机性本身所扮演的重要角色，从而以生育这一结果为例，在一个近乎理想的预测环境中系统考察。
AI.method: 举办数据挑战赛，邀请147名研究者利用调查数据和全人口注册数据预测荷兰18-45岁居民三年内生育子女的情况；预测方法涵盖从逻辑回归到大语言模型和Transformer等各类模型；同时通过模拟受孕和妊娠的随机生物学过程，估算预测精度的理论上限，并与实际结果进行比较。
AI.result: 预测精度为中等水平（最优F1：注册数据0.59，调查数据0.76）；复杂先进模型并未优于经典模型，更大的注册数据也并未优于调查数据；模拟估算的预测上限为调查数据F1约0.86-0.94、注册数据约0.88-0.96，实际表现低于该上限。
AI.conclusion: 观测到的预测表现未达到预测上限，说明不完善的数据与方法以及未建模的随机性共同导致了差距；同时预测上限本身表明，仅生育过程中的随机性就已经对个体人生轨迹的预测设置了不可忽略的极限。

title: Inspicio: Open-Vocabulary, LLM-Based Sense Retrieval for Historical Languages
summary: Word Sense Disambiguation has advanced rapidly for English and a handful of well-resourced modern languages, but it continues to assume the existence of a sense inventory and a word-to-sense mapping in the source language (Navigli, 2026). These assumptions break down for most historical and low-resource languages, whose dedicated WordNets are either incomplete or still under construction. We present Inspicio, an open-vocabulary retrieval pipeline that links tokens in context to synsets of the Open English WordNet (McCrae et al., 2020) without requiring any source-language inventory or mapping. For each occurrence, an instruction-tuned LLM produces two English translations of the surrounding sentence, a small set of candidate dictionary-style definitions, and a few candidate English lemmas. These outputs drive a hybrid retrieval step that combines dense definition-synset similarity, sparse lemma matching, and Maximal Marginal Relevance re-ranking. We evaluate the pipeline across a 6x6 grid of LLMs and sentence-embedding models on a new bilingual set of manually annotated Latin and Ancient Greek perception verbs, on a subset of PREMOVE dataset (Farina, 2025), and on a diachronic sample of Italian. The best configuration reaches 96% Recall@50 on the perception-verb test set, with each component contributing measurable gains, and remains competitive in the out-of-domain and cross-lingual settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Inspicio，一个面向历史语言和低资源语言的开放词汇检索式词义消歧流水线，无需源语言义类清单或词-义映射，通过指令微调 LLM 生成翻译、候选定义和候选词元，再结合稠密检索、稀疏匹配与 MMR 重排序，将上下文中的词元链接到 Open English WordNet 的 synset，最优配置在拉丁语和古希腊语感知动词测试集上取得 96% 的 Recall@50。
AI.motivation: 词义消歧（WSD）在英语及少数资源丰富的现代语言中进展迅速，但其前提是源语言中存在义类清单（sense inventory）和词到义的映射。这一假设在大多数历史语言和低资源语言中不成立，因为这些语言的专用 WordNet 要么不完整，要么仍在建设中，导致传统 WSD 方法无法直接应用。
AI.method: 提出 Inspicio 开放词汇检索流水线：对每个词元出现位置，先由指令微调的大语言模型（LLM）生成周围句子的两个英文翻译、一小组合适的词典式定义以及若干候选英文词元；随后进入混合检索阶段，综合稠密定义-义类（synset）相似度、稀疏词元匹配以及最大边际相关（Maximal Marginal Relevance）重排序，将上下文中的词元链接到 Open English WordNet 的 synset，全程无需任何源语言词表或映射。
AI.result: 在 6×6 的 LLM 与句向量模型组合网格上，使用新构建的拉丁语和古希腊语感知动词双语人工标注集、PREMOVE 数据子集以及意大利语历时样本进行评测。最佳配置在感知动词测试集上达到 96% 的 Recall@50，各组件均带来可测量的增益，且在域外和跨语言设置下仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Inspicio 验证了不依赖源语言义类清单的开放词汇 WSD 方法在历史语言与低资源语言上的有效性，混合检索各组件的贡献均可量化，整体性能在域外与跨语言场景下保持稳健，为缺少 WordNet 资源的语言提供了一条可行路径。

title: StainPresetNet: Stain Preset Network for Fast Multi-to-Multi Stain Normalization
summary: Stain normalization reduces color variations caused by variations in staining protocols and imaging conditions, thereby enhancing computer-aided diagnostic system performance. Traditional methods derive mapping relationships from individual or limited reference images through pixel-wise transformation, offering style flexibility but suffering from inaccurate color mapping extraction. While existing deep-learning-based approaches achieve accurate dataset-wide color mapping through complex neural networks, they face challenges including computational inefficiency, artifact generation, and fixed normalization directions requiring model retraining for directional changes. To address these limitations, we propose StainPresetNet - a novel framework that combines structural preservation with dataset-level color mapping while maintaining computational efficiency. Our method implements pixel-wise normalization guided by preset reference images, enabling multi-directional adaptability without retraining. Evaluations on cytopathology and histopathology datasets demonstrate that StainPresetNet achieves superior color mapping accuracy compared to conventional methods, effectively improves classifier generalization in diagnostic tasks, and reduces computational overhead by 90\% versus existing deep learning approaches. The proposed preset-guided mechanism facilitates flexible adjustment of normalization directions through simple reference image replacement, overcoming the directional rigidity of current deep-learning-based solutions.

AI.tldr: StainPresetNet是一个结合结构保持与数据集级颜色映射的染色归一化框架，通过预设参考图像引导的逐像素归一化实现多方向适应，无需重新训练，并在准确率、泛化性和计算效率（开销降低90%）上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统方法基于单张或有限参考图像进行逐像素变换，虽具备风格灵活性，但颜色映射提取不准确；现有深度学习方法虽能实现数据集级准确映射，却存在计算效率低、产生伪影以及归一化方向固定、方向变化需重新训练模型等问题。
AI.method: 提出StainPresetNet框架，将结构保持与数据集级颜色映射相结合，并保持计算效率；采用预设参考图像引导的逐像素归一化，通过简单替换参考图像即可灵活调整归一化方向，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在细胞病理学和组织病理学数据集上的评估表明，StainPresetNet在颜色映射准确性上优于传统方法，有效提升分类器在诊断任务中的泛化能力，相比现有深度学习方法将计算开销降低90%。
AI.conclusion: 预设引导机制通过简单更换参考图像即可灵活调整归一化方向，克服了现有深度学习解决方案的方向刚性缺陷，为染色归一化提供了一种高效、准确且多方向可适应的解决方案。

title: Verifiable Disaster Storylines and Causal Knowledge Graphs: A Citation-Grounded Pipeline from Heterogeneous Humanitarian Sources
summary: Effective humanitarian response depends on the rapid synthesis of heterogeneous, high-volume information sources - a task that routinely exceeds human analytical capacity in the critical early hours of a crisis. We present a pipeline that combines structured disaster records from EM-DAT with unstructured documents from ReliefWeb and the European Media Monitor (EMM) to produce source-grounded disaster storylines and causal knowledge graphs supporting situational awareness for responders and analysts. Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation, the pipeline extracts structured storylines - tabular event profiles covering 17 fields, from severity and key drivers to child-sensitive impact indicators - and constructs causal knowledge graphs where each node and edge is enriched with citation-grounded explanatory narratives, enabling full traceability back to primary sources. We evaluate the system on three diverse crisis use cases through a human evaluation involving 9 domain expert and 9 non-expert evaluators. Results confirm high retrieval precision, strong faithfulness of extracted causal relations, and a clear expert preference for citation-grounded components over ungrounded alternatives. The pipeline is designed to scale to the full EM-DAT catalogue, with the goal of publicly releasing a narrative-enriched version of the database.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个将结构化灾害数据（EM-DAT）与非结构化文档（ReliefWeb与欧洲媒体监测EMM）相结合的流水线，利用检索增强生成（RAG）自动提取17字段的结构化事件画像（storylines）并构建带引文溯源、可解释叙述的因果知识图谱，以支持人道主义响应的态势感知。在三个危机案例上通过9名领域专家与9名非专家的人工评估证实了高检索精度、强因果抽取忠实性，且专家明显偏好带引文溯源组件。该流水线可扩展至完整EM-DAT目录，目标公开发布叙事增强版数据库。
AI.motivation: 有效的人道主义响应依赖于对异构、高容量信息源的快速综合，而这一任务在危机发生后的关键数小时内往往超出人类分析能力，因此需要自动化方法来支撑应急响应人员与分析师的态势感知。
AI.method: 构建一条流水线：将EM-DAT结构化灾害记录与ReliefWeb和欧洲媒体监测（EMM）的非结构化文档结合；采用检索增强生成（RAG）抽取覆盖17个字段的结构化事件画像（严重程度、关键驱动因素、儿童敏感影响指标等），并构建因果知识图谱；图谱中的每个节点和边均附有基于引文来源的解释性叙述，实现对原始来源的完全可追溯。
AI.result: 基于三个多样化危机用例，由9名领域专家和9名非专家评估者进行人工评估。结果显示高检索精度、抽取因果关系的高忠实度，以及专家对带引文溯源组件相比无溯源替代方案的明确偏好。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线设计为可扩展至完整EM-DAT目录，目标是公开发布一个叙事增强版数据库，从而提升人道主义响应的信息综合能力。

title: Recent Developments in Transformer Inference Deployment on FPGA Platforms: A Survey
summary: With the rapid and continuous growth in the incorporation of machine learning models based on the Transformer architecture, capable deployment is in high demand. In this context, capable deployment refers to operational performance aspects, e.g., throughput and latency, as well as efficiency aspects, e.g., energy consumption. When it comes to the task of inference using such models, purpose-built hardware accelerators provide a lucrative alternative to common deployment choices, such as Central Processing Units (CPUs) and Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). The Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) platforms category is an example of such alternative accelerators, promising implementation flexibility, energy efficiency, improved latency and suitability for on-site deployment. We investigate the most recent advances, trends, and design choices for Transformer inference on FPGA platforms. We perform a systematic literature review, extracting and delving into preferred techniques for implementation and optimisation. This study and the provided taxonomy of topics could act as a guide for researchers from the academia and industry alike.

AI.tldr: 本文对基于Transformer架构的机器学习模型在FPGA平台上的推理部署进行了系统性文献综述，梳理了最新的进展、趋势与设计选择，重点关注吞吐量、延迟等运行性能以及能耗等效率指标，并提出了可用于指导学术界与工业界研究者的主题分类法。
AI.motivation: 随着基于Transformer架构的机器学习模型快速增长并被广泛采用，其高效部署需求日益迫切。高效的部署既要考虑吞吐量和延迟等运行性能，也要考虑能耗等效率指标。在推理任务中，专用硬件加速器（如FPGA平台）相比CPU和GPU更具吸引力，因其具备实现灵活性、能效、更低延迟以及适合现场部署等优势。因此需要系统性地梳理FPGA上Transformer推理的最新研究进展与设计选择。
AI.method: 作者采用系统性文献综述（Systematic Literature Review）的方法，检索并深入分析FPGA平台上Transformer推理的最新技术进展、趋势与设计选择，提取实现与优化方面的偏好技术，并在此基础上构建了一个涉及相关主题的分类法（taxonomy）。
AI.result: 研究识别并归纳了FPGA平台上Transformer推理的实现与优化技术偏好、最新进展和设计趋势，形成了一套主题分类法，可为学术界与工业界研究者提供参考指南。
AI.conclusion: 该综述表明FPGA是Transformer推理部署的可行且具吸引力的替代方案，所提供的分类法有助于研究人员快速把握该领域的关键技术与研究方向，指导后续研究与实践。

title: Right Frame, Wrong Rule: Cultural Cues Expose the Financial Knowledge Gap They Were Meant to Close
summary: When a question has valid answers under different normative frameworks, a language model must decide which framework to use and whether it can answer correctly within it. We call this setting normative pluralism and study it in Islamic finance using a four-choice taxonomy that separates framework selection from within-framework correctness. This separation reveals the stereotype trap: a cultural cue steers a model toward one framework, but the model selects an incorrect answer within that framework. Across twelve models, two languages, and fifty demographic signals, cultural cues change framework selection and reveal substantial differences in accuracy, especially among non-frontier models. Under the strongest signal, large open-weight models select the Islamic framework 97% of the time. A two-choice evaluation would report near-perfect alignment, although 57--66% of those selections are incorrect. These findings motivate, but do not directly test, the competence-conditioned routing hypothesis: models may favor frameworks where they are more accurate, while cultural cues may expose framework-specific competence gaps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"规范多元主义"（normative pluralism）这一研究设置，聚焦语言模型在多个有效规范性框架下如何选择框架及在框架内作答。作者以伊斯兰金融为案例，采用四选分类法将"框架选择"与"框架内正确性"分离，揭示出"刻板印象陷阱"：文化线索引导模型选择某一框架，但模型在该框架内却给出错误答案。跨12个模型、2种语言、50个人口统计线索的实验表明，文化线索显著改变框架选择，并暴露出尤其体现在非前沿模型上的准确性差异。
AI.motivation: 当一个提问在不同规范性框架下都存在有效答案时，语言模型必须决定采用哪个框架，并判断自己能否在该框架内正确作答。现有评估（尤其是二选分类法）无法区分"框架选择"与"框架内正确性"，从而会高估模型的对齐程度（例如将模型偏好伊斯兰框架误报为近乎完美的对齐），因此需要新的分类法来度量这一双重任务。
AI.method: 以伊斯兰金融为测试领域，设计四选分类法来分离两个维度：框架选择（是否选择伊斯兰框架）与框架内正确性（在所选择框架内答案是否正确）。对12个模型、2种语言、50个人口统计线索（文化线索）进行系统性评测，并据此考察"能力条件化路由假设"（models may favor frameworks where they are more accurate）。
AI.result: 文化线索会系统性改变模型的框架选择，且不同模型间准确性差异显著，特别是在非前沿模型中。在最强的线索条件下，大型开放权重模型有97%的概率选择伊斯兰框架；若用二选分类法评估会显示近乎完美的对齐，但其中57%–66%的选择实际是错误的，暴露出显著的框架内能力缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了文化线索可能暴露模型在不同规范性框架下的特定能力差距，并提出了"能力条件化路由"假设（模型可能偏向其更擅长的框架）。不过该假设仅被动机性地提出，文中并未直接检验。该工作为评估多规范性框架下的语言模型行为提供了更细致的度量框架，也提示单纯依据框架选择来判定文化对齐具有误导性。

title: On the Design Fundamentals of Pixel Text Representation Learning
summary: Text-rich visual inputs require models that can read, retrieve, and compress language directly in pixel space, yet existing pixel-text encoders struggle with fixed resolution pretraining, visual shortcut learning, weak visual grounding, and multilingual visual text understanding. In this work, we investigate the fundamental design principles required for robust visual text representation learning. Through systematic controlled ablations, we identify four critical components: variable image resolutions and rendered font sizes provide spatial proxies for high-resolution document generalization; natural image-text pairs are indispensable for grounding and prevent text-only collapse; layout-aware rendering helps prevent pixel-level shortcuts; and a two-stage multilingual curriculum enables effective cross-lingual alignment. By integrating these principles into a scalable training recipe, we train Pixel Linguist II, a native-resolution vision encoder trained with on-the-fly rendering, unified contrastive grounding, and a multilingual curriculum over 280M training examples. Pixel Linguist II sets new state-of-the-art results on English, cross-lingual, and multilingual Visual STS and ViDoRe, while also enabling better MLLM downstream evaluation. Notably, Pixel Linguist II remains robust under 80\% visual token compression, showing great promise for optical context compression. Our code and resources are available at https://github.com/Pixel-Linguist/Pixel-Linguist-II.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统消融实验，识别出鲁棒视觉文本表征学习的四项关键设计原则（可变分辨率与渲染字号、自然图文对、布局感知渲染、两阶段多语言课程），并将其整合为可扩展训练方案，训练出原生分辨率视觉编码器 Pixel Linguist II。该模型在英文、跨语言及多语言 Visual STS 和 ViDoRe 基准上刷新 SOTA，并在 MLLM 下游评测中表现更优，且在 80% 视觉 token 压缩下依然鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 富文本视觉输入需要模型直接在像素空间中读取、检索和压缩语言，但现有像素文本编码器存在固定分辨率预训练、视觉捷径学习、视觉定位薄弱以及多语言视觉文本理解不足等关键缺陷，亟需探究鲁棒视觉文本表征学习的基本设计原则。
AI.method: 通过受控消融实验识别四项关键组件：(1) 可变图像分辨率与渲染字号，为高分辨率文档泛化提供空间代理；(2) 自然图像-文本对，用于定位并防止仅文本坍缩；(3) 布局感知渲染，防止像素级捷径；(4) 两阶段多语言课程，实现有效的跨语言对齐。将这些原则整合为可扩展训练方案，以即时渲染、统一对比定位和多语言课程在 280M 训练样本上训练原生分辨率视觉编码器 Pixel Linguist II。
AI.result: Pixel Linguist II 在英文、跨语言和多语言 Visual STS 及 ViDoRe 基准上取得新 SOTA 结果，并在 MLLM 下游评测中表现更佳；在 80% 视觉 token 压缩下仍保持鲁棒性，显示出光学上下文压缩的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 变分辨率/字号、自然图文对、布局感知渲染与多语言课程是构建鲁棒视觉文本编码器的核心原则；Pixel Linguist II 验证了该训练范式的有效性，为像素空间中的文本理解与高压缩率光学上下文压缩提供了可行方案，代码与资源已开源。

title: Reinforcement Learning Enhanced LLM Agents for Complex Vehicle Routing Problems
summary: Vehicle Routing Problems (VRPs) are fundamental combinatorial optimization problems with widespread applications in various scenarios. The advanced optimization solvers can effectively solve such problems. However, modeling complex VRP variants for solvers often requires substantial domain expertise, which limits the accessibility of advanced optimization technologies. In this paper, we propose Reinforcement Learning Enhanced LLMAgents(RLEA), a multi-agent framework designed to automate the modeling of complex VRPs. RLEA introduces a lightweight neural Planner trained with Soft Q-learning to efficiently orchestrate the actions of LLM-based agents. In addition, we equip the system with an evolutionary memory module and retrieval-augmented generation, enabling the agent to leverage both accumulated experience and external solver knowledge during program generation and refinement for solving VRPs. We evaluated 48 distinct VRP variants across various solvers. The experimental results demonstrate that RLEA outperforms the previous state-of-the-ar method, achieving a 16.67% higher success rate while significantly reducing runtime errors. These results validate that integrating reinforcement learning with LLM-based reasoning is highly effective for automated optimization modeling. The appendix is available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19134435.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLEA（强化学习增强的LLM智能体），一个多智能体框架，通过轻量级神经规划器（Soft Q-learning训练）编排LLM智能体的行动，并配备进化记忆模块与检索增强生成，自动为求解器建模复杂的车辆路径问题（VRP），在48种VRP变体上以16.67%更低的成功率提升超越了之前的最佳方法。
AI.motivation: 车辆路径问题（VRP）是重要的组合优化问题，高级求解器能有效解决，但为求解器建模复杂VRP变体需要大量领域专业知识，这限制了先进优化技术的可及性，因此需要自动化建模方法。
AI.method: 提出多智能体框架RLEA：1）引入一个使用Soft Q-learning训练的轻量级神经规划器，高效编排基于LLM的智能体的行动；2）配备进化记忆模块与检索增强生成（RAG），使智能体在程序生成与精化过程中利用积累的经验和外部求解器知识。
AI.result: 在48种不同的VRP变体及多种求解器上进行评估，RLEA相比先前最先进方法将成功率提高了16.67%，同时显著减少了运行时错误。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了将强化学习与基于LLM的推理相结合对自动化优化建模非常有效，即通过强化学习调度LLM智能体能够显著提升复杂优化问题建模的自动化程度与成功率。

title: REFACTOR-VLA: Unsupervised Library Learning of Typed Motor Programs
summary: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models -- OpenVLA, $π_0$, RT-2, RDT-1B -- are monolithic: they emit raw motor commands or short action chunks without organizing behavior into reusable abstractions, so they degrade on long-horizon tasks and resist interpretation. Existing skill-discovery methods sidestep the core question of when two action sequences are behaviorally equivalent, either clustering contrastive embeddings or delegating the judgment to a language model uncalibrated to the robot's dynamics. We introduce REFACTOR-VLA, a wake/sleep system for learning reusable skills. Its sleep phase clusters motor-program fragments under a Behavioral-Equivalence Kernel (BEK) computed from rollouts of a learned latent world model $M_φ$; its wake phase emits typed lambda terms over a Hindley--Milner-inspired vocabulary, consumed by a library-conditioned rectified-flow action decoder. Abstractions are admitted only if they pass Minimum Description Length and return-preservation gates. On LIBERO we report two findings. First, enlarging the world model from 188M to 430M parameters worsened performance on 4 of 4 suites, so capacity alone does not help. Second, the training objective matters far more: adding an auxiliary supervised contrastive (InfoNCE) loss during world-model warmup substantially improves sleep-phase clustering, giving Normalized Mutual Information at $n=3$ seeds of $0.462 \pm 0.021$ (object), $0.867 \pm 0.025$ (spatial), $0.915 \pm 0.013$ (goal) and $0.754 \pm 0.010$ (LIBERO-10), and beating the strongest published baseline on all 4 suites by a mean $Δ= +0.184$. Across providers ($n=12$) the 95% bootstrap confidence interval for mean pairwise NMI is $[0.683, 0.729]$ (mean $0.705$). The sleep phase also yields the first real-LIBERO task-language library: the decoder uses 2 of 3 admitted abstractions and rewrites all 256 sampled demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出 REFACTOR-VLA，一个基于觉醒/睡眠（wake/sleep）范式的可复用技能学习系统：睡眠阶段借助行为等价核（BEK）和潜世界模型对运动程序片段进行聚类，觉醒阶段将抽象编码为带类型的 lambda 项并交由库条件化整流流动作解码器使用，抽象需通过最小描述长度与返回保持两道门控。在 LIBERO 上发现：增大世界模型容量（188M→430M）反而使 4/4 套件性能下降，而训练目标（引入 InfoNCE 辅助对比损失）才是关键，显著提升了聚类质量，并以平均 Δ=+0.184 超越所有最强基线；系统还产出了首个真实 LIBERO 任务语言库。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型（OpenVLA、π0、RT-2、RDT-1B）都是单体式的：直接输出原始电机指令或短动作块，不把行为组织成可复用抽象，导致长程任务性能退化且难以解释。已有技能发现方法回避了“两个动作序列何时行为等价”这一核心问题，要么对对比嵌入做聚类，要么把判断交给与机器人动力学未校准的语言模型，缺乏行为层面的可信依据。
AI.method: REFACTOR-VLA 包含两个阶段：（1）睡眠阶段：利用学习到的潜世界模型 M_φ 的 rollouts 计算行为等价核（BEK），并据此对运动程序片段进行聚类以形成技能库；（2）觉醒阶段：在 Hindley–Milner 启发的词表上生成带类型的 lambda 项作为抽象，由库条件化的整流流（rectified-flow）动作解码器消费；抽象只有在通过最小描述长度（MDL）与返回保持（return-preservation）门控后才被接纳。此外，在世界模型预热阶段加入辅助监督对比（InfoNCE）损失以改善睡眠阶段聚类。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 上得到两个发现：其一，将世界模型从 188M 扩到 430M 参数在 4/4 套件上均使性能变差，说明单纯增加容量无效；其二，训练目标远比容量重要——加入 InfoNCE 辅助损失后，睡眠阶段聚类质量大幅提升（n=3 种子）：NMI 分别为 object 0.462±0.021、spatial 0.867±0.025、goal 0.915±0.013、LIBERO-10 0.754±0.010，在全部 4 套件上以平均 Δ=+0.184 超越最强已发表基线；跨提供者（n=12）NMI 均值 0.705，95% 自助法置信区间 [0.683, 0.729]。睡眠阶段还产出首个真实 LIBERO 任务语言库：解码器使用了 3 个已接纳抽象中的 2 个，并重写了全部 256 条采样演示。
AI.conclusion: 可复用技能的质量取决于行为等价的判别与训练目标，而非单纯堆叠模型容量；以行为等价核和带门控的抽象接纳为基础、辅以 InfoNCE 对比损失，可在真实 LIBERO 上获得高质量技能聚类并生成首个任务语言库，为长程、可解释的 VLA 行为组织提供了可行范式。

title: Phrase-Localized Language-Contrastive Guidance: Training-Free Localized Accent Control for Code-Switching Text-to-Speech
summary: Current speech synthesis struggles with code-switching, which mixes a foreign language phrase into a primary language utterance, causing the phrase to be spoken with the primary language's accent rather than its native one. We propose Phrase-Localized Language-Contrastive Guidance (LCG), a training-free inference framework that restores a native accent to code-switched phrases in cross-lingual text-to-speech. LCG replaces the single language guidance applied across the whole utterance with a separate guidance for each region, so each part is guided by its own language. To choose where to apply this localized guidance, we propose a self-attention probing technique that finds the phrase boundaries without external alignments. Together, these components generate speech in which each region carries the accent of its own language, requiring no fine-tuning or auxiliary models. Across diverse language pairs, LCG robustly increases the nativeness of the code-switched phrase while suppressing accent leakage, and preserving overall speaker identity and naturalness.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为"短语局部语言对比引导"(LCG)的无训练推理框架，通过为每个区域分别施加其所属语言的引导，并利用自注意力探测技术定位语码转换短语边界，从而在不微调、不引入辅助模型的情况下恢复跨语言语音合成中代码转换短语的母语口音。
AI.motivation: 现有语音合成在语码转换场景中表现不佳：当外语短语混入主要语言的语句时，该短语往往带有主要语言的口音而非其母语口音，破坏了自然度与地道性。
AI.method: LCG将原本作用于整句的单一语言引导替换为针对每个区域（region）的独立引导，使每个部分受其自身语言引导；同时提出自注意力探测技术，无需外部对齐即可定位代码转换短语的边界，从而确定局部引导的应用位置。整个框架无需微调或辅助模型。
AI.result: 在多种语言对上的实验表明，LCG稳健地提升了代码转换短语的口音地道性，抑制了口音泄漏，同时保持了整体说话人身份和自然度。
AI.conclusion: 短语局部语言对比引导是一种简单有效的无训练推理方案，能够在跨语言文本到语音合成中为每个语言区域恢复对应母语口音，兼顾地道性、说话人一致性与自然度。

title: Dotting the Eye: An Intent-Driven Image Retouching Agent for Visual Focus Enhancement
comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Image retouching is commonly formulated as enhancing overall visual quality through color adjustment, but in practice, it also serves to emphasize visual focus by guiding viewers' attention toward a specific subject or region. Achieving such focus-oriented retouching is inherently challenging, as it requires well-coordinated global and local adjustments to manipulate perceptual saliency while maintaining visual naturalness. This intricate process typically demands substantial professional expertise. In this study, we propose EyeControl, a MLLM-driven agent with a diffusion-based retouching executor that enables visual focus enhancement under weak user intent. With only a few clicks or coarse strokes, EyeControl directs visual attention to the intended region, effectively "dotting the eye" of the image. The core idea is to explicitly link the weak user intention with the target editing region and the corresponding tonal adjustment operations during retouching. To achieve this, the system first interprets the intent and image content to infer the visual focus and generate structured intent guidance for the retouching executor. Second, the retouching executor is encouraged to respond more strongly to the target region, explicitly aligning its attention map with a designed pseudo-intent map. We also introduce an operation-consistency constraint to improve coordination between global and local adjustments, achieving more natural and coherent retouching. Additionally, we contribute ControlArt-Bench, a high-quality evaluation dataset for visual focus enhancement. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that EyeControl yields perceptually appealing results with stronger intent alignment. Code can be found in https://github.com/DragonisCV/EyeControl.

AI.tldr: EyeControl 是一个由多模态大语言模型（MLLM）驱动的智能体，结合基于扩散模型的修图执行器，在仅需少量点击或粗略笔画等弱用户意图下，实现对图像视觉焦点的增强（“画龙点睛”），同时保持视觉自然性。
AI.motivation: 图像修图不仅要提升整体视觉质量，还要通过引导观者注意力来突出视觉焦点。这类面向焦点的修图需要全局与局部调整的精细协调以操控感知显著性并保持自然度，通常依赖专业经验，现有方法难以在弱用户意图（少量点击/粗略笔画）下完成，因此需要一种自动化的视觉焦点增强方案。
AI.method: 提出 EyeControl 系统：1）由 MLLM 驱动的智能体先解读用户弱意图与图像内容，推断视觉焦点并生成结构化的意图指导；2）基于扩散模型的修图执行器通过将注意力图与设计的伪意图图显式对齐，使模型对目标区域响应更强；3）引入操作一致性约束，协调全局与局部调整，保证修图更自然连贯；4）构建高质量评估数据集 ControlArt-Bench。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，EyeControl 生成的修图结果在感知上更具吸引力，且与用户意图的对齐度更强；同时提供了质量评估数据集 ControlArt-Bench，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: EyeControl 验证了将弱用户意图显式桥接至目标编辑区域及对应色调调整操作的有效性，为焦点导向的图像修图提供了可行的智能体+扩散执行器框架，具有较强的意图对齐与视觉自然性，并可通过开源代码与基准数据集支持后续研究。

title: Beyond the Clock: Measuring the Value of Adaptive Revision
summary: As agentic systems become compound systems, increasingly important decisions move above task execution itself: when should a higher-level controller preserve the strategy guiding another process, and when should it revise it? We study this meta-level control problem in a hierarchical latent reasoner whose manager can retain or replace a commitment governing lower-level computation. Across three precommitted training seeds, learned revision timing produces qualitatively different policies, ranging from an almost deterministic early clock to substantially more state conditioned schedule distributions, yet none outperforms the best forced timing policy evaluated on the same frozen checkpoint. This separates state dependence from decision value: a controller can vary its actions with internal state without turning that variation into a reproducible task-performance benefit.
