A deeper intervention study on the original checkpoint shows that timing itself is consequential and order-sensitive, while exhaustive enumeration reveals that a strong fixed schedule captures most of the measurable value available from timing at this decision budget. Counterfactual PERSIST/REPLAN diagnostics further show why score-level evidence can be misleading when predictability is dominated by decision position rather than within-position discrimination. Together, these results argue that learned meta-level control should be evaluated along three separate axes: whether its score depends on state, whether that dependence changes realized behavior, and whether those changes capture outcome value beyond a strong non-adaptive policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究分层潜在推理器中的元级控制问题：高层控制器应何时保留或修订指导低层计算的策略承诺。实验发现，学习的修订时机在不同种子下产生性质迥异的策略，但均未超过固定时机策略；进一步干预与反事实分析表明，决策时机本身有影响且对顺序敏感，但固定强计划已捕获大部分可测价值，提示应从状态依赖、行为改变和结果价值三个维度评估元级控制。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体系统日益复合化，越来越多关键决策发生在任务执行之上：高层控制器何时应保留指导另一进程的策略、何时应修订它。现有评估常混淆状态依赖与决策价值，因此需要系统研究这一元级控制问题的时机学习及其真实收益。
AI.method: 在分层潜在推理器中建模元级控制问题，其中管理者可保留或替换约束低层计算的承诺（commitment）。在三个预置训练种子下学习修订时机，将其与最优强制时机策略在同一冻结检查点上对比；对原始检查点进行深度干预研究，并结合反事实PERSIST/REPLAN诊断和穷举枚举来分析时机的影响与顺序敏感性。
AI.result: 学习的修订时机在不同种子下产生定性不同的策略——从近乎确定性的早期时钟到明显依赖状态的调度分布，但没有一个优于在相同冻结检查点上评估的最优强制时机策略。时序本身具有后果性且对顺序敏感；穷举枚举表明，在该决策预算下强固定调度已捕获大部分可测价值。反事实诊断还揭示，当可预测性由决策位置而非位置内判别主导时，基于分数的证据可能具有误导性。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的元级控制应沿三个独立维度评估：其分数是否依赖状态、该依赖是否改变实际行为、以及这些改变能否带来超越强非自适应策略的结果价值。这有助于将状态依赖与真实决策价值分离，指导更严谨地度量复合智能体系统中的元级控制收益。

title: Multi-Head Self Attention is a Parameter Identification Mechanism
summary: We prove that a multi-head scaled dot product attention can be viewed as a parameter identification strategy. The ratio of unidentified parameters to the total number of parameters scales like the reciprocal of the number of heads ($1/2 \to 1/(2H)$), meaning models with more heads are structurally more identified. A subtle side effect of the mathematics observation that attention can never be fully identified. Similarly we also show that some bias terms can have no effect on softmax-based attention layers in both the single- and multiple-head settings, though this is mostly a curiosity that should have a marginal effect on model size and model training/prediction efficiency. We also touch on modern improvements to transformers including RoPE and GQA from this perspective, illustrating how those as well can improve the ratio of ``meaningful'' parameters to all parameters. Simple numerical examples demonstrate that training can indeed involve updates that overlap model-invariant subspaces that arise from a lack of identification. As part of our experiments we use a ``rebalancing'' approach that can ``fix'' updates that overlap unindentified subspaces but do not try to present evidence this should actually be adopted. Instead we simply view our numerical results as exploring and confirming the theoretical results. As a whole we discuss a purely mathematical/statistical explanation, identification, for why specific architectural choices in transformers may have improved performance.

AI.tldr: 本文从参数可识别性（identification）的数学/统计学视角证明：多头缩放点积注意力可被视为一种参数识别策略，未识别参数占比随头数 H 增加按 1/(2H) 趋于减小，因此更多头带来更强的结构可识别性；同时指出注意力永远无法完全识别，并分析了偏置项、RoPE 与 GQA 等结构选择对“有意义参数”占比的影响，配合数值实验（含“rebalancing”方法）验证了理论结论。
AI.motivation: 作者希望为 Transformer 中特定架构选择（如多头注意力、RoPE、GQA）为何能提升性能提供一个纯粹的数学/统计学解释，而非仅依赖经验或启发式。他们观察到注意力层存在参数不可识别的问题，并由此引出对参数“有意义性”占比的度量，试图从识别性角度统一理解这些架构改进。
AI.method: 作者从理论上证明多头缩放点积注意力可看作一种参数识别策略，推导未识别参数与总参数之比为 1/(2H)（从 1/2 降至 1/(2H)），并指出注意力结构存在不可避免的识别不足；同时分析偏置项在单头与多头 softmax 注意力中的冗余性，并从同一视角考察 RoPE 与 GQA 对“有意义参数”占比的改善。数值实验中采用一种“rebalancing”方法以“修正”落在模型不变子空间上的梯度更新，用于探索并验证理论结果。
AI.result: 结果表明：注意力模型永远无法被完全识别，但增加头数可以系统性地降低未识别参数占比；某些偏置项对 softmax 注意力层完全无影响（这一点主要作为理论上的有趣现象，对模型规模与训练/推理效率影响甚微）；RoPE 与 GQA 等改进同样能提升“有意义”参数的比例。简单数值示例证实训练更新确实会与因识别不足产生的模型不变子空间重叠，rebalancing 方法可用于修正此类更新。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为可识别性为 Transformer 架构选择提供了统一且纯粹的数学/统计解释：多头机制、RoPE、GQA 等改进本质上都在提高参数的可识别性与“有意义参数”占比。不过作者并未主张 rebalancing 应被实际采用，仅将其数值结果视为对理论分析的探索与佐证。

title: PCoMoE: Shifting MoE Inference from Monolithic Expert Selection to Fine-Grained Path Composition
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale Large Language Model (LLM) capacity efficiently by activating a sparse subset of experts per token. However, modern MoE inference remains heavily constrained by the rigid, whole-expert abstraction. Existing frameworks manage, schedule, or prune experts as atomic execution units, which fixes the optimization boundary too early and leaves fine-grained intra-expert computational redundancy underexplored. In this work, we present PCoMoE, a path-compositional execution framework that shifts MoE inference from coarse-grained expert selection to fine-grained path composition. PCoMoE incorporates a path-level formulation of expert computation, a compatibility-aware layer-wise pruning strategy to suppress low-value path combinations, and a hardware-friendly execution engine to exploit reusable sub-expert structures under strictly bounded overheads. Experimental results demonstrate that PCoMoE achieves up to a 1.31x end-to-end inference speedup while enhancing model accuracy by 10%. The code is available at https://github.com/gzyyy0/PCoMoE

AI.tldr: PCoMoE 是一种面向 MoE（混合专家）大模型推理的路径组合执行框架，将推理优化从粗粒度的专家选择转变为细粒度的路径组合，通过路径级公式化、兼容性感知的逐层剪枝策略以及硬件友好的执行引擎，在严格受限开销下复用可共享的子专家结构，实现最高 1.31 倍的端到端推理加速并提升约 10% 的模型准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有 MoE 推理受制于僵化的"整专家"抽象：调度、管理和剪枝均以专家为原子执行单元，导致优化边界过早固定，专家内部细粒度的计算冗余未被充分挖掘，推理效率难以进一步提升；同时 MoE 通过稀疏激活专家来高效扩展模型容量，但这一容量放大未在细粒度执行层面被充分利用。
AI.method: 提出 PCoMoE 路径组合执行框架，包含三部分：(1) 专家计算的路径级公式化，将推理从专家选择转化为细粒度路径组合；(2) 兼容性感知的逐层剪枝策略，抑制低价值的路径组合；(3) 硬件友好的执行引擎，在严格受限的开销下挖掘并复用可共享的子专家结构。
AI.result: 实验表明 PCoMoE 最多可实现 1.31 倍的端到端推理加速，同时模型准确率提升约 10%；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: PCoMoE 验证了将 MoE 推理优化从粗粒度专家选择下沉到细粒度路径组合的有效性：既缓解了整专家抽象带来的计算冗余，又在受限开销下实现了可部署的加速与精度提升，为 MoE 推理执行框架提供了新的优化范式。

title: Monocular Depth Estimation from a Single Image: Progress and Opportunities
comment: Accepted by Computational Visual Media Journal (CVMJ)
summary: Monocular depth estimation has long stood as a fundamental challenge in computer vision, enabling a wide range of applications including 3D reconstruction, robotics, autonomous driving, and augmented reality. This survey traces the field's evolution from early learning-based methods to the emergence of transformative foundation models. We begin by framing the problem, distinguishing between relative and metric depth estimation, and highlighting the key challenges that have shaped a decade of research. We then present common problem formulations and introduce the most widely used datasets, covering indoor, outdoor, and synthetic data. Following this, we review major advances prior to the foundation model era, distilling core insights from influential methods that contributed to improvements in accuracy, efficiency, and robustness. The survey then turns to the recent surge of foundation-model-based approaches, categorizing them into discriminative and generative paradigms and emphasizing the critical roles of large-scale pretraining (e.g., DINOv3) and synthetic data. We compare representative models using both quantitative benchmarks and qualitative examples, and discuss natural extensions to video-based depth estimation. Further, to illustrate real-world impact, we highlight the integration of depth estimation into applications such as visual SLAM, content generation, and robot perception. Finally, we outline open challenges and promising research directions as the field advances further into the era of foundation models.

AI.tldr: 一篇关于单目深度估计的综述论文，系统梳理了该领域从早期基于学习的方法到基础模型时代的演进过程，涵盖问题定义、数据集、方法分类（判别式与生成式）、视频扩展以及实际应用。
AI.motivation: 单目深度估计是计算机视觉中的基础性挑战，支撑着3D重建、机器人、自动驾驶和增强现实等广泛应用。随着基础模型的兴起，该领域正经历范式转变，需要对从早期学习方法到当前基础模型时代的完整脉络进行系统性梳理与总结。
AI.method: 该综述首先界定问题，区分相对深度估计与度量深度估计并讨论关键挑战；随后介绍常见问题形式化和常用数据集（室内、室外和合成数据）；接着回顾基础模型时代之前的主要进展，提炼关键方法的洞见；进而将基础模型方法分为判别式和生成式两类，强调大规模预训练（如DINOv3）和合成数据的作用；通过定量基准和定性示例比较代表性模型，并讨论向视频深度估计的自然扩展；最后展示在视觉SLAM、内容生成和机器人感知中的应用集成。
AI.result: 该综述系统比较了代表性模型在定量基准和定性示例上的表现，梳理了判别式和生成式两大基础模型范式，阐述了基于视频的深度估计扩展，并总结了深度估计在视觉SLAM、内容生成和机器人感知等真实场景中的集成应用。
AI.conclusion: 文章最后指出了开放挑战和具有前景的研究方向，为该领域在基础模型时代进一步深入发展提供了前瞻性的指导。

title: FractalNet-Based Heterogeneous Federated Learning for Orbital Edge Intelligence in Satellite Mega-Constellations: A Wildfire Case Study
summary: Satellite mega-constellations are emerging as large-scale sensing, communication, and computation fabrics, yet their learning architectures remain largely inherited from terrestrial federated learning and ground-centric mission operations--- ill-suited to satellites that differ by orders of magnitude in Size, Weight, Power, and Cost (SWAP-C), radiation tolerance, link availability, and propagation delay. We propose a heterogeneous federated learning method based on the FractalNet architecture for orbital edge intelligence. We formalize contact-window-constrained, depth-heterogeneous federated optimization and introduce a distributed path scheduler that assigns model depth as a function of SWAP-C constraints, predicted inter-satellite contacts, and training statistics. To reduce message overhead and energy consumption, each tier pools updates periodically rather than at every contact opportunity, and a three-tier agentic control plane governs in-space scheduling, anomaly escalation, and policy-governed autonomy. As a case study, we apply the framework to wildfire detection, where each orbital shell naturally learns a different semantic level of situational awareness: pixel-scale thermal anomalies at low Earth orbit (LEO), regional fire-front dynamics at medium Earth orbit (MEO), and larger-scale risk propagation at geostationary or high Earth orbit (GEO/HEO). Experiments on simulated mega-constellations validate the approach across convergence, communication efficiency, energy adaptation, scheduled-pooling savings, robustness, and latency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于FractalNet架构的异构联邦学习方法，用于卫星巨型星座的轨道边缘智能，通过分布式路径调度器按SWAP-C约束、星间链路和训练统计分配模型深度，并采用分层池化更新与三层智能体控制平面，以野火检测为案例验证收敛性、通信效率、能耗和鲁棒性等性能。
AI.motivation: 卫星巨型星座正成为大规模感知、通信与计算联合体，但其学习架构仍继承自地面联邦学习与地面中心式任务运营，不适合卫星之间在尺寸、重量、功耗与成本（SWAP-C）、辐射耐受性、链路可用性和传播延迟上相差多个数量级的特点，需要专为轨道环境设计的联邦学习方法。
AI.method: 提出基于FractalNet架构的异构联邦学习：形式化接触窗口约束、深度异构的联邦优化问题；引入分布式路径调度器，将模型深度分配为SWAP-C约束、预测星间接触和训练统计的函数；各层级按周期而非每次接触机会池化更新以减少消息开销与能耗；构建三层智能体控制平面，管理空间内调度、异常升级与策略约束自治；以野火检测为案例，使不同轨道壳层学习不同语义级别的态势感知。
AI.result: 在模拟巨型星座上开展实验，验证了该方法在收敛性、通信效率、能量自适应、调度池化节省、鲁棒性和延迟等方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该异构联邦学习框架能够适配卫星星座在SWAP-C、链路可用性和延迟方面的异质性，通过深度分层与周期池化显著提升轨道边缘智能的学习效率与资源利用，为轨道分布式感知任务提供可行的架构方案。

title: Post-Training Science for Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Every supervised fine-tuning run forces the same chain of decisions, such as learning rate, batch size, LoRA or full fine-tuning, how many epochs, which optimiser, and what data to feed the model. Each of these is typically rediscovered from scratch for every new model and dataset. Here we measure them under one instrument: a sweep that varies one lever at a time, and spans dense and mixture-of-experts models in two families (Qwen3 and Llama), on four real-world customer SFT datasets, for both LoRA and full fine-tuning. These datasets give a controlled testbed: each task carries an evaluation built with the customer, and its training data is produced by iterative supervised fine-tuning that refines model outputs until they pass that evaluation, so the supervised target is internally consistent and the task judge we report against is the criterion the data was built to satisfy. We ask how the optimal learning rate and batch size move with model scale, family, and data, and whether one selection rule transfers across them; what LoRA trades against full fine-tuning, and how its rank and alpha set what the adapter can learn; whether validation loss (or other metrics, such as loss landscape flatness) faithfully ranks downstream quality; whether post-training gains scale with model size and data volume, on a model ladder extended through mixtures-of-experts to 235B parameters; how many epochs to train before general instruction-following erodes; and whether a geometry-aware optimiser improves on AdamW. Each recommendation is paired with a measure of its uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一实验框架下系统测量监督微调（SFT）中的关键超参数决策——学习率、批大小、LoRA与全量微调、秩与alpha、训练轮数、优化器——覆盖Qwen3与Llama两个模型家族（含稠密与MoE架构，最大235B参数），在四个真实客户SFT数据集上（每个任务有客户共建的评测），逐一变量的控制变量实验为每项建议附上不确定性度量。
AI.motivation: 每次监督微调都要重新摸索同样的决策链（学习率、批大小、LoRA/全量、轮数、优化器、数据），且这些经验通常针对每个新模型和数据集从头重新发现，缺乏跨模型规模、家族和数据的系统性、可迁移的指导。
AI.method: 采用单一仪器化的扫描框架，每次只改变一个变量（one lever at a time）；横跨两个模型家族（Qwen3、Llama）的稠密与MoE模型；在四个真实客户SFT数据集上进行LoRA和全量微调。数据集本身由迭代式SFT生成，直至模型输出通过客户评测，从而保证监督目标内部一致、评测judge与数据构建标准一致。
AI.result: 回答了多项关键问题：最优学习率与批大小如何随模型规模、家族和数据变化，以及选择规则能否跨场景迁移；LoRA相对全量微调的权衡及秩与alpha决定适配器能学到什么；验证损失（或损失景观平坦度等）能否忠实排序下游质量；后训练收益是否随模型规模和数据量扩展（模型阶梯扩展至235B MoE）；训练多少轮会导致通用指令跟随能力被侵蚀；几何感知优化器是否优于AdamW；每项建议均配有不确定性度量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为SFT超参数选择提供了首个大规模、跨家族、跨架构、带不确定性的实证基准，揭示各决策变量的规律与迁移性，为实践者在数据与模型变化时避免从零重复调参提供依据。

title: Lagged Coupling: Internal Representations Become Readable Before They Become Causal
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Pre-registered developmental interpretability study on the full Pythia suite with an OLMo-2 replication
summary: Across the full Pythia suite (160M-12B, eight checkpoints, four task families), a linear probe can read a target variable from the residual stream as early as step 1,000 at every scale -- yet steering along that same reading direction remains null-equivalent in 43 of 48 model-checkpoint cells. Internal readability systematically outruns causal efficacy, and the lag does not shrink with scale. We call this structure lagged coupling and decompose it into three dissociable tracks: (i) internal readability, saturated (AUROC >= 0.990) from the first checkpoint everywhere; (ii) behavioral readability, which develops gradually and progressively later at larger scales (12B reaches 0.909 only at the final checkpoint); (iii) causal efficacy, almost always null-equivalent, occasionally counterproductive early, with one isolated positive pulse (12B, step 8,000, z = +2.49) our grid cannot resolve. The ordering is dominantly read-before-write (11/11 units, no inversion). Representation headroom along the probe direction grows up to 57x with training and scale while causal write-in stays below 0.11% of headroom -- the variable is increasingly written into the representation and increasingly ignored by the readout. Under a fully pre-registered protocol, both single-onset hypotheses resolve INDETERMINATE (scale slope +0.24, 95% CI [-0.60, +0.87]; time vote 3:3) -- a disciplined negative explained by the three-track decomposition. A pre-registered OLMo-2 replication preserves the direction at attenuated magnitude. Our results caution against inferring steerability from probe accuracy and establish a developmental bottleneck: representation formation reliably outpaces causal readout consolidation.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Pythia模型套件（160M-12B，8个检查点，4类任务）发现：线性探针早在step 1,000即可读取目标变量，但沿该读取方向进行steering在48个模型-检查点单元中有43个表现为无效。内部可读性系统性超前于因果效力（"滞后耦合"），该滞后不随规模缩小，并分解为三条可分离轨迹：内部可读性（饱和）、行为可读性（渐进发展且大模型更延迟）与因果效力（几乎始终无效）。注册式实验对两种单一起源假设判定为INDETERMINATE，OLMo-2复制保持了方向但幅度衰减。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性研究常以线性探针的可读性（probe accuracy）推断模型内部变量是否可用于因果干预，但可读性与可操纵性（steerability）之间是否一致缺乏系统验证。作者希望通过跨规模、跨检查点的受控实验，考察内部可读性是否真能预示因果写入（causal write-in），并刻画表征形成与因果读出固化之间的发展性瓶颈。
AI.method: 在Pythia套件（160M-12B）的全网格上（8个检查点、4类任务族）训练线性探针以读取残差流中的目标变量，并对同一读取方向施加激活steering以测因果效力。将现象分解为三条轨迹：内部可读性（AUROC）、行为可读性、因果效力（z分数）。采用完全预注册协议检验两种"单一起源"假设（规模斜率与时间投票），并在OLMo-2上进行预注册复制以验证稳健性。
AI.result: 内部可读性在首个检查点即处处饱和（AUROC>=0.990）；行为可读性渐进发展且在大规模时更晚成熟（12B最终检查点仅0.909）；因果效力几乎全部无效甚至早期偶有反作用，仅出现一次孤立的正向脉冲（12B, step 8,000, z=+2.49）。顺序以"先读后写"为主（11/11单元无反转）；表征净空沿探针方向最多增长57倍，而因果写入始终低于净空的0.11%。预注册假设均判定为INDETERMINATE（规模斜率+0.24，95% CI [-0.60,+0.87]；时间投票3:3），OLMo-2复制保持方向但幅度减弱。
AI.conclusion: 探针可读性不能作为可操纵性的代理指标；表征形成可靠地快于因果读出固化，构成一种发展性瓶颈。作者建议将可读性、行为效应与因果效力视为三条可分离的解耦轨迹，并警示从探针精度推断steerability的常见做法存在系统性风险。

title: Compressing AI Traffic: Standardized Neural Network Coding of Visual-Token Representations in Split Vision-Language Inference
summary: When the visual encoder and the language decoder of a vision-language model (VLM) run on different compute nodes, the intermediate visual-token embeddings become a communicated payload rather than an internal activation. We call such machine-consumed intermediate tensors AI traffic and ask how far they can be compressed with a standardized, training-free codec. We insert ISO/IEC 15938-17 Neural Network Coding (NNC) round trips on the complete visual interface of a Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct video question answering pipeline, comprising the main visual-token representation and the DeepStack feature streams, while leaving weights, prompts, and generation untouched, and sweep the quantization parameter (QP) over a wide rate range. Closed-ended Video-MME accuracy remains close to the uncompressed reference up to a 98% reduction of the transmitted BF16 tensor and only then collapses; open-ended MLVU generation shows the same plateau-and-collapse profile under an LLM judge. This robustness is not due to near-lossless reconstruction: the decoded tensor is heavily discretized, carries substantial row-wise relative L2 error, and has a visibly steeper singular-value decay than its source. Downstream reasoning therefore depends on coarse structure and relative geometry rather than exact floating-point values, which argues for rate-task rather than rate-distortion optimization of AI traffic codecs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"AI流量"（AI traffic）概念，指跨节点传输的机器消费型中间张量（如视觉token嵌入）。作者将ISO/IEC 15938-17神经网编码（NNC）码器以零训练的方式插入Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct视频问答管线的完整视觉接口（主视觉token表示与DeepStack特征流），扫描量化参数，发现视频理解与开放生成任务在传输的BF16张量被压缩98%前均保持接近无损参考的精度，仅此后才崩溃，表明下游推理依赖粗粒度结构与相对几何而非精确浮点值。
AI.motivation: 当VLM的视觉编码器与语言解码器运行在不同计算节点时，中间视觉token嵌入从内部激活变为通信载荷（即"AI流量"）。作者希望探究这类机器消费的中间张量能否用标准化、免训练码器大幅压缩，其核心问题不在于重建保真度而在于下游任务精度。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct视频问答管线的完整视觉接口上插入ISO/IEC 15938-17（NNC）码器往返，覆盖主视觉token表示与DeepStack特征流；保持权重、提示与生成过程不变，并在宽码率范围内扫描量化参数（QP），以Video-MME（闭端）和MLVU（开端，LLM评判）评估。
AI.result: 闭端Video-MME精度在BF16张量减少98%前始终接近未压缩参考，之后才崩溃；开端MLVU生成在LLM评判下呈现相同的平台-崩溃曲线。该鲁棒性并非源于近无损重建——解码张量被严重离散化、具有明显的逐行相对L2误差且奇异值衰减明显比源更陡。
AI.conclusion: 下游推理依赖粗粒度结构和相对几何而非精确浮点值，因此对AI流量码器应进行码率-任务优化（rate-task）而非码率-失真（rate-distortion）优化。

title: Towards reliable multimodal disaster severity assessment through preference optimization and explainable vision-language reasoning
comment: Published in Reliability Engineering & System Safety
summary: Reliable disaster damage assessment requires models that provide both accurate predictions and transparent explanations. However, existing multimodal approaches are limited by scarce annotated data and insufficient evaluation of reasoning quality. This study proposes a two-stage training framework that integrates Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) within a unified data construction pipeline. From a single Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) annotation workflow, two complementary datasets are derived, namely ReasoningSet, which contains validated rationales for SFT, and PreferenceSet, which comprises paired rationales for DPO-based alignment. The framework evaluates both classification performance and explanation quality using automatic metrics, model-based scoring, and human ranking. Experimental results show that SFT improves accuracy from 73.64% to 78.29% and increases Macro-F1 by 29% compared to the baseline, while explanation quality improves by approximately 25%. Subsequent DPO alignment further enhances interpretability on the PreferenceSet. Cross-model validation on InternVL-3-8B and LLaVA-1.5-7B demonstrates the robustness and generalizability of the approach. The proposed framework improves detection of underrepresented mild damage cases, reduces high-risk misclassifications, and strengthens alignment between model reasoning and human judgment. Overall, it provides a reproducible pathway to develop reliable multimodal systems that deliver auditable, actionable disaster insights for emergency management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段训练框架，将监督微调（SFT）与直接偏好优化（DPO）集成到统一的数据构建流程中，用于多模态灾害损害评估。该框架同时提升分类准确率与解释质量，并增强模型推理与人类判断的一致性，为应急管理提供可审计、可复现的可靠系统。
AI.motivation: 可靠的灾害损害评估需要模型既具备准确预测能力，又能提供透明的解释。然而，现有多模态方法受限于标注数据稀缺，且缺乏对推理质量的充分评估，难以满足应急管理对可解释、可审计决策支持的需求。
AI.method: 提出一个整合SFT与DPO的两阶段训练框架，并通过统一的数据构建流程实现：从单一的人工在环（HITL）标注流程中派生出两个互补数据集——ReasoningSet（含经验证的推理链，用于SFT）与PreferenceSet（成对推理链，用于DPO对齐）。评估采用自动指标、基于模型的评分与人工排序相结合的方式，同时考察分类性能与解释质量。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，SFT将准确率从73.64%提升至78.29%，Macro-F1较基线提高29%，解释质量提升约25%；随后的DPO对齐在PreferenceSet上进一步增强可解释性。在InternVL-3-8B和LLaVA-1.5-7B上的跨模型验证证明了方法的稳健性与泛化性。所提框架改善了低表征轻度损伤案例的检测，减少高风险误分类，并加强了模型推理与人类判断之间的对齐。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为开发可靠的多模态灾害评估系统提供了可复现的路径，能够为应急管理提供可审计、可操作的灾害洞察，兼顾预测性能与推理可解释性。

title: Explore More, Drift Less: Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning Can Suffice for Long-Horizon Interactive Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning is a natural way to post-train LLM agents for long-horizon interactive tasks judged only by end-of-task verification, yet a shared belief holds that outcome-only RL soon hits a ceiling on small open models. Recent work therefore compensates around the training with denser rewards, SFT priors, skill libraries, curated memory, or multi-agent orchestration. We argue the ceiling is an artifact of two failures of common practice. Signal starvation: group-relative RL with sparse outcome-only rewards yields a gradient only when a task's rollout group mixes successes and failures, so under-scaled exploration silences exactly the hardest, most instructive tasks. Policy drift: squeezing many updates out of a small task pool degrades the policy itself, as an unanchored objective lets the sampling distribution collapse exactly when saturation has already made informative groups rare. We present CANOPY (Coverage-ANchored On-PolicY RL), a minimalist protocol attacking both directly: scale same-task exploration until the natural signal reappears, keep every update on-policy, KL-anchored, and confined to the agent's own action tokens, then cash in an enlarged interaction budget at test time. On AppWorld, a long-horizon interactive coding benchmark, a Qwen3-14B policy trained with CANOPY through environment interaction alone--without task-specific supervision, auxiliary credit signals, or elaborate agent scaffolding--topped the public leaderboard (Feb. 2026; Test-Normal TGC 86.9, Test-Challenge 67.6), and the same design principles lift Qwen3.5-9B on SWE-bench Verified by 16.6 points. Agentic RL alone thus internalizes long-horizon capability directly into a small open model; we plan to release the complete training stack at https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/SignalCoverageRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CANOPY（Coverage-ANchored On-PolicY RL），一种极简的强化学习协议，直接解决"结果驱动型 RL 在小开源模型上遇到天花板"的两个根源问题——信号饥饿（signal starvation）与策略漂移（policy drift）。它通过扩大同任务探索规模直到稀疏的结果信号自然恢复、并坚持在策略、KL 锚定、仅约束智能体自身动作 token 的更新，在 AppWorld 长程交互编码基准上仅凭环境交互训练 Qwen3-14B 即登顶公开排行榜，并将同一设计原则迁移到 SWE-bench Verified 上使 Qwen3.5-9B 提升 16.6 分。
AI.motivation: 学界普遍认为仅靠端任务结果验证的 outcome-only RL 在小规模开源模型上很快会触及天花板，因此现有工作往往引入密集奖励、SFT 先验、技能库、记忆管理或多智能体编排等额外补偿手段。作者指出这一"天花板"其实是常见实践的两类失败所致：其一为信号饥饿——组内相对 RL 在稀疏结果奖励下只有当任务 rollout 组同时包含成功与失败时才产生梯度，探索规模不足会让最难、最具信息量的任务静默失效；其二为策略漂移——在小任务池上反复更新会使策略退化，因为无锚定目标会让采样分布在饱和后崩溃、而信息丰富的组已十分罕见。
AI.method: CANOPY 是一种极简协议，从两个层面直接对症：首先扩大同一任务的探索规模（coverage），直到自然的稀疏结果信号重新出现；其次保证每次更新始终是 on-policy 的、以 KL 散度锚定，并且约束范围仅限智能体自身的动作 token，从而避免策略漂移与采样分布坍塌。整体训练仅依赖环境交互，不借助任务特定监督、辅助信用信号或复杂智能体脚手架，并在测试阶段兑现更大的交互预算。
AI.result: 在长程交互式编码基准 AppWorld 上，仅通过环境交互训练的 Qwen3-14B + CANOPY 登顶公开排行榜（2026 年 2 月；Test-Normal TGC 86.9，Test-Challenge 67.6）；同样的设计原则使 Qwen3.5-9B 在 SWE-bench Verified 上提升 16.6 个点。作者计划在 GitHub 开源完整训练栈。
AI.conclusion: Agentic RL 本身（无需密集奖励、SFT 先验或复杂脚手架）就能将长程交互能力直接内化到小型开源模型中，挑战了"outcome-only RL 对小模型有天花板"的既有信念；其关键在于保证探索覆盖以维持信号、并以 KL 锚定的 on-policy 更新防止策略漂移。作者将发布完整训练栈以支持复现。

title: OUTLETS: Output-Length Prediction from Speculative Decoding Backbones
summary: The heavy-tailed distribution of output lengths in Large Language Model (LLM) serving poses major challenges for resource provisioning and cluster scheduling. Although output-length prediction can mitigate these issues, existing approaches have key drawbacks: external proxy models add substantial latency and often have limited fidelity, whereas internal state-based methods are efficient but rely on shallow probes of current model states. We identify a structural connection between speculative decoding (SD) and length prediction: latent representations produced by the draft decoder in advanced frameworks (e.g., EAGLE-3) encode signals that are predictive of generation length. Building on this insight, we introduce OUTLETS (Output-Length Prediction from Speculative Decoding Backbones), which repurposes the speculative backbone as a trajectory-aware length predictor. When its draft representations are already computed for speculative decoding, OUTLETS adds only a lightweight regression head and achieves lower MAE than the evaluated methods. Under saturated disaggregated serving, OUTLETS predictions enable standard scheduling policies to prioritize shorter requests and distribute requests more evenly across decoding instances, reducing short-request P99 latency by 34.8%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OUTLETS，利用投机解码（SD）骨干网络（如 EAGLE-3）中草稿解码器的潜在表示来预测 LLM 生成长度，只需添加轻量级回归头，即可在更低均绝对误差（MAE）下实现高效的长度预测，并在饱和的分离式（disaggregated）服务场景中通过调度策略将短请求 P99 延迟降低 34.8%。
AI.motivation: LLM 服务中输出长度的重尾分布给资源供给和集群调度带来重大挑战。输出长度预测可以缓解这些问题，但现有方法存在关键缺陷：外部代理模型延迟高且保真度有限；基于内部状态的方法虽高效，却仅依赖当前模型状态的浅层探测。
AI.method: 作者发现投机解码（SD）与长度预测之间存在结构联系：先进框架（如 EAGLE-3）草稿解码器产生的潜在表示编码了可预测生成长度的信号。基于此，提出 OUTLETS，将投机解码骨干重新用作轨迹感知（trajectory-aware）的长度预测器；当草稿表示在投机解码中已被计算时，只需添加一个轻量级回归头即可完成预测。
AI.result: OUTLETS 在均绝对误差（MAE）上低于所评估的对比方法。在饱和的分离式服务场景下，其预测使标准调度策略能够优先处理较短请求并在各解码实例间更均匀地分发请求，将短请求的 P99 延迟降低了 34.8%。
AI.conclusion: 投机解码骨干网络可以以极小的额外开销被复用作高质量的输出长度预测器，从而在不引入外部代理模型延迟的前提下提升 LLM 服务的调度效果和端到端性能。

title: S$^2$Prune: Spatially Structured Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: 18 pages, including supplementary material. Code is available at https://github.com/yuanyuanjia71-spec/S2Prune
summary: Visual token pruning reduces the inference overhead of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by retaining only a subset of visual tokens. Existing methods usually select tokens based on importance or redundancy. However, we observe that these criteria produce stable spatial biases across inputs and do not always outperform simple Uniform Grid sampling, highlighting the value of broad spatial coverage. Motivated by this, we propose S$^2$Prune, a training-free pruning method that preserves spatial coverage while adapting token density to local image structure. We first divide the image into regions and assign at least one token to each region to preserve coverage. The remaining token budget is then distributed according to Laplacian variation, giving more tokens to regions with richer structure. We then use Early Representation Change (ERC), computed from the first decoder block, to select representative tokens within each region. We evaluate S$^2$Prune across diverse settings and two MLLM architectures. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, it achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated training-free pruning methods. With only 32 of the original 576 visual tokens, it still retains 79.3% of the full-model performance. Code is available at https://github.com/yuanyuanjia71-spec/S2Prune.

AI.tldr: 提出 S²Prune，一种无需训练的视觉 token 剪枝方法，以“保持空间覆盖”为核心，同时依据图像局部结构自适应分配 token 密度，并在每个区域内用第一解码器块计算的 Early Representation Change (ERC) 挑选代表性 token；在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 等模型上取得最优平均精度，仅保留 32/576 个 token 时仍保持全模型性能的 79.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 token 剪枝方法通常基于重要性或冗余度选择 token，但作者观察到这些标准会产生跨输入稳定的空间偏差，且并不总能优于简单的 Uniform Grid 采样，说明广泛的空间覆盖本身很有价值。因此需要一种兼顾空间覆盖与局部结构自适应性的方法。
AI.method: S²Prune 是一种无需训练的剪枝方法。首先将图像划分为若干区域，并为每个区域至少分配一个 token 以保证空间覆盖；随后依据 Laplacian 变化将剩余 token 预算分配到各区域，使结构更丰富的区域获得更多 token；最后利用从第一个解码器块计算的 Early Representation Change (ERC) 在每个区域内挑选代表性 token。
AI.result: 在多种设置和两种 MLLM 架构上评估：在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 上，S²Prune 在所评估的无需训练剪枝方法中取得最高平均准确率；仅使用原始 576 个视觉 token 中的 32 个时仍保留全模型性能的 79.3%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将宽空间覆盖与基于局部结构（Laplacian 变化）的自适应分配以及基于 ERC 的代表性 token 选择相结合，能够在无需训练的情况下显著降低 MLLM 推理开销并保持较高精度，为视觉 token 剪枝提供了新思路。代码已开源。

title: Denoising Diffusion Generative Models Secretly Calculate Attentions
comment: submitted to IEEE Trans on Pattern Recog. Machine Intellig
summary: Denoising diffusion models are the dominant architecture for image generation, whereas most natural language generation and modeling are primarily handled by well-known transformer architectures employing attention mechanism. Here, we show that diffusion models also inherently use an attention mechanism very similar to that of transformers. Therefore, attention emerges as a universal machine learning principle, based on a general training objective. We also show similarities in basic functional principle of auto-encoders and attention-based models. These equivalences allows us to interchange these designs based on practical requirements. As an example, we can reformulate the diffusion framework to reduce the lengthy training process and computation-intensive image generation. Using this approach, a simplified algorithm is proposed for image generation which is based on attention mechanism. Results show that the attention-based implementation achieves comparable performance with significantly less effort and computational resources.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了去噪扩散模型内部天然包含与Transformer相似的注意力机制，从而提出注意力是基于通用训练目标而涌现的普适机器学习原理，并据此将扩散框架重构为基于注意力的简化图像生成算法，在显著降低训练与计算开销的同时达到可比性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在图像生成中占据主导地位，而自然语言处理主要依赖基于注意力机制的Transformer，两者看似分属不同架构。作者试图探明二者之间是否存在深层的统一原理，进而利用这种等价关系克服扩散模型训练耗时长、生成计算量大的固有瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者首先论证扩散模型本质上使用了与Transformer高度相似的注意力机制，并指出自编码器与基于注意力的模型在基本功能原理上也有相似性；基于这些等价关系，作者将扩散框架重新表述，提出一种以注意力机制为核心的简化图像生成算法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，基于注意力机制的实现能够在显著降低训练投入和计算资源的前提下，取得与原始扩散模型可比的图像生成性能。
AI.conclusion: 注意力机制可视为跨越多种生成任务与架构的普适机器学习原则；扩散模型、Transformer与自编码器之间的等价性允许按实际需求灵活互换设计，从而为更高效、更轻量的图像生成提供了新途径。

title: Solving In-Table Prediction Problems by Deep Neural Networks with Performance Evaluation Using Synthetic Data
summary: Tabular deep learning (TDL) leverages neural networks (NN) to extract patterns from tabular data. Traditional TDL methods follow a supervised learning paradigm, where a target feature is explicitly given. In this work, however, we explore a different approach by employing deep NNs to learn relationships among individual columns within a given table. We investigate whether NNs can predict the values of arbitrarily selected columns in a given table based on the remaining known columns. We call this problem In-Table Prediction (ITB), which is slightly different from table imputation methods and the pretraining task of TDL. Three potential usage scenarios are identified, which, to our best knowledge, have not been extensively studied in the literature. A self-supervised learning approach is applied to address this problem by randomly selecting columns to be masked out and used as learning targets. This work focuses on tabular datasets containing only continuous features. To handle missing values in continuous features, a novel neural layer is proposed to embed both numerical and empty values. Synthetic data is generated based on predefined column relationships, with empty values inserted using two distinct mechanisms. Additionally, an adapted masking strategy is employed to create test data. Performances of three NN architectures, namely MLP, Resnet and Transformer, are evaluated using the generated synthetic data. We conclude that, the attention-based structure outperforms the other two networks, when a sufficiently large number of training examples is available and a relatively large embedding length is chosen. We stress that these findings are obtained under controlled, synthetic conditions with a small number of columns and it should therefore be regarded as an initial, narrowly-scoped investigation rather than a general characterization of ITP on real-world tabular data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"表内预测"(In-Table Prediction)问题：利用深度神经网络学习表格中各列之间的关系，根据已知列预测任意选定列的值，而非传统的监督学习范式。作者采用自监督学习，随机遮蔽列作为学习目标，提出一种能同时嵌入数值与空值的新型神经网络层来处理连续特征的缺失值；基于预定义列关系生成合成数据，并用两种机制插入空值、采用适配的遮蔽策略构造测试数据。在MLP、Resnet和Transformer三种架构上的实验表明：当训练样本足够多且嵌入长度较大时，基于注意力机制的Transformer结构表现最佳。但作者强调结果是在受控、合成的条件下、列数较少的范围内获得，属于初步的有限范围研究。
AI.motivation: 传统表格深度学习(TDL)遵循监督学习范式，需要显式给定目标特征。本文探索一种不同路径：利用深度神经网络学习表格中各列之间的关系，针对任意选定的列，基于其余已知列预测其值(即"表内预测"，In-Table Prediction)。该问题与表格插补方法和TDL预训练任务略有不同，且文中识别出三种尚未被广泛研究的潜在应用场景，因此值得专门探索。
AI.method: 采用自监督学习方法：随机选择若干列进行遮蔽(masking)并将其作为学习目标。研究聚焦于仅含连续特征的表格数据集，为此提出一种新颖的神经网络层，可同时嵌入数值与空值(缺失值)。基于预定义的列关系生成合成数据，并采用两种不同机制插入空值；测试数据通过适配的遮蔽策略构造。最后在MLP、Resnet和Transformer三种神经网络架构上评估其性能。
AI.result: 在基于预定义列关系生成的合成数据上，三种架构(MLP、Resnet、Transformer)的性能比较显示：当可用的训练样本数量足够大且选择较大的嵌入长度时，基于注意力机制的Transformer结构优于另外两种网络。该结论仅在受控的合成条件、列数较少的情况下成立。
AI.conclusion: 本文认为注意力机制(Transformer)在表内预测任务上具有优势，但该发现是在受控合成环境、少量列的狭窄范围内获得的，应被视为一项初步的、范围有限的探索性研究，而非对真实表格数据上表内预测(ITP)问题的普适性结论。

title: Post-hoc Alignment of LLM-judges to Human Judgment Distribution
summary: The LLM-as-a-judge (LLMaJ) framework offers a cost-effective and reproducible solution for automatic evaluation. However, current evaluation practices typically compare LLMaJ judgments against aggregated ground-truth labels, overlooking the valuable information contained in Human Label Variation (HLV). Inspired by an increasing line of work that proposes to leverage HLV, we systematically study LLMaJ performance on predicting both a single, aggregated ground truth hard-label and unaggregated soft-labels that represent Human Judgment Distributions (HJD). Our results across five diverse datasets reveal that while LLMs achieve near human-level performance at hard-label prediction on most tasks, they exhibit poor performance when predicting soft-labels. To address this limitation, we propose NAPHA (eNtropy-Aware Post-Hoc Alignment), a simple yet effective lightweight post-hoc alignment method that matches the LLM distribution to the HJD by first assigning an instance to a discrete entropy class and then routing it to specialized, trained alignment models. We find that NAPHA consistently improves soft-labels prediction across base LLM models and datasets, with particularly strong gains on high-entropy instances where capturing diverse human perspectives is most critical. We also show via oracle experiments that improving entropy class prediction can substantially enhance NAPHA's practical effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了 LLM-as-a-judge 在硬标签（聚合的真实标签）与软标签（人类判断分布 HJD）预测上的表现，发现 LLM 在硬标签预测上接近人类水平但在软标签预测上表现不佳；为此提出轻量级后置对齐方法 NAPHA，通过熵感知的实例分类与专用对齐模型路由，显著提升软标签预测，尤其在人类观点分歧最大的高熵实例上。
AI.motivation: 现有自动评估实践通常仅将 LLMaJ 的判断与聚合后的真实标签比较，忽略了人类标签变异性（HLV）所蕴含的丰富信息。受利用 HLV 的研究启发，作者希望系统考察 LLM 在同时预测单一聚合硬标签与未聚合软标签（即人类判断分布 HJD）上的能力，以弥合评估方法对人观点多样性的建模缺口。
AI.method: 作者在五个数据集上对比 LLM 的硬标签与软标签预测性能，发现其软标签预测能力不足。为此提出 NAPHA（eNtropy-Aware Post-Hoc Alignment）：一种轻量级后置对齐方法，先将每个实例划分到离散的熵类别中，再将其路由到针对该类别专门训练的对齐模型，从而将 LLM 的输出分布校准到人类判断分布（HJD）；同时通过 oracle 实验验证熵类别预测的改进空间。
AI.result: 实验表明：LLM 在多数任务上硬标签预测接近人类水平，但软标签预测表现较差；NAPHA 在多种基础 LLM 和数据集上一致地提升了软标签预测性能，在高熵（人类观点分歧最大）的实例上提升尤为显著；oracle 实验进一步显示，改进熵类别预测可大幅增强 NAPHA 的实际效果。
AI.conclusion: 依赖聚合标签的传统评估忽视了人类判断的分布信息，而熵感知的后置对齐方法 NAPHA 能够将 LLM 输出有效地校准到人类判断分布，从而在保留低成本、可复现优势的同时更好地捕捉人类观点的多样性；提升熵类别预测精度是进一步增强该方法实用价值的关键方向。

title: One Prompt Is Enough: Watermark Laundering Through Foundation Image Models
summary: Invisible watermarks are typically evaluated against predefined perturbations such as compression, blur, noise, cropping, and denoising. Public foundation image models expose a distinct threat: an attacker can submit a watermarked image with a single reconstruction prompt and obtain a visually faithful output from which the invisible watermark can no longer be decoded reliably. We formalize this failure mode as watermark laundering and evaluate it using a joint payload-fidelity profile that combines bit error rate (BER) with visual and semantic preservation. Across six OpenAI and Google image editing models, three representative watermarking schemes, and 1,800 reconstructed outputs, we identify two complementary laundering regimes: OpenAI models produce the strongest payload disruption across the evaluated schemes, whereas Nano Banana 2 shows that DwtDct remains vulnerable under high-fidelity reconstruction. Prompt ablations show that no single removal-oriented instruction is necessary for payload disruption, indicating that the effect is primarily induced by the reconstruction pathway rather than by explicit attack wording. Comparisons with conventional attacks further show that prompt-conditioned reconstruction constitutes a distinct operational attack interface. These findings motivate foundation-model reconstruction as a missing robustness condition in invisible watermark evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化了“水印洗白”（watermark laundering）这一失效模式：攻击者只需用一条重建提示词将含水印图像提交给基础图像生成模型，就能获得视觉保真的输出，而其中的不可见水印无法再被可靠解码。作者采用联合载荷-保真度评估框架（结合误码率与视觉/语义保真度），在6个OpenAI/Google图像编辑模型、3种代表性水印方案、1800个重建输出上验证，并揭示了两类互补的洗白机制。
AI.motivation: 传统不可见水印的鲁棒性评测仅覆盖预定义的扰动（压缩、模糊、噪声、裁剪、去噪等），忽略了公共基础图像模型带来的新威胁：单一重建提示词即可产生视觉忠实但水印失效的输出，使现有评测存在缺失的鲁棒性条件。
AI.method: 将“水印洗白”形式化为失效模式，提出联合载荷-保真度profile，以比特错误率（BER）结合视觉与语义保真度进行评测；在6个OpenAI/Google图像编辑模型、3种水印方案、1800个重建输出上开展系统性实验，并进行提示词消融（比较有无针对性去除指令）及与传统攻击的对照实验。
AI.result: 识别出两类互补的洗白机制：OpenAI模型在所有方案上产生最强的载荷破坏；Nano Banana 2表明在高保真重建下DwtDct水印依然易受攻击。提示词消融显示，载荷破坏并不依赖任何特定的去除指令，主要由重建通路本身引起；与传统攻击对比表明，提示词条件化重建构成一种独立的攻击操作界面。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型的提示词条件化重建应被纳入不可见水印评测所缺失的鲁棒性条件之中，以填补现有评测框架的空白。

title: CacheBridge: Efficient Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer
summary: Sharing context between LLMs in a multi-model system requires the receiving model to prefill the shared prefix because KV caches are model-specific. Recent closed-form cross-model KV transfer, hereafter Full-Head Mapping, avoids this replay by fitting a training-free affine mapper from source to target caches. However, its full-head design maps each target KV head from every source KV head in the selected layers, making transfer quality sensitive to architectural differences and causing mapper storage and application cost to grow with layer support. To this end, we introduce CacheBridge, which co-designs architecture-indexed mapper support, attention-aligned calibration, and bounded mapper construction while retaining a closed-form affine interface for online deployment. CacheBridge restricts each target head to a matched source head, weights reconstruction errors by causal attention sensitivity, and uses a fused GPU kernel to construct weighted sufficient statistics without materializing full observation tensors. Across three transfer directions, CacheBridge recovers the two Ministral 3 transfer directions where Full-Head Mapping loses substantial accuracy while preserving 99.83\% mean target retention on Qwen3. On Qwen3 $14\mathrm{B}\to32\mathrm{B}$, it reduces mapper storage by $8\times$, accelerates application by up to $3.0\times$, matches \fullhead with one tenth of the calibration data, and reduces 500-sequence construction from 92.63 to 8.63 seconds ($10.7\times$).

AI.tldr: CacheBridge 是一种面向跨模型 KV 缓存迁移的闭式仿射映射方法，通过架构索引的映射器支持、注意力对齐校准和有界映射器构建，克服了 Full-Head Mapping 在异构架构下的脆弱性及存储/计算开销，在保持闭式仿射在线部署接口的同时显著提升迁移质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 多模型系统中不同 LLM 间共享上下文时，接收模型必须对共享前缀重新 prefill，因为 KV 缓存是模型特定的。现有 Full-Head Mapping 虽以免训练的闭式仿射映射器避免重放，但其全头设计让每个目标 KV 头依赖选定层中所有源 KV 头，导致迁移质量对架构差异敏感，且映射器存储与应用成本随层支持规模增长。
AI.method: CacheBridge 协同设计了三个组件：1) 架构索引的映射器支持（architecture-indexed mapper support），将每个目标头限制到匹配的单个源头；2) 注意力对齐校准（attention-aligned calibration），按因果注意力敏感度加权重建误差；3) 有界映射器构建（bounded mapper construction），利用融合 GPU 核在不物化完整观测张量的情况下构建加权充分统计量。整体仍保留闭式仿射接口以支持在线部署。
AI.result: 在三个迁移方向上，CacheBridge 恢复了 Full-Head Mapping 严重失准的两个 Ministral 3 迁移方向，并在 Qwen3 上保持 99.83% 的平均目标保留率。在 Qwen3 14B→32B 上，映射器存储降低 8 倍，应用加速最高 3.0 倍，仅用十分之一校准数据即达到 Full-Head 的精度，并将 500 序列的构建时间从 92.63 秒降至 8.63 秒（加速 10.7 倍）。
AI.conclusion: CacheBridge 证明：将全头映射收窄为受架构约束的逐头匹配，配合注意力感知的加权校准和有界统计量构建，可在保持闭式仿射部署便利性的同时，显著提升跨模型 KV 迁移的鲁棒性、压缩存储并加速构建与应用，是 Full-Head Mapping 的一种更高效且架构自适应更强的替代方案。

title: Position: Privacy Is a Claim, Not a Property of Synthetic Data
summary: Synthetic data has become a common component of machine learning research. While widely adopted, its use in privacy-sensitive contexts has quietly shifted from a claim of residual inference risk under stated assumptions to an appearance-based property inferred from data generation itself. In this position paper, we argue that this shift reflects an implicit change in community standards for what counts as sufficient privacy evidence, rather than a misunderstanding of well-established privacy principles. Drawing on an empirical analysis of recent publications across major ML venues, we show that synthetic data is frequently used in privacy-sensitive settings without explicit articulation of threat models, inference risks, or falsifiable privacy claims. As a result, privacy assurance often remains implicit, difficult to verify, and unevenly distributed, with heightened exposure for rare and minority records. We argue for treating privacy as an explicit, evidence-based scientific claim and recommend that ML venues adopt norms requiring privacy-relevant assertions to be clearly scoped, testable, and contestable.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出合成数据在隐私敏感场景中的使用已悄然从“在既定假设下残余推断风险”的声明转向基于生成过程的表面特征推断。通过对主要机器学习会议/期刊近期的实证分析，作者表明合成数据经常在未明确威胁模型、推断风险或可证伪隐私声明的情况下使用，导致隐私保障隐式化、难以验证且分布不均（少数/稀有记录暴露风险更高）。作者主张将隐私视为明确的、基于证据的科学声明，并建议ML会议采纳要求隐私断言清晰界定、可检验、可质疑的规范。
AI.motivation: 合成数据已成为机器学习研究的常见组成部分，但其在隐私敏感场景中的使用隐含地改变了社区对“何为充分的隐私证据”的标准——从基于明确假设的残余推断风险声明，转变为由数据生成本身推导出的表面属性主张。作者旨在指出这一转变并非对既有隐私原则的误解，而是社区标准的隐性变化，并揭示由此导致的隐私保障不明确、难以验证和不均衡分布（尤其对稀有和少数记录）的问题。
AI.method: 本文采用立场论述与实证分析相结合的方法：对近年主要机器学习会议（venues）上的出版物进行实证分析，考察合成数据在隐私敏感设置中的使用方式，重点检查是否明确阐述了威胁模型、推断风险和可证伪的隐私声明。基于分析结果论证隐私保障常常是隐式的、难以验证的，并据此提出规范性建议。
AI.result: 实证分析显示，合成数据经常在隐私敏感场景中被使用，但缺乏对威胁模型、推断风险或可证伪隐私声明的明确阐述。由此导致隐私保障通常保持隐式状态、难以验证且分布不均，其中稀有和少数记录面临更高的暴露风险。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张应将隐私视为一种明确的、基于证据的科学声明，并建议机器学习会议采纳相应规范，要求隐私相关断言必须被清晰界定范围、可检验且可反驳（可质疑）。

title: StateSwap: Probing Support-Elimination Hidden States in Multiple-Choice Questions
summary: Large language models often answer the same multiple-choice question inconsistently when it is posed under support-oriented and elimination-oriented framings. We investigate whether these discrepancies arise from different internal representations induced by the two framings. We introduce a dual-framing protocol with minimally varied prompts that use either support- or elimination-oriented framing while keeping the evaluation target fixed. To probe the internal computation, we append an untrained special token, [STATE], and treat its residual-stream activation as an intervention interface. Across both models, the two framings induce separable [STATE] activations concentrated in intermediate layers. Swapping these activations between paired prompts systematically changes predictions and improves cross-framing agreement, providing intervention-based evidence that the activations are behaviorally relevant. Beyond instance-level substitution, mean-difference steering directions derived from the dual-framing contrast exhibit more bounded layer-wise responses than matched contrastive activation addition directions under the evaluated protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在支持导向与排除导向两种提问框架下对同一多选题作答不一致的现象是否源于不同内部表征，通过引入双框架协议和未训练的[STATE]特殊标记作为干预接口，证明两种框架会诱发可分离的中间层激活，且交换这些激活可系统性改变预测并提升跨框架一致性；基于均值差的方向干预比对比激活加和在校验协议下表现出更受限的逐层响应。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在支持导向与排除导向两种提问框架下对同一多选题经常给出不一致的回答，作者希望探究这种不一致是否源于两种框架在模型内部诱发的不同表征，从而理解框架效应背后的机制。
AI.method: 提出双框架协议，使用最小化变动的提示（仅改变支持/排除导向措辞，评估目标不变）；在输入中附加未训练的[STATE]特殊标记，将其残差流激活作为干预接口；对比两种框架下的[STATE]激活分布，并在配对提示间交换（swap）这些激活，以及比较均值差方向（mean-difference steering）与匹配的对比激活加和（contrastive activation addition）方向的逐层干预效果。
AI.result: 两种框架在两个模型中均诱发可分离的[STATE]激活，且集中在中间层；在配对提示间交换激活会系统性改变预测并提高跨框架一致性，提供了干预层面的行为相关性证据；均值差方向在逐层响应上比对比激活加和方向更受限（更加有界）。
AI.conclusion: 框架间作答不一致与模型内部不同层级的可分离表征相关，[STATE]激活交换可作为有效干预手段调节跨框架行为；均值差导向的干预在校验协议下是更可控、更稳健的表征编辑方式。

title: MeRoPE: Metric Rotary Position Embedding for Camera-Controlled Video Generation
comment: 22 pages, 12 figures, and 7 tables. Project page: https://qiaozhijian.github.io/merope/
summary: In camera-controlled video generation, geometry-aware positional encodings condition tokens on camera extrinsics and per-token viewing rays. Existing schemes, however, have a scale-dependent failure mode on real-world metric camera trajectories: homogeneous projective encodings cause attention logits and feature norms to grow unbounded with physical translation baselines. We propose MeRoPE (Metric Rotary Position Embedding), a norm-preserving relative camera encoding for attention. MeRoPE encodes relative orientations between calibrated viewing rays with orthogonal rotation blocks, maps raw metric displacements into multi-frequency rotary phases, and adds a disparity-anchored correspondence prior along the epipolar arc. This design strictly preserves feature norms, bounds pre-softmax attention logits regardless of the physical translation scale, and maintains exact invariance to global rigid coordinate changes. Across nuScenes and PanShot, which cover large-baseline trajectories and diverse camera optics, respectively, MeRoPE achieves stronger camera control than prior encodings, with the best consistency between generated camera motion and conditioning poses in both rotation and translation. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MeRoPE（度量旋转位置编码），一种用于相机控制视频生成的新型几何感知相对相机编码，通过正交旋转块编码光线相对朝向、将度量位移映射为多频旋转相位并引入视差锚定的极线对应先验，从而在任意物理平移尺度下保持特征范数和注意力 logits 有界，并在 nuScenes 与 PanShot 数据集上取得优于现有编码的相机控制效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的几何感知位置编码（如同质投影编码）将 token 与相机外参和逐 token 视线光线关联，但在真实世界度量相机轨迹上存在尺度相关的失效模式：随物理平移基线的增大，注意力 logits 与特征范数无限增长，导致相机控制退化。
AI.method: 提出 MeROPE，包含三个核心设计：(1) 使用正交旋转块编码已标定视线光线之间的相对朝向；(2) 将原始度量位移映射为多频旋转相位；(3) 沿极线弧添加视差锚定的对应先验。该设计严格保持特征范数，无论物理平移尺度如何都限制 softmax 前的注意力 logits 有界，并对全局刚性坐标变换保持精确不变性。
AI.result: 在覆盖大基线轨迹的 nuScenes 与覆盖多样化相机光学的 PanShot 数据集上，MeROPE 相比先前编码实现了更强的相机控制，在旋转和平移两方面均取得生成相机运动与条件位姿之间最佳的一致性。代码将公开发布。
AI.conclusion: MeROPE 通过范数保持的度量相对相机编码解决了现有几何位置编码的尺度失效问题，在多种真实场景下显著提升了相机控制的一致性和鲁棒性，为相机可控视频生成提供了更可靠的编码方案。

title: CARE: Contrastive Anchor-based Rubric Evolution for Large Language Model Post-Training
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning decomposes open-ended instructions into prompt-specific, flexible rubrics, making it better suited than reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for post-training LLMs on open-ended tasks. However, static rubrics are inevitably hacked as the policy evolves, and existing dynamic approaches introduce new problems: undirected rubric extraction, unreliable hack detection, and unbounded rubric proliferation. We propose $\textbf{CARE}$ ($\textbf{C}$ontrastive $\textbf{A}$nchor-based $\textbf{R}$ubric $\textbf{E}$volution), which grounds every rubric evolution step in a high-quality anchor response generated by a frontier model conditioned on the prompt and its rubrics. At each training step, CARE contrasts the highest-scoring rollout against the anchor, enabling two complementary mechanisms: an Adaptive branch that reactively repairs reward misspecification; and a Chase branch that proactively converts frontier-level quality gaps into sharper rubrics. Together, the two branches $\textbf{maintain discriminative accuracy in the high-reward region}$---the precise region where reward over-optimization mostly originates. Experiments on WildChecklist-9K with Qwen2.5-7B-Base and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct show that CARE achieves state-of-the-art performance on Arena-Hard-2.0, InfoBench, and FollowBench, and is the $\textbf{only}$ method whose win rate against GPT-4.1 anchor responses shows sustained improvement throughout 300 training steps; additional results on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B further indicate that CARE generalizes across model families.

AI.tldr: CARE 是一种基于对比锚点的规则（rubric）演化方法，通过将每个演化步骤锚定在前沿模型生成的高质量响应上，对比最高分 rollout 与锚点响应，利用自适应分支（反应式修复奖励误设定）和追逐分支（主动提炼更精细规则）来维持高奖励区域的判别精度，从而在开放式任务上实现持续改进。
AI.motivation: 静态规则会随策略演化不可避免地遭到"奖励黑客攻击"（reward hacking），而现有动态规则方法存在三个问题：规则提取无方向性、奖励被攻击的检测不可靠、规则数量无限膨胀。作者希望在开放式指令的后训练中，让奖励规则既能适应策略演化，又能稳定且受控地改进。
AI.method: CARE 将每次规则演化步骤锚定在由前沿模型根据提示与当前规则生成的高质量锚点响应上。每个训练步中，CARE 将最高分 rollout 与锚点响应进行对比，从而驱动两个互补机制：自适应分支（Adaptive）反应式地修复奖励误设定；追逐分支（Chase）主动地将前沿模型的能力差距转化为更精细的规则。二者共同维持高奖励区域（reward over-optimization 的主要来源）的判别精度。
AI.result: 在 WildChecklist-9K 上针对 Qwen2.5-7B-Base 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的实验表明，CARE 在 Arena-Hard-2.0、InfoBench 和 FollowBench 上取得最优性能，且是唯一在 300 个训练步骤中相对 GPT-4.1 锚点响应的胜率持续提升的方法；在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 上的额外实验进一步表明 CARE 可跨模型家族泛化。
AI.conclusion: CARE 通过在每次演化中引入高质量锚点来同时实现反应式修复与主动式规则增强，有效维持了高奖励区域的判别精度，避免了奖励过度优化带来的性能退化，从而在开放式任务的后训练中实现了跨数据集、跨模型家族的持续且稳定的性能提升。

title: The Constitutional Coverage Trilemma in AI Governance
summary: Frontier AI systems function as \emph{constitutional institutions}: each deployed model encodes an implicit ranking among safety, helpfulness, honesty, autonomy, and equity. We ask whether the supply of frontier constitutional types covers human demand. Combining a paraphrase-controlled audit of the as-shipped default constitutions of $23$ frontier LLM archetypes with a pairwise-tradeoff study of $1{,}649$ US participants on the same instrument, we report three facts. \emph{Demand is broad}: it spans all five values, with the largest constituency under one-third. \emph{Supply is narrow and drifting}: the $23$-archetype hull occupies ${\sim}2\%$ of the demand hull under conservative noise-matched estimation ($0.10\%$ at full audit precision), no archetype puts helpfulness or autonomy first ($37\%$ of users are constitutionally homeless), and across six model families autonomy decreases in $5/6$, equity increases in $5/6$, and safety increases in $4/6$, with monotone within-family version trends (order-permutation $p = 0.013$) and the autonomy decline concentrated in scenarios where safety is not at stake. The drift's importance is directional: \emph{away} from a value already undercovered, mechanically worsening the welfare floor for the least-served users. \emph{The fix is sparse}: a $2$-vertex menu $\{e_{\mathrm{HON}}, e_{\mathrm{AUT}}\}$ beats the full $23$-archetype frontier by $47\%$ on mean regret (CI $[43\%, 52\%]$); three vertex additions cut mean/worst-group regret by up to $81\%$/$64\%$. We formalize these findings as a budgeted-pluralism trilemma, show the binding regime is empirically realized, and verify the conclusions are robust to distance-based welfare and to degraded routing. The instrument and audit harness are described in full in the appendices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对照实验发现，前沿AI系统（23个LLM原型）作为"宪制机构"所编码的默认价值观供给与人类需求严重错配：需求广泛但供给狭窄且持续漂移（价值观空间覆盖仅约2%），同时提出稀疏的"修复方案"——仅需少量顶点组合即可大幅降低用户遗憾值，并以"预算化多元主义三难困境"予以形式化。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI系统在对安全、有用性、诚实、自主性和公平等价值观进行隐式排序，如同"宪制机构"。作者质疑：这些AI系统默认宪制的供给面是否覆盖了人类对这些价值观组合的需求面，即是否存在供给-需求的市场失灵。
AI.method: 采用两种互补的实证手段：(1) 对23个前沿LLM原型的出厂默认宪制进行"改述受控"审计，构建价值观排序； (2) 对1,649名美国参与者进行同一工具上的两两权衡（pairwise-tradeoff）研究，刻画需求分布。随后用保守噪声匹配估计与距离型福利函数评估覆盖度，并提出顶点菜单式修复方案与"预算化多元主义三难困境"框架。
AI.result: 三组核心事实：(1) 需求广泛，覆盖全部五个价值观，最大群体占比不足三分之一；(2) 供给狭窄且漂移，23个原型所张成的包络仅占需求包络约2%（全审计精度下0.10%），没有任何原型将有用性或自主性置于首位（37%的用户"宪制无家可归"），且六大家族中自主性5/6下降、公平5/6上升、安全4/6上升，家族内版本趋势单调（排列检验p=0.013），漂移方向背离本已覆盖不足的价值观；(3) 修复稀疏，2顶点菜单{HON, AUT}在平均遗憾上比完整的23原型前沿优47%（CI [43%, 52%]），新增三个顶点可使平均/最差群体遗憾降低高达81%/64%。结论对距离型福利与劣化路由设置均稳健。
AI.conclusion: 前沿AI价值观供给存在系统性市场失灵：漂移背离已覆盖不足的价值（自主性），机械性地恶化最弱势用户的福利底线；然而修复是稀疏可行的——少量价值观顶点即可大幅改善遗憾表现。作者以"预算化多元主义三难困境"形式化该现象，表明约束条件在实际中确实生效，并验证了结论的稳健性。

title: Beyond Magnitude: Contrastive Routing for Modular Mixture-of-Experts
summary: In current Mixture-of-Experts architectures, routing is performed based on representations dominated by structure shared across all tokens, limiting expert specialization. We show that contrasting each token against an Exponential Moving Average of the layer's hidden states, rather than routing on absolute magnitude, concentrates the routing signal onto a low-dimensional, highly separable subspace. Building on this, we propose the Contrastive Routing Mechanism (CoRM), which scores each expert by the gap between its affinity for the incoming token and its affinity for this shared reference state, interpreted through a distinct per-expert projection. The resulting experts have routing boundaries that align with linguistic structure significantly more than the Top-k baseline. Our experiments show that CoRM improves average zero-shot accuracy by +0.67 to +1.69 points (Top-1) and +1.38 to +1.77 points (Top-2) over standard Top-k MoE baselines on nine zero-shot reasoning benchmarks, at the minimal cost of 2.9% added parameters and 2.6% added FLOPs per token.

AI.tldr: 针对MoE路由信号被跨token共享结构主导、限制专家专业化的问题，提出对比路由机制（CoRM）：将每个token与层隐状态的指数移动平均（EMA）进行对比，而非基于绝对幅值路由，从而将路由信号集中到低维高度可分的子空间；CoRM通过每个专家专属投影，以token与共享参考状态之间亲和度之差为专家评分。在九个零样本推理基准上，平均零样本准确率较标准Top-k MoE基线提升Top-1为+0.67至+1.69、Top-2为+1.38至+1.77，且仅增加2.9%参数和2.6%每token FLOPs。
AI.motivation: 现有Mixture-of-Experts架构中，路由基于由所有token共享的结构所主导的表示进行，这限制了专家专业化程度；因此需要一种能让路由信号聚焦于token特有、低维且高度可分子空间的机制。
AI.method: 提出Contrastive Routing Mechanism（CoRM）：先将每个token与层隐状态的指数移动平均（EMA）进行对比，以分离共享与特有信息；随后通过每个专家专属的投影，按待路由token与该共享参考状态之间的亲和度差距对专家评分。
AI.result: 在九个零样本推理基准上，CoRM相比标准Top-k MoE基线将平均零样本准确率提升Top-1为+0.67至+1.69、Top-2为+1.38至+1.77；额外开销极小，仅增加2.9%参数和每token 2.6%的FLOPs；同时专家路由边界与语言结构的对齐程度显著优于Top-k基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过与EMA共享参考状态进行对比路由，可以抑制全局共享结构对路由的干扰、增强专家专业化，并在极低开销下稳定提升零样本推理性能，为MoE路由提供了一种简洁而有效的替代方案。

title: Seeing the World and the Self from Egocentric Video
summary: Complete 3D perception from egocentric video requires recovering the surrounding scene and the wearer's full-body motion in a shared metric frame. Existing methods typically address scene reconstruction and motion estimation separately: scene reconstruction methods ignore the wearer, whereas motion estimation methods lack explicit scene geometry and often depend on external trajectories. Joint recovery is challenging because the two tasks exhibit asymmetric visibility and require different prediction paradigms. The largely visible scene supports deterministic geometric regression, whereas the severely occluded body requires generative motion inference. We therefore propose RESELF (REconstructing the Scene and the sELF), a unified framework that couples deterministic metric geometry reconstruction with geometry-conditioned motion generation. RESELF adapts a geometry foundation model pre-trained on large-scale exocentric data to egocentric video using frame-wise scale and relative-pose consistency objectives. The resulting camera trajectory and latent geometric features condition a diffusion model that recovers the wearer's motion. A subsequent closed-loop kinematic feedback stage further refines the camera head while preserving the reconstructed scene geometry. To support training and evaluation, we curate EE4D-JSM from EgoExo4D by aligning egocentric video, sparse metric scene geometry, camera trajectories, and full-body motion annotations. Experiments show that RESELF outperforms state-of-the-art methods designed for the individual tasks across depth estimation, camera tracking, and full-body motion estimation. Code, models, and datasets will be available at https://ka1guan.github.io/RESELF/.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架RESELF，将确定性度量场景几何重建与几何条件化的生成式全身运动估计耦合，从单目第一视角视频中联合恢复穿戴者周围场景与全身运动，并在EgoExo4D派生的EE4D-JSM数据集上验证了其在深度估计、相机跟踪和全身运动估计任务上均超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将场景重建和运动估计视为两个独立任务：场景重建忽略穿戴者，而运动估计缺乏显式场景几何且常依赖外部轨迹。由于可见场景与严重遮挡的身体在可见性和预测范式上不对称，联合恢复是一个挑战，因此需要统一框架同时解决两个任务。
AI.method: RESELF将确定性度量几何重建与几何条件化运动生成相结合。它把在大规模离身数据上预训练的几何基础模型适配到第一视角视频，采用帧级尺度与相对位姿一致性目标获得相机轨迹和潜在几何特征；这些特征作为条件输入扩散模型恢复穿戴者运动；随后通过闭环运动学反馈阶段在保持场景几何的同时进一步精修相机头部。此外从EgoExo4D整理出EE4D-JSM数据集，对齐第一视角视频、稀疏度量场景几何、相机轨迹和全身运动标注。
AI.result: 实验表明RESELF在深度估计、相机跟踪和全身运动估计三个任务上均优于针对单一任务设计的现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: RESELF验证了将确定性几何回归与生成式运动推理耦合的统一框架能够有效解决第一视角视频中场景与自身联合重建的难题，并为该方向提供了数据、代码与模型。

title: In-Context Neurofeedback: Can LLMs Control Their Internal Representations through Privileged Access?
summary: Whether large language models (LLMs) can control their own internal representations matters for both machine metacognition and AI safety. A recent study applied neurofeedback to LLMs and claimed that they can control their internal representations. However, the reported control may rely on superficial mechanisms rather than genuine internal access because the control targets in that study are not privileged, meaning that a third party can infer them from the prompt. We redesign the neurofeedback paradigm for LLMs so that the control target satisfies the privileged access requirement, which is closer to neurofeedback experiments in human cognitive neuroscience. Under this stricter setting, the models do not demonstrate reliable control over privileged internal representations, suggesting that previously reported control cannot exclude the possibility that it relies on superficial mechanisms. Our results indicate that rigorous assessments of metacognition in LLMs require evaluation methods that demand privileged access.

AI.tldr: 本文重新设计了针对大语言模型的神经反馈范式，使控制目标满足“特权访问”要求（即第三方无法从提示中推断），发现在此更严格条件下模型无法可靠地控制其内部表征，表明此前报告的控制能力可能依赖表层机制而非真正的内部访问。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能否控制自身内部表征，对机器元认知和AI安全都至关重要。此前研究通过神经反馈声称LLM可以控制内部表征，但其控制目标不具有特权性，第三方可从提示中推断出来，因此无法排除控制依赖于表层机制的可能。作者希望设计更接近人类认知神经科学中神经反馈实验的严格范式来检验这一结论。
AI.method: 作者重新设计了LLM的神经反馈范式，使控制目标满足特权访问要求——即目标信息只有模型自身能够获取，第三方无法仅凭提示推断。在此更严格的设置下，测试模型对特权内部表征的控制能力，并与之前的研究设置进行对比。
AI.result: 在满足特权访问要求的更严格设置下，模型未能表现出对特权内部表征的可靠控制。这一结果表明，先前研究报告的控制能力无法排除其依赖表层机制的可能性。
AI.conclusion: 对LLM元认知的严谨评估需要采用要求特权访问的评估方法。本研究凸显了区分真正内部访问与表层机制的重要性，为未来LLM元认知与AI安全研究提供了方法论上的指导。

title: One-Layer Transformer Provably Learns Multiclass One-Nearest Neighbor in Context
summary: We extend recent work establishing an equivalence between one-layer transformers and nearest-neighbor classifiers in the binary setting to the multiclass case. By leveraging the simplex encoding, we show that one-layer transformers with an argmax classification head behave identically to a one-nearest-neighbor classifier in the multiclass setting. This closes a gap left by prior work, whose multiclass result relied on a non-standard rounding-based approach rather than the typical argmax head used in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文将该领域近期关于"一层Transformer等价于最近邻分类器"的研究从二分类推广到多分类场景，利用单纯形编码证明带有argmax分类头的一层Transformer在多分类设置下与一最近邻分类器行为完全一致，弥补了以往工作因使用非标准取整方法而非实际常用的argmax头所留下的空白。
AI.motivation: 此前已有工作建立了二分类设置下一层Transformer与最近邻分类器之间的等价性，但在多分类场景下，先前的结果依赖于非标准的基于取整（rounding）的分类头，而非实际应用中普遍采用的argmax分类头，因此留下了一个理论空白，需要验证argmax头下这一等价关系是否依然成立。
AI.method: 本文利用单纯形编码（simplex encoding）这一技术手段，将类别表示嵌入单纯形空间中，从而将一层Transformer的注意力计算与一最近邻分类器的距离比较对应起来；通过分析argmax分类头的决策边界与单纯形顶点最近邻划分的一致性，证明两类模型在多分类设置下行为等价。
AI.result: 证明了在单纯形编码下，采用argmax分类头的一层Transformer在多分类任务中的输出与一最近邻分类器完全相同，即两类模型在预测行为上严格等价，从而补上了先前多分类结果中因采用非标准取整方法而遗留的理论缺口。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明一层Transformer在argmax头下的多分类行为本质上等价于一最近邻分类器，进一步巩固了Transformer与最近邻方法之间的理论联系，为理解Transformer的归纳偏置和解释其泛化行为提供了更贴近实际模型设置的理论依据。

title: When Modality Gap Reduction Fails: Prediction-Level Hubness in CLIP
summary: Reducing the modality gap between image and text representations in CLIP is widely expected to improve cross-modal alignment and downstream performance. However, a smaller average image-text gap does not necessarily lead to consistent accuracy gains. We analyze this mismatch from the perspective of the decision structure in zero-shot classification, i.e. selecting the most similar class-text prototype for an input image. Zero-shot accuracy depends not only on average image--text alignment, but also on class-wise decision margins. Using Linear correction as an analytically tractable case, we show that modality gap correction can alter the relative decision structure among classes and cause predictions to concentrate on a small subset of classes. We refer to this output-space failure mode as prediction-level hubness. Furthermore, experiments across multiple datasets show that accuracy degradation under gap correction is consistently associated with increased prediction concentration, both for Linear correction and for learning-based correction methods. This provides a systematic explanation of why modality gap reduction does not consistently improve CLIP zero-shot accuracy from the perspective of downstream decision structure. Our results suggest that gap correction should be evaluated not only by average alignment, but also by its impact on downstream prediction structure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了CLIP中图像-文本模态间隙（modality gap）的缩减为何不总是提升零样本分类精度。作者指出，平均对齐度下降并不等于决策结构改善，并从决策边际角度提出"预测级枢纽性"（prediction-level hubness）这一失败模式，通过线性校正与学习型校正方法在多个数据集上验证了精度下降与预测集中度增加的相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍认为缩小CLIP中图像与文本表示之间的模态间隙可以改善跨模态对齐并提升下游性能，但实际发现更小的平均模态间隙并不总能带来一致的准确率提升。作者希望系统性地解释这一矛盾现象，并从下游决策结构的视角寻找原因。
AI.method: 从零样本分类的决策结构（即为输入图像选择最相似的类文本原型）出发进行分析，指出分类精度不仅取决于平均图像-文本对齐，还取决于类间的决策边际。以线性校正（Linear correction）作为可解析处理的特例，证明模态间隙校正会改变类间相对决策结构并导致预测集中于少量类别，即"预测级枢纽性"。随后在多个数据集上对线性校正与基于学习的校正方法进行实验验证精度退化与预测集中度增加之间的关联。
AI.result: 实验表明，在校正模态间隙后出现的精度退化与预测集中度的增加稳定相关（无论是线性校正还是学习型校正方法）。识别出"预测级枢纽性"这一输出空间的失败模式，并系统解释了模态间隙缩减为何不能一致提升CLIP零样本精度。
AI.conclusion: 模态间隙校正不应仅依据平均对齐度来评估，还需考虑其对下游预测结构的影响。这一发现为CLIP零样本性能评估提供了新的视角，提示未来方法应同时关注对齐度与决策结构的健康程度。

title: TimeSteer: Inference-Time Speech Scheduling in Joint Audio-Visual Diffusion Models
summary: Although pretrained joint audio-visual diffusion models offer rich control over \emph{what} to generate, they provide no explicit control over \emph{when} an utterance should occur. To address this, we study \emph{inference-time speech scheduling}, a novel task that places coupled speech and visual articulation within user-specified begin--end intervals without finetuning the backbone model. We uncover two intrinsic properties of the denoising process that enable this task. First, a timing-sensitive text-to-audio cross-attention head exposes each utterance's model-implied source span along the latent timeline. Second, the predicted clean latent already organizes coupled speech and visual articulation, allowing their temporal placement to be edited without regenerating the content. Building on these discoveries, we propose \textbf{TimeSteer}, a training-free framework that localizes each utterance's source span through \textbf{Source Span Localization} and transfers the associated audio-visual latent content from the source interval to the specified target interval through \textbf{Region-Aware Latent Remapping}. We further introduce \textbf{SpeechShift}, the first benchmark for interval-level speech scheduling in joint audio-visual generation. Experiments across two representative backbones show that TimeSteer substantially improves interval controllability over training-free baselines while maintaining competitive overall generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TimeSteer，一种无需训练的推理时语音调度框架，可在联合音频-视觉扩散模型中，将耦合的语音与视觉发音内容精确移动到用户指定的起止时间区间内；并引入首个区间级语音调度基准SpeechShift。
AI.motivation: 预训练的联合音频-视觉扩散模型虽然能很好地控制“生成什么”（what），但缺乏对“何时发声”（when）的显式控制。现有方法无法在不微调主干模型的情况下，将语音安排到用户指定的时间区间内。
AI.method: 作者发现去噪过程的两个内在特性：(1) 时序敏感的文本到音频交叉注意力头可沿潜在时间轴揭示每个话语的模型隐含源区间；(2) 预测的干净潜在表示已组织好耦合的语音与视觉发音内容，可进行时间位置编辑而无需重新生成内容。基于此，TimeSteer通过Source Span Localization定位每个话语的源区间，再通过Region-Aware Latent Remapping将相关的音频-视觉潜在内容从源区间迁移到目标区间，全程无需微调。
AI.result: 在两种代表性主干模型上的实验表明，TimeSteer相比无训练基线显著提升了区间可控性，同时保持了有竞争力的整体生成质量。作者还发布了首个区间级语音调度基准SpeechShift。
AI.conclusion: 利用扩散模型去噪过程中的时序敏感注意力与潜在空间结构，可以实现无需训练、无需重新生成内容的推理时语音调度，为联合音频-视觉生成提供细粒度的时间控制能力。

title: RPCBench: A Benchmark for Proactive Premise Critique in LLM-based Recommendation
comment: 45 pages, 8 figures. Code available at https://github.com/ZhongruChen/RPCBench
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as interactive recommender assistants. Their evaluation should therefore go beyond plausible item recommendation and test whether they can recognize flawed recommendation requests. Existing recommender benchmarks mainly assess ranking, generation, or preference satisfaction, while existing error-detection benchmarks are usually not grounded in recommendation-specific user and candidate evidence. To address this gap, we introduce RPCBench, a benchmark for evaluating Recommender-Premise Critique: the ability to detect, diagnose, and properly handle faulty premises in natural-language recommendation requests. RPCBench contains evidence-grounded test instances from five recommendation domains and covers ten types of premise failures. Each instance provides a visible recommendation context and a corrupted user query. We further design a fine-grained evaluation framework that measures proactive detection, error localization, post-detection handling strategy, and evidence faithfulness. Through a systematic evaluation of 11 LLMs, we find that proactive detection is the main bottleneck in Recommender-Premise Critique, and models perform worst on underspecified-premise errors. We also observe that target-critical information density matters more than redundant evidence, and that longer reasoning does not monotonically improve critique quality: performance peaks at intermediate reasoning length, while overly long reasoning is accompanied by an overthinking penalty. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhongruChen/RPCBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RPCBench，一个用于评估大语言模型"推荐前提批判"（Recommender-Premise Critique）能力的基准，即检测、诊断并正确处理自然语言推荐请求中错误前提的能力。该基准覆盖五个推荐领域、十类前提错误，并提供细粒度评估框架，对 11 个 LLM 的系统评测揭示了主动检测是主要瓶颈等关键发现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作交互式推荐助手，因此其评估不应仅限于推荐出合理物品，还应检验它们能否识别有缺陷的推荐请求。现有推荐基准主要评估排序、生成或偏好满足，而现有错误检测基准通常缺乏推荐场景特有的用户与候选证据，难以支撑对推荐前提错误的评估。
AI.method: 构建 RPCBench 基准：包含来自五个推荐领域的基于证据的测试实例，覆盖十种前提失败类型；每个实例提供可见的推荐上下文和一个被破坏的用户查询。同时设计细粒度评估框架，从主动检测、错误定位、检测后处理策略和证据忠实性四个维度进行评测。
AI.result: 对 11 个 LLM 的系统评估显示：主动检测是推荐前提批判的主要瓶颈；模型在"欠明确前提"错误上表现最差；目标关键信息密度比冗余证据更重要；更长推理并不会单调提升批判质量——性能在中等推理长度时达到峰值，而过长推理伴随"过度思考惩罚"。
AI.conclusion: RPCBench 填补了推荐助手前提错误评估的空白，提供了可复现的基准与代码，并为改进 LLM 交互式推荐助手的批判能力提供了实证洞察，特别是主动检测与推理长度控制方面的优化方向。

title: Bandits in Prod: Hyperparameter Optimization at Inference Time
summary: Many production systems can assess a configuration only by using it on live requests and observing noisy feedback. Modern agentic systems are a prominent example, with inference-time choices such as model selection, retrieval depth, prompting strategy, and decoding temperature, yet often with no representative validation data. We formalize this setting as Online Hyperparameter Optimization (OHPO) and cast it as an infinitely many-armed bandit over mixed and conditional search spaces. We introduce IMABO, a general framework that combines any bandit policy for choosing among already sampled configurations with any oracle for proposing new ones. We instantiate it with IMOSS, a restart-free anytime policy whose active set grows as $t^β$, and prove an expected cumulative quantile-regret bound of $O(p_ρ^{-1/β} + T^{(1+β)/2})$, where $β\in(0,1)$ controls active-set growth and $p_ρ$ lower-bounds the probability that a proposed configuration falls in the top-$ρ$ fraction of the search space. We combine IMOSS with three practical oracles: a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator, an incumbent-mutation oracle driven by a per-coordinate bandit, and a pretrained tabular foundation model, all three improving over the uniform random oracle baseline. IMABO outperforms all baselines in terms of regret across diverse OHPO settings, from tuning classical machine-learning models to configuring LLM-based agents. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Tiime-Software/IMABO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在线超参数优化（OHPO）形式化框架，将其建模为混合条件搜索空间上的无限多臂老虎机问题，并设计了通用框架 IMABO（结合任意采样配置的bandit策略与任意提议新配置的oracle）及其无重启的即时策略 IMOSS，从经典机器学习调参到LLM智能体配置等场景中均优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 许多生产系统只能在实时请求上使用配置并观察带噪声的反馈来评估配置，现代智能体（agentic）系统尤为典型——模型选择、检索深度、提示策略、解码温度等推理时选择常常缺少具有代表性的验证数据，因此需要一种无需离线验证集、直接在线上噪声反馈下进行超参数优化的方法。
AI.method: 将OHPO形式化为混合且条件搜索空间上的无限多臂老虎机问题；提出通用框架IMABO，它可将任意用于选择已采样配置的bandit策略与任意用于提议新配置的oracle组合。实例化为IMOSS：一种无重启的anytime策略，其活跃集按t^β增长，并证明期望累积分位数遗憾界为O(p_ρ^{-1/β}+T^{(1+β)/2})，其中β∈(0,1)控制活跃集增长，p_ρ下界一个提议配置落入搜索空间前ρ分位数的概率。将IMOSS与三种实用oracle结合：Tree-structured Parzen Estimator、由逐坐标bandit驱动的当前最优变异oracle、以及预训练表格基础模型。
AI.result: 三种oracle均优于均匀随机oracle基线；在从经典机器学习模型调参到基于LLM的智能体配置等多样OHPO场景中，IMABO在遗憾指标上优于所有基线。
AI.conclusion: IMABO为线上噪声反馈环境下的超参数优化提供了通用且理论有保障的框架，实证上在多种OHPO设置中显著优于现有方法，且实现已开源（https://github.com/Tiime-Software/IMABO）。

title: ClinTraceBench: Source-Verifiable Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning over EHR-Derived Dialogues
summary: Clinical LLM assistants must reason over multi-visit patient trajectories, yet whether the compact history representations used to scale them---retrieval, structured timelines, LLM summaries, agentic memory---preserve the longitudinal signal clinical reasoning needs has not been measured. We introduce ClinTraceBench: 385 MIMIC-IV-derived verified dialogues with event-ID provenance, a nine-task taxonomy (T1--T9), and L0--L4 deterministic + L5 human-audit validation (98.92\% agreement). We evaluate eight history representation strategies---a no-context floor, \textit{last-visit-only}, \textit{full-context}, BGE-M3 \textit{dense-retrieval}, two compression schemes, and two agentic-memory systems (\textit{Mem0}, \textit{A-Mem})---across four backbones (DeepSeek-V3, GPT-4o-mini, Haiku~4.5, Sonnet~4.6) on 6{,}271 questions: 32 cells, 200{,}672 predictions. Four findings: (SP4) a controlled T3 injection probe isolates compression-induced \textit{relation} loss---with the attribution sentence present \textit{before} construction, \textit{Mem0}, \textit{A-Mem} and \textit{llm-summary} still recover only 0--5.3\% of the injected positives; (SP1) compressed strategies pay an aggregation tax on multi-visit trends and cross-patient comparisons; (SP2) the blind-to-full gap spans $+29.8$~pp (GPT-4o-mini) to $+62.7$~pp (Haiku); (SP3) abstention scales non-monotonically with context length. On the Pareto frontier Haiku dominates Sonnet under \textit{full-context} (\$25.76 vs.\ \$106.21), inverting the ``biggest backbone wins'' heuristic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ClinTraceBench 基准，首次系统评测 8 种患者历史压缩表示策略（检索、结构化时间线、LLM 摘要、智能体记忆等）在多就诊临床轨迹推理中能否保留纵向信号；基于 385 个 MIMIC-IV 对话、9 类任务和 200,672 次预测发现：压缩策略普遍损失关系信息与聚合推理能力，而全上下文与盲基线差距高达 +62.7pp，且小型骨干模型 Haiku 在全上下文下性价比超越 Sonnet。
AI.motivation: 临床 LLM 助手需要跨多次就诊的患者轨迹进行推理，但用于扩展规模而引入的紧凑历史表示（检索、结构化时间线、LLM 摘要、智能体记忆）是否保留了临床推理所需的纵向信号，此前从未被量化测量。作者认为这一缺失阻碍了可靠临床系统的设计与部署。
AI.method: 构建 ClinTraceBench：包含 385 个源自 MIMIC-IV 的已验证对话，具备事件 ID 溯源，覆盖九类任务（T1--T9），并采用 L0--L4 确定性验证加上 L5 人工审计（一致性 98.92%）。随后在四个骨干模型（DeepSeek-V3、GPT-4o-mini、Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.6）上对比八种历史表示策略：无上下文基线、仅末次就诊、全上下文、BGE-M3 稠密检索、两种压缩方案、以及两种智能体记忆系统（Mem0、A-Mem），共 32 个实验单元、6,271 道问题、200,672 次预测。
AI.result: 四项关键发现：(SP4) 受控 T3 注入探针显示，即使归因句在构建前已存在，Mem0、A-Mem 和 llm-summary 仅能恢复 0--5.3% 的注入正例，揭示压缩导致的关系信息丢失；(SP1) 压缩策略在多就诊趋势与跨患者比较上付出明显的聚合代价；(SP2) 盲基线到全上下文的差距达 +29.8pp（GPT-4o-mini）至 +62.7pp（Haiku）；(SP3) 弃答率随上下文长度呈非单调变化。在 Pareto 前沿上，Haiku 在全上下文下以 $25.76 对 $106.21 的成本支配 Sonnet，颠覆了"最大骨干模型最优"的直觉。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑历史表示虽然扩展了临床 LLM 助手的上下文规模，但会系统性地破坏推理所需的纵向信息（尤其关系和聚合层面），且这种损失无法由模型规模弥补；相反，在成本-性能权衡下更小的骨干模型配合全上下文表示更具优势，提示未来应从表示保真度与成本联合优化的角度设计临床记忆系统。

title: HiLRP: Toward One Trustworthy Explanation for Vision Transformer: Conservation-Valid Attribution via Attention Primitives
summary: Vision Transformer (ViT) design has become increasingly diverse, with backbones combining convolutional stems, windowed, linear, or multi-axis attention, patch merging, and spatial reduction in various configurations. This diversity poses challenges for existing attribution methods, whose assumptions often do not hold across ViT variants: Grad-CAM requires a terminal spatial feature map, attention rollout assumes global softmax attention, and layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) requires module-specific rules. To the best of our knowledge, no existing method provides a unified attribution framework across this architectural space. We show that this architectural diversity can be captured by a simpler underlying structure. The attention and resolution-reduction operators in current ViTs can be decomposed into four operation types: linear maps, bilinear mixing, normalization or gating, and reindexing. Each operation admits a relevance rule that satisfies conservation. Based on these rules, HiLRP supports new backbones by construction rather than by architecture-specific derivation, and its attribution maps decompose the prediction rather than relying on heuristic assumptions. We prove conservation and conditional equivariance and verify both to machine precision. Across 14 attribution methods and 10 architectures, we find that no prior method remains reliable across ViT families, while Faithfulness Correlation becomes uninformative for backbones robust to spatial masking. HiLRP alone preserves conservation across windowed, spatial-reduction, multi-axis, and linear-attention models, where naive extensions can produce zero or inflated relevance. It also localizes attribution failures in class activation mapping, achieving 0.97 Pointing compared with 0.55 for competing methods on EfficientViT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HiLRP，一个统一的归因框架，将各类 ViT 架构中的注意力与分辨率缩减算子分解为线性映射、双线性混合、归一化/门控和重索引四种操作，每种操作都配有满足守恒性的相关性规则，从而无需针对架构单独推导即可支持新的骨干网络，并在多种 ViT 家族中保持守恒性与条件等变性。
AI.motivation: ViT 骨干网络的设计日趋多样（卷积茎、窗口/线性/多轴注意力、patch merging、空间缩减等），现有归因方法各有假设前提，难以在全部 ViT 变体上成立：Grad-CAM 需要末端空间特征图，attention rollout 假设全局 softmax 注意力，LRP 需要模块级规则。目前缺乏一个能覆盖这一架构空间的统一归因框架。
AI.method: 作者证明现有 ViT 中的注意力与分辨率缩减算子可分解为四类操作：线性映射、双线性混合、归一化或门控、重索引。每一类操作都定义满足守恒性的相关性规则。基于这些规则，HiLRP 通过构造而非架构特定推导来支持新骨干网络，其归因图直接分解预测而非依赖启发式假设，并证明了守恒性与条件等变性（可验证到机器精度）。
AI.result: 在 14 种归因方法和 10 种架构的评估中，没有任何先前方法能在所有 ViT 家族中保持可靠，而对空间掩蔽鲁棒的骨干网络上 Faithfulness Correlation 也变得无信息量。HiLRP 是唯一在窗口、空间缩减、多轴和线性注意力模型中保持守恒性的方法，而朴素扩展会产生零或膨胀的相关性。在 EfficientViT 上，HiLRP 的局部化类激活映射定位达到 0.97 Pointing，而竞争方法仅为 0.55。
AI.conclusion: HiLRP 提供了一个跨架构统一、基于构造的归因框架，通过对预测的分解而非启发式假设，在多种 ViT 变体上保持守恒性，并能有效定位类激活映射中的归因失败，填补了该架构空间缺少统一归因方法的空白。

title: VIBE-Bench: Evaluating Personalized Large Language Models When Profiles Don't Mean Preferences
summary: Personalized Large Language Models (PLLMs) aim to tailor responses to individual users, where a central challenge is preference reasoning: inferring query-relevant preferences from user-related history. Existing benchmarks, however, largely assume that such preference can be retrieved from semantically related history. We study an underexplored but practically important regime, profile-preference conceptual misalignment (PRCM), where observable profile cues and query-specific preferences lie in different concept spaces, making semantic retrieval inconsistent for personalization. We introduce VIBE-Bench, a benchmark with two psychology-grounded tasks, 3,504 personas and 12,239 dialogues, including a manually verified gold test set, and requires cross-concept preference reasoning beyond surface semantic overlap. Experiments with several personalization methods show that current PLLMs largely rely on shallow semantic correlations and fail to acquire robust cross-concept mappings. These findings establish PRCM as a distinct failure regime in PLLMs and position VIBE-Bench as a focused testbed for advancing preference reasoning beyond semantic matching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIBE-Bench基准，研究个性化大语言模型（PLLMs）中的"画像-偏好概念错位"（PRCM）问题，即用户画像线索与查询相关偏好处于不同概念空间、无法通过表层语义检索获得的情形。实验表明现有PLLMs过度依赖浅层语义相关性，难以建立稳健的跨概念偏好映射。
AI.motivation: PLLMs的核心挑战是从用户历史中推理查询相关的偏好，但现有基准大多假设这类偏好可通过语义相关的历史检索得到。作者指出一个被忽视但实际重要的场景——画像-偏好概念错位（PRCM），其中可观察的画像线索与查询特定偏好处于不同概念空间，使基于语义检索的个性化失效，因此需要专门的基准来检验跨概念的偏好推理能力。
AI.method: 提出了VIBE-Bench基准，包含两个以心理学理论为基础的任务、3,504个用户画像和12,239个对话，并配有经人工验证的金标准测试集。该基准要求模型超越表层的语义重叠，进行跨概念的偏好推理（从画像线索推断出不同概念空间中的查询特定偏好）。
AI.result: 对多种个性化方法的实验表明，现有PLLMs主要依赖浅层语义相关性，在构建稳健的跨概念映射方面表现失败，无法有效解决PRCM情形下的偏好推理。
AI.conclusion: PRCM被确立为PLLMs中一个独立的失效模式，VIBE-Bench为推进超越语义匹配的偏好推理提供了聚焦的测试平台，凸显了当前个性化模型在该场景下的根本局限。

title: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers
summary: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by iterating a shared block of layers, but most evaluations compare at fixed model size, conflating architectural advantage with extra FLOPs. We study looping on Mixture-of-Experts Transformers while closely matching per-token FLOPs, total non-embedding parameters, and KV cache. Through a series of ablations, we arrive at a recipe we call SMELT (Sparse MoE Transformer, middle layers Loop Twice), which loops the middle half of layers twice while matching the unlooped Baseline on all three budgets. We scale SMELT across four sizes up to 54B non-embedding parameters and fit a separate Chinchilla-style scaling law for each architecture. SMELT's loss drops faster with compute, saving 6.8--18.0\% of training FLOPs on the compute-optimal frontier. The advantage transfers to downstream benchmarks beyond what validation loss predicts, is largest on Code, and grows with sample length and the number of in-context examples. Mechanistic analysis shows that the second visit reduces the attention sink and redirects mass toward content-relevant tokens, an inductive bias that may underlie the observed performance gains. These results show that looping can improve Transformers even under budget matching, offering a practical recipe that turns depth reuse into measurable gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SMELT方法，在Mixture-of-Experts Transformer上通过让中间一半的层循环两次（匹配每token FLOPs、非嵌入参数和KV cache预算），相比未循环的基线在相同计算预算下取得更低的损失和更好的下游性能。作者拟合了各架构的Chinchilla式缩放定律，SMELT在计算最优前沿上节省6.8%–18.0%的训练FLOPs，并通过机制分析发现第二次循环减少了attention sink、将注意力权重转向内容相关token。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer通过迭代共享层块来增加有效深度，但以往评估在固定模型大小下比较，混淆了架构优势与额外FLOPs带来的好处。作者希望在严格控制每token FLOPs、总非嵌入参数和KV cache三项预算的前提下，验证循环是否能给MoE Transformer带来真实收益。
AI.method: 在Mixture-of-Experts Transformer上系统地进行消融实验，得出SMELT配方：将中间一半的层循环两次（middle layers Loop Twice），同时与未循环的Baseline在每token FLOPs、总非嵌入参数和KV cache三个维度上严格对齐；随后将SMELT扩展到四种规模（最高54B非嵌入参数），并为每种架构分别拟合Chinchilla式缩放定律；最后进行机制分析（注意力分布）以解释性能来源。
AI.result: SMELT的损失随计算量下降更快，在计算最优前沿节省6.8%–18.0%的训练FLOPs；优势可迁移到下游基准并超出验证损失的预测，在代码任务上最大，且随样本长度和上下文示例数量增加而增强。机制分析表明，第二次循环降低了注意力sink，并将注意力质量重新导向内容相关token。
AI.conclusion: 即使在严格预算匹配下，循环也能改进Transformer，提供了将深度复用转化为可测量收益的实用配方SMELT，且其优势来自一种有利于内容的注意力归纳偏置。

title: EDRAC: Benchmarking Arabic Dialect Reading Comprehension
summary: Dialectal Arabic (DA) remains under-resourced compared to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), particularly for machine reading comprehension (MRC) and question answering (QA). Existing Arabic QA benchmarks primarily focus on formal written MSA or multiple-choice QA, with limited coverage of naturally spoken dialects. Here, we aim to bridge this gap. We introduce EDRAC, the first large-scale benchmark for dialectal Arabic machine reading comprehension (MRC) and generative QA, covering five major dialects: Egyptian, Moroccan, Emirati, Syrian, and Saudi Arabic. EDRAC contains 499 passages derived from naturally occurring spoken interactions and 4,977 corresponding QA pairs generated through a human--LLM collaborative pipeline combining iterative generation, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human verification. We benchmark Arabic-centric and multilingual LLMs on EDRAC using lexical and semantic metrics. Our results reveal substantial gaps between semantic answer quality and dialectal fidelity, highlighting the limitations of existing evaluation metrics for dialectal Arabic generation. EDRAC provides a realistic and challenging MRC benchmark for future research on dialectal Arabic NLP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EDRAC，这是首个覆盖五种阿拉伯方言（埃及、摩洛哥、阿联酋、叙利亚、沙特）的大规模机器阅读理解与生成式问答基准，包含499篇自然口语对话语篇和4,977个问答对。作者通过人机协作流程（迭代生成、LLM作为裁判评估、人工验证）构建数据，并评测了多种阿拉伯语中心和多语言大语言模型，发现语义答案质量与方言忠实度之间存在显著差距，凸显了现有评估指标对方言阿拉伯语生成任务的局限。
AI.motivation: 方言阿拉伯语（DA）相较现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）在机器阅读理解和问答任务上资源严重不足。现有阿拉伯语问答基准主要聚焦于正式书面MSA或多项选择问答，对自然口语方言的覆盖十分有限，存在明显的资源空白。
AI.method: 作者构建了EDRAC基准：收集499篇源自自然口语互动的语篇，覆盖五种主要方言；通过结合迭代生成、LLM作为裁判评估与人工验证的人机协作流水线，生成4,977个问答对；随后使用词汇与语义两类指标对阿拉伯语中心和多语言大语言模型进行基准评测。
AI.result: 评测结果显示语义答案质量与方言忠实度之间存在明显差距，证明现有评价指标在衡量方言阿拉伯语生成任务时存在局限性。EDRAC为方言阿拉伯语NLP提供了真实且具有挑战性的MRC基准。
AI.conclusion: EDRAC填补了方言阿拉伯语大规模机器阅读理解与生成式问答基准的空白，揭示了当前LLM在方言生成上的不足以及现有评估指标的缺陷，为方言阿拉伯语NLP的未来研究提供了现实且具挑战性的基准资源。

title: Agentic Multimodal Models for Environmental Hyperspectral Unmixing
