summary: Hyperspectral unmixing is a key task in remote sensing that aims to decompose mixed pixels in hyperspectral images into their constituent material signatures, or endmembers, and their fractional abundances. Conventional modular approaches estimate the scene composition through successive model-order estimation, endmember extraction, and abundance estimation stages, whose errors can lead to redundant or ambiguous candidate components and ultimately affect the recovered decomposition. We introduce an algorithm-agnostic, large vision-language model (LVLM)-driven agentic framework that refines the outputs of such pipelines rather than replacing their underlying numerical algorithms. Starting from an initial decomposition, the agent iteratively gathers complementary spectral and spatial evidence through dedicated tools, including spectral-library retrieval and abundance-map visualization, and modifies the active endmember set through merge and discard operations followed by abundance re-estimation. We apply the same refinement procedure to several modular pipelines combining different model-order, extraction, and abundance-estimation methods, and evaluate it on HYDICE Urban, Jasper Ridge, and Stonewall Playa. Experiments show that the proposed agent consistently improves endmember cardinality and generally improves the recovered spectral signatures and abundance maps across heterogeneous modular pipelines, while remaining competitive with integrated end-to-end unmixing methods, including CNN-AE, uDAS, and R-CoNMF. These results highlight the potential of tool-using LVLM agents to combine spectral and spatial evidence for algorithm-agnostic refinement of physically grounded hyperspectral unmixing decompositions. Code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/agentic-hu.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种算法无关的、由大视觉-语言模型（LVLM）驱动的智能体框架，用于精化传统模块化高光谱解混流水线（模型阶数估计、端元提取、丰度估计）的输出。智能体通过工具（光谱库检索、丰度图可视化）迭代收集光谱与空间证据，并通过合并、剔除操作修改活动端元集后重新估计丰度，在多个数据集上一致改善端元数量与分解质量，且与端到端方法（CNN-AE、uDAS、R-CoNMF）保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 传统模块化高光谱解混方法按模型阶数估计、端元提取、丰度估计依次进行，各阶段误差会级联积累，导致候选组件冗余或歧义，最终损害分解质量。现有方法缺乏跨阶段整合光谱与空间证据、并对整体分解进行反馈修正的机制，因此需要一种不替换底层数值算法、而是对其输出进行智能精化的新途径。
AI.method: 提出一个算法无关的智能体框架：以初始分解为起点，由LVLM智能体通过专用工具（光谱库检索、丰度图可视化等）迭代补充光谱与空间证据，并通过合并（merge）和剔除（discard）操作修改活动端元集，随后重新估计丰度；同一精化流程被应用于多种模块化流水线（组合不同模型阶数、提取与丰度估计方法）。
AI.result: 在HYDICE Urban、Jasper Ridge和Stonewall Playa三个数据集上的实验表明，该智能体在不同模块化流水线上一致改善端元基数（cardinality），并普遍提升恢复的光谱签名与丰度图质量；同时与端到端解混方法（CNN-AE、uDAS、R-CoNMF）相比保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，会使用工具的LVLM智能体能够整合光谱与空间证据，以算法无关的方式精化物理上有依据的高光谱解混分解结果，为物理约束的模块化解混流水线提供了一种通用、可扩展的增强范式。

title: Few-Shot Out of Domain Intent Detection with Covariance Corrected Mahalanobis Distance
comment: 1st AAAI Workshop on Uncertainty Reasoning and Quantification in Decision Making
summary: Conversational agents like chatbots and voice assistants are trained to understand and respond to user intents. On encountering an utterance with an intent different from the ones they have been trained on, these agents are expected to classify the intent as `unknown' or `out of domain'. This problem is known as out of domain (OOD) intent detection. Podolskiy et al. (2021), showed that Mahalanobis distance can be used effectively for identifying OOD intents, outperforming competing approaches. However, their method fails to outperform the baselines in the practically important few-shot setting. In this paper we analyze the reason for low performance and propose a covariance corrected Mahalanobis distance for detecting out-of-domain intents.

AI.tldr: 针对对话式代理（如聊天机器人和语音助手）的域外意图检测问题，本文分析了 Mahalanobis 距离方法在少样本设置下表现不佳的原因，并提出一种协方差校正的 Mahalanobis 距离方法来改进域外意图检测。
AI.motivation: 对话式代理常会遇到训练时未见过的用户意图，需要将其正确识别为“未知”或“域外”（OOD）。Podolskiy 等人（2021）证明 Mahalanobis 距离能有效检测 OOD 意图并优于现有方法，但该方法在实际重要的少样本（few-shot）设置下无法超越基线，因此需要分析其性能低下的原因并加以改进。
AI.method: 本文首先分析 Mahalanobis 距离在少样本场景下表现不佳的原因，随后提出一种协方差校正的 Mahalanobis 距离（covariance corrected Mahalanobis distance），通过修正协方差估计来提升少样本条件下的 OOD 意图检测性能。
AI.result: 所提出的协方差校正 Mahalanobis 距离能够在少样本设置下有效检测域外意图，弥补了原方法在该场景下的不足，其性能优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过分析少样本设置下 Mahalanobis 距离失效的根源并提出协方差校正方案，本文提供了一种更稳健、适用于数据稀缺场景的 OOD 意图检测方法。

title: Contribution-Aware Bandwidth Allocation for Multimodal Split Learning
summary: Multimodal models are increasingly the default option for perception at the network edge, yet they are trained almost entirely in the datacenter, because a client holding several sensor streams cannot host an encoder per modality. Split Learning makes such training feasible by keeping only the first layers on the device, at the cost of an uplink that must carry smashed activations for every modality at every step. Existing compression schemes give each modality the same keep-ratio, so the shared budget is divided in proportion to smashed-activation dimension, a quantity unrelated to how much each modality contributes to the fused prediction. We make that division an explicit decision and call it inter-modality allocation: under a fixed uplink budget, every policy transmits the same expected payload and differs only in how that payload is split across modalities. Our allocator, ModalShare, sets each modality's keep-ratio from a Shapley contribution score that the server computes over coalitions of activations it has already received. Measuring this score adds no uplink traffic and no client-side computation, and needs no prior knowledge of which stream is which. ModalShare improves accuracy over equal keep-ratios by 15.4 and 12.4 percentage points on CREMA-D and MVSA at matched payload in 5x compression, with strong performance across three compressors, three datasets, and four budgets. We show that existing compressors underperform in multimodal settings, with ModalShare recovering what gains are left behind.

AI.tldr: ModalShare 提出了一种面向多模态分割学习的跨模态带宽分配机制，基于 Shapley 贡献分数在服务器端决定各模态的压缩保留比例，在不增加上行流量和客户端计算的前提下，显著优于等比例分配方案。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型在边缘侧推理日益普及，但训练几乎全部在数据中心完成，因为客户端持有多个传感器流却无法为每种模态都托管一个编码器。分割学习虽可将首层保留在设备端，但上行链路必须在每一步为每种模态传输破碎激活值。现有压缩方案为所有模态设定相同保留比例，导致共享预算按破碎激活维度比例分配，而这与该模态对融合预测的实际贡献无关。因此需要一种显式的跨模态分配决策，在固定上行预算下按贡献度分配各模态的保留比例。
AI.method: 作者将带宽分配形式化为跨模态分配问题：在固定上行预算下，所有策略传输相同的期望负载，区别仅在于负载在各模态间的拆分方式。所提出的分配器 ModalShare 依据服务器在已收到的激活值联合体上计算的 Shapley 贡献分数，为每种模态设定保留比例。该分数的测量不增加上行流量、不增加客户端计算，也无需事先知道各模态流对应何种数据类型。实验涵盖三种压缩器、三个数据集和四种预算。
AI.result: 在 5 倍压缩、负载匹配的条件下，ModalShare 在 CREMA-D 和 MVSA 上较等保留比例方案分别提升 15.4 和 12.4 个百分点的准确率；并在三种压缩器、三个数据集和四种预算下均表现强劲。结果表明现有压缩器在多模态场景下表现欠佳，而 ModalShare 能够回收这些被遗漏的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 将跨模态带宽分配作为显式决策是提升多模态分割学习性能的关键。基于 Shapley 贡献的服务器端分配可在零额外通信与零客户端成本的前提下，超越统一保留比例方案，并弥补现有压缩器在多模态设置下的不足。

title: Overfitting Mitigation via Singular Value Decomposition in Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
summary: Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding enables high-quality text generation by selecting the hypothesis that maximizes a utility metric over sampled pseudo-references. However, it is highly susceptible to metric overfitting: it can irregularly inflate the chosen utility metric at the direct expense of other unoptimized evaluation metrics. To mitigate this, we introduce SVD-MBR, which frames the pairwise utility matrix as a noisy information signal. By computing a low-rank approximation via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and retaining only the top-$k$ components, we effectively decouple true consensus from metric noise. Experiments demonstrate that SVD-MBR successfully regularizes decoding, yielding substantial gains across a range of generalized metrics. Furthermore, we reveal that this denoising is metric-dependent: neural metrics encode a robust low-rank consensus ideal for SVD, whereas surface-level metrics struggle to separate signal from metric noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SVD-MBR，利用奇异值分解对成对效用矩阵进行低秩近似，从而将「真实共识」与「度量噪声」解耦，缓解最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）解码中的度量过拟合问题，实验表明其在多种广义评估指标上带来显著提升。
AI.motivation: MBR 解码通过从采样伪参考中选择最大化效用度量的假设来生成高质量文本，但它极易发生度量过拟合：会不规则地抬高所选的效用度量，却直接损害其他未被优化的评估指标。因此需要一种正则化手段来抑制这种过拟合。
AI.method: 将成对效用矩阵视为含噪声的信息信号，通过奇异值分解（SVD）计算其低秩近似并仅保留前 k 个成分，从而有效分离真实共识信号与度量噪声，得到 SVD-MBR 解码方法。
AI.result: 实验表明 SVD-MBR 能够有效正则化解码过程，在一系列广义评估指标上取得显著提升；同时揭示该去噪效果具有度量依赖性：神经度量编码了稳健的低秩共识结构，非常适合 SVD 去噪，而表面级度量难以将信号与度量噪声分离。
AI.conclusion: SVD-MBR 为 MBR 解码的度量过拟合问题提供了一种有效的低秩去噪正则化方案，并指出其有效性取决于所用度量是否具备稳健的低秩共识结构，为后续选择适合的效用度量提供了指导。

title: CMRVision: A Foundation Model for Cardiac MR Image Analysis
comment: Accepted at MedAGI 2026 (peer-reviewed workshop at MICCAI 2026)
summary: Cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging provides complementary information on cardiac anatomy, function, and tissue characterization across multiple sequences and views. In this work, we investigate foundation model pretraining for 2D CMR and introduce CMRVision, a CMR-specific foundation model trained using DINOv3-style self-supervised learning on a multi-center, multi-sequence cohort of 36 million CMR images. We systematically evaluate architectural and training design choices for domain-specific pretraining. CMRVision is evaluated on two downstream tasks: multi-task segmentation across cine, late gadolinium enhancement (LGE), and mapping sequences, and cine view classification. Our experiments show that CMR-specific pretraining, smaller patch sizes, and patch-level objectives consistently improve downstream performance. Across a multi-task segmentation benchmark, CMRVision achieved the strongest overall performance, outperforming prior natural-image (NI), medical-image, supervised, and CMR foundation model baselines. Improvements were modest but consistent across structures and sequences, with Dice scores ranging from 0.940-0.967 for LV and 0.855-0.905 for myocardium, and reaching 0.929 for RV, 0.920 for LA, and 0.931 for RA. The largest gains were observed for myocardium segmentation in LGE and mapping images. In a zero-shot segmentation task on unseen LGE long-axis views, the model achieved an average Dice score of 0.692, demonstrating cross-view generalization. For cine view classification, CMRVision achieved the highest average accuracy (0.906), compared to prior methods reported in the literature. These results highlight the potential of CMRVision to support robust and generalizable cardiac MRI analysis across multiple sequences and views.

AI.tldr: CMRVision 是一个面向心脏磁共振（CMR）影像的领域专用基础模型，采用 DINOv3 风格的自监督学习在 3600 万张多中心、多序列 CMR 图像上预训练，并通过多任务分割、零样本分割和 cine 视图分类等下游任务验证，在多个基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: CMR 影像通过多种序列和视图提供心脏解剖、功能及组织特征的互补信息，但现有基础模型多基于自然图像或其他医学影像领域，缺乏针对 CMR 的专用预训练。作者旨在探索 2D CMR 上的基础模型预训练，以提升跨序列、跨视图的下游分析性能与泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出 CMRVision：采用 DINOv3 风格的自监督学习方法，在包含多中心、多序列（cine、LGE、mapping）的 3600 万张 CMR 图像上预训练；系统评估了架构与训练设计选择（如 patch 大小、patch 级目标函数），并在两个下游任务（多任务分割、cine 视图分类）上进行评测，包括对未见 LGE 长轴视图的零样本分割。
AI.result: CMR 专用预训练、更小的 patch 尺寸和 patch 级目标一致提升下游性能。在多任务分割基准上，CMRVision 综合表现最强：LV Dice 0.940-0.967、心肌 0.855-0.905、RV 0.929、LA 0.920、RA 0.931；LGE 与 mapping 中心肌分割增益最大。零样本 LGE 长轴分割平均 Dice 0.692；cine 视图分类平均准确率 0.906，优于文献中已有方法。
AI.conclusion: 领域专用（CMR-specific）预训练、较小的 patch 尺寸及 patch 级目标函数对性能提升至关重要；CMRVision 展示了跨多序列、多视图的稳健性与泛化能力，有望为心脏 MRI 分析提供通用且可靠的基础模型支撑。

title: CoBRA: Learning Tool-Use Boundaries via Counterfactual Margins
summary: As large language models increasingly act through external tools, deciding when to call a tool has become a central problem alongside deciding how to use it. Unnecessary tool calls introduce latency, cost, retrieval noise, and error propagation, while missed calls hurt knowledge-intensive queries or questions requiring up-to-date evidence. Existing methods typically trigger tools from absolute query or generation signals, such as difficulty, confidence, or final task reward, and therefore lack an explicit estimate of the instance-level marginal benefit of tool use. We propose CoBRA, a counterfactual boundary-learning framework for tool-augmented language models. CoBRA first constructs internal and external experts from the same base model, collects paired trajectories, and estimates the reward margin between answering with and without tools. This margin partitions data into internal-favored, external-favored, and ambiguous cases. CoBRA then uses clear-margin samples for Boundary-Aware Cold-Start SFT, followed by MARS-RL with reference-split rollouts and counterfactual marginal advantages to optimize boundary decisions. Experiments with retrieval as the main tool on Qwen3-4B show that CoBRA improves tool-use efficiency and boundary-sensitive answer accuracy while maintaining strong performance on tool-dependent out-of-distribution questions.

AI.tldr: CoBRA 提出一种基于反事实边界的工具调用决策框架：通过同一基础模型构建内部/外部专家并估计“带工具与否”的奖励边际，将数据划分为内部偏好、外部偏好与模糊三类，利用清晰边界样本进行边界感知冷启动 SFT，再通过 MARS-RL（参考分裂 rollout + 反事实边际优势）优化工具调用的时机决策，在 Qwen3-4B 检索增强实验中同时提升工具使用效率与边界敏感答案准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型通过外部工具行动时，“何时调用工具”与“如何使用工具”同样关键。不必要的工具调用会带来延迟、成本、检索噪声和错误传播，而漏调工具则会损害知识密集型或需最新证据的问题。现有方法通常基于绝对信号（查询难度、置信度、最终任务奖励）触发工具，缺乏对实例级工具使用边际收益的显式估计，因此难以做出最优的二值决策。
AI.method: CoBRA 是一个反事实边界学习框架：1) 从同一基础模型构建“内部专家”（不带工具）与“外部专家”（带工具），收集配对轨迹并估计两者奖励之间的边际；2) 该边际将数据划分为内部偏好、外部偏好与模糊三类；3) 使用清晰边际样本进行边界感知冷启动 SFT；4) 再通过 MARS-RL，采用参考分裂 rollout 与反事实边际优势来优化边界决策。
AI.result: 以检索为主要工具、在 Qwen3-4B 上的实验表明：CoBRA 提升了工具使用效率与边界敏感答案准确率，同时在依赖工具的分布外（OOD）问题上保持了强性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模“工具使用的实例级边际收益”并据此学习决策边界，能够在提升效率与准确率之间取得良好平衡，且不会牺牲对工具强依赖场景（OOD）的鲁棒性，为工具增强型 LLM 的调用时机决策提供了一种新的反事实学习范式。

title: Predicting Subsurface Abnormalities Growth using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: The research explores the pioneering integration of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) into the domain of Ground-Penetrating Radar (GPR) data prediction. This research presents a detailed development framework for a specialized PINN model, proficient at interpreting and forecasting GPR data, much like how medical imaging models predict tumor behavior. By harnessing the synergy between deep learning algorithms and the physical laws governing subsurface structures or in medical terms, human tissues the model effectively embeds the physics of electromagnetic wave propagation into its architecture. This ensures that predictions not only align with fundamental physical principles but also mirror the precision needed in medical diagnostics for detecting and monitoring tumors. The suggested deep learning structure comprises three components: a CNN, a spatial feature channel attention (SFCA) mechanism, and ConvLSTM, along with temporal feature frame attention (TFFA) modules. The attention mechanism computes channel attention and temporal attention weights using self-adaptation, thereby fine tuning the visual and temporal feature responses to extract the most pertinent and significant visual and temporal features. By integrating physics directly into the neural network, our model has shown enhanced accuracy in forecasting GPR data. This improvement is vital for conducting effective assessments of bridge deck conditions and other evaluations related to civil infrastructure. The use of Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) has demonstrated the potential to transform the field of Non-Destructive Evaluation (NDE) by enhancing the precision of infrastructure deterioration predictions. Moreover, it offers a deeper insight into the fundamental mechanisms of deterioration, viewed through the prism of physics-based models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将物理信息神经网络（PINNs）创新性地集成到探地雷达（GPR）数据预测领域，提出了一种由CNN、空间特征通道注意力（SFCA）机制、ConvLSTM和时序特征帧注意力（TFFA）模块组成的三部分深度学习架构。通过将电磁波传播的物理规律嵌入网络，并利用自适应注意力机制优化视觉与时空特征，该模型在GPR数据预测精度上显著提升，为非破坏性评估（NDE）尤其是桥梁桥面状况评估提供了更精确、符合物理原理的预测工具。
AI.motivation: 传统GPR数据预测方法难以同时兼顾物理规律与数据特征，导致对桥梁桥面等民用基础设施劣化状态的评估精度有限。本文希望通过物理信息神经网络将电磁波传播的物理定律与深度学习的数据挖掘能力相结合，从而提升GPR数据预测的准确性和对劣化机制的深层理解，推动非破坏性评估领域的发展。
AI.method: 提出一个集成物理信息的三组件深度学习架构：1）CNN用于提取空间视觉特征；2）空间特征通道注意力（SFCA）机制通过自适应方式计算通道注意力权重，优化视觉特征响应；3）ConvLSTM处理时序信息，配合时序特征帧注意力（TFFA）模块自适应计算时序注意力权重，提取关键时空特征。同时将电磁波传播的物理方程作为约束嵌入网络架构，使预测结果符合基本物理原理。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，通过将物理信息直接集成到神经网络中，该模型在GPR数据预测上展现出更高的精度。这种精度提升对桥梁桥面状况及其它民用基础设施的有效评估至关重要，验证了PINN在改进基础设施劣化预测精度方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）有望变革非破坏性评估（NDE）领域，通过提升基础设施劣化预测的精确度，为基于物理模型的劣化基本机制提供更深刻的洞察。该研究类比医学影像模型预测肿瘤行为的方式，展示了物理约束深度学习在GPR数据解释与预测中的广阔应用前景。

title: Does task decomposition improve automatic NLG evaluation?
summary: The LLM-as-a-judge (LLMaJ) framework has emerged as a promising solution for cheap, reproducible, reference-free Natural Language Generation (NLG) evaluation. Prior work seeks to improve LLMaJ by decomposing evaluation tasks into simpler sub-tasks. In this work, we systematically compare LLMaJ methods with and without decomposition on multiple NLG datasets. We find no evidence that LLMaJ with task decomposition leads to performance gains over a fair baseline that does not use decomposition. Instead, we find that previously reported performance gains in decomposition-based LLMaJ stem from using human labels as training data, and not task decomposition itself. Also, we find that, when human labels are available, LLMaJ without using task decomposition can perform comparably to human annotators.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了基于任务分解与不基于任务分解的LLM-as-a-judge（LLMaJ）评估方法，发现任务分解本身并不能带来性能提升；先前研究报告的性能增益实际来源于使用人类标注作为训练数据，而非分解本身。此外，当人类标注可用时，不采用任务分解的LLMaJ可达到与人类标注者相当的水平。
AI.motivation: LLMaJ框架被视为廉价、可复现、无需参考的自然语言生成（NLG）评估方案，先前工作通过将评估任务分解为更简单的子任务来改进LLMaJ，但缺乏对这些方法公平、系统的比较，且对其性能增益的真正来源存在疑问。
AI.method: 在多个NLG数据集上，对使用任务分解和不使用任务分解的LLMaJ方法进行系统的公平对比实验，通过控制是否为基线与对照方法提供人类标签作为训练数据，剥离任务分解与数据监督两个因素的影响。
AI.result: 结果表明：与不使用分解的公平基线相比，带任务分解的LLMaJ并未表现出性能提升；先前研究中的性能增益源自人类标签训练数据而非任务分解本身；在有人类标签的条件下，不使用任务分解的LLMaJ即可达到与人类标注者相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 任务分解并非LLMaJ评估性能提升的真正原因，人类标签数据才是关键驱动因素；研究提示该领域此前部分结论需被重新审视，且在不引入额外复杂分解机制的情况下，LLMaJ在有监督信号时已具备与人类标注者媲美的评估能力。

title: Reliability Challenges in Diffusion Vision-Language Models
summary: Diffusion-based Large Vision-Language Models (dLVLMs) have recently emerged as a compelling alternative to autoregressive (AR) LVLMs, offering advantages in parallel decoding, bidirectional context, and controllable generation. Despite rapid progress, their reliability properties remain largely uncharacterized. We present the first systematic reliability evaluation of hallucination and bias in dLVLMs, benchmarking six diffusion models against competitive AR baselines across four dimensions. Our key findings are: (1) dLVLMs reverse the yes-bias of AR models in binary visual queries; (2) they achieve competitive hallucination rates yet exhibit degraded linguistic quality; (3) they collapse to near-zero accuracy on underrepresented racial groups with opposite-polarity gender bias; and (4) they exhibit accuracy collapse in multiple-choice settings when the correct option is shorter than its distractors, associated with a length prior that emerges at the first denoising step. Tokens committed at late denoising steps with low confidence further correlate with hallucinated content, pointing to a mechanistic signal unique to diffusion generation. These patterns vary across model families, suggesting reliability is shaped by the generative paradigm together with training data.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地评估了基于扩散的大型视觉语言模型（dLVLMs）在幻觉与偏见方面的可靠性，对六个扩散模型与自回归基线模型在四个维度上进行了基准测试。研究发现dLVLMs反转了自回归模型的"是-偏置"，幻觉率相当但语言质量下降，在代表性不足的种族群体上准确率近乎为零且性别偏见极性相反，并在多选题设置中因长度先验（出现在第一步去噪）而出现准确率崩溃。低置信度的晚期去噪步长提交的token与幻觉内容相关，揭示了扩散生成特有的机制信号。
AI.motivation: 尽管扩散式大型视觉语言模型（dLVLMs）作为自回归（AR）LVLMs的替代方案快速发展，具备并行解码、双向上下文和可控生成等优势，但其可靠性特性（如幻觉与偏见）尚未得到系统性刻画，因此需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对六个扩散模型与具有竞争力的自回归基线模型进行基准测试，从四个维度（二元视觉查询中的偏见、幻觉率与语言质量、种族与性别偏见、多选题设置）展开系统的可靠性评估，并结合去噪步骤的置信度分析机制性信号。
AI.result: 主要发现：（1）dLVLMs在二元视觉查询中反转了AR模型的"是-偏置"；（2）幻觉率与AR模型相当但语言质量下降；（3）在代表性不足的种族群体上准确率跌至近乎为零，且性别偏见极性相反；（4）在多选题设置中当正确答案短于干扰项时出现准确率崩溃，这与第一步去噪即出现的长度先验相关。晚期去噪步骤低置信度提交的token与幻觉内容相关，且这些模式在不同模型家族间有所差异。
AI.conclusion: dLVLMs的可靠性由生成范式与训练数据共同塑造，其独特的偏见方向、长度先验和去噪置信度信号表明需要针对扩散生成机制专门设计可靠性改进方法，而非直接沿用自回归模型的评估与缓解策略。

title: Provably Safe Sim-to-Real Transfer
summary: To mitigate the sample complexity of real-world reinforcement learning (RL), a common practice is to first train a policy in a simulator, where samples are cheap, and then deploy the learned policy in the real world with the hope that it generalizes effectively. Such direct sim-to-real transfer is not guaranteed to succeed: simulator-trained policies can be suboptimal in the real world due to sim-to-real mismatch. Correcting this mismatch requires collecting data from the real system, but in many applications, such as robotics and healthcare, this data-collection process is itself subject to safety constraints. This gives rise to the problem of safe sim-to-real transfer: how can an agent exploit an imperfect simulator while ensuring safe real-world data collection and learning a near-optimal feasible policy for the target system? We address this problem by formulating safe sim-to-real transfer within the framework of reward-free safe RL. We design a computationally efficient algorithm that exploits simulator information to provably reduce real-world interaction while ensuring safe exploration and enabling the computation of a near-optimal feasible policy for any potential reward function. Our real-world sample complexity bound characterizes the benefit of using the simulator in terms of the sim-to-real mismatch.

AI.tldr: 本文研究安全模拟器到真实环境迁移（safe sim-to-real transfer）问题，在奖励无关安全强化学习框架下提出一种计算高效的算法，利用模拟器信息显著降低真实系统交互次数，同时保证安全探索，并能针对任意潜在奖励函数计算近似最优的可行策略，其真实样本复杂度界以模拟器与真实环境的失配程度刻画模拟器带来的收益。
AI.motivation: 真实世界强化学习样本代价高昂，常见做法是先在廉价模拟器中训练策略再迁移到真实环境，但模拟器与真实环境的失配会导致策略次优；修正失配需要从真实系统采集数据，而机器人、医疗等应用中数据采集本身受安全约束制约。因此需要研究如何利用不完美的模拟器，同时保证真实世界数据采集的安全并学习近似最优的可行策略。
AI.method: 将安全模拟器到真实环境迁移问题形式化为奖励无关安全强化学习（reward-free safe RL）框架下的问题，设计了一个计算高效的算法。该算法充分挖掘模拟器信息以从理论上减少真实世界的交互次数，同时确保安全探索；在获得安全数据集后，可为任意潜在奖励函数计算近似最优的可行策略。
AI.result: 给出了真实世界样本复杂度上界，该界以模拟器与真实环境的失配程度为参数，定量刻画了使用模拟器所带来的样本效率收益；结果表明在奖励无关安全强化学习下可证明地减少真实交互并保持安全。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明即使在模拟器不完美的情况下，也能通过奖励无关安全强化学习框架实现安全且高效的模拟器到真实环境迁移：既能保证真实世界探索安全，又能为任意奖励函数得到近似最优的可行策略，并明确了模拟器价值与失配程度之间的关系。

title: Subword Segmental BabyLMs: Learning to Tokenise for Sample-Efficient Pretraining
summary: In the standard LM training pipeline, subword tokenisation is applied as a preprocessing step. Subword segmental language modelling is an alternative paradigm in which tokenisation is learned during training, allowing the model to discover subword units that optimise its training objective. In this paper, we present our submission to the 2026 BabyLM Challenge, for which we develop two new subword segmental LMs: SubSegGPT and SubSegDeBERTa. SubSegGPT is a decoder-only model that learns tokenisation during autoregressive pretraining. SubSegDeBERTa is an encoder-based model that jointly learns to generate and tokenise masked words. We train both for the Strict and Strict-small tracks. Our top submission to Strict is SubSegDeBERTa, which achieves notable gains in zero-shot evaluation. Our top submission to Strict-small is SubSegGPT, which outperforms tokenisation-based baselines. Our results show that learnable subword tokenisation can improve sample-efficiency for BabyLM pretraining. We analyse the subword learning dynamics of our models and find that tokenisation gradually converges on subword units that balance morphological alignment and fine-grained segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文面向2026年BabyLM挑战赛，提出了两种新的子词分段式语言模型——SubSegGPT（仅解码器，在自回归预训练中学习分词）和SubSegDeBERTa（基于编码器，联合学习生成和分词被掩码的词）。在Strict轨道中SubSegDeBERTa取得最佳成绩，在Strict-small轨道中SubSegGPT超越基于分词器的基线，表明可学习的子词分词能提升BabyLM预训练的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 标准LM训练流程将子词分词作为预处理步骤，而子词分段式语言建模是一种在训练过程中学习分词的替代范式，让模型自行发现能优化训练目标的子词单元。作者希望验证这种可学习分词范式在数据有限的BabyLM预训练场景中的有效性，以提升样本效率。
AI.method: 作者提出两种新的子词分段式LM：SubSegGPT为仅解码器的自回归预训练模型，在训练中学习分词；SubSegDeBERTa为基于编码器的模型，联合学习生成被掩码的词并同时进行分词。两者均在Strict和Strict-small两个轨道上进行训练与评估。
AI.result: 在Strict轨道中，最佳提交为SubSegDeBERTa，在零样本评估中取得显著提升；在Strict-small轨道中，最佳提交为SubSegGPT，优于基于分词器的基线。子词学习动态分析显示，分词过程会逐渐收敛到在形态对齐与细粒度切分之间取得平衡的子词单元。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，可学习的子词分词能够提升BabyLM预训练的样本效率，且分词单元最终收敛于兼顾形态对齐与细粒度切分的平衡状态，为小样本语言预训练提供了一种有效的替代分词方案。

title: ExBind: A Controlled Diagnostic Benchmark for Visual-to-Executable Correspondence
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, benchmark and diagnostic evaluation paper
summary: Multimodal coding and editing systems must map a visible or semantic referent to the exact executable object that can be edited. A wrong reference may select a valid but incorrect DOM node, SVG element, graph endpoint, hierarchy member, or table cell, while final execution success alone does not reveal the source of the failure. ExBind isolates this visual-to-executable correspondence layer as a controlled diagnostic benchmark between semantic localization and action execution. It samples representation-independent latent binding instances and compiles them into SVG, DOM, canvas, tree, graph, and table cases with deterministic mappings to executable references. Models output only a strict reference; the evaluator maps predictions back to latent structure and scores structural constraints without requiring reasoning traces. The release contains a 250-case broad suite, a disjoint 240-case targeted suite, and 50 paired latent groups. Qwen2.5-VL-3B achieves 98.4% candidate validity but 76.4% exact accuracy, while Qwen3-VL-4B achieves 100.0% validity and 98.8% exact accuracy. In the targeted table suite, all Qwen2.5-VL-3B residual errors are valid correct-row/wrong-column selections. Candidate-order perturbations change case-level outcomes while preserving this error pattern. ExBind is designed for controlled diagnosis rather than population-scale ranking or end-to-end editing evaluation. Code and benchmark records are available at https://github.com/Daerwang2020/Exbind and https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ziqianwwww/ExBind.

AI.tldr: ExBind 是一个面向多模态编码与编辑系统的受控诊断基准，专门隔离"视觉/语义指代 → 可执行对象"这一对应层，通过将隐式潜在绑定实例编译为 SVG、DOM、canvas、树、图、表格等用例，并用严格参考与确定性映射评估模型的结构约束正确性，以区分语义定位错误与动作执行错误。
AI.motivation: 多模态编码与编辑系统必须将可见或语义指代映射到精确的可执行对象；错误的引用可能选中合法但错误的 DOM 节点、SVG 元素、图端点、层级成员或表格单元格，且仅凭最终执行成功无法揭示失败根源。现有评估缺乏对该"视觉到可执行"对应关系的受控诊断，无法判断错误源于语义定位还是动作执行。
AI.method: ExBind 将视觉到可执行的对应层作为介于语义定位与动作执行之间的受控诊断基准。它采样与表示无关的潜在绑定实例，并将其编译为带有确定性可执行引用映射的 SVG、DOM、canvas、树、图、表格用例。模型仅输出严格引用，评估器将预测映射回潜在结构并依据结构约束打分，无需推理轨迹。发布包含 250 例广泛套件、240 例无重叠的定向套件及 50 组配对潜在分组。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-VL-3B 达到 98.4% 候选有效性但仅 76.4% 精确准确率；Qwen3-VL-4B 达到 100.0% 有效性与 98.8% 精确准确率。在定向表格套件中，Qwen2.5-VL-3B 的所有残余错误均为"行正确、列错误"的合法选择；候选顺序扰动会改变用例级结果但保持该错误模式。
AI.conclusion: ExBind 面向受控诊断而非大规模排名或端到端编辑评测，能够可靠地将错误归因于视觉到可执行对应层的结构约束，并揭示特定模型（如 Qwen2.5-VL-3B）的系统性错误模式。代码与基准数据已公开。

title: Spawn Freely, Act Sparingly: Progressive Risk Vesting for Recursive LLM-Agent Trees
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Theory and synthetic numerical studies; no deployed-agent evaluation
summary: Recursive LLM agents can broaden their search by spawning specialists. Some branches later request tools that send data or deploy code. When should a branch receive authority to act? We distinguish sandbox spawning, in which external controls prevent the specified harm, from capability activation, in which a selected branch crosses an irreversible-action boundary. Progressive Risk Vesting (PRV) holds a trajectory-level risk budget in escrow and debits it as branches are activated. We prove an anytime harm bound for adaptively generated trees. Branch outcomes may be dependent, but each local certificate needs to remain valid conditional on the full pre-activation history, including the information used to select the request. When activation gates, branch charges, and compute constraints are held fixed, delayed vesting preserves every policy available under irrevocable spawn charging. Marginal risk estimates can still fail after branch selection. In a stylized branching model, trajectory harm changes as the authority reproduction number $\mathcal{R}_A$ crosses one. As local risk $p$ approaches zero, trajectory harm is proportional to $p$ below criticality, proportional to $\sqrt{p}$ at criticality, and retains a positive floor above it. A finite-type occupancy model yields risk and compute shadow prices. For nested fanout modes with decreasing marginal value per unit risk, these prices produce a threshold rule. Branching calculations and a split-sample experiment illustrate the results. These synthetic studies do not estimate safety in deployed agents. The analysis suggests a design rule: search broadly in the sandbox and grant recursive authority sparingly, with an explicit risk charge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出渐进式风险归属（PRV）机制，为递归LLM智能体在分支激活时管理轨迹级风险预算，证明自适应生成树上的随时风险界，并通过分支模型与折半样本实验得出“沙盒中广泛搜索、递归授权从简并明示风险收费”的设计规则。
AI.motivation: 递归LLM智能体通过生成专业分支扩大搜索范围，但部分分支随后会请求可发送数据或部署代码等不可逆动作的工具；此时需要决定分支何时获得执行权限，以在授权灵活性与风险可控性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 将沙盒生成（外部控制可防止特定危害）与能力激活（选中分支跨越不可逆动作边界）加以区分；PRV将轨迹级风险预算托管于“保管账户”，随分支激活逐笔扣减；对自适应生成树证明随时风险界，并引入授权再生数R_A刻画轨迹危害的临界相变，辅以有限类型占用模型给出风险与计算的影子价格及阈值规则。
AI.result: 在激活门控、分支收费与计算约束固定时，延迟归属保留了不可撤销生成收费下的全部可用策略；边际风险估计在分支选择后仍可能失效。随局部风险p趋零，路径危害在临界以下正比于p、临界处正比于√p、临界以上保持非零下限；影子价格驱动的阈值规则在嵌套扇出模式下成立，分支计算与折半样本实验验证了这些结论。
AI.conclusion: 分析给出明确设计原则：在沙盒中广泛搜索、而递归授权应节制授予并附带明确的风险收费；同时强调合成研究不能替代对已部署智能体安全性的实际评估。

title: CATeye: Coupled Attribute-Topology Invariance Learning for Voucher Abuse Detection
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, Accepted by CIKM 2026 Applied Research Track
summary: Voucher abuse poses a major challenge in e-commerce, where malicious users exploit promotional vouchers for profit. Unfortunately, fraud patterns evolve rapidly over time and across regions, causing distribution shifts that degrade existing detection models unless retrained frequently. To tackle this, we propose the Coupled Attribute-Topology Invariance Learning framework (CATeye). The key challenge arises from coupled attribute-topology shift, where edges built from attribute proximity cause environment-driven attribute shift to induce shifted topology, thereby amplifying variant signals through GNN message passing. CATeye sees through such coupled shifts with two learnable selectors. First, an Attribute Invariance Selector (AIS) learns node-adaptive masks to filter out non-invariant attributes. Then, conditioned on retained invariant attributes, an Edge Invariance Selector (EIS) samples an invariant subgraph and isolates non-invariant edges. Using the resulting invariant and non-invariant components, CATeye constructs multiple views and applies view-specific objectives to emphasize domain-invariant representations while suppressing domain-specific variations. Experiments on both a proprietary dataset from Lazada, a major Southeast Asian e-commerce platform, and a public benchmark show that CATeye consistently outperforms nine strong domain generalization and graph anomaly detection baselines, achieving up to an 8.61% improvement in average F1 score over the strongest baseline. Source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tian0426/CATeye.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CATeye（Coupled Attribute-Topology Invariance Learning）框架，用于电商优惠券滥用检测。针对属性-拓扑耦合分布偏移（属性偏移经由属性邻近构建的边传导为拓扑偏移，并通过GNN消息传递放大变体信号），CATeye设计了属性不变性选择器（AIS）与边不变性选择器（EIS）两个可学习选择器，分别筛选不变属性并采样不变子图，进而构建多个视图并施加视图特定目标，以强化领域不变表征、抑制领域特定变化。在Lazada私有数据集和公开基准上，CATeye一致优于九种强基线，平均F1最高提升8.61%。
AI.motivation: 电商平台中恶意用户滥用促销优惠券牟利已成重大挑战，且欺诈模式随时间与地域快速演化，导致分布偏移使现有检测模型频繁退化、需要频繁重训。核心难点在于属性-拓扑耦合偏移：基于属性邻近构建的图边会使环境驱动的属性偏移传导为拓扑偏移，再经GNN消息传递放大变体信号，从而显著削弱模型泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出CATeye框架，通过两个可学习选择器穿透耦合偏移：1）属性不变性选择器（AIS）学习节点自适应掩码，过滤非不变属性；2）基于保留的不变属性，边不变性选择器（EIS）采样不变子图并隔离非不变边。随后利用不变与非不变组件构造多视图，并施加视图特定目标函数，以强调域不变表征、抑制域特定变化，实现联合的属性-拓扑不变性学习。
AI.result: 在来自东南亚电商平台Lazada的私有数据集与一个公开基准上开展实验，CATeye一致优于九种强领域泛化与图异常检测基线，相对于最强基线在平均F1分数上最高取得8.61%的提升。源代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: CATeye通过属性-拓扑解耦的不变性学习有效应对电商优惠券滥用中的耦合分布偏移，显著提升了检测模型在跨时间、跨区域环境下的泛化性能，验证了“先选不变属性、再据其构建不变子图”这一级联选择策略的有效性。

title: LLMPEDIA: Browsing, Verifying, and Comparing the Parametric Encyclopedic Knowledge of LLMs
summary: Flagship language models appear saturated on benchmarks like MMLU (Hendrycks et al., 2021), scoring above 90% - yet benchmarks test only what the experimenter thought to ask, the availability bias of fixed question sets. LLMPEDIA makes this bias measurable and browsable. We recursively materialized ~1.3M articles from three model families' parametric memory (GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama-3.3-70B) without retrieval, then audited a stratified sample of atomic claims against Wikipedia and a curated web stack, coloring every claim supported, refuted, or insufficient (Saeed and Razniewski, 2026). On a uniform random sample the true rate is 68.4% - more than 21 pp below MMLU - with 30.5% of claims insufficient: assertions no benchmark probes and the world's largest encyclopedia cannot adjudicate - long-tail knowledge or plausible hallucination, the evidence cannot tell - extending to free text the coverage gap GPTKB established for triples (Hu et al., 2025). The resulting live, open encyclopedia lets visitors inspect this frontier one claim at a time through five one-click views - link-traversal exploration, claim-level factuality, cross-model and political-persona comparison, and a guided topic drill-down - each page, claim, and verdict at a stable URL. LLMPEDIA is live at https://llmpedia.net

AI.tldr: LLMPEDIA 是一个递归从三个旗舰语言模型（GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama-3.3-70B）的参数记忆中物化约 130 万篇文章、再对原子声明进行人工审计的开放式动态百科；在均匀随机抽样下真实事实性仅为 68.4%，比旗舰模型在 MMLU 上的 90% 以上低逾 21 个百分点，且 30.5% 的声明无法被任何基准或 Wikipedia 裁定（信息不足），从而量化并可视化了固定题集基准的可获得性偏差。
AI.motivation: 旗舰语言模型在 MMLU 等基准上看似饱和（超过 90%），但这些基准只测试实验者想到要问的问题，存在固定题集的可获得性偏差；现有基准无法测度模型参数记忆中的长尾知识与潜在幻觉，需要一种让这种偏差可测量、可浏览的新评估方式。
AI.method: 递归地从三个模型家族（GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama-3.3-70B）的参数记忆中物化约 130 万篇文章（不使用检索），随后对分层抽样出的原子声明，对照 Wikipedia 与精选网络语料库逐条审计，将每条声明标注为"支持""驳斥"或"信息不足"；并以五种一键视图（链接遍历浏览、声明级事实性、跨模型与政治人物比较、引导式主题下钻）呈现，所有页面、声明与判定均有稳定 URL，作为实时开放百科发布。
AI.result: 在均匀随机样本上，真实支持率为 68.4%，比 MMLU 低 21 个百分点以上；30.5% 的声明被判定为"信息不足"，即既无基准探测、世界上最大的百科也无法裁定（长尾知识或貌似合理的幻觉，证据无法区分）；这将对三元组建立的覆盖缺口（GPTKB）扩展到了自由文本。
AI.conclusion: LLMPEDIA 证明旗舰模型在封闭题基准下的高分掩盖了其开放域参数记忆真实事实性的显著下降，并提供一个可逐声明检查前沿模型事实性的实时开放资源（https://llmpedia.net），使"基准问不到的内容"这一覆盖缺口变得可量化、可浏览。

title: Accurate Reconstruction of Gas Turbine Blade Geometry Using 3D/2D Rigid Registration and CT View Optimization
comment: conference proceedings International Conference on Computed Tomography (iCT) 2025, 8 pages, 6 figures
summary: Non-destructive X-ray and computed tomography (CT) testing are essential for ensuring the dimensional accuracy of manufactured components with complex internal structures, such as the cooling channels in gas turbine blades, which directly affect thermal performance and service life. This study presents a multipart 3D-2D rigid registration approach for aligning CAD models with X-ray projections as an alternative to CT reconstruction for part inspection and measurement. A greedy registration algorithm sequentially aligns the blade's exterior before registering its internal components by maximizing the mutual information between simulated and acquired X-ray images. This stepwise approach reduces problem complexity and improves alignment accuracy. View angles are optimized using a greedy method that iteratively selects angles to minimize dimensional measurement errors. The results indicate that a small number of oblique views provides the best accuracy, although a broad range of angles yields acceptable results. The method achieves subpixel registration accuracy, with errors below one-fifth of the magnified detector-pixel pitch. Image noise and defects reduce registration precision, but direct registration in projection space mitigates these effects compared with CT reconstruction. Appropriate view selection can therefore preserve acceptable subpixel accuracy in the presence of image noise and defects.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多部件三维到二维刚体配准方法，通过贪心算法依次对齐CAD模型的外部与内部结构，在投影空间中直接配准模拟X射线图像与实测图像，以替代CT重建实现燃气轮机叶片等复杂内部结构零件的无损检测与测量，并结合贪心视角优化，实现了优于1/5放大探测器像素间距的亚像素配准精度。
AI.motivation: 燃气轮机叶片等复杂内部结构零件的尺寸精度直接影响热性能与使用寿命，非破坏性X射线和CT检测对保证其尺寸精度至关重要。然而CT重建成本高、耗时且易受噪声与缺陷影响，需要探索更高效、更鲁棒的替代方案，因此提出直接在投影空间将CAD模型与X射线投影配准的方法用于零件检测与测量。
AI.method: 提出一种多部件3D-2D刚体配准方法：采用贪心配准算法，首先对齐叶片外部轮廓，再依次配准内部组件，通过最大化模拟X射线图像与实测图像之间的互信息实现逐级配准，以降低问题复杂度并提高精度；同时采用贪心方法迭代选择视角，以最小化尺寸测量误差。
AI.result: 少量斜视视角即可获得最佳精度，且较宽泛的视角范围也能产生可接受结果；该方法达到亚像素配准精度，误差低于放大后探测器像素间距的五分之一；图像噪声和缺陷会降低配准精度，但相较于CT重建，直接在投影空间配准可缓解这些不利影响，合理的视角选择可在存在噪声和缺陷时保持可接受的亚像素精度。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，以少量斜视角在投影空间直接进行多部件逐步配准是CT重建的有效替代方案，能够在图像噪声与缺陷存在时仍保持亚像素级精度，适用于复杂内部结构零件的检测与测量。

title: Data-Driven Persona-Conditioned Agents for A/B Test Simulation
comment: Work accepted at EMNLP 2026 Industry Track
summary: A/B testing is the gold standard for evaluating product changes, but each experiment requires real user traffic, engineering effort, and weeks of measurement. We propose a simulation framework that predicts A/B test outcomes using LLM-powered agents conditioned on data-driven personas grounded in real user behavioral signals. Unlike prior work that relies on synthetic or rule-based personas, our agents are constructed from anonymized behavioral data-activity patterns, engagement signals, and inferred demographics-enabling more faithful population modeling. We frame A/B test simulation as a structured question task and systematically study (i) question design formats, (ii) the impact of persona data source and domain alignment, (iii) the trade-off between per-persona behavioral depth and population diversity, and (iv) efficient population subsampling. On a benchmark of 40 A/B tests spanning two metric types, our best configuration achieves 0.75-0.90 directional accuracy depending on the test metric, demonstrating that data-driven personas are a viable path toward fast, low-cost experiment pre-screening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于LLM智能体的模拟框架，用数据驱动的人设（persona）预测A/B测试结果，在40个A/B测试基准上达到0.75-0.90的方向准确率，为快速低成本实验预筛选提供了可行路径。
AI.motivation: A/B测试是评估产品变更的金标准，但每个实验都需要真实用户流量、工程工作量和数周测量周期，成本高、速度慢。因此需要一个能快速、低成本预筛选实验结果的模拟框架。
AI.method: 提出一个基于LLM智能体的模拟框架，智能体由来自匿名化行为数据（活动模式、参与信号、推断的人口统计特征）驱动的人设构建，区别于依赖合成或基于规则人设的先前工作。将A/B测试模拟建模为结构化问答任务，并系统研究了四方面：(i)问题设计格式、(ii)人设数据源与领域对齐的影响、(iii)单个人设行为深度与人群多样性之间的权衡、(iv)高效的人群子采样。
AI.result: 在包含40个A/B测试、两种指标类型的基准上，最佳配置根据测试指标达到0.75-0.90的方向准确率，表明数据驱动的人设是实现快速、低成本实验预筛选的可行途径。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的人设结合LLM智能体能够以较低成本较准确地预测A/B测试结果（方向准确率0.75-0.90），可用于实验的快速预筛选，减少对真实用户流量和测量周期的依赖。

title: TRIAGE: Three-level Routing and Intelligent Agent Guidance for Efficient Execution
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents based on the ReAct paradigm have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tool use and task execution. However, ReAct suffers from a fundamental efficiency problem: every query triggers a complete reasoning loop from scratch, and similar queries repeat identical steps without leveraging historical experience. We propose TRIAGE,a three-level routing framework that reduces token consumption by reusing historical execution trajectories. Its core innovation is TaaS (Trajectory-as-a-Skill), which abstracts historical execution trajectories into reusable skills, realizing 'experience as a service'. TRIAGE classifies queries into three levels: (1) Direct Reuse-identical queries, 0 tokens; (2) Skill Substitution-similar queries, 0 tokens via deterministic parameter substitution; (3) Full ReAct-novel queries, automatically stored for future reuse. In large-scale experiments on 1,007 security monitoring queries, TRIAGE achieves 62.3% token savings, with 56.0% of queries at Level 2 and 5.5% at Level 1, both executing at zero cost. Cross-domain validation on ToolBench (15 domains, 345 queries) achieves 76.3% token reduction, confirming the generalizability of semantic routing. An online learning experiment demonstrates cold-start-to-mature evolution: the L2 hit rate rises from 0% to 57% within the first 100 queries, and the average token cost drops from 198 to 74.7. We also propose an automatic Skill extraction mechanism that distills high-frequency trajectory patterns into deterministic Skills, creating a positive feedback loop of 'the more you use it, the more efficient it becomes'.

AI.tldr: 提出 TRIAGE 三层路由框架，通过"轨迹即技能（TaaS）"将历史执行轨迹抽象为可复用技能，按查询类别分别采用直接复用（0 token）、技能替换（0 token）和完整 ReAct 推理，在安全监控与 ToolBench 数据集上分别节省 62.3% 和 76.3% 的 token，并具有冷启动到成熟的在线学习能力。
AI.motivation: ReAct 范式的 LLM 智能体存在根本性的效率问题：每个查询都要从头启动完整的推理循环，相似查询会重复执行相同步骤，无法利用历史执行经验，导致 token 消耗高、效率低下。
AI.method: 提出 TRIAGE 三层路由框架，核心创新为 TaaS（Trajectory-as-a-Skill），将历史执行轨迹抽象为可复用技能，实现"经验即服务"。（1）Level 1 Direct Reuse：相同查询直接复用，0 token；（2）Level 2 Skill Substitution：相似查询通过确定性参数替换执行，0 token；（3）Level 3 Full ReAct：新查询执行完整推理并自动存储供未来复用。同时提出自动 Skill 提取机制，将高频轨迹模式蒸馏为确定性技能，形成"越用越高效"的正反馈循环。
AI.result: 在 1,007 条安全监控查询上节省 62.3% token，其中 Level 2 占 56.0%、Level 1 占 5.5%，均以零成本执行；ToolBench 跨领域验证（15 个领域、345 条查询）实现 76.3% token 缩减，证明语义路由的泛化性；在线学习实验中，前 100 条查询内 L2 命中率从 0% 升至 57%，平均 token 成本从 198 降至 74.7。
AI.conclusion: TRIAGE 通过经验复用机制显著降低 LLM 智能体的 token 消耗，且具备跨领域泛化能力与自我进化的在线学习特性，验证了"使用越多、效率越高"的正反馈设计有效性。

title: PersuaRL: Reinforcement Learning-Driven Multi-Expert Selection for Persuasive Dialogue Generation in Insurance
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are revolutionizing digital communication by powering conversational agents deployed across domains such as customer service, digital sales, and insurance. These agents, built on LLMs, can understand user input, retrieve relevant information, and generate coherent responses. However, while they excel at factual communication, they often lack the ability to engage in truly persuasive, context-sensitive dialogue, especially in domains like insurance, where trust and clarity are critical. Building on this need within the insurance domain, our work focuses on improving the persuasiveness of digital agents, aka LLMs. To support this, we introduce InsureDial, a Persuasive Insurance Dialogue dataset, designed to capture the nuances of persuasive communication specific to motor insurance interactions. We introduce PersuaRL, a reinforcement learning-based framework that equips LLM-driven dialogue agents with the ability to adaptively explore, select, and coordinate strategies across multiple expert modules, guided by the evolving dialogue context, to achieve more effective persuasion. We conduct extensive automatic human and qualitative evaluations on two benchmark persuasion dialogue datasets, including our InsureDial. Our evaluations consistently demonstrate that PersuaRL outperforms baseline, generating contextually appropriate and highly persuasive responses.

AI.tldr: 本文针对保险等信任与透明度至关重要的领域中大语言模型（LLM）驱动的对话智能体缺乏说服力和上下文敏感性的问题，提出了用于说服性保险对话的数据集InsureDial，以及基于强化学习的框架PersuaRL。PersuaRL使对话智能体能够根据不断演变的对话语境，自适应地探索、选择和协调多个专家模块中的说服策略，从而提升说服效果。在包括InsureDial在内的两个基准说服对话数据集上的自动评估和人工评估表明，PersuaRL始终优于基线，能生成上下文恰当且高度有说服力的回复。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的对话智能体虽然擅长事实性交流，但在保险等对信任和清晰度要求极高的领域中，往往缺乏真正有说服力、上下文敏感的话语能力，因此需要提升数字智能体（LLM）的说服力。
AI.method: （1）构建InsureDial，一个针对机动车保险交互中说服性沟通细节的说服性保险对话数据集；（2）提出PersuaRL，一个基于强化学习的框架，使LLM驱动的对话智能体能够依据不断变化的对话语境，在多个专家模块间自适应地探索、选择和协调策略，以实现更有效的说服。
AI.result: 在两个基准说服对话数据集（包括InsureDial）上进行了大规模的自动评估、人工评估和定性评估，实验一致表明PersuaRL优于基线，能够生成上下文恰当且高度有说服力的回复。
AI.conclusion: PersuaRL在说服性对话任务上显著超过基线方法，验证了其有效性，为保险等专业领域提升LLM对话智能体的说服力提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Diffusion Based Unpaired Data Learning for Inverse Problems
summary: Data is important in many deep learning-based inverse problem solvers. However, obtaining sufficient paired data in many scenarios remains highly challenging, while unpaired data is cheap. To maximize data utilization, this paper proposes LUD-DIF, a diffusion-based approach for solving inverse problems with unpaired data. Starting from the evidence lower bound (ELBO) of the joint distribution, we decouple it into two independent diffusion processes under the weak-coupling assumption. The method provides theoretical support from a variational inference perspective, derives the loss function, quantitatively analyzes the error bound introduced by the assumption, and offers a theorem-motivated heuristic for hyperparameter selection. Experimental results demonstrate that LUD-DIF achieves outstanding performance on multiple image inverse problems, validating its effectiveness and generalization capability in unpaired inverse problem settings.

AI.tldr: LUD-DIF 是一种基于扩散模型、面向无配对数据的逆问题求解方法。它从联合分布的证据下界（ELBO）出发，在弱耦合假设下将目标解耦为两个独立的扩散过程，并从变分推断角度提供理论支撑、推导损失函数、量化误差界并给出超参数选择的定理启发式方法。实验表明该方法在多个图像逆问题上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 在许多基于深度学习的逆问题求解器中，数据至关重要，但获取充足的配对数据极具挑战且成本高昂，而无配对数据则相对廉价。因此本文旨在最大化数据利用率，利用扩散模型在仅有无配对数据的情况下求解逆问题。
AI.method: 提出 LUD-DIF 方法：1）从联合分布的 ELBO 出发，在弱耦合假设下将目标解耦为两个相互独立的扩散过程；2）从变分推断视角提供理论支持并推导出相应损失函数；3）定量分析弱耦合假设引入的误差界；4）给出由定理启发的超参数选择启发式规则。
AI.result: 在多个图像逆问题上的实验结果表明，LUD-DIF 取得了出色的性能，验证了其在无配对逆问题设定下的有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: LUD-DIF 为无配对数据条件下的逆问题求解提供了一种有理论依据的扩散模型方案，能够在配对数据稀缺时仍保持较强的求解效果和泛化性能，具有实际应用价值。

title: AgentFactory: Towards Automated Agentic System Design and Optimization
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities as powerful components in agentic systems, enabling sophisticated reasoning and complex task execution. However, current approaches to manually designing and optimizing agentic systems heavily rely on manual effort, limiting their adaptability and scalability. Recent work has explored the automated optimization of workflow designs. However, these approaches often overlook the crucial role of model capabilities and focus on single performance metrics, failing to address real-world deployment constraints. In this paper, we present AgentFactory, a framework that jointly optimizes both foundation models and workflow structures in agentic systems while considering multiple objectives including performance, cost, and efficiency. AgentFactory leverages advanced LLMs as optimizers to navigate the vast search space of possible configurations, employing a three-stage optimization pipeline to automatically discover effective combinations of fine-tuned models and optimized workflows. Through an iterative optimization process, our framework systematically explores and evaluates different agentic system designs, adapting to task-specific requirements while maintaining operational efficiency. We evaluate AgentFactory across eight benchmarks spanning five domains, including general reasoning, coding, mathematics, medicine, and finance. Our experiments demonstrate that AgentFactory consistently outperforms both manually designed methods and existing automated approaches, achieving an average improvement of 9.1% across all benchmarks, with particularly significant gains in domain-specific tasks (19.6% on MedQA and 18.7% on FinEval). These results establish AgentFactory as a promising approach for developing more capable and efficient agentic systems through automated optimization.

AI.tldr: AgentFactory 是一个联合优化基础模型与工作流结构的智能体系统框架，利用大语言模型作为优化器，通过三阶段优化流水线在性能、成本和效率等多个目标之间进行权衡，在八个基准、五个领域上平均提升9.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统的设计与优化高度依赖人工，可扩展性和适应性受限；已有的自动化工作流优化方法忽视了模型能力的关键作用，且仅关注单一性能指标，无法满足真实部署中的成本与效率约束。
AI.method: 提出 AgentFactory 框架，它联合优化基础模型与工作流结构，将多个目标（性能、成本、效率）纳入考量。具体采用高级 LLM 作为优化器来探索庞大的配置搜索空间，并设计三阶段优化流水线，通过迭代优化过程自动发现微调模型与优化工作流的有效组合，适配任务特定需求并维持运行效率。
AI.result: 在涵盖通用推理、编程、数学、医学和金融五个领域的八个基准上评估，AgentFactory 在所有基准上平均提升 9.1%，一致优于人工设计方法及现有自动化方法；领域特定任务提升尤为显著，MedQA 上提升 19.6%，FinEval 上提升 18.7%。
AI.conclusion: AgentFactory 通过自动化联合优化为构建更强大且高效的智能体系统提供了有前景的途径，证明了同时优化模型与工作流并考虑多目标约束的有效性。

title: Learning Sparse Decision Trees via Transformer Variational Auto-Encoders
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM 2026)
summary: Decision trees are among the most widely used models in machine learning, largely due to their transparent decision logic, making them well-suited for high-stakes decision-making contexts. However, most existing learning algorithms focus on predictive performance, overlooking the joint optimization of other desirable properties, such as structural sparsity. In this work we propose TREVIS, an approach for learning decision trees with respect to complex objectives, based on the exploration of the latent space of a Tree Transformer Variational Auto-Encoder (TTVAE). By mapping decision trees onto latent representations, TREVIS replaces the discrete search space with a continuous one, enabling gradient-based optimization via a differentiable surrogate model. We experiment with TREVIS for learning decision trees that jointly optimize predictive performance and sparsity. Results show that TREVIS discovers decision trees matching the predictive performance of existing near-optimal algorithms while improving their structural sparsity.

AI.tldr: 提出 TREVIS，利用树形 Transformer 变分自编码器（TTVAE）将决策树映射到连续潜空间，通过可微代理模型进行梯度优化，从而在保持预测性能的同时联合优化结构稀疏性等复杂目标。
AI.motivation: 决策树因透明的决策逻辑被广泛应用于高风险决策场景，但大多数现有学习算法仅关注预测性能，忽略了与结构稀疏性等其他理想属性的联合优化。离散搜索空间限制了复杂目标的梯度优化。
AI.method: 提出 TREVIS 方法：利用 Tree Transformer Variational Auto-Encoder (TTVAE) 将决策树编码到潜空间，从而将离散搜索空间替换为连续空间，借助可微的代理模型实现基于梯度的优化，以联合优化预测性能与稀疏性等多个目标。
AI.result: 实验表明，TREVIS 学习到的决策树在预测性能上与现有近最优算法相当，同时显著改善了结构稀疏性。
AI.conclusion: TREVIS 证明了通过潜空间连续化与梯度优化，可以在不牺牲预测性能的前提下联合优化决策树的多重属性（如稀疏性），为面向复杂目标的决策树学习提供了新思路。

title: CaRL-EM: Cost-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Entity Matching with LLMs
summary: Entity matching (EM) requires fine-grained contextual understanding and domain knowledge. Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can serve as strong matchers across domains, but most methods either make independent pairwise decisions or rely on manually designed composite pipelines, thus lacking flexibility in realistic multi-candidate settings. At the same time, they typically ignore inference cost at scale. We formulate LLM-based EM with candidates as a cost-aware sequential decision problem and propose CaRL-EM, a reinforcement learning controller that manages LLM operations. Given the state of an anchor record, its candidate set, and the cost, CaRL-EM adaptively chooses among different operators (Match/Compare/Select/Decide) and model capacities to maximize a quality-cost objective. The policy interacts with abstract operators, allowing the same controller to be reused with different underlying LLM backends at inference time without retraining. Experiments on 7 benchmarks show that CaRL-EM (i) learns to dynamically plan the usage of inexpensive and expensive operators based on task complexity, (ii) achieves robust zero-shot transfer across diverse datasets and domains, and (iii) consistently achieves a better quality-cost trade-off than strong LLM-based baselines and manually designed pipelines, yielding a lower inference cost at comparable or higher quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 CaRL-EM，一个基于强化学习（RL）的成本感知控制器，将基于大语言模型（LLM）的实体匹配（EM）建模为带候选集的多步顺序决策问题，通过自适应调度匹配/比较/选择/决策等算子及不同模型容量，以在推理成本和质量之间取得更优的权衡。
AI.motivation: 实体匹配（EM）需要细粒度的上下文理解与领域知识，LLM 已被证明是跨领域强大的匹配器。然而多数现有方法要么做独立的成对决策，要么依赖人工设计的复合流水线，在现实多候选场景中缺乏灵活性；同时这些方法普遍忽视了大规模推理成本问题。
AI.method: 将带候选集的 LLM 实体匹配形式化为成本感知的序列决策问题，并提出 CaRL-EM：一个强化学习控制器，在给定锚点记录状态、候选集与成本的情况下，自适应地从不同算子（Match/Compare/Select/Decide）和不同模型容量中选择操作，以最大化质量-成本目标。策略与抽象算子交互，使其可在推理时复用不同底层 LLM 后端而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在 7 个基准上的实验表明 CaRL-EM：(i) 能根据任务复杂度动态规划廉价与昂贵算子的使用；(ii) 在不同数据集与领域间实现稳健的零样本迁移；(iii) 相比强 LLM 基线与人工设计流水线持续取得更优的质量-成本权衡，在相当或更高质量下实现更低的推理成本。
AI.conclusion: CaRL-EM 通过将 EM 建模为成本感知的顺序决策问题，实现了灵活、可迁移且成本高效的 LLM 实体匹配，在真实多候选环境下显著优于现有基线与人工流水线，为大规模 LLM 应用提供了一种实用方案。

title: IntroConformal: Conformal Factuality Guarantees for Large Vision-Language Models via Introspective Signals
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved strong multimodal performance, yet ensuring the factual correctness of generated content remains challenging. Existing methods that provide statistical guarantees on factuality typically rely on external verifiers or generation-time confidence signals, which introduce auxiliary dependencies or often fail for confident but incorrect outputs. We argue that reliable factuality control can instead be achieved through introspective signals derived from the model itself. We introduce IntroConformal, a training-free Conformal Risk Control (CRC) framework that provides finite-sample, distribution-free factuality guarantees. We first instantiate it with layer-wise semantic stability, a conformity score derived from hidden-state representations, and then propose verification probability, a stronger score capturing the model's self-administered judgment on claim factuality. Across multiple LVLM architectures, IntroConformal satisfies the conformal risk guarantee while substantially reducing abstention and achieving competitive or superior claim-level discrimination relative to external verifier-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IntroConformal，一种免训练的保形风险控制（CRC）框架，利用模型自身的自省信号（分层语义稳定性与验证概率）替代外部验证器，为大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）提供有限样本、无分布假设的事实性统计保证。
AI.motivation: LVLM在生成内容上难以保证事实正确性；现有提供统计保证的方法依赖外部验证器或生成时置信度信号，前者引入额外依赖，后者对“高置信但错误”的输出常失效。因此需要一种仅依赖模型自身、可靠的事实性控制机制。
AI.method: 提出免训练的保形风险控制（CRC）框架IntroConformal。首先用基于隐藏状态表示的分层语义稳定性作为一致性分数实例化该框架，随后提出验证概率（verification probability）这一更强的一致性分数，用于捕捉模型对声明事实性的自我判定。
AI.result: 在多种LVLM架构上，IntroConformal满足保形风险保证，同时显著降低弃权（abstention）率，并在声明级判别能力上达到与基于外部验证器的基线相当或更优的水平。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的LVLM事实性控制可通过模型自身衍生的自省信号实现，IntroConformal在不依赖外部验证器的情况下，同时满足有限样本的保形风险保证与更强的判别能力，为事实性控制提供了更实用的新范式。

title: QILP-0: Constructing Observational Declarative Twins of Quantum Circuits
comment: 39 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems
summary:
This paper introduces QXymb, a general framework for constructing observational declarative twins of quantum circuits, and develops QILP-0, its first complete order-0 specialization. QILP-0 constructs a finite multi-valued propositional logic program from observed circuit behaviour within a declared observational scope.
  The pipeline traverses a declared family of quantum observables incrementally according to a reproducible structural grading and a declared observational reference horizon. Progress is quantified through reference-relative coverage against a fixed target-independent reference. Observable responses are organized through target-independent geometry, while retained latent structure is mapped deterministically back to original observable columns before symbolic processing, preserving observational semantics and provenance.
  Selected observable profiles are converted into a finite relation through admissible target-independent discretization. The target is used only afterwards to audit twin-admissibility and induce the declarative theory. A theory is certified as an exact observational declarative twin when it completely and correctly reconstructs the resulting finite task-conditioned discrete relation. Logical exactness is therefore separated from numerical, backend, provider, and discretization uncertainty, which is retained as audit metadata.
  Validation uses two complementary QML settings. Exhaustive Bars & Stripes experiments compare product and grid-CZ embeddings from 16 to 100 qubits and exercise the native-discrete branch. Low-Depth MNIST analyses all 14,708 digit-0/1 instances before and after a trained variational quantum transformation and exercises continuous discretization. In every reported relation, the induced QILP-0 theory achieves complete, conflict-free reconstruction with strict accuracy equal to one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QXymb 框架，用于为量子电路构建观测性声明式孪生（observational declarative twin），并给出其首个完整阶-0 特化 QILP-0。QILP-0 在声明的观测范围内从电路行为构造有限多值命题逻辑程序，通过参考相对覆盖度量化进度，采用与目标无关的离散化将可观测概貌转为有限关系，再仅以目标做审计与理论归纳，最终在 Bars & Stripes（16–100 量子比特）与 Low-Depth MNIST（14,708 个样本）上实现严格准确率等于 1 的完整无冲突重构。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习（QML）中，电路的逻辑/符号层面行为与底层数值、后端、提供商及离散化不确定性混杂在一起，难以获得可审计、可复现且语义保真的电路级声明式描述。现有方法缺乏一个通用框架来从观测行为出发、以与目标无关的方式构建并认证量子电路的精确逻辑孪生。
AI.method: 提出通用框架 QXymb 及其阶-0 完整特化 QILP-0。其流程包括：按可复现的结构分级与声明的观测参考视界（observational reference horizon）增量遍历一族量子可观测量；以参考相对覆盖度量化进展；通过目标无关几何组织观测响应，并将保留的隐结构确定性地映射回原始可观测列以保持语义与溯源；经目标无关的容许离散化将所选观测概貌转为有限关系；目标仅在之后用于审计孪生容许性并归纳声明式理论；当完全且正确地重构有限任务条件离散关系时，理论被认证为精确的观测声明式孪生，从而将逻辑精确性与数值/后端/提供商/离散化不确定性分离（后者保留为审计元数据）。
AI.result: 在两组互补的 QML 设定中验证：穷举 Bars & Stripes 实验对比 16 到 100 量子比特的乘积与 grid-CZ 嵌入并验证原生离散分支；Low-Depth MNIST 分析全部 14,708 个数字 0/1 样本（含训练后变分量子变换前后）验证连续离散化。在所有报告的离散关系中，归纳得到的 QILP-0 理论均实现完整、无冲突的重构，严格准确率等于 1。
AI.conclusion: QILP-0/QXymb 证明了以目标无关方式、可审计地构建量子电路精确观测声明式孪生的可行性：逻辑精确性可与数值等不确定性解耦并获得严格准确率为 1 的完整重构，为量子电路的可复现符号级描述、验证与审计提供了通用基础。

title: Efficiently Estimating Optimal Hyperparameter Scaling Laws through Power-Law Entropy Search
summary: Optimal hyperparameter scaling laws describe how the best hyperparameters for large language model (LLM) training change with model and data scale, enabling practitioners to predict optimal configurations at production scales without expensive large-scale tuning. However, estimating these scaling laws conventionally requires exhaustive grid searches over thousands of training runs, consuming enormous computational resources. We introduce Power-Law Entropy Search (PLES), a computational cost-aware acquisition function built on multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization that efficiently estimates optimal hyperparameter scaling laws through adaptive experimentation. A key innovation in PLES is that it searches for candidates that reduce the overall uncertainty of a scaling law estimate, instead of optimizing a single objective function. At each iteration, PLES selects the candidate configuration that maximally reduces the uncertainty of the scaling law estimates per unit computational cost, naturally favoring informative small-scale experiments. We evaluate PLES on synthetic benchmarks, surrogate models fitted to real LLM training data, and actual LLM pre-training runs. Across all settings, PLES converges to accurate optimal hyperparameter scaling laws using less than one-tenth of the computational budget required by conventional grid search and other baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Power-Law Entropy Search (PLES)，一种基于多保真贝叶斯优化的计算成本感知采集函数，用于高效估计大语言模型训练的最优超参数缩放定律。PLS通过选择能最大程度降低缩放定律估计不确定性的候选配置，而非优化单一目标函数，从而在不到传统网格搜索十分之一的计算预算内收敛到准确的缩放定律。
AI.motivation: 最优超参数缩放定律能帮助实践者在生产规模下预测最优配置，避免昂贵的大规模调参。然而，传统方法需要对数以千计的训练运行进行穷举网格搜索，消耗巨大计算资源。因此需要一种更高效的方法来估计这些缩放定律。
AI.method: PLES是一种计算成本感知的采集函数，构建在多保真贝叶斯优化之上。其核心创新在于：它搜索能整体降低缩放定律估计不确定性的候选方案，而非优化单一目标函数。每次迭代中，PLES选择在单位计算成本下最大程度降低缩放定律估计不确定性的候选配置，自然倾向于信息量大的小规模实验。
AI.result: 在合成基准、拟合真实LLM训练数据的代理模型以及实际LLM预训练运行三种场景中，PLES均以不到传统网格搜索和其他基线方法十分之一的计算预算收敛到准确的最优超参数缩放定律。
AI.conclusion: PLES通过从"优化目标"转向"最小化缩放定律估计不确定性"的范式转变，结合多保真贝叶斯优化和计算成本感知，实现了对最优超参数缩放定律的高效估算，大幅降低了计算开销，为大规模LLM训练的超参数配置预测提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Towards AI-Assisted Clinical Trial Matching: Practical Considerations, Multicenter Evaluation, and Real-World Deployment
summary: Clinical trials are essential for advancing cancer care and drug development, but many fail because of insufficient patient enrollment. While there is growing interest in using AI to support patient recruitment, existing systems largely perform eligibility assessment alone and have rarely been evaluated in real-world oncology workflows. Here we present TrialGPT 2.0, an AI-assisted clinical trial recommendation system designed for real-world deployment. Rather than asking only whether a patient may qualify, the system also assesses which trials warrant further consideration given the patient's current clinical needs and local workflow priorities, and provides structured, inspectable explanations for expert review. Importantly, we evaluated TrialGPT 2.0 retrospectively and prospectively across multiple oncology-focused settings, spanning government, academic cancer-center, patient-advocacy, and NIH referral workflows. In retrospective multicenter cohorts comprising 288 cases, TrialGPT 2.0 retrieved at least one clinician-recommended trial in its top 10 recommendations for approximately 91% of cases while reducing clinician screening time by 55.0%. In a six-month prospective evaluation embedded in an active precision oncology tumor board, TrialGPT 2.0 contributed additional trial opportunities missed by the routine workflow, expanding patient access to clinical trial participation by 90.9%. To support scientific reproducibility, we also introduce NIH-TrialBench, a clinician-authored dataset comprising 126 diverse synthetic patient vignettes and matching scenarios from 11 NIH Institutes and Centers. Together, these results support the value of AI to assist clinical trial matching by improving clinician efficiency and identifying frequently overlooked trial opportunities, ultimately helping to expand and accelerate accrual to cancer trials.

AI.tldr: TrialGPT 2.0是一个面向真实世界部署的AI辅助临床试验推荐系统，不仅评估患者是否符合入组资格，还根据患者临床需求和本地工作流优先级推荐值得进一步考虑的试验，并提供结构化、可检查的解释供专家审阅。系统在回顾性多中心队列（288例）中，前10项推荐中包含至少一项临床医生推荐试验的比例约为91%，同时将医生筛查时间减少55.0%；在为期六个月的精准肿瘤学肿瘤委员会前瞻性评估中，额外发现常规流程遗漏的试验机会，使患者参与临床试验的机会扩大90.9%。此外，论文还发布了由临床医生撰写的NIH-TrialBench数据集（126个患者场景，涵盖11个NIH研究所），以支持科学可复现性。
AI.motivation: 临床试验对推进癌症治疗和药物开发至关重要，但许多试验因患者入组不足而失败。现有AI系统大多只做资格评估，很少在真实肿瘤学工作流中得到评估。因此需要一种能真正部署到现实工作流程中的AI辅助推荐系统，以提升医生效率并发现被遗漏的试验机会。
AI.method: TrialGPT 2.0超越了单纯的资格判断，同时评估哪些试验在考虑患者当前临床需求和本地工作流优先级后值得进一步考虑，并提供结构化的、可检查的解释供专家审阅。研究采用了回顾性与前瞻性评估：回顾性多中心队列包含288例病例，覆盖政府、学术癌症中心、患者倡导组织和NIH转诊工作流；前瞻性评估则在活跃的精准肿瘤学肿瘤委员会中进行六个月的嵌入部署。同时构建了NIH-TrialBench数据集，包含126个由临床医生撰写的多样化合成患者场景，对应11个NIH研究所和中心的匹配场景。
AI.result: 在回顾性多中心队列（288例）中，TrialGPT 2.0在前10项推荐中包含至少一项临床医生推荐试验的比例约为91%，同时将临床医生筛查时间减少55.0%。在六个月的前瞻性评估中，TrialGPT 2.0发现了常规工作流遗漏的额外试验机会，将患者参与临床试验的机会扩大90.9%。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，AI在协助临床试验匹配方面具有价值，能够提高临床医生效率并发现经常被忽视的试验机会，最终有助于扩大和加速癌症试验的患者入组。同时，NIH-TrialBench数据集为科学可复现性提供了支持。

title: Multimodal RGB-Infrared Combination for UAV-Based Wildfire Segmentation: A Comparative Study on FLAME3
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have emerged as a promising platform for firefighting operations due to their flexibility, low operational cost, and ability to acquire high-resolution imagery in locations that may be difficult or dangerous to access using conventional methods. Recent advances in deep learning have significantly improved the capabilities of UAV-based wildfire monitoring systems. The present work investigates RGB-infrared fusion for binary wildfire segmentation on the FLAME3 dataset. In this Study, RGB and Infrared baselines are compared with three representative fusion strategies across three segmentation architectures, including U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and SegFormer. The key motivation of this work is to analyze the contribution of each modality, evaluate the impact of fusion timing, and examine how different network architectures exploit multimodal information for UAV wildfire delineation. The findings indicate that thermal information plays a dominant role in UAV segmentation and that feature-level multimodal fusion combined with transformer-based architectures offers the most promising direction for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了无人机森林火灾图像分割中的RGB-红外多模态融合问题，在FLAME3数据集上对比了三种分割架构（U-Net、DeepLabV3+、SegFormer）下的RGB/红外基线与三种代表性融合策略，发现热红外信息对分割起主导作用，且特征级融合结合基于Transformer的架构是最有前景的方向。
AI.motivation: 无人机因其灵活性、低运行成本及在难以或危险区域获取高分辨率图像的能力，成为火灾扑救的重要平台，而深度学习进一步提升了基于无人机的野火监测能力。本文的核心动机是分析各模态对野火分割的贡献、评估融合时机（即不同融合阶段）的影响，并考察不同网络架构如何利用多模态信息进行野火边界划定。
AI.method: 在FLAME3数据集上进行RGB-红外双模态二值野火分割实验：分别构建RGB与红外单模态基线，并与三种代表性融合策略进行对比；同时采用U-Net、DeepLabV3+和SegFormer三种分割架构，系统评估不同融合时序（如输入级、特征级等）对分割性能的影响。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，热红外信息在无人机野火分割中起主导作用；特征级多模态融合结合基于Transformer的架构（SegFormer）性能最佳，为未来的研究提供了最有前景的方向。
AI.conclusion: 本研究系统验证了热红外模态在无人机野火分割中的核心价值，指出特征级融合与Transformer架构的组合是提升野火分割性能的关键路径，为后续无人机火灾监测系统的多模态融合设计提供了重要的实验依据和方向指引。

title: WorldBench: Culturally Grounded Benchmark for Multilingual Agents
summary: Despite the growing use of LLM-powered agents to solve multi-step tasks in complex environments, existing benchmarks rarely test state preservation, performance across languages, and application to realistic, grounded scenarios. To address these concerns, we present WorldBench: a comprehensive, multilingual benchmark of genuine, persona-grounded everyday workflows, where agents can act in a sandbox via structured actions. WorldBench comprises 1,600 tasks across seven languages and eight cultures, filtered and refined through feedback from human annotators with language- and culture-specific expertise. For evaluation, we extend metrics from previous works and introduce Constrained Task Success (CTS), which combines natural language instructions and testbeds to score task completion, minimal modification, and other complementary metrics through deterministic and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations. Our experiments show that frontier models reach only 49.2% CTS, with all models demonstrating large gaps between correctness and environment preservation. We thereby show that current agents remain brittle in multilingual, agentic scenarios, especially for long-horizon tasks and under state-preservation constraints

AI.tldr: 本文提出WorldBench，一个大规模多语言、多文化、基于真实人物角色日常事务的智能体评测基准，包含7种语言、8种文化下的1,600个任务，并引入Constrained Task Success (CTS)指标对任务完成度、环境最小改动等进行确定性及LLM-as-a-Judge评估，实验表明前沿模型CTS仅达49.2%，暴露了其在长时程任务和状态保持约束下的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体基准很少测试状态保持能力、跨语言性能以及对现实接地场景的应用，缺乏对多步骤、多语言、多文化环境下真实日常事务的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建WorldBench基准：覆盖七种语言和八种文化、经具备语言与文化专长的人工标注者筛选和精炼的1,600个任务；智能体可在沙箱中通过结构化动作行动。扩展既有指标并提出Constrained Task Success (CTS)，将自然语言指令与测试环境结合，通过确定性评估与LLM-as-a-Judge评估，综合衡量任务完成度、最小化环境改动及其他互补指标。
AI.result: 前沿模型CTS仅达49.2%，所有模型在正确性与环境保持之间存在较大差距，表明当前智能体在多语言、智能体场景中仍较脆弱，尤其在长时程任务和状态保持约束下表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 现有智能体在真实感、多语言、多文化的agentic场景中仍显脆弱，尤其在长时程任务和状态保持约束下性能明显不足，WorldBench可作为推动该方向评测与发展的基准。

title: Edge-Girth as a Structural Edge Feature for Graph Neural Networks
summary: Graph neural networks (GNN) based on message passing are provably no more powerful than the one-dimensional Weisfeiler--Leman colour-refinement test (1-WL): two graphs it cannot tell apart receive identical representations, however deep or wide the network. A common remedy augments node or edge features with precomputed structural descriptors, most often counts of a fixed small subgraph such as triangles or longer cycles, but such counts require committing in advance to the size of the substructure counted, a choice usually made blind to the data. We study a descriptor that avoids this choice. The edge-girth of an edge is the length of a shortest cycle through it, and its multiplicity is the number of such shortest cycles; together they form a per-edge invariant that reports cycles of arbitrary length, computable exactly by a single breadth-first search per edge. Injected into a gated message-passing architecture, EGAGNN, it reaches a test MAE a factor three below the closest gated comparator on the ZINC-12k regression benchmark at 104k parameters; against bounded cycle-counting descriptors under the same architecture, it matches only a dictionary counting cycles up to length eight, using twice as many channels, while a dictionary capped at length four performs no better than no structural information at all. On graph discrimination we prove a matching limitation: on graphs where every edge sees the same number of shortest cycles of the same length, the descriptor becomes constant and any model built on it collapses back to the 1-WL bound. This holds without exception across all 400 pairs of the BREC benchmark: not one of the 90 such pairs is distinguished.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于边围长（edge-girth）及其重数（multiplicity）的逐边结构描述符，它可报告任意长度的环而无需预先指定子图大小，通过每条边一次广度优先搜索精确计算；将其注入门控消息传递架构EGAGNN，在ZINC-12k基准上以10.4万参数将测试MAE降低到最接近门控对比模型的三分之一，并能匹敌计数到长度八的环字典描述符；同时证明该描述符在每条边具有相同最短环长度与重数的图上退化为常数，模型坍缩回1-WL界限，BREC基准中90个此类图对无一被区分。
AI.motivation: 基于消息传递的GNN在表达能力上不超过1-WL颜色细化测试，常见补救措施是注入预计算的子结构计数（如三角形、长环），但这类计数需要事先盲选被计数的子图大小。作者希望找到一种无需预先承诺子结构尺寸的结构描述符。
AI.method: 利用边的围长（经过该边的最短环长度）及其重数（此类最短环的数量）构成逐边不变量，可编码任意长度的环，每条边通过一次BFS精确计算。将该描述符注入门控消息传递架构，得到EGAGNN模型；并从理论上证明当图中每条边的最短环长度与重数相同时该描述符为常数，任意基于它的模型崩溃回1-WL界限。
AI.result: EGAGNN在ZINC-12k回归基准上测试MAE比最接近的门控对比模型低三倍（10.4万参数）；与有界环计数描述符相比，仅能匹敌计数至长度八的字典（且需两倍通道），而上限为四的字典效果与无结构信息相当；在图判别上，BREC基准400对中有90对属于描述符退化情形，全部无法区分，该结果无一例外。
AI.conclusion: 任意长度环的逐边描述符在有界计数基线中表现突出，但其区分能力存在本质上限：在对称性导致描述符常数的图上，模型能力坍缩回1-WL，说明此类局部环特征不能超越1-WL的表达界限。

title: Ready to Speak: Aligning LLMs for TTS-Friendly Text Generation
summary: Current Large Language Models (LLMs) are primarily optimized for written text, often producing outputs that are grammatically correct and helpful yet poorly suited for spoken delivery via Text-to-Speech (TTS). In this work, we study how to make LLMs natively generate TTS-friendly text, which we frame as a preference alignment problem: instead of relying on downstream rewriting modules, we directly align LLMs to generate text optimized for spoken delivery. We introduce two preference datasets spanning different target domains, CORA and Recipe, which contain paired TTS-friendly and TTS-unfriendly responses. We further propose an evaluation suite combining a pattern-based heuristic metric, a TTS$\to$ASR evaluation pipeline, and a MUSHRA listening study with human judges. Our experiments compare the recently proposed Feature-aware Sampling and Tuning (FaST) framework -- leveraging interpretable features instead of a black-box reward model -- against an array of alignment baselines on the TTS-friendly generation task. Notably, we found that FaST achieves the best overall tradeoff between TTS-friendliness and helpfulness across various settings. We also identified a strong correlation between our different metrics, highlighting the ability to reliably assess TTS-friendliness via an efficient heuristic.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何让大语言模型（LLM）原生生成适合语音合成（TTS）的文本，将其建模为偏好对齐问题：无需下游改写模块，直接对齐LLM生成面向口语输出的文本。作者构建了覆盖不同领域的成对偏好数据集CORA和Recipe，提出了包含模式启发式指标、TTS→ASR评估流水线及MUSHRA人工听感测试的评估套件，并对比了FaST框架与多种对齐基线。实验表明FaST在TTS友好性与有用性之间取得了最佳综合权衡，且各指标间存在强相关性，可用高效启发式指标可靠评估TTS友好性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM主要针对书面文本优化，其输出虽语法正确、内容有用，却不适合通过TTS进行口语化播报；而当前方案通常依赖下游改写模块，增加系统复杂度且未必最优。因此，作者希望让LLM原生生成TTS友好文本，并将此视为偏好对齐问题。
AI.method: 作者将TTS友好文本生成形式化为偏好对齐任务：1) 构建两个覆盖不同目标领域的成对偏好数据集CORA与Recipe（含TTS友好与不友好配对的响应）；2) 提出结合基于模式的启发式指标、TTS→ASR评估流水线以及MUSHRA人工听感测试的评估套件；3) 使用基于可解释特征而非黑盒奖励模型的FaST框架，与多种对齐基线在TTS友好生成任务上进行系统对比。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，FaST框架在多种设置下于TTS友好性与内容有用性之间取得了最佳综合权衡；同时，作者发现所提出的不同评估指标之间具有强相关性，说明可通过高效的启发式指标可靠地评估TTS友好性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明LLM可以通过偏好对齐直接生成TTS友好文本，无需下游改写模块；FaST凭借可解释特征实现了优于基线方法的表现，而高效启发式指标与复杂评估流水线的强相关性，为TTS友好性的低成本可靠评估提供了依据，推动了LLM直接面向语音播报的生成。

title: Scale-based Approach for Active Wildfire Segmentation on Satellite Imagery
summary: Active wildfire mapping from satellite imagery is challenging due to the sparse and highly imbalanced nature of fire pixels, especially in early-stage or low-density fire observations. This work investigates the use of multispectral Landsat-8 imagery for active-fire segmentation under multi-scale wildfire size conditions. We propose a data-driven protocol to characterize fire-region size distributions through connected-component analysis and an interquartile range criterion, enabling the evaluation of model robustness across different local fire-region densities. Three segmentation architectures, U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and SegFormer, are evaluated under different SWIR-based spectral configurations. Results show that U-Net achieves the strongest robustness across the evaluated conditions, SegFormer provides competitive performance, and DeepLabV3+ tends to produce conservative predictions with reduced recall. Across architectures, SWIR2 consistently achieves the strongest or near-best results, highlighting its importance for active-fire segmentation in Landsat-8 imagery. These findings suggest that both spectral band selection and architectural design are critical for robust satellite-based active wildfire mapping trained on low active fire-pixel density images.

AI.tldr: 本文针对卫星影像中活动火灾像素稀疏且高度不平衡的难题，提出一种基于连通分量分析与四分位距准则的数据驱动协议来刻画火灾区域尺寸分布，并在多尺度火灾条件下评估 U-Net、DeepLabV3+ 与 SegFormer 三种分割架构在不同 SWIR 光谱配置下的表现。结果表明 U-Net 鲁棒性最强、SegFormer 表现接近、DeepLabV3+ 预测偏保守，且 SWIR2 波段对活动火灾分割尤为关键。
AI.motivation: 活动火灾像素在卫星影像中极为稀疏且类别高度不平衡，尤其在火灾早期或低密度观测条件下，导致主动火灾分割极具挑战性；同时不同尺度火灾区域的存在进一步考验模型的泛化鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出一种数据驱动的协议：通过连通分量分析结合四分位距（IQR）准则对火灾区域尺寸分布进行表征，以评估模型在不同局部火灾区域密度下的鲁棒性；在此基础上，在基于 SWIR 的不同光谱配置下分别训练并比较 U-Net、DeepLabV3+ 和 SegFormer 三种分割架构。
AI.result: U-Net 在各类评估条件下鲁棒性最强，SegFormer 表现具有竞争力，DeepLabV3+ 则倾向于产生保守的预测且召回率较低；在所有架构中，SWIR2 波段始终取得最强或接近最优的结果，凸显其对 Landsat-8 活动火灾分割的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 光谱波段选择与网络架构设计对基于低活动火灾像素密度图像进行稳健的星载活动火灾制图均至关重要；两项因素的合理组合能够显著提升火灾分割的鲁棒性与精度。

title: User Representation via Cross Multi-source Behavior Pre-training for Mobile Games
comment: Accepted by IEEE ICDM 2026, regular paper, 10 pages
summary: User representation pre-training has become a fundamental paradigm for alleviating data sparsity in downstream personalization tasks. However, existing studies predominantly focus on single-app or app-level behaviors, overlooking the inherently cross-source and multi-granular nature of user activities on mobile devices. At the device level, user intent emerges from complex interactions among heterogeneous behavior sources and hierarchical action structures, posing challenges that cannot be addressed by conventional app-centric modeling. To tackle this issue, we propose CM-PTM, a novel Cross Multi-source Behavior Pre-Training Model tailored for mobile game user representation learning on device-level behavioral logs. CM-PTM employs hierarchical cascaded mask-then-predict proxy tasks that first infer the source of the next behavior and then progressively refine predictions at the app-action level. This design enables unified modeling of cross-source dependencies and fine-grained behavioral dynamics within a single pre-training paradigm. Extensive experiments on large-scale real-world mobile datasets demonstrate that CM-PTM effectively captures users' endogenous interests and consistently delivers significant performance gains on downstream mobile game recommendation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出CM-PTM，一种面向移动设备级行为日志的跨多源行为预训练模型，通过层级级联的掩码-预测代理任务统一建模跨来源依赖与细粒度行为动态，并在大规模真实移动数据集上验证其对下游手游推荐任务的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有用户表示预训练研究主要聚焦于单一应用或应用级行为，忽视了移动设备上用户行为天然具有跨来源、多粒度特性；设备层面用户意图来源于异构行为来源与层级动作结构的复杂交互，传统以应用为中心的建模方法难以应对该挑战。
AI.method: 提出CM-PTM，采用层级级联的掩码-预测（mask-then-predict）代理任务：首先推断下一行为的来源（source），再逐步细化到应用-动作（app-action）级别的预测，从而在单一预训练范式下统一建模跨来源依赖与细粒度行为动态。
AI.result: 在大规模真实移动数据集上的大量实验表明，CM-PTM能有效捕捉用户内生兴趣，并在下游移动游戏推荐任务上持续取得显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CM-PTM证实了面向设备级跨来源、多粒度行为建模的预训练范式能够更好地学习用户表征，缓解数据稀疏问题，并稳定提升下游移动游戏推荐效果，为该方向提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Diffusion as a Training Curriculum for Timestep-Free Iterative Reasoning
summary: Diffusion models and recursive reasoners are both iterative, but they carry information across iterations differently. We add a persistent hidden state to a diffusion denoiser and remove its timestep conditioning, leaving a single shared update that can be run to arbitrary depth. The result is an anytime solver: accuracy keeps improving with inference depth far beyond the rollout lengths and backpropagation window used in training, reaching 99.90% exact solve on Sudoku-Extreme. We also obtain 98.93% solve rate on Maze-Unique. Surprisingly, progressive denoising is unnecessary at inference: holding corruption at its maximum by replacing every non-clue variable with fresh Gaussian noise at each step retains near-perfect solving and converges to stable solutions. This simple noise-injection mechanism enables a single trajectory to efficiently explore the solution space and settle on the correct answer without parallel rollouts, candidate selection, or external verifiers required by prior reasoning models. Nonetheless, ordered annealed corruption remains critical during training, which suggests that diffusion's primary contribution to our anytime solver is not a sampling procedure at inference, but a denoising training curriculum.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将扩散模型与递归推理统一起来的"任意时刻求解器"（anytime solver）：在扩散去噪器中加入持久隐状态并移除时间步条件，使同一共享更新可任意深度运行。该方法在Sudoku-Extreme达到99.90%的精确求解率、Maze-Unique达98.93%，且推理时无需渐进去噪——每步注入最大程度的高斯噪声仍可近乎完美求解并收敛到稳定解。作者发现扩散的核心贡献并非推理时的采样过程，而是训练时有序退火损坏所构成的去噪训练课程。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型与递归推理器都是迭代式过程，但二者跨迭代传递信息的方式不同。作者希望弥合这一差异，探索能否设计一种同时具备扩散模型鲁棒性与递归推理深度扩展能力的迭代求解机制，从而在无并行采样、无候选选择、无外部验证器的条件下高效求解组合推理问题。
AI.method: 在扩散去噪器中加入一个持久隐藏状态（persistent hidden state），并移除其时间步条件（timestep conditioning），从而得到一个可在任意深度运行的单一共享更新函数。训练时仍采用有序退火损坏（ordered annealed corruption）的课程；推理时则放弃渐进去噪，改为每一步用全新高斯噪声替换所有非线索变量（保持最大损坏），使单条轨迹高效探索解空间并稳定收敛。
AI.result: 该求解器在远超训练时展开长度与反向传播窗口的推理深度下持续提升精度，在Sudoku-Extreme上达到99.90%的精确求解率，在Maze-Unique上达到98.93%的求解率。最令人意外的是推理阶段无需渐进去噪：即使每一步都保持最大损坏水平并注入新鲜高斯噪声，仍能近乎完美求解并收敛到稳定解。
AI.conclusion: 作者据此推断，扩散机制在该任意时刻求解器中的主要贡献并非推理时的采样流程，而是训练阶段的有序退火损坏所构建的去噪训练课程。噪声注入本身即可作为高效的解空间探索机制，这为设计无需外部验证与并行展开的深度推理模型提供了新的思路。

title: From Base Rollouts to RL Reasoning: A Budgeted Search Perspective
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but how these gains relate to inference-time decoding and search remains unclear. Does RL create reasoning the base model lacks, or shift the rollout distribution toward trajectories it can already reach but rarely samples? We study this behaviorally with a Unified Decoding Framework (UDF), which expresses token-level sampling, beam-like search, tree search, and sequence-level resampling as executable policies over a shared budgeted operating space, scored post hoc with pass@$k$, self-consistency, best-of-$N$, and first-finish success. Using paired Base/RL checkpoints from SimpleRL-Zoo, we ask whether an RL default-policy curve can be approximated by a structured path of Base operating points. On Math500, AIME, GPQA, and IFEval, the pass@$k$ recovery path follows a Budgeted Operating-Point Transition Rule (BOPTR), $N_{\mathrm{Base}} \approx αN_{\mathrm{RL}}^β$, with benchmark-conditioned exponents. On Qwen2.5-7B, BOPTR gives the lowest transfer error among the non-oracle rules we test, 3.41 pp (95% CI [2.32, 5.53]); a three-seed replication gives 3.07 $\pm$ 0.39 pp. The rule extends to ten models across four families (3.28 to 4.87 pp on checkpoints added after fitting), to four benchmarks it was never fitted on (5.03 pp vs. 4.44 pp in fit), and holds without an RL checkpoint for the target model (4.19 pp) or without RL supervision of any kind (5.08 pp). These results support a qualified internalized-search reading: under the recipe we test, much of the measured RL gain corresponds to a change in sampling efficiency toward operating points the base model can already reach under search. We treat the scaling patterns as descriptive of this recipe and cohort, report where they break down, and use UDF and BOPTR as behavioral diagnostics rather than evidence of parameter-level equivalence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提升语言模型推理能力的机制，提出统一解码框架（UDF）与预算化操作点转移规则（BOPTR），证明RL默认策略曲线可被基线模型的搜索操作点近似，支持“内化搜索”的有限解释。
AI.motivation: RLVR显著提升语言模型推理能力，但其收益的来源尚不明确：RL究竟创造了基线模型本不具备的推理能力，还是仅仅把采样分布移向基线模型虽能达到但极少采样的轨迹？作者希望从行为层面回答这一问题。
AI.method: 提出统一解码框架（UDF），将token级采样、束搜索、树搜索、序列级重采样表达为共享预算操作空间中的可执行策略，并用pass@k、self-consistency、best-of-N、first-finish success进行事后评分。基于SimpleRL-Zoo的Base/RL配对检查点，检验RL默认策略曲线能否被Base模型的结构化操作点路径近似，推导出预算化操作点转移规则（BOPTR）：N_Base ≈ α N_RL^β。
AI.result: BOPTR在Qwen2.5-7B上取得非oracle规则中最低的迁移误差3.41个百分点（95% CI [2.32, 5.53]），三种子复现为3.07±0.39 pp；该规则可泛化到四个家族的十个模型（3.28至4.87 pp）、四个未拟合基准（5.03 pp vs 拟合4.44 pp），并在无RL检查点（4.19 pp）乃至完全无RL监督（5.08 pp）时依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种有限度的“内化搜索”解释：在所测试的配方下，RL的大部分可测收益对应采样效率的改变，即把解码导向基模型在搜索下本可达到的操作点。作者强调这些缩放模式仅对所测配方与模型群组具描述性，并指出其失效情形；UDF与BOPTR应作为行为诊断工具，而非参数级等价性的证据。

title: MegaStyle++: Scaling Image Style Space through Hierarchical Style Definition
comment: The dataset and code will be updated at https://github.com/Tencent/MegaStyle, 10pages, 5 figures
summary: Image style is a highly abstract, human-constructed concept shaped by a range of visual factors and intrinsically entangled with content, yet a unified and explicit definition of image style remains lacking. In this work, we first discuss the fundamental question of what is style and then propose a hierarchical style definition that describes image style from an overall style identity to fine-grained visual attributes, providing a more structured, transferable, and interpretable style representation. Based on this definition, we refine the style annotation pipeline of MegaStyle and construct MegaStyle++-8M, a large-scale style dataset containing 150K overall style identities, 1M fine-grained style prompts, and 8M stylized images. Extensive analyses demonstrate that our hierarchical definition substantially expands the style space in both diversity and semantic breadth, while precisely capturing intrinsic visual style of reference images. The dataset and code will be updated at https://github.com/Tencent/MegaStyle, we hope MegaStyle++ provides a scalable foundation for studying and modeling diverse image styles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种层级化的图像风格定义，并基于此构建了大规模风格数据集 MegaStyle++-8M（含150K整体风格身份、1M细粒度风格提示词、8M风格化图像），在多样性与语义广度上显著拓展了风格空间，为图像风格研究提供了可扩展的基础。
AI.motivation: 图像风格是一个高度抽象、由人类构建的概念，由多种视觉因素共同塑造，且与内容内在纠缠，目前缺乏统一且明确的风格定义，这阻碍了风格的可结构化表示与建模。
