AI.result: 3种直觉假设均无法预测哪些层受益于精度恢复；损伤弥散分布，8/9模型恢复75%精度差距需约一半层数，仅Qwen3-8B高度集中。在匹配的精度预算下，全局细粒度量化优于局部修复，对所有8个group-128兼容模型提升21-52点（含集中型的Qwen3-8B）。次要发现：残差受预算限制（8-bit近似无损）；峰值恢复位置与家族内架构相关但跨家族不相关。
AI.conclusion: 在该预算设定下，全局更细的量化粒度是比选择性保护关键层更好的默认策略。更重要的是，与量化损伤相关的廉价启发式信号并不能直接指认恢复精度能提升精度的位置，必须通过因果干预来验证此类问题。

title: Investigating Linear Probe Robustness to Linguistic Register, Medical Specialty, and Corpus Shifts in Medical QA
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 9 pages, 4 figures (main text); 28 pages total, including appendix. Code and data: https://github.com/mnishant2/MedProbe_release
summary: Linear classifiers trained on hidden states of a large language model (LLM), linear probes, can flag factual errors from a single forward pass. Geometrically, that implies that true and false statements separate along a stable direction in hidden state space, i.e., the truth direction. Prior work disagrees on whether this generalises across input shifts, but the disagreement is hard to interpret because cross-dataset probe transfer experiments confound several kinds of input change at once. We isolate three such variables in medical question-answering (QA): writing style (register), domain (medical specialty), and corpus (dataset). We build a benchmark using 500 MedQA entries, each rewritten into four styles (textbook, patient, clinical note, colloquial), annotated with clinical specialty, and grouped with two other exam corpora, MedMCQA and MMLU-medical, for cross-dataset evaluation. Probing four open-weight LLMs (2--8B), we find that the truth direction is largely robust to writing style (mean $Δ_\text{register} \approx 0.10$ AUROC on held-out facts) and to medical specialty ($Δ_\text{specialty} \approx 0.03$), but degrades unevenly across corpora: by $0.12$ AUROC on MMLU-medical and by $0.21$ on MedMCQA, roughly twice the register gap. The register result replicates with a second generator and carries over to human-written patient questions. The truth direction is therefore largely stable within the medical domain but breaks under some corpus shifts, and question format does not explain the break, which suggests that the signal a linear probe recovers is partly bound to dataset structure rather than to medical knowledge alone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过解耦三种输入变化（写作风格、医学专科、语料库）来评估线性探针所学"真值方向"的泛化能力，发现其在写作风格与专科上基本稳健，但在跨语料库（MedMCQA、MMLU-medical）上明显退化，且此退化不能由问题格式解释，表明探针信号部分绑定于数据集结构而非纯粹的医学知识。
AI.motivation: 以往关于真值方向能否跨输入偏移泛化的研究存在分歧，但跨数据集探针迁移实验同时混入了多种输入变化（风格、领域、语料库），难以解释分歧来源。作者希望隔离这些变量，明确真值方向究竟对哪种变化稳健、对哪种变化失效。
AI.method: 构建基准：将500条MedQA条目改写为四种风格（教材、患者、临床笔记、口语），标注临床专科，并与MedMCQA、MMLU-medical两个考试语料库组合作跨数据集评测。对四个开源LLM（2-8B）的隐藏状态训练线性探针，分别测写作风格、医学专科、语料库三种偏移下的AUROC变化。
AI.result: 真值方向对写作风格大体稳健（平均Δ_register≈0.10 AUROC），对医学专科更稳健（Δ_specialty≈0.03），但在跨语料库时非均匀退化：MMLU-medical上下降0.12，MedMCQA上下降0.21，约为风格差距的两倍。注册（格式）结果用第二个生成器复现，并推广到人工书写的患者问题。
AI.conclusion: 真值方向在医学领域内部大体稳定，但在某些语料库偏移下失效；问题格式并非失效原因，说明线性探针恢复的信号部分与数据集结构绑定，而非仅依赖医学知识。

title: Revisiting Cross-View Completion: Self-Supervised Pre-Training via Reconstruction Error Comparison
summary: Self-supervised pre-training via cross-view completion learns strong features for 3D vision from co-visible regions of image pairs. However, the reference view provides little information for reconstructing non-co-visible patches, implicitly yielding a monocular training signal in these regions. We introduce Gekko, which turns this limitation into a useful signal. The relative improvement of the cross-view reconstruction error over a masked-autoencoder error is a self-supervised proxy for co-visibility: large improvements indicate co-visible regions, negligible ones non-co-visible areas. Gekko is a network, trained from scratch, that jointly performs cross-view completion, masked autoencoding, and per-pixel prediction of this relative improvement, providing an additional binocular signal for all masked regions without any ground-truth 3D annotation. Under identical architectures and training data, Gekko consistently outperforms CroCo on zero-shot correspondence estimation, relative pose estimation, and pointmap regression, with up to 6 times higher accuracy at the strictest relative-pose threshold and a 22% drop in end-point error on ETH3D. The extra channel it learns is itself a strong co-visibility detector on unseen scenes, and Gekko's frozen features outperform released cross-view backbones of comparable or larger size. It can also be trained directly from raw videos with a simple stride-based curriculum, removing the cumbersome 3D preprocessing prior methods require while matching models trained on curated data. Code and pre-trained models are publicly available.

AI.tldr: Gekko 是一种针对 3D 视觉的自监督预训练方法，它将交叉视角补全中的"非共视区域缺乏参考信息"这一局限转化为有效信号：通过比较交叉视角重建误差与掩码自编码器误差的相对提升量，作为共视性的自监督代理，并让网络联合学习交叉视角补全、掩码自编码和逐像素共视性预测，从而为所有掩码区域提供额外的双目信号，无需任何 3D 真值标注，在零样本匹配、相对位姿估计和点图回归上持续超越 CroCo。
AI.motivation: 现有基于交叉视角补全的自监督预训练（如 CroCo）能利用图像对共视区域学习强的 3D 视觉特征，但参考视图对非共视区域几乎不提供信息，导致这些区域退化为单调的单目训练信号，限制了特征的多样性。作者希望把这一看似缺陷的现象转化为有意义、可利用的自监督信号。
AI.method: Gekko 的关键洞察是：交叉视角重建误差相对掩码自编码误差的改善程度可作为共视性的自监督代理——改善大说明是共视区域，改善可忽略则是非共视区域。据此训练一个从零开始的网络，联合执行三项任务：交叉视角补全、掩码自编码，以及逐像素预测该相对改善量，从而为所有掩码区域提供额外的双目信号。此外，Gekko 可直接在原始视频上使用基于步长（stride）的简单课程策略训练，省去了以往方法繁琐的 3D 预处理流程。
AI.result: 在完全相同的架构与训练数据下，Gekko 在零样本对应关系估计、相对位姿估计和点图回归上一致优于 CroCo：在最严格的相对位姿阈值下精度最高提升 6 倍，在 ETH3D 上端点误差下降 22%。学习到的额外通道本身在未见场景上是强共视性检测器；其冻结特征优于已发布的同等或更大规模的交叉视角骨干网络；基于原始视频训练的模型也能匹配用精挑数据训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: Gekko 证明将交叉视角补全的"非共视局限"转化为显式的共视性预测信号，能显著提升 3D 视觉自监督预训练的特征质量，并在多种下游任务上超越现有方法；同时其训练流程可简化为直接从原始视频学习，为消除对 3D 标注/预处理的依赖提供了可行路径。代码与预训练模型已公开。

title: Making Prospective Memory SLM-Shaped: Typed Intention Stores for Small-Model Agents
summary: Prospective memory means carrying out a deferred intention at the right future cue while other work continues. Benchmarks now isolate it as an agent skill, yet frontier LLMs still struggle: the best published PM-Bench scaffold reaches only 65.1% Set-F1. We argue that this loop is schema-constrained state tracking rather than open-ended reasoning, and that small models can execute it when the action space is typed. We propose the Prospective Intention Store (PIS) that puts lifecycle logic in code and scoped language work on the model. The scaffold is agentic and training-free: no selector fine-tuning and no trajectory distillation. On PM-Bench, DeepSeek-Chat with PIS reaches 82.9% Set-F1. On Gemma-E2B, Set-F1 is only 4.2% without a store and at most 6.6% under seven retrospective memories, while PIS reaches 66.2%. PIS further reaches 70.1% Set-F1, where retrospective memory methods stay at most 54.4%. PIS sets a new state of the art on this benchmark and enables small models to surpass the published large-model scaffold.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练、基于智能体（agentic）的脚手架——前瞻意图存储（PIS），将生命周期逻辑放在代码中、将范围化的语言工作交给模型，在PM-Bench上以82.9% Set-F1刷新SOTA，并让小模型超越已发表的大模型脚手架，验证了前瞻记忆是"受模式约束的状态跟踪"这一论断。
AI.motivation: 前瞻记忆是智能体在继续其他工作的同时、在正确的未来线索出现时执行延迟意图的能力。尽管基准测试已将其孤立为一项智能体技能，但前沿LLM仍然表现不佳：PM-Bench上已发表的最佳脚手架仅达到65.1% Set-F1。作者认为该任务本质上是受模式（schema）约束的状态跟踪，而非开放式推理，因此小模型在动作空间被类型化时也能够执行它，这为设计更轻量、可扩展的解决方案提供了动机。
AI.method: 提出前瞻意图存储（PIS）脚手架，采用"代理式+免训练"设计：将意图的生命周期逻辑（如存储、匹配、触发、更新状态）放入代码中实现，而将范围化的语言处理任务（scoped language work）交由模型完成。PIS不依赖选择器微调（selector fine-tuning），也不依赖轨迹蒸馏（trajectory distillation），属于纯推理时的agentic框架。
AI.result: 在PM-Bench上，DeepSeek-Chat配合PIS达到82.9% Set-F1（对比已发布最佳脚手架65.1%）。在Gemma-E2B上，无存储时Set-F1仅4.2%，使用七条回溯记忆最多也只能达到6.6%，而PIS达到66.2%；在另一场景下PIS达到70.1%，而回溯记忆方法最多只有54.4%。PIS在该基准上刷新了SOTA，并能使小模型超越已发表的大模型脚手架。
AI.conclusion: PIS在PM-Bench上达到新的最先进水平（SOTA），实证支持了"前瞻记忆是受模式约束的状态跟踪而非开放式推理"这一观点，证明在动作空间被类型化、生命周期逻辑代码化的前提下，小模型也能比已发表的大模型脚手架表现更好，为无需微调的前瞻记忆智能体提供了一条可扩展、样本高效的路线。

title: How Correct Is Your Answer? A Semantic Correctness Framework for Open QA Evaluation
summary: Reliable evaluation of open-ended question answering remains a bottleneck for measuring answer correctness of modern LLMs. Unlike multiple-choice tasks, free-form answers may be correct in many surface forms and may fail in qualitatively different ways, including incompleteness, contradiction, overgeneration, and endorsement of false premises. Existing judgment-based and similarity-based metrics often collapse these distinctions. We address this gap with three reusable contributions. First, we introduce a semantic correctness taxonomy that assigns open-ended answers to eight ordered classes, separating verbose-but-correct answers from those contaminated by hallucinated content. Second, we release CAP-Correctness, an 8.8k-example benchmark spanning widely used QA datasets, and CAP-Statements, an 11k-example dataset for converting question-answer pairs into declarative statements for natural language inference (NLI) training and statement-based evaluation. Third, we introduce CAP (Context-Aware Precision), a reference-based metric that scores question-conditioned statements using bidirectional NLI. Under a monotonicity protocol testing whether metrics respect the taxonomy's intended ordering, CAP outperforms established baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开放域问答评估的语义正确性分类体系（八级有序类别）、两个数据集（CAP-Correctness 8.8k 样本与 CAP-Statements 11k 样本）以及基于双向 NLI 的参考型指标 CAP（Context-Aware Precision），并通过单调性协议验证 CAP 在尊重分类体系排序方面优于已有基线。
AI.motivation: 开放域问答的可靠评估是衡量现代 LLM 答案正确性的瓶颈。自由文本答案可以以多种表面形式正确，且可能以不同方式失败（不完整、矛盾、过度生成、认可错误前提），而现有基于判断和基于相似度的指标常常混淆这些区别，难以对答案的错误类型进行细粒度区分。
AI.method: 作者提出三项可复用贡献：(1) 语义正确性分类体系，将开放域答案划分为八个有序类别，将冗长但正确的答案与混入幻觉内容的答案区分开；(2) 发布 CAP-Correctness（8.8k 示例，涵盖常用 QA 数据集）和 CAP-Statements（11k 示例，将问答对转换为陈述句用于 NLI 训练与基于陈述句的评估）；(3) 提出 CAP（Context-Aware Precision），一种基于参考的指标，使用双向 NLI 对带问题条件的陈述进行评分。
AI.result: 在用于检验指标是否尊重分类体系预期排序的单调性协议下，CAP 优于已建立的基线方法，证明其能更可靠地区分不同级别的答案正确性。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入分类体系、数据集和新型指标，填补了开放域问答评估中无法细粒度区分答案正确性等级的空白；CAP 在单调性测试中的优势表明其可作为更可靠的评估工具，并为 NLI 驱动的陈述式评估提供了训练资源。

title: What, Where, and How: Probing Spatiotemporal Representations in Video Foundation Models
comment: Interactive visualizations are available at https://vid-rep-pca.netlify.app/
summary: Self-supervised video foundation models learn rich spatiotemporal representations, yet it remains unclear what visual concepts these representations encode, where they emerge across transformer layers, and how they are geometrically organized. In this work, we tackle these three questions through a systematic layer-wise analysis of V-JEPA 2 and VideoMAE-v2. We leverage lightweight probes trained to discover three temporally grounded properties: (i) camera motion understanding, (ii) intuitive physics, and (iii) anomaly detection. Both models encode camera motion, with best results ($>90$ ROC AUC) emerging at 60-70% of network depth, and achieve moderate anomaly detection performance ($>60$ ROC AUC), but remain near chance on intuitive-physics tasks, suggesting a limited encoding of deeper physical reasoning. Beyond classification, we find that temporal features from individual videos form smooth low-dimensional trajectories in representation space, suggesting that camera motion is not only linearly decodable but also geometrically organized. Based on these results, we apply geometry-aware spline-based steering in the model's latent representations to interpolate camera motion, yielding steered videos with smoother trajectories and more coherent temporal progression than linear interpolation.

AI.tldr: 本文对自监督视频基础模型（V-JEPA 2 与 VideoMAE-v2）进行系统性的逐层分析，利用轻量探针在三个时间维度属性的任务（相机运动理解、直觉物理、异常检测）上考察表征内容、层间涌现位置与几何组织，并进一步利用表征空间中平滑的低维轨迹进行样条插值以实现相机运动的可控编辑。
AI.motivation: 自监督视频基础模型虽能学习丰富的时空表征，但其内部编码的视觉概念究竟是什么、这些概念在Transformer各层中于何处涌现、以及它们在表征空间中如何几何组织，仍不明确。作者希望通过回答这三个问题，加深对视频基础模型可解释性的理解，并探索几何结构与可控生成之间（如运动插值）的潜在联系。
AI.method: 对 V-JEPA 2 与 VideoMAE-v2 进行逐层（layer-wise）系统分析，训练轻量探针（lightweight probes）用于发现三种时间上可具身化的属性：(i) 相机运动理解、(ii) 直觉物理、(iii) 异常检测；同时分析单个视频时序特征在表征空间中形成的低维轨迹，并基于几何结构采用感知几何的样条（spline）引导法在隐表征中进行相机运动的插值编辑。
AI.result: 两个模型均能编码相机运动，最佳性能（ROC AUC超过90%）出现在网络深度约60%-70%处；异常检测达到中等水平（ROC AUC超过60%）；而在直觉物理任务上接近随机水平，说明模型对更深层物理推理的编码有限。此外，单视频时序特征在表征空间形成平滑低维轨迹，表明相机运动不仅可线性解码，还具备几何组织性；基于此，样条引导的插值相比线性插值能产生轨迹更平滑、时间推进更连贯的视频。
AI.conclusion: 自监督视频基础模型的表征中相机运动信息在中间层最丰富且以几何化的低维轨迹形式组织，而对物理推理的编码明显不足；表征空间的几何结构可用于引导生成（如运动插值），为视频基础模型的可解释性与可控运动生成提供了新思路与实用工具。

title: Analog-DB: An Agent-First Analog Integrated Circuit Database, From Blocks to Systems
summary: Sharing analog integrated circuit designs remains difficult: foundry non-disclosure agreements restrict the process details a design depends on, and the testbenches behind published results are rarely released. We present analog-db, an open-source, versioned database built on a shareable design representation. A domain-specific language captures each design as a process-neutral topology, reusable testbenches, and a machine-readable datasheet under one schema, so a design is shared in full and re-simulates on the process kits it is bound to. A parameterization scheme exposes functional sub-blocks and device sizes as named parameters that carry their matching constraints, making circuits composable and retargetable; a schema-governed contract and queryable catalog let AI design agents discover and reuse them directly. Across the regulator corpus, all 23 circuit-kit bindings on three open kits meet their own recorded specification bands (typical corner, matched devices, no layout) and 10 of 23 meet a common class band. Seventeen of the 23 imported sizings failed their testbenches and closed under a gm/ID sizing loop driven by the annotated sub-block roles, typically within one to three iterations. In a supervised case study, a coding agent working from the released artifacts sized the op-amp cores of a chopper instrumentation amplifier on an open 130nm kit, locating four hand-entry defects and a missing common-mode feedback loop that the sizing-only baseline did not repair. The database holds 68 circuits across sixteen classes, verifiable at schematic level under a tiered harness and tracked on a power/performance scoreboard, released at https://github.com/MacAnalog/spicexplorer-release.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 analog-db，一个基于可共享设计表示的开源、版本化模拟集成电路设计数据库。它通过领域专用语言将设计统一表示为工艺中立拓扑、可复用测试台和机器可读数据手册，并借助参数化方案与模式化契约，使电路可组合、可重定向且可供 AI 设计代理直接发现与复用。在稳压器语料库中，三个开放工艺套件上的 23 个电路-工艺绑定均满足各自记录的规范带；导入的 23 个尺寸中 17 个在测试台中失败，并在带注释子块角色驱动的 gm/ID 尺寸闭环内（通常 1~3 次迭代）收敛。监督案例中，编码代理基于发布产物在开放 130nm 套件上调整斩波仪表放大器的运放核，定位了 4 处手工录入缺陷和缺失的共模反馈环路，而仅做尺寸调整的基线未能修复。
AI.motivation: 共享模拟集成电路设计仍然困难：代工厂的非披露协议限制了设计所依赖的工艺细节，且已发布结果背后的测试台很少公开，导致设计难以被完整复现、复用与再仿真。
AI.method: 提出 analog-db，一种开源、版本化数据库，建立在可共享的设计表示之上。核心手段包括：1) 一种领域专用语言，在统一模式下将每个设计捕获为工艺中立拓扑、可复用测试台及机器可读数据手册，使设计得以完整共享并在绑定工艺套件上重新仿真；2) 一套参数化方案，将功能子块和器件尺寸暴露为携带匹配约束的命名参数，使电路可组合、可重定向；3) 由模式治理的契约和可查询目录，让 AI 设计代理能直接发现并复用这些设计。
AI.result: 在稳压器语料库中，三个开放工艺套件上的全部 23 个电路-工艺绑定均满足其自身记录的规范带（典型角、匹配器件、无版图），其中 10/23 满足共同类别带；23 个导入尺寸中 17 个在测试台中失败，并在由带注释子块角色驱动的 gm/ID 尺寸闭环中（通常 1~3 次迭代）收敛。在受监督的案例研究中，编码代理仅凭发布产物在开放 130nm 套件上为斩波仪表放大器调整运放核，定位了 4 处手工录入缺陷和缺失的共模反馈环路，而仅做尺寸调整的基线未能修复。数据库共含 16 个类别、68 个电路，可在分层测试框架下于原理图层面验证，并在功耗/性能记分板上跟踪。
AI.conclusion: analog-db 证明通过工艺中立拓扑、可复用测试台、机器可读数据手册和参数化约束的统一模式，模拟电路设计能够被完整共享、可复现、可组合并可被 AI 设计代理直接复用；其发布产物已在开放工艺套件上完成原理图级验证，覆盖 68 个电路、16 个类别，并提供分层验证框架与功耗/性能记分板，代码已开源发布。

title: Behaviorally Effective LoRA Writes Are Sparse and Structured
summary:
Low-rank adaptation fixes the rank of the update, but it does not identify which parts of a trained
  write actually carry behavior. We study that question directly and show that behaviorally effective
  LoRA writes are sparse, structured, and far more concentrated than the raw low-rank parameterization
  suggests.
  We use Learned-Basis LoRA, a learned-basis continuation recipe, to expose that structure. The recipe
  warms up an unconstrained adapter, converts its learned write columns into a module-wise orthonormal
  basis, freezes that basis, and continues training inside the constrained parameterization. Across 14
  exact switches from unconstrained to constrained form, held-out accuracy is unchanged at the
  conversion step and reconstructed write matrices differ by at most 0.25% relative Frobenius error.
  Same-state continuation then shows that the same trained checkpoint develops differently under
  different write subspaces, establishing write geometry as a causal state variable. A no-retraining
  projection test shows that useful write signal stays inside the learned write space and largely
  disappears from random or frozen-activation PCA controls.
  The concentration pattern is strong at both local and global scales. Across GSM8K, MathQA, and AQuA,
  per-module top-k continuation reaches its optimum at k in {2, 4} in all twelve seed-level cases we
  test. A stricter global ranking test shows that learned top-16 and top-32 subsets outperform matched
  random subsets, especially on GSM8K/Qwen and MathQA/Qwen. Single-direction ablations further reveal a
  sparse set of late q_proj, o_proj, and down_proj components with outsized behavioral impact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Learned-Basis LoRA，一种基于学习基的“延拓（continuation）”配方，用于揭示低秩更新中真正承载行为的部分，并通过GSM8K、MathQA、AQuA等多个基准证明：行为有效的 LoRA 写入是稀疏、结构化且远比原始低秩参数化所暗示的更集中的。
AI.motivation: 低秩适应（LoRA）固定了更新矩阵的秩，但并未识别训练写入中哪些部分真正承载行为。作者希望直接研究这一问题，揭示行为有效写入的内在结构，从而回答“写入几何”作为因果状态变量的作用。
AI.method: 提出 Learned-Basis LoRA 延拓配方：先预热一个无约束适配器，将其学到的写入列转换为模块级正交基，冻结该基，再在受限参数化内继续训练。还采用同状态延拓、无重训练投影测试（对比随机或冻结激活的PCA控制）、逐模块 top-k 延拓、全局排序测试及单方向消融等手段进行分析。
AI.result: 在14次从无约束到约束形式的精确切换中，保持精度在转换步骤不变，重建写入矩阵的相对Frobenius误差至多0.25%。同状态延拓显示同一检查点在不同写入子空间下发展不同，确立写入几何为因果状态变量。逐模块top-k在k∈{2,4}（12个种子级用例全部）达到最优；全局排名显示top-16/top-32子集优于匹配的随机子集；单方向消融发现少量 late q_proj、o_proj、down_proj 分量具有超常行为影响。
AI.conclusion: 行为有效的 LoRA 写入是稀疏、结构化且高度集中的，其集中模式在局部与全局尺度上均成立；写入子空间（写入几何）本身是决定后续训练的因果状态变量，而随机或冻结激活的主成分并不保留有用的写入信号。

title: BS: Take the Hint - Interactive Multitracer PET/CT Lesion Segmentation with a Scribble-Conditioned ResEnc U-Net
summary: Automated lesion segmentation in whole-body PET/CT is complicated by the variety of physiological tracer uptake patterns and by the differing appearance of lesions across tracers. The autoPET/CT V challenge addresses this by making segmentation interactive: user scribbles marking foreground and background are supplied alongside the image, and the algorithm is expected to exploit them. We present our submission, a scribble-conditioned residual encoder U-Net operating on four input channels: CT, PET, and a sparse scribble map for each of foreground and background. The network is initialised from the autoPET-III winning weights and extended from two to four input channels, with the two scribble channels zero-initialised so that the pretrained representation is preserved exactly at initialisation. Every model is fine-tuned per fold from the corresponding autoPET-III fold checkpoint, so that no validation case is seen during pretraining. PET intensities are normalised against a per-scan aorta blood-pool reference derived from a CT segmentation, which removes tracer- and centre-specific scaling without requiring lesion labels. At inference the five fold models are ensembled by averaging their softmax outputs per sliding-window patch, before Gaussian-weighted stitching. On the challenge's five-fold split, with each fold evaluated on its own validation cases, mean Dice is 0.554 and mean lesion-level F1 is 0.528 without scribbles, rising to 0.751 and 0.733 after five correction rounds. About 85% of that gain follows the first scribble, and the spread between fold models narrows five-fold over the same rounds, so interaction largely compensates for how well or badly a given model segments unaided.

AI.tldr: 针对autoPET/CT V交互式分割挑战，提出一种基于涂鸦条件（scribble-conditioned）的残差编码器U-Net，以CT、PET及前景/背景稀疏涂鸦图为四通道输入，从autoPET-III冠军权重初始化并逐fold微调，采用主动脉血池归一化和五折集成。无交互时平均Dice为0.554、病灶级F1为0.528，经五轮交互修正后分别提升至0.751和0.733，其中约85%的增益来自首次涂鸦。
AI.motivation: 全身PET/CT中的自动化病灶分割因不同示踪剂下生理性摄取模式多样、病灶外观差异大而困难重重。autoPET/CT V挑战引入交互式分割，通过用户提供前景/背景涂鸦来引导算法，作者旨在设计能有效利用这些涂鸦信息、并充分利用已有autoPET-III预训练权重的模型。
AI.method: 采用涂鸦条件的残差编码器U-Net，输入为四个通道：CT、PET、前景涂鸦掩膜和背景涂鸦掩膜。网络从autoPET-III冠军权重初始化，通道数由2扩展至4，新增的两个涂鸦通道零初始化以完整保留预训练表示；每个模型均从对应的autoPET-III折检查点按折微调，确保验证集在预训练中可见。PET强度以基于CT分割得到的每扫描主动脉血池参考值归一化，无需病灶标签即可消除示踪剂与中心间的尺度差异。推理时将五个折模型在滑动窗口块上平均softmax输出进行集成，再经高斯加权拼接。
AI.result: 在挑战的五折划分上，每折以其自身验证病例评估：无涂鸦时平均Dice为0.554、平均病灶级F1为0.528；经五轮交互修正后分别提升至0.751和0.733。约85%的性能增益来自首次涂鸦，且各折模型间的离散度在五轮交互后收窄五倍，表明交互在很大程度上弥补了模型无辅助分割能力的优劣差异。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的涂鸦条件U-Net方案在交互式PET/CT病灶分割中表现优异，通过零初始化扩展通道的方式成功复用了预训练权重，而交互涂鸦能显著提升分割性能并压缩不同fold模型的性能差距，验证了交互机制对该任务的强大补偿作用。

title: A Composable Evaluation System for Reproducible Omni-Modal Foundation Model Evaluation
summary: Building an omni-modal foundation model means evaluating it across text, image, video, and audio. Excellent evaluation toolkits exist for each modality, but their inference engines, prompt conventions, and metric implementations are mutually incompatible, so practitioners end up maintaining separate environments for every toolchain and still struggle to compare results across them. OmniEvaluator grew out of this need in our own model development: rather than reimplementing benchmarks, it connects existing inference engines and curated evaluation libraries at a higher level, exposing four inference backends, four evaluation frameworks, and over a thousand benchmarks through a single interface. Every run is recorded as an artifact capturing the full configuration for exact reproduction, and results flow into a shared dashboard for cross-model comparison. A federated mode shares GPU inference servers across concurrent evaluations, and a built-in verifier, small enough to run on CPU, keeps its score stable across engines and prompts where rule-based scoring fluctuates under configuration mismatch, matching cost-efficient commercial LLM judges without their recurring API cost. The system, demo video, and dashboard are publicly available. (https://github.com/naver-ai/omni-evaluator)

AI.tldr: OmniEvaluator 是一个面向全模态基础模型的统一评测平台，通过连接现有的推理引擎和评测库（提供四个推理后端、四个评测框架、一千多个基准测试），以单一接口实现文本、图像、视频、音频的跨模态评估。每次运行都以构件形式记录完整配置以保证可复现，结果汇聚到共享仪表盘进行跨模型对比，并支持联邦模式共享 GPU 推理服务器。内置的轻量级 CPU 验证器在规则式打分因配置不一致而波动时能保持分数稳定，其效果可与成本高昂的商业 LLM 裁判相媲美，却无需重复 API 费用。
AI.motivation: 现有各模态（文本、图像、视频、音频）都有优秀的评测工具包，但它们的推理引擎、提示词规范和指标实现互不兼容，导致实践者需要为每条工具链维护独立环境，且难以跨工具链比较结果。
AI.method: OmniEvaluator 不重新实现基准测试，而是在更高层级连接现有推理引擎与精选评测库：暴露四个推理后端、四个评测框架和一千多个基准测试于同一接口；每次运行记录为包含完整配置的构件以支持精确复现；提供共享仪表盘和跨并发评测共享 GPU 推理服务器的联邦模式；并内置可在 CPU 上运行的小型验证器，在配置不匹配导致规则式打分波动时稳定评分。
AI.result: 该验证器能保持跨引擎和提示词的稳定分数，其性能达到成本高昂的商业 LLM 裁判的水平，且无需反复产生 API 费用。系统、演示视频和仪表盘均已公开。
AI.conclusion: OmniEvaluator 通过单一统一接口整合异构的评测生态，解决了全模态评测中环境维护与结果比对繁琐的问题，在保证可复现性和评分稳定性的同时，以低成本的本地验证器替代昂贵的商业裁判，为构建全模态基础模型提供了高效、开放的评测基础设施。

title: Polish ModernBERT: The Long and Short of Polish Language Understanding
summary: Encoder-only Transformers remain effective for discriminative and representation-learning tasks, yet Polish encoders still largely rely on BERT/RoBERTa-style architectures. We introduce \textbf{Polish ModernBERT}, a family of four Polish encoders available at Base and Large scales, each with 512-token and 8K context variants. We adapt the ModernBERT pretraining recipe through staged selection experiments and release a long-context benchmark covering legal topic classification, ideological decision-direction prediction, factual-consistency assessment over literary plot summaries, and human-rights violation assessment. Across 30 tasks, Polish ModernBERT achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated Polish encoders, reaching 83.99 and 85.11 for the Base-8K and Large-8K models, respectively. On long-context tasks, the 8K variants improve over matched Polish RoBERTa-8K baselines from 67.47 to 77.15 and from 75.88 to 78.49 at the Base and Large scales, respectively. The Base-8K model achieves this gain with 22\% fewer parameters (149M vs.\ 190M). Efficiency measurements in representative inference setups show lower peak memory usage and latency than matched Polish RoBERTa baselines in both 512-token and 8K settings. Polish ModernBERT-8K-Base additionally achieves the best result on a Polish retrieval benchmark among the evaluated encoders below 300M parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Polish ModernBERT，一个包含 Base 与 Large 两个规模、各含 512-token 与 8K 上下文变体的波兰语编码器家族，通过适配 ModernBERT 预训练配方、发布长上下文基准，在 30 个任务上取得波兰语编码器最佳综合性能，并以更少的参数量和更低的内存/延迟超越匹配的 Polish RoBERTa 基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管编码器（encoder-only）Transformer 在判别式与表示学习任务上依然高效，波兰语编码器仍主要依赖 BERT/RoBERTa 风格的架构，缺乏对 ModernBERT 等新一代配方与长上下文能力的适配，需要更先进、更高效的波兰语编码器。
AI.method: 通过分阶段（staged）选择实验来适配 ModernBERT 预训练配方，构建了四个波兰语编码器（Base/Large 规模 × 512-token/8K 上下文变体），并发布了包含法律主题分类、意识形态决策方向预测、文学情节摘要事实一致性评估以及人权侵犯评估的长上下文基准。
AI.result: 在 30 个任务上取得波兰语编码器最佳综合性能（Base-8K 与 Large-8K 分别达 83.99 与 85.11）；长上下文任务上 8K 变体将匹配的 Polish RoBERTa-8K 基线从 67.47 提升至 77.15（Base）、75.88 提升至 78.49（Large）；Base-8K 以少 22% 的参数（149M vs 190M）取得增益，并在推理中实现更低峰值内存与延迟；该模型还在 300M 参数以下的波兰语检索基准上取得最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: Polish ModernBERT 家族在性能、效率与长上下文能力上全面优于匹配的 Polish RoBERTa 基线，为波兰语编码器树立了新的最优水平，证明 ModernBERT 配方可成功迁移到低资源语言并带来显著收益。

title: H3-World: Turning Language Understanding into World Control
summary: We present H3-World, an efficient framework that turns the 33B MiniMax-H3 video generator into an interactive world model. Our key finding is that, as large video generators become more capable, language is emerging as a natural interface for control. MiniMax-H3, for example, already supports zero-shot control of character behavior and camera motion through natural-language instructions. Building on this, H3-World turns this coarse language interface into precise, temporally grounded world control, without introducing dedicated action modules. Specifically, we represent each action as a structured combination of character and camera instructions, and align them with the corresponding temporal video latents. To make the control temporally precise, we further introduce temporal attention routing, which restricts each instruction to its intended time interval and reduces control leakage across actions. Importantly, H3-World directly reuses the semantic representations learned during large-scale video pretraining and requires only lightweight adaptation. With only 8,000 gameplay samples, 10,000 LoRA optimization steps, and 0.199% trainable parameters, H3-World achieves effective character and camera control while preserving strong generation quality. It also generalizes to unseen scenarios. These results show that the control capabilities emerging in large video generators can be efficiently transformed into interactive world control.

AI.tldr: 提出 H3-World 框架，将 33B 参数的 MiniMax-H3 视频生成器高效改造为交互式世界模型，通过语言指令实现精细且时间上可控的角色与相机控制，仅用 0.199% 可训练参数即可获得良好效果。
AI.motivation: 随着大型视频生成器能力增强，语言正成为自然的控制接口（如 MiniMax-H3 已支持零样本的自然语言角色与相机控制），但该粗粒度语言接口需要被转化为精确、时间上可落地的世界控制，且不希望引入专用的动作模块。
AI.method: 将每个动作表示为角色指令与相机指令的结构化组合，并使其与对应的时序视频隐变量对齐；引入时间注意力路由（temporal attention routing），将每条指令限定在其目标时间区间内以减少跨动作的控制泄漏；直接复用大规模视频预训练中学到的语义表征，仅需轻量适配（LoRA）。
AI.result: 仅使用 8,000 个游戏样本、10,000 步 LoRA 优化和 0.199% 可训练参数，即实现有效的角色与相机控制，同时保持强大的生成质量，并能泛化到未见场景。
AI.conclusion: 大型视频生成器中涌现的控制能力可以被高效地转化为交互式世界控制，验证了“语言作为控制接口 + 轻量时序对齐”这一范式的可行性与可扩展性。

title: Automated Event Log Generation from Unstructured Text Using Finetuned LLMs
summary: Process mining (PM) provides a powerful framework for discovering and optimizing operational processes from event data. However, the efficacy of PM techniques is strictly predicated on the availability of structured event logs. Thus far, event logs have often been laboriously created by domain and process mining experts. This costly effort causes large portions of organizational knowledge, including incident tickets, manuals, and textual reports, to remain underutilized. We address this bottleneck by investigating the efficacy of Large Language Models (LLMs) as automated data translators. We propose a scalable framework that leverages LLMs as data translators to bridge the gap between unstructured textual resources and structured event data. We finetune LLMs on a newly created text-to-log dataset, demonstrating that the resulting models can extract high-fidelity event logs from unstructured resources. Our results show that this finetuning approach outperforms few-shot or zero-shot prompting by a large amount, highlighting finetuning as a necessary pre-condition for generating reliable event data. We conclude that our method provides a promising pipeline for making previously unused data available to process mining ecosystems, effectively expanding the possibilities of using PM to further investigate organizational workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可扩展框架，利用大型语言模型（LLMs）作为数据转换器，将非结构化的文本资源（如事件工单、手册、文本报告）自动转换为结构化事件日志，以缓解流程挖掘中事件日志构建成本高昂的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 流程挖掘（PM）依赖结构化事件日志，但事件日志通常需要领域专家和流程挖掘专家手工构建，成本高昂，导致大量组织知识（如工单、手册、文本报告）未被充分利用。
AI.method: 提出一个利用LLMs作为数据转换器的可扩展框架，在新建的文本到日志（text-to-log）数据集上对LLMs进行微调，使其能够从非结构化文本资源中提取高保真的事件日志。
AI.result: 微调后的模型能从非结构化资源中提取高保真事件日志；与少样本或零样本提示相比，微调方法大幅提升性能，表明微调是生成可靠事件数据的必要前提。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为将此前未利用的数据引入流程挖掘生态系统提供了有前景的流水线，有效扩展了运用PM进一步研究组织工作流程的可能性。

title: InSight: A Benchmark for Agentic Claim Verification in Interactive Visualizations
comment: To be presented at EMNLP Main Conference
summary: Vision Language Models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in interpreting static visual artifacts, but modern data analysis is inherently dynamic, requiring the active interrogation of interactive environments. Existing benchmarks are predominantly constrained to static imagery and one-shot question answering and fail to capture the epistemic demands of this domain, where evidence is frequently occluded, distributed across linked views, or conditionally revealed through user agency. In this paper, we introduce InSight, a benchmark for agentic claim verification over interactive visualizations. The dataset consists of 21,349 claims derived from human-authored analytical narratives and grounded in fully interactive web-based environments. Agents must navigate these environments to determine whether a natural language claim is supported, refuted or not verifiable given the available evidence. Unlike traditional evaluations, InSight treats interaction traces as intrinsic proxies for reasoning, enabling a rigorous audit of how models seek and synthesize visual evidence. We evaluate state-of-the-art models, revealing that interactive verification remains a non-trivial challenge. We release InSight at https://github.com/maevehutch/insight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InSight，一个面向交互式可视化环境的智能体声明验证基准。该基准包含 21,349 条源自人工撰写的分析叙事、且以完全交互式 Web 环境为支撑的声明，要求智能体在环境中主动导航以判定声明的支持、反驳或不可验证状态，并将交互轨迹作为推理过程的内在代理进行审计。实验表明，现有最先进模型在该任务上仍面临显著挑战。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在解释静态视觉工件上表现出色，但现代数据分析本质上是动态的，需要主动与交互式环境进行交互。现有基准局限于静态图像和一次性问答，无法捕捉该领域中证据经常被遮挡、分布在多个关联视图或需通过用户操作有条件地揭示的认知需求。因此需要一个新的基准来评估智能体在交互式可视化环境中进行声明验证的能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了 InSight 基准：数据集包含 21,349 条声明，这些声明源自人工撰写的分析叙事，并依托于完全交互式的 Web 环境。智能体必须在这些环境中导航，以判断自然语言声明是被支持、被反驳还是因现有证据不足而无法验证。与传统评估不同，InSight 将交互轨迹视为推理过程的内在代理，从而能够严格审查模型如何搜寻并综合视觉证据。作者在基准上评估了当前最先进的模型。
AI.result: 对现有最先进模型的评估结果表明，交互式声明验证仍然是一个非平凡（non-trivial）的挑战，当前模型在该任务上的表现有限。
AI.conclusion: InSight 填补了静态视觉理解与动态数据分析之间的评估空白，为智能体在交互式可视化环境中的证据搜索与推理提供了可审计的评测平台。该基准强调交互轨迹作为推理证据的价值，并为未来交互式视觉推理研究指明了方向。基准已在 https://github.com/maevehutch/insight 公开发布。

title: SpatialGuard: Harness-Guided Verifiable Spatial Reasoning for Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Complex 3D spatial text to image generation requires models to convert natural language into stable visual geometry, not merely semantic appearance. Existing prompt-driven or layout-conditioned methods improve controllability, but often lack an optimizable and verifiable spatial intermediary before visual sampling. As a result, object relations, occlusion, visibility, and camera constraints can decay during multi-round generation. This paper presents SpatialGuard, a structured layout-guided framework for complex 3D spatial text-to-image generation. SpatialGuard parses prompts into image synthesis-oriented 3D layouts through a Spatial Layout Architect, realizes them as visual conditions and candidate images through a Visual Realizer, and uses a Visual Alignment Critic to validate consistency among prompt, layout, and image. To keep constraints stable across iterations, SpatialGuard introduces a Layout Harness that organizes rule constraints, tool invocation, shared knowledge, and feedback loops around the editable layout state. This design turns complex spatial generation from implicit prompt following into a verifiable process of planning, realization, validation, and repair. Comprehensive experiments show that SpatialGuard achieves state-of-the-art performance in complex 3D spatial layout generation and improves spatial faithfulness over existing text-to-image and layout control baselines.

AI.tldr: SpatialGuard 是一个面向复杂 3D 空间文本到图像生成的布局引导框架，通过将提示词解析为可优化的 3D 布局，并将空间生成从隐式提示遵循转变为可验证的规划—实现—验证—修复流程，从而在复杂 3D 空间布局生成上达到最优性能并提升空间保真度。
AI.motivation: 复杂 3D 空间文本到图像生成要求模型将自然语言转换为稳定的视觉几何而非仅语义外观。现有基于提示词驱动或布局条件的方法虽提升了可控性，但缺乏在视觉采样之前可优化且可验证的空间中介，导致多轮生成中物体关系、遮挡、可见性及相机约束容易退化。
AI.method: SpatialGuard 采用结构化布局引导框架，包含四个核心组件：Spatial Layout Architect 将提示词解析为面向图像合成的 3D 布局；Visual Realizer 将布局实现为视觉条件与候选图像；Visual Alignment Critic 验证提示词、布局与图像之间的一致性；以及 Layout Harness 围绕可编辑的布局状态组织规则约束、工具调用、共享知识与反馈循环，以保持跨迭代的约束稳定。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，SpatialGuard 在复杂 3D 空间布局生成中达到最先进性能，并在空间保真度上优于现有文本到图像及布局控制基线。
AI.conclusion: 将复杂空间生成从隐式提示遵循转化为包含规划、实现、验证与修复的可验证过程，能有效稳定跨迭代的空间约束，为复杂 3D 空间文本到图像生成提供了一条可行的结构化解法。

title: LEAP: Likelihood Elicitation and Aggregation for LLM-based Probabilistic Forecasting
comment: Accepted to the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026). 20 pages, 3 figures, and 15 tables. Code: https://github.com/layingfish/LEAP
summary: LLM-based forecasting systems have improved on real-world tasks such as financial markets and sports outcomes, largely through stronger search and tool use. Many systems still ask an LLM to read all collected evidence together and produce the final forecast. We call this design Monolithic Prediction. It can obscure how individual evidence items affect the result and collapse uncertainty across competing outcomes. We propose LEAP (Likelihood Elicitation and Aggregation for Probabilistic forecasting), which reorganizes how collected evidence is used in the prediction stage. LEAP examines each evidence item separately and elicits likelihood parameters that describe its implications for the target. An explicit prior and a deterministic probabilistic model then combine these likelihoods into a posterior distribution. This procedure supports continuous, single-choice, and multi-choice forecasts while preserving reproducible evidence contributions. We build a benchmark covering forecasting, information-seeking, and browsing tasks, and evaluate LEAP on our own agent loop and several agent CLI frameworks. Given the same evidence, LEAP improves most prediction and calibration metrics across models and remains stronger under controlled comparisons of prior access, inference budget, and aggregation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LEAP（似然提取与聚合的概率预测框架），将证据收集后的预测阶段从"整体一次性读取"重构为"逐条证据分别提取似然参数 + 显式先验 + 确定性概率模型聚合"，以提升 LLM 预测系统的可解释性与预测质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的预测系统虽然通过更强的搜索和工具使用提升了真实世界任务（如金融市场、体育赛事）的表现，但多数系统仍将所有收集到的证据一次性交给 LLM 生成最终预测（即"整体式预测"）。这种设计会掩盖单个证据对结果的影响，并在相互竞争的结局之间混乱地折叠不确定性，导致可解释性差、不确定性建模不准确。
AI.method: LEAP 重新组织预测阶段对已收集证据的使用方式：它逐条检查每个证据项，分别提取描述其对目标影响的似然参数；随后由显式先验和确定性概率模型将这些似然组合为后验分布。该方法支持连续型、单选型和多选型预测，同时保证证据贡献的可复现性。作者还构建了涵盖预测、信息搜索和浏览任务的基准，并在自建 agent 循环及多个 agent CLI 框架上评估 LEAP。
AI.result: 在相同证据条件下，LEAP 在多数预测指标和校准指标上相较基线有所提升；在控制先验访问、推理预算和聚合方式的受控对比中，LEAP 仍保持更强的表现。
AI.conclusion: 将预测阶段从整体式读取改为逐证据似然提取与概率聚合，能够在保持证据贡献可复现的同时提升预测与校准性能，为 LLM 预测系统提供了一种更透明、更稳健的设计范式。

title: When Tokenization is Secretly Output Supervision
summary: Tokenization in language models is treated by default as an input preprocessing decision. We argue that this framing is incomplete: in autoregressive models, tokenizer granularity determines what the model must resolve in a single forward pass, and therefore the supervision signal it receives. This affects both the difficulty of the learning problem and the representations that emerge inside the model. We test this in a controlled experiment on numeric reasoning with a novel decoupling of input and output tokenization. As the output supervision view predicts, differences in task performance, training dynamics, and model internals are induced by output tokenization and largely invariant to input tokenization. This may matter in practice, because models with different tokenization strategies differ not only in input representation but in the task they were trained on. Comparisons between models may thus partly reflect task definition rather than ability. A survey of 120 recent *CL papers on numeric reasoning confirms that this is rarely acknowledged: only about 10% report the numeric tokenization of the models they evaluate, while 69% compare across tokenization, and thus supervision, regimes without reporting it. While prior work documents that tokenization consistently affects model performance, there is no principled account of why. We argue that framing tokenization as output supervision provides that account.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将分词（tokenization）重新理解为输出监督（output supervision）而非单纯的输入预处理：自回归模型中，分词粒度决定了模型单次前向传播需解决的任务，从而影响学习难度与内部表征。通过在数值推理任务上解耦输入/输出分词的受控实验，证明性能、训练动态及模型内部差异主要由输出分词决定，且对输入分词不敏感；对120篇*CL论文的调查显示仅约10%报告数值分词设置，69%在未报告的情况下跨分词（即监督）机制比较模型。这为“分词影响模型性能”提供了原则性解释，并警示跨模型比较可能反映任务定义而非能力差异。
AI.motivation: 分词默认被视为输入预处理决策，但该视角不完整：在自回归模型中，分词粒度决定了模型单次前向传播需要解决的任务，进而决定了它接收的监督信号，这同时影响学习问题的难度和模型内部涌现的表征。虽然已有文献表明分词会持续影响模型性能，但缺乏原则性的解释来解释“为什么”。
AI.method: 在数值推理任务上设计受控实验，采用新颖的输入分词与输出分词解耦方法，分别考察二者对任务性能、训练动力学和模型内部表征的影响；同时开展对120篇近期*CL数值推理论文的调查研究，统计其报告数值分词设置及跨分词比较的情况。
AI.result: 与输出监督视图的预测一致，任务性能、训练动态和模型内部结构的差异由输出分词导致，且在很大程度上对输入分词保持不变；调查显示仅约10%的论文报告了所用模型的分词设置，而69%的论文在未报告的情况下跨分词（即跨监督）机制进行了比较。
AI.conclusion: 分词策略不同的模型不仅在输入表征上不同，更在于它们被训练的任务本身就不同，因此模型间的比较可能部分反映的是任务定义差异而非能力差异。将分词框定为输出监督为既有“分词影响性能”的观察提供了原则性解释，并呼吁研究社区在比较与报告时正视分词作为监督信号的作用。

title: A Benchmark for Vehicle Attribute Classification in Cross-Domain Surveillance Scenarios
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 Conference on Graphics, Patterns and Images (SIBGRAPI)
summary: Vehicle attribute analysis is a key component of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), supporting applications such as vehicle identification, traffic monitoring, and forensic investigation. However, models trained under controlled conditions often degrade in real surveillance scenarios due to changes in viewpoint, occlusion, illumination, and sensor characteristics. This paper introduces Unconstrained Vehicle Identification Benchmark (UVIB), a benchmark for evaluating three operational vehicle-analysis tasks: front/rear orientation, occlusion-related suitability for Vehicle Make and Model Recognition (VMMR), and color clarity. The benchmark contains 84,835 vehicle images from seven public Brazilian datasets, grouped into surveillance and general acquisition domains, with unified binary annotations that were not jointly available in the original sources. Four representative architectures, EfficientNetV2-S, ResNet-50, ViT/B-16, and YOLO11s-cls, are evaluated under mixed-domain, cross-domain, and cross-dataset protocols. The results show that domain shift has a stronger impact than architecture choice, with substantial degradation in cross-domain settings, especially for VMMR suitability and color clarity. While orientation generalizes more reliably, VMMR suitability remains affected by class imbalance and ambiguous occlusions, and color clarity is highly sensitive to illumination and sensor modality. These findings highlight the need for benchmarks and evaluation protocols that explicitly measure operational robustness beyond standard in-domain accuracy. The proposed benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/UFPR-IPASP-PR/uvib-vehicle-attributes/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UVIB基准，一个包含84,835张来自七个巴西公开数据集的车辆图像、统一二值标注（朝向、VMMR适用性、颜色清晰度）的无约束车辆属性分析基准，并通过四种架构在混合域、跨域和跨数据集协议下的实验表明，域偏移对性能的影响大于架构选择，尤其在VMMR适用性与颜色清晰度上退化显著。
AI.motivation: 受控条件下训练的车辆属性模型在真实监控场景中常因视角、遮挡、光照和传感器特性变化而性能退化，但缺乏明确衡量这种操作鲁棒性的基准与评测协议，现有数据集也缺少统一的高层车辆分析标注。
AI.method: 构建UVIB基准：收集七个巴西公开数据集的84,835张车辆图像，划分为监控域和一般采集域，统一补充了原先各源未共同提供的三类二值标注（前/后朝向、VMMR适用性、颜色清晰度）；采用EfficientNetV2-S、ResNet-50、ViT/B-16和YOLO11s-cls四种代表性架构，在混合域、跨域和跨数据集三类协议下进行系统评测。
AI.result: 域偏移对性能的影响大于架构选择；跨域设置下性能显著退化，尤其体现在VMMR适用性与颜色清晰度。朝向任务泛化较可靠；VMMR适用性受类别不平衡和模糊遮挡影响；颜色清晰度对光照和传感器模态高度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调需在标准域内精度之外，采用明确衡量操作鲁棒性的基准与评测协议；提议的UVIB基准已公开，以支持智能交通系统中车辆属性分析在真实场景下的评估与发展。

title: Cheap Verifiers, Large Blind Spots: Measuring the Reliability Cost of Cost-Saving Cascades
summary: Inference cascades cut cost by answering most queries with a cheap model and escalating a hard tail to a frontier model that acts as verifier. A natural extension closes the loop: fine-tune the cheap student on the verifier's rejections so the escalation rate, and cost, fall each round. We measure this loop on real LLMs and report four findings. First, the verifier's blind spot, the fraction of the student's wrong answers it accepts, is large and moves adversarially: it grows with student capability ($β$ from 0.12 to 0.55 as the student scales 0.5B to 32B) and shrinks with verifier capability, so it is worst in the cheap-student, cheap-verifier regime cascades exist to create. Second, buying it away returns the saving: a frontier verifier drives $β$ to about 0.05 but then escalates on 46% of hard-MATH queries against a 39% true error rate, paying the frontier price on nearly half of all traffic. Third, naive corrective fine-tuning on the verifier-rejected tail does not improve the small student but degrades and ultimately collapses it, across every teacher we tried (cross-family and same-family), so at this scale the self-improving loop is self-defeating. Fourth, through all of this the cascade's own dashboard, every metric computed through the verifier, reads a flat 3% error while true delivered error swings up to 32%: the system is blind to its own degradation by construction. We then give the theory that explains the blindness, a two-population conservation law, $ε_\infty \lesssim q_0 β_0$, under which every in-loop metric improves while true quality does not, and a synthetic study that validates the mechanism. The practical conclusion: the reliability of a self-improving cascade cannot be read from any metric computed through its own verifier.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"推理级联"的闭环改进（用廉价模型回答大多数查询、用前沿模型作验证者处理困难尾部，并基于验证者拒绝样本微调学生模型），发现该自改进循环实际是自我拆台：验证者的盲区（接受学生错误答案的比例）会随学生能力增强而增大、且成本与质量同时失控。作者提出解释盲区的"两群体守恒律"，并得出结论：自改进级联的可靠性无法通过其自身验证者计算出的任何指标读取。
AI.motivation: 推理级联通过廉价模型回答大多数查询、以廉价成本将困难尾部升级到作为验证者的前沿模型来降低成本。自然的延伸是"闭环"：在验证者拒绝的样本上微调廉价学生模型，从而每轮降低升级率与成本。作者希望在真实LLM上度量这一循环是否真的奏效。
AI.method: 在真实LLM上进行闭环测量实验：系统性地缩放学生模型（0.5B到32B）和验证者能力，测量验证者的盲区β（接受学生错误答案的比例）如何变化；测试基于验证者拒绝尾部进行朴素纠正微调的效果（跨家族与同家族教师）；并对比通过验证者计算出的所有指标与真实交付错误率。随后提出解释盲区的两群体守恒定律 ε∞ ≲ q0β0，并用合成研究验证该机制。
AI.result: 四点发现：(1) 验证者盲区大且对抗性移动——学生从0.5B扩到32B时β从0.12增至0.55，在最差的"廉价学生+廉价验证者"组合下最严重；(2) 用前沿验证者虽把β压到约0.05，但在hard-MATH上对46%的查询升级（真实错误率仅39%），代价高昂；(3) 朴素纠正微调无法提升小模型，反而使其退化并最终崩溃（所有教师皆然）；(4) 级联自身仪表盘（经验证者计算的指标）始终显示约3%的错误率，而真实错误率最高达32%——系统对自身退化结构性失明。合成研究验证了理论机制。
AI.conclusion: 自改进级联的可靠性无法从任何通过其自身验证者计算的指标中读取；在该尺度下，朴素"教师-学生"闭环的自改进是自我拆台的（self-defeating），并伴随指标盲区。研究给出守恒律 ε∞ ≲ q0β0 作为理论解释，说明为何循环内所有指标改善而真实质量不改善。

title: From Rollouts to Recipes: Self-Contained Post-Training for LLMs
summary: Post-training large language models usually applies a single training recipe to all samples, even though the model's own rollouts reveal different sample-level learning states. We propose Self-Routing, a behavior-conditioned post-training framework that uses rollout correctness and confidence to decide how each sample should be optimized. Depending on its behavior state, a sample is routed to GRPO, on-policy self-distillation, regularization, or skipping, allowing training to adapt without external teachers, extra annotations, or additional sampling. Experiments on mathematical reasoning across Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 backbones show that Self-Routing consistently improves over uniform GRPO, uniform OPSD, fixed mixtures, and simpler routing baselines. Further analyses show that the routing distribution changes over training and reduces unnecessary updates on low-signal or already stable samples.

AI.tldr: Self-Routing 是一种行为条件化的后训练框架，它根据模型自身 rollout 的正确性和置信度，将每个样本路由到 GRPO、在线自蒸馏、正则化或跳过等不同优化方式，从而让训练过程无需外部教师或额外标注即可自适应地适配每个样本的学习状态，并在数学推理任务上稳定优于统一配方与固定混合基线。
AI.motivation: 现有一致的后训练流程通常对所有样本使用单一的训练配方，忽视了模型自身 rollout 所揭示的样本级差异（即不同样本处于不同的学习状态），导致训练缺乏自适应性。
AI.method: 提出 Self-Routing 框架：基于 rollout 的正确性与置信度判断每个样本的行为状态（behavior state），据此将样本路由到四种优化方式之一——GRPO、在线策略自蒸馏（on-policy self-distillation）、正则化或跳过。该方法无需外部教师、额外标注或额外采样，使训练能随行为状态动态调整。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3 与 Qwen3.5 基座上的数学推理实验中，Self-Routing 一致优于统一 GRPO、统一 OPSD、固定混合以及更简单的路由基线；进一步分析表明路由分布会随训练演化，并减少对低信号或已稳定样本的不必要更新。
AI.conclusion: 自适应、行为条件化的样本路由能有效替代单一训练配方，提升后训练效率与性能；通过依据样本实时状态动态分配优化策略，可避免低信号或已稳定样本上的冗余更新，为后训练提供了可扩展且免额外数据的通用范式。

title: UI-VISA: U-Net Initialized Vascular Image Segmentation Architecture
summary: Accurate segmentation of vascular structures in digital subtraction angiography (DSA) images remains challenging due to the thin, elongated, and branching nature of blood vessels. Pixel-wise deep learning approaches such as U-Net achieve strong general-purpose segmentation performance but often produce fragmented or discontinuous predictions in fine vascular regions, since they do not explicitly enforce structural connectivity. Region growing algorithms preserve spatial context and topological continuity, but are highly sensitive to seed point initialization and can be computationally expensive. We propose UI-VISA (U-Net Initialized Vascular Image Segmentation Architecture), a hybrid pipeline that combines the complementary strengths of both approaches. UI-VISA uses U-Net's foreground predictions as informed seed points for a CNN-guided region growing algorithm, which then iteratively refines the segmentation by enforcing local connectivity and recovering fine vessel details that U-Net alone tends to miss or over-predict. We evaluate UI-VISA against standalone U-Net and a prior region-growing-based method (VISA) using 5-fold cross-validation on 26 DSA images. UI-VISA achieves the highest mean Dice and clDice scores across folds, and a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test shows the improvement in clDice is statistically significant ($p=0.023$), consistent with the method's design goal of preserving vascular connectivity, while the improvement in Dice does not reach significance ($p=0.104$).

AI.tldr: 提出UI-VISA混合框架，将U-Net的前景预测作为CNN引导的区域生长算法的种子点，通过迭代细化分割来保持血管连通性，在26张DSA图像上5折交叉验证中取得最高平均Dice和clDice分数，其中clDice提升具有统计学显著性（p=0.023）。
AI.motivation: DSA图像中血管结构细长、分支多，分割困难。U-Net等像素级深度学习方法缺乏结构连通性约束，易在细小血管区域产生碎片化或不连续预测；区域生长算法虽能保持拓扑连续性，但对种子点初始化高度敏感且计算开销大。二者互补优势需要结合。
AI.method: 提出UI-VISA混合流水线：先用U-Net生成前景预测作为信息丰富的种子点，再交由CNN引导的区域生长算法迭代细化分割，通过在细化过程中强制局部连通性来恢复U-Net遗漏或过度预测的细小血管细节。评估采用26张DSA图像上的5折交叉验证，与独立U-Net及先前基于区域生长的方法VISA对比。
AI.result: UI-VISA在5折交叉验证中取得最高的平均Dice和clDice分数；配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验表明clDice提升具有统计学显著性（p=0.023），而Dice提升未达显著水平（p=0.104）。clDice的显著提升与其设计目标（保持血管连通性）一致。
AI.conclusion: UI-VISA通过结合U-Net与CNN引导的区域生长，有效改善DSA血管分割的连通性和细小血管细节恢复，尤其在连通性指标（clDice）上带来统计显著的改进，验证了混合分割策略的优越性。

title: SymFold: Synergizing Evolutionary and Structural Priors for Accurate Protein Inverse Folding
summary: Protein inverse folding aims to recover amino acid sequences for a given 3D protein structure, underpinning broad applications such as enzyme engineering and drug discovery.Current methods often follow a serial pipeline, in which a structure encoder predicts a coarse sequence, which is then refined by protein language models (PLMs). However, because PLMs only perform post-hoc sequence edits, the refinement is bounded by the quality of upstream predictions.Thanks to recent multimodal protein language models (MPLMs), we could directly encode structure to generate sequences with pretrained structural knowledge, but we observe that they are not effective for inverse folding. Therefore, we introduce a symmetric dual-path architecture that both leverages PLMs for pretrained sequence evolution knowledge and MPLMs for pretrained structural knowledge to iteratively guide protein sequence generation.Through extensive experiments across standard protein inverse folding benchmarks, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing prior approaches, and ablation studies validate the rationale of our symmetric design, revealing a promising direction for the community.

AI.tldr: 提出一种对称双路径架构，同时利用蛋白质语言模型（PLM）的预训练序列演化知识和多模态蛋白质语言模型（MPLM）的预训练结构知识，迭代引导蛋白质序列生成，在标准逆向折叠基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有逆向折叠方法普遍采用串行管道：结构编码器先预测粗糙序列，再由蛋白质语言模型（PLM）后验精修，但PLM仅做事后编辑，效果受上游预测质量限制。尽管多模态蛋白质语言模型（MPLM）可直接编码结构并具备预训练结构知识，但实测其对逆向折叠并不有效，因此需要一种能同时充分发挥两类模型优势的架构。
AI.method: 提出对称双路径（symmetric dual-path）架构，一方面利用PLM的预训练序列演化知识，另一方面利用MPLM的预训练结构知识，两种知识流对称地、迭代地引导蛋白质序列生成，从而替代传统的串行"编码-精修"管道。
AI.result: 在标准蛋白质逆向折叠基准上的大量实验表明，该方法超越先前方法并达到当前最优（SOTA）水平；消融实验验证了对称设计的合理性。
AI.conclusion: 对称双路径架构能够有效融合序列演化知识与结构知识，为蛋白质逆向折叠提供了有前景的新方向。

title: GlossoGen: Emergent Language in Complex Multi-Agent LLM Interactions
summary: The growing rate at which LLM agents interact with one another raises key questions about language evolution in multi-LLM-agent settings, with implications for safety and monitorability as well as for linguistic accounts of LLMs. To address these questions, we introduce GlossoGen, a novel platform for studying multi-agent language evolution in complex scenarios. Within GlossoGen, we build the SaveVeyru scenario, which requires agents with partial information to communicate under pressure. We find that language evolution does occur between LLM agents, that the resulting languages are compositional and morphologically productive, and that they deviate from the LLMs' English prior in ways that render them incomprehensible to humans. Moreover, we identify several qualities essential to this evolution: pressure towards efficiency; the strength of the models backing the agents; and access to a "postmortem" stage in which agents can agree on linguistic conventions. Importantly, we observe that different conditions govern the transmission of language to new agents. Specifically, we find that agents learn new languages from usage alone, take an active role in this learning, and that while stronger models are required for novel language emergence, weaker models can learn an existing language once it has emerged. Taken together, our results indicate that current LLMs have the potential for cumulative cultural evolution -- previously attested only in humans -- with mixed populations of agents developing capacities that go beyond their lowest common denominator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GlossoGen平台，在SaveVeyru场景（部分信息、高压沟通）下研究LLM智能体间的语言演化，发现智能体之间确实发生语言演化，产生的语言具有组合性和形态能产性，但偏离英语先验而令人类难以理解，并识别出促进演化的关键因素及语言向新智能体传播的条件，表明当前LLM具备此前仅在人类中观测到的累积文化演化潜力。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体之间互动的频率不断增长，引发关于多智能体环境中语言演化的关键问题，涉及安全性、可监控性以及语言学的理论解释。作者希望通过可控实验研究LLM智能体之间是否及如何发生语言演化。
AI.method: 作者构建了名为GlossoGen的新型研究平台，并设计SaveVeyru场景：要求拥有部分信息的智能体在时间压力下进行沟通。通过该系统观察智能体间的语言使用，并系统操纵效率压力、底层模型强度以及"事后复盘"（postmortem）阶段等条件，检验语言演化及其传播机制。
AI.result: 实验发现：语言演化确实发生，且演化后的语言具有组合性和形态能产性，并与LLM的英语先验发生偏离而致人类难以理解；效率压力、模型强度以及"postmortem"阶段是演化的关键因素。在语言传播方面，智能体能仅凭使用习得新语言并主动参与学习，更强模型是新型语言涌现的必要条件，而较弱模型在语言涌现后能够学会已有语言。这表明对语言能力的要求低于语言创造能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，当前LLM具备累积文化演化的潜能——此前仅被证实存在于人类之中——混合智能体群体可能发展出超越其"最低共同分母"的能力。这一发现对多智能体系统的安全性、可监控性以及LLM语言演化的语言学解释具有重要意义。

title: Uncovering Understanding-Generation Synergy in Native Unified Multimodal Models: From Representation, Task to System
summary: While unified multimodal models (UMMs) jointly perform visual understanding and generation within a single model, functional unification does not guarantee learning synergy: the two objectives may reinforce each other, compete for capacity, or merely coexist. We investigate their relationship at the representation, task, and system levels in a controlled, structurally native setting without pretrained vision priors. At the representation level, we find that each objective provides useful signal to the other: generation enriches the visual features learned for understanding, while understanding strengthens vision--language alignment for generation. However, when both objectives are forced through the same computation path, one tends to dominate. A task-decoupled architecture that specializes conflicting visual computation while preserving semantic interaction avoids this asymmetric degradation. At the task level, through three case studies, we find positive bidirectional transfer when understanding and generation tasks rely on shared knowledge. At the system level, we show that an end-to-end UMM outperforms a matched planner--executor pipeline on complex tasks that explicitly require both image understanding and generation. Together, these results show that the value of UMMs extends beyond a unified interface: appropriate specialization, shared task knowledge, and end-to-end optimization can turn coexistence into synergy.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究统一多模态模型（UMMs）中视觉理解与生成两种目标之间的关系，在表示、任务、系统三个层面展开受控实验，发现两种目标互有裨益但共享计算路径时会发生一方主导的不对称退化，并提出任务解耦架构、正向迁移证据及端到端优化等机制，最终说明UMMs的价值不仅在于统一接口，更在于恰当的专化、共享任务知识与端到端优化可将共存转化为协同。
AI.motivation: 尽管统一多模态模型（UMMs）在单一模型内联合执行视觉理解与生成，但功能的统一并不能保证学习的协同：两种目标可能互相促进、争夺容量或仅仅共存。作者希望弄清这些目标之间到底是何种关系，从而理解UMMs的联合训练是否真正产生协同效应。
AI.method: 在无预训练视觉先验的受控、结构原生设定下，作者从三个层面展开研究：(1) 表示层面——检验每个目标对另一目标提供的监督信号，并对比共享计算路径与任务解耦架构（专化冲突的视觉计算同时保留语义交互）；(2) 任务层面——通过三个案例研究考察依赖于共享知识的理解与生成任务之间的双向迁移；(3) 系统层面——将端到端UMM与匹配的"规划器-执行器"流水线在需要同时进行图像理解与生成的复杂任务上进行比较。
AI.result: 表示层面：生成丰富了用于理解的视觉特征，而理解增强了用于生成的视觉-语言对齐；但当两目标强制经过同一计算路径时，一方趋于主导，任务解耦架构可避免这种不对称退化。任务层面：当理解与生成任务依赖共享知识时，存在正向双向迁移。系统层面：端到端UMM在明确需要图像理解与生成协同的复杂任务上优于匹配的规划器-执行器流水线。
AI.conclusion: UMMs的价值超越了统一接口本身：合适的专化设计、共享任务知识以及端到端优化能够把共存转变为真正的协同。研究清晰刻画了理解与生成目标在不同层面的关系，为统一多模态模型架构设计提供了实证指导。

title: EDGE: Error Dependency Graph-Guided Multi-Error Attribution in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM) agent failures often contain multiple related errors rather than a single mistake. Existing attribution methods usually identify a responsible agent, step, or root cause, but do not explicitly model dependency between errors. We introduce EDGE, an Error Dependency Graph-guided multi-Error attribution framework. EDGE constructs an error dependency graph from observed error events and validates a reliable causal subset through counterfactual rollout. The inference graph guides a two-stage LLM-as-judge detector for error attribution, and the intervention-validated subgraph provides a more reliable basis for explanation and repair analysis. Experiments on TRAIL and MAST show that EDGE improves category-level multi-error attribution across most evaluated models and settings. Experiments with adapted Who&When-style prompts show that the graph helps across prompting strategies. These results suggest that dependency structure is a useful diagnostic prior for agent failures beyond isolated root-cause prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出EDGE框架，通过构建错误依赖图并进行反事实干预验证，以显式建模多错误间的依赖关系，从而提升大语言模型智能体失败场景中多错误归因的准确性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体的失败往往包含多个相互关联的错误，而现有归因方法通常只识别单一的负责智能体、步骤或根因，未显式建模错误之间的依赖关系。
AI.method: EDGE框架包含两部分：首先从观察到的错误事件构建错误依赖图，并通过反事实回滚（counterfactual rollout）验证出可靠的因果子集；随后该推断图引导一个两阶段的LLM-as-judge检测器进行错误归因，干预验证后的子图为解释与修复分析提供更可靠的依据。
AI.result: 在TRAIL和MAST数据集上的实验表明，EDGE在大多数评测模型和设置下提升了类别级多错误归因性能；在改编的Who&When风格提示实验中，依赖图在多种提示策略下均带来增益。
AI.conclusion: 依赖结构可作为智能体失败诊断中超越孤立根因预测的有效先验，有助于更可靠地解释与修复多错误失败场景。

title: Knowledge Distillation During Mid-Training Favors Reasoning over Factual Recall
comment: 33 pages, 13 figures, 9 tables. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/midtraining-distillation
summary: Logit-based knowledge distillation (KD) is used to train smaller language models (LMs) via supervision from stronger teachers, but whether its benefits are consistent across training stages remains unclear. Through controlled experiments, we find that forward Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation--the standard KD formulation--with post-trained teachers behaves fundamentally differently during mid-training, an intermediate phase of self-supervised learning on curated corpora. Surprisingly, while forward KD simultaneously improves reasoning and factual recall during pre-training relative to standard next-token prediction (NTP), it instead slows factual recall acquisition during mid-training despite continued reasoning gains. We trace this stage dependence to an asymmetry in teacher confidence across data domains and the student's evolving knowledge state: teachers are more confident on procedural than knowledge-intensive data, while students acquire low-entropy factual knowledge earlier in training. To mitigate this imbalance, we propose Switch Distillation, a simple mid-training objective that distills on tokens where the teacher is confident, using teacher predictive entropy as a lightweight routing signal, and otherwise falls back to cross-entropy. Switch Distillation consistently outperforms existing distillation objectives across teacher sizes. Relative to standard NTP, it achieves 1.61-1.71x the reasoning performance and 1.13-1.19x the knowledge and commonsense performance while preserving 96.7-96.8% of factual recall. Crucially, these benefits persist after post-training: Switch Distillation closes the factual recall gap while maintaining 1.25-1.32x and 1.13-1.20x gains in reasoning and knowledge and commonsense, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文发现基于logit的蒸馏（尤其是前向KL散度）在预训练与中期训练阶段效果不一致：中期训练中虽然提升推理能力，却拖慢事实知识回忆的获取。作者提出Switch Distillation，通过教师预测熵作为路由信号，只对教师高置信度的token进行蒸馏、其余回退到交叉熵，从而在推理、知识与常识上均超越现有蒸馏目标，并在后训练后保持收益。
AI.motivation: 现有的logit蒸馏（前向KL）对较小语言模型的收益是否在各训练阶段保持一致尚不明确。作者通过受控实验发现，使用后训练教师的前向KL蒸馏在中期训练阶段呈现本质不同的行为：与标准下一token预测相比，虽然持续带来推理增益，却减慢了事实回忆的获取，其根因在于教师在不同数据域上的置信度不对称与学生知识状态的变化。
AI.method: 提出Switch Distillation：一种简单的中期训练目标，以教师预测熵作为轻量路由信号，仅对教师置信度高的token进行蒸馏，其余token回退到标准交叉熵；通过该机制缓解教师置信度与数据域的不平衡，消除中期训练中的阶段依赖性退化。
AI.result: Switch Distillation在不同教师规模下一致优于现有蒸馏目标。相对于标准NTP，它达到1.61-1.71x的推理性能、1.13-1.19x的知识与常识性能，同时保留96.7-96.8%的事实回忆；后训练后事实回忆差距被弥合，推理与知识/常识增益分别保持1.25-1.32x和1.13-1.20x。
AI.conclusion: 阶段依赖是蒸馏设计的关键因素：前向KL在中期训练中系统性损害事实回忆获取。Switch Distillation通过基于教师置信度的选择性蒸馏，在推理、知识与常识与事实回忆之间取得更优权衡，且其收益在后训练后持续保持，为中期阶段的KD目标设计提供了新的范式。

title: A survey of AI-generated voices and their detection
summary: The ability of artificial intelligence (AI) models to generate highly realistic human voices has advanced rapidly. These technologies power accessibility tools, virtual assistants and creative applications, but they also enable harmful uses, including impersonation, fraud and disinformation. Recent incidents of voice cloning scams targeting businesses and political leaders underscore the urgent need for robust safeguards. Unlike image and video deepfakes, the detection of synthetic voices poses unique challenges due to the complexity of phonetics, prosody and auditory perception. This survey offers a comprehensive overview of AI voice generation and detection methods, encompassing both the technical foundations and the latest state-of-the-art advances. This study also identifies key open challenges, benchmark resources and future directions to make this survey useful for future researchers.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于人工智能语音生成与检测的综述，系统梳理了语音合成与伪造检测的技术基础与最新进展，并指出现有基准资源、开放挑战与未来研究方向，旨在为后续研究者提供参考。
AI.motivation: 人工智能生成高度逼真的人类语音技术发展迅速，虽然支撑了无障碍工具、虚拟助手和创意应用，但也带来冒充、欺诈和虚假信息等有害用途。近期针对企业和政要的语音克隆诈骗事件凸显了建立可靠防护措施的紧迫性。与图像和视频深度伪造不同，语音伪造检测因语音学、韵律和听觉感知的复杂性面临独特挑战，亟需系统的综述来梳理现状。
AI.method: 采用综述（survey）方法，对AI语音生成与检测方法进行全面梳理，涵盖技术基础和最新最先进（state-of-the-art）进展，并系统性地归纳关键开放挑战、基准资源与未来研究方向。
AI.result: 研究识别并总结了语音伪造检测领域的关键开放挑战、基准（benchmark）资源以及未来研究方向，为后续研究人员提供了可用的参考框架。
AI.conclusion: 语音生成与检测是一个兼具技术价值与社会安全意义的领域；通过系统综述，本文阐明其技术全景、现存难题与演进脉络，为构建稳健的语音伪造防护体系及引导未来研究提供了方向性指引。

title: Lightweight Adaptation of EEG Foundation Models for Stroke Motor Imagery Decoding: Domain Shift and Subject-Level Robustness
summary: Motor imagery (MI) electroencephalography (EEG) decoding could support post-stroke rehabilitation, but models developed on healthy cohorts may not transfer reliably to pathological EEG. We evaluated whether Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can efficiently adapt three pretrained EEG foundation models (i.e., LaBraM-base, REVE-base, and REVE-large) for binary left- versus right-hand MI decoding. Frozen-backbone head-only baselines and LoRA adaptation were evaluated using subject-wise five-fold cross-validation on the PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset and a binary subset of the UET175 dataset comprising 30 stroke participants. On EEGMMIDB, LoRA increased accuracy to 0.822 for LaBraM-base and 0.957 for REVE-base. On UET175, all head-only models performed near chance. With LoRA, LaBraM-base remained near chance (0.499$\pm$0.009), whereas REVE-base reached 0.847$\pm$0.194 and outperformed REVE-large (0.806$\pm$0.178), indicating that increased model capacity alone did not improve stroke-domain adaptation. The strongest stroke configuration, REVE-base LoRA, was further evaluated using within-cohort leave-one-subject-out cross-validation (LOOCV), showing 0.952 mean accuracy, but subject-wise accuracy ranged from 0.586 to 1.000, revealing a small low-performing tail. Zero-shot transfer from EEGMMIDB to UET175 remained near chance (0.464$\pm$0.072). These findings show that healthy-benchmark performance does not ensure transfer to stroke EEG. Translation of EEG foundation models to pseudo-online or real-time rehabilitation BCIs should therefore include target-domain adaptation and subject-level assessment of temporal informativeness, spatial sensitivity, and physiological discriminability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用低秩适配（LoRA）将三个预训练EEG基础模型（LaBraM-base、REVE-base、REVE-large）高效适配到左右手运动想象（MI）解码任务上，重点对比了健康人群基准与脑卒中患者数据（UET175）上的迁移性能，发现健康基准指标并不能保证向病理EEG的迁移，目标域适配和受试者级评估对康复BCI至关重要。
AI.motivation: 运动想象脑电解码可支持卒中后康复，但基于健康人群训练的模型可能无法可靠迁移到病理EEG上。需要探索一种高效的适配方法（LoRA），并验证其在健康受试者与卒中患者上的迁移能力差距，以指导EEG基础模型向真实康复BCI的转化。
AI.method: 采用低秩适配（LoRA）分别适配三个预训练EEG基础模型（LaBraM-base、REVE-base、REVE-large），并以冻结骨干仅训练分类头的基线作为对照；在PhysioNet EEGMMIDB健康数据集和包含30名卒中参与者的UET175二元子集上进行受试者级五折交叉验证；对最优配置（REVE-base+LoRA）进一步进行队列内留一受试者交叉验证（LOOCV），并评估了从EEGMMIDB到UET175的零样本迁移。
AI.result: 在EEGMMIDB上，LoRA使LaBraM-base准确率达0.822、REVE-base达0.957。在UET175上，所有仅训练分类头的模型均接近随机水平；采用LoRA后LaBraM-base仍接近随机（0.499±0.009），而REVE-base达0.847±0.194并优于REVE-large（0.806±0.178），说明单纯增加模型容量并不能改善卒中域适配。最强配置REVE-base+LoRA在LOOCV下平均准确率为0.952，但受试者间波动大（0.586~1.000），存在少数低表现尾部；跨数据集零样本迁移接近随机（0.464±0.072）。
AI.conclusion: 健康基准上的优异表现并不能确保向卒中EEG的成功迁移。将EEG基础模型部署到伪在线或实时康复BCI时，必须包含目标域适配，并从时间信息量、空间敏感性和生理可判别性三个维度开展受试者级评估。

title: SDARE-Bench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Conversational Stigma Detection and Response in Dyadic and Group Dialogue
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in advice seeking and decision making that may affect social judgements. Despite stigma's profound effects on people and communities, benchmarks remain scarce. Existing general-domain evaluations typically rely on static prompts and fixed-format tasks, overlooking conversational contexts and audience effects in everyday communication. To address these gaps, we introduce SDARE-Bench, the first scenario-based benchmark evaluating both stigma detection and open-ended response generation in LLMs, comprising 1,138 dyadic queries and 1,388 group dialogue. Empirical results across 8 LLMs consistently demonstrate poor identification of stigma components, especially in group dialogues. In open-ended response generation, stigma expression was substantially higher in group settings than in dyadic, with weaker resistance to stigma and more unrealistic advice. Responses were evaluated using a classifier trained on 1,392 human annotated responses. In constructed group pressure settings, stigma expression rates further increased to a striking average of 97.5%. Our findings identify stigma response as a recurring LLM safety vulnerability, especially in socially complex conversational contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出了 SDARE-Bench——首个面向 LLM 的耻辱感（stigma）检测与开放回复生成的情景化基准，包含 1,138 条双人对话与 1,388 条群体对话，并通过 8 个 LLM 的实验发现群体情境下耻辱感识别差、表达率高（高压情境下达 97.5%），揭示耻辱感应对是 LLM 反复出现的 safety 漏洞。
AI.motivation: LLM 越来越多地用于可能影响社会判断的求助与决策场景；尽管耻辱感对个人和社区影响深远，相关评测基准仍然稀缺。现有通用域评测依赖静态提示与固定格式任务，忽视了日常沟通中的会话上下文和受众效应，需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建 SDARE-Bench，首个情景化基准，同时评测 LLM 的耻辱感检测与开放式回复生成；数据包含 1,138 条双人查询和 1,388 条群体对话，并在构造的群体压力情境下进行测试。回复质量由基于 1,392 条人工标注回复训练的分类器进行评估。
AI.result: 在 8 个 LLM 上的实验显示，模型对耻辱感成分的识别普遍较差，尤其在群体对话中。开放式回复生成方面，群体设定下的耻辱感表达显著高于双人设定，对抗耻辱感的能力更弱且建议更不切实际；在构造的群体压力情境下，耻辱感表达率平均飙升至 97.5%。
AI.conclusion: 耻辱感应对被识别为 LLM 反复出现的安全漏洞，尤其是在社交复杂的会话情境中；该基准为后续研究提供了评估与改进的方向。

title: EdiTikZ: Scientific Figure Editing from Revision Trajectories
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong performance in generating scientific figures from text or images. However, producing publication-ready figures requires iterative refinement, making scientific figure editing an important yet largely unexplored task. Existing approaches rely on costly proprietary agentic systems, focus primarily on evaluation, or construct training supervision from synthetically generated edits. Instead, we leverage naturally occurring scientific revision and development trajectories as a scalable source of supervision. To this end, we introduce DaEdiTikZ, the first large-scale dataset of revision-derived scientific figure edits, constructed by mining 391K plausible TikZ edit pairs from arXiv, GitHub, and TeX SE and inferring 781K directed edit instructions with a VLM conditioned on rendered figures and TikZ code. We further introduce DaEdiTikZ-Bench, a human-refined benchmark with 790 instances, and train two compact Qwen3.5-based EdiTikZ models (4B and 9B) by jointly learning reconstruction and editing, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) with complementary rewards for rendered fidelity and edit application. Automatic evaluation places our 9B model above all tested baselines, while human evaluation with 9 annotators and 4,320 ratings places it above GPT-5.6-Sol and on par with Gemini-3.1-Pro. Under severe out-of-distribution shifts, it remains competitive with GPT-5.6-Sol near its 2K training sequence-length regime. Models and datasets will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于自然发生的科学修订轨迹构建的大规模图表编辑数据集DaEdiTikZ（含391K个TikZ编辑对及781K条由VLM推断的编辑指令），并据此训练紧凑型EdiTikZ模型（4B/9B），通过联合重建与编辑学习及带互补奖励的强化学习，在自动评测中超越所有基线，人工评测中超越GPT-5.6-Sol、与Gemini-3.1-Pro相当。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型可从文本或图像生成科学图表，但生成出版级图表需要迭代精修，因此科学图表编辑是一项重要且尚未充分探索的任务。现有方法依赖昂贵的专有智能体系统、仅侧重评估、或基于合成编辑构建训练监督，缺乏可扩展且自然的监督来源。本文利用自然发生的科学修订与发展轨迹作为可扩展的监督信号。
AI.method: 1) 构建DaEdiTikZ数据集：从arXiv、GitHub和TeX Stack Exchange挖掘391K个合理的TikZ编辑对，并用VLM基于渲染图像与TikZ代码推断出781K条有向编辑指令；2) 构建人工精炼基准DaEdiTikZ-Bench，含790个实例；3) 训练基于Qwen3.5的紧凑型EdiTikZ模型（4B和9B），联合学习重建与编辑任务，并通过带互补奖励（渲染保真度与编辑应用）的强化学习进行优化。
AI.result: 自动评估中9B模型优于所有测试基线；人工评估（9名标注者、4320条评分）显示其优于GPT-5.6-Sol、与Gemini-3.1-Pro相当；在严重的分布外偏移下，在约2K训练序列长度区间内仍与GPT-5.6-Sol保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过挖掘自然修订轨迹而非合成数据，可有效且可扩展地训练紧凑型科学图表编辑模型；模型与数据集将公开发布，以推动该方向研究。

title: A systematic Approach to constructing a Chance-and-Risk Matrix for Semiconductor Supply Chains
comment: Copyright 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary: Semiconductor supply chains face escalating risks from geopolitical tensions, geographic concentration, and rapid technological shifts, yet no scalable system continuously extracts, structures, and prioritizes risk intelligence from public corporate disclosures. We present an end-to-end pipeline that retrieves corporate documents for semiconductor companies and uses large language models (LLMs) to extract the risks and opportunities they describe. It organizes these into a knowledge graph linking each item to its category, sources, and related events, then merges duplicates and ranks them with a three-layer mechanism combining an algorithmic formula, an LLM relevance adjustment, and expert validation. Applied to five companies across the value chain, the pipeline produces 76,207 scored items, of which an independent check finds 92.6% valid. The automated rankings match expert judgment at an average Spearman correlation of 0.55 for risks and 0.72 for opportunities, and the resulting matrices identify trade restrictions as the dominant cross-company risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端流水线，利用大语言模型从半导体企业的公开公司披露文件中持续提取、结构化并优先排序风险与机遇信息，构建知识图谱并进行三层排序，经五家价值链企业验证，产出76,207条评分条目，独立检验有效性达92.6%，自动化排序与专家判断的平均Spearman相关系数分别为0.55（风险）与0.72（机遇），并识别出贸易限制是跨企业最突出的风险。
AI.motivation: 半导体供应链面临地缘政治紧张、地理集中和快速技术变革带来的日益严重的风险，但目前缺乏可扩展的系统能够从公开公司披露中持续提取、结构化并优先排序风险情报，因此亟需自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 构建端到端流水线：首先检索半导体公司的企业文档，使用大语言模型（LLM）提取其中描述的风险与机遇；随后将这些条目组织成知识图谱，将其与类别、来源及相关事件相链接；再通过去重合并，并采用三层排序机制（算法公式、LLM相关性调整、专家验证）对条目进行排序。
AI.result: 在覆盖价值链的5家公司上进行应用，产出76,207条评分条目，独立检查显示其中92.6%有效；自动化排序与专家判断的平均Spearman相关系数对风险为0.55、对机遇为0.72；生成的风险矩阵将贸易限制识别为最突出的跨公司风险。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线能够以高有效性和与专家判断良好的一致性，实现半导体供应链风险情报的规模化、持续自动化提取与排序，验证了其实际可用性，并可为供应链风险管理提供可操作、可量化的决策支持。

title: Parsing the Stream: A Live Trace Model for Long-Horizon Agents and Their Observers
summary: A long-horizon agent's trace outgrows both of its consumers: the human observer monitoring the run, and the agent itself, whose bounded context the trace must be folded back into. We present a live trace model, an append-only event ledger folded incrementally into typed run state and compiled into per-consumer views, and evaluate it for both consumers against deterministic ground truth. For the observer side, evaluated with an LLM reader as proxy, the compiled view answers monitoring questions using approximately 14x and 15x fewer input tokens (by reader) and at 5-7x lower cost than a budget-capped single-call reading of the raw trace, with higher accuracy (0.85-0.87 versus 0.48). Because the questions were co-designed with the view schema, we treat the token and cost reduction, conditional on schema coverage, as the transferable result. For the agent, on 120-link sequential-dependency tasks, mechanisms that maintain the task's running statistic in per-step state succeed where full-context prompting fails (30/30 versus 8/30 under a clean protocol, n=30, labeled descriptive owing to benchmark-system co-development); a prompt-level scratchpad matches the fold's accuracy at lower cost, and a two-arm decomposition attributes the fold's accuracy to its deterministic aggregate and its cost advantage to its compactness. The fold's remaining value over cheaper alternatives is deterministic auditability and serving the observer from the same state. We derive eleven candidate requirements for trace folding from observed failures and delimit them with an order-sensitive task family on which the fold ceases to help. Code, benchmarks, a regenerable synthetic corpus, and all workbench traces are released.

AI.tldr: 针对长程智能体运行轨迹超出人类观察者与智能体自身上下文容量的问题，提出"实时轨迹模型"：将追加式事件账本增量折叠为类型化运行状态，并编译为面向不同消费者的视图。实验显示，对观察者端（以 LLM 读者为代理），编译视图相比读取原始轨迹在监控问答上减少约 14-15 倍输入 token、成本降至 1/5-1/7，准确率从 0.48 提升至 0.85-0.87；对智能体端，在 120 步顺序依赖任务上，维持运行统计量的状态机制以 30/30 完胜全上下文提示的 8/30。折叠相比更廉价的替代方案（提示级草稿本）的剩余价值在于确定性可审计性，以及从同一状态服务观察者。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体的运行轨迹规模超出其两类消费者的处理能力：人类观察者需要监控运行过程，而智能体自身需将轨迹折回有界上下文。二者都面临轨迹"读不完"的问题，需要一个既能被增量吸收、又能为不同消费方提供适配视图的轨迹表示。
AI.method: 提出实时轨迹模型：以追加式事件账本（append-only event ledger）作为底层记录，通过增量折叠（folding）转换成类型化运行状态，并针对不同消费者编译为相应视图。对观察者端，以 LLM 读者为代理评估编译视图回答监控问题的效果；对智能体端，在 120 条顺序依赖任务上比较"在每步状态中维护任务运行统计量"、全上下文提示与提示级草稿本等机制，并通过两臂分解（two-arm decomposition）区分折叠在准确率（确定性聚合）与成本（紧凑性）上的贡献；同时从观测失败中归纳十一项轨迹折叠候选需求，并用对顺序敏感的任务族界定折叠失效的边界。
AI.result: 观察者端：编译视图回答监控问题较预算受限的单次原始轨迹读取减少约 14x/15x 输入 token（按读者不同），成本降低 5-7 倍，准确率 0.85-0.87 对 0.48。智能体端：维护运行统计量的每步状态机制在 120 步顺序依赖任务上 30/30 全成功，而全上下文提示仅 8/30（n=30，标注为描述性结果，因与基准系统协同开发）；提示级草稿本以更低成本达到与折叠相近的准确率。两臂分解显示折叠的准确率优势来自确定性聚合，成本优势来自紧凑性；折叠相对廉价替代方案的剩余价值是确定性可审计性及用同一状态服务观察者。此外归纳出十一项轨迹折叠候选需求，并以顺序敏感任务族展示了折叠失效的情形。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹折叠是一种兼顾两类消费者的有效机制：在观察者端显著降低 token 与成本并提升监控准确率，在智能体端使超长任务在有限上下文内可行。然而其价值主张需精确定位——当更廉价的提示级机制足以达到同等准确率时，折叠的核心剩余优势在于确定性可审计性与状态复用；同时通过顺序敏感任务族明确了其适用边界。作者指出部分结果带有描述性局限（问题与视图模式协同设计、基准与系统协同开发），并将 token/成本缩减（在 schema 覆盖条件下）视为可迁移结论，同时公开全部代码、基准与可再生的合成语料。

title: From Confusion to Clarity: Confusion-Aware Retrieval and Knowledge Injection for Text Classification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) struggle to classify text into taxonomies with many semantically similar labels, as the distinctions are domain-specific and not captured by pre-training. To handle large label spaces, a common approach retrieves top-$K$ candidate labels by embedding similarity and prompt the LLM to choose among them. However, top-$K$ retrieval reduces the number of candidates but does not help the model tell similar ones apart. When two similar labels both appear as candidates, the model lacks the signal to choose correctly between them. We propose a framework that (1) identifies which label pairs the model struggles to distinguish, (2) expands the candidate set to include confusable labels, and (3) generates targeted rules to differentiate between similar candidates. The framework requires no fine-tuning, and the generated rules transfer to smaller, cheaper models. On three benchmarks (WOS, Flipkart, LEDGAR), our approach improves Macro F1 by up to 10.0pp over retrieval baselines, with smaller models (2B--20B) gaining up to 11.5pp via cross-model transfer.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型在大型标签体系（含许多语义相近标签）下分类困难的问题，提出一个无需微调的框架：先识别模型易混淆的标签对，再扩充候选集加入易混淆标签，并生成针对性规则来区分相似候选。在WOS、Flipkart、LEDGAR三个基准上，Macro F1最高比检索式基线提升10.0个百分点，且生成规则可迁移至更小模型（2B–20B），最高带来11.5个百分点的提升。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型难以将文本分类到包含大量语义相近标签的体系中，因为这些标签之间的区别是领域特定的，预训练并未捕获。现有常见方案是通过嵌入相似度检索Top-K候选标签再让LLM选择，但这只是减少候选数量，并不能帮助模型区分相似标签——当两个相似标签同时出现在候选中时，模型缺乏正确选择的判别信号。
AI.method: 提出一个三步框架：(1) 识别模型难以区分的标签对；(2) 将易混淆标签扩充进候选集合；(3) 生成有针对性的规则以区分相似候选标签。该框架无需微调，且生成的规则可迁移到更小、更便宜的模型上。
AI.result: 在WOS、Flipkart、LEDGAR三个基准上，该方法相对检索式基线在Macro F1上最高提升10.0个百分点；通过跨模型迁移，较小的模型（2B–20B）最高获得11.5个百分点的提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式识别混淆标签对并生成判别规则，可以显著提升LLM在大型、语义相近标签体系上的分类表现，且该方法轻量、无需微调，规则具有良好的跨模型可迁移性，能够增强小模型能力。

title: Harness-of-Harness: Multi-Day Autonomous Software Development with Continual Improvement
summary: This paper studies autonomous software development, in which LLM-based coding agents transform high-level requirements into complete, functional, and usable software systems without human intervention. We introduce Harness-of-Harness (HoH), a framework that enables coding agents to continually improve software during autonomous development. HoH operates on existing coding-agent harnesses, and organizes their executions into iterative planning-coding-testing loops. To sustain improvement across loops, HoH balances repair with capability growth, scopes development into small and verifiable increments, separates implementation-time testing from independent evaluation, and constrains verifiable outputs rather than prescribing agent workflows. It progressively exposes deliverables, role-specific tools, and skills, encourages reuse rather than recreation, and maintains versioned project histories. On GameCraft-Bench, FrontierSWE, and ProgramBench, three harness-model pairs (Codex with GPT-5.5, OpenCode with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and Pi with MiniMax-M3), HoH consistently outperforms the corresponding standalone harnesses, achieving an average relative gain of 52.25 percent and a maximum gain of 82.86 percent after three iterations. In a multi-day deployment with more than 70 iterations, HoH autonomously develops a first-person-shooter game, featuring a coherent storyline, fully implemented core mechanics, human-playable experience, polished visuals and integrated audio. Github: https://github.com/Flesymeb/HarnessOfHarness Project Page: https://flesymeb.github.io/HarnessOfHarness/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Harness-of-Harness (HoH) 框架，通过将现有编码智能体 harness 组织成迭代的规划-编码-测试循环，使 LLM 编码智能体能够在无人类干预下自主且持续地改进软件。在 GameCraft-Bench、FrontierSWE 和 ProgramBench 三个基准上，HoH 显著优于三个对应的独立 harness（平均相对提升 52.25%，最高 82.86%），并在多日、70 余次迭代的部署中自主开发出一款完整的第一人称射击游戏。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 编码智能体虽然能将高层需求转化为软件系统，但在完全自主的开发过程中缺乏持续改进的能力，难以平衡修复缺陷与能力增长，也难以将复杂开发任务分解为可验证的小步增量。
AI.method: HoH 在现有编码智能体 harness 之上运作，将其执行组织为规划-编码-测试的迭代循环。为确保持续改进，它平衡了缺陷修复与能力增长，将开发划分为小而可验证的增量，将实现期测试与独立评估分离，并只约束可验证的输出而非规定具体工作流；同时渐进式地暴露交付物、角色专用工具与技能，鼓励复用而非重建，并维护带版本历史记录的项目档案。
AI.result: 在 GameCraft-Bench、FrontierSWE 和 ProgramBench 上，三组 harness-模型配对（Codex+GPT-5.5、OpenCode+DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Pi+MiniMax-M3）均持续超越对应独立 harness，三次迭代后平均相对提升 52.25%，最高 82.86%；在一次多日、70 余次迭代的部署中，自主开发出一款具备连贯剧情、完整核心机制、可玩体验、精致画面和集成音频的第一人称射击游戏。
AI.conclusion: HoH 证明了通过对现有 harness 进行结构化编排（而非重新设计智能体），能够显著增强编码智能体在长期自主软件开发中的持续改进能力与最终产出质量，为完全自主的软件开发提供了一条通用且有效的框架路径。

title: From Production Traffic to Post-Training: Building a Self-Hosted LLM That Covers the Corporate Request Mix
summary: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool. We consolidate traffic from over 200 internal applications onto a single model by closing quality gaps identified through production error analysis along three axes: instruction following, function-calling, and internal task distribution. Quality is tracked by offline benchmarks stratified to production traffic and scored by deterministic verifiers or calibrated LLM judges. Rather than optimising all objectives jointly, which introduces cross-domain reward interference, we train a separate GRPO expert per axis and merge them via two-stage SLERP. Each expert's reward exposes a distinct failure mode, namely semantic collapse, over-calling, and verbosity hacking, each requiring a domain-specific fix. In non-reasoning mode the recipe surpasses a ${\sim}7\times$ larger by total parameters baseline on the in-house Arena with 69.6 to 65.8, instruction following with 0.85 to 0.83, and function-calling with 0.79 to 0.77, while lifting general dialogue benchmarks. The model absorbs 50% of platform traffic, 116M requests per month, at a fraction of the serving cost.

AI.tldr: 企业因数据驻留约束需要自托管LLM，本文通过将200多个内部应用流量整合到单一模型上，采用分轴训练GRPO专家并经两阶段SLERP合并的方法，在推理（非reasoning）模式下以约1/7参数量超越基线，覆盖平台50%流量（每月1.16亿请求），大幅降低服务成本。
AI.motivation: 数据驻留约束迫使企业自托管LLM，但持续引入新模型而不淘汰旧模型会扩大服务集群，使有限的GPU池碎片化；因此需要在不牺牲质量的前提下将多样化应用流量整合到单一模型。
AI.method: 通过生产环境错误分析沿三个轴（指令遵循、函数调用、内部任务分布）识别并弥合质量差距；质量由按生产流量分层的离线基准衡量，采用确定性验证器或校准过的LLM裁判打分。为避免跨域奖励干扰，不联合优化所有目标，而是为每个轴单独训练GRPO专家，再用两阶段SLERP合并。各专家奖励暴露了不同失效模式（语义坍缩、过度调用、冗长性黑客），均需针对性修复。
AI.result: 在非推理模式下，该方案以总参数约为基线1/7的模型超越基线：内部Arena得分69.6对65.8，指令遵循0.85对0.83，函数调用0.79对0.77，并提升通用对话基准。模型吸收了平台50%流量（每月1.16亿请求），服务成本大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 针对生产流量分布定制、按轴隔离训练并合并专家、且各轴配备专用奖励与失效修复的配方，可在显著降低算力/服务成本的同时实现质量超越更大基线，为数据驻留约束下的企业LLM整合提供了可行路径。

title: When Guardrails Look Effective: Construct Validity Failures in LLM Agent Commerce Evaluation
comment: Submitted to the NeurIPS 2026 Trust-AI-Eval Workshop. 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. The accompanying artifact is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/a2a-evaluation-artifact-staging-2F25/
summary: Interactive simulations increasingly evaluate policies in markets populated by language-model agents. Their outputs can look economic---prices, profits, consumer surplus, and welfare---without instantiating the behavior named in the claim. We audit this risk in a multi-turn buyer--seller testbed for configurable hotel transactions. An initial implementation reported welfare gains from two marketplace guardrails of +87.4, +35.0, and +28.8 across a Qwen2.5 1.5B--14B ladder. It also gave guarded and unguarded agents different offer schemas and choice procedures. Holding the schema and buyer chooser fixed changes the paired contrasts to +7.2, -13.9, and +23.8. The four largest 14B single-generation effects averaged +229; after three generations per profile-condition, they averaged +37.6 (95% bootstrap interval [-34.2, 109.3]), while generation residuals account for 49.9% of variation in this post-hoc probe. A seller-incentive check is non-monotone: increasing profit pressure produces less profit than the default seller prompt. Scripted positive controls show why this matters.
